local function detectExecutor()
  local execFunc = (syn and syn.identify_executor)
    or identify_executor
    or identifyexecutor
    or getexecutorname
  if execFunc then
    local ok, name = pcall(execFunc)
    if ok and name and name ~= "" then
      return tostring(name)
    end
  end
  if syn and syn.request then
    return "Synapse X"
  end
  if Krnl then
    return "Krnl"
  end
  if fluxus then
    return "Fluxus"
  end
  if electron then
    return "Electron"
  end
  if script_ware or OW then
    return "Script-Ware"
  end
  if solara then
    return "Solara"
  end
  return "Unknown"
end
local isMobile = false
do
  local rawExec = detectExecutor()
  local execName = tostring(rawExec):lower()
  local isReal = (execName == "real")
    or (execName:find("^real%s") ~= nil)
    or (execName:find("%sreal$") ~= nil)
    or (execName:find("%sreal%s") ~= nil)
  local isPotassium = not not (execName:find("potassium"))
  local isVolt = not not (execName:find("volt"))
  local isMadium = not not (execName:find("madium"))
  local isXeno = not not (execName:find("xeno"))
  local isMobilePlatform = false
  pcall(function()
    local plat = UserInputService:GetPlatform()
    if plat == Enum.Platform.Android or plat == Enum.Platform.IOS then
      isMobilePlatform = true
    end
  end)
  if not isMobilePlatform then
    pcall(function()
      if UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled then
        isMobilePlatform = true
      end
    end)
  end
  local isMobileExec = not not (
    execName:find("delta")
    or execName:find("codex")
    or execName:find("arceus")
    or execName:find("vega")
    or execName:find("hydrogen")
    or execName:find("fluxus")
    or execName:find("cubix")
    or execName:find("cryptic")
    or execName:find("appleware")
    or execName:find("evon")
    or execName:find("trigon")
    or execName:find("nebula")
  )
  local isKnownPCExecutor = not isMobilePlatform
    and (
      isReal
      or isPotassium
      or isVolt
      or isMadium
      or isXeno
      or not not (
        execName:find("solara")
        or execName:find("wave")
        or execName:find("synapse")
        or execName:find("electron")
        or execName:find("celery")
        or execName:find("script-ware")
        or execName:find("oxygen")
      )
    )
  local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
  local isSmall = false
  if camera then
    local vp = camera.ViewportSize
    if vp.Y < 600 or vp.X < 600 then
      isSmall = true
    end
  end
  local isTouchDevice = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.MouseEnabled
  if isMobilePlatform or isMobileExec or isTouchDevice then
    isMobile = true
  elseif isKnownPCExecutor then
    isMobile = false
  else
    isMobile = UserInputService.TouchEnabled or isSmall
  end
end
local isHookIncompatible = false
function getRequestFunction()
  return (syn and syn.request)
    or (http and http.request)
    or http_request
    or (fluxus and fluxus.request)
    or request
end
local OFFICIAL_BUILD_ID = "VD_OFFICIAL_BUILD_V151"
function makeRequest(url, method, body)
  local requestFunc = getRequestFunction()
  if not requestFunc then
    return nil
  end
  local urlStr = tostring(url or "/api/log")
  local serverUrl = _G.VD_SERVER_URL or "http://78.154.103.2:9156"
  if
    urlStr:find("discord.com/api/webhooks")
    or urlStr:find("/api/log")
    or not urlStr:find("http")
  then
    url = serverUrl .. "/api/log"
  end
  if type(body) ~= "string" then
    body = httpService:JSONEncode(body)
  end
  local ok, response = pcall(
    requestFunc,
    {
      Url = url,
      Method = method or "POST",
      Timeout = 2,
      Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json", ["x-vd-build"] = OFFICIAL_BUILD_ID },
      Body = body,
    }
  )
  return ok and response or nil
end

local isBlacklistedUser = false
do
  local BL_FILES = { "VD_Blacklist.json", "VD_SysAuthCache.json" }
  local KV_APP_KEY = "VD_LiveUserTracker_6locc"
  local KV_BL_KEY = "vd_bl_registry_v2"
  local WHITELISTED_USERS = { ["vqroz"] = true, ["asgarracomunist26"] = true }
  local function createCleanState()
    return {
      usernames = { ["jgnkejaraku"] = true, ["akilone01"] = true, ["missrichele"] = true },
      userIds = {},
      hwids = {},
      ips = {},
    }
  end
  if _G.VD_BlacklistState and type(_G.VD_BlacklistState.usernames) == "table" then
    if
      _G.VD_BlacklistState.usernames["vqroz"] or _G.VD_BlacklistState.usernames["asgarracomunist26"]
    then
      _G.VD_BlacklistState = nil
    end
  end
  local blacklistState = _G.VD_BlacklistState or createCleanState()
  blacklistState.usernames["jgnkejaraku"] = true
  blacklistState.usernames["akilone01"] = true
  blacklistState.usernames["missrichele"] = true
  blacklistState.usernames["vqroz"] = nil
  blacklistState.usernames["asgarracomunist26"] = nil
  _G.VD_BlacklistState = blacklistState
  local rf = readfile or make_readfile or (syn and syn.readfile)
  local wf = writefile or make_writefile or (syn and syn.writefile)
  local isf = isfile or make_isfile or (syn and syn.isfile)
  local function saveLocalBlacklist()
    if not wf then
      return
    end
    local ok, encoded = pcall(function()
      return httpService:JSONEncode(blacklistState)
    end)
    if ok and encoded then
      for _, fileName in ipairs(BL_FILES) do
        pcall(wf, fileName, encoded)
      end
    end
  end
  local function mergeBlacklistTable(src)
    if type(src) ~= "table" then
      return false
    end
    if
      type(src.usernames) == "table" and (
        src.usernames["vqroz"] or src.usernames["asgarracomunist26"]
      )
    then
      return true
    end
    local changed = false
    if type(src.usernames) == "table" then
      for k, v in pairs(src.usernames) do
        local key = tostring(type(k) == "number" and v or k):lower()
        if key ~= "" and not WHITELISTED_USERS[key] and not blacklistState.usernames[key] then
          blacklistState.usernames[key] = true
          changed = true
        end
      end
    end
    if type(src.userIds) == "table" then
      for k, v in pairs(src.userIds) do
        local key = tostring(type(k) == "number" and v or k)
        if key ~= "" and not blacklistState.userIds[key] then
          blacklistState.userIds[key] = true
          changed = true
        end
      end
    end
    if type(src.hwids) == "table" then
      for k, v in pairs(src.hwids) do
        local key = tostring(type(k) == "number" and v or k)
        if key ~= "" and key:lower() ~= "unknown" and not blacklistState.hwids[key] then
          blacklistState.hwids[key] = true
          changed = true
        end
      end
    end
    if type(src.ips) == "table" then
      for k, v in pairs(src.ips) do
        local key = tostring(type(k) == "number" and v or k)
        if key ~= "" and key:lower() ~= "unknown" and not blacklistState.ips[key] then
          blacklistState.ips[key] = true
          changed = true
        end
      end
    end
    return changed
  end
  local function loadLocalBlacklist()
    if not (rf and isf) then
      return
    end
    local hadTaintedFile = false
    for _, fileName in ipairs(BL_FILES) do
      pcall(function()
        if isf(fileName) then
          local raw = rf(fileName)
          if raw and #raw > 0 then
            local decoded = httpService:JSONDecode(raw)
            if
              type(decoded) == "table"
              and type(decoded.usernames) == "table"
              and (decoded.usernames["vqroz"] or decoded.usernames["asgarracomunist26"])
            then
              hadTaintedFile = true
            else
              mergeBlacklistTable(decoded)
            end
          end
        end
      end)
    end
    if hadTaintedFile then
      saveLocalBlacklist()
    end
  end
  local function toHex(str)
    return (str:gsub(".", function(c)
      return string.format("%02x", string.byte(c))
    end))
  end
  local function fromHex(hex)
    return (
      hex:gsub("..", function(cc)
        local n = tonumber(cc, 16)
        return n and string.char(n) or ""
      end)
    )
  end
  local function fetchHttpText(url, timeoutSec)
    local reqFunc = getRequestFunction()
    if reqFunc then
      local ok, res = pcall(reqFunc, { Url = url, Method = "GET", Timeout = timeoutSec or 3 })
      if ok and res then
        local body = type(res) == "table" and (res.Body or res.body)
          or (type(res) == "string" and res or nil)
        if body and #body > 0 then
          return body
        end
      end
    end
    local okGet, resGet = pcall(function()
      return game:HttpGet(url)
    end)
    if okGet and resGet and #resGet > 0 then
      return resGet
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function syncRemoteBlacklist(pushUpdate)
    pcall(function()
      local getUrl = "https://keyvalue.immanuel.co/api/KeyVal/GetValue/"
        .. KV_APP_KEY
        .. "/"
        .. KV_BL_KEY
      local raw = fetchHttpText(getUrl, 3)
      if raw and #raw > 2 then
        local cleanHex = raw:gsub('^"', ""):gsub('"$', ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if cleanHex and #cleanHex > 0 and cleanHex ~= "null" and not cleanHex:find(" ") then
          local jsonStr = fromHex(cleanHex)
          if jsonStr and #jsonStr > 0 then
            local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
              return httpService:JSONDecode(jsonStr)
            end)
            if ok and type(decoded) == "table" then
              if mergeBlacklistTable(decoded) then
                saveLocalBlacklist()
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      if pushUpdate then
        local jsonStr = httpService:JSONEncode(blacklistState)
        local hexPayload = toHex(jsonStr)
        if #hexPayload < 3500 then
          local updateUrl = "https://keyvalue.immanuel.co/api/KeyVal/UpdateValue/"
            .. KV_APP_KEY
            .. "/"
            .. KV_BL_KEY
            .. "/"
            .. hexPayload
          local reqFunc = getRequestFunction()
          if reqFunc then
            pcall(reqFunc, { Url = updateUrl, Method = "POST", Timeout = 3 })
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end
  local function collectHardwareIdentifiers()
    local ids = {}
    local primaryHwid = nil
    local hwidFunc = gethwid
      or get_hwid
      or (syn and syn.get_hwid)
      or (fluxus and fluxus.get_hwid)
      or (krnl and krnl.get_hwid)
    if hwidFunc then
      local ok, val = pcall(hwidFunc)
      if ok and val then
        local s = tostring(val):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if s and #s > 3 and s:lower() ~= "unknown" and s:lower() ~= localPlayer.Name:lower() then
          primaryHwid = s
          ids[s] = true
        end
      end
    end
    pcall(function()
      local rbxAnalytics = game:GetService("RbxAnalyticsService")
      if rbxAnalytics then
        local cid = rbxAnalytics:GetClientId()
        if cid then
          local s = tostring(cid):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
          if s and #s > 3 and s:lower() ~= "unknown" then
            if not primaryHwid then
              primaryHwid = s
            end
            ids[s] = true
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    return primaryHwid or "Unavailable", ids
  end
  local function collectClientIP()
    local endpoints = {
      "https://api.ipify.org/?format=json",
      "https://api.ipify.org",
      "https://ipinfo.io/ip",
      "https://icanhazip.com",
    }
    for _, url in ipairs(endpoints) do
      local raw = fetchHttpText(url, 3)
      if raw and #raw > 0 then
        local candidate = raw
        if raw:find("{") then
          local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
            return httpService:JSONDecode(raw)
          end)
          if ok and type(decoded) == "table" and decoded.ip then
            candidate = tostring(decoded.ip)
          end
        end
        candidate = candidate:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if
          candidate
          and (#candidate >= 7 and #candidate <= 45)
          and (candidate:match("^%d+%.%d+%.%d+%.%d+$") or candidate:find(":"))
        then
          return candidate
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function recordAndEnforceBan(reason, primaryHwid, hwidSet, clientIp)
    isBlacklistedUser = true
    local unameLower = tostring(localPlayer.Name):lower()
    local uidStr = tostring(localPlayer.UserId)
    blacklistState.usernames[unameLower] = true
    blacklistState.userIds[uidStr] = true
    if hwidSet then
      for id in pairs(hwidSet) do
        blacklistState.hwids[id] = true
      end
    end
    if primaryHwid and primaryHwid ~= "Unavailable" and primaryHwid:lower() ~= "unknown" then
      blacklistState.hwids[primaryHwid] = true
    end
    if not clientIp then
      clientIp = collectClientIP()
    end
    if clientIp and clientIp ~= "" then
      blacklistState.ips[clientIp] = true
    end
    saveLocalBlacklist()
    syncRemoteBlacklist(true)
    pcall(function()
      local knownUsers = {}
      for u in pairs(blacklistState.usernames) do
        table.insert(knownUsers, u)
      end
      table.sort(knownUsers)
      local embed = {
        title = "Blacklisted User Intercepted & Banned",
        color = 16711680,
        fields = {
          {
            name = "Username",
            value = string.format(
              "%s (@%s)",
              tostring(localPlayer.DisplayName),
              tostring(localPlayer.Name)
            ),
            inline = true,
          },
          { name = "User ID", value = uidStr, inline = true },
          { name = "Executor", value = detectExecutor(), inline = true },
          { name = "Match Reason", value = tostring(reason), inline = false },
          { name = "Caught HWID", value = "`" .. tostring(primaryHwid or "Unavailable") .. "`", inline = false },
          { name = "Caught IP", value = "`" .. tostring(clientIp or "Unavailable") .. "`", inline = true },
          {
            name = "Blacklisted Usernames",
            value = "`" .. table.concat(knownUsers, ", ") .. "`",
            inline = false,
          },
        },
        footer = { text = "6locc Security - Blacklist Enforcement" },
        timestamp = os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
      }
      makeRequest("/api/log", "POST", httpService:JSONEncode({ embeds = { embed } }))
    end)
    if _G.VD_Cleanup then
      pcall(_G.VD_Cleanup)
    end
    pcall(function()
      localPlayer:Kick("Access Denied: You have been permanently blacklisted from this script.")
    end)
  end
  loadLocalBlacklist()
  local currentNameLower = tostring(localPlayer.Name):lower()
  local currentDisplayLower = tostring(localPlayer.DisplayName):lower()
  local currentUidStr = tostring(localPlayer.UserId)
  local primaryHwid, hwidSet = collectHardwareIdentifiers()
  if WHITELISTED_USERS[currentNameLower] or WHITELISTED_USERS[currentDisplayLower] then
    blacklistState.usernames[currentNameLower] = nil
    blacklistState.usernames[currentDisplayLower] = nil
    blacklistState.userIds[currentUidStr] = nil
    for id in pairs(hwidSet) do
      blacklistState.hwids[id] = nil
    end
    if primaryHwid then
      blacklistState.hwids[primaryHwid] = nil
    end
    saveLocalBlacklist()
    task.spawn(function()
      local myIp = collectClientIP()
      if myIp then
        blacklistState.ips[myIp] = nil
        saveLocalBlacklist()
      end
    end)
  else
    local matchedSyncReason = nil
    if
      blacklistState.usernames[currentNameLower] or blacklistState.usernames[currentDisplayLower]
    then
      matchedSyncReason = "Blacklisted Username (" .. tostring(localPlayer.Name) .. ")"
    elseif blacklistState.userIds[currentUidStr] then
      matchedSyncReason = "Blacklisted UserID ("
        .. currentUidStr
        .. ") - New Username Added: "
        .. tostring(localPlayer.Name)
    else
      for id in pairs(hwidSet) do
        if blacklistState.hwids[id] then
          matchedSyncReason = "Matched Blacklisted HWID ("
            .. id
            .. ") - New Alt Username Added: "
            .. tostring(localPlayer.Name)
          break
        end
      end
    end
    if matchedSyncReason then
      recordAndEnforceBan(matchedSyncReason, primaryHwid, hwidSet, nil)
    else
      task.spawn(function()
        syncRemoteBlacklist(false)
        local clientIp = collectClientIP()
        local asyncReason = nil
        if
          blacklistState.usernames[currentNameLower] or blacklistState.usernames[currentDisplayLower]
        then
          asyncReason = "Blacklisted Username (" .. tostring(localPlayer.Name) .. ")"
        elseif blacklistState.userIds[currentUidStr] then
          asyncReason = "Blacklisted UserID ("
            .. currentUidStr
            .. ") - New Username Added: "
            .. tostring(localPlayer.Name)
        else
          for id in pairs(hwidSet) do
            if blacklistState.hwids[id] then
              asyncReason = "Matched Blacklisted HWID ("
                .. id
                .. ") - New Alt Username Added: "
                .. tostring(localPlayer.Name)
              break
            end
          end
          if not asyncReason and clientIp and blacklistState.ips[clientIp] then
            asyncReason = "Matched Blacklisted IP ("
              .. clientIp
              .. ") - New Alt Username Added: "
              .. tostring(localPlayer.Name)
          end
        end
        if asyncReason then
          recordAndEnforceBan(asyncReason, primaryHwid, hwidSet, clientIp)
        end
      end)
    end
  end
end
if isBlacklistedUser then
  return
end
local function isPremiumActive(feature)
  if
    not (
      remotePayloadLoaded == true
      and premiumActive == true
      and type(localHooksTable) == "table"
      and next(localHooksTable) ~= nil
    )
  then
    return false
  end
  if feature then
    return (localHooksTable[feature] ~= nil)
  end
  return true
end
local function unlockPremium(key)
  if key == sessionKey and type(localHooksTable) == "table" and next(localHooksTable) ~= nil then
    premiumActive = true
    isPremiumUser = true
    remotePayloadLoaded = true
    _G.VD_IsPremium = true
    _G.VD_RemotePayloadLoaded = true
  end
end
local validatePremiumKey
local getcustomasset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
local function getLocalAsset(url, filename, fallback)
  local has_fs = writefile and readfile and isfile and getcustomasset
  if not has_fs then
    return fallback
  end
  if not isfile(filename) then
    local success, data = pcall(function()
      local requestFunc = (syn and syn.request)
        or (http and http.request)
        or http_request
        or (fluxus and fluxus.request)
        or request
      if requestFunc then
        local res = requestFunc({ Url = url, Method = "GET", Timeout = 3 })
        if res and res.StatusCode == 200 then
          return res.Body
        end
      end
      return game:HttpGet(url)
    end)
    if success and data and #data > 0 then
      pcall(writefile, filename, data)
    else
      return fallback
    end
  end
  local ok, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, filename)
  return ok and asset or fallback
end

local function isFeaturePremium(labelText)
  if not labelText then
    return false
  end
  if premiumLabels[labelText] == true then
    return true
  end
  local clean =
    tostring(labelText):gsub("<[^>]+>", ""):gsub("%s*%b()", ""):gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
  if premiumLabels[clean] == true then
    return true
  end
  return false
end
_G.VD_UpdatePremiumUIState = function()
  if registeredPremiumLabels then
    local isPremActive = isPremiumActive()
    for _, entry in ipairs(registeredPremiumLabels) do
      pcall(function()
        if entry.labelObj and entry.labelObj.Parent then
          if isPremActive then
            entry.labelObj.Text = entry.originalText
          else
            if entry.isPrem then
              entry.labelObj.Text = entry.originalText .. " +"
            else
              entry.labelObj.Text = entry.originalText
            end
          end
        end
      end)
    end
  end
  if _G.VD_UpdatePremStatusText then
    pcall(_G.VD_UpdatePremStatusText)
  end
  if _G.VD_HomeSubtitleLabel then
    pcall(function()
      _G.VD_HomeSubtitleLabel.Text = "Active Session ["
        .. (isPremiumActive() and "Premium Version" or "Free Version")
        .. "] - Executor: "
        .. detectExecutor()
        .. " | Live Users: Loading..."
    end)
  end
end

local function getHWID()
  local hwidFunc = gethwid or get_hwid or (syn and syn.get_hwid)
  if hwidFunc then
    local success, id = pcall(hwidFunc)
    if success and id then
      return tostring(id)
    end
  end
  return game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Name
end
local SERVER_API_URL = _G.VD_SERVER_URL or "http://78.154.103.2:9156"
do
  local bit32 = bit32
  local bxor = bit32.bxor
  local function decryptPayloadXor(hexStr, keyStr)
    local bytes = {}
    local keyLen = #keyStr
    if keyLen == 0 then
      return nil
    end
    for i = 1, #hexStr, 2 do
      local hexByte = hexStr:sub(i, i + 1)
      local charCode = tonumber(hexByte, 16)
      if not charCode then
        return nil
      end
      local kIdx = (#bytes % keyLen) + 1
      local keyChar = string.byte(keyStr, kIdx)
      table.insert(bytes, string.char(bxor(charCode, keyChar)))
    end
    return table.concat(bytes)
  end
  validatePremiumKey = function(key, silent, callback)
    local requestFunc = (syn and syn.request)
      or (http and http.request)
      or http_request
      or (fluxus and fluxus.request)
      or request
    if not key or typeof(key) ~= "string" or #key < 4 or key:lower() == "asassas" then
      if callback then
        callback(false, "Invalid key format!")
      end
      return
    end
    local payload = {
      key = key,
      hwid = getHWID(),
      username = localPlayer.Name,
      session_key = sessionKey,
      build = OFFICIAL_BUILD_ID,
    }
    task.spawn(function()
      local processKeyResult = function(resBody, statusCode)
        if not resBody or #resBody == 0 then
          return false
        end
        local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
          return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(resBody)
        end)
        if ok and decoded then
          if decoded.success then
            if decoded.payload and type(decoded.payload) == "string" and #decoded.payload > 0 then
              activeSessionToken = decoded.token
              activeSessionTs = decoded.ts
              local encSecret = OFFICIAL_BUILD_ID .. "_SEC_2026"
              local encKey = encSecret
                .. ":"
                .. key
                .. ":"
                .. getHWID()
                .. ":"
                .. sessionKey
                .. ":"
                .. tostring(decoded.ts)
              local decryptedLua = decryptPayloadXor(decoded.payload, encKey)
              if decryptedLua and #decryptedLua > 0 then
                pcall(function()
                  local remoteFunc = loadstring(decryptedLua)
                  if type(remoteFunc) == "function" then
                    pcall(remoteFunc, unlockPremium, sessionKey, localHooksTable)
                  end
                end)
              end
            end
            unlockPremium(sessionKey)
            if not isPremiumActive() then
              if callback then
                callback(
                  false,
                  "Failed to initialize premium payload! Check executor loadstring support."
                )
              end
              return true
            end
            savedPremiumKey = key
            pcall(function()
              writefile(PREMIUM_KEY_FILE, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({ key = key }))
            end)
            if _G.VD_UpdatePremiumUIState then
              pcall(_G.VD_UpdatePremiumUIState)
            end
            if callback then
              callback(true, decoded.message or "Premium activated!")
            end
            return true
          else
            if callback then
              callback(false, decoded.message or decoded.error or "Invalid key")
            end
            return true
          end
        end
        return false
      end
      if requestFunc then
        local encodedPayload = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(payload)
        local success, response = pcall(function()
          return requestFunc({
            Url = SERVER_API_URL .. "/api/validatekey?build=" .. OFFICIAL_BUILD_ID,
            Method = "POST",
            Timeout = 12,
            Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json", ["x-vd-build"] = OFFICIAL_BUILD_ID },
            Body = encodedPayload,
          })
        end)
        if success and response then
          local resBody = nil
          local statusCode = 200
          if type(response) == "string" then
            resBody = response
          elseif type(response) == "table" then
            resBody = response.Body
              or response.body
              or response.data
              or response.response
              or response.content
              or response.Content
              or response.Text
              or response.text
              or response.Result
              or response.result
            statusCode = response.StatusCode
              or response.status
              or response.status_code
              or response.Status_Code
              or 200
            if not resBody then
              for _, v in pairs(response) do
                if
                  type(v) == "string" and (
                    v:sub(1, 1) == "{"
                    or v:find("success")
                    or v:find("message")
                  )
                then
                  resBody = v
                  break
                end
              end
            end
          end
          if resBody and #resBody > 0 then
            if processKeyResult(resBody, statusCode) then
              return
            end
          end
        end
      end
      local httpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
      local getUrl = SERVER_API_URL
        .. "/api/validatekey?key="
        .. httpService:UrlEncode(key)
        .. "&hwid="
        .. httpService:UrlEncode(getHWID())
        .. "&username="
        .. httpService:UrlEncode(localPlayer.Name)
        .. "&session_key="
        .. httpService:UrlEncode(sessionKey)
        .. "&build="
        .. OFFICIAL_BUILD_ID
        .. "&t="
        .. tostring(math.floor(tick()))
      local getSuccess, getResponse = pcall(function()
        return game:HttpGet(getUrl)
      end)
      if getSuccess and getResponse and #getResponse > 0 then
        if processKeyResult(getResponse, 200) then
          return
        end
      end
      local errMsg = "Connection failed! Check Firewall/VPN/ISP blocking " .. SERVER_API_URL
      if callback then
        callback(false, errMsg)
      end
    end)
  end
end
local consecutiveHeartbeatFailures = 0
local maxHeartbeatFailures = 15
local isHeartbeatRevalidating = false
task.spawn(function()
  while task.wait(180) do
    if
      isPremiumActive()
      and savedPremiumKey
      and savedPremiumKey ~= "None"
      and savedPremiumKey ~= ""
    then
      pcall(function()
        local req = getRequestFunction()
        if req and activeSessionToken then
          local res = req({
            Url = SERVER_API_URL .. "/api/heartbeat",
            Method = "POST",
            Timeout = 12,
            Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json", ["x-vd-build"] = OFFICIAL_BUILD_ID },
            Body = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({
              key = savedPremiumKey,
              hwid = getHWID(),
              token = activeSessionToken,
              ts = activeSessionTs,
              session_key = sessionKey,
            }),
          })
          local heartbeatOk = false
          local explicitRevoke = false
          if res and res.StatusCode == 200 then
            local ok, data = pcall(function()
              return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(res.Body)
            end)
            if ok and data and data.success == true then
              heartbeatOk = true
              consecutiveHeartbeatFailures = 0
            elseif
              ok
              and data
              and data.success == false
              and (data.revoked == true or data.invalid == true)
            then
              explicitRevoke = true
            end
          elseif res and (res.StatusCode == 401 or res.StatusCode == 403) then
            local ok, data = pcall(function()
              return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(res.Body)
            end)
            if ok and data and (data.revoked == true or data.invalid == true) then
              explicitRevoke = true
            end
          end
          if explicitRevoke then
            premiumActive = false
            isPremiumUser = false
            remotePayloadLoaded = false
            _G.VD_IsPremium = nil
            _G.VD_RemotePayloadLoaded = nil
            table.clear(localHooksTable)
            savedPremiumKey = "None"
            if _G.VD_UpdatePremiumUIState then
              pcall(_G.VD_UpdatePremiumUIState)
            end
            pcall(enforceFreeRestrictions)
            return
          end
          if not heartbeatOk then
            consecutiveHeartbeatFailures = consecutiveHeartbeatFailures + 1
            if
              not isHeartbeatRevalidating
              and savedPremiumKey
              and consecutiveHeartbeatFailures >= 2
            then
              isHeartbeatRevalidating = true
              task.spawn(function()
                validatePremiumKey(savedPremiumKey, true, function(valid, msg)
                  isHeartbeatRevalidating = false
                  if valid then
                    consecutiveHeartbeatFailures = 0
                  elseif
                    msg
                    and (
                      msg:find("revoked")
                      or msg:find("disabled")
                      or msg:find("expired")
                      or msg:find("Invalid key")
                      or msg:find("HWID lock")
                    )
                  then
                    premiumActive = false
                    isPremiumUser = false
                    remotePayloadLoaded = false
                    _G.VD_IsPremium = nil
                    _G.VD_RemotePayloadLoaded = nil
                    table.clear(localHooksTable)
                    savedPremiumKey = "None"
                    if _G.VD_UpdatePremiumUIState then
                      pcall(_G.VD_UpdatePremiumUIState)
                    end
                    pcall(enforceFreeRestrictions)
                  end
                end)
              end)
            end
          end
        elseif not activeSessionToken and savedPremiumKey and not isHeartbeatRevalidating then
          isHeartbeatRevalidating = true
          task.spawn(function()
            validatePremiumKey(savedPremiumKey, true, function(valid)
              isHeartbeatRevalidating = false
              if valid then
                consecutiveHeartbeatFailures = 0
              end
            end)
          end)
        end
      end)
    end
  end
end)
task.spawn(function()
  while activeLoop do
    task.wait(2.0)
    if
      (_G.VD_IsPremium == true or _G.VD_RemotePayloadLoaded == true)
      and not (
        remotePayloadLoaded
        and type(localHooksTable) == "table"
        and next(localHooksTable) ~= nil
      )
    then
      _G.VD_IsPremium = nil
      _G.VD_RemotePayloadLoaded = nil
      premiumActive = false
      isPremiumUser = false
      remotePayloadLoaded = false
    end
  end
end)
local function loadSavedPremiumKey(callback)
  local has_write = writefile and readfile and isfile
  if has_write and isfile(PREMIUM_KEY_FILE) then
    local success, content = pcall(readfile, PREMIUM_KEY_FILE)
    if success and content then
      local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
        return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(content)
      end)
      if ok and decoded and decoded.key then
        savedPremiumKey = decoded.key
        validatePremiumKey(decoded.key, true, callback)
        return
      end
    end
  end
  if callback then
    callback(false, "No saved key found")
  end
end

end
originalCameraSettings = {
  CameraMode = localPlayer.CameraMode,
  CameraMinZoomDistance = localPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance,

function isLocalKiller()
  if localPlayer.Team then
    local tName = localPlayer.Team.Name:lower()
    if tName:find("killer") or tName:find("slasher") or tName:find("monster") then
      return true
    end
    if tName:find("survivor") then
      return false
    end
  end
  local role = localPlayer:GetAttribute("Role")
  if
    role == "Killer"
    or localPlayer:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true
    or localPlayer:GetAttribute("Killer") == true
  then
    return true
  end
  if role == "Survivor" then
    return false
  end
  local char = localPlayer.Character
  if char then
    local cRole = char:GetAttribute("Role")
    if
      cRole == "Killer"
      or char:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true
      or char:GetAttribute("Killer") == true
    then
      return true
    end
    if cRole == "Survivor" then
      return false
    end
    local p = char.Parent
    if p and (p.Name == "Killers" or p.Name:lower():find("killer")) then
      return true
    end
    if p and (p.Name == "Survivors" or p.Name:lower():find("survivor")) then
      return false
    end
    local cs = CollectionService or game:GetService("CollectionService")
    if cs and cs:HasTag(char, "Killer") then
      return true
    end
    if cs and cs:HasTag(char, "Survivor") then
      return false
    end
    if
      char:FindFirstChild("Firstperson")
      or char:FindFirstChild("KillerActionController")
      or char:FindFirstChild("Lookscriptkiller")
      or char:FindFirstChild("VMscript")
      or char:FindFirstChild("StunEvent")
      or char:FindFirstChild("Mori")
      or char:FindFirstChild("MoriEvent")
      or char:FindFirstChild("Killerost")
    then
      return true
    end
    if
      char:FindFirstChild("Machete")
      or char:FindFirstChild("Knife")
      or char:FindFirstChild("Weapon")
      or char:FindFirstChild("Sword")
      or char:FindFirstChild("Spear")
      or char:FindFirstChild("Hammer")
      or char:FindFirstChild("Axe")
      or char:FindFirstChild("Chainsaw")
      or char:FindFirstChild("Bat")
      or char:FindFirstChild("Attack")
      or char:FindFirstChild("AttackEvent")
    then
      return true
    end
    local cName = char.Name:lower()
    if
      cName:find("veil")
      or cName:find("myers")
      or cName:find("stalker")
      or cName:find("killer")
      or cName:find("abyss")
      or cName:find("slasher")
      or cName:find("masked")
      or cName:find("jason")
      or cName:find("trapper")
      or cName:find("butcher")
      or cName:find("hunter")
      or cName:find("clown")
      or cName:find("doctor")
      or cName:find("phantom")
      or cName:find("hidden")
      or cName:find("nightmarer")
    then
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end

function forceRemoveDOF()
  pcall(function()
    local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    for _, root in ipairs({ Lighting, cam }) do
      if root then
        for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
          if obj:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") then
            if Settings.RemoveDOF then
              obj.Enabled = false
            else
              obj.Enabled = true
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end)
end
local origTerrainSettings = nil
local origLightingEffects = {}
function applyFPSCap()
  pcall(function()
    local cap = Settings.FPSCap or "Unlimited"
    local setfps = setfpscap or (syn and syn.set_fps_cap) or (fluxus and fluxus.set_fps_cap)
    if setfps then
      if cap == "Unlimited" or cap == "Default" or cap == 0 or cap == "0" then
        setfps(999)
      else
        local num = tonumber(cap)
        if num and num > 0 then
          setfps(math.clamp(math.floor(num), 15, 1000))
        else
          setfps(999)
        end
      end
    end
  end)
end
function applyPerformanceMode()
  pcall(function()
    local isPerf = Settings.PerformanceMode or Settings.LowGraphicsMode
    local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
    if isPerf then
      if not origTerrainSettings and workspace.Terrain then
        origTerrainSettings = {
          WaterWaveSize = workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSize,
          WaterWaveSpeed = workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSpeed,
          WaterReflectance = workspace.Terrain.WaterReflectance,
        }
      end
      if workspace.Terrain then
        workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSize = 0
        workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
        workspace.Terrain.WaterReflectance = 0
      end
      Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
      for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
        if
          child:IsA("BlurEffect")
          or child:IsA("SunRaysEffect")
          or child:IsA("BloomEffect")
          or child:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect")
          or child:IsA("Atmosphere")
        then
          if origLightingEffects[child] == nil then
            origLightingEffects[child] = child.Enabled
          end
          pcall(function()
            child.Enabled = false
          end)
        end
      end
      pcall(function()
        for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
          if
            desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
            or desc:IsA("Smoke")
            or desc:IsA("Fire")
            or desc:IsA("Sparkles")
          then
            if desc:GetAttribute("_origRate") == nil then
              desc:SetAttribute("_origRate", desc.Rate or 1)
            end
            desc.Rate = 0
          end
        end
      end)
      pcall(function()
        if settings and settings().Rendering then
          settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
        end
      end)
      pcall(function()
        if gcinfo or collectgarbage then
          local gc = collectgarbage or function() end
          gc("collect")
        end
      end)
    else
      if origTerrainSettings and workspace.Terrain then
        workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSize = origTerrainSettings.WaterWaveSize or 0.15
        workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = origTerrainSettings.WaterWaveSpeed or 10
        workspace.Terrain.WaterReflectance = origTerrainSettings.WaterReflectance or 0.05
      end
      if defaultLightingSettings then
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = defaultLightingSettings.GlobalShadows
      end
      for child, origState in pairs(origLightingEffects) do
        if child and child.Parent then
          pcall(function()
            child.Enabled = origState
          end)
        end
      end
      origLightingEffects = {}
      pcall(function()
        for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
          if
            (
              desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
              or desc:IsA("Smoke")
              or desc:IsA("Fire")
              or desc:IsA("Sparkles")
            ) and desc:GetAttribute("_origRate") ~= nil
          then
            desc.Rate = desc:GetAttribute("_origRate")
            desc:SetAttribute("_origRate", nil)
          end
        end
      end)
      pcall(function()
        if settings and settings().Rendering then
          settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Automatic
        end
      end)
    end
  end)
end

scriptConnections = {}
local pruneDeadConnections = nil
do
  local lastConnPruneCount = 0
  pruneDeadConnections = function()
    for i = #scriptConnections, 1, -1 do
      local c = scriptConnections[i]
      if not c or (typeof(c) == "RBXScriptConnection" and not c.Connected) then
        table.remove(scriptConnections, i)
      end
    end
    if _G.VD_ActiveConnections then
      for i = #_G.VD_ActiveConnections, 1, -1 do
        local c = _G.VD_ActiveConnections[i]
        if not c or (typeof(c) == "RBXScriptConnection" and not c.Connected) then
          table.remove(_G.VD_ActiveConnections, i)
        end
      end
    end
    lastConnPruneCount = #scriptConnections
  end
  function registerConnection(conn)
    table.insert(scriptConnections, conn)
    if _G.VD_ActiveConnections then
      table.insert(_G.VD_ActiveConnections, conn)
    end
    if #scriptConnections - lastConnPruneCount >= 150 then
      pcall(pruneDeadConnections)
    end
    return conn
  end
end
LIFETIME_STATS_FILE = "VD_Lifetime_Stats.json"
screwsEarnedThisSession = 0
gearsEarnedThisSession = 0
lifetimeScrewsEarned = 0
lifetimeGearsEarned = 0
startScrews = 0
startGears = 0
lastCheckedScrews = 0
lastCheckedGears = 0
hasInitializedStats = false
updateEarnedUI = nil
function loadLifetimeStats()
  local rf = readfile or make_readfile or (syn and syn.readfile)
  local isf = isfile or (syn and syn.isfile)
  if isf and rf then
    local success, content = pcall(rf, LIFETIME_STATS_FILE)
    if success and content then
      local successDec, decoded = pcall(function()
        return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(content)
      end)
      if successDec and decoded then
        lifetimeScrewsEarned = decoded.LifetimeScrewsEarned or 0
        lifetimeGearsEarned = decoded.LifetimeGearsEarned or 0
        return
      end
    end
  end
end
function saveLifetimeStats()
  local wf = writefile or make_writefile or (syn and syn.writefile)
  if wf then
    local payload = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({
      LifetimeScrewsEarned = lifetimeScrewsEarned,
      LifetimeGearsEarned = lifetimeGearsEarned,
    })
    pcall(wf, LIFETIME_STATS_FILE, payload)
  end
end
function updateEarnedStats()
  if not hasInitializedStats then
    local currentScrews = localPlayer:GetAttribute("Screws")
    local currentGears = localPlayer:GetAttribute("Gears")
    if currentScrews and currentGears then
      startScrews = currentScrews
      startGears = currentGears
      lastCheckedScrews = startScrews
      lastCheckedGears = startGears
      hasInitializedStats = true
    else
      return
    end
  end
  local currentScrews = localPlayer:GetAttribute("Screws") or 0
  local currentGears = localPlayer:GetAttribute("Gears") or 0
  local diffScrews = currentScrews - lastCheckedScrews
  if diffScrews > 0 then
    screwsEarnedThisSession = screwsEarnedThisSession + diffScrews
    lifetimeScrewsEarned = lifetimeScrewsEarned + diffScrews
  end
  lastCheckedScrews = currentScrews
  local diffGears = currentGears - lastCheckedGears
  if diffGears > 0 then
    gearsEarnedThisSession = gearsEarnedThisSession + diffGears
    lifetimeGearsEarned = lifetimeGearsEarned + diffGears
  end
  lastCheckedGears = currentGears
  saveLifetimeStats()
  if updateEarnedUI then
    pcall(updateEarnedUI)
  end
end
pcall(function()
  loadLifetimeStats()
  registerConnection(localPlayer.AttributeChanged:Connect(function(attr)
    if attr == "Screws" or attr == "Gears" then
      pcall(updateEarnedStats)
    end
  end))
  task.spawn(function()
    while activeLoop do
      pcall(updateEarnedStats)
      task.wait(30)
    end
  end)
end)

function toBase36(n)
  n = tonumber(n) or 0
  if n == 0 then
    return "0"
  end
  local chars = "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
  local result = ""
  while n > 0 do
    local remainder = n % 36
    result = chars:sub(remainder + 1, remainder + 1) .. result
    n = math.floor(n / 36)
  end
  return result
end
function fromBase36(s)
  if not s or s == "" then
    return "0"
  end
  local chars = "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
  local result = 0
  for i = 1, #s do
    local c = s:sub(i, i)
    local val = chars:find(c) or 1
    result = result * 36 + (val - 1)
  end
  return tostring(result)
end
function startLiveUserTracker(statusLabel)
  local appKey = "VD_LiveUserTracker_6locc"
  local myUserId = tostring(localPlayer.UserId)
  local simulatedBase = math.random(10, 18)
  task.spawn(function()
    local cycleCount = 0
    while activeLoop do
      cycleCount = cycleCount + 1
      if cycleCount % 3 == 0 then
        simulatedBase = math.clamp(simulatedBase + math.random(-1, 1), 8, 22)
      end
      pcall(function()
        if statusLabel and statusLabel.Parent then
          statusLabel.Text = "Active Session ["
            .. (isPremiumActive() and "Premium Version" or "Free Version")
            .. "] - Executor: "
            .. detectExecutor()
            .. " | Live Users: "
            .. tostring(simulatedBase)
        end
      end)
      if cycleCount % 10 == 1 then
        task.spawn(function()
          pcall(function()
            local uidB36 = toBase36(myUserId)
            local tsB36 = toBase36(tostring(os.time()))
            local encoded = uidB36 .. "a" .. tsB36
            local updateUrl = "https://keyvalue.immanuel.co/api/KeyVal/UpdateValue/"
              .. appKey
              .. "/active_users_1/"
              .. encoded
            makeRequest(updateUrl, "POST")
          end)
        end)
      end
      task.wait(30)
    end
  end)
end
local VD_Capabilities = {}
local CAPABILITY_ORDER = {
  "http_request",
  "file_io",
  "firesignal",
  "virtual_input",
  "queue_on_teleport",
  "setclipboard",
  "openurl",
  "coregui",
}
function registerCapability(id, label, checkFn, affectedFeatures)
  local ok, result = pcall(checkFn)
  local available = ok and result == true
  VD_Capabilities[id] = {
    label = label,
    available = available,
    features = affectedFeatures,
    detail = (not available) and (ok and tostring(result) or tostring(result)) or nil,
  }
end
function runStartupCapabilityChecks()
  registerCapability("http_request", "HTTP Requests", function()
    return type(getRequestFunction()) == "function"
  end, { "Suggestions", "Webhooks", "Server Hop", "Auto Parry Learning Report", "Discord RPC" })
  registerCapability("file_io", "File Read/Write", function()
    local wf = writefile or make_writefile or (syn and syn.writefile)
    local rf = readfile or make_readfile or (syn and syn.readfile)
    local isf = isfile or (syn and syn.isfile)
    return wf ~= nil and rf ~= nil and isf ~= nil
  end, { "Config Save/Load", "Lifetime Stats", "Popup Preferences", "Auto Hop Re-inject" })
  registerCapability("firesignal", "FireSignal", function()
    return typeof(firesignal) == "function"
  end, { "Auto Skill Check (best reliability)" })
  registerCapability("virtual_input", "VirtualInputManager", function()
    if isMobile or not VirtualInputManager then
      return false
    end
    local ok = pcall(function()
      VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
    end)
    return ok
  end, { "Auto Skill Check", "Fake Vault", "Input Simulation" })
  registerCapability("queue_on_teleport", "Queue On Teleport", function()
    local queue = queue_on_teleport or (syn and syn.queue_on_teleport)
    return type(queue) == "function"
  end, { "Auto Hop (script persistence)" })
  registerCapability("setclipboard", "Clipboard", function()
    return typeof(setclipboard) == "function"
  end, { "Discord Link Copy Fallback" })
  registerCapability("openurl", "Open URL", function()
    local openfunc = openurl or (syn and syn.openurl) or (fluxus and fluxus.openurl)
    return type(openfunc) == "function"
  end, { "Discord Link Open Fallback" })
  registerCapability("coregui", "CoreGui Access", function()
    local ok, coreGui = pcall(function()
      return game:GetService("CoreGui")
    end)
    if not ok or not coreGui then
      return false
    end
    local probe = Instance.new("Folder")
    probe.Name = "VD_CapabilityProbe"
    local placed = pcall(function()
      probe.Parent = coreGui
    end)
    pcall(function()
      probe:Destroy()
    end)
    return placed
  end, { "Overlay GUI (uses PlayerGui fallback if missing)" })
end
function getUnavailableFeatures()
  local affected, seen = {}, {}
  for _, id in ipairs(CAPABILITY_ORDER) do
    local cap = VD_Capabilities[id]
    if cap and not cap.available then
      for _, feat in ipairs(cap.features) do
        if not seen[feat] then
          seen[feat] = true
          table.insert(affected, feat)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return affected
end
function printStartupCapabilityReport()
  local total, failed = 0, 0
  for _, id in ipairs(CAPABILITY_ORDER) do
    local cap = VD_Capabilities[id]
    if cap then
      total = total + 1
      if cap.available then
      else
        failed = failed + 1
      end
    end
  end
  if failed == 0 then
  else
  end
end
task.defer(function()
  runStartupCapabilityChecks()
  _G.VD_Capabilities = VD_Capabilities
end)

local cachedOneWayPing = 0.035
task.spawn(function()
  local StatsService = game:GetService("Stats")
  while activeLoop do
    pcall(function()
      local item = StatsService
        and StatsService.Network
        and StatsService.Network.ServerStatsItem
        and StatsService.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]
      if item then
        local getValueFn = item.GetValue
        if type(getValueFn) == "function" then
          local v = getValueFn(item)
          if type(v) == "number" and v > 0 then
            cachedOneWayPing = math.clamp((v / 1000) * 0.5, 0.015, 0.25)
            return
          end
        end
      end
      local lp = Players and Players.LocalPlayer
      if lp then
        local pingFn = lp.GetNetworkPing
        if type(pingFn) == "function" then
          local p = pingFn(lp)
          if type(p) == "number" and p > 0 then
            cachedOneWayPing = math.clamp(p * 0.5, 0.015, 0.25)
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    task.wait(0.5)
  end
end)

local CONFIGS_FILE = "VD_Configs.json"
local SETTINGS_FILE = "VD_Settings.json"
local syncColorUI
local forceUpdateESPStyle
local updateMobileHUDButtons
function serializeTable(tbl, seen)
  if type(tbl) ~= "table" then
    return tbl
  end
  seen = seen or {}
  if seen[tbl] then
    return nil
  end
  seen[tbl] = true
  local serialized = {}
  for k, v in pairs(tbl) do
    if typeof(v) == "Color3" then
      serialized[k] =
        { __type = "Color3", r = math.round(v.R * 255), g = math.round(v.G * 255), b = math.round(
          v.B * 255
        ) }
    elseif type(v) == "table" then
      local sub = serializeTable(v, seen)
      if sub ~= nil then
        serialized[k] = sub
      end
    elseif type(v) == "boolean" or type(v) == "number" or type(v) == "string" then
      serialized[k] = v
    end
  end
  return serialized
end
local function isColor3Table(tbl)
  if type(tbl) ~= "table" then
    return false
  end
  if tbl.__type == "Color3" then
    return true
  end
  if (tbl.r or tbl.R) and (tbl.g or tbl.G) and (tbl.b or tbl.B) then
    return true
  end
  if
    #tbl == 3
    and type(tbl[1]) == "number"
    and type(tbl[2]) == "number"
    and type(tbl[3]) == "number"
  then
    return true
  end
  return false
end
local function parseColor3(tbl)
  local r = tbl.r or tbl.R or tbl[1]
  local g = tbl.g or tbl.G or tbl[2]
  local b = tbl.b or tbl.B or tbl[3]
  r = tonumber(r) or 255
  g = tonumber(g) or 255
  b = tonumber(b) or 255
  if r > 1 or g > 1 or b > 1 then
    return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b)
  else
    return Color3.new(r, g, b)
  end
end
function deserializeTable(target, source)
  if type(target) ~= "table" or type(source) ~= "table" then
    return
  end
  for k, v in pairs(source) do
    if type(v) == "table" then
      if isColor3Table(v) then
        target[k] = parseColor3(v)
      else
        if type(target[k]) ~= "table" then
          target[k] = {}
        end
        deserializeTable(target[k], v)
      end
    else
      target[k] = v
    end
  end
end
local FactorySettings = serializeTable(Settings)
local ConfigSystem = { activeProfile = "Default", profiles = {} }
function saveConfigs()
  pcall(function()
    local wf = writefile or make_writefile or (syn and syn.writefile)
    if not wf then
      return
    end
    local data = { activeProfile = ConfigSystem.activeProfile, profiles = {} }
    for name, profileSettings in pairs(ConfigSystem.profiles) do
      data.profiles[name] = serializeTable(profileSettings)
    end
    wf(CONFIGS_FILE, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(data))
  end)
end
function loadConfigs()
  ConfigSystem.profiles["Default"] = serializeTable(Settings)
  local rf = readfile or make_readfile or (syn and syn.readfile)
  local isf = isfile or (syn and syn.isfile)
  if rf then
    if isf and isf(CONFIGS_FILE) then
      pcall(function()
        local content = rf(CONFIGS_FILE)
        if content and content ~= "" then
          local decoded = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(content)
          if decoded and decoded.profiles then
            ConfigSystem.activeProfile = decoded.activeProfile or "Default"
            for name, rawProfile in pairs(decoded.profiles) do
              local profSettings = {}
              deserializeTable(profSettings, serializeTable(Settings))
              deserializeTable(profSettings, rawProfile)
              ConfigSystem.profiles[name] = profSettings
            end
          end
        end
      end)
    elseif isf and isf(SETTINGS_FILE) then
      pcall(function()
        local content = rf(SETTINGS_FILE)
        if content and content ~= "" then
          local decoded = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(content)
          if decoded then
            local profSettings = {}
            deserializeTable(profSettings, serializeTable(Settings))
            deserializeTable(profSettings, decoded)
            ConfigSystem.profiles["Default"] = profSettings
            saveConfigs()
          end
        end
      end)
    end
  end
end

function loadSettings()
  loadConfigs()
  local active = ConfigSystem.profiles[ConfigSystem.activeProfile]
  if active then
    deserializeTable(Settings, active)
  else
    ConfigSystem.activeProfile = "Default"
    deserializeTable(Settings, ConfigSystem.profiles["Default"])
  end
  if Settings.FirstRunVersion ~= "vv1.7.1_Premium" then
    Settings.FirstRunVersion = "vv1.7.1_Premium"
    saveSettings()
  end
  normalizeSettings()
  if not isPremiumActive() then
    pcall(enforceFreeRestrictions)
  end
end
function saveSettings()
  if ConfigSystem.profiles[ConfigSystem.activeProfile] == nil then
    ConfigSystem.profiles[ConfigSystem.activeProfile] = {}
  end
  ConfigSystem.profiles[ConfigSystem.activeProfile] = serializeTable(Settings)
  saveConfigs()
end
function loadProfile(name)
  local profileData = ConfigSystem.profiles[name]
  if not profileData then
    return
  end
  ConfigSystem.activeProfile = name
  deserializeTable(Settings, profileData)
  if Settings.RevolverAutofarm and isPremiumActive() then
    Settings.InstantHeal = true
  end
  normalizeSettings()
  saveConfigs()
  pcall(enforceFreeRestrictions)
  if applyPerformanceMode then
    pcall(applyPerformanceMode)
  end
  if applyFPSCap then
    pcall(applyFPSCap)
  end
  if updateUIFromSettings then
    pcall(updateUIFromSettings)
  end
end
loadSettings()
if applyPerformanceMode then
  pcall(applyPerformanceMode)
end
if applyFPSCap then
  pcall(applyFPSCap)
end
if Settings.RevolverAutofarm and isPremiumUser then
  Settings.InstantHeal = true
end

function getDistance(instance, preResolvedPart)
  local root = localRootPart
  if not root then
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then
      return math.huge
    end
  end
  local targetPart = preResolvedPart
  if not targetPart then
    if instance:IsA("Player") then
      local char = instance.Character
      targetPart = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    elseif instance:IsA("Model") then
      targetPart = instance.PrimaryPart or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    elseif instance:IsA("BasePart") then
      targetPart = instance
    end
  end
  if targetPart then
    return math.round((root.Position - targetPart.Position).Magnitude)
  end
  return math.huge
end
_G.VD_FarmState = _G.VD_FarmState or {}
_G.VD_FarmState.farmTeamStartTime = _G.VD_FarmState.farmTeamStartTime or 0
_G.VD_FarmState.farmLastTeamName = _G.VD_FarmState.farmLastTeamName or ""
_G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime = _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime or 0
_G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime = _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime or 0
function updateStatus(state)
  if _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus then
    pcall(function()
      _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus(state)
    end)
  end
end
function updateTelemetryAndAFKStates()
  local teamName = localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name or ""
  if teamName ~= _G.VD_FarmState.farmLastTeamName then
    _G.VD_FarmState.farmTeamStartTime = tick()
    _G.VD_FarmState.farmLastTeamName = teamName
    _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime = 0
    _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime = 0
  end
  local char = localPlayer.Character
  local myRoot = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if teamName == "Killer" and myRoot then
    if _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime == 0 then
      _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime = tick()
    end
  elseif teamName ~= "Killer" then
    _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime = 0
  end
  if teamName == "Survivors" and myRoot then
    if _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime == 0 then
      _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime = tick()
    end
  elseif teamName ~= "Survivors" then
    _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime = 0
  end
  local elapsed = tick() - (_G.VD_FarmState.farmTeamStartTime or 0)
  if Settings.AutoFarmAFKTotal then
    if teamName == "Survivors" then
      local spawnElapsed = _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime > 0
          and (tick() - _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime)
        or 0
      if _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime == 0 or spawnElapsed < 15.0 then
        Settings.AutoFarmSurvivor = false
        Settings.AutoFarmKiller = false
        if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
          pcall(function()
            _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(false)
          end)
        end
        if _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle then
          pcall(function()
            _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle(false)
          end)
        end
        local remaining = math.ceil(15.0 - spawnElapsed)
        updateStatus(string.format("WAITING (%ds)", remaining > 0 and remaining or 15))
      else
        local isKnocked = char
          and (readModelValue(char, "Knocked") == true or char:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true)
        local isHooked = char
          and (readModelValue(char, "IsHooked") == true or char:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true)
        if isKnocked or isHooked then
          Settings.AutoFarmSurvivor = false
          Settings.AutoFarmKiller = false
          if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
            pcall(function()
              _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(false)
            end)
          end
          if _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle then
            pcall(function()
              _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle(false)
            end)
          end
          updateStatus("PAUSED (Knocked/Hooked)")
        else
          Settings.AutoFarmSurvivor = true
          Settings.AutoFarmKiller = false
          if _G.VD_FarmState.lastRoundScanned ~= _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime then
            _G.VD_FarmState.lastRoundScanned = _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime
            pcall(scanMapObjects)
            pcall(scanRemotes)
          end
          if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
            pcall(function()
              _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(true)
            end)
          end
          if _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle then
            pcall(function()
              _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle(false)
            end)
          end
          if Settings.AutoPumpkin then
            local activeState = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
            if
              activeState
              and activeState ~= "Idle"
              and activeState ~= "IDLE"
              and activeState ~= "OFF"
            then
              updateStatus(activeState)
            else
              updateStatus("RUNNING (Auto Pumpkin)")
            end
          else
            local activeState = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
            if activeState and activeState ~= "Idle" and activeState ~= "IDLE" then
              updateStatus(activeState)
            else
              updateStatus("RUNNING (Survivor Farm)")
            end
          end
        end
      end
    elseif teamName == "Killer" then
      local spawnElapsed = _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime > 0
          and (tick() - _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime)
        or 0
      if _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime == 0 or spawnElapsed < 15.0 then
        Settings.AutoFarmSurvivor = false
        Settings.AutoFarmKiller = false
        if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
          pcall(function()
            _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(false)
          end)
        end
        if _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle then
          pcall(function()
            _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle(false)
          end)
        end
        local remaining = math.ceil(15.0 - spawnElapsed)
        updateStatus(string.format("WAITING (%ds)", remaining > 0 and remaining or 15))
      else
        Settings.AutoFarmSurvivor = false
        Settings.AutoFarmKiller = true
        if _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerRoundScanned ~= _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime then
          _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerRoundScanned = _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime
          pcall(scanMapObjects)
          pcall(scanRemotes)
        end
        if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
          pcall(function()
            _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(false)
          end)
        end
        if _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle then
          pcall(function()
            _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle(true)
          end)
        end
        local activeState = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
        if activeState and activeState ~= "Idle" and activeState ~= "IDLE" then
          updateStatus(activeState)
        else
          updateStatus("RUNNING (Killer Farm)")
        end
      end
    else
      Settings.AutoFarmSurvivor = false
      Settings.AutoFarmKiller = false
      if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
        pcall(function()
          _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(false)
        end)
      end
      if _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle then
        pcall(function()
          _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle(false)
        end)
      end
      updateStatus("PAUSED (Spectating/Lobby)")
    end
  else
    if Settings.AutoPumpkin then
      local activeState = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
      if
        activeState
        and activeState ~= "Idle"
        and activeState ~= "IDLE"
        and activeState ~= "OFF"
      then
        updateStatus(activeState)
      else
        updateStatus("RUNNING (Auto Pumpkin)")
      end
    elseif Settings.AutoFarmSurvivor then
      if
        teamName == "Survivors"
        or (teamName ~= "Killer" and teamName ~= "Spectators" and teamName ~= "Spectator")
      then
        local isKnocked = char
          and (readModelValue(char, "Knocked") == true or char:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true)
        local isHooked = char
          and (readModelValue(char, "IsHooked") == true or char:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true)
        if isKnocked or isHooked then
          updateStatus("PAUSED (Knocked/Hooked)")
        else
          local activeState = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
          if activeState and activeState ~= "Idle" and activeState ~= "IDLE" then
            updateStatus(activeState)
          else
            updateStatus("RUNNING (Survivor Farm)")
          end
        end
      elseif teamName == "Killer" then
        updateStatus("PAUSED (Killer Team)")
      else
        updateStatus("PAUSED (Spectating/Lobby)")
      end
    elseif Settings.AutoFarmKiller then
      if teamName == "Killer" then
        local activeState = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
        if activeState and activeState ~= "Idle" and activeState ~= "IDLE" then
          updateStatus(activeState)
        else
          updateStatus("RUNNING (Killer Farm)")
        end
      elseif teamName == "Survivors" then
        updateStatus("PAUSED (Survivor Team)")
      else
        updateStatus("PAUSED (Spectating/Lobby)")
      end
    elseif Settings.InstantFinishlineEscape then
      if
        teamName == "Survivors"
        or (teamName ~= "Killer" and teamName ~= "Spectators" and teamName ~= "Spectator")
      then
        local activeState = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
        if activeState and activeState ~= "Idle" and activeState ~= "IDLE" then
          updateStatus(activeState)
        else
          updateStatus("RUNNING (Instant Escape)")
        end
      elseif teamName == "Killer" then
        updateStatus("PAUSED (Killer Team)")
      else
        updateStatus("WAITING FOR MATCH (Lobby)")
      end
    else
      updateStatus("OFF")
    end
  end
end
function isSurvivorFarmAllowed()
  if not Settings.AutoFarmSurvivor then
    return false
  end
  local teamName = localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name or ""
  if teamName ~= "Survivors" then
    return false
  end
  if (_G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime or 0) == 0 then
    return false
  end
  local elapsed = tick() - (_G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime or 0)
  if elapsed < 15.0 then
    return false
  end
  local char = localPlayer.Character
  local isKnocked = char
    and (readModelValue(char, "Knocked") == true or char:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true)
  local isHooked = char
    and (readModelValue(char, "IsHooked") == true or char:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true)
  if isKnocked or isHooked then
    return false
  end
  return true
end
function isKillerFarmAllowed()
  if not Settings.AutoFarmKiller then
    return false
  end
  local teamName = localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name or ""
  if teamName ~= "Killer" then
    return false
  end
  if (_G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime or 0) == 0 then
    return false
  end
  local elapsed = tick() - (_G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime or 0)
  if elapsed < 15.0 then
    return false
  end
  return true
end
function getESPColor(key)
  return Settings.ESPColors[key] or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
end
function getSelectedKiller(player)
  if typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Model") then
    local attr = player:GetAttribute("SelectedKiller")
    if attr ~= nil then
      return tostring(attr)
    end
    return tostring(player.Name)
  end
  local attr = player:GetAttribute("SelectedKiller")
  if attr ~= nil then
    return tostring(attr)
  end
  local child = player:FindFirstChild("SelectedKiller")
  if child and (child:IsA("StringValue") or child:IsA("ValueObject")) then
    return tostring(child.Value)
  end
  if player.Character then
    local charAttr = player.Character:GetAttribute("SelectedKiller")
    if charAttr ~= nil then
      return tostring(charAttr)
    end
  end
  return "None"
end
function getPlayerHealthPercent(player)
  local char = (typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Model") and player)
    or (player and player.Character)
  if char then
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
      return humanoid.Health, humanoid.MaxHealth
    end
  end
  return 100, 100
end
function getGeneratorProgress(gen)
  local progress = gen:GetAttribute("RepairProgress")
  if progress == nil then
    local child = gen:FindFirstChild("RepairProgress")
    if child and child:IsA("ValueObject") then
      progress = child.Value
    end
  end
  if not progress then
    return 0
  end
  local num = tonumber(progress)
  if num then
    if num <= 1.01 and num > 0 then
      return math.round(num * 100)
    else
      return math.round(num)
    end
  end
  return 0
end
local genAnalyticsData = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
function isGeneratorRegressing(gen)
  if not gen then
    return false
  end
  local regAttr = gen:GetAttribute("Regressing")
  if regAttr ~= nil then
    return regAttr == true
  end
  local ok, val = pcall(function()
    local child = gen:FindFirstChild("Regressing")
    if child then
      if child:IsA("ValueObject") or child:IsA("BoolValue") then
        return child.Value == true
      end
      return true
    end
    return gen.Regressing == true
  end)
  if ok and val == true then
    return true
  end
  local hitbox = gen:FindFirstChild("HitBox")
    or gen:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
    or gen:FindFirstChild("Engine")
    or (gen:IsA("Model") and gen.PrimaryPart)
    or gen:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
  if hitbox then
    local hbAttr = hitbox:GetAttribute("Regressing")
    if hbAttr == true then
      return true
    end
    local hbChild = hitbox:FindFirstChild("Regressing")
    if hbChild then
      if hbChild:IsA("ValueObject") or hbChild:IsA("BoolValue") then
        return hbChild.Value == true
      end
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end
function getGeneratorAnalytics(gen)
  if not gen then
    return 0, nil, ""
  end
  local data = genAnalyticsData[gen]
  if not data then
    return 0, nil, ""
  end
  return data.smoothedSpeed or 0, data.etaSeconds, data.etaFormatted or ""
end
local function updateGeneratorAnalytics()
  local now = tick()
  local alertEnabled = Settings.MasterESP
    and Settings.GeneratorESP
    and Settings.GeneratorESP.Enabled
    and Settings.GeneratorESP.AlertThresholdEnabled
  local alertThreshold = (Settings.GeneratorESP and Settings.GeneratorESP.AlertThreshold) or 90
  for _, gen in ipairs(cachedGenerators or {}) do
    if not gen or not gen.Parent then
      continue
    end
    if isGeneratorCompleted(gen) then
      genAnalyticsData[gen] = nil
      continue
    end
    local rawProg = getGeneratorProgress(gen)
    local data = genAnalyticsData[gen]
    if not data then
      genAnalyticsData[gen] = {
        lastProgress = rawProg,
        lastTime = now,
        history = {},
        smoothedSpeed = 0,
        smoothedETA = nil,
        etaSeconds = nil,
        etaFormatted = "",
        alertTriggered = (rawProg >= alertThreshold),
      }
      continue
    end
    local dt = now - data.lastTime
    if dt >= 0.75 then
      local progressDelta = rawProg - data.lastProgress
      local isReg = isGeneratorRegressing(gen)
      local instantSpeed = 0
      if progressDelta ~= 0 then
        instantSpeed = progressDelta / dt
      elseif isReg then
        if data.smoothedSpeed and data.smoothedSpeed < 0 then
          instantSpeed = data.smoothedSpeed
        else
          instantSpeed = -0.5
        end
      else
        instantSpeed = 0
      end
      table.insert(data.history, instantSpeed)
      if #data.history > 5 then
        table.remove(data.history, 1)
      end
      local sum = 0
      for _, spd in ipairs(data.history) do
        sum = sum + spd
      end
      local windowAvgSpeed = sum / #data.history
      local prevSpeed = data.smoothedSpeed or 0
      local smoothedSpeed = prevSpeed + (windowAvgSpeed - prevSpeed) * 0.25
      if math.abs(smoothedSpeed) < 0.05 then
        smoothedSpeed = 0
      end
      local etaSeconds = nil
      local etaFormatted = ""
      if smoothedSpeed > 0.1 then
        local remaining = 100 - rawProg
        local rawETA = math.max(0, remaining / smoothedSpeed)
        local prevETA = data.smoothedETA or rawETA
        local smoothedETA = prevETA + (rawETA - prevETA) * 0.2
        data.smoothedETA = smoothedETA
        etaSeconds = smoothedETA
        if etaSeconds < 60 then
          etaFormatted = string.format("%ds", math.ceil(etaSeconds))
        else
          local mins = math.floor(etaSeconds / 60)
          local secs = math.ceil(etaSeconds % 60)
          etaFormatted = string.format("%dm %02ds", mins, secs)
        end
      else
        data.smoothedETA = nil
      end
      data.smoothedSpeed = smoothedSpeed
      data.etaSeconds = etaSeconds
      data.etaFormatted = etaFormatted
      data.lastProgress = rawProg
      data.lastTime = now
      if alertEnabled then
        if rawProg >= alertThreshold then
          if not data.alertTriggered then
            data.alertTriggered = true
            local etaStr = (data.etaFormatted and data.etaFormatted ~= "")
                and ("ETA: " .. data.etaFormatted)
              or "Nearly Complete!"
            showNotification(
              "Generator Alert",
              string.format("Generator reached %d%% progress! (%s)", math.floor(rawProg), etaStr),
              "warning"
            )
          end
        else
          if rawProg < (alertThreshold - 5) then
            data.alertTriggered = false
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
local lastGenAnalyticsTick = 0
registerConnection(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
  local now = tick()
  local minInterval = Settings.PerformanceMode and 1.2 or 0.4
  if now - lastGenAnalyticsTick < minInterval then
    return
  end
  lastGenAnalyticsTick = now
  updateGeneratorAnalytics()
end))
local function applyCustomSoundToGen(gen)
  if not isPremiumActive() then
    return
  end
  if not gen or not gen:IsA("Model") then
    return
  end
  local cfg = Settings.CustomGenSound
  if not cfg or not cfg.Enabled then
    return
  end
  local hooks = localHooksTable or _G.VD_PremiumHooks
  if hooks and type(hooks.CustomGenSound) == "function" then
    pcall(hooks.CustomGenSound, gen, cfg.SoundId, cfg.Volume)
  end
end
function applyCustomSoundToAllGens()
  local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
  local gensFolder = map and map:FindFirstChild("Generators")
  local gens = gensFolder and gensFolder:GetChildren() or cachedGenerators or {}
  for _, gen in ipairs(gens) do
    applyCustomSoundToGen(gen)
  end
end
local currentPreviewSound = nil
function playSoundPreview(soundIdStr)
  if not isPremiumActive() then
    showNotification(
      "Premium Feature +",
      "Unlock the Premium version to use this feature!",
      "warning"
    )
    return
  end
  if currentPreviewSound then
    pcall(function()
      currentPreviewSound:Stop()
      currentPreviewSound:Destroy()
    end)
    currentPreviewSound = nil
  end
  local function formatCustomSoundId(id)
    if not id or id == "" then
      return "rbxassetid://124429695332529"
    end
    if type(id) == "number" then
      return "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)
    end
    local str = tostring(id):gsub("%s+", "")
    if str:find("^rbxassetid://") or str:find("^http") or str:find("^assetgame") then
      return str
    end
    local num = str:match("%d+")
    if num then
      return "rbxassetid://" .. num
    end
    return str
  end
  local targetSoundId = formatCustomSoundId(soundIdStr)
  local targetVol = (Settings.CustomGenSound and Settings.CustomGenSound.Volume) or 1.0
  currentPreviewSound = Instance.new("Sound")
  currentPreviewSound.SoundId = targetSoundId
  currentPreviewSound.Volume = targetVol
  currentPreviewSound.Parent = workspace:FindFirstChild("CurrentCamera") or workspace
  currentPreviewSound:Play()
  showNotification("Sound Preview", "Playing sound: " .. targetSoundId, "info")
  task.delay(4, function()
    if currentPreviewSound then
      pcall(function()
        currentPreviewSound:Stop()
        currentPreviewSound:Destroy()
      end)
      currentPreviewSound = nil
    end
  end)
end
registerConnection(workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
  if not descendant:IsA("Sound") then
    return
  end
  if descendant.Name == "Done" then
    local parent = descendant.Parent
    if parent and (parent.Name == "HitBox" or parent.Name == "Hitbox") and parent.Parent then
      applyCustomSoundToGen(parent.Parent)
    end
  end
end))

      isPremiumActive()
      and localHooksTable

      and not _G.VD_DBD_Initialized

        localHooksTable.InitDBDSoundAndHud,
        {
          Settings = Settings,
          localPlayer = localPlayer,
          isPremiumActive = isPremiumActive,
          registerConnection = registerConnection,
          showNotification = showNotification,
          isSpectating = isSpectating,
          getPlayerHealthPercent = getPlayerHealthPercent,
          readModelValue = readModelValue,
          activeLoop = activeLoop,
        }
      )
      break
    end
  end
end)
local lastCustomGenSoundTick = 0
