  local cfg = Settings.CustomGenSound
  if cfg and cfg.Enabled then
    local now = tick()
    local minInterval = Settings.PerformanceMode and 2.5 or 1.0
    if now - lastCustomGenSoundTick < minInterval then
      return
    end
    lastCustomGenSoundTick = now
    local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
    local gensFolder = map and map:FindFirstChild("Generators")
    if gensFolder then
      for _, gen in ipairs(gensFolder:GetChildren()) do
        applyCustomSoundToGen(gen)
      end
    end
  end
end))
function isGeneratorCompleted(gen)
  local completed = gen:GetAttribute("Completed")
  if completed == nil then
    local child = gen:FindFirstChild("Completed")
    if child and child:IsA("BoolValue") then
      completed = child.Value
    end
  end
  if completed == true or completed == "true" or tostring(completed):lower() == "true" then
    return true
  end
  return false
end
function isGeneratorPaused(gen)
  if not gen then
    return false
  end
  local paused = gen:GetAttribute("ProgressPaused")
  if paused == nil then
    local child = gen:FindFirstChild("ProgressPaused")
    if child and child:IsA("ValueBase") then
      paused = child.Value
    end
  end
  return paused == true or paused == "true" or tostring(paused):lower() == "true"
end
function getGatePartSafe(gate)
  if not gate or typeof(gate) ~= "Instance" or not gate.Parent then
    return nil
  end
  if gate:IsA("BasePart") then
    return gate
  end
  local exitLever = (gate.Name == "ExitLever" and gate)
    or gate:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true)
    or gate:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")
  if exitLever then
    local main = exitLever:FindFirstChild("Main")
      or (exitLever:IsA("BasePart") and exitLever)
      or (exitLever:IsA("Model") and exitLever.PrimaryPart)
      or exitLever:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
      or exitLever:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    if main then
      return main
    end
  end
  if gate:IsA("Model") and gate.PrimaryPart then
    return gate.PrimaryPart
  end
  return gate:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") or gate:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end
function getGateProgress(inst)
  if not inst then
    return 0
  end
  local function extractProg(obj)
    if not obj then
      return nil
    end
    local val = obj:GetAttribute("ActivationProgress")
      or obj:GetAttribute("Progress")
      or obj:GetAttribute("RepairProgress")
    if val == nil then
      local child = obj:FindFirstChild("ActivationProgress") or obj:FindFirstChild("Progress")
      if child and child:IsA("ValueObject") then
        val = child.Value
      end
    end
    if val ~= nil then
      local num = tonumber(val)
      if num then
        if num <= 1.01 and num > 0 then
          return math.round(num * 100)
        else
          return math.round(num)
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local p1 = extractProg(inst)
  if p1 then
    return p1
  end
  local exitLever = (inst.Name == "ExitLever" and inst)
    or inst:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true)
    or inst:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")
  if exitLever then
    local p2 = extractProg(exitLever)
    if p2 then
      return p2
    end
    local mainPart = exitLever:FindFirstChild("Main")
      or (exitLever:IsA("BasePart") and exitLever)
      or (exitLever:IsA("Model") and exitLever.PrimaryPart)
      or exitLever:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    if mainPart then
      local p3 = extractProg(mainPart)
      if p3 then
        return p3
      end
    end
  end
  local mainDirect = inst:FindFirstChild("Main", true)
  if mainDirect then
    local p4 = extractProg(mainDirect)
    if p4 then
      return p4
    end
  end
  if inst.Parent and inst.Parent ~= workspace then
    local p5 = extractProg(inst.Parent)
    if p5 then
      return p5
    end
    if inst.Parent.Parent and inst.Parent.Parent ~= workspace then
      local p6 = extractProg(inst.Parent.Parent)
      if p6 then
        return p6
      end
    end
  end
  return 0
end
function isInLobby()
  if localPlayer then
    local team = localPlayer.Team
    local teamName = team and team.Name or ""
    if teamName ~= "Survivors" and teamName ~= "Killer" then
      return true
    end
  end
  local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
  if not map then
    return true
  end
  local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby") or workspace:FindFirstChild("lobby")
  local char = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
  if lobby and char and char:IsDescendantOf(lobby) then
    return true
  end
  return false
end
_G.VD_IsInLobby = isInLobby
function isSpectating()
  if localPlayer and localPlayer.Team then
    local teamName = localPlayer.Team.Name
    if
      teamName == "Spectator"
      or teamName == "Spectators"
      or teamName:lower():find("spec")
      or teamName:lower():find("lobby")
    then
      return true
    end
  end
  if isInLobby() then
    return true
  end
  return false
end
writeModelValue = function(instance, name, value)
  if not instance then
    return
  end
  if instance:GetAttribute(name) ~= nil then
    instance:SetAttribute(name, value)
    return
  end
  local child = instance:FindFirstChild(name)
  if child and child:IsA("ValueBase") then
    child.Value = value
    return
  end
  instance:SetAttribute(name, value)
end
readModelValue = function(instance, name)
  if not instance then
    return nil
  end
  local attr = instance:GetAttribute(name)
  if attr ~= nil then
    return attr
  end
  local child = instance:FindFirstChild(name)
  if child and child:IsA("ValueBase") then
    return child.Value
  end
  return nil
end
local isTeleportingTransit = false
local currentActiveTween = nil
function safeSegmentedTeleport(root, targetCFrame, customSpeed)
  if not root or not root.Parent then
    return
  end
  if isTeleportingTransit then
    if currentActiveTween then
      pcall(function()
        currentActiveTween:Cancel()
      end)
    end
  end
  isTeleportingTransit = true
  local ok, res = pcall(function()
    local targetPos = (typeof(targetCFrame) == "CFrame" and targetCFrame.Position) or targetCFrame
    local targetCF = (typeof(targetCFrame) == "CFrame" and targetCFrame) or CFrame.new(targetPos)
    local startCF = root.CFrame
    local startPos = startCF.Position
    local totalDist = (targetPos - startPos).Magnitude
    if totalDist <= 2.0 then
      root.CFrame = targetCF
      pcall(function()
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
      end)
      return
    end
    local speed = customSpeed or Settings.SafeTpSpeed or 14.0
    if speed > 22.0 then
      speed = 22.0
    end
    if speed < 6.0 then
      speed = 6.0
    end
    local duration = totalDist / math.max(speed, 1.0)
    local char = root.Parent
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local alteredParts = {}
    if char and char:IsA("Model") then
      for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
          alteredParts[p] = true
          p.CanCollide = false
        end
      end
    end
    local noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
      if char and char.Parent then
        for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
          if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
            p.CanCollide = false
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    local isUnderground = Settings.UndergroundTP == true and totalDist > 12.0
    local uDepth = Settings.UndergroundDepth or 8.5
    if isUnderground then
      pcall(function()
        root.CFrame = root.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, uDepth, 0)
      end)
    end
    local travelDir = (targetPos - startPos)
    local hDir = Vector3.new(travelDir.X, 0, travelDir.Z)
    local finalCF = isUnderground and (targetCF - Vector3.new(0, uDepth, 0)) or targetCF
    if hDir.Magnitude > 0.01 then
      local facingPos = isUnderground and (targetPos - Vector3.new(0, uDepth, 0)) or targetPos
      finalCF = CFrame.new(facingPos, facingPos + hDir.Unit)
    end
    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    local tween = TweenService:Create(root, tweenInfo, { CFrame = finalCF })
    currentActiveTween = tween
    local keepAliveConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
      if not root or not root.Parent then
        return
      end
      pcall(function()
        local dirUnit = travelDir.Unit
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dirUnit * speed
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
          hum:Move(Vector3.new(dirUnit.X, 0, dirUnit.Z), false)
          hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
        end
      end)
    end)
    tween:Play()
    local startTime = tick()
    local maxWait = duration + 2.0
    local completed = false
    local tweenCompletedConn
    tweenCompletedConn = tween.Completed:Connect(function()
      completed = true
    end)
    while not completed and (tick() - startTime) < maxWait do
      task.wait(0.05)
      if not root or not root.Parent then
        break
      end
      local currentDistToTarget = (targetPos - root.Position).Magnitude
      if currentDistToTarget > totalDist + 15.0 then
        pcall(function()
          tween:Cancel()
        end)
        break
      end
    end
    if tweenCompletedConn then
      pcall(function()
        tweenCompletedConn:Disconnect()
      end)
    end
    if keepAliveConn then
      pcall(function()
        keepAliveConn:Disconnect()
      end)
    end
    if noclipConn then
      pcall(function()
        noclipConn:Disconnect()
      end)
    end
    if root and root.Parent then
      root.CFrame = targetCF
      pcall(function()
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
          hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
        end
      end)
    end
    for p in pairs(alteredParts) do
      if p and p.Parent then
        pcall(function()
          p.CanCollide = true
        end)
      end
    end
    task.wait(0.05)
  end)
  currentActiveTween = nil
  isTeleportingTransit = false
  return ok
end
local gameSpeedBoosts = {}
local ourLastWrittenValue = {}
local speedBoostListeners = {}
local writingSpeedBoost = false
function applySpeedBoostToModel(model) end
function monitorModelSpeedBoost(model) end
function applyLocalPlayerModifiers()
  local team = localPlayer.Team
  local teamName = team and team.Name
  local filter = Settings.ModifierTeamFilter or "Both"
  local isAllowedTeam = false
  if filter == "Both" then
    isAllowedTeam = (not teamName) or (teamName ~= "Spectators" and teamName ~= "Spectator")
  elseif filter == "Survivors" then
    isAllowedTeam = (not teamName) or (teamName ~= "Killer" and teamName ~= "Spectators")
  elseif filter == "Killer" then
    isAllowedTeam = (teamName == "Killer")
  end
  if not isAllowedTeam and Settings.SpeedBoostEnabled then
    Settings.SpeedBoostEnabled = false
    pcall(saveSettings)
    if updateUIFromSettings then
      pcall(updateUIFromSettings)
    end
    showNotification("Speed Boost", "Disabled: Speed Boost team filter active!", "warning")
  end
  local playerName = localPlayer.Name
  if not playerName then
    return
  end
  local targets = {}
  if localPlayer.Character then
    table.insert(targets, localPlayer.Character)
  end
  local direct = workspace:FindFirstChild(playerName)
  if direct and direct:IsA("Model") then
    if not table.find(targets, direct) then
      table.insert(targets, direct)
    end
  end
  local searchRoots =
    { "climb_obsessing", "climb_collisoning", "climb_collisioning", "climb_colliding" }
  for _, rootName in ipairs(searchRoots) do
    local root = workspace:FindFirstChild(rootName)
    if root then
      local model = root:FindFirstChild(playerName)
      if model and model:IsA("Model") then
        if not table.find(targets, model) then
          table.insert(targets, model)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  for _, model in ipairs(targets) do
    local vSpeed = isAllowedTeam and Settings.VaultSpeed or 1.0
    writeModelValue(model, "vaultspeed", vSpeed)
  end
end
pcall(function()
  _G.VD_FlingReportHooked = true
end)
local speedBoostHeartbeatConn = nil
if not speedBoostHeartbeatConn then
  local lastSpeedTick = os.clock()
  speedBoostHeartbeatConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local nowClock = os.clock()
    local dt = nowClock - lastSpeedTick
    lastSpeedTick = nowClock
    if dt > 0.1 then
      dt = 0.0166
    end
    if not activeLoop then
      return
    end
    if not Settings.SpeedBoostEnabled then
      return
    end
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    if not char then
      return
    end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not root or hum.Health <= 0 then
      return
    end
    pcall(function()
      char:SetAttribute("BypassFlingAntiCheat", true)
      char:SetAttribute("ForensicsLaunch", true)
      char:SetAttribute("BypassNoclipAntiCheat", true)
      char:SetAttribute("donttrack", true)
      char:SetAttribute("AC_MovementGraceUntil", 999999999)
      char:SetAttribute("AC_AllowedSpeed", 999999)
      char:SetAttribute("NetTraversalUntil", 999999999)
    end)
    local team = localPlayer.Team
    local teamName = team and team.Name
    local filter = Settings.ModifierTeamFilter or "Both"
    if filter == "Survivors" and teamName == "Killer" then
      return
    end
    if filter == "Killer" and teamName ~= "Killer" then
      return
    end
    if teamName == "Spectators" or teamName == "Spectator" then
      return
    end
    if
      char:GetAttribute("IsStunned") == true
      or char:GetAttribute("Immobile") == true
      or char:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
      or char:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
      or char:GetAttribute("IsCarried") == true
    then
      return
    end
    local moveDir = hum.MoveDirection
    if moveDir.Magnitude > 0.05 then
      local baseSpeed = char:GetAttribute("Speed") or 16
      local mult = tonumber(Settings.SpeedBoost) or 1.3
      if Settings.CountSpeedPerks then
        local gameBoost = char:GetAttribute("speedboost") or 1.0
        mult = gameBoost + (mult - 1.0)
      end
      local now = tick()
      local isSurvivorOrNeutral = (teamName ~= "Killer")
      if
        isSurvivorOrNeutral
        and Settings.SimulateQuickRecovery
        and (now < (_G.VD_QuickRecoveryBoostEnd or 0))
      then
        mult = mult + 0.4
      end
      if
        isSurvivorOrNeutral
        and Settings.SimulatePerfectLanding
        and (now < (_G.VD_PerfectLandingBoostEnd or 0))
      then
        mult = mult + 0.4
      end
      local flatDir = Vector3.new(moveDir.X, 0, moveDir.Z).Unit
      local curVel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
      local targetSpeed = baseSpeed * mult
      local safePhysicsSpeed = math.min(targetSpeed, 18.5)
      root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
        Vector3.new(flatDir.X * safePhysicsSpeed, curVel.Y, flatDir.Z * safePhysicsSpeed)
      local extraSpeed = targetSpeed - safePhysicsSpeed
      if extraSpeed > 0 then
        local stepOffset = flatDir * (extraSpeed * dt)
        root.CFrame = root.CFrame + stepOffset
      end
    end
  end)
  registerConnection(speedBoostHeartbeatConn)
end
cachedGenerators = {}
cachedHooks = {}
cachedPallets = {}
cachedVaults = {}
cachedBloodEffects = {}
cachedGates = {}
cachedBearTraps = {}
cachedPumpkins = {}
local function handleNewMapObject(descendant)
  if not descendant or not descendant.Parent then
    return
  end
  local class = descendant.ClassName
  if class ~= "Model" and class ~= "Part" and class ~= "Folder" then
    return
  end
  local name = descendant.Name
  if name == "Generator" and descendant:IsA("Model") then
    if not table.find(cachedGenerators, descendant) then
      table.insert(cachedGenerators, descendant)
    end
  elseif
    descendant:IsA("Model")
    and (
      descendant.Parent and descendant.Parent.Name == "Pallets"
      or descendant.Name == "Pallet"
      or descendant:FindFirstChild("Intact")
    )
  then
    if not table.find(cachedPallets, descendant) then
      table.insert(cachedPallets, descendant)
    end
  elseif
    name == "Window"
    or name:lower():find("window")
    or name == "Vault"
    or name:lower():find("vault")
  then
    local hasBottom = false
    local hasInviswall = false
    local hasTrigger = false
    for _, child in ipairs(descendant:GetDescendants()) do
      local cName = child.Name:lower()
      if cName == "bottom" then
        hasBottom = true
      elseif cName == "inviswall" then
        hasInviswall = true
      elseif cName == "vaulttrigger" then
        hasTrigger = true
      end
    end
    if hasBottom and hasInviswall and hasTrigger then
      if not table.find(cachedVaults, descendant) then
        table.insert(cachedVaults, descendant)
      end
    end
  elseif name == "VaultTrigger" or name:lower():find("vaulttrigger") then
    local vaultModel = descendant.Parent
    if vaultModel and (vaultModel:IsA("Model") or vaultModel:IsA("Folder")) then
      local hasBottom = false
      local hasInviswall = false
      for _, child in ipairs(vaultModel:GetDescendants()) do
        local cName = child.Name:lower()
        if cName == "bottom" then
          hasBottom = true
        elseif cName == "inviswall" then
          hasInviswall = true
        end
      end
      if hasBottom and hasInviswall then
        if not table.find(cachedVaults, vaultModel) then
          table.insert(cachedVaults, vaultModel)
        end
      end
    end
  elseif name == "BloodEffect" and descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
    if not table.find(cachedBloodEffects, descendant) then
      table.insert(cachedBloodEffects, descendant)
    end
  elseif name == "Hook" or name == "HookPoint" then
    local players = Players:GetPlayers()
    local playerChars = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(players) do
      if p.Character then
        playerChars[p.Character] = true
      end
    end
    local isPlayerChar = false
    local current = descendant
    while current and current ~= workspace do
      if playerChars[current] then
        isPlayerChar = true
        break
      end
      current = current.Parent
    end
    if not isPlayerChar then
      local targetPart = nil
      if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
        targetPart = descendant
      elseif descendant:IsA("Model") or descendant:IsA("Folder") then
        targetPart = descendant:FindFirstChild("HookPoint")
          or (descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant.PrimaryPart)
          or descendant:FindFirstChild("Handle")
          or descendant:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
      end
      if targetPart then
        if not table.find(cachedHooks, targetPart) then
          table.insert(cachedHooks, targetPart)
        end
      end
    end
  elseif
    name == "ExitLever"
    and not (
      name:lower():find("spot")
      or name:lower():find("spawn")
      or name:lower():find("marker")
      or name:lower():find("point")
    )
  then
    if not table.find(cachedGates, descendant) then
      table.insert(cachedGates, descendant)
    end
  elseif (name == "Gate" or name == "ESCAPEGATE") and descendant:IsA("Model") then
    local lever = descendant:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true)
    if lever and not table.find(cachedGates, lever) then
      table.insert(cachedGates, lever)
    end
  elseif
    name == "BearTrap" or (CollectionService and CollectionService:HasTag(descendant, "BearTrap"))
  then
    if not table.find(cachedBearTraps, descendant) then
      table.insert(cachedBearTraps, descendant)
    end
  elseif
    (descendant.Parent and descendant.Parent.Name == "Pumpkins")
    or (name:lower():find("pumpkin") and name ~= "Pumpkins")
  then
    if not descendant:IsA("Folder") then
      local target = (descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant)
        or (descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant)
      if target and not table.find(cachedPumpkins, target) then
        table.insert(cachedPumpkins, target)
      end
    end
  end
end
local function handleRemovedMapObject(descendant)
  if not descendant then
    return
  end
  local name = descendant.Name
  if name == "Generator" then
    local idx = table.find(cachedGenerators, descendant)
    if idx then
      table.remove(cachedGenerators, idx)
    end
    pcall(function()
      removeModelESP(descendant, "Generator")
    end)
  elseif
    name == "Pallet"
    or (descendant.Parent and descendant.Parent.Name == "Pallets")
    or table.find(cachedPallets, descendant)
  then
    local idx = table.find(cachedPallets, descendant)
    if idx then
      table.remove(cachedPallets, idx)
    end
    pcall(function()
      removeModelESP(descendant, "Pallet")
    end)
  elseif
    name == "Window"
    or name:lower():find("window")
    or name == "Vault"
    or name:lower():find("vault")
  then
    local idx = table.find(cachedVaults, descendant)
    if idx then
      table.remove(cachedVaults, idx)
    end
    pcall(function()
      removeModelESP(descendant, "Vault")
    end)
  elseif name == "VaultTrigger" or name:lower():find("vaulttrigger") then
    local vaultModel = descendant.Parent
    if vaultModel then
      local idx = table.find(cachedVaults, vaultModel)
      if idx then
        table.remove(cachedVaults, idx)
      end
      pcall(function()
        removeModelESP(vaultModel, "Vault")
      end)
    end
  elseif name == "BloodEffect" then
    local idx = table.find(cachedBloodEffects, descendant)
    if idx then
      table.remove(cachedBloodEffects, idx)
    end
    pcall(function()
      removeModelESP(descendant, "BloodEffect")
    end)
  elseif name == "Hook" or name == "HookPoint" then
    local idx = table.find(cachedHooks, descendant)
    if idx then
      table.remove(cachedHooks, idx)
      pcall(function()
        removeModelESP(descendant, "Hook")
      end)
    else
      for i = #cachedHooks, 1, -1 do
        local h = cachedHooks[i]
        if h == descendant or h:IsDescendantOf(descendant) then
          table.remove(cachedHooks, i)
          pcall(function()
            removeModelESP(h, "Hook")
          end)
        end
      end
    end
  elseif
    name == "Gate"
    or name == "ESCAPEGATE"
    or name == "ExitLever"
    or table.find(cachedGates, descendant)
  then
    local idx = table.find(cachedGates, descendant)
    if idx then
      table.remove(cachedGates, idx)
    end
    pcall(function()
      removeModelESP(descendant, "Gate")
    end)
  elseif name == "BearTrap" then
    local idx = table.find(cachedBearTraps, descendant)
    if idx then
      table.remove(cachedBearTraps, idx)
    end
    pcall(function()
      removeModelESP(descendant, "BearTrap")
    end)
  elseif
    name == "Pumpkin"
    or (descendant.Parent and descendant.Parent.Name == "Pumpkins")
    or table.find(cachedPumpkins, descendant)
  then
    local idx = table.find(cachedPumpkins, descendant)
    if idx then
      table.remove(cachedPumpkins, idx)
    end
    pcall(function()
      removeModelESP(descendant, "Pumpkins")
    end)
  end
end
registerConnection(workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
  pcall(handleNewMapObject, descendant)
end))
registerConnection(workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(descendant)
  pcall(handleRemovedMapObject, descendant)
end))
for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
  pcall(handleNewMapObject, desc)
end

      pcall(scanMapObjects)
      pcall(refreshTPMenu)
    end)
  end
end))

  if child.Name == "Map" then
    cachedGenerators = {}
    cachedHooks = {}
    cachedPallets = {}
    cachedVaults = {}
    cachedBloodEffects = {}
    cachedGates = {}
    cachedBearTraps = {}
    cachedPumpkins = {}
    if cleanupAllMapESP then
      pcall(cleanupAllMapESP)
    end
  end
end))

_G.VD_BLACKLISTED_ANIMATION_IDS = BLACKLISTED_ANIMATION_IDS
_G.VD_LoggedAnimations = _G.VD_LoggedAnimations or {}
_G.VD_BlacklistAnimation = function(id)
  if not id then
    return false
  end
  local cleanId = string.match(tostring(id), "%d+") or ""
  if cleanId ~= "" then
    BLACKLISTED_ANIMATION_IDS[cleanId] = true
    if _G.VD_LoggedAnimations[cleanId] then
      _G.VD_LoggedAnimations[cleanId].blacklisted = true
    end
    print("[VD PARRY] Added animation ID to Blacklist: " .. cleanId)
    warn("[VD PARRY] Blacklisted: " .. cleanId)
    pcall(function()
      if rconsoleprint then
        rconsoleprint("@@RED@@[VD BLACKLIST] Added: " .. cleanId .. "\n")
      end
    end)
    return true
  end
  return false
end
_G.VD_UnblacklistAnimation = function(id)
  if not id then
    return false
  end
  local cleanId = string.match(tostring(id), "%d+") or ""
  if cleanId ~= "" then
    BLACKLISTED_ANIMATION_IDS[cleanId] = nil
    if _G.VD_LoggedAnimations[cleanId] then
      _G.VD_LoggedAnimations[cleanId].blacklisted = false
    end
    print("[VD PARRY] Removed animation ID from Blacklist: " .. cleanId)
    warn("[VD PARRY] Unblacklisted: " .. cleanId)
    pcall(function()
      if rconsoleprint then
        rconsoleprint("@@GREEN@@[VD BLACKLIST] Removed: " .. cleanId .. "\n")
      end
    end)
    return true
  end
  return false
end
_G.VD_PrintLoggedAnimations = function()
  print("=== VD LOGGED KILLER ANIMATIONS ===")
  if not _G.VD_LoggedAnimations or not next(_G.VD_LoggedAnimations) then
    print("No killer animations logged yet.")
    return
  end
  for id, info in pairs(_G.VD_LoggedAnimations) do
    print(
      string.format(
        "ID: %s | Killer: %s | Prio: %s | Loop: %s | BL: %s | Name: '%s' | Track: '%s' | Time: %s",
        tostring(id),
        tostring(info.killer),
        tostring(info.priority),
        tostring(info.looped),
        tostring(info.blacklisted),
        tostring(info.name),
        tostring(info.track),
        tostring(info.time)
      )
    )
  end
end
local cachedSCPs = {}
function updateSCPCache()
  local scps = {}
  local added = {}
  local function addSCP(inst)
    if inst and not added[inst] then
      added[inst] = true
      table.insert(scps, inst)
    end
  end
  local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
  if map then
    for _, folderName in ipairs({ "1", "2" }) do
      local folder = map:FindFirstChild(folderName)
      if folder then
        for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
          if child:IsA("Model") then
            addSCP(child)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local function isSCPName(name)
      return string.match(name:lower(), "^scp%d*$") ~= nil
    end
    for _, child in ipairs(map:GetChildren()) do
      if child.Name ~= "1" and child.Name ~= "2" then
        if child:IsA("Model") and isSCPName(child.Name) then
          addSCP(child)
        elseif child:IsA("Folder") or child:IsA("Model") then
          for _, subChild in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
            if subChild:IsA("Model") and isSCPName(subChild.Name) then
              addSCP(subChild)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    for _, child in ipairs(map:GetChildren()) do
      if child:IsA("Model") and child ~= localPlayer.Character then
        local curedVal = child:GetAttribute("Cured")
        if tonumber(curedVal) == 3 then
          addSCP(child)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  cachedSCPs = scps
end
local lastMapInstance = nil
local cachedMapName = "Unknown Map"
function getMapName()
  local ok, text = pcall(function()
    return game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Darkness.Frame.MapInfo.MapTitle.Text
  end)
  if ok and text and text ~= "" then
    if text:upper() == "NOSTROMO" then
      return "Loading..."
    end
    return text
  end
  local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
  if not map then
    lastMapInstance = nil
    cachedMapName = "Unknown Map"
    return cachedMapName
  end
  local currentMapInstance = map:FindFirstChildOfClass("Model")
    or map:FindFirstChildOfClass("Folder")
    or map
  if currentMapInstance == lastMapInstance and cachedMapName ~= "Unknown Map" then
    return cachedMapName
  end
  lastMapInstance = currentMapInstance
  if map:FindFirstChild("HooksMeat", true) then
    cachedMapName = "BLOODBATH! Club"
    return cachedMapName
  end
  if map:FindFirstChild("Rooftop", true) then
    cachedMapName = "Mercy Hospital Rooftop"
    return cachedMapName
  end
  if map:FindFirstChild("inviswallasylum", true) then
    cachedMapName = "Mount Massive Asylum"
    return cachedMapName
  end
  if map:FindFirstChild("Tesla", true) then
    cachedMapName = "Site 68"
    return cachedMapName
  end
  if map:FindFirstChild("Breakwater", true) then
    cachedMapName = "The Bay Harbor"
    return cachedMapName
  end
  if map:FindFirstChild("RockVar0", true) then
    cachedMapName = "Woodview Cabin"
    return cachedMapName
  end
  local model = map:FindFirstChild("Model", true)
  if model then
    local p = model:GetPivot().Position
    if (p - Vector3.new(-811.4, 212.8, -7774.5)).Magnitude < 100 then
      cachedMapName = "Firelink Shrine"
      return cachedMapName
    end
    if (p - Vector3.new(1114.67, -16.92, -12.99)).Magnitude < 100 then
      cachedMapName = "Valdelobos Village"
      return cachedMapName
    end
  end
  cachedMapName = "Unknown Map"
  return cachedMapName
end
function applyBlockInteractions()
  pcall(function()
    local vaultEvent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    vaultEvent = vaultEvent and vaultEvent:FindFirstChild("Window")
    vaultEvent = vaultEvent and vaultEvent:FindFirstChild("VaultEvent")
    if vaultEvent then
      for _, vault in ipairs(cachedVaults) do
        if vault and vault.Parent then
          for _, child in ipairs(vault:GetDescendants()) do
            if child.Name == "VaultTrigger" then
              vaultEvent:FireServer(child, true)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    local palletSlideEvent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    palletSlideEvent = palletSlideEvent and palletSlideEvent:FindFirstChild("Pallet")
    palletSlideEvent = palletSlideEvent and palletSlideEvent:FindFirstChild("PalletSlideEvent")
    if palletSlideEvent then
      for _, pallet in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
        if pallet and pallet.Parent then
          for _, child in ipairs(pallet:GetDescendants()) do
            if child.Name == "PalletPointSlide" or child.Name:find("Slide") then
              palletSlideEvent:FireServer(child, true)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end)
end
function releaseBlockInteractions()
  _G.VD_ReleasingBlockInteractions = true
  pcall(function()
    local vaultCompleteEvent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    vaultCompleteEvent = vaultCompleteEvent and vaultCompleteEvent:FindFirstChild("Window")
    vaultCompleteEvent = vaultCompleteEvent
      and vaultCompleteEvent:FindFirstChild("VaultCompleteEvent")
    if vaultCompleteEvent then
      local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
      local searchRoot = map or workspace
      for _, child in ipairs(searchRoot:GetDescendants()) do
        if child.Name == "VaultTrigger" then
          vaultCompleteEvent:FireServer(child, false)
        end
      end
    end
  end)
  _G.VD_ReleasingBlockInteractions = false
  pcall(function()
    local palletSlideCompleteEvent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    palletSlideCompleteEvent = palletSlideCompleteEvent
      and palletSlideCompleteEvent:FindFirstChild("Pallet")
    palletSlideCompleteEvent = palletSlideCompleteEvent
      and palletSlideCompleteEvent:FindFirstChild("PalletSlideCompleteEvent")
    if palletSlideCompleteEvent then
      for _, pallet in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
        if pallet and pallet.Parent then
          for _, child in ipairs(pallet:GetDescendants()) do
            if child.Name == "PalletPointSlide" or child.Name:find("Slide") then
              palletSlideCompleteEvent:FireServer(child)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end)
end
do
  local isScanningMapObjects = false
  function scanMapObjects()
    if isScanningMapObjects then
      return
    end
    if isInLobby and isInLobby() then
      table.clear(cachedGenerators)
      table.clear(cachedBearTraps)
      table.clear(cachedHooks)
      table.clear(cachedPallets)
      table.clear(cachedVaults)
      return
    end
    isScanningMapObjects = true
    task.spawn(function()
      local gens, hooks, pallets, vaults, bloods, gates, traps = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
      local hookSet = {}
      pcall(updateSCPCache)
      pcall(function()
        processedNoclip = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        moonwalkPartCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "kv" })
        if originalCanCollide then
          for part, _ in pairs(originalCanCollide) do
            if not part or not part.Parent then
              originalCanCollide[part] = nil
            end
          end
        end
      end)
      local players = Players:GetPlayers()
      local playerChars = {}
      for _, p in ipairs(players) do
        if p.Character then
          playerChars[p.Character] = true
        end
      end
      local mapFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
      local allDescendants = mapFolder and mapFolder:GetDescendants() or workspace:GetDescendants()
      for i, descendant in ipairs(allDescendants) do
        if i % 300 == 0 then
          task.wait()
        end
        local name = descendant.Name
        if (name == "Generator" or name:lower():find("generator")) and descendant:IsA("Model") then
          table.insert(gens, descendant)
        elseif
          descendant:IsA("Model")
          and (
            descendant.Parent and descendant.Parent.Name == "Pallets"
            or descendant.Name == "Pallet"
            or descendant:FindFirstChild("Intact")
          )
        then
          table.insert(pallets, descendant)
        elseif
          descendant.Name == "BearTrap"
          or (CollectionService and CollectionService:HasTag(descendant, "BearTrap"))
        then
          table.insert(traps, descendant)
        elseif
          name == "Window"
          or name:lower():find("window")
          or name == "Vault"
          or name:lower():find("vault")
        then
          local hasBottom = descendant:FindFirstChild("bottom")
            or descendant:FindFirstChild("Bottom")
          local hasInviswall = descendant:FindFirstChild("inviswall")
            or descendant:FindFirstChild("Inviswall")
          local hasTrigger = descendant:FindFirstChild("vaulttrigger")
            or descendant:FindFirstChild("VaultTrigger")
          if not (hasBottom and hasInviswall and hasTrigger) then
            for _, child in ipairs(descendant:GetChildren()) do
              local cName = child.Name:lower()
              if cName == "bottom" then
                hasBottom = true
              elseif cName == "inviswall" then
                hasInviswall = true
              elseif cName == "vaulttrigger" then
                hasTrigger = true
              end
            end
          end
          if hasBottom and hasInviswall and hasTrigger then
            table.insert(vaults, descendant)
          end
        elseif name == "BloodEffect" and descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
          table.insert(bloods, descendant)
        elseif name == "Hook" or name == "HookPoint" then
          local isPlayerChar = false
          local current = descendant
          while current and current ~= workspace and current ~= mapFolder do
            if playerChars[current] then
              isPlayerChar = true
              break
            end
            current = current.Parent
          end
          if not isPlayerChar then
            local targetPart = nil
            if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
              targetPart = descendant
            elseif descendant:IsA("Model") or descendant:IsA("Folder") then
              targetPart = descendant:FindFirstChild("HookPoint")
                or (descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant.PrimaryPart)
                or descendant:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                or descendant:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            end
            if targetPart and not hookSet[targetPart] then
              hookSet[targetPart] = true
              table.insert(hooks, targetPart)
            end
          end
        elseif
          (
            name == "ExitLever"
            or descendant:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true)
            or descendant:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")
          )
          and not (
            name:lower():find("spot")
            or name:lower():find("spawn")
            or name:lower():find("marker")
            or name:lower():find("point")
          )
        then
          local lever = (descendant.Name == "ExitLever" and descendant)
            or descendant:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true)
            or descendant:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")
          if lever and not table.find(gates, lever) then
            table.insert(gates, lever)
          end
        end
      end
      cachedGenerators = gens
      cachedHooks = hooks
      cachedPallets = pallets
      cachedVaults = vaults
      cachedBloodEffects = bloods
      if mapFolder then
        for _, child in ipairs(mapFolder:GetChildren()) do
          local cName = child.Name:lower()
          local isSpotOrSpawn = cName:find("spot")
            or cName:find("spawn")
            or cName:find("marker")
            or cName:find("point")
          if not isSpotOrSpawn then
            local lever = (child.Name == "ExitLever" and child)
              or child:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true)
              or child:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")
            if lever and not table.find(gates, lever) then
              table.insert(gates, lever)
            end
          end
        end
      end
      local pumpkins = {}
      local pumpkinsFolder = mapFolder and mapFolder:FindFirstChild("Pumpkins")
      if pumpkinsFolder then
        for _, child in ipairs(pumpkinsFolder:GetChildren()) do
          if not child:IsA("Folder") then
            local target = (child:IsA("Model") and child) or (child:IsA("BasePart") and child)
            if target and not table.find(pumpkins, target) then
              table.insert(pumpkins, target)
            end
          else
            for _, sub in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
              local target = (sub:IsA("Model") and sub) or (sub:IsA("BasePart") and sub)
              if target and not table.find(pumpkins, target) then
                table.insert(pumpkins, target)
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      for _, desc in ipairs(mapFolder:GetDescendants()) do
        if
          desc.Name ~= "Pumpkins"
          and desc.Name:lower():find("pumpkin")
          and not desc:IsA("Folder")
        then
          local target = (desc:IsA("Model") and desc) or (desc:IsA("BasePart") and desc)
          if target and not table.find(pumpkins, target) then
            table.insert(pumpkins, target)
          end
        end
      end
      cachedPumpkins = pumpkins
      cachedGates = gates
      cachedBearTraps = traps
      if refreshTPMenu then
        pcall(refreshTPMenu)
      end
      isScanningMapObjects = false
    end)
  end
end
forceUpdateESPStyle = function()
  local posY = 3.5 + (Settings.ESPPositionY or 0)
  local espFont = Enum.Font[Settings.ESPFont] or Enum.Font.Ubuntu
  local espInfoFont = (Settings.ESPFont == "GothamBold" and Enum.Font.Ubuntu) or espFont
  local strokeColor = Settings.ESPTextOutlineColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  local customTextColor = (Settings.ESPTextColorMode == "Custom" and Settings.ESPTextColor) or nil
  for _, data in pairs(ActiveESP.Players) do
    data.LastESPStyle = nil
    data.LastHighlightColor = nil
    data.LastNameColor = nil
    if data.Billboard then
      data.Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, posY, 0)
    end
    if data.NameLabel then
      data.NameLabel.Font = espFont
      data.NameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = strokeColor
      if customTextColor then
        data.NameLabel.TextColor3 = customTextColor
      end
    end
    if data.InfoLabel then
      data.InfoLabel.Font = espInfoFont
      data.InfoLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = strokeColor
      if customTextColor then
        data.InfoLabel.TextColor3 = customTextColor
      end
    end
  end
  for _, list in pairs({
    ActiveESP.Generators,
    ActiveESP.Hooks,
    ActiveESP.Pallets,
    ActiveESP.Vaults,
    ActiveESP.BloodEffects,
    ActiveESP.Gates,
    ActiveESP.SCPs,
    ActiveESP.BearTraps,
    ActiveESP.Pumpkins,
  }) do
    for _, data in pairs(list) do
      data.LastESPStyle = nil
      data.LastHighlightColor = nil
      if data.Billboard then
        data.Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, posY, 0)
      end
      if data.NameLabel then
        data.NameLabel.Font = espFont
        data.NameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = strokeColor
        if customTextColor then
          data.NameLabel.TextColor3 = customTextColor
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
function createPlayerESP(player)
  if ActiveESP.Players[player] then
    return
  end
  local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
  hl.FillTransparency = Settings.ESPFillTransparency or 0.6
  hl.OutlineTransparency = Settings.ESPOutlineTransparency or 0.1
  hl.Enabled = false
  hl.Parent = highlightParent
  local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
  bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
  bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.5 + (Settings.ESPPositionY or 0), 0)
  bb.Enabled = false
  bb.Parent = billboardParent
  local container = Instance.new("Frame")
  container.Name = "Container"
  container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  container.BorderSizePixel = 0
  container.Parent = bb
  local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
  corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
  corner.Parent = container
  local containerStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
  containerStroke.Thickness = 1
  containerStroke.Transparency = 1
  containerStroke.Parent = container
  local espFont = Enum.Font[Settings.ESPFont] or Enum.Font.Ubuntu
  local espInfoFont = (Settings.ESPFont == "GothamBold" and Enum.Font.Ubuntu) or espFont
  local nl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  nl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  nl.TextColor3 = (Settings.ESPTextColorMode == "Custom" and Settings.ESPTextColor)
    or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
  nl.Font = espFont
  nl.TextStrokeColor3 = Settings.ESPTextOutlineColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  nl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
  nl.Parent = container
  local infoLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  infoLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  infoLabel.TextColor3 = (Settings.ESPTextColorMode == "Custom" and Settings.ESPTextColor)
    or Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
  infoLabel.Font = espInfoFont
  infoLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Settings.ESPTextOutlineColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  infoLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
  infoLabel.Parent = container
  ActiveESP.Players[player] = {
    Highlight = hl,
    Billboard = bb,
    Container = container,
    ContainerStroke = containerStroke,
    NameLabel = nl,
    InfoLabel = infoLabel,
    Tracer = nil,
    CurrentCharacter = nil,
    LastAuraEnabled = nil,
    LastHighlightColor = nil,
    LastBillboardEnabled = nil,
    LastNameText = nil,
    LastNameColor = nil,
    LastInfoText = nil,
    LastHookedProgressVal = nil,
    LastHookedChangeTime = 0,
    LastESPStyle = nil,
    LastIsMobile = nil,
  }
end
local function setTracerVisible(data, visible)
  local tracer = data.Tracer
  if not tracer then
    return
  end
  pcall(function()
    if type(tracer) == "table" then
      for _, obj in pairs(tracer) do
        if type(obj) == "table" or type(obj) == "userdata" then
          pcall(function()
            obj.Visible = visible
          end)
        end
      end
    elseif typeof(tracer) == "Instance" then
      tracer.Visible = visible
    end
  end)
end
function removePlayerESP(player)
  local data = ActiveESP.Players[player]
  if data then
    if data.Highlight then
      pcall(function()
        data.Highlight:Destroy()
      end)
    end
    if data.Billboard then
      pcall(function()
        data.Billboard:Destroy()
      end)
    end
    if data.Tracer then
      pcall(function()
        if type(data.Tracer) == "table" then
          for _, obj in pairs(data.Tracer) do
            if type(obj) == "table" or type(obj) == "userdata" then
              pcall(function()
                obj:Remove()
              end)
            elseif typeof(obj) == "Instance" then
              pcall(function()
                obj:Destroy()
              end)
            end
          end
        elseif typeof(data.Tracer) == "Instance" then
          data.Tracer:Destroy()
        end
      end)
      data.Tracer = nil
    end
    ActiveESP.Players[player] = nil
  end
end
local playerEspCleaned = false
function updatePlayersESP()
  if isSpectating() then
    if not playerEspCleaned then
      for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local data = ActiveESP.Players[player]
        if data then
          if data.LastAuraEnabled ~= false then
            data.Highlight.Enabled = false
            data.LastAuraEnabled = false
          end
          if data.LastBillboardEnabled ~= false then
            data.Billboard.Enabled = false
            data.LastBillboardEnabled = false
          end
          if data.Tracer then
            setTracerVisible(data, false)
          end
          data.CurrentCharacter = nil
        end
      end
      playerEspCleaned = true
    end
    return
  end
  local isMeEspActive = Settings.MeESP and Settings.MeESP.Enabled
  if
    not Settings.MasterESP
    or (not Settings.KillerESP.Enabled and not Settings.SurvivorESP.Enabled and not isMeEspActive)
  then
    if not playerEspCleaned then
      for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local data = ActiveESP.Players[player]
        if data then
          if data.LastAuraEnabled ~= false then
            data.Highlight.Enabled = false
            data.LastAuraEnabled = false
          end
          if data.LastBillboardEnabled ~= false then
            data.Billboard.Enabled = false
            data.LastBillboardEnabled = false
          end
          if data.Tracer then
            setTracerVisible(data, false)
          end
          data.CurrentCharacter = nil
        end
      end
      playerEspCleaned = true
    end
    return
  end
  playerEspCleaned = false
  local style = Settings.ESPStyle or "Standard"
  if not _G.VD_EspActiveTargets then
    _G.VD_EspActiveTargets = {}
    _G.VD_EspKnownPlayerChars = {}
    _G.VD_CachedBotsList = {}
    _G.VD_LastBotScanTime = 0
  end
  local activeTargets = _G.VD_EspActiveTargets
  local knownPlayerChars = _G.VD_EspKnownPlayerChars
  table.clear(activeTargets)
  table.clear(knownPlayerChars)
  for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    table.insert(activeTargets, { entity = player, char = player.Character, isBot = false })
    if player.Character then
      knownPlayerChars[player.Character] = true
    end
  end
  local nowTime = tick()
  if (nowTime - _G.VD_LastBotScanTime) >= 0.8 then
    _G.VD_LastBotScanTime = nowTime
    table.clear(_G.VD_CachedBotsList)
    for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
      if child:IsA("Model") and child ~= localPlayer.Character and not knownPlayerChars[child] then
        local hum = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hrp = child:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hum and hrp then
          local isScp = (isSCPName and isSCPName(child.Name)) or (child:GetAttribute("Cured") == 3)
          if
            not isScp
            and (hum.Health > 0 or child:GetAttribute("Knocked") or child:GetAttribute("IsHooked"))
          then
            table.insert(_G.VD_CachedBotsList, child)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    for _, folderName in ipairs({ "Survivors", "Killers", "Bots" }) do
      local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild(folderName)
      if folder then
        for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
          if
            child:IsA("Model")
            and child ~= localPlayer.Character
            and not knownPlayerChars[child]
          then
            local hum = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = child:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hum and hrp then
              local isScp = (isSCPName and isSCPName(child.Name))
                or (child:GetAttribute("Cured") == 3)
              if
                not isScp
                and (
                  hum.Health > 0
                  or child:GetAttribute("Knocked")
                  or child:GetAttribute("IsHooked")
                )
              then
                table.insert(_G.VD_CachedBotsList, child)
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  for _, bot in ipairs(_G.VD_CachedBotsList) do
    if bot and bot.Parent and bot:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and not knownPlayerChars[bot] then
      local hum = bot:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if
        hum and (hum.Health > 0 or bot:GetAttribute("Knocked") or bot:GetAttribute("IsHooked"))
      then
        table.insert(activeTargets, { entity = bot, char = bot, isBot = true })
        knownPlayerChars[bot] = true
      end
    end
  end
  for _, targetInfo in ipairs(activeTargets) do
    local player = targetInfo.entity
    local isBot = targetInfo.isBot
    local char = targetInfo.char
    local isMe = not isBot and (player == localPlayer)
    if isMe and not (Settings.MeESP and Settings.MeESP.Enabled) then
      local data = ActiveESP.Players[localPlayer]
      if data then
        if data.Highlight then
          data.Highlight.Enabled = false
        end
        if data.Billboard then
          data.Billboard.Enabled = false
        end
        if data.Tracer then
          setTracerVisible(data, false)
        end
        data.LastAuraEnabled = false
        data.LastBillboardEnabled = false
        data.CurrentCharacter = nil
      end
      continue
    end
    createPlayerESP(player)
    local data = ActiveESP.Players[player]
    if not data then
      continue
    end
    local rootPart = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local isKiller = data.IsKiller
    local isSurvivor = data.IsSurvivor
    local isCuredZombie = false
    if isMe then
      isKiller = false
      isSurvivor = false
      data.IsKiller = false
      data.IsSurvivor = false
    elseif isBot then
      local pName = char.Parent and char.Parent.Name
      if
        pName == "Killers"
        or char:FindFirstChild("StunEvent")
        or char:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer"
        or char:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true
        or char.Name == "Veil"
      then
        isKiller = true
        isSurvivor = false
      else
        isSurvivor = true
        isKiller = false
      end
      data.IsKiller = isKiller
      data.IsSurvivor = isSurvivor
    elseif isKiller == nil or data.CurrentCharacter ~= char then
      local team = player.Team
      isKiller = team and team.Name == "Killer"
      isSurvivor = team and team.Name == "Survivors"
      if not team then
        local plName = player.Name:lower()
        if plName:find("killer") then
          isKiller = true
        elseif plName:find("survivor") then
          isSurvivor = true
        end
      end
      if char then
        local pName = char.Parent and char.Parent.Name
        if pName == "Killers" or char:FindFirstChild("StunEvent") then
          isKiller = true
          isSurvivor = false
        elseif char.Name == "Veil" or (char.Parent and char.Parent.Name == "Veil") then
          isKiller = true
          isSurvivor = false
        end
        local curedVal = char:GetAttribute("Cured")
        if curedVal == 3 then
          isCuredZombie = true
          isKiller = true
          isSurvivor = false
        end
      end
      if isKiller == nil then
        isKiller = false
      end
      if isSurvivor == nil then
        isSurvivor = false
      end
      data.IsKiller = isKiller
      data.IsSurvivor = isSurvivor
    else
      if char then
        local curedVal = char:GetAttribute("Cured")
        if curedVal == 3 then
          isCuredZombie = true
          isKiller = true
          isSurvivor = false
        end
      end
    end
    local espEnabled = false
    local col = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    local isKnocked = false
    local isHookedActive = false
    if char then
      local knocked = readModelValue(char, "Knocked")
      if knocked == true or tostring(knocked):lower() == "true" or knocked == 1 then
        isKnocked = true
      end
      local isHooked = readModelValue(char, "IsHooked") == true
        or char:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
      if isHooked then
        isHookedActive = true
      else
        local progressVal = readModelValue(char, "HookedProgress")
        if progressVal and tonumber(progressVal) then
          local progNum = tonumber(progressVal)
          if data.LastHookedProgressVal == nil then
            data.LastHookedProgressVal = progNum
            data.LastHookedChangeTime = 0
          elseif data.LastHookedProgressVal ~= progNum then
            data.LastHookedProgressVal = progNum
            data.LastHookedChangeTime = os.clock()
          end
          if os.clock() - (data.LastHookedChangeTime or 0) < 2.0 then
            isHookedActive = true
          end
        else
          data.LastHookedProgressVal = nil
        end
      end
    end
    local dist = isMe and 0 or getDistance(player, rootPart)
    local withinRange = isMe or (dist <= Settings.ESPRange)
    if isMe and Settings.MeESP and Settings.MeESP.Enabled then
      espEnabled = true
      col = getESPColor("Me")
    elseif isCuredZombie and Settings.KillerESP.Enabled and withinRange then
      espEnabled = true
      local scpColor = Settings.ESPColors and Settings.ESPColors["SCP"]
      col = scpColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 80)
    elseif isKiller and Settings.KillerESP.Enabled and withinRange then
      espEnabled = true
      col = getESPColor("Killer")
    elseif isSurvivor and Settings.SurvivorESP.Enabled and withinRange then
      espEnabled = true
      if isKnocked or isHookedActive then
        col = getESPColor("SurvivorKnocked")
      else
        local health, maxHealth = getPlayerHealthPercent(player)
        if health < maxHealth then
          col = getESPColor("SurvivorInjured")
        else
          col = getESPColor("SurvivorHealthy")
        end
      end
    end
    if espEnabled and rootPart and char then
      if data.CurrentCharacter ~= char then
        data.Highlight.Adornee = char
        data.Billboard.Adornee = rootPart
        data.CurrentCharacter = char
      end
      local showAura = isMe and Settings.MeESP.Aura
        or isKiller and Settings.KillerESP.Aura
        or isSurvivor and Settings.SurvivorESP.Aura
      local isCarried = false
      if char.Parent and char.Parent ~= workspace then
        if char.Parent:IsA("Model") and char.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
          isCarried = true
        elseif
          char.Parent.Name:lower():find("carry") or char.Parent.Name:lower():find("carried")
        then
          isCarried = true
        end
      end
      if isSurvivor and isCarried then
        showAura = false
      end
      local targetAlpha = 1.0
      local isFadeActive = Settings.ESPDistanceFade and Settings.ESPDistanceFadePlayers
      if isFadeActive and dist then
        if dist >= Settings.ESPFadeMax then
          targetAlpha = 0.0
        elseif dist > Settings.ESPFadeStart then
          local range = Settings.ESPFadeMax - Settings.ESPFadeStart
          local diff = dist - Settings.ESPFadeStart
          targetAlpha = 1.0 - (diff / range)
        end
      end
      data.DistanceOpacityFactor = targetAlpha
      data.LastAuraEnabled = showAura and (targetAlpha > 0.005)
      data.TargetHighlightVisible = true
      local highlightFillCol = (Settings.ESPFillColorMode == "Custom" and Settings.ESPFillColor)
        or col
      local highlightOutlineCol = (
        Settings.ESPOutlineColorMode == "Custom" and Settings.ESPOutlineColor
      ) or col
      if data.Highlight.FillColor ~= highlightFillCol then
        data.Highlight.FillColor = highlightFillCol
      end
      if data.Highlight.OutlineColor ~= highlightOutlineCol then
        data.Highlight.OutlineColor = highlightOutlineCol
      end
      local textOutlineCol = Settings.ESPTextOutlineColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
      if data.NameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 ~= textOutlineCol then
        data.NameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = textOutlineCol
      end
      if data.InfoLabel and data.InfoLabel.TextStrokeColor3 ~= textOutlineCol then
        data.InfoLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = textOutlineCol
      end
      local espFont = Enum.Font[Settings.ESPFont] or Enum.Font.Ubuntu
      if data.NameLabel.Font ~= espFont then
        data.NameLabel.Font = espFont
      end
      local espInfoFont = (Settings.ESPFont == "GothamBold" and Enum.Font.Ubuntu) or espFont
      if data.InfoLabel and data.InfoLabel.Font ~= espInfoFont then
        data.InfoLabel.Font = espInfoFont
      end
      local expectedPosY = 3.5 + (Settings.ESPPositionY or 0)
      if data.Billboard.StudsOffset.Y ~= expectedPosY then
        data.Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, expectedPosY, 0)
      end
      if data.LastESPStyle ~= style or data.LastIsMobile ~= isMobile then
        data.LastESPStyle = style
        data.LastIsMobile = isMobile
        local customTextSize = Settings.ESPTextSize
        if style == "Old" then
          data.Billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 70)
          data.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
          data.Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1.0
          data.ContainerStroke.Transparency = 1.0
          data.NameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.4, 0)
          data.NameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
          data.NameLabel.TextSize = customTextSize or 15
          data.NameLabel.Visible = true
          data.InfoLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.6, 0)
          data.InfoLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.4, 0)
          data.InfoLabel.TextSize = customTextSize and math.max(7, customTextSize - 2) or 13
          data.InfoLabel.Visible = true
        elseif style == "Standard" then
          data.Billboard.Size = isMobile and UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 42) or UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 50)
          data.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
          data.Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1.0
          data.ContainerStroke.Transparency = 1.0
          data.NameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.45, 0)
          data.NameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.05, 0)
          data.NameLabel.TextSize = customTextSize or (isMobile and 11 or 13)
          data.NameLabel.Visible = true
          data.InfoLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.45, 0)
          data.InfoLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
          data.InfoLabel.TextSize = customTextSize and math.max(7, customTextSize - 2)
            or (isMobile and 9 or 11)
          data.InfoLabel.Visible = true
        elseif style == "Compact" then
          data.Billboard.Size = isMobile and UDim2.new(0, 110, 0, 18) or UDim2.new(0, 145, 0, 22)
          data.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
          data.Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1.0
          data.ContainerStroke.Transparency = 1.0
          data.NameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
          data.NameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
          data.NameLabel.TextSize = customTextSize or (isMobile and 9 or 11)
          data.NameLabel.Visible = true
          data.InfoLabel.Visible = false
        elseif style == "Minimal" then
          data.Billboard.Size = isMobile and UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 16) or UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 20)
          data.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
          data.Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1.0
          data.ContainerStroke.Transparency = 1.0
          data.NameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
          data.NameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
          data.NameLabel.TextSize = customTextSize or (isMobile and 9 or 11)
          data.NameLabel.Visible = true
          data.InfoLabel.Visible = false
        end
      end
      if style == "Aura Only" then
        if data.LastBillboardEnabled ~= false then
          data.Billboard.Enabled = false
          data.LastBillboardEnabled = false
        end
      else
        local nameShow = isMe and Settings.MeESP.ShowName
          or isKiller and Settings.KillerESP.ShowName
          or isSurvivor and Settings.SurvivorESP.ShowName
        if nameShow == nil then
          nameShow = true
        end
        local rawName
        if isBot then
          rawName = tostring(player.Name) .. " [Bot]"
        else
          rawName = (
            _G.VD_SpoofedNames
            and (
              player:IsA("Player") and _G.VD_SpoofedNames[player.UserId]
              or _G.VD_SpoofedNames[player.Name]
            )
          )
            or (player:IsA("Player") and player.DisplayName)
            or player.Name
        end
        local nameText = nameShow and rawName or ""
        if
          nameShow
          and not isMe
          and (
            Settings.SurvivorESP.CensorNames
            or (Settings.HideLivePlayersMode and Settings.HideLivePlayersMode ~= "Normal")
          )
        then
          nameText = "[Hidden]"
        end
        local distText = string.format("%dm", dist)
        local state = "Healed"
        if isKnocked then
          state = "Knocked"
        elseif isHookedActive then
          state = "Hooked"
        else
          local health, maxHealth = getPlayerHealthPercent(player)
          if health < maxHealth then
            state = "Injured"
          end
        end
        local hookCount = 0
        if isSurvivor then
          local wsPlayer = (not isBot and workspace:FindFirstChild(player.Name))
            or (isBot and player)
          if wsPlayer then
            local hcAttr = wsPlayer:GetAttribute("HookCount")
            if hcAttr ~= nil then
              hookCount = tonumber(hcAttr) or 0
            else
              local hcObj = wsPlayer:FindFirstChild("HookCount")
              if hcObj and hcObj.Value ~= nil then
                hookCount = tonumber(hcObj.Value) or 0
              end
            end
          end
          if hookCount == 0 and char then
            local hc = char:GetAttribute("HookCount")
            if hc ~= nil then
              hookCount = tonumber(hc) or 0
            else
              local hcObj = char:FindFirstChild("HookCount")
              if
                hcObj
                and (hcObj:IsA("ValueObject") or hcObj:IsA("NumberValue") or hcObj:IsA("IntValue"))
              then
                hookCount = tonumber(hcObj.Value) or 0
              end
            end
          end
        end
        local nameTextToSet = ""
        local infoTextToSet = ""
        if style == "Old" or style == "Standard" then
          nameTextToSet = nameText
          local infoText = ""
          local separator = (style == "Old") and "\n" or "  "
          if
            (isMe and Settings.MeESP.Distance)
            or (isKiller and Settings.KillerESP.Distance)
            or (isSurvivor and Settings.SurvivorESP.Distance)
          then
            infoText = infoText .. string.format("[%d meters]" .. separator, dist)
          end
          if isMe and Settings.MeESP.HealthState then
            infoText = infoText .. "State: " .. state .. separator
          end
          if isKiller and Settings.KillerESP.SelectedKiller then
            local selected = getSelectedKiller(player)
            infoText = infoText .. "Killer: " .. selected .. separator
          end
          if isSurvivor and Settings.SurvivorESP.HealthState then
            infoText = infoText .. "State: " .. state .. separator
          end
          if isSurvivor and Settings.SurvivorESP.ShowHookCount and hookCount > 0 then
            infoText = infoText .. "Hooks: " .. hookCount .. separator
          end
          infoTextToSet = infoText
        elseif style == "Compact" then
          local showDist = (isMe and Settings.MeESP.Distance)
            or (isKiller and Settings.KillerESP.Distance)
            or (isSurvivor and Settings.SurvivorESP.Distance)
          local distPrefix = showDist and ("[" .. distText .. "] ") or ""
          if isMe then
            if Settings.MeESP.HealthState and state ~= "Healed" then
              nameTextToSet = nameShow and string.format("%s%s (%s)", distPrefix, nameText, state)
                or (
                  showDist and string.format("[%s] (%s)", distText, state)
                  or string.format("(%s)", state)
                )
            else
              nameTextToSet = nameShow and string.format("%s%s", distPrefix, nameText)
                or (showDist and string.format("[%s]", distText) or "")
            end
          elseif isKiller then
            local selected = getSelectedKiller(player)
            if Settings.KillerESP.SelectedKiller and selected ~= "None" then
              if nameShow then
                nameTextToSet = string.format("%s%s (%s)", distPrefix, nameText, selected)
              else
                if showDist then
                  nameTextToSet = string.format("[%s] (%s)", distText, selected)
                else
                  nameTextToSet = string.format("(%s)", selected)
                end
              end
            else
              if nameShow then
                nameTextToSet = string.format("%s%s", distPrefix, nameText)
              else
                nameTextToSet = showDist and string.format("[%s]", distText) or ""
              end
            end
          else
            local suffix = ""
            if Settings.SurvivorESP.ShowHookCount and hookCount > 0 then
              suffix = " | " .. hookCount .. "H"
            end
            if Settings.SurvivorESP.HealthState and state ~= "Healed" then
              if nameShow then
                nameTextToSet = string.format("%s%s (%s%s)", distPrefix, nameText, state, suffix)
              else
                if showDist then
                  nameTextToSet = string.format("[%s] (%s%s)", distText, state, suffix)
                else
                  nameTextToSet = string.format("(%s%s)", state, suffix)
                end
              end
            else
              if nameShow then
                nameTextToSet = string.format("%s%s%s", distPrefix, nameText, suffix)
              else
                if showDist then
                  nameTextToSet = string.format("[%s]%s", distText, suffix)
                else
                  nameTextToSet = suffix ~= "" and suffix or ""
                end
              end
            end
          end
        elseif style == "Minimal" then
          local showDist = (isKiller and Settings.KillerESP.Distance)
            or (isSurvivor and Settings.SurvivorESP.Distance)
          if showDist then
            nameTextToSet = string.format("[%s]", distText)
          else
            if nameShow then
              nameTextToSet = nameText:sub(1, 4)
            else
              nameTextToSet = ""
            end
          end
        end
        local showBillboard = true
        if style == "Minimal" or style == "Compact" then
          if nameTextToSet == "" then
            showBillboard = false
          end
        else
          if nameTextToSet == "" and infoTextToSet:gsub("%s+", "") == "" then
            showBillboard = false
          end
        end
        if data.LastBillboardEnabled ~= showBillboard then
          data.Billboard.Enabled = showBillboard
          data.LastBillboardEnabled = showBillboard
        end
        if data.LastNameText ~= nameTextToSet then
          data.NameLabel.Text = nameTextToSet
          data.LastNameText = nameTextToSet
        end
        if data.LastNameColor ~= col then
          data.NameLabel.TextColor3 = col
          data.LastNameColor = col
        end
        if style == "Standard" or style == "Old" then
          if data.LastInfoText ~= infoTextToSet then
            data.InfoLabel.Text = infoTextToSet
            data.LastInfoText = infoTextToSet
          end
        end
        local isTargetMatching = true
        if Settings.TracerTarget == "Killers Only" then
          isTargetMatching = isKiller
        elseif Settings.TracerTarget == "Survivors Only" then
          isTargetMatching = isSurvivor
        end
        local tracerEnabled = Settings.ESPTracers
          and espEnabled
          and rootPart
          and char
          and isTargetMatching
        local tracer = data.Tracer
        if tracerEnabled then
          local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
          local screenPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(rootPart.Position)
          if onScreen then
            local startPos = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y)
            if Settings.TracerOrigin == "Center" then
              startPos = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
            elseif Settings.TracerOrigin == "Top" then
              startPos = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, 0)
            end
            local endPos = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
            local distanceOpacityFactor = 1.0
            if Settings.ESPDistanceFade and dist then
              if dist >= Settings.ESPFadeMax then
                distanceOpacityFactor = 0.0
              elseif dist > Settings.ESPFadeStart then
                local range = Settings.ESPFadeMax - Settings.ESPFadeStart
                local diff = dist - Settings.ESPFadeStart
                distanceOpacityFactor = 1.0 - (diff / range)
              end
            end
            local tracerColor = col
            if Settings.TracerColorMode == "Custom" then
              tracerColor = getESPColor("Tracer")
            end
            local drawingTrans = 0.8
            if Settings.ESPDistanceFade and Settings.ESPDistanceFadeTracers then
              drawingTrans = 0.8 * distanceOpacityFactor
            end
            local isTracerVisible = drawingTrans > 0.01
            local canUseDrawing = (Drawing and typeof(Drawing.new) == "function")
            if canUseDrawing then
              if not tracer or type(tracer) ~= "table" or not tracer.Line then
                if tracer then
                  pcall(function()
                    if type(tracer) == "table" then
                      for _, obj in pairs(tracer) do
                        if type(obj) == "table" or type(obj) == "userdata" then
                          pcall(function()
                            obj:Remove()
                          end)
                        end
                      end
                    elseif typeof(tracer) == "Instance" then
                      tracer:Destroy()
                    end
                  end)
                end
                local okLine, dLine = pcall(Drawing.new, "Line")
                if okLine and dLine then
                  dLine.Thickness = 1.5
                  local okL, dLeft = pcall(Drawing.new, "Line")
                  local okR, dRight = pcall(Drawing.new, "Line")
                  if okL and dLeft then
                    dLeft.Thickness = 1.5
                  end
                  if okR and dRight then
                    dRight.Thickness = 1.5
                  end
                  tracer = { Line = dLine, Left = (okL and dLeft) or nil, Right = (okR and dRight)
                    or nil }
                  data.Tracer = tracer
                else
                  tracer = nil
                  data.Tracer = nil
                end
              end
              if tracer and tracer.Line then
                local isArrow = (Settings.TracerStyle == "Arrow")
                if isArrow and (not tracer.Left or not tracer.Right) then
                  local okL, dLeft = pcall(Drawing.new, "Line")
                  local okR, dRight = pcall(Drawing.new, "Line")
                  if okL and dLeft then
                    dLeft.Thickness = 1.5
                    tracer.Left = dLeft
                  end
                  if okR and dRight then
                    dRight.Thickness = 1.5
                    tracer.Right = dRight
                  end
                end
                pcall(function()
                  tracer.Line.Color = tracerColor
                  tracer.Line.Transparency = drawingTrans
                  tracer.Line.Visible = isTracerVisible
                  tracer.Line.From = startPos
                end)
                if isArrow and tracer.Left and tracer.Right then
                  local dir = (endPos - startPos).Unit
                  if dir.Magnitude > 0 then
                    local perp = Vector2.new(-dir.Y, dir.X)
                    local arrowSize = 10
                    local back = endPos - dir * arrowSize
                    local left = back + perp * (arrowSize * 0.5)
                    local right = back - perp * (arrowSize * 0.5)
                    pcall(function()
                      tracer.Line.To = back
                      tracer.Left.Color = tracerColor
                      tracer.Left.Transparency = drawingTrans
                      tracer.Left.Visible = isTracerVisible
                      tracer.Left.From = endPos
                      tracer.Left.To = left
                      tracer.Right.Color = tracerColor
                      tracer.Right.Transparency = drawingTrans
                      tracer.Right.Visible = isTracerVisible
                      tracer.Right.From = endPos
                      tracer.Right.To = right
                    end)
                  else
                    pcall(function()
                      tracer.Line.To = endPos
                      tracer.Left.Visible = false
                      tracer.Right.Visible = false
                    end)
                  end
                else
                  pcall(function()
                    tracer.Line.To = endPos
                    if tracer.Left then
                      tracer.Left.Visible = false
                    end
                    if tracer.Right then
                      tracer.Right.Visible = false
                    end
                  end)
                end
              end
            else
              if not tracer or type(tracer) ~= "userdata" or tracer.Parent == nil then
                if type(tracer) == "table" then
                  pcall(function()
                    for _, obj in pairs(tracer) do
                      pcall(function()
                        obj:Remove()
                      end)
                    end
                  end)
                end
                tracer = Instance.new("Frame")
                tracer.Name = "Tracer_" .. player.Name
                tracer.BorderSizePixel = 0
                tracer.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
                tracer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                tracer.ZIndex = 2
                tracer.Parent = _G.VD_TracerContainer
                data.Tracer = tracer
              end
              local diff = endPos - startPos
              local dist2D = diff.Magnitude
              local angle = math.atan2(diff.Y, diff.X)
              local center = (startPos + endPos) / 2
              tracer.Size = UDim2.new(0, dist2D, 0, 1.2)
              tracer.Position = UDim2.new(0, center.X, 0, center.Y)
              tracer.Rotation = math.deg(angle)
              tracer.BackgroundColor3 = tracerColor
              local frameTrans = 0.2
              if Settings.ESPDistanceFade and Settings.ESPDistanceFadeTracers then
                frameTrans = 1.0 - (0.8 * distanceOpacityFactor)
              end
              tracer.BackgroundTransparency = frameTrans
              tracer.Visible = frameTrans < 0.99
            end
          else
            if tracer then
              setTracerVisible(data, false)
            end
          end
        else
          if tracer then
            setTracerVisible(data, false)
          end
        end
      end
    else
      if data.LastAuraEnabled ~= false then
        data.Highlight.Enabled = false
        data.LastAuraEnabled = false
      end
      if data.LastBillboardEnabled ~= false then
        data.Billboard.Enabled = false
        data.LastBillboardEnabled = false
      end
      if data.Tracer then
        setTracerVisible(data, false)
      end
      data.CurrentCharacter = nil
    end
  end
  for entity, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.Players) do
    if typeof(entity) == "Instance" and entity:IsA("Player") then
      if not Players:FindFirstChild(entity.Name) then
        removePlayerESP(entity)
      end
    elseif typeof(entity) == "Instance" and entity:IsA("Model") then
      if not entity.Parent or not entity:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
        removePlayerESP(entity)
      else
        local hum = entity:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if
          hum
          and hum.Health <= 0
          and not (entity:GetAttribute("Knocked") or entity:GetAttribute("IsHooked"))
        then
          removePlayerESP(entity)
        end
      end
    else
      removePlayerESP(entity)
    end
  end
end

        progressText = string.format("\nProgress: %d%%", progress)

            progressText = progressText .. string.format(" (+%.1f%%/s)", speed)
