function getModelTargetPart(model)
  if model:IsA("Model") then
    local intact = model:FindFirstChild("Intact")
    if intact then
      if intact:IsA("BasePart") then
        return intact
      end
      if intact:IsA("Model") then
        return intact.PrimaryPart or intact:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
      end
    end
    return model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
  end
  if model:IsA("BasePart") then
    return model
  end
  return nil
end
function getVaultHighlightPart(inst)
  local bottom = inst:FindFirstChild("Bottom")
  if not bottom or not bottom:IsA("BasePart") then
    local target = getModelTargetPart(inst)
    if target and target:IsA("BasePart") then
      return target
    end
    if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
      return inst
    end
    return inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") or inst
  end
  local closestPart = nil
  local minDistance = math.huge
  for _, part in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do
    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= bottom and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
      if part.Transparency < 1 then
        local dist = (part.Position - bottom.Position).Magnitude
        if dist < minDistance then
          minDistance = dist
          closestPart = part
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return closestPart or bottom
end
function disableMapESPData(data)
  data.CurrentAlpha = 0.0
  if data.LastAuraEnabled ~= false then
    if data.Highlight and data.Highlight:IsA("Highlight") then
      data.Highlight.Enabled = false
    elseif data.Highlight and data.Highlight:IsA("BoxHandleAdornment") then
      data.Highlight.Visible = false
    end
    if data.PuddleHighlight and data.PuddleHighlight:IsA("Highlight") then
      data.PuddleHighlight.Enabled = false
    end
    data.LastAuraEnabled = false
  end
  if data.LastBillboardEnabled ~= false then
    data.Billboard.Enabled = false
    data.LastBillboardEnabled = false
  end
end
function createModelESP(instance, esptype)
  local meta = MAP_ESP_TYPES[esptype]
  if not meta then
    return
  end
  local list = meta.espList()
  if list[instance] then
    return
  end
  local col = getESPColor(esptype)
  local highlight
  if esptype == "Vault" then
    highlight = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
    highlight.AlwaysOnTop = true
    highlight.ZIndex = 5
    highlight.Transparency = Settings.ESPFillTransparency or 0.6
    highlight.Color3 = (Settings.ESPFillColorMode == "Custom" and Settings.ESPFillColor) or col
    highlight.Visible = false
    highlight.Parent = highlightParent
  else
    highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.FillTransparency = Settings.ESPFillTransparency or 0.6
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = Settings.ESPOutlineTransparency or 0.1
    highlight.FillColor = (Settings.ESPFillColorMode == "Custom" and Settings.ESPFillColor) or col
    highlight.OutlineColor = (Settings.ESPOutlineColorMode == "Custom" and Settings.ESPOutlineColor)
      or col
    highlight.Enabled = false
    highlight.Parent = highlightParent
  end
  local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
  billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
  billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.5 + (Settings.ESPPositionY or 0), 0)
  billboard.Enabled = false
  billboard.Parent = billboardParent
  local container = Instance.new("Frame")
  container.Name = "Container"
  container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  container.BorderSizePixel = 0
  container.Parent = billboard
  local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
  corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
  corner.Parent = container
  local containerStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
  containerStroke.Thickness = 1
  containerStroke.Transparency = 1
  containerStroke.Parent = container
  local espFont = Enum.Font[Settings.ESPFont] or Enum.Font.Ubuntu
  local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  nameLabel.TextColor3 = (Settings.ESPTextColorMode == "Custom" and Settings.ESPTextColor) or col
  nameLabel.Font = espFont
  nameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Settings.ESPTextOutlineColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
  nameLabel.Parent = container
  local targetPart = getModelTargetPart(instance)
  local targetAdornee = instance
  local puddleHighlight = nil
  local bloodPuddle = nil
  if esptype == "Gate" then
    local mainPart = getGatePartSafe(instance)
    local exitLever = (instance.Name == "ExitLever" and instance)
      or instance:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true)
      or instance:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")
    if mainPart then
      targetPart = mainPart
      targetAdornee = (exitLever and exitLever:IsA("Model") and exitLever) or mainPart
    end
  elseif esptype == "BearTrap" then
    if instance:IsA("Folder") then
      targetAdornee = targetPart
        or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model")
        or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    end
  elseif esptype == "Pumpkins" then
    if
      instance:IsA("BasePart")
      and instance.Parent
      and instance.Parent:IsA("Model")
      and instance.Parent ~= workspace
      and instance.Parent.Name ~= "Pumpkins"
    then
      targetAdornee = instance.Parent
    end
  elseif esptype == "Vault" then
    targetAdornee = getVaultHighlightPart(instance)
  elseif esptype == "Hook" then
    local current = instance
    local hookContainer = nil
    local hookModel = nil
    while current and current ~= workspace do
      if current.Name == "Hook" then
        hookContainer = current
        break
      end
      current = current.Parent
    end
    if not hookContainer then
      if
        instance.Parent and (instance.Parent.Name == "Hook" or instance.Parent.Name == "Model")
      then
        hookContainer = (instance.Parent.Name == "Hook" and instance.Parent)
          or instance.Parent.Parent
      end
    end
    if hookContainer then
      bloodPuddle = hookContainer:FindFirstChild("Cartoony Blood Puddle")
        or hookContainer:FindFirstChild("CartoonyBloodPuddle")
        or hookContainer:FindFirstChild("Blood Puddle")
        or hookContainer:FindFirstChild("BloodPuddle")
      if hookContainer:IsA("Model") then
        targetAdornee = hookContainer
      else
        hookModel = hookContainer:FindFirstChild("Model")
          or hookContainer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model")
        targetAdornee = hookModel or instance
      end
    else
      local cur = instance
      while cur and cur ~= workspace do
        if cur.Name == "Model" and cur:IsA("Model") then
          hookModel = cur
          break
        end
        cur = cur.Parent
      end
      if hookModel then
        targetAdornee = hookModel
        if hookModel.Parent then
          bloodPuddle = hookModel.Parent:FindFirstChild("Cartoony Blood Puddle")
        end
      end
    end
    if
      bloodPuddle
      and (targetAdornee ~= hookContainer or not (hookContainer and hookContainer:IsA("Model")))
    then
      puddleHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
      puddleHighlight.FillTransparency = Settings.ESPFillTransparency or 0.6
      puddleHighlight.OutlineTransparency = Settings.ESPOutlineTransparency or 0.1
      puddleHighlight.FillColor = (Settings.ESPFillColorMode == "Custom" and Settings.ESPFillColor)
        or col
      puddleHighlight.OutlineColor = (
        Settings.ESPOutlineColorMode == "Custom" and Settings.ESPOutlineColor
      ) or col
      puddleHighlight.Adornee = bloodPuddle
      puddleHighlight.Enabled = false
      puddleHighlight.Parent = highlightParent
    end
  end
  list[instance] = {
    Highlight = highlight,
    PuddleHighlight = puddleHighlight,
    BloodPuddle = bloodPuddle,
    Billboard = billboard,
    Container = container,
    ContainerStroke = containerStroke,
    NameLabel = nameLabel,
    TargetPart = targetPart,
    TargetAdornee = targetAdornee,
    CachedPosition = targetPart and targetPart.Position or Vector3.new(),
    LastAdornee = nil,
    LastAuraEnabled = nil,
    LastHighlightColor = nil,
    LastBillboardAdornee = nil,
    LastBillboardEnabled = nil,
    LastText = nil,
    LastESPStyle = nil,
    LastIsMobile = nil,
  }
end
function removeModelESP(instance, esptype)
  local meta = MAP_ESP_TYPES[esptype]
  if not meta then
    return
  end
  local list = meta.espList()
  local data = list[instance]
  if data then
    if data.Highlight then
      pcall(function()
        data.Highlight:Destroy()
      end)
    end
    if data.PuddleHighlight then
      pcall(function()
        data.PuddleHighlight:Destroy()
      end)
    end
    if data.Billboard then
      pcall(function()
        data.Billboard:Destroy()
      end)
    end
    list[instance] = nil
  end
end
local mapEspDisabledTracker = {}
function updateMapESP(esptype, instances)
  local meta = MAP_ESP_TYPES[esptype]
  if not meta then
    return
  end
  if not Settings.MasterESP or not meta.isEnabled() then
    if not mapEspDisabledTracker[esptype] then
      local list = meta.espList()
      for _, data in pairs(list) do
        disableMapESPData(data)
      end
      mapEspDisabledTracker[esptype] = true
    end
    return
  end
  mapEspDisabledTracker[esptype] = nil
  debug.profilebegin("Helper_UpdateMapESP_" .. tostring(esptype))
  local list = meta.espList()
  local deadInstances = {}
  for inst, _ in pairs(list) do
    if not inst or not inst.Parent or not inst:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
      table.insert(deadInstances, inst)
    end
  end
  for _, inst in ipairs(deadInstances) do
    pcall(function()
      removeModelESP(inst, esptype)
    end)
  end
  local baseCol = getESPColor(esptype)
  local style = Settings.ESPStyle or "Standard"
  local root = localRootPart
  if not root then
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  end
  for _, inst in ipairs(instances) do
    if not inst or not inst.Parent then
      continue
    end
    if meta.shouldSkip(inst) then
      removeModelESP(inst, esptype)
      continue
    end
    createModelESP(inst, esptype)
    local data = list[inst]
    if not data then
      continue
    end
    local col = baseCol
    local cachedPos = data.CachedPosition
    if esptype == "Hook" then
      local hookPos = cachedPos
      if hookPos then
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
          if p ~= localPlayer and p.Character then
            local char = p.Character
            local isHooked = char:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
            if isHooked then
              local rootChar = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
              if rootChar and (rootChar.Position - hookPos).Magnitude <= 15 then
                col = Color3.fromRGB(180, 20, 20)
                break
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    elseif esptype == "Pallet" then
      col = baseCol
    end
    local targetPart = data.TargetPart
    if not targetPart or not targetPart.Parent then
      if esptype == "Gate" then
        targetPart = getGatePartSafe(inst)
      else
        targetPart = getModelTargetPart(inst)
      end
      data.TargetPart = targetPart
      if esptype == "Gate" and targetPart then
        data.TargetAdornee = (
          inst:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true)
          and inst:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true):IsA("Model")
          and inst:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true)
        ) or targetPart
      end
    end
    local currentPos = targetPart and targetPart.Position or cachedPos
    data.CachedPosition = currentPos
    local dist = root and currentPos and math.round((root.Position - currentPos).Magnitude)
      or math.huge
    local withinRange = dist <= Settings.ESPRange
    if targetPart and withinRange then
      local targetAdornee = data.TargetAdornee
      if data.LastAdornee ~= targetAdornee then
        data.Highlight.Adornee = targetAdornee
        data.LastAdornee = targetAdornee
        if esptype == "Vault" and targetAdornee and targetAdornee:IsA("BasePart") then
          data.Highlight.Size = targetAdornee.Size
          data.Highlight.CFrame = CFrame.new()
        end
      end
      if
        data.PuddleHighlight
        and data.BloodPuddle
        and data.PuddleHighlight.Adornee ~= data.BloodPuddle
      then
        data.PuddleHighlight.Adornee = data.BloodPuddle
      end
      local showAura = meta.showAura()
      local targetAlpha = 1.0
      local isFadeActive = false
      if Settings.ESPDistanceFade and Settings.ESPDistanceFadeMap then
        if esptype == "Generator" and Settings.ESPDistanceFadeGenerators then
          isFadeActive = true
        elseif esptype == "Pallet" and Settings.ESPDistanceFadePallets then
          isFadeActive = true
        elseif esptype == "Vault" and Settings.ESPDistanceFadeVaults then
          isFadeActive = true
        elseif esptype == "Hook" and Settings.ESPDistanceFadeHooks then
          isFadeActive = true
        elseif esptype == "Gate" and Settings.ESPDistanceFadeGates then
          isFadeActive = true
        elseif esptype == "SCP" and Settings.ESPDistanceFadeSCPs then
          isFadeActive = true
        elseif esptype == "BloodEffect" then
          isFadeActive = true
        end
      end
      if isFadeActive and dist then
        if dist >= Settings.ESPFadeMax then
          targetAlpha = 0.0
        elseif dist > Settings.ESPFadeStart then
          local range = Settings.ESPFadeMax - Settings.ESPFadeStart
          local diff = dist - Settings.ESPFadeStart
          targetAlpha = 1.0 - (diff / range)
        end
      end
      data.DistanceOpacityFactor = targetAlpha
      data.LastAuraEnabled = showAura and (targetAlpha > 0.005)
      local highlightFillCol = (Settings.ESPFillColorMode == "Custom" and Settings.ESPFillColor)
        or col
      local highlightOutlineCol = (
        Settings.ESPOutlineColorMode == "Custom" and Settings.ESPOutlineColor
      ) or col
      if esptype == "Vault" then
        if data.Highlight.Color3 ~= highlightFillCol then
          data.Highlight.Color3 = highlightFillCol
        end
      else
        if data.Highlight.FillColor ~= highlightFillCol then
          data.Highlight.FillColor = highlightFillCol
        end
        if data.Highlight.OutlineColor ~= highlightOutlineCol then
          data.Highlight.OutlineColor = highlightOutlineCol
        end
      end
      if data.PuddleHighlight and data.PuddleHighlight:IsA("Highlight") then
        if data.PuddleHighlight.FillColor ~= highlightFillCol then
          data.PuddleHighlight.FillColor = highlightFillCol
        end
        if data.PuddleHighlight.OutlineColor ~= highlightOutlineCol then
          data.PuddleHighlight.OutlineColor = highlightOutlineCol
        end
      end
      local textOutlineCol = Settings.ESPTextOutlineColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
      if data.NameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 ~= textOutlineCol then
        data.NameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = textOutlineCol
      end
      local espFont = Enum.Font[Settings.ESPFont] or Enum.Font.Ubuntu
      if data.NameLabel.Font ~= espFont then
        data.NameLabel.Font = espFont
      end
      local expectedPosY = 3.5 + (Settings.ESPPositionY or 0)
      if data.Billboard.StudsOffset.Y ~= expectedPosY then
        data.Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, expectedPosY, 0)
      end
      if data.LastESPStyle ~= style or data.LastIsMobile ~= isMobile then
        data.LastESPStyle = style
        data.LastIsMobile = isMobile
        local customTextSize = Settings.ESPTextSize
        if style == "Old" then
          data.Billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 45)
          data.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
          data.Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1.0
          data.ContainerStroke.Transparency = 1.0
          data.NameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
          data.NameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
          data.NameLabel.TextSize = customTextSize or 14
        elseif style == "Standard" then
          data.Billboard.Size = isMobile and UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 20) or UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 26)
          data.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
          data.Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1.0
          data.ContainerStroke.Transparency = 1.0
          data.NameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
          data.NameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
          data.NameLabel.TextSize = customTextSize or (isMobile and 9 or 11)
        elseif style == "Compact" then
          data.Billboard.Size = isMobile and UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 16) or UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 20)
          data.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
          data.Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1.0
          data.ContainerStroke.Transparency = 1.0
          data.NameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
          data.NameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
          data.NameLabel.TextSize = customTextSize or (isMobile and 8 or 10)
        elseif style == "Minimal" then
          data.Billboard.Size = isMobile and UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 16) or UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 20)
          data.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
          data.Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1.0
          data.ContainerStroke.Transparency = 1.0
          data.NameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
          data.NameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
          data.NameLabel.TextSize = customTextSize or (isMobile and 8 or 10)
        end
      end
      if style == "Aura Only" then
        if data.LastBillboardEnabled ~= false then
          data.Billboard.Enabled = false
          data.LastBillboardEnabled = false
        end
      else
        if data.LastBillboardEnabled ~= true then
          data.Billboard.Enabled = true
          data.LastBillboardEnabled = true
        end
        if data.LastBillboardAdornee ~= targetPart then
          data.Billboard.Adornee = targetPart
          data.LastBillboardAdornee = targetPart
        end
        local txt = ""
        if style == "Old" or style == "Standard" then
          txt = meta.getText(inst, dist)
        elseif style == "Compact" then
          if esptype == "Generator" then
            local progress = getGeneratorProgress(inst)
            local speed, etaSec, etaStr = getGeneratorAnalytics(inst)
            local progressText = ""
            if Settings.GeneratorESP.ShowProgress then
              progressText = string.format(" %d%%", progress)
              if Settings.GeneratorESP.ShowRepairSpeed and math.abs(speed) > 0.05 then
                if speed > 0 then
                  progressText = progressText .. string.format(" (+%.1f%%/s)", speed)
                else
                  progressText = progressText .. string.format(" (%.1f%%/s)", speed)
                end
              end
              if Settings.GeneratorESP.ShowETA and etaStr ~= "" then
                progressText = progressText .. string.format(" [%s]", etaStr)
              end
              if Settings.GeneratorESP.ShowRepairingCount then
                local repCount = inst:GetAttribute("PlayersRepairingCount") or 0
                progressText = progressText .. string.format(" (%dp)", repCount)
              end
            elseif Settings.GeneratorESP.ShowRepairingCount then
              local repCount = inst:GetAttribute("PlayersRepairingCount") or 0
              progressText = string.format(" (%dp)", repCount)
            end
            local label = Settings.GeneratorESP.NoText and "" or "Gen"
            if Settings.GeneratorESP.ShowDistance then
              if label == "" then
                txt = string.format("[%dm]%s", dist, progressText)
              else
                txt = string.format("Gen [%dm]%s", dist, progressText)
              end
            else
              txt = label .. progressText
            end
          else
            local noText = false
            if esptype == "BloodEffect" then
              noText = Settings.BloodESP.NoText
            elseif esptype == "SCP" then
              noText = Settings.SCPESP.NoText
            else
              local set = Settings[esptype .. "ESP"]
              noText = set and set.NoText
            end
            local label = ""
            if not noText then
              if esptype == "SCP" then
                label = inst.Name:upper()
              else
                local shortNames = {
                  Hook = "Hook",
                  Pallet = "Pallet",
                  Vault = "Vault",
                  BloodEffect = "Blood",
                  Gate = "Gate",
                }
                label = shortNames[esptype] or esptype
              end
            end
            local showDist = false
            if esptype == "BloodEffect" then
              showDist = Settings.BloodESP.ShowDistance
            elseif esptype == "SCP" then
              showDist = Settings.SCPESP.ShowDistance
            else
              local set = Settings[esptype .. "ESP"]
              showDist = set and set.ShowDistance
            end
            local progressText = ""
            if esptype == "Gate" and Settings.GateESP and Settings.GateESP.ShowProgress then
              local prog = getGateProgress(inst)
              progressText = string.format(" [%d%%]", prog)
            end
            if showDist then
              if label == "" then
                txt = string.format("[%dm]%s", dist, progressText)
              else
                txt = string.format("%s [%dm]%s", label, dist, progressText)
              end
            else
              txt = label .. progressText
            end
          end
        elseif style == "Minimal" then
          if esptype == "Generator" then
            local progress = getGeneratorProgress(inst)
            local progressText = ""
            if Settings.GeneratorESP.ShowProgress then
              progressText = string.format(" %d%%", progress)
              if Settings.GeneratorESP.ShowRepairingCount then
                local repCount = inst:GetAttribute("PlayersRepairingCount") or 0
                progressText = progressText .. string.format(" (%dp)", repCount)
              end
            elseif Settings.GeneratorESP.ShowRepairingCount then
              local repCount = inst:GetAttribute("PlayersRepairingCount") or 0
              progressText = string.format(" (%dp)", repCount)
            end
            if Settings.GeneratorESP.ShowDistance then
              txt = string.format("[%dm]%s", dist, progressText)
            else
              local label = Settings.GeneratorESP.NoText and "" or "Gen"
              txt = label .. progressText
            end
          else
            local noText = false
            if esptype == "BloodEffect" then
              noText = Settings.BloodESP.NoText
            elseif esptype == "SCP" then
              noText = Settings.SCPESP.NoText
            else
              local set = Settings[esptype .. "ESP"]
              noText = set and set.NoText
            end
            local label = ""
            if not noText then
              if esptype == "SCP" then
                label = inst.Name:upper():sub(1, 3)
              else
                local shortNames =
                  { Hook = "Hoo", Pallet = "Pal", Vault = "Vau", BloodEffect = "Blo", Gate = "Gat" }
                label = shortNames[esptype] or esptype:sub(1, 3)
              end
            end
            local showDist = false
            if esptype == "BloodEffect" then
              showDist = Settings.BloodESP.ShowDistance
            elseif esptype == "SCP" then
              showDist = Settings.SCPESP.ShowDistance
            else
              local set = Settings[esptype .. "ESP"]
              showDist = set and set.ShowDistance
            end
            local progressText = ""
            if esptype == "Gate" and Settings.GateESP and Settings.GateESP.ShowProgress then
              local prog = getGateProgress(inst)
              progressText = string.format(" %d%%", prog)
            end
            if showDist then
              txt = string.format("[%dm]%s", dist, progressText)
            else
              txt = label .. progressText
            end
          end
        end
        if data.LastText ~= txt then
          data.NameLabel.Text = txt
          data.LastText = txt
        end
        local mapTextCol = (Settings.ESPTextColorMode == "Custom" and Settings.ESPTextColor) or col
        if data.NameLabel.TextColor3 ~= mapTextCol then
          data.NameLabel.TextColor3 = mapTextCol
        end
      end
    else
      disableMapESPData(data)
    end
  end
  debug.profileend()
end
function manageHighlights()
  local candidates = {}
  for player, data in pairs(ActiveESP.Players) do
    if data.Highlight and data.LastAuraEnabled then
      table.insert(
        candidates,
        { data = data, priority = 1, dist = getDistance(
          player,
          data.Billboard and data.Billboard.Adornee
        ) }
      )
    else
      data.TargetHighlightVisible = false
    end
  end
  local mapLists = {
    ActiveESP.SCPs,
    ActiveESP.Generators,
    ActiveESP.Hooks,
    ActiveESP.Pallets,
    ActiveESP.Vaults,
    ActiveESP.BloodEffects,
    ActiveESP.Gates,
    ActiveESP.BearTraps,
    ActiveESP.Pumpkins,
  }
  for idx, list in ipairs(mapLists) do
    local priority = 4
    if idx == 1 then
      priority = 2
    elseif idx == 2 or idx == 7 or idx == 8 then
      priority = 3
    end
    for inst, data in pairs(list) do
      if data.Highlight and data.LastAuraEnabled then
        table.insert(
          candidates,
          { data = data, priority = priority, dist = getDistance(inst, data.LastBillboardAdornee) }
        )
      else
        data.TargetHighlightVisible = false
      end
    end
  end
  table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
    if a.priority ~= b.priority then
      return a.priority < b.priority
    end
    return a.dist < b.dist
  end)
  local maxHighlights = 28
  for i, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
    local shouldEnable = (i <= maxHighlights)
    candidate.data.TargetHighlightVisible = shouldEnable
    if (Settings.ESPFadeDuration or 0.2) <= 0.01 then
      if candidate.data.Highlight:IsA("Highlight") then
        if candidate.data.Highlight.Enabled ~= shouldEnable then
          candidate.data.Highlight.Enabled = shouldEnable
        end
      elseif candidate.data.Highlight:IsA("BoxHandleAdornment") then
        if candidate.data.Highlight.Visible ~= shouldEnable then
          candidate.data.Highlight.Visible = shouldEnable
        end
      end
      if candidate.data.PuddleHighlight and candidate.data.PuddleHighlight:IsA("Highlight") then
        if candidate.data.PuddleHighlight.Enabled ~= shouldEnable then
          candidate.data.PuddleHighlight.Enabled = shouldEnable
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
local espFadeListsCache = nil
function updateESPFadeTransitions(dt)
  if not Settings.MasterESP then
    return
  end
  local isPerf = Settings.PerformanceMode
  local fadeDur = isPerf and 0 or (Settings.ESPFadeDuration or 0.2)
  local isInstant = isPerf or (fadeDur <= 0.01)
  local baseFillTrans = Settings.ESPFillTransparency or 0.6
  local baseOutlineTrans = Settings.ESPOutlineTransparency or 0.1
  local function processEntry(data, isVault)
    if not data or not data.Highlight then
      return
    end
    local targetAlpha = 0.0
    if data.TargetHighlightVisible ~= false and data.LastAuraEnabled then
      targetAlpha = data.DistanceOpacityFactor or 1.0
    end
    if data.CurrentAlpha == nil then
      data.CurrentAlpha = targetAlpha
    elseif isInstant then
      data.CurrentAlpha = targetAlpha
    else
      local step = dt / fadeDur
      if data.CurrentAlpha < targetAlpha then
        data.CurrentAlpha = math.min(targetAlpha, data.CurrentAlpha + step)
      elseif data.CurrentAlpha > targetAlpha then
        data.CurrentAlpha = math.max(targetAlpha, data.CurrentAlpha - step)
      end
    end
    local alpha = data.CurrentAlpha
    local isVisible = alpha > 0.005
    if
      data.LastFadeAlpha == alpha
      and data.LastFadeFill == baseFillTrans
      and data.LastFadeOutline == baseOutlineTrans
      and data.LastFadeVis == isVisible
    then
      return
    end
    data.LastFadeAlpha = alpha
    data.LastFadeFill = baseFillTrans
    data.LastFadeOutline = baseOutlineTrans
    data.LastFadeVis = isVisible
    if isVault then
      if data.Highlight:IsA("BoxHandleAdornment") then
        if data.Highlight.Visible ~= isVisible then
          data.Highlight.Visible = isVisible
        end
        if isVisible then
          data.Highlight.Transparency = 1.0 - ((1.0 - baseFillTrans) * alpha)
        end
      end
    else
      if data.Highlight:IsA("Highlight") then
        if data.Highlight.Enabled ~= isVisible then
          data.Highlight.Enabled = isVisible
        end
        if isVisible then
          data.Highlight.FillTransparency = 1.0 - ((1.0 - baseFillTrans) * alpha)
          data.Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 1.0 - ((1.0 - baseOutlineTrans) * alpha)
        end
      end
      if data.PuddleHighlight and data.PuddleHighlight:IsA("Highlight") then
        if data.PuddleHighlight.Enabled ~= isVisible then
          data.PuddleHighlight.Enabled = isVisible
        end
        if isVisible then
          data.PuddleHighlight.FillTransparency = 1.0 - ((1.0 - baseFillTrans) * alpha)
          data.PuddleHighlight.OutlineTransparency = 1.0 - ((1.0 - baseOutlineTrans) * alpha)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  for _, data in pairs(ActiveESP.Players) do
    processEntry(data, false)
  end
  if not espFadeListsCache then
    espFadeListsCache = {
      ActiveESP.Generators,
      ActiveESP.Hooks,
      ActiveESP.Pallets,
      ActiveESP.BloodEffects,
      ActiveESP.Gates,
      ActiveESP.SCPs,
      ActiveESP.BearTraps,
      ActiveESP.Pumpkins,
    }
  end
  for _, list in ipairs(espFadeListsCache) do
    for _, data in pairs(list) do
      processEntry(data, false)
    end
  end
  for _, data in pairs(ActiveESP.Vaults) do
    processEntry(data, true)
  end
end
function cleanupAll()
  pcall(function()
    RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("BlatantAimbotLock")
  end)
  if _G.VD_FovCircle then
    pcall(function()
      _G.VD_FovCircle:Remove()
    end)
  end
  if _G.VD_FovGui then
    pcall(function()
      _G.VD_FovGui:Destroy()
    end)
  end
  if _G.VD_CrosshairGui then
    pcall(function()
      _G.VD_CrosshairGui:Destroy()
    end)
    _G.VD_CrosshairGui = nil
  end
  for player, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.Players) do
    removePlayerESP(player)
  end
  for gen, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.Generators) do
    removeModelESP(gen, "Generator")
  end
  for scp, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.SCPs) do
    removeModelESP(scp, "SCP")
  end
  for hook, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.Hooks) do
    removeModelESP(hook, "Hook")
  end
  for pallet, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.Pallets) do
    removeModelESP(pallet, "Pallet")
  end
  for vault, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.Vaults) do
    removeModelESP(vault, "Vault")
  end
  for blood, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.BloodEffects) do
    removeModelESP(blood, "BloodEffect")
  end
  for gate, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.Gates) do
    removeModelESP(gate, "Gate")
  end
  for pumpkin, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.Pumpkins) do
    removeModelESP(pumpkin, "Pumpkins")
  end
  for trap, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.BearTraps) do
    removeModelESP(trap, "BearTrap")
  end
  cleanupParryUI()
  if _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment then
    pcall(function()
      _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment:Destroy()
    end)
    _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment = nil
  end
  parryCircleAlpha = 0.0
  pcall(function()
    if _G.VD_SpearSilentAimFOVCircle then
      pcall(function()
        _G.VD_SpearSilentAimFOVCircle.Visible = false
      end)
      pcall(function()
        _G.VD_SpearSilentAimFOVCircle:Remove()
      end)
      _G.VD_SpearSilentAimFOVCircle = nil
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _G.VD_RevolverSilentAimFOVCircle then
      pcall(function()
        _G.VD_RevolverSilentAimFOVCircle.Visible = false
      end)
      pcall(function()
        _G.VD_RevolverSilentAimFOVCircle:Remove()
      end)
      _G.VD_RevolverSilentAimFOVCircle = nil
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _G.VD_SilentAimHighlight then
      pcall(function()
        _G.VD_SilentAimHighlight:Destroy()
      end)
      _G.VD_SilentAimHighlight = nil
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if cleanupKillerGroundFOV then
      cleanupKillerGroundFOV()
    end
    local fovFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("VD_KillerGroundFOV")
    if fovFolder then
      pcall(function()
        fovFolder:Destroy()
      end)
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if workspace:FindFirstChild("VeilSquareHolder") then
      workspace.VeilSquareHolder:Destroy()
    end
    if workspace:FindFirstChild("VD_SpearTrajectory") then
      workspace.VD_SpearTrajectory:Destroy()
    end
  end)
end

currentThemeName = "Default"
mobileFloatingButtons = {}
function applyTheme(themeName)
  currentThemeName = themeName or "Default"
  local t = themes[currentThemeName] or themes.Default
  local oldBg = UI.Bg
  local oldSidebar = UI.Sidebar
  local oldCard = UI.Card
  local oldElevated = UI.Elevated
  local oldStroke = UI.Stroke
  local oldStrokeDim = UI.StrokeDim
  local oldAccent = UI.Accent
  local oldAccentCyan = UI.AccentCyan
  local oldAccentGreen = UI.AccentGreen
  local oldAccentRed = UI.AccentRed
  UI.Bg = t.Bg
  UI.Sidebar = t.Sidebar
  UI.Card = t.Card
  UI.Elevated = t.Elevated
  UI.Stroke = t.Stroke
  UI.StrokeDim = t.StrokeDim
  UI.Accent = t.Accent
  UI.AccentCyan = t.AccentCyan
  UI.AccentGreen = t.AccentGreen
  UI.AccentRed = t.AccentRed
  if not mainFrame then
    return
  end
  mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Bg
  local customBgActive = Settings.CustomBackground
    and Settings.CustomBackground.Enabled
    and isPremiumActive()
    and localHooksTable
    and (localHooksTable.CustomBackground or localHooksTable["Custom Background"])
  mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = customBgActive and 1 or t.BgTrans
  _G.VD_MainStroke = mainFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
  if _G.VD_MainStroke then
    _G.VD_MainStroke.Color = UI.Stroke
    _G.VD_MainStroke.Thickness = 1.0
  end
  local sidebar = mainFrame:FindFirstChild("Sidebar")
  if sidebar then
    sidebar.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Sidebar
    sidebar.BackgroundTransparency = customBgActive and 0.85 or t.BgTrans
    local sideStroke = sidebar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if sideStroke then
      sideStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
    end
  end
  for _, desc in ipairs(screenGui:GetDescendants()) do
    if desc:IsA("GuiObject") then
      if
        desc.Name == "VD_CustomBg"
        or desc.Name == "VD_BgOverlay"
        or (bgImage and desc == bgImage)
        or (bgOverlay and desc == bgOverlay)
      then
        if desc.Name == "VD_CustomBg" or (bgImage and desc == bgImage) then
          pcall(function()
            desc.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
          end)
        end
        continue
      end
      local dName = desc.Name
      local dNameLower = dName:lower()
      local isAvatarOrLogo = (
        dName == "LogoImage"
        or dNameLower:find("logo") ~= nil
        or dName == "TitleLogo"
      )
        or (dName == "HomeHeaderAvatar" or dName == "WelcomeBackAvatar" or dNameLower:find("avatar") ~= nil or dNameLower:find(
          "portrait"
        ) ~= nil or dNameLower:find("survivor") ~= nil)
        or (
          desc:IsA("ImageLabel")
          and desc.Image
          and (
            desc.Image:find("rbxthumb://") ~= nil
            or desc.Image:find("roblox.com") ~= nil
            or desc.Image:find("dbd_hud_") ~= nil
            or desc.Image:find("VD_Logo") ~= nil
          )
        )
      if isAvatarOrLogo then
        if desc:IsA("ImageLabel") or desc:IsA("ImageButton") then
          desc.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        elseif desc:IsA("TextLabel") and dName == "TitleLogo" then
          desc.TextColor3 = UI.Text
        end
        local logoStroke = desc:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        if logoStroke then
          logoStroke.Color = UI.Accent
        end
        continue
      end
      if desc.BackgroundColor3 == oldBg then
        desc.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Bg
      elseif desc.BackgroundColor3 == oldSidebar then
        desc.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Sidebar
      elseif desc.BackgroundColor3 == oldCard then
        desc.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
      elseif desc.BackgroundColor3 == oldElevated then
        desc.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
      elseif desc.BackgroundColor3 == oldAccent then
        desc.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Accent
      elseif desc.BackgroundColor3 == oldAccentCyan then
        desc.BackgroundColor3 = UI.AccentCyan
      elseif desc.BackgroundColor3 == oldAccentGreen then
        desc.BackgroundColor3 = UI.AccentGreen
      elseif desc.BackgroundColor3 == oldAccentRed then
        desc.BackgroundColor3 = UI.AccentRed
      elseif desc.BackgroundColor3 == oldStroke then
        desc.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Stroke
      elseif desc.BackgroundColor3 == oldStrokeDim then
        desc.BackgroundColor3 = UI.StrokeDim
      end
      if desc:IsA("ImageLabel") or desc:IsA("ImageButton") then
        local isTintableIcon = dName == "TabIcon"
          or dName == "Icon"
          or dName == "SearchIcon"
          or dName:find("Chevron") ~= nil
          or dName:find("Check") ~= nil
          or (
            desc.Parent
            and (
              desc.Parent.Name:find("TabBtn") ~= nil
              or desc.Parent.Name:find("Toggle") ~= nil
              or desc.Parent.Name:find("Selector") ~= nil
              or desc.Parent.Name:find("Slider") ~= nil
            )
          )
        if isTintableIcon then
          if desc.ImageColor3 == oldAccent then
            desc.ImageColor3 = UI.Accent
          elseif desc.ImageColor3 == oldAccentCyan then
            desc.ImageColor3 = UI.AccentCyan
          elseif desc.ImageColor3 == oldStroke then
            desc.ImageColor3 = UI.Stroke
          elseif desc.ImageColor3 == oldStrokeDim then
            desc.ImageColor3 = UI.StrokeDim
          end
        end
      end
      if desc:IsA("TextLabel") or desc:IsA("TextBox") or desc:IsA("TextButton") then
        local isExplicitAccentText = desc:GetAttribute("ThemeAccentText") == true
          or dName == "PopupTitle"
          or dName == "GetKeyBtn"
          or (desc.Parent and desc.Parent.Name == "HeaderBanner")
          or (desc.Parent and desc.Parent.Name:find("MobileFloating_") ~= nil)
        if isExplicitAccentText then
          if desc.TextColor3 == oldAccent then
            desc.TextColor3 = UI.Accent
          elseif desc.TextColor3 == oldAccentCyan then
            desc.TextColor3 = UI.AccentCyan
          elseif desc.TextColor3 == oldAccentGreen then
            desc.TextColor3 = UI.AccentGreen
          end
        elseif desc.TextColor3 == oldAccentCyan then
          desc.TextColor3 = UI.AccentCyan
        elseif desc.TextColor3 == oldAccentGreen then
          desc.TextColor3 = UI.AccentGreen
        end
      end
      local stroke = desc:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
      if stroke then
        if stroke.Color == oldStroke then
          stroke.Color = UI.Stroke
        elseif stroke.Color == oldStrokeDim then
          stroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
        elseif stroke.Color == oldAccent then
          stroke.Color = UI.Accent
        end
      end
      if desc.Name == "SectionLine" then
        desc.BackgroundColor3 = UI.StrokeDim
      end
    end
  end
  if searchBarContainer then
    searchBarContainer.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
  end
  if searchStroke then
    searchStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
  end
  if searchIconLbl then
    pcall(function()
      if searchIconLbl:IsA("ImageLabel") then
        searchIconLbl.ImageColor3 = UI.TextSub
      else
        searchIconLbl.TextColor3 = UI.Accent
      end
    end)
  end
  if searchBox then
    searchBox.TextColor3 = UI.Text
    searchBox.PlaceholderColor3 = UI.Muted
  end
  if clearSearchBtn then
    clearSearchBtn.TextColor3 = UI.TextSub
  end
  if searchBox and searchBox.Text ~= "" and updateSearchResults then
    local clean = searchBox.Text:gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", ""):lower()
    if #clean > 0 then
      pcall(updateSearchResults, clean)
    end
  end
  if applyCustomBackground then
    pcall(applyCustomBackground)
  elseif _G.VD_ApplyCustomBg then
    pcall(_G.VD_ApplyCustomBg)
  end
end
local mobileButtonSavedPositions = {}
local function isKeybindFeatureActive(keybindName)
  if not keybindName or keybindName == "" then
    return nil
  end
  local k = tostring(keybindName):lower():gsub("%s+", "")
  if k == "togglespeedboost" or k == "speedboost" then
    return Settings.SpeedBoostEnabled == true
  elseif k == "noturnspeedloss" or k == "preserveturnspeed" then
    return Settings.NoTurnSpeedLoss == true
  elseif k == "automoonwalk" or k == "moonwalk" then
    return Settings.AutoMoonwalk == true
  elseif k == "noclipvaultspallets" or k == "noclip" then
    return Settings.NoclipVaultsPallets == true
  elseif k == "autofleekiller" or k == "autoflee" then
    return Settings.AutoFleeKiller == true
  elseif k == "alwaysfastvault" or k == "fastvault" then
    return (Settings.FastVault == true or Settings.AlwaysFastVault == true)
  elseif k == "alwaysvault" then
    return Settings.AlwaysVault == true
  elseif k == "fakevault" then
    return Settings.FakeVault == true
  elseif k == "instantheal" then
    return Settings.InstantHeal == true
  elseif k == "autoparry" then
    return Settings.AutoParry == true
  elseif k == "frenzyparry" then
    return Settings.FrenzyParry == true
  elseif k == "revolverautofarm" then
    return Settings.RevolverAutofarm == true
  elseif k == "revolveraimbot" or k == "aimbot" then
    return (Settings.RevolverAimbot and Settings.RevolverAimbot.Enabled) == true
  elseif k == "flowstateperk" or k == "flowstate" then
    return Settings.FlowstatePerk == true
  elseif k == "simulatequickrecovery" or k == "quickrecovery" then
    return Settings.SimulateQuickRecovery == true
  elseif k == "simulateperfectlanding" or k == "perfectlanding" then
    return Settings.SimulatePerfectLanding == true
  elseif k == "activefeaturesoverlay" or k == "activefeatures" then
    return Settings.ShowActiveFeatures == true
  elseif k == "spectatorlist" or k == "spectators" then
    return Settings.ShowSpectatorList == true
  elseif k == "nofog" then
    return Settings.NoFog == true
  elseif k == "dofremoval" or k == "removedof" then
    return Settings.RemoveDOF == true
  elseif k == "fullbright" then
    return Settings.FullBright == true
  elseif k == "noskillchecks" then
    return Settings.NoSkillChecks == true
  elseif k == "rainbowcharacter" or k == "rainbow" then
    return Settings.RainbowCharacter == true
  elseif k == "fakelag" then
    return Settings.FakeLag == true
  elseif k == "desync" then
    return Settings.Desync == true
  elseif k == "blockvaultpalletinteraction" or k == "blockvaults" or k == "blockpallets" then
    return Settings.BlockVaultPalletInteraction == true
  elseif Settings[keybindName] ~= nil and type(Settings[keybindName]) == "boolean" then
    return Settings[keybindName] == true
  end
  for settingKey, settingVal in pairs(Settings) do
    if type(settingVal) == "boolean" then
      local sk = settingKey:lower():gsub("%s+", "")
      if sk == k then
        return settingVal == true
      end
    elseif type(settingVal) == "table" and settingVal.Enabled ~= nil then
      local sk = settingKey:lower():gsub("%s+", "")
      if sk == k or sk .. "esp" == k or sk .. "track" == k then
        return settingVal.Enabled == true
      end
    end
  end
  return nil
end
function createOrUpdateMobileFloatingButton(keybindName, buttonText)
  if not isMobile then
    return
  end
  local parentContainer = guiParent
    or (localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui"))
  if not parentContainer then
    return
  end
  local mobileHUD = parentContainer:FindFirstChild("VD_MobileHUD")
  if not mobileHUD or not mobileHUD.Parent then
    if mobileHUD then
      pcall(function()
        mobileHUD:Destroy()
      end)
    end
    mobileHUD = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    mobileHUD.Name = "VD_MobileHUD"
    mobileHUD.ResetOnSpawn = false
    mobileHUD.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    mobileHUD.DisplayOrder = 99997
    pcall(function()
      mobileHUD.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    end)
    mobileHUD.Parent = parentContainer
  end
  local existing = mobileFloatingButtons[keybindName]
  local targetPos = mobileButtonSavedPositions[keybindName]
  if
    not targetPos
    and Settings.MobileButtonPositions
    and Settings.MobileButtonPositions[keybindName]
  then
    local p = Settings.MobileButtonPositions[keybindName]
    if p and p.XScale and p.YScale then
      targetPos = UDim2.new(p.XScale, p.XOffset or 0, p.YScale, p.YOffset or 0)
      mobileButtonSavedPositions[keybindName] = targetPos
    end
  end
  if not targetPos then
    local btnCount = 0
    for _ in pairs(mobileFloatingButtons) do
      btnCount = btnCount + 1
    end
    local yOffset = 0.22 + (btnCount * 0.12)
    if yOffset > 0.75 then
      yOffset = 0.22
    end
    targetPos = UDim2.new(0.85, -20, yOffset, 0)
  end
  local activeState = isKeybindFeatureActive(keybindName)
  local bgColor = UI.Bg
  local bgTrans = 0.25
  local textColor = UI.Accent
  local strokeColor = UI.Stroke
  local strokeThick = 1.0
  if activeState == true then
    bgColor = Color3.fromRGB(18, 48, 28)
    bgTrans = 0.2
    textColor = Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128)
    strokeColor = Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94)
    strokeThick = 1.4
  elseif activeState == false then
    bgColor = Color3.fromRGB(42, 16, 20)
    bgTrans = 0.35
    textColor = Color3.fromRGB(248, 113, 113)
    strokeColor = Color3.fromRGB(225, 29, 72)
    strokeThick = 1.0
  end
  local button = existing
  if not button or not button.Parent then
    button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Name = "MobileFloating_" .. keybindName
    button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 42)
    button.Position = targetPos
    button.ZIndex = 998
    button.Parent = mobileHUD
    Instance.new("UICorner", button).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", button)
    stroke.Thickness = strokeThick
    local dragStart, startPos = nil, nil
    local dragging = false
    local dragInput = nil
    registerConnection(button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
      if
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
      then
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = button.Position
        dragging = false
        local connection
        connection = input.Changed:Connect(function()
          if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
            dragStart = nil
            dragInput = nil
            if connection then
              connection:Disconnect()
            end
            if dragging then
              mobileButtonSavedPositions[keybindName] = button.Position
              if not Settings.MobileButtonPositions then
                Settings.MobileButtonPositions = {}
              end
              Settings.MobileButtonPositions[keybindName] = {
                XScale = button.Position.X.Scale,
                XOffset = button.Position.X.Offset,
                YScale = button.Position.Y.Scale,
                YOffset = button.Position.Y.Offset,
              }
              pcall(saveSettings)
            else
              local action = keybindActions[keybindName]
              if action then
                TweenService:Create(button, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 38) })
                  :Play()
                task.delay(0.1, function()
                  if button and button.Parent then
                    TweenService
                      :Create(button, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 42) })
                      :Play()
                  end
                end)
                action()
                task.delay(0.05, function()
                  if updateMobileHUDButtons then
                    pcall(updateMobileHUDButtons)
                  end
                end)
              end
            end
          end
        end)
      end
    end))
    registerConnection(button.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
      if
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
      then
        dragInput = input
      end
    end))
    registerConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
      if input == dragInput and dragStart then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        if delta.Magnitude > 5 then
          dragging = true
        end
        button.Position = UDim2.new(
          startPos.X.Scale,
          startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
          startPos.Y.Scale,
          startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
      end
    end))
    mobileFloatingButtons[keybindName] = button
  end
  button.Text = buttonText:upper()
  button.BackgroundColor3 = bgColor
  button.BackgroundTransparency = bgTrans
  button.TextColor3 = textColor
  local btnStroke = button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
  if btnStroke then
    btnStroke.Color = strokeColor
    btnStroke.Thickness = strokeThick
  end
end
function showMobileKeybindPrompt(keybindName, onConfirm)
  if not mainFrame then
    return
  end
  local overlay = Instance.new("TextButton")
  overlay.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
  overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  overlay.Text = ""
  overlay.AutoButtonColor = false
  overlay.BorderSizePixel = 0
  overlay.ZIndex = 9999
  overlay.Parent = mainFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("ScreenGui") or mainFrame.Parent
  Instance.new("UICorner", overlay).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.Radius)
  local modal = Instance.new("Frame")
  modal.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 140)
  modal.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
  modal.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
  modal.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
  modal.BorderSizePixel = 0
  modal.Parent = overlay
  Instance.new("UICorner", modal).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
  local modalStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", modal)
  modalStroke.Color = UI.Accent
  modalStroke.Thickness = 1.0
  local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
  title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 10)
  title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  title.Text = "Mobile HUD Setup"
  title.TextColor3 = UI.Accent
  title.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
  title.TextSize = 13
  title.Parent = modal
  local message = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  message.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 32)

function cleanupParryUI()
  pcall(function()
    local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if not playerGui then
      return
    end
    for _, guiName in ipairs({ "Survivor", "Survivor-con", "Survivor-mob", "Survivor-gamepad" }) do
      local survivor = playerGui:FindFirstChild(guiName)
      if survivor then
        local bLeft = survivor:FindFirstChild("bottom left")
          or survivor:FindFirstChild("BottomLeft")
          or survivor
        local gen = bLeft:FindFirstChild("Gen") or survivor:FindFirstChild("Gen", true)
        local itemFrame = gen and gen:FindFirstChild("ItemFrame")
        if itemFrame then
          local gui = itemFrame:FindFirstChild("Gui")
          if gui then
            local label = gui:FindFirstChild("ParryCooldownLabel")
            if label then
              pcall(function()
                label:Destroy()
              end)
            end
          end
          local label2 = itemFrame:FindFirstChild("ParryCooldownLabel")
          if label2 then
            pcall(function()
              label2:Destroy()
            end)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local survivorMob = playerGui:FindFirstChild("Survivor-mob")
    local controls = survivorMob and survivorMob:FindFirstChild("Controls")
    if controls then
      local label = controls:FindFirstChild("ParryCooldownLabel")
      if label then
        pcall(function()
          label:Destroy()
        end)
      end
      local btn1 = controls:FindFirstChild("Gui-mob")
      if btn1 and btn1:FindFirstChild("ParryCooldownLabel") then
        pcall(function()
          btn1.ParryCooldownLabel:Destroy()
        end)
      end
      local btn2 = controls:FindFirstChild("action")
      if btn2 and btn2:FindFirstChild("ParryCooldownLabel") then
        pcall(function()
          btn2.ParryCooldownLabel:Destroy()
        end)
      end
    end
  end)
end
do
  local notifQueue = {}
  local activeNotifs = {}
  local MAX_VISIBLE_NOTIFS = 4
  local NOTIF_GAP = 6
  local BASE_Y_OFFSET = isMobile and 14 or 56
  local BASE_X_OFFSET = isMobile and 12 or 18
  local NOTIF_WIDTH = isMobile and 210 or 250
  local function updateNotifPositions()
    local currentY = BASE_Y_OFFSET
    for _, notifData in ipairs(activeNotifs) do
      notifData.targetY = currentY
      if notifData.frame and notifData.frame.Parent then
        TweenService:Create(
          notifData.frame,
          TweenInfo.new(0.24, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
          { Position = UDim2.new(0, BASE_X_OFFSET, 0, currentY) }
        ):Play()
      end
      currentY = currentY + (notifData.height or 46) + NOTIF_GAP
    end
  end
  local spawnNextNotification
  spawnNextNotification = function()
    if #activeNotifs >= MAX_VISIBLE_NOTIFS or #notifQueue == 0 then
      return
    end
    local n = table.remove(notifQueue, 1)
    local pendingCount = #notifQueue
    local displayDuration = 3.0
    if pendingCount > 0 then
      displayDuration = math.max(1.2, 3.0 - (pendingCount * 0.4))
    end
    local nType = tostring(n.notifType or "info"):lower()
    local iconSymbol = "i"
    local iconCol = UI.Text
    local borderCol = UI.Stroke
    if nType == "warning" or nType == "warn" then
      iconSymbol = "!"
      iconCol = UI.Warning
      borderCol = Color3.fromRGB(56, 40, 20)
    elseif nType == "error" or nType == "danger" then
      iconSymbol = "✕"
      iconCol = UI.Danger
      borderCol = Color3.fromRGB(60, 24, 28)
    elseif nType == "success" then
      iconSymbol = "✓"
      iconCol = UI.Success
      borderCol = Color3.fromRGB(24, 52, 32)
    else
      iconSymbol = "i"
      iconCol = UI.AccentCyan
      borderCol = UI.Stroke
    end
    local parentGui = screenGui
      or (
        localPlayer
        and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        and localPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("JLXHelperGui")
      )
    if not parentGui then
      return
    end
    local function stripEmojis(str)
      if not str then
        return ""
      end
      local s = tostring(str)
      s = s:gsub("", "")
        :gsub("", "")
        :gsub("⚡", "")
        :gsub("⏻", "")
        :gsub("👥", "")
        :gsub("📩", "")
        :gsub("⚔️", "")
        :gsub("⚔", "")
        :gsub("▶", "")
        :gsub("◐", "")
        :gsub("📄", "")
        :gsub("◎", "")
      s = s:gsub("[%z\1-\127\194-\244][\128-\191]*", function(c)
        local b = string.byte(c, 1)
        if b >= 240 then
          return ""
        end
        return c
      end)
      s = s:gsub("%s+", " "):gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
      return s
    end
    local rawTitle = stripEmojis(n.title or "Warning")
    local rawMsg = stripEmojis(n.message or "")
    local styledMsg = rawMsg
    if not styledMsg:find("<font") then
      styledMsg = styledMsg:gsub("ADMIN", "<font color='#ef4444'><b>ADMIN</b></font>")
      styledMsg = styledMsg:gsub("MODERATOR", "<font color='#3b82f6'><b>MODERATOR</b></font>")
      styledMsg = styledMsg:gsub("ENABLED", "<font color='#22c55e'><b>ENABLED</b></font>")
      styledMsg = styledMsg:gsub("DISABLED", "<font color='#ef4444'><b>DISABLED</b></font>")
      styledMsg = styledMsg:gsub("Vanish", "<font color='#888899'>Vanish</font>")
      styledMsg = styledMsg:gsub("Near", "<font color='#22c55e'>Near</font>")
      styledMsg = styledMsg:gsub("Spec", "<font color='#38bdf8'>Spec</font>")
    end
    local currentY = BASE_Y_OFFSET
    for _, prev in ipairs(activeNotifs) do
      currentY = currentY + (prev.height or 46) + NOTIF_GAP
    end
    local cardHeight = (#rawMsg > 35 or rawMsg:find("\n")) and 54 or 46
    local nFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    nFrame.Name = "VD_Notif_" .. tostring(tick())
    nFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, NOTIF_WIDTH, 0, cardHeight)
    nFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, -NOTIF_WIDTH - 20, 0, currentY)
    nFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 16, 21)
    nFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
    nFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    nFrame.ZIndex = 5000
    nFrame.Parent = parentGui
    Instance.new("UICorner", nFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    local nStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", nFrame)
    nStroke.Color = borderCol
    nStroke.Thickness = 1.0
    local iconAssetMap = {
      warning = "rbxassetid://7733658504",
      warn = "rbxassetid://7733658504",
      error = "rbxassetid://7743878496",
      danger = "rbxassetid://7743878496",
      success = "rbxassetid://7733715400",
      info = "rbxassetid://7733964719",
    }
    local headerIcon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    headerIcon.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
    headerIcon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 7)
    headerIcon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    headerIcon.Image = iconAssetMap[nType] or "rbxassetid://7733964719"
    headerIcon.ImageColor3 = iconCol
    headerIcon.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    headerIcon.ZIndex = 5001
    headerIcon.Parent = nFrame
    local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0, 16)
    titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 6)
    titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    titleLabel.Text = rawTitle
    titleLabel.TextColor3 = UI.Text
    titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    titleLabel.TextSize = 11.5
    titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    titleLabel.ZIndex = 5001
    titleLabel.Parent = nFrame
    local msgLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    msgLabel.RichText = true
    msgLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, cardHeight - 24)
    msgLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 22)
    msgLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    msgLabel.Text = styledMsg
    msgLabel.TextColor3 = UI.TextSub
    msgLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    msgLabel.TextSize = 11
    msgLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    msgLabel.TextWrapped = true
    msgLabel.ZIndex = 5001
    msgLabel.Parent = nFrame
    local notifData = { frame = nFrame, height = cardHeight, targetY = currentY }
    table.insert(activeNotifs, notifData)
    TweenService:Create(
      nFrame,
      TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
      { Position = UDim2.new(0, BASE_X_OFFSET, 0, currentY) }
    ):Play()
    task.spawn(function()
      task.wait(displayDuration)
      if nFrame and nFrame.Parent then
        local curY = notifData.targetY or currentY
        TweenService
          :Create(
            nFrame,
            TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
            { Position = UDim2.new(0, -NOTIF_WIDTH - 30, 0, curY), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }
          )
          :Play()
        task.wait(0.2)
        pcall(function()
          nFrame:Destroy()
        end)
      end
      for i, item in ipairs(activeNotifs) do
        if item == notifData then
          table.remove(activeNotifs, i)
          break
        end
      end
      updateNotifPositions()
      spawnNextNotification()
    end)
  end
  function clearAllNotifications()
    table.clear(notifQueue)
    for i = #activeNotifs, 1, -1 do
      local notifData = activeNotifs[i]
      if notifData and notifData.frame then
        pcall(function()
          notifData.frame:Destroy()
        end)
      end
    end
    table.clear(activeNotifs)
  end
  function showNotification(title, message, notifType)
    if Settings.DisableAllNotifications then
      clearAllNotifications()
      return
    end
    table.insert(notifQueue, { title = title, message = message, notifType = notifType or "info" })
    while #activeNotifs < MAX_VISIBLE_NOTIFS and #notifQueue > 0 do
      spawnNextNotification()
    end
  end
end
function showStartupCapabilityReport()
  local affected = getUnavailableFeatures()
  if #affected == 0 then
    showNotification(
      "Compatibility Check",
      "All features supported on " .. detectExecutor() .. ".",
      "success"
    )
    return
  end
  local preview = table.concat(affected, ", ")
  if #preview > 90 then
    preview = preview:sub(1, 87) .. "..."
  end
  showNotification(
    "Compatibility Warning",
    #affected .. " feature group(s) may not work: " .. preview,
    "warning"
  )
end

_G.VD_MinimapCard.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
  if
    input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
  then
    _G.VD_IsDraggingMinimap = true
    _G.VD_MinimapDragStart = input.Position
    _G.VD_MinimapStartPos = _G.VD_MinimapCard.Position
    _G.VD_MinimapDragInput = input
  end
end)
_G.VD_MinimapCard.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
  if
    _G.VD_IsDraggingMinimap
    and (
      input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    )
  then
    local delta = input.Position - _G.VD_MinimapDragStart
    _G.VD_MinimapCard.Position = UDim2.new(
      _G.VD_MinimapStartPos.X.Scale,
      _G.VD_MinimapStartPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
      _G.VD_MinimapStartPos.Y.Scale,
      _G.VD_MinimapStartPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
    )
  end
end)
_G.VD_MinimapCard.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
  if input == _G.VD_MinimapDragInput then
    _G.VD_IsDraggingMinimap = false
    _G.VD_MinimapDragInput = nil
  end
end)
local savedMouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
local savedMouseIconEnabled = false
local hasSavedMouseState = false
local isMenuOpen = not isMobile
local function saveMouseState()
  pcall(function()
    if not isMenuOpen then
      savedMouseBehavior = UserInputService.MouseBehavior
      savedMouseIconEnabled = UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled
      hasSavedMouseState = true
    end
  end)
end
local function restoreMouseState()
  pcall(function()
    if isMobile or UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
      UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
      UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
      return
    end
    if hasSavedMouseState then
      UserInputService.MouseBehavior = savedMouseBehavior
      UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = savedMouseIconEnabled
    else
      local inMatch = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") ~= nil
      if inMatch then
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
        UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
      else
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
        UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
      end
    end
  end)
end

function findEmoteByName(name)
  if not name then
    return nil
  end
  for _, e in ipairs(allEmotesList or {}) do
    if e.name == name or e.name:lower() == name:lower() then
      return e
    end
  end
  for _, e in ipairs(Settings.UserCustomEmotes or {}) do
    if e.name == name or e.name:lower() == name:lower() then
      return e
    end
  end
  return nil
end
function getFullEmoteList()
  local list = {}
  for _, e in ipairs(allEmotesList or {}) do
    table.insert(list, e)
  end
  for _, e in ipairs(Settings.UserCustomEmotes or {}) do
    table.insert(list, e)
  end
  return list
end

    currentEmoteWheelPage = currentEmoteWheelPage - 1

    if currentEmoteWheelPage > totalEmotePages then

      hoveredWheelSlot = i
      TweenService:Create(
        sBtn,
        TweenInfo.new(0.12),
        { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 38, 52), BackgroundTransparency = 0 }
      ):Play()
      TweenService:Create(sStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { Color = UI.Accent }):Play()
    end)

      if hoveredWheelSlot == i then

      end
      if closeCustomEmoteWheel then
        closeCustomEmoteWheel()
      end
    end)
    slotButtons[i] = sBtn
    slotLabels[i] = sLbl
    slotStrokes[i] = sStroke
  end
  refreshCustomEmoteWheel = function()
    local fullList = getFullEmoteList()
    local layout = Settings.EmoteWheelLayout or "Custom Slots"
    if layout == "Custom Slots" then
      pageLabel.Text = "Equipped Slots"
      pagePrevBtn.Visible = false
      pageNextBtn.Visible = false
      for i = 1, 8 do
        local slotKey = "CustomEmoteSlot" .. tostring(i)
        local emoteName = Settings[slotKey] or "None"
        local found = (emoteName ~= "None") and findEmoteByName(emoteName) or nil
        slotEmoteData[i] = found
        if found then
          slotLabels[i].Text = found.name
          slotLabels[i].TextColor3 = UI.Text
        else
          slotLabels[i].Text = "Slot " .. tostring(i) .. " (Empty)"
          slotLabels[i].TextColor3 = UI.TextSub
        end
      end
    else
      totalEmotePages = math.max(1, math.ceil(#fullList / EMOTES_PER_PAGE))
      if currentEmoteWheelPage > totalEmotePages then
        currentEmoteWheelPage = 1
      end
      pageLabel.Text = "Page "
        .. tostring(currentEmoteWheelPage)
        .. "/"
        .. tostring(totalEmotePages)
      pagePrevBtn.Visible = true
      pageNextBtn.Visible = true
      local startIdx = (currentEmoteWheelPage - 1) * EMOTES_PER_PAGE
      for i = 1, 8 do
        local item = fullList[startIdx + i]
        slotEmoteData[i] = item
        if item then
          slotLabels[i].Text = item.name
          slotLabels[i].TextColor3 = UI.Text
        else
          slotLabels[i].Text = "---"
          slotLabels[i].TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 72, 85)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  openCustomEmoteWheel = function()
    if not Settings.CustomEmoteWheel then
      return
    end
    if isEmoteWheelOpen then
      return
    end
    isEmoteWheelOpen = true
    hoveredWheelSlot = 0
    refreshCustomEmoteWheel()
    wheelContainer.Visible = true
    wheelContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    TweenService:Create(
      wheelContainer,
      TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
      { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }
    ):Play()
    pcall(function()
      UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
      UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
    end)
  end
  closeCustomEmoteWheel = function()
    if not isEmoteWheelOpen then
      return
    end
    isEmoteWheelOpen = false
    wheelContainer.Visible = false
    if Settings.EmoteWheelMode == "Hold" and hoveredWheelSlot > 0 then
      local data = slotEmoteData[hoveredWheelSlot]
      if data and data.id and playCustomEmote then
        playCustomEmote(data.id, data.name)
      end
    end
    hoveredWheelSlot = 0
  end
  toggleCustomEmoteWheel = function()
    if isEmoteWheelOpen then
      closeCustomEmoteWheel()
    else
      openCustomEmoteWheel()
    end
  end
  local wheelInputConn = nil
  updateCustomEmoteWheelBinding = function()
    if wheelInputConn then
      pcall(function()
        wheelInputConn:Disconnect()
      end)
      wheelInputConn = nil
    end
    local keyName = Settings.EmoteWheelKey or "F"
    local targetKey = Enum.KeyCode[keyName] or Enum.KeyCode.F
    wheelInputConn = registerConnection(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
      if gpe then
        return
      end
      if not Settings.CustomEmoteWheel then
        return
      end
      if input.KeyCode == targetKey then
        if Settings.EmoteWheelMode == "Hold" then
          openCustomEmoteWheel()
        else
          toggleCustomEmoteWheel()
        end
      end
    end))
    registerConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gpe)
      if input.KeyCode == targetKey then
        if Settings.CustomEmoteWheel and Settings.EmoteWheelMode == "Hold" and isEmoteWheelOpen then
          closeCustomEmoteWheel()
        end
      end
    end))
  end
  task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(0.5)
    pcall(updateCustomEmoteWheelBinding)
    pcall(refreshCustomEmoteWheel)
  end)
end

applyCustomBackground = function()
  local sidebar = mainFrame:FindFirstChild("Sidebar")
  local isCustomBg = isPremiumActive()
    and (localHooksTable and (localHooksTable.CustomBackground or localHooksTable["Custom Background"]))
    and (Settings.CustomBackground and Settings.CustomBackground.Enabled)
  if not isCustomBg then
    bgImage.Visible = false
    bgOverlay.Visible = false
    mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Bg
    mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = (
      themes
      and themes[currentThemeName]
      and themes[currentThemeName].BgTrans
    ) or 0.02
    if sidebar then
      sidebar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
    end
    return
  end
  local cfg = Settings.CustomBackground
  local resolvedImage = ""
  if cfg.LocalFile and cfg.LocalFile ~= "" then
    local hasFs = writefile and readfile and isfile and getcustomasset
    if hasFs then
      local ok, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, cfg.LocalFile)
      if ok and asset and asset ~= "" then
        resolvedImage = asset
      end
    end
  end
  if resolvedImage == "" and cfg.AssetId and cfg.AssetId ~= "" then
    local id = cfg.AssetId
    if not id:match("^rbxassetid://") then
      id = "rbxassetid://" .. (id:match("%d+") or "")
    end
    resolvedImage = id
  end
  if resolvedImage == "" then
    bgImage.Visible = false
    bgOverlay.Visible = false
    mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Bg
    mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = (
      themes
      and themes[currentThemeName]
      and themes[currentThemeName].BgTrans
    ) or 0.02
    if sidebar then
      sidebar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
    end
    return
  end
  bgImage.Image = resolvedImage
  bgImage.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
  if cfg.ScaleType then
    local mode = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
    if cfg.ScaleType == "Stretch" then
      mode = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
    elseif cfg.ScaleType == "Fit" then
      mode = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    end
    bgImage.ScaleType = mode
  end
  bgImage.Visible = true
  local overlayOpacity = math.clamp((cfg.Overlay or 40) / 100, 0, 0.70)
  bgOverlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  bgOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - overlayOpacity
  bgOverlay.Visible = overlayOpacity > 0
  mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  if sidebar then
    sidebar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.85
  end
end
_G.VD_ApplyCustomBg = applyCustomBackground

registerConnection(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
  local isFocused = true
  pcall(function()
    isFocused = UserInputService:IsWindowFocused()
  end)
  if not isFocused then
    return
  end
  if (mainFrame and isMenuOpen) or isEmoteWheelOpen then
    pcall(function()
      local mouse = localPlayer:GetMouse()
      if mouse and mouse.Icon ~= "rbxassetid://26140499" then
        mouse.Icon = "rbxassetid://26140499"
      end
      if UserInputService.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.Default then
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
      end
      if not UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled then
        UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
      end
    end)
  else
    pcall(function()
      local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
      if cam and cam.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
        return
      end
      local team = localPlayer.Team
      local isSpectating = not team
        or (
          team.Name == "Spectators"
          or team.Name:lower():find("spec")
          or team.Name:lower():find("lobby")
        )
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local isAlive = humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0
      local isTouchClient = isMobile or UserInputService.TouchEnabled
      if not isTouchClient and not isSpectating and isAlive then
        if
          UserInputService.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
          or UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled ~= false
        then
          UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
          UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
        end
      else
        if
          UserInputService.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
          or UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled ~= true
        then
          UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
          UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
        end
      end
    end)
  end
  pcall(function()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera or camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
      return
    end
    local rep = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    if
      rep:GetAttribute("RankedState") == "Intro" or rep:GetAttribute("Darkness2Covered") == true
    then
      return
    end
    local isKiller = isLocalKiller()
    if isKiller then
      if Settings.KillerThirdPerson then
        localPlayer.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
        localPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance = 10
        if Settings.InfiniteZoom then
          localPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 100000
        else
          localPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 12
        end
        _G.wasThirdPersonActive = true
      else
        if _G.wasThirdPersonActive then
          localPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
          localPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 0.5
          localPlayer.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
          _G.wasThirdPersonActive = false
        elseif localPlayer.CameraMode == Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson then
          localPlayer.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
        end
      end
    else
      if _G.wasThirdPersonActive then
        localPlayer.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
        _G.wasThirdPersonActive = false
      end
      if Settings.InfiniteZoom then
        localPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 100000
        if Settings.CameraZoomEnabled then
          localPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance = Settings.CameraZoom or 12.8
        else
          localPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
        end
      elseif Settings.CameraZoomEnabled then
        localPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance = Settings.CameraZoom or 12.8
        localPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = Settings.CameraZoom or 12.8
      end
    end
  end)
end))

  if not searchBox:IsFocused() and #searchBox.Text == 0 then
    TweenService:Create(searchStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Color = UI.Stroke, Thickness = 1.0 })
      :Play()
    TweenService:Create(searchBarContainer, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 })
      :Play()
  end
end)
searchBarContainer.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
  if not searchBox:IsFocused() and #searchBox.Text == 0 then
    TweenService
      :Create(searchStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Color = UI.StrokeDim, Thickness = 0.85 })
      :Play()
    TweenService:Create(searchBarContainer, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 })
      :Play()
  end
end)
searchBox.Focused:Connect(function()
  TweenService:Create(searchStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Color = UI.Accent, Thickness = 1.15 })
    :Play()
  TweenService:Create(searchBarContainer, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.15 })
    :Play()
  TweenService
    :Create(searchIconLbl, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { ImageTransparency = 0, ImageColor3 = UI.Accent })
    :Play()
end)
searchBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
  local text = searchBox.Text
  local clean = text:gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
  if #clean == 0 then
    TweenService
      :Create(searchStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Color = UI.StrokeDim, Thickness = 0.85 })
      :Play()
    TweenService:Create(searchBarContainer, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 })
      :Play()
    TweenService:Create(
      searchIconLbl,
      TweenInfo.new(0.18),
      { ImageTransparency = 0.3, ImageColor3 = UI.TextSub }
    ):Play()
  end
end)
searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
  local text = searchBox.Text
  local clean = text:gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1"):lower()
  if #clean == 0 then
    clearSearchBtn.Visible = false
    if searchContainer and searchContainer.Visible then
      searchContainer.Visible = false
      if activeTab and tabContainers[activeTab] then
        tabContainers[activeTab].Visible = true
        tabContainers[activeTab].GroupTransparency = 0
      end
    end
  else
    clearSearchBtn.Visible = true
    for name, container in pairs(tabContainers) do
      container.Visible = false
    end
    if searchContainer then
      searchContainer.Visible = true
      searchContainer.GroupTransparency = 0
    end
    if updateSearchResults then
      updateSearchResults(clean)
    end
  end
end)
clearSearchBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
  searchBox.Text = ""
  searchBox:ReleaseFocus()
  clearSearchBtn.Visible = false
  if searchContainer then
    searchContainer.Visible = false
  end
  if activeTab and tabContainers[activeTab] then
    tabContainers[activeTab].Visible = true
    tabContainers[activeTab].GroupTransparency = 0
  end
end)
registerConnection(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
  if isBindingKey then
    return
  end
  if
    input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F
    and (
      UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)
      or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl)
    )
  then
    if mainFrame and mainFrame.Visible and searchBox then
      searchBox:CaptureFocus()
      searchBox.SelectionStart = 1
      searchBox.CursorPosition = #searchBox.Text + 1
    end
    return
  end
  if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
    if
      searchBox
      and (
        searchBox:IsFocused() or (
          searchBox.Text ~= ""
          and searchContainer
          and searchContainer.Visible
        )
      )
    then
      searchBox.Text = ""
      searchBox:ReleaseFocus()
      if clearSearchBtn then
        clearSearchBtn.Visible = false
      end
      if searchContainer then
        searchContainer.Visible = false
      end
      if activeTab and tabContainers[activeTab] then
        tabContainers[activeTab].Visible = true
        tabContainers[activeTab].GroupTransparency = 0
      end
    end
  end
end))
