tabButtons = {}
tabContainers = {}
tabHeaderTitles = {}
activeTab = nil
function switchTab(tabName)
  if activeTab == tabName and (not searchContainer or not searchContainer.Visible) then
    if tabContainers and tabContainers[tabName] and not tabContainers[tabName].Visible then
      tabContainers[tabName].Visible = true
      tabContainers[tabName].GroupTransparency = 0
    end
    return
  end
  if searchContainer then
    searchContainer.Visible = false
  end
  if searchBox and searchBox.Text ~= "" then
    searchBox.Text = ""
    if clearSearchBtn then
      clearSearchBtn.Visible = false
    end
  end
  for name, btn in pairs(tabButtons) do
    local iconLbl = btn:FindFirstChild("Icon")
    local glow = btn:FindFirstChild("ActiveIndicator")
    local stroke = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if name == tabName then
      TweenService:Create(
        btn,
        TweenInfo.new(0.18),
        { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 26), BackgroundTransparency = 0.1 }
      ):Play()
      if stroke then
        TweenService:Create(
          stroke,
          TweenInfo.new(0.18),
          { Transparency = 0, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) }
        ):Play()
      end
      if iconLbl then
        TweenService:Create(
          iconLbl,
          TweenInfo.new(0.18),
          { ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), ImageTransparency = 0 }
        ):Play()
      end
      if glow then
        TweenService:Create(
          glow,
          TweenInfo.new(0.18),
          { BackgroundTransparency = 0, Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.7, 0) }
        ):Play()
      end
    else
      TweenService:Create(
        btn,
        TweenInfo.new(0.18),
        { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 16, 21), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }
      ):Play()
      if stroke then
        TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
      end
      if iconLbl then
        TweenService:Create(
          iconLbl,
          TweenInfo.new(0.18),
          { ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), ImageTransparency = 0.35 }
        ):Play()
      end
      if glow then
        TweenService:Create(
          glow,
          TweenInfo.new(0.18),
          { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.7, 0) }
        ):Play()
      end
    end
  end
  for name, container in pairs(tabContainers) do
    if name == tabName then
      container.Visible = true
      container.GroupTransparency = 1
      TweenService:Create(container, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { GroupTransparency = 0 }):Play()
    else
      container.Visible = false
    end
  end
  activeTab = tabName
  if tabName == "Teleport" or tabName == "TP" then
    if scanMapObjects then
      pcall(scanMapObjects)
    end
    if refreshTPMenu then
      pcall(refreshTPMenu)
    end
  end
end
local function cleanFeatureName(text)
  if not text then
    return ""
  end
  return tostring(text)
    :gsub("<[^>]+>", "")
    :gsub("%s*%+", "")
    :gsub("%s*%b()", "")
    :gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
end
function resolveTabNameFromInstance(instance)
  local curr = instance
  while curr and curr ~= contentFolder and curr ~= screenGui and curr ~= game do
    if tabByScroll and tabByScroll[curr] then
      return tabByScroll[curr]
    end
    if tabContainers then
      for tName, tContainer in pairs(tabContainers) do
        if curr == tContainer then
          return tName
        end
      end
    end
    if groupInfoByContent and groupInfoByContent[curr] and groupInfoByContent[curr].parentTab then
      return groupInfoByContent[curr].parentTab
    end
    curr = curr.Parent
  end
  return nil
end
function registerSearchableFeature(data)
  if not data or not data.name or data.name == "" then
    return
  end
  local cleanName = cleanFeatureName(data.name)
  if cleanName == "" or cleanName:lower() == "trigger" then
    return
  end
  local detectedTab = nil
  if data.container then
    detectedTab = resolveTabNameFromInstance(data.container)
  end
  if not detectedTab and data.parent then
    detectedTab = resolveTabNameFromInstance(data.parent)
  end
  local tabName = data.tabName or detectedTab or currentBuildingTabName or "Home"
  local sectionName = data.sectionName or currentBuildingSectionName or "General"
  local entry = {
    name = cleanName,
    rawLabel = data.name,
    tabName = tabName,
    sectionName = sectionName,
    controlType = data.controlType or "Toggle",
    container = data.container,
    parent = data.parent,
    parentGroup = data.parentGroup,
    isPremium = data.isPremium or isFeaturePremium(data.name),
    keybindName = data.keybindName,
    controlRef = data.controlRef,
    callback = data.callback,
    description = data.description or "",
  }
  table.insert(searchableFeatures, entry)
  return entry
end
function jumpToFeature(feature)
  if not feature then
    return
  end
  if searchBox then
    searchBox.Text = ""
    searchBox:ReleaseFocus()
  end
  if clearSearchBtn then
    clearSearchBtn.Visible = false
  end
  if searchContainer then
    searchContainer.Visible = false
  end
  local elem = feature.container or (feature.parentGroup and feature.parentGroup.container)
  local targetTab = nil
  if elem then
    targetTab = resolveTabNameFromInstance(elem)
  end
  if not targetTab and feature.parent then
    targetTab = resolveTabNameFromInstance(feature.parent)
  end
  if not targetTab then
    targetTab = feature.tabName
  end
  local tabAliases = {
    dashboard = "Home",
    home = "Home",
    esp = "ESP",
    farm = "Farm",
    autofarm = "Farm",
    self = "Self",
    modifiers = "Self",
    combat = "Combat",
    tp = "Teleport",
    teleport = "Teleport",
    teleports = "Teleport",
    visual = "Visuals",
    visuals = "Visuals",
    config = "Config",
    configs = "Config",
    community = "Community",
  }
  if targetTab then
    local normalized = tostring(targetTab):lower():gsub("%s+", "")
    if tabAliases[normalized] then
      targetTab = tabAliases[normalized]
    end
  end
  if not (targetTab and tabContainers and tabContainers[targetTab]) then
    for tName, _ in pairs(tabContainers or {}) do
      if tName:lower() == tostring(targetTab):lower() then
        targetTab = tName
        break
      end
    end
  end
  if not (targetTab and tabContainers and tabContainers[targetTab]) then
    targetTab = activeTab or "Home"
  end
  if activeTab == targetTab then
    if tabContainers and tabContainers[targetTab] then
      tabContainers[targetTab].Visible = true
      tabContainers[targetTab].GroupTransparency = 0
    end
  else
    switchTab(targetTab)
  end
  if elem then
    local curr = elem
    while curr and curr ~= contentFolder and curr ~= screenGui and curr ~= game do
      if
        groupInfoByContent
        and groupInfoByContent[curr]
        and groupInfoByContent[curr].groupObj
        and groupInfoByContent[curr].groupObj.toggleExpand
      then
        pcall(function()
          groupInfoByContent[curr].groupObj.toggleExpand(true)
        end)
      end
      curr = curr.Parent
    end
  end
  if feature.parentGroup and feature.parentGroup.toggleExpand then
    pcall(function()
      feature.parentGroup.toggleExpand(true)
    end)
  end
  task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(0.12)
    local scroll = tabScrollByName
      and (tabScrollByName[targetTab] or tabScrollByName[feature.tabName])
    if scroll and elem and elem:IsDescendantOf(scroll) then
      pcall(function()
        local scrollAbsY = scroll.AbsolutePosition.Y
        local elemAbsY = elem.AbsolutePosition.Y
        local currentCanvasY = scroll.CanvasPosition.Y
        local targetY = currentCanvasY + (elemAbsY - scrollAbsY) - 50
        scroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, targetY))
      end)
    end
    if elem and elem.Parent and elem.Parent:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
      local innerScroll = elem.Parent
      pcall(function()
        local innerAbsY = innerScroll.AbsolutePosition.Y
        local elemAbsY = elem.AbsolutePosition.Y
        local currentCanvasY = innerScroll.CanvasPosition.Y
        local targetY = currentCanvasY + (elemAbsY - innerAbsY) - 20
        innerScroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, targetY))
      end)
    end
    if elem then
      pcall(function()
        local targetStroke = elem:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
          or (elem:FindFirstChild("VisualFrame") and elem.VisualFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass(
            "UIStroke"
          ))
          or (
            elem:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Frame")
            and elem:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Frame"):FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
          )
        if targetStroke then
          local originalColor = targetStroke.Color
          local originalThickness = targetStroke.Thickness
          targetStroke.Color = UI.AccentCyan or UI.Accent
          targetStroke.Thickness = 2.2
          TweenService:Create(
            targetStroke,
            TweenInfo.new(1.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Color = originalColor, Thickness = originalThickness }
          ):Play()
        end
      end)
    end
  end)
end
renderedResultCards = {}
function updateSearchResults(query)
  for _, item in ipairs(renderedResultCards) do
    if item and item.Parent then
      item:Destroy()
    end
  end
  renderedResultCards = {}
  if not query or query == "" then
    if searchSubLbl then
      searchSubLbl.Text = "Type in the search bar above to filter features across all tabs."
    end
    return
  end
  local matches = {}
  local seen = {}
  for _, feat in ipairs(searchableFeatures) do
    local nameLower = feat.name:lower()
    local secLower = (feat.sectionName or ""):lower()
    local tabLower = (feat.tabName or ""):lower()
    local keyLower = (feat.keybindName or ""):lower()
    local descLower = (feat.description or ""):lower()
    local matchScore = nil
    if nameLower == query then
      matchScore = 1
    elseif nameLower:sub(1, #query) == query then
      matchScore = 2
    elseif nameLower:find(query, 1, true) then
      matchScore = 3
    elseif secLower:find(query, 1, true) then
      matchScore = 4
    elseif tabLower:find(query, 1, true) then
      matchScore = 5
    elseif keyLower:find(query, 1, true) or descLower:find(query, 1, true) then
      matchScore = 6
    end
    if matchScore and not seen[feat.name .. ":" .. (feat.tabName or "")] then
      seen[feat.name .. ":" .. (feat.tabName or "")] = true
      table.insert(matches, { feat = feat, score = matchScore })
    end
  end
  table.sort(matches, function(a, b)
    if a.score ~= b.score then
      return a.score < b.score
    end
    return a.feat.name < b.feat.name
  end)
  if searchSubLbl then
    searchSubLbl.Text = string.format('Found %d feature(s) matching "%s"', #matches, query)
  end
  if #matches == 0 then
    local emptyCard = Instance.new("Frame")
    emptyCard.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 70)
    emptyCard.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
    emptyCard.BackgroundTransparency = 0.6
    emptyCard.BorderSizePixel = 0
    emptyCard.Parent = resultsFrame
    Instance.new("UICorner", emptyCard).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
    local emptyStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", emptyCard)
    emptyStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
    emptyStroke.Thickness = 0.85
    local emptyTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    emptyTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    emptyTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 14)
    emptyTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    emptyTitle.Text = "No features found"
    emptyTitle.TextColor3 = UI.Text
    emptyTitle.Font = UI.Font or Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    emptyTitle.TextSize = 13.5
    emptyTitle.Parent = emptyCard
    local emptySub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    emptySub.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
    emptySub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 36)
    emptySub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    emptySub.Text = "Try searching for: ESP, Farm, Speed, Noclip, Aimbot, Visuals, Config..."
    emptySub.TextColor3 = UI.Muted
    emptySub.Font = UI.Font or Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    emptySub.TextSize = 11
    emptySub.Parent = emptyCard
    table.insert(renderedResultCards, emptyCard)
    return
  end
  for i, matchItem in ipairs(matches) do
    local feat = matchItem.feat
    local isPrem = feat.isPremium
    local card = Instance.new("Frame")
    card.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42)
    card.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
    card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.65
    card.BorderSizePixel = 0
    card.LayoutOrder = i
    card.Parent = resultsFrame
    Instance.new("UICorner", card).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", card)
    stroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
    stroke.Thickness = 0.85
    card.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
      TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Color = UI.Stroke, Thickness = 1 }):Play()
      TweenService:Create(card, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 }):Play()
    end)
    card.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
      TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Color = UI.StrokeDim, Thickness = 0.85 })
        :Play()
      TweenService:Create(card, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.65 }):Play()
    end)
    local pathLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    pathLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -165, 0, 13)
    pathLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 5)
    pathLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    pathLabel.Text =

    cardClickOverlay.MouseButton1Click:Connect(onSelect)
    table.insert(renderedResultCards, card)
  end
end
local iconCache = {}
function resolveIcon(iconName, fallbackRbxId)
  if iconCache[iconName] then
    return iconCache[iconName]
  end
  local customAssetFunc = getcustomasset or (syn and syn.getcustomasset)
  if customAssetFunc and writefile and isfile and readfile then
    local folder = "VD_Icons"
    if not isfolder or not isfolder(folder) then
      pcall(makefolder, folder)
    end
    local localPath = folder .. "/" .. iconName .. ".png"
    if isfile(localPath) then
      local ok, asset = pcall(customAssetFunc, localPath)
      if ok and asset then
        iconCache[iconName] = asset
        return asset
      end
    else
      task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function()
          local url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/latte-soft/lucide-roblox/master/icons/compiled/48px/"
            .. iconName
            .. ".png"
          local data = game:HttpGet(url)
          if data and #data > 50 then
            writefile(localPath, data)
          end
        end)
      end)
    end
  end
  iconCache[iconName] = fallbackRbxId
  return fallbackRbxId
end

function createSection(parent, title, accentColor)
  currentBuildingSectionName = title
  local detectedTab = resolveTabNameFromInstance(parent)
  if detectedTab then
    currentBuildingTabName = detectedTab
  end
  local col = UI.TextSub
  if accentColor == UI.Danger or (title:find("MAINTENANCE") or title:find("EXIT")) then
    col = UI.Danger
  end
  local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
  frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
  frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
  frame.Parent = parent
  local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, 0)
  label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0)
  label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  label.Text = title:upper()
  label.TextColor3 = col
  label.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
  label.TextSize = 10.5
  label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
  label.Parent = frame
end
keybindActions["ToggleUI"] = function()
  pcall(toggleUI)
end
toggleInProgress = false
function toggleUI(targetState)
  if not mainFrame then
    return
  end
  if isLoadingScreenActive then
    return
  end
  if toggleInProgress then
    return
  end
  local targetVisible = (targetState ~= nil) and targetState or not mainFrame.Visible
  if mobileToggleBtn then
    mobileToggleBtn.Visible = (isMobile or UserInputService.TouchEnabled)
  end
  mainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
  local t = themes[currentThemeName] or themes.Default
  local mouse = localPlayer:GetMouse()
  if targetVisible then
    saveMouseState()
    toggleInProgress = true
    isMenuOpen = true
    mainFrame.Visible = true
    pcall(function()
      local modalBtn = mainFrame:FindFirstChild("ModalButton")
      if modalBtn then
        modalBtn.Modal = false
      end
      mouse.Icon = "rbxassetid://26140499"
      UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
      UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
    end)
    mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, UI.MainW * 0.85, 0, UI.MainH * 0.85)
    mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -(UI.MainW * 0.85) / 2, 0.5, -(UI.MainH * 0.85) / 2)
    mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    local tweenSize = TweenService:Create(
      mainFrame,
      TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
      { Size = UDim2.new(0, UI.MainW, 0, UI.MainH), Position = UDim2.new(
        0.5,
        -UI.MainW / 2,
        0.5,
        -UI.MainH / 2
      ) }
    )
    local customBgActive = Settings.CustomBackground
      and Settings.CustomBackground.Enabled
      and isPremiumActive()
      and localHooksTable
      and (localHooksTable.CustomBackground or localHooksTable["Custom Background"])
      and bgImage
      and bgImage.Visible
    local targetBgTrans = customBgActive and 1 or t.BgTrans
    local tweenTrans = TweenService:Create(
      mainFrame,
      TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
      { BackgroundTransparency = targetBgTrans }
    )
    tweenSize:Play()
    tweenTrans:Play()
    tweenSize.Completed:Connect(function()
      toggleInProgress = false
    end)
  else
    toggleInProgress = true
    isMenuOpen = false
    pcall(function()
      local modalBtn = mainFrame:FindFirstChild("ModalButton")
      if modalBtn then
        modalBtn.Modal = false
      end
      restoreMouseState()
    end)
    local tweenSize = TweenService:Create(
      mainFrame,
      TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
      {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, UI.MainW * 0.85, 0, UI.MainH * 0.85),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -(UI.MainW * 0.85) / 2, 0.5, -(UI.MainH * 0.85) / 2),
      }
    )
    local tweenTrans = TweenService:Create(
      mainFrame,
      TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
      { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }
    )
    tweenSize:Play()
    tweenTrans:Play()
    tweenSize.Completed:Connect(function()
      mainFrame.Visible = false
      toggleInProgress = false
    end)
  end
end
local function getFriendlyKeyName(keyName)
  if not keyName or keyName == "" or keyName == "None" then
    return "None"
  end
  local str = tostring(keyName)
  local isHold = false
  if str:sub(1, 5):lower() == "hold " then
    isHold = true
    str = str:sub(6)
  end
  local clean = str:gsub("Enum%.KeyCode%.", "")
  if isHold then
    return "HOLD " .. clean
  end
  return clean
end
function createKeybindButton(parent, keybindName, actionCallback)
  if actionCallback then
    keybindActions[keybindName] = actionCallback
  end
  local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
  btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18)
  btn.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
  btn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
  btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 21, 28)
  btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
  btn.Text = ""
  btn.TextColor3 = UI.Text
  btn.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
  btn.TextSize = 10
  btn.AutoButtonColor = false
  btn.Parent = parent
  Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
  local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
  stroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
  stroke.Thickness = 0.8
  local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding", btn)
  pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6)
  pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
  local function updateText(animate)
    local targetBg, targetStroke, targetTextColor, targetText, targetFont, targetTextSize
    if isMobile then
      local mb = Settings.MobileButtons and Settings.MobileButtons[keybindName]
      if mb and mb ~= "" and mb ~= "None" then
        targetText = tostring(mb):upper()
        targetTextColor = Color3.fromRGB(240, 242, 250)
        targetFont = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        targetTextSize = 10
        targetBg = Color3.fromRGB(26, 28, 38)
        targetStroke = Color3.fromRGB(60, 65, 80)
      else
        targetText = "NONE"
        targetTextColor = Color3.fromRGB(115, 120, 135)
        targetFont = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        targetTextSize = 9.5
        targetBg = Color3.fromRGB(18, 19, 25)
        targetStroke = UI.StrokeDim
      end
    else
      local k = Settings.Keybinds and Settings.Keybinds[keybindName]
      if k and k ~= "" and k ~= "None" then
        local friendly = getFriendlyKeyName(k):upper()
        targetText = friendly
        targetTextColor = Color3.fromRGB(240, 242, 250)
        targetFont = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        targetTextSize = 10
        targetBg = Color3.fromRGB(26, 28, 38)
        targetStroke = Color3.fromRGB(60, 65, 80)
      else
        targetText = "NONE"
        targetTextColor = Color3.fromRGB(115, 120, 135)
        targetFont = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        targetTextSize = 9.5
        targetBg = Color3.fromRGB(18, 19, 25)
        targetStroke = UI.StrokeDim
      end
    end
    btn.Text = targetText
    btn.Font = targetFont
    btn.TextSize = targetTextSize
    if animate then
      TweenService
        :Create(
          btn,
          TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
          { BackgroundColor3 = targetBg, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, TextColor3 = targetTextColor }
        )
        :Play()
      TweenService:Create(
        stroke,
        TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        { Color = targetStroke, Thickness = 0.8 }
      ):Play()
    else
      btn.BackgroundColor3 = targetBg
      btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
      btn.TextColor3 = targetTextColor
      stroke.Color = targetStroke
      stroke.Thickness = 0.8
    end
  end
  keybindButtons[keybindName] = function()
    updateText(false)
  end
  btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if isMobile then
      showMobileKeybindPrompt(keybindName, function(btnText)
        if not btnText or btnText:gsub("%s+", "") == "" then
          if Settings.MobileButtons then
            Settings.MobileButtons[keybindName] = nil
          end
          if mobileFloatingButtons and mobileFloatingButtons[keybindName] then
            pcall(function()
              mobileFloatingButtons[keybindName]:Destroy()
            end)
            mobileFloatingButtons[keybindName] = nil
          end
          showNotification("Button Removed", "Floating button removed.", "info")
        else
          local cleanText = btnText:sub(1, 6)
          if not Settings.MobileButtons then
            Settings.MobileButtons = {}
          end
          Settings.MobileButtons[keybindName] = cleanText
          if createOrUpdateMobileFloatingButton then
            pcall(createOrUpdateMobileFloatingButton, keybindName, cleanText)
          end
          showNotification(
            "Button Setup",
            "Floating button '" .. cleanText .. "' setup!",
            "success"
          )
        end
        pcall(saveSettings)
        updateText(true)
      end)
      return
    end
    isBindingKey = true
    btn.Text = "..."
    TweenService:Create(
      btn,
      TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
      {
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 12),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.05,
        TextColor3 = UI.AccentCyan,
      }
    ):Play()
    TweenService:Create(
      stroke,
      TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
      { Color = UI.AccentCyan, Thickness = 1.2 }
    ):Play()
    local beganConn, endedConn
    local pressedKey = nil
    local pressStartTime = 0
    local holdTimerThread = nil
    local function cleanup()
      if holdTimerThread then
        pcall(task.cancel, holdTimerThread)
        holdTimerThread = nil
      end
      if beganConn then
        beganConn:Disconnect()
        beganConn = nil
      end
      if endedConn then
        endedConn:Disconnect()
        endedConn = nil
      end
      isBindingKey = false
    end
    beganConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
      local isGamepad = (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad2
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad3
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad4
      )
      local isKey = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or isGamepad
      local isMouse3 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3
      if isKey or isMouse3 then
        local kName = isKey and input.KeyCode.Name or input.UserInputType.Name
        if kName == "Escape" or kName == "Backspace" or kName == "Delete" then
          cleanup()
          Settings.Keybinds[keybindName] = "None"
          pcall(saveSettings)
          updateText(true)
          if _G.VD_RefreshHotkeys then
            pcall(_G.VD_RefreshHotkeys)
          end
          return
        end
        if not pressedKey then
          pressedKey = kName
          pressStartTime = tick()
          btn.Text = pressedKey:upper()
          holdTimerThread = task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(0.4)
            if pressedKey == kName and isBindingKey then
              btn.Text = "HOLD " .. pressedKey:upper()
              TweenService
                :Create(
                  stroke,
                  TweenInfo.new(0.15),
                  { Color = UI.AccentPink or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 120), Thickness = 1.4 }
                )
                :Play()
              btn.TextColor3 = UI.AccentPink or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 120)
            end
          end)
        end
      end
    end)
    endedConn = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
      local isGamepad = (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad2
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad3
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad4
      )
      local isKey = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or isGamepad
      local isMouse3 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3
      if (isKey or isMouse3) and pressedKey then
        local kName = isKey and input.KeyCode.Name or input.UserInputType.Name
        if kName == pressedKey then
          local duration = tick() - pressStartTime
          cleanup()
          if duration >= 0.4 then
            Settings.Keybinds[keybindName] = "Hold " .. pressedKey
            showNotification(
              "Keybind Set",
              keybindName .. " bound to HOLD " .. pressedKey,
              "success"
            )
          else
            Settings.Keybinds[keybindName] = pressedKey
            showNotification("Keybind Set", keybindName .. " bound to " .. pressedKey, "success")
          end
          pcall(saveSettings)
          updateText(true)
          if _G.VD_RefreshHotkeys then
            pcall(_G.VD_RefreshHotkeys)
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end)
  updateText(false)
  return btn
end
function createToggle(parent, labelText, defaultVal, callback, accentColor, keybindName)
  local isPrem = isFeaturePremium(labelText)
  local displayLabelText = labelText
  if not isPremiumActive() and isPrem then
    displayLabelText = labelText .. " +"
  end
  local container = Instance.new("Frame")
  container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
  container.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
  container.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
  container.BorderSizePixel = 0
  container.Parent = parent
  Instance.new("UICorner", container).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
  local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", container)
  stroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
  stroke.Thickness = 0.9
  local showKeybind = keybindName ~= nil
  local initialVal = defaultVal
  if initialVal and isPrem and not isPremiumActive() then
    initialVal = false
  end
  local box = Instance.new("TextButton")
  box.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
  box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -8)
  box.BackgroundColor3 = initialVal and UI.Text or UI.Elevated
  box.BackgroundTransparency = initialVal and 0 or 0.6
  box.Text = ""
  box.AutoButtonColor = false
  box.Parent = container
  Instance.new("UICorner", box).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
  local boxStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", box)
  boxStroke.Color = initialVal and UI.Text or UI.Stroke
  boxStroke.Thickness = 0.8
  local checkImg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
  checkImg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12)
  checkImg.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -6, 0.5, -6)
  checkImg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  checkImg.Image = "rbxassetid://7733715400"
  checkImg.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 16, 21)
  checkImg.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
  checkImg.Visible = not not initialVal
  checkImg.Parent = box
  local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  label.RichText = true
  label.Size = showKeybind and UDim2.new(1, -120, 1, 0) or UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0)
  label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 0)
  label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  label.Text = displayLabelText
  label.TextColor3 = UI.Text
  label.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
  label.TextSize = 12
  label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
  label.Parent = container
  table.insert(
    registeredPremiumLabels,
    { labelObj = label, originalText = labelText, isPrem = isPrem }
  )
  local state = initialVal
  local function setValue(val, triggerCallback)
    if val and isPrem and not isPremiumActive() then
      val = false
    end
    state = val
    TweenService
      :Create(
        box,
        TweenInfo.new(0.15),
        {
          BackgroundColor3 = state and UI.Text or UI.Elevated,
          BackgroundTransparency = state and 0 or 0.6,
        }
      )
      :Play()
    checkImg.Visible = not not state
    TweenService:Create(boxStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Color = state and UI.Text or UI.Stroke })
      :Play()
    if triggerCallback and callback then
      pcall(callback, val)
    end
  end
  local function setDirect(val, showNotif)
    if not isPremiumActive() and isPrem and val then
      showNotification("Premium Feature", "Unlock Premium in Config tab!", "warning")
      setValue(false, true)
      return
    end
    setValue(val, true)
    if showNotif and Settings.ShowToggleNotifications then
      local cleanTitle =
        labelText:gsub("<[^>]+>", ""):gsub("%s*%b()", ""):gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
      local statusStr = val and "ENABLED" or "DISABLED"
      local statusType = val and "success" or "warning"
      showNotification(cleanTitle, statusStr, statusType)
    end
  end
  local function toggleState()
    setDirect(not state, true)
  end
  if keybindName and keybindName ~= "" then
    keybindActions[keybindName] = toggleState
    keybindSetters[keybindName] = function(v)
      setDirect(v, true)
    end
    keybindGetters[keybindName] = function()
      return state
    end
  end
  local cleanLabel = labelText:gsub("<[^>]+>", ""):gsub("%s*%b()", ""):gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
  if cleanLabel ~= "" then
    keybindActions[cleanLabel] = toggleState
    keybindSetters[cleanLabel] = function(v)
      setDirect(v, true)
    end
    keybindGetters[cleanLabel] = function()
      return state
    end
    local compactLabel = cleanLabel:gsub("%s+", "")
    keybindActions[compactLabel] = toggleState
    keybindSetters[compactLabel] = function(v)
      setDirect(v, true)
    end
    keybindGetters[compactLabel] = function()
      return state
    end
  end
  box.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleState)
  local clickOverlay = Instance.new("TextButton")
  clickOverlay.Size = UDim2.new(1, showKeybind and -70 or 0, 1, 0)
  clickOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  clickOverlay.Text = ""
  clickOverlay.Parent = container
  clickOverlay.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleState)
  if showKeybind then
    local keybindBtn = createKeybindButton(container, keybindName, toggleState)
    keybindBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0)
  end
  container.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
    TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Color = UI.Stroke, Thickness = 1.0 }):Play()
    TweenService:Create(container, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 }):Play()
  end)
  container.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
    TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Color = UI.StrokeDim, Thickness = 0.9 })
      :Play()
    TweenService:Create(container, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.5 }):Play()
  end)
  local returnObj = { setValue = setValue, container = container }
  registerSearchableFeature({
    name = labelText,
    parent = parent,
    controlType = "Toggle",
    container = container,
    keybindName = keybindName,
    isPremium = isPrem,
    controlRef = returnObj,
    callback = toggleState,
  })
  return returnObj
end
function createButton(parent, labelText, buttonText, callback, accentColor, keybindName)
  local isPrem = isFeaturePremium(labelText)
  local displayLabelText = labelText
  if not isPremiumActive() and isPrem then
    displayLabelText = labelText .. " +"
  end
  local container = Instance.new("Frame")
  container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
  container.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
  container.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
  container.BorderSizePixel = 0
  container.Parent = parent
  Instance.new("UICorner", container).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
  local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", container)
  stroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
  stroke.Thickness = 0.9
  local showKeybind = keybindName ~= nil
  local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  label.RichText = true
  label.Size = showKeybind and UDim2.new(1, -185, 1, 0) or UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, 0)
  label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
  label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  label.Text = displayLabelText
  label.TextColor3 = UI.Text
  label.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
  label.TextSize = 12
  label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
  label.Parent = container
  table.insert(
    registeredPremiumLabels,
    { labelObj = label, originalText = labelText, isPrem = isPrem }
  )
  local btnBack = Instance.new("Frame")
  btnBack.Size = UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 20)
  btnBack.Position = UDim2.new(1, -98, 0.5, -10)
  btnBack.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
  btnBack.BorderSizePixel = 0
  btnBack.Parent = container
  Instance.new("UICorner", btnBack).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
  local btnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btnBack)
  btnStroke.Color = UI.Stroke
  btnStroke.Thickness = 0.8
  local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
  btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
  btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  btn.Text = (buttonText or "TRIGGER"):upper()
  btn.TextColor3 = UI.Text
  btn.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
  btn.TextSize = 10.5
  btn.AutoButtonColor = false
  btn.Parent = btnBack
  btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
    TweenService
      :Create(btnBack, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 36, 46) })
      :Play()
  end)
  btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
    TweenService:Create(btnBack, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated }):Play()
  end)
  local buttonAction = function()
    if not isPremiumActive() and isPrem then
      showNotification("Premium Feature", "Unlock Premium in Config tab!", "warning")
      return
    end
    pcall(callback)
  end
  if keybindName and keybindName ~= "" then
    keybindActions[keybindName] = buttonAction
  end
  local cleanLabel = labelText:gsub("<[^>]+>", ""):gsub("%s*%b()", ""):gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
  if cleanLabel ~= "" then
    keybindActions[cleanLabel] = buttonAction
    keybindActions[cleanLabel:gsub("%s+", "")] = buttonAction
  end
  btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(buttonAction)
  if showKeybind then
    local keybindBtn = createKeybindButton(container, keybindName, buttonAction)
    keybindBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -105, 0.5, 0)
  end
  registerSearchableFeature({
    name = labelText,
    parent = parent,
    controlType = "Button",
    container = container,
    keybindName = keybindName,
    isPremium = isPrem,
    callback = buttonAction,
  })
  return container
end
function createSubToggle(parent, labelText, defaultVal, callback)
  local isPrem = isFeaturePremium(labelText)
  local displayLabelText = labelText
  local container = Instance.new("Frame")
  container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
  container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  container.BorderSizePixel = 0
  container.Parent = parent
  local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  label.RichText = true
  label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0)
  label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0)
  label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  label.Text = displayLabelText
  label.TextColor3 = UI.TextSub
  label.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
  label.TextSize = 11.5
  label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
  label.Parent = container
  local track = Instance.new("TextButton")
  track.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 14)
  track.Position = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0.5, -7)
  track.BackgroundColor3 = defaultVal and UI.Text or UI.Elevated
  track.Text = ""
  track.AutoButtonColor = false
  track.Parent = container
  Instance.new("UICorner", track).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
  local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
  knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
  knob.Position = defaultVal and UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, -5) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -5)
  knob.BackgroundColor3 = defaultVal and Color3.fromRGB(15, 16, 21) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190)
  knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
  knob.Parent = track
  Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
  local state = defaultVal
  local function setValue(val)
    state = val
    TweenService
      :Create(track, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundColor3 = state and UI.Text or UI.Elevated })
      :Play()
    TweenService
      :Create(
        knob,
        TweenInfo.new(0.15),
        {
          Position = state and UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, -5) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -5),
          BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(15, 16, 21) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190),
        }
      )
      :Play()
  end
  track.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not isPremiumActive() and isPrem then
      showNotification("Premium Feature", "Unlock Premium in Config tab!", "warning")
      setValue(false)
      return
    end
    setValue(not state)
    callback(state)
  end)
  local returnObj = { setValue = setValue, container = container }
  registerSearchableFeature({
    name = labelText,
    parent = parent,
    controlType = "SubToggle",
    container = container,
    isPremium = isPrem,
    controlRef = returnObj,
    callback = callback,
  })
  return returnObj
end
function createCollapsibleGroup(parent, labelText, accentColor)
  local isPrem = isFeaturePremium(labelText)
  local displayLabelText = labelText
  local group = Instance.new("Frame")
  group.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
  group.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  group.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
  group.BorderSizePixel = 0
  group.Parent = parent
  local groupLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
  groupLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
  groupLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
  groupLayout.Parent = group
  local container = Instance.new("TextButton")
  container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
  container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  container.BorderSizePixel = 0
  container.Text = ""
  container.AutoButtonColor = false
  container.LayoutOrder = 1
  container.Parent = group
  local visualFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
  visualFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
  visualFrame.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
  visualFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
  visualFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
  visualFrame.Parent = container
  Instance.new("UICorner", visualFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
  local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", visualFrame)
  stroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
  stroke.Thickness = 0.9
  local chevron = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
  chevron.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
  chevron.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -7)
  chevron.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  chevron.Image = "rbxassetid://7733717755"
  chevron.ImageColor3 = UI.TextSub
  chevron.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
  chevron.Parent = visualFrame
  local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  label.RichText = true
  label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 1, 0)
  label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 0)
  label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  label.Text = displayLabelText
  label.TextColor3 = UI.Text
  label.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
  label.TextSize = 12
  label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
  label.Parent = visualFrame
  table.insert(
    registeredPremiumLabels,
    { labelObj = label, originalText = labelText, isPrem = isPrem }
  )
  local content = Instance.new("Frame")
  content.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
  content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  content.BorderSizePixel = 0
  content.ClipsDescendants = true
  content.LayoutOrder = 2
  content.Parent = group
  local contentLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
  contentLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
  contentLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
  contentLayout.Parent = content
  local contentPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
  contentPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12)
  contentPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 2)
  contentPadding.Parent = content
  local expanded = false
  local function toggleExpand(targetState)
    if targetState == nil then
      expanded = not expanded
    else
      expanded = targetState
    end
    TweenService:Create(
      chevron,
      TweenInfo.new(0.2),
      { Rotation = expanded and 90 or 0, ImageColor3 = expanded and UI.Text or UI.TextSub }
    ):Play()
    TweenService:Create(
      stroke,
      TweenInfo.new(0.2),
      { Color = expanded and UI.Stroke or UI.StrokeDim, Thickness = expanded and 1.1 or 0.9 }
    ):Play()
    local targetHeight = expanded and contentLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y or 0
    TweenService:Create(
      content,
      TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
      { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, targetHeight) }
    ):Play()
  end
  contentLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
    if expanded then
      content.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, contentLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
    end
  end)
  container.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not isPremiumActive() and isPrem then
      showNotification("Premium Feature", "Unlock Premium in Config tab!", "warning")
      return
    end
    toggleExpand()
  end)
  local function addSubToggle(subText, subDefaultVal, subCallback)
    return createSubToggle(content, subText, subDefaultVal, subCallback)
  end
  local returnObj = {
    addSubToggle = addSubToggle,
    content = content,
    toggleExpand = toggleExpand,
    container = group,
  }
  local detectedTab = resolveTabNameFromInstance(parent) or currentBuildingTabName or "General"
  groupInfoByContent[content] = {
    groupObj = returnObj,
    parentTab = detectedTab,
    sectionName = currentBuildingSectionName,
    groupTitle = cleanFeatureName(labelText),
  }
  registerSearchableFeature({
    name = labelText,
    parent = parent,
    controlType = "Group",
    container = group,
    parentGroup = returnObj,
    isPremium = isPrem,
  })
  return returnObj
end

)
  local isPrem = isFeaturePremium(labelText)

  if keybindName and keybindName ~= "" then

    keybindSetters[keybindName] = function(v)

    end

    end
  end
  local cleanLabel = labelText:gsub("<[^>]+>", ""):gsub("%s*%b()", ""):gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
  if cleanLabel ~= "" then
    keybindActions[cleanLabel] = toggleState
    keybindSetters[cleanLabel] = function(v)
      setDirect(v, true)
    end
    keybindGetters[cleanLabel] = function()
      return state
    end
    local compactLabel = cleanLabel:gsub("%s+", "")
    keybindActions[compactLabel] = toggleState
    keybindSetters[compactLabel] = function(v)
      setDirect(v, true)
    end
    keybindGetters[compactLabel] = function()
      return state
    end
  end
  if showKeybind then
    local keybindBtn = createKeybindButton(visualFrame, keybindName, toggleState)
    keybindBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0.5, 0)
  end
  local function addSubToggle(subText, subDefaultVal, subCallback)
    return createSubToggle(content, subText, subDefaultVal, subCallback)
  end
  local returnObj = {
    addSubToggle = addSubToggle,
    toggleExpand = toggleExpand,
    setValue = setValue,
    content = content,
    container = group,
  }
  local detectedTab = resolveTabNameFromInstance(parent) or currentBuildingTabName or "General"
  groupInfoByContent[content] = {
    groupObj = returnObj,
    parentTab = detectedTab,
    sectionName = currentBuildingSectionName,
    groupTitle = cleanFeatureName(labelText),
  }
  registerSearchableFeature({
    name = labelText,
    parent = parent,
    controlType = "Toggle",
    container = group,
    keybindName = keybindName,
    isPremium = isPrem,
    controlRef = returnObj,
    parentGroup = returnObj,
    callback = toggleCallback,
  })
  return returnObj
end
function createCollapsibleHeader(parent, labelText, accentColor)
  return createCollapsibleGroup(parent, labelText, accentColor)
end
function createSelector(parent, labelText, options, values, currentValue, callback)
  options = options or {}
  values = values or options
  local isPrem = isFeaturePremium(labelText)
  local displayLabelText = labelText
  if not isPremiumActive() and isPrem then
    displayLabelText = labelText .. " +"
  end
  local group = Instance.new("Frame")
  group.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
  group.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  group.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
  group.BorderSizePixel = 0
  group.Parent = parent
  local groupLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
  groupLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
  groupLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 3)
  groupLayout.Parent = group
  local header = Instance.new("TextButton")
  header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
  header.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
  header.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
  header.BorderSizePixel = 0
  header.Text = ""
  header.AutoButtonColor = false
  header.LayoutOrder = 1
  header.Parent = group
  Instance.new("UICorner", header).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
  local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", header)
  stroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
  stroke.Thickness = 0.9
  local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  label.RichText = true
  label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -155, 1, 0)
  label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
  label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  label.Text = displayLabelText
  label.TextColor3 = UI.Text
  label.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
  label.TextSize = 12
  label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
  label.Parent = header
  table.insert(
    registeredPremiumLabels,
    { labelObj = label, originalText = labelText, isPrem = isPrem }
  )
  local pill = Instance.new("Frame")
  pill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 22)
  pill.Position = UDim2.new(1, -138, 0.5, -11)
  pill.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
  pill.BorderSizePixel = 0
  pill.Parent = header
  Instance.new("UICorner", pill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
  local pillStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", pill)
  pillStroke.Color = UI.Stroke
  pillStroke.Thickness = 0.8
  local currentTextLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  currentTextLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 1, 0)
  currentTextLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
  currentTextLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  currentTextLbl.Text = "None"
  currentTextLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 242, 250)
  currentTextLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
  currentTextLbl.TextSize = 11
  currentTextLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
  currentTextLbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
  currentTextLbl.Parent = pill
  local chevron = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
  chevron.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
  chevron.Position = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0.5, -7)
  chevron.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  chevron.Image = "rbxassetid://7733717447"
  chevron.ImageColor3 = UI.TextSub
  chevron.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
  chevron.Parent = pill
  local dropdownFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
  dropdownFrame.Name = "DropdownMenu"
  dropdownFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
  dropdownFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 16, 21)
  dropdownFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
  dropdownFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
  dropdownFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
  dropdownFrame.Visible = false
  dropdownFrame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
  dropdownFrame.LayoutOrder = 2
  dropdownFrame.Parent = group
  Instance.new("UICorner", dropdownFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
  local dropStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", dropdownFrame)
  dropStroke.Color = UI.Stroke
  dropStroke.Thickness = 0.9
  local dropList = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
  dropList.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
  dropList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
  dropList.Parent = dropdownFrame
  local dropPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding", dropdownFrame)
  dropPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
  dropPadding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4)
  dropPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4)
  dropPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4)
  local isOpen = false
  local selectedValue = currentValue
  local function toggleDropdown(forceState)
    isOpen = (forceState ~= nil) and forceState or not isOpen
    dropdownFrame.Visible = isOpen
    TweenService:Create(chevron, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Rotation = isOpen and 180 or 0 }):Play()
    TweenService
      :Create(pillStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Color = isOpen and UI.Accent or UI.Stroke })
      :Play()
    TweenService
      :Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Color = isOpen and UI.Stroke or UI.StrokeDim })
      :Play()
  end
  local function rebuildOptions()
    for _, child in ipairs(dropdownFrame:GetChildren()) do
      if child:IsA("TextButton") then
        child:Destroy()
      end
    end
    for i, optName in ipairs(options) do
      local optVal = values[i]
      local isSelected = (optVal == selectedValue)
      local optBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
      optBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
      optBtn.BackgroundColor3 = isSelected and Color3.fromRGB(28, 30, 40)
        or Color3.fromRGB(15, 16, 21)
      optBtn.BackgroundTransparency = isSelected and 0 or 1
      optBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
      optBtn.Text = ""
      optBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
      optBtn.Parent = dropdownFrame
      Instance.new("UICorner", optBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
      local optLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
      optLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -26, 1, 0)
      optLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
      optLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      optLbl.Text = tostring(optName)
      optLbl.TextColor3 = isSelected and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        or Color3.fromRGB(160, 165, 180)
      optLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
      optLbl.TextSize = 11.5
      optLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
      optLbl.Parent = optBtn
      local checkmark = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
      checkmark.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
      checkmark.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0.5, -7)
      checkmark.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      checkmark.Image = "rbxassetid://7733715400"
      checkmark.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
      checkmark.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
      checkmark.Visible = isSelected
      checkmark.Parent = optBtn
      optBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        if optVal ~= selectedValue then
          TweenService
            :Create(
              optBtn,
              TweenInfo.new(0.12),
              { BackgroundTransparency = 0.5, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 25, 34) }
            )
            :Play()
          TweenService
            :Create(optLbl, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 235, 245) })
            :Play()
        end
      end)
      optBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        if optVal ~= selectedValue then
          TweenService:Create(optBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
          TweenService
            :Create(optLbl, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 165, 180) })
            :Play()
        end
      end)
      optBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if not isPremiumActive() and isPrem then
          showNotification("Premium Feature", "Unlock Premium in Config tab!", "warning")
          return
        end
        selectedValue = optVal
        currentTextLbl.Text = tostring(optName)
        toggleDropdown(false)
        rebuildOptions()
        if callback then
          pcall(callback, optVal)
        end
      end)
      if isSelected then
        currentTextLbl.Text = tostring(optName)
      end
    end
  end
  local function setValue(val, triggerCallback)
    selectedValue = val
    for i, v in ipairs(values) do
      if v == val then
        currentTextLbl.Text = tostring(options[i] or val)
        break
      end
    end
    rebuildOptions()
    if triggerCallback and callback then
      pcall(callback, val)
    end
  end
  local function updateOptions(newOptions, newValues, newCurrentVal)
    options = newOptions or {}
    values = newValues or options
    setValue(newCurrentVal ~= nil and newCurrentVal or values[1])
  end
  header.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not isPremiumActive() and isPrem then
      showNotification("Premium Feature", "Unlock Premium in Config tab!", "warning")
      return
    end
    toggleDropdown()
  end)
  rebuildOptions()
  local returnObj = {
    setValue = setValue,
    updateOptions = updateOptions,
    toggleDropdown = toggleDropdown,
    container = group,
  }
  registerSearchableFeature({
    name = labelText,
    parent = parent,
    controlType = "Selector",
    container = group,
    isPremium = isPrem,
    controlRef = returnObj,
    callback = callback,
  })
  return returnObj
end
function createSlider(
  parent,
  labelText,
  minVal,
  maxVal,
  defaultVal,
  callback,
  accentColor,
  arg8,
  arg9
)
  local step = nil
  local suffix = ""
  if type(arg8) == "number" then
    step = arg8
    if type(arg9) == "string" then
      suffix = arg9
    end
  elseif type(arg8) == "string" then
    suffix = arg8
  elseif type(arg9) == "string" then
    suffix = arg9
  end
  local isPrem = isFeaturePremium(labelText)
  local displayLabelText = labelText
  local container = Instance.new("Frame")
  container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
  container.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
  container.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
  container.BorderSizePixel = 0
  container.Parent = parent
  Instance.new("UICorner", container).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
  local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", container)
  stroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
  stroke.Thickness = 0.9
  local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  label.RichText = true
  label.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 18)
  label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 4)
  label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  label.Text = displayLabelText
  label.TextColor3 = UI.Text
  label.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
  label.TextSize = 12
  label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
  label.Parent = container
  local function formatVal(v)
    local num = tonumber(v) or 0
    if type(step) == "number" and step > 0 and step < 0.1 then
      if maxVal then
        return string.format("%.2f / %.2f%s", num, maxVal, suffix)
      end
      return string.format("%.2f%s", num, suffix)
    end
    if maxVal then
      return tostring(math.round(num * 100) / 100) .. " / " .. tostring(maxVal) .. suffix
    end
    return tostring(math.round(num * 100) / 100) .. suffix
  end
  local currentSliderVal = defaultVal
  local valueLabel = Instance.new("TextBox")
  valueLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 18)
  valueLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 4)
  valueLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  valueLabel.Text = formatVal(defaultVal)
  valueLabel.TextColor3 = UI.TextSub
  valueLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
  valueLabel.TextSize = 11
  valueLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
  valueLabel.ClearTextOnFocus = false
  valueLabel.Parent = container
  local track = Instance.new("TextButton")
  track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 3)
  track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 26)
  track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 34, 43)
  track.BorderSizePixel = 0
  track.Text = ""
  track.AutoButtonColor = false
  track.Parent = container
  Instance.new("UICorner", track).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
  local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
  fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
  fill.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Text
  fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
  fill.Parent = track
  Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
  local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
  knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 9, 0, 9)
  knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, -4, 0.5, -4)
  knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
  knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
  knob.Parent = track
  Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
  local function setValue(val, triggerCallback)
    currentSliderVal = val
    local percentage = math.clamp((val - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 1)
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(percentage, 0, 1, 0)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(percentage, -4, 0.5, -4)
    if not valueLabel:IsFocused() then
      valueLabel.Text = formatVal(val)
    end
    if triggerCallback and callback then
      pcall(callback, val)
    end
  end
  valueLabel.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    if not isPremiumActive() and isPrem then
      showNotification("Premium Feature", "Unlock Premium in Config tab!", "warning")
      valueLabel.Text = formatVal(currentSliderVal)
      return
    end
    local rawText = valueLabel.Text:gsub("[^%d%.%-]", "")
    local num = tonumber(rawText)
    if num then
      num = math.clamp(num, minVal, maxVal)
      setValue(num, true)
    else
      valueLabel.Text = formatVal(currentSliderVal)
    end
  end)
  local function update(input)
    local sizeX = track.AbsoluteSize.X
    if sizeX <= 0 then
      sizeX = 180
    end
    local posX = math.clamp(input.Position.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X, 0, sizeX)
    local percentage = posX / sizeX
    local val = minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * percentage
    if type(step) == "number" and step > 0 then
      val = math.round(val / step) * step
    else
      val = math.round(val)
    end
    currentSliderVal = val
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(percentage, 0, 1, 0)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(percentage, -4, 0.5, -4)
    if not valueLabel:IsFocused() then
      valueLabel.Text = formatVal(val)
    end
    callback(val)
  end
  local initPercentage = math.clamp((defaultVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 1)
  fill.Size = UDim2.new(initPercentage, 0, 1, 0)
  knob.Position = UDim2.new(initPercentage, -4, 0.5, -4)
  local dragging = false
  track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if
      input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    then
      if not isPremiumActive() and isPrem then
        showNotification("Premium Feature", "Unlock Premium in Config tab!", "warning")
        return
      end
      dragging = true
      update(input)
    end
  end)
  registerConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if
      dragging
      and (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
      )
    then
      update(input)
    end
  end))
  registerConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if
      input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    then
      dragging = false
    end
  end))
  local returnObj = { setValue = setValue, container = container }
  registerSearchableFeature({
    name = labelText,
    parent = parent,
    controlType = "Slider",
    container = container,
    isPremium = isPrem,
    controlRef = returnObj,
    callback = callback,
  })
  return returnObj
end
function createSliderFloat(
  parent,
  labelText,
  minVal,
  maxVal,
  defaultVal,
  callback,
  accentColor,
  stepVal
)
  return createSlider(
    parent,
    labelText,
    minVal,
    maxVal,
    defaultVal,
    callback,
    accentColor,
    stepVal or 0.01
  )
end
function createInput(

    inputBack.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated

      container = container,

        if not textBox:IsFocused() then
          textBox.Text = tostring(val)
        end
      end,
    }
    registerSearchableFeature({
      name = labelText,
      parent = parent,
      controlType = "Input",
      container = container,
      isPremium = isPrem,
      controlRef = returnObj,
      callback = callback,
    })
    return returnObj
  else
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.RichText = true
    label.Size = UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 1, 0)
    label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = displayLabelText
    label.TextColor3 = UI.Text
    label.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    label.TextSize = 12
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = container
    local inputBack = Instance.new("Frame")
    inputBack.Size = UDim2.new(0, 96, 0, 20)
    inputBack.Position = UDim2.new(1, -106, 0.5, -10)
    inputBack.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
    inputBack.BorderSizePixel = 0
    inputBack.Parent = container
    Instance.new("UICorner", inputBack).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    local textBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
    textBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, 0)
    textBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0)
    textBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    textBox.Text = tostring(defaultVal or "")
    textBox.PlaceholderText = placeholderText or "value"
    textBox.PlaceholderColor3 = UI.Muted

    textBox.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu

    textBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false

    textBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
      pcall(callback, textBox.Text)
    end)
    local returnObj = {
      container = container,
      textBox = textBox,
      setValue = function(val)
        if not textBox:IsFocused() then
          textBox.Text = tostring(val)
        end
      end,
    }
    registerSearchableFeature({
      name = labelText,
      parent = parent,
      controlType = "Input",
      container = container,
      isPremium = isPrem,
      controlRef = returnObj,
      callback = callback,
    })
    return returnObj
  end
end
function createCompactColorPicker(parent, labelText, defaultColor, callback, isPremium)
  local isPrem = isPremium or isFeaturePremium(labelText)
  local displayLabelText = labelText
  if not isPremiumActive() and isPrem then
    displayLabelText = labelText .. ' <font color="#FF2A6D">[👑]</font>'
  end
  if not defaultColor or typeof(defaultColor) ~= "Color3" then
    defaultColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
  end
  local currentColor = defaultColor
  local currentH, currentS, currentV = Color3.toHSV(defaultColor)
  local isOpen = false
  local container = Instance.new("Frame")
  container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
  container.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
  container.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
  container.BorderSizePixel = 0
  container.ClipsDescendants = true
  container.Parent = parent
  Instance.new("UICorner", container).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
  local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", container)
  stroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
  stroke.Thickness = 0.9
  local header = Instance.new("TextButton")
  header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
  header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  header.Text = ""
  header.AutoButtonColor = false
  header.Parent = container
  local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  titleLabel.RichText = true
  titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -95, 1, 0)
  titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
  titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  titleLabel.Text = displayLabelText
  titleLabel.TextColor3 = UI.Text
  titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
  titleLabel.TextSize = 12
  titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
  titleLabel.Parent = header
  local rightSide = Instance.new("Frame")
  rightSide.Size = UDim2.new(0, 85, 1, 0)
  rightSide.Position = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 0)
  rightSide.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  rightSide.Parent = header
  local hexBadge = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    currentColor = Color3.fromHSV(currentH, currentS, currentV)
    colorCube.BackgroundColor3 = currentColor
    pickerBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(currentH, 1, 1)
    local r = math.floor(currentColor.R * 255)
    local g = math.floor(currentColor.G * 255)
    local b = math.floor(currentColor.B * 255)
    hexBadge.Text = string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", r, g, b)
    svKnob.Position = UDim2.new(currentS, 0, 1 - currentV, 0)
    hueKnob.Position = UDim2.new(currentH, 0, 0.5, 0)
    if fireCallback and callback then
      pcall(function()
        callback(currentColor)
      end)
    end

  local function setDropdownOpen(open)
    isOpen = open
    local targetHeight = isOpen and 175 or 32
    TweenService:Create(
      container,
      TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
      { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, targetHeight) }
    ):Play()
    TweenService
      :Create(
        cubeStroke,
        TweenInfo.new(0.15),
        { Color = isOpen and UI.Accent or Color3.fromRGB(80, 85, 100), Thickness = isOpen and 1.8
          or 1.2 }
      )
      :Play()
  end

    if isPrem and not isPremiumActive() then
      showNotification("Premium Feature", "Unlock Premium in Config tab!", "warning")
      return
    end
    setDropdownOpen(not isOpen)
  end)

    pBtn.BackgroundColor3 = pCol
    pBtn.Text = ""
    pBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    pBtn.Parent = presetRow
    Instance.new("UICorner", pBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    pbStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 65, 75)
    pbStroke.Thickness = 0.8
    pBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
      currentH, currentS, currentV = Color3.toHSV(pCol)
      refreshAll(true)
    end)
  end
  local svDragging = false
  svClickBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
    if
      inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
      or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    then
      svDragging = true
      local abs = pickerBox.AbsolutePosition
      local sz = pickerBox.AbsoluteSize
      currentS = math.clamp((inp.Position.X - abs.X) / math.max(1, sz.X), 0, 1)
      currentV = math.clamp(1 - (inp.Position.Y - abs.Y) / math.max(1, sz.Y), 0, 1)
      refreshAll(true)
    end
  end)
  registerConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
    if
      svDragging
      and (
        inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
      )
    then
      local abs = pickerBox.AbsolutePosition
      local sz = pickerBox.AbsoluteSize
      currentS = math.clamp((inp.Position.X - abs.X) / math.max(1, sz.X), 0, 1)
      currentV = math.clamp(1 - (inp.Position.Y - abs.Y) / math.max(1, sz.Y), 0, 1)
      refreshAll(true)
    end
  end))
  local hueDragging = false
  hueClickBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)

    then

      hueDragging
      and (
        inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
      )

    end
  end))
  registerConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
    if
      inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
      or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    then
      svDragging = false
      hueDragging = false
    end
  end))
  local returnObj = {
    setColor = function(col)
      if col and typeof(col) == "Color3" then
        currentH, currentS, currentV = Color3.toHSV(col)
        refreshAll(false)
      end
    end,
    setValue = function(col)
      if col and typeof(col) == "Color3" then
        currentH, currentS, currentV = Color3.toHSV(col)
        refreshAll(false)
      end
    end,
    getColor = function()
      return currentColor
    end,
    container = container,
  }
  registerSearchableFeature({
    name = labelText,
    parent = parent,
    controlType = "Color",
    container = container,
    isPremium = isPrem,
    controlRef = returnObj,
    callback = callback,
  })
  refreshAll(false)
  return returnObj
end

  local svDragging = false

      currentV = math.clamp(1 - (inp.Position.Y - abs.Y) / math.max(1, sz.Y), 0, 1)

  registerSearchableFeature({
    name = labelText,
    parent = parent,
    controlType = "Color",
    container = container,
    isPremium = isPrem,
    controlRef = returnObj,
    callback = callback,
  })
  refreshAll(false)
  return returnObj
end
function createHueSlider(parent, labelText, defaultColor, callback)
  return createColorWheel(parent, labelText, defaultColor, callback)
end
function setRevolverAutofarm(val)
  if val and not isPremiumActive("RevolverAutofarm") then
    showNotification(
      "Premium Feature +",
      "Unlock the Premium version to use this feature!",
      "warning"
    )
    if controlRegistry["RevolverAutofarm"] and controlRegistry["RevolverAutofarm"].setValue then
      pcall(function()
        controlRegistry["RevolverAutofarm"].setValue(false)
      end)
    end
    return
  end
  Settings.RevolverAutofarm = val
  if val then
    if not Settings.InstantHeal then
      instantHealWasDisabledBeforeRevolver = true
      Settings.InstantHeal = true
      if controlRegistry["InstantHeal"] and controlRegistry["InstantHeal"].setValue then
        pcall(function()
          controlRegistry["InstantHeal"].setValue(true)
        end)
      end
    else
      instantHealWasDisabledBeforeRevolver = false
    end
  else
    if instantHealWasDisabledBeforeRevolver then
      Settings.InstantHeal = false
      if controlRegistry["InstantHeal"] and controlRegistry["InstantHeal"].setValue then
        pcall(function()
          controlRegistry["InstantHeal"].setValue(false)
        end)
      end
      instantHealWasDisabledBeforeRevolver = false
    end
  end
  if controlRegistry["RevolverAutofarm"] and controlRegistry["RevolverAutofarm"].setValue then
    pcall(function()
      controlRegistry["RevolverAutofarm"].setValue(val)
    end)
  end
  pcall(saveSettings)
end
