do
  local originalSkyboxes = {}
  _G.VD_UpdateCustomSkybox = function()
    pcall(function()
      local cfg = Settings.CustomSkybox
      if not cfg or not cfg.Enabled then
        local customSky = Lighting:FindFirstChild("VD_CustomSkybox")
        if customSky then
          customSky:Destroy()
        end
        for _, sky in ipairs(originalSkyboxes) do
          if sky and sky.Parent == nil then
            sky.Parent = Lighting
          end
        end
        originalSkyboxes = {}
        return
      end
      for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Sky") and child.Name ~= "VD_CustomSkybox" then
          table.insert(originalSkyboxes, child)
          child.Parent = nil
        end
      end
      local sky = Lighting:FindFirstChild("VD_CustomSkybox")
      if not sky then
        sky = Instance.new("Sky")
        sky.Name = "VD_CustomSkybox"
        sky.Parent = Lighting
      end
      local presetData = _G.VD_SKYBOX_PRESETS[cfg.Preset]
      if cfg.Preset == "Custom Textures" or not presetData then
        local master = (cfg.CustomBk and cfg.CustomBk ~= "") and cfg.CustomBk
          or "rbxassetid://159454299"
        sky.SkyboxBk = (cfg.CustomBk and cfg.CustomBk ~= "") and cfg.CustomBk or master
        sky.SkyboxDn = (cfg.CustomDn and cfg.CustomDn ~= "") and cfg.CustomDn or master
        sky.SkyboxFt = (cfg.CustomFt and cfg.CustomFt ~= "") and cfg.CustomFt or master
        sky.SkyboxLf = (cfg.CustomLf and cfg.CustomLf ~= "") and cfg.CustomLf or master
        sky.SkyboxRt = (cfg.CustomRt and cfg.CustomRt ~= "") and cfg.CustomRt or master
        sky.SkyboxUp = (cfg.CustomUp and cfg.CustomUp ~= "") and cfg.CustomUp or master
      else
        sky.SkyboxBk = presetData.Bk
        sky.SkyboxDn = presetData.Dn
        sky.SkyboxFt = presetData.Ft
        sky.SkyboxLf = presetData.Lf
        sky.SkyboxRt = presetData.Rt
        sky.SkyboxUp = presetData.Up
      end
      sky.CelestialBodiesShown = (cfg.CelestialBodies ~= false)
    end)
  end
  local function resolveUserId(input)
    if not input then
      return nil
    end
    input = tostring(input):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if input == "" then
      return nil
    end
    local num = tonumber(input)
    if num and num > 0 then
      return num
    end
    local ok, id = pcall(function()
      return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(input)
    end)
    if ok and id then
      return id
    end
    return nil
  end
  _G.VD_GetTargetPlayers = function(targetSelection)
    targetSelection = targetSelection
      or (Settings and Settings.PlayerCustomizer and Settings.PlayerCustomizer.SelectedTarget)
      or "LocalPlayer (Self)"
    local res = {}
    if targetSelection == "LocalPlayer (Self)" or targetSelection == "Self" then
      if localPlayer then
        table.insert(res, localPlayer)
      end
    elseif targetSelection == "All Players" then
      for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        table.insert(res, p)
      end
    elseif targetSelection == "Killer" then
      for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local espData = ActiveESP and ActiveESP.Players and ActiveESP.Players[p]
        local isK = (espData and espData.IsKiller) or (p.Team and p.Team.Name == "Killer")
        if isK then
          table.insert(res, p)
        end
      end
    elseif targetSelection == "Survivors" then
      for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local espData = ActiveESP and ActiveESP.Players and ActiveESP.Players[p]
        local isS = (espData and espData.IsSurvivor) or (p.Team and p.Team.Name == "Survivors")
        if isS and p ~= localPlayer then
          table.insert(res, p)
        end
      end
    else
      for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if
          p.Name == targetSelection
          or p.DisplayName == targetSelection
          or tostring(p.UserId) == targetSelection
        then
          table.insert(res, p)
          break
        end
      end
    end
    return res
  end
  _G.VD_GetLobbyPlayerOptions = function()
    local opts = { "LocalPlayer (Self)", "All Players", "Killer", "Survivors" }
    local vals = { "LocalPlayer (Self)", "All Players", "Killer", "Survivors" }
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if p ~= localPlayer then
        local label = string.format("%s (@%s)", p.DisplayName or p.Name, p.Name)
        table.insert(opts, label)
        table.insert(vals, p.Name)
      end
    end
    return opts, vals
  end
  _G.VD_UpdateCustomParticles = function()
    pcall(function()
      local cfg = Settings.CustomParticles
      if not cfg or not cfg.Enabled then
        for _, plyr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
          if plyr.Character then
            for _, child in ipairs(plyr.Character:GetDescendants()) do
              if
                child.Name == "VD_CustomParticleEmitter"
                or child.Name == "VD_CustomParticleAttachment"
              then
                pcall(function()
                  child:Destroy()
                end)
              end
            end
          end
        end
        return
      end
      local targets = _G.VD_GetTargetPlayers(cfg.Target)
      local targetSet = {}
      for _, t in ipairs(targets) do
        targetSet[t] = true
      end
      for _, plyr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if not targetSet[plyr] and plyr.Character then
          for _, child in ipairs(plyr.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if
              child.Name == "VD_CustomParticleEmitter"
              or child.Name == "VD_CustomParticleAttachment"
            then
              pcall(function()
                child:Destroy()
              end)
            end
          end
        end
      end
      local preset = _G.VD_PARTICLE_PRESETS["Hellfire"]
      local col = cfg.Color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
      local rate = cfg.Rate or 25
      local sz = cfg.Size or 1.0
      for _, plyr in ipairs(targets) do
        local char = plyr.Character
        if char then
          local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
          if root then
            local att = root:FindFirstChild("VD_CustomParticleAttachment")
            if not att then
              att = Instance.new("Attachment")
              att.Name = "VD_CustomParticleAttachment"
              att.Parent = root
            end
            local emitter = att:FindFirstChild("VD_CustomParticleEmitter")
            if not emitter then
              emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
              emitter.Name = "VD_CustomParticleEmitter"
              emitter.Parent = att
            end
            emitter.Texture = preset.Texture
            emitter.Rate = rate
            emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new(sz * 0.5, sz)
            emitter.Lifetime = preset.Lifetime or NumberRange.new(1, 2)
            emitter.Speed = preset.Speed or NumberRange.new(2, 6)
            emitter.SpreadAngle = preset.SpreadAngle or Vector2.new(180, 180)
            emitter.Acceleration = preset.Acceleration or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            emitter.LightEmission = preset.LightEmission or 0.8
            emitter.LightInfluence = preset.LightInfluence or 0
            if preset.Rotation then
              emitter.Rotation = preset.Rotation
            end
            if preset.RotSpeed then
              emitter.RotSpeed = preset.RotSpeed
            end
            if preset.Transparency then
              emitter.Transparency = preset.Transparency
            else
              emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, 0.1),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
              })
            end
            if not cfg.Rainbow then
              emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(col)
            end
            emitter.Enabled = true
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end
  local function clearCharacterAppearance(char)
    for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
      if
        obj:IsA("Accessory")
        or obj:IsA("Shirt")
        or obj:IsA("Pants")
        or obj:IsA("ShirtGraphic")
        or obj:IsA("BodyColors")
        or obj:IsA("CharacterMesh")
      then
        pcall(function()
          obj:Destroy()
        end)
      elseif obj.Name == "Head" and obj:IsA("BasePart") then
        for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
          if child:IsA("Decal") and child.Name == "face" then
            pcall(function()
              child:Destroy()
            end)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function applyAppearanceFromInfo(info, char)
    if not char or not info then
      return
    end
    clearCharacterAppearance(char)
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if info.bodyColors then
      local bc = Instance.new("BodyColors")
      bc.HeadColor3 = Color3.fromHex(info.bodyColors.headColorHex or "f5cd92")
      bc.LeftArmColor3 = Color3.fromHex(info.bodyColors.leftArmColorHex or "f5cd92")
      bc.RightArmColor3 = Color3.fromHex(info.bodyColors.rightArmColorHex or "f5cd92")
      bc.LeftLegColor3 = Color3.fromHex(info.bodyColors.leftLegColorHex or "f5cd92")
      bc.RightLegColor3 = Color3.fromHex(info.bodyColors.rightLegColorHex or "f5cd92")
      bc.TorsoColor3 = Color3.fromHex(info.bodyColors.torsoColorHex or "f5cd92")
      bc.Parent = char
    end
    if info.assets then
      for _, asset in ipairs(info.assets) do
        local assetId = asset.id
        task.spawn(function()
          pcall(function()
            local objects = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId))
            for _, item in ipairs(objects) do
              if item:IsA("Accessory") then
                item.Parent = char
                local handle = item:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                if handle then
                  local att = handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
                  if att then
                    local targetAtt = nil
                    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                      if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        targetAtt = part:FindFirstChild(att.Name)
                        if targetAtt then
                          local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
                          weld.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
                          weld.Part0 = handle
                          weld.Part1 = part
                          weld.C0 = att.CFrame
                          weld.C1 = targetAtt.CFrame
                          weld.Parent = handle
                          break
                        end
                      end
                    end
                  elseif head then
                    local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
                    weld.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
                    weld.Part0 = handle
                    weld.Part1 = head
                    weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)
                    weld.Parent = handle
                  end
                  handle.CanCollide = false
                end
              elseif
                item:IsA("Shirt")
                or item:IsA("Pants")
                or item:IsA("ShirtGraphic")
                or item:IsA("BodyColors")
                or item:IsA("CharacterMesh")
              then
                item.Parent = char
              elseif item:IsA("Decal") and head then
                item.Name = "face"
                item.Parent = head
              elseif item:IsA("SpecialMesh") and head then
                local existingMesh = head:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
                if existingMesh then
                  existingMesh:Destroy()
                end
                item.Parent = head
              end
            end
          end)
        end)
      end
    end
  end
  local function applyAppearanceFromModel(appearanceModel, char)
    if not char or not appearanceModel then
      return
    end
    clearCharacterAppearance(char)
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    for _, item in ipairs(appearanceModel:GetChildren()) do
      if item:IsA("Accessory") then
        local clone = item:Clone()
        clone.Parent = char
        local handle = clone:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if handle then
          local att = handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
          if att then
            for _, part in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
              if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                local targetAtt = part:FindFirstChild(att.Name)
                if targetAtt then
                  local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
                  weld.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
                  weld.Part0 = handle
                  weld.Part1 = part
                  weld.C0 = att.CFrame
                  weld.C1 = targetAtt.CFrame
                  weld.Parent = handle
                  break
                end
              end
            end
          elseif head then
            local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
            weld.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
            weld.Part0 = handle
            weld.Part1 = head
            weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)
            weld.Parent = handle
          end
          handle.CanCollide = false
        end
      elseif
        item:IsA("Shirt")
        or item:IsA("Pants")
        or item:IsA("ShirtGraphic")
        or item:IsA("BodyColors")
        or item:IsA("CharacterMesh")
      then
        item:Clone().Parent = char
      elseif item:IsA("Decal") and head then
        local d = item:Clone()
        d.Name = "face"
        d.Parent = head
      end
    end
  end
  _G.VD_ApplySkinToTarget = function(targetSelection, sourceInput)
    local target = sourceInput
      or (Settings and Settings.PlayerCustomizer and Settings.PlayerCustomizer.SkinTarget)
      or (Settings and Settings.SkinChangerTarget)
    if not target or target == "" then
      pcall(function()
        showNotification("Skin Changer", "Please enter a valid Username or User ID!", "warning")
      end)
      return false
    end
    local targets = _G.VD_GetTargetPlayers(targetSelection)
    if #targets == 0 then
      showNotification("Skin Changer", "No target players found!", "warning")
      return false
    end
    task.spawn(function()
      local userId = resolveUserId(target)
      if not userId then
        showNotification("Skin Changer", "Utente non trovato: " .. tostring(target), "warning")
        return
      end
      local count = 0
      for _, plyr in ipairs(targets) do
        _G.VD_SpoofedSkins[plyr.UserId] = userId
        _G.VD_SpoofedSkins[plyr.Name] = userId
        local char = plyr.Character
        if char then
          local okModel, appModel = pcall(function()
            return Players:GetCharacterAppearanceAsync(userId)
          end)
          if okModel and appModel then
            applyAppearanceFromModel(appModel, char)
            pcall(function()
              appModel:Destroy()
            end)
            count = count + 1
          else
            local okInfo, appInfo = pcall(function()
              return Players:GetCharacterAppearanceInfoAsync(userId)
            end)
            if okInfo and appInfo then
              applyAppearanceFromInfo(appInfo, char)
              count = count + 1
            end
          end
        end
      end
      showNotification(
        "Skin Changer",
        string.format("Skin applied to %d player(s)! (ID: %s)", count, tostring(userId)),
        "success"
      )
    end)
    return true
  end
  _G.VD_ResetSkinForTarget = function(targetSelection)
    local targets = _G.VD_GetTargetPlayers(targetSelection)
    if #targets == 0 then
      return
    end
    task.spawn(function()
      local count = 0
      for _, plyr in ipairs(targets) do
        _G.VD_SpoofedSkins[plyr.UserId] = nil
        _G.VD_SpoofedSkins[plyr.Name] = nil
        local char = plyr.Character
        if char then
          local okModel, appModel = pcall(function()
            return Players:GetCharacterAppearanceAsync(plyr.UserId)
          end)
          if okModel and appModel then
            applyAppearanceFromModel(appModel, char)
            pcall(function()
              appModel:Destroy()
            end)
            count = count + 1
          else
            local okInfo, appInfo = pcall(function()
              return Players:GetCharacterAppearanceInfoAsync(plyr.UserId)
            end)
            if okInfo and appInfo then
              applyAppearanceFromInfo(appInfo, char)
              count = count + 1
            end
          end
        end
      end
      showNotification(
        "Skin Changer",
        string.format("Appearance restored for %d player(s)!", count),
        "info"
      )
    end)
  end
  _G.VD_UpdateSurvivorHUD = function()
    pcall(function()
      local pg = localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
      if not pg then
        return
      end
      local framesToScan = {}
      for _, guiName in ipairs({
        "Survivor",
        "Survivor-con",
        "Survivor-mob",
        "SurvivorGui",
        "SpectatorHUD",
        "SpectatorHUD-con",
        "SpectatorHUD-mob",
      }) do
        local gui = pg:FindFirstChild(guiName)
        if gui then
          local bLeft = gui:FindFirstChild("bottom left") or gui:FindFirstChild("BottomLeft")
          if bLeft then
            local fr = bLeft:FindFirstChild("Frame")
            if fr and not table.find(framesToScan, fr) then
              table.insert(framesToScan, fr)
            end
          end
          local fr2 = gui:FindFirstChild("Frame", true)
          if fr2 and (fr2:FindFirstChild("Survivor1") or fr2:FindFirstChild("Survivor2")) then
            if not table.find(framesToScan, fr2) then
              table.insert(framesToScan, fr2)
            end
          end
        end
      end
      for _, frame in ipairs(framesToScan) do
        for _, child in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
          if
            child:IsA("GuiObject")
            and (
              child.Name:sub(1, 8) == "Survivor"
              or child:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
              or child:FindFirstChildOfClass("ImageLabel")
              or child:FindFirstChildOfClass("ViewportFrame")
            )
          then
            local txtLabel = child:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
              or child:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
              or child:FindFirstChild("TextLabel", true)
              or child:FindFirstChild("Name", true)
              or child:FindFirstChild("PlayerName", true)
            local imgLabel = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("ImageLabel")
              or child:FindFirstChild("ImageLabel", true)
              or child:FindFirstChild("Avatar", true)
              or child:FindFirstChild("Icon", true)
            local vpFrame = child:FindFirstChild("ViewportFrame")
              or child:FindFirstChildOfClass("ViewportFrame")
              or child:FindFirstChild("ViewportFrame", true)
            local matchedPlayer = nil
            local currentText = txtLabel and txtLabel.Text or ""
            local origText = child:GetAttribute("VD_OrigName")
            for _, plyr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
              if
                (origText and (origText == plyr.Name or origText == plyr.DisplayName))
                or (
                  currentText ~= "" and (
                    currentText == plyr.Name or currentText == plyr.DisplayName
                  )
                )
              then
                matchedPlayer = plyr
                break
              end
            end
            if not matchedPlayer and vpFrame then
              local wm = vpFrame:FindFirstChild("WorldModel")
                or vpFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("WorldModel")
              if wm then
                for _, mChild in ipairs(wm:GetChildren()) do
                  if mChild:IsA("Model") then
                    local pFound = Players:FindFirstChild(mChild.Name)
                    if pFound then
                      matchedPlayer = pFound
                      break
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end
            if not matchedPlayer and imgLabel and imgLabel.Image then
              local uidMatch = imgLabel.Image:match("userId=(%d+)")
                or imgLabel.Image:match("id=(%d+)")
              if uidMatch then
                for _, plyr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                  if tostring(plyr.UserId) == uidMatch then
                    matchedPlayer = plyr
                    break
                  end
                end
              end
            end
            if not matchedPlayer and child.Name == "Survivor1" then
              matchedPlayer = localPlayer
            end
            local spoofedName = nil
            if matchedPlayer then
              spoofedName = _G.VD_SpoofedNames
                and (
                  _G.VD_SpoofedNames[matchedPlayer.UserId] or _G.VD_SpoofedNames[matchedPlayer.Name]
                )
            end
            if
              (not spoofedName or spoofedName == "")
              and (matchedPlayer == localPlayer or child.Name == "Survivor1")
            then
              if
                Settings
                and Settings.PlayerCustomizer
                and Settings.PlayerCustomizer.SpoofedName
                and Settings.PlayerCustomizer.SpoofedName ~= ""
              then
                spoofedName = Settings.PlayerCustomizer.SpoofedName
              end
            end
            if (not spoofedName or spoofedName == "") and Settings and Settings.StreamerMode then
              if matchedPlayer == localPlayer or child.Name == "Survivor1" then
                spoofedName = "Anonymous User"
              else
                local num = child.Name:match("%d+") or "X"
                spoofedName = "Survivor " .. num
              end
            end
            if txtLabel then
              if spoofedName and spoofedName ~= "" then
                if not child:GetAttribute("VD_OrigName") then
                  child:SetAttribute("VD_OrigName", txtLabel.Text)
                end
                if txtLabel.Text ~= spoofedName then
                  txtLabel.Text = spoofedName
                end
              else
                local savedOrig = child:GetAttribute("VD_OrigName")
                if savedOrig and savedOrig ~= "" then
                  txtLabel.Text = savedOrig
                  child:SetAttribute("VD_OrigName", nil)
                end
              end
            end
            local spoofedIcon = nil
            if matchedPlayer then
              spoofedIcon = _G.VD_SpoofedIcons
                and (
                  _G.VD_SpoofedIcons[matchedPlayer.UserId] or _G.VD_SpoofedIcons[matchedPlayer.Name]
                )
            end
            if
              (not spoofedIcon or spoofedIcon == "")
              and (matchedPlayer == localPlayer or child.Name == "Survivor1")
            then
              if
                Settings
                and Settings.PlayerCustomizer
                and Settings.PlayerCustomizer.SpoofedIcon
                and Settings.PlayerCustomizer.SpoofedIcon ~= ""
              then
                spoofedIcon = Settings.PlayerCustomizer.SpoofedIcon
              elseif Settings and Settings.StreamerMode then
                spoofedIcon = "rbxassetid://0"
              end
            end
            if spoofedIcon and spoofedIcon ~= "" then
              if tonumber(spoofedIcon) and not string.find(spoofedIcon, "://") then
                spoofedIcon = "rbxassetid://" .. spoofedIcon
              end
            end
            if spoofedIcon and spoofedIcon ~= "" then
              if imgLabel then
                if not child:GetAttribute("VD_OrigIcon") then
                  child:SetAttribute("VD_OrigIcon", imgLabel.Image)
                end
                if imgLabel.Image ~= spoofedIcon then
                  imgLabel.Image = spoofedIcon
                end
              end
              if vpFrame then
                local spoofImg = vpFrame:FindFirstChild("VD_SpoofIcon")
                if not spoofImg then
                  spoofImg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                  spoofImg.Name = "VD_SpoofIcon"
                  spoofImg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                  spoofImg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
                  spoofImg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                  spoofImg.ZIndex = 25
                  local corner = vpFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
                  if corner then
                    local cloneCorner = corner:Clone()
                    cloneCorner.Parent = spoofImg
                  end
                  spoofImg.Parent = vpFrame
                end
                if spoofImg.Image ~= spoofedIcon then
                  spoofImg.Image = spoofedIcon
                end
                spoofImg.Visible = true
              end
            else
              if imgLabel then
                local savedOrigIcon = child:GetAttribute("VD_OrigIcon")
                if savedOrigIcon and savedOrigIcon ~= "" then
                  imgLabel.Image = savedOrigIcon
                  child:SetAttribute("VD_OrigIcon", nil)
                end
              end
              if vpFrame then
                local spoofImg = vpFrame:FindFirstChild("VD_SpoofIcon")
                if spoofImg then
                  pcall(function()
                    spoofImg:Destroy()
                  end)
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end
  _G.VD_ApplyNameToTarget = function(targetSelection, newName)
    newName = newName
      or (Settings and Settings.PlayerCustomizer and Settings.PlayerCustomizer.SpoofedName)
      or ""
    if not newName or newName == "" then
      showNotification("Name Changer", "Please enter a valid name!", "warning")
      return false
    end
    local targets = _G.VD_GetTargetPlayers(targetSelection)
    if #targets == 0 then
      showNotification("Name Changer", "No target players found!", "warning")
      return false
    end
    for _, plyr in ipairs(targets) do
      _G.VD_SpoofedNames[plyr.UserId] = newName
      _G.VD_SpoofedNames[plyr.Name] = newName
      local char = plyr.Character
      if char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
          pcall(function()
            hum.DisplayName = newName
          end)
        end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if head then
          for _, desc in ipairs(head:GetDescendants()) do
            if
              desc:IsA("TextLabel") and (desc.Text == plyr.Name or desc.Text == plyr.DisplayName)
            then
              desc.Text = newName
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if _G.VD_UpdateSpectatorListOverlay then
      pcall(_G.VD_UpdateSpectatorListOverlay)
    end
    if _G.VD_UpdateInfoBanner then
      pcall(_G.VD_UpdateInfoBanner)
    end
    if _G.VD_UpdateSurvivorHUD then
      pcall(_G.VD_UpdateSurvivorHUD)
    end
    showNotification(
      "Name Changer",
      string.format("Name spoofed to '%s' for %d player(s)!", newName, #targets),
      "success"
    )
    return true
  end
  _G.VD_ResetNameForTarget = function(targetSelection)
    local targets = _G.VD_GetTargetPlayers(targetSelection)
    for _, plyr in ipairs(targets) do
      _G.VD_SpoofedNames[plyr.UserId] = nil
      _G.VD_SpoofedNames[plyr.Name] = nil
      local char = plyr.Character
      if char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
          pcall(function()
            hum.DisplayName = plyr.DisplayName
          end)
        end
      end
    end
    if _G.VD_UpdateSpectatorListOverlay then
      pcall(_G.VD_UpdateSpectatorListOverlay)
    end
    if _G.VD_UpdateInfoBanner then
      pcall(_G.VD_UpdateInfoBanner)
    end
    if _G.VD_UpdateSurvivorHUD then
      pcall(_G.VD_UpdateSurvivorHUD)
    end
    showNotification("Name Changer", "Names restored successfully!", "info")
  end
  _G.VD_ApplyIconToTarget = function(targetSelection, iconInput)
    iconInput = iconInput
      or (Settings and Settings.PlayerCustomizer and Settings.PlayerCustomizer.SpoofedIcon)
      or ""
    if not iconInput or iconInput == "" then
      showNotification(
        "Icon Changer",
        "Please enter a valid Username, User ID, or Asset ID!",
        "warning"
      )
      return false
    end
    local targets = _G.VD_GetTargetPlayers(targetSelection)
    if #targets == 0 then
      showNotification("Icon Changer", "No target players found!", "warning")
      return false
    end
    task.spawn(function()
      local resolvedIcon = iconInput
      local uid = resolveUserId(iconInput)
      if uid then
        resolvedIcon = string.format(
          "https://www.roblox.com/headshot-thumbnail/image?userId=%s&width=150&height=150&format=png",
          tostring(uid)
        )
      elseif not string.find(iconInput, "://") and tonumber(iconInput) then
        resolvedIcon = "rbxassetid://" .. iconInput
      end
      for _, plyr in ipairs(targets) do
        _G.VD_SpoofedIcons[plyr.UserId] = resolvedIcon
        _G.VD_SpoofedIcons[plyr.Name] = resolvedIcon
      end
      if _G.VD_UpdateSpectatorListOverlay then
        pcall(_G.VD_UpdateSpectatorListOverlay)
      end
      if _G.VD_UpdateInfoBanner then
        pcall(_G.VD_UpdateInfoBanner)
      end
      if _G.VD_UpdateSurvivorHUD then
        pcall(_G.VD_UpdateSurvivorHUD)
      end
      showNotification(
        "Icon Changer",
        string.format("Avatar icon spoofed for %d player(s)!", #targets),
        "success"
      )
    end)
    return true
  end
  _G.VD_ResetIconForTarget = function(targetSelection)
    local targets = _G.VD_GetTargetPlayers(targetSelection)
    for _, plyr in ipairs(targets) do
      _G.VD_SpoofedIcons[plyr.UserId] = nil
      _G.VD_SpoofedIcons[plyr.Name] = nil
    end
    if _G.VD_UpdateSpectatorListOverlay then
      pcall(_G.VD_UpdateSpectatorListOverlay)
    end
    if _G.VD_UpdateInfoBanner then
      pcall(_G.VD_UpdateInfoBanner)
    end
    if _G.VD_UpdateSurvivorHUD then
      pcall(_G.VD_UpdateSurvivorHUD)
    end
    showNotification("Icon Changer", "Avatar icons restored successfully!", "info")
  end
  _G.VD_ApplySkinChanger = function(targetInput)
    return _G.VD_ApplySkinToTarget("LocalPlayer (Self)", targetInput)
  end
  _G.VD_ResetSkinChanger = function()
    return _G.VD_ResetSkinForTarget("LocalPlayer (Self)")
  end
end
task.spawn(function()
  local function connectPlayerRespawn(plyr)
    plyr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
      if
        _G.VD_SpoofedSkins
        and _G.VD_SpoofedSkins[plyr.UserId]
        and Settings.SkinChangerAutoReapply ~= false
      then
        task.wait(0.6)
        pcall(function()
          local skinId = _G.VD_SpoofedSkins[plyr.UserId]
          if skinId and char and char.Parent then
            local okModel, appModel = pcall(function()
              return Players:GetCharacterAppearanceAsync(skinId)
            end)
            if okModel and appModel then
              applyAppearanceFromModel(appModel, char)
              pcall(function()
                appModel:Destroy()
              end)
            end
          end
        end)
      end
      if _G.VD_SpoofedNames and _G.VD_SpoofedNames[plyr.UserId] then
        task.wait(0.3)
        pcall(function()
          local newName = _G.VD_SpoofedNames[plyr.UserId]
          local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
          if hum then
            hum.DisplayName = newName
          end
        end)
      end
      if
        Settings.CustomParticles
        and Settings.CustomParticles.Enabled
        and _G.VD_UpdateCustomParticles
      then
        task.wait(0.5)
        pcall(_G.VD_UpdateCustomParticles)
      end
    end)
  end
  for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    connectPlayerRespawn(p)
  end
  Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(connectPlayerRespawn)
end)

  while activeLoop and task.wait(0.3) do
    if _G.VD_UpdateSurvivorHUD then

        shouldRun = true
      end
      if _G.VD_SpoofedIcons and next(_G.VD_SpoofedIcons) then
        shouldRun = true
      end

        shouldRun = true
      end
      if
        Settings
        and Settings.PlayerCustomizer
        and Settings.PlayerCustomizer.SpoofedName
        and Settings.PlayerCustomizer.SpoofedName ~= ""
      then
        shouldRun = true
      end
      if
        Settings
        and Settings.PlayerCustomizer
        and Settings.PlayerCustomizer.SpoofedIcon
        and Settings.PlayerCustomizer.SpoofedIcon ~= ""
      then
        shouldRun = true
      end
      if shouldRun then
        pcall(_G.VD_UpdateSurvivorHUD)
      end
    end
  end
end)
task.spawn(function()
  while activeLoop do
    if
      Settings.CustomParticles
      and Settings.CustomParticles.Enabled
      and Settings.CustomParticles.Rainbow
    then
      local rainbowCol = Color3.fromHSV((tick() % 4) / 4, 0.9, 1)
      for _, plyr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plyr.Character then
          local emitter = plyr.Character:FindFirstChild("VD_CustomParticleEmitter", true)
          if emitter then
            emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(rainbowCol)
          end
        end
      end
      task.wait(0.06)
    else
      task.wait(0.5)
    end
  end
end)
do
  local emoteMoveConnection = nil
  function stopCustomEmote()
    if emoteMoveConnection then
      pcall(function()
        emoteMoveConnection:Disconnect()
      end)
      emoteMoveConnection = nil
    end
    if currentEmoteTrack then
      pcall(function()
        currentEmoteTrack:Stop(0.2)
      end)
      currentEmoteTrack = nil
    end
    if currentEmoteSound then
      pcall(function()
        currentEmoteSound:Stop()
        currentEmoteSound:Destroy()
      end)
      currentEmoteSound = nil
    end
    pcall(function()
      local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
      local emoteHandler = remote and remote:FindFirstChild("EmoteHandler")
      if emoteHandler then
        emoteHandler:FireServer("StopEmote")
      end
    end)
  end
  function playCustomEmote(assetId, emoteName)
    stopCustomEmote()
    local char = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local animator = hum and (hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or hum)
    if not animator then
      showNotification("Animation Player", "Character Animator not found!", "error")
      return
    end
    local idStr = tostring(assetId):match("%d+") or tostring(assetId)
    local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
    anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. idStr
    local ok, track = pcall(function()
      return animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
    end)
    if not ok or not track then
      showNotification("Animation Player", "Failed to load emote: " .. tostring(emoteName), "error")
      return
    end
    currentEmoteTrack = track
    track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
    track:Play(0.2)
    pcall(function()
      local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
      local emoteHandler = remote and remote:FindFirstChild("EmoteHandler")
      if emoteHandler then
        emoteHandler:FireServer(emoteName)
      end
    end)
    showNotification("Animation Player", emoteName, "info")
    if not (Settings.WalkWhileEmoting == true) then
      emoteMoveConnection =
        registerConnection(hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MoveDirection"):Connect(function()
          if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 and currentEmoteTrack == track then
            stopCustomEmote()
          end
        end))
    end
    track.Stopped:Connect(function()
      if currentEmoteTrack == track then
        stopCustomEmote()
      end
    end)
  end
end

    local function createStatLabel(
      parent,
      labelName,
      attributeName,
      defaultVal,
      pos,
      size,
      iconAssetId
    )
      local iconOffset = 0
      if iconAssetId then
        iconOffset = 18
        local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        img.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
        img.Position =
          UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale, pos.X.Offset, pos.Y.Scale, pos.Y.Offset + (size.Y.Offset - 14) / 2)
        img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        img.Image = iconAssetId
        if iconAssetId == "rbxassetid://71824917786372" then
          img.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
        end
        img.ZIndex = 3
        img.Parent = parent
      end
      local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
      lbl.Size = size - UDim2.new(0, iconOffset, 0, 0)
      lbl.Position = pos + UDim2.new(0, iconOffset, 0, 0)
      lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      lbl.RichText = true
      lbl.TextColor3 = UI.TextSub
      lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
      lbl.TextSize = 12
      lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
      lbl.ZIndex = 2
      lbl.Parent = parent
      local attrConnection = nil
      local function update()
        if not currentSelectedPlayer or not currentSelectedPlayer.Parent then
          currentSelectedPlayer = localPlayer
        end
        local val = currentSelectedPlayer:GetAttribute(attributeName)
        if val == nil then
          val = currentSelectedPlayer:GetAttribute(attributeName:lower())
        end
        if val == nil then
          val = currentSelectedPlayer:GetAttribute(attributeName:gsub(" ", ""))
        end
        if val == nil then
          val = defaultVal
        end
        local suffix = ""
        if (attributeName:find("Chance") or labelName:find("Chance")) and type(val) == "number" then
          suffix = "%"
        end
        lbl.Text = labelName
          .. ": <font color='#ffffff'><b>"
          .. tostring(val)
          .. suffix
          .. "</b></font>"
      end
      local function bindToPlayer()
        if attrConnection then
          attrConnection:Disconnect()
          attrConnection = nil
        end
        update()
        if currentSelectedPlayer then
          attrConnection = currentSelectedPlayer.AttributeChanged:Connect(function(attr)
            if
              attr == attributeName
              or attr:lower() == attributeName:lower()
              or attr:gsub(" ", "") == attributeName:gsub(" ", "")
            then
              update()
            end
          end)
        end
      end
      bindToPlayer()
      table.insert(statUpdateFuncs, bindToPlayer)
    end
    createStatLabel(
      statsCard,
      "Level",
      "Level",
      "N/A",
      UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 44),
      UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 0, 20)
    )

      "rbxassetid://73812709713798"
    )
    local function getPlayerEquippedItem(player)
      if not player then
        return "None"
      end
      local item = player:GetAttribute("EquippedItem")
      if not item or item == "" or item == "None" then
        if player.Character then
          for _, child in ipairs(player.Character:GetChildren()) do
            if
              (child:IsA("Tool") or child:IsA("Model"))
              and child.Name ~= "Weapon"
              and child.Name ~= "Animate"
              and not child.Name:find("Arm")
              and not child.Name:find("Body")
            then
              item = child.Name
              break
            end
          end
        end
      end
      if not item or item == "" then
        return "None"
      end
      local skinKey = "EquippedSkin_" .. item:gsub(" ", "_")
      local skin = player:GetAttribute(skinKey)
      if not skin or skin == "Default" or skin == "" then
        local skinKey2 = "EquippedSkin_" .. item:gsub(" ", "")
        skin = player:GetAttribute(skinKey2)
      end
      if skin and skin ~= "Default" and skin ~= "" then
        return item .. " (" .. tostring(skin) .. ")"
      end
      return tostring(item)
    end
    local itemIcon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    itemIcon.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
    itemIcon.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 88 + (20 - 14) / 2)
    itemIcon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    itemIcon.Image = "rbxassetid://10734975692"
    itemIcon.ImageColor3 = UI.Accent
    itemIcon.ZIndex = 3
    itemIcon.Parent = statsCard
    local itemLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    itemLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.45, -18, 0, 20)
    itemLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 18, 0, 88)
    itemLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    itemLbl.RichText = true
    itemLbl.TextColor3 = UI.TextSub
    itemLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    itemLbl.TextSize = 12
    itemLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    itemLbl.ZIndex = 2
    itemLbl.Parent = statsCard
    local itemConn = nil
    local charConn = nil
    local charAddedConn = nil
    local function updateItem()
      local p = currentSelectedPlayer or localPlayer
      local itemStr = getPlayerEquippedItem(p)
      itemLbl.Text = "Item: <font color='#ffffff'><b>" .. itemStr .. "</b></font>"
    end
    local function bindItem()
      if itemConn then
        itemConn:Disconnect()
        itemConn = nil
      end
      if charConn then
        charConn:Disconnect()
        charConn = nil
      end
      if charAddedConn then
        charAddedConn:Disconnect()
        charAddedConn = nil
      end
      updateItem()
      local p = currentSelectedPlayer or localPlayer
      if p then
        itemConn = p.AttributeChanged:Connect(updateItem)
        if p.Character then
          charConn = p.Character.AttributeChanged:Connect(updateItem)
        end
        charAddedConn = p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
          if charConn then
            charConn:Disconnect()
            charConn = nil
          end
          task.delay(1, function()
            if char and char.Parent then
              charConn = char.AttributeChanged:Connect(updateItem)
              updateItem()
            end
          end)
        end)
      end
    end
    bindItem()
    table.insert(statUpdateFuncs, bindItem)
    createSection(tabHome, "Session & Lifetime Earnings", UI.Accent)

    local earnedStatsStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", earnedStatsCard)
    earnedStatsStroke.Color = UI.Stroke
    local function createStaticStatLabel(parent, labelName, defaultVal, pos, size, iconAssetId)
      local iconOffset = 0
      if iconAssetId then

      end
      local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")

      lbl.Position = pos + UDim2.new(0, iconOffset, 0, 0)
      lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      lbl.RichText = true
      lbl.TextColor3 = UI.TextSub
      lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
      lbl.TextSize = 12
      lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
      lbl.ZIndex = 2
      lbl.Parent = parent
      local function setValue(val)
        lbl.Text = labelName .. ": <font color='#ffffff'><b>" .. tostring(val) .. "</b></font>"
      end
      setValue(defaultVal)
      return setValue
    end

    pcall(updateEarnedUI)
    createSection(tabHome, "Community Links", UI.Accent)
    createButton(tabHome, "Join Discord Community", "Join", function()
      local invite = "pNjEEr34EG"
      local url = "https://discord.gg/" .. invite
      local rpcRequest = (syn and syn.request)
        or (http and http.request)
        or http_request
        or (fluxus and fluxus.request)
        or request
      local success = false
      if rpcRequest then
        pcall(function()
          rpcRequest({
            Url = "http://127.0.0.1:6463/rpc?v=1",
            Method = "POST",
            Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json", ["Origin"] = "https://discord.com" },
            Body = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({
              cmd = "INVITE_BROWSER",
              args = { code = invite },
              nonce = game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false),
            }),
          })
          success = true
        end)
      end
      if not success then
        local openfunc = openurl or (syn and syn.openurl) or (fluxus and fluxus.openurl)
        if openfunc then
          pcall(function()
            openfunc(url)
            success = true
          end)
        end
      end
      pcall(function()
        setclipboard(url)
      end)
      showNotification(
        success and "Discordrpc" or "Link Copied",
        success and "Opening invite in Discord App!" or "Discord link copied to clipboard!",
        "success"
      )
    end)
    createButton(tabHome, "Join Telegram Community", "Join", function()
      local tgUrl = "https://t.me/gethypnosis"
      local copySuccess = false
      if setclipboard then
        pcall(function()
          setclipboard(tgUrl)
          copySuccess = true
        end)
      elseif toclipboard then
        pcall(function()
          toclipboard(tgUrl)
          copySuccess = true
        end)
      end
      local openfunc = openurl or (syn and syn.openurl) or (fluxus and fluxus.openurl)
      if openfunc then
        pcall(openfunc, tgUrl)
      end
      showNotification("Telegram", "Link: t.me/gethypnosis copied to clipboard!", "success")
    end)
  end
end

initESPTab()
local function initFarmTab()
  _G.VD_FarmStatusLabel = nil
  _G.VD_SetFarmToggle = nil
  _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle = nil
  _G.VD_SetTotalAFKToggle = nil
  _G.VD_SetHopEscapeToggle = nil
  _G.VD_SetInstantEscapeToggle = nil
  _G.VD_DoCancelGen = nil
  do
    createSection(tabFarm, "Survivor Automations", UI.Accent)
    local farmToggleObj = createCollapsibleToggle(
      tabFarm,
      "Survivor Auto Farm",
      Settings.AutoFarmSurvivor,
      function(val)
        if val then
          if Settings.AutoFarmAFKTotal then
            Settings.AutoFarmAFKTotal = false
            if _G.VD_SetTotalAFKToggle then
              _G.VD_SetTotalAFKToggle(false)
            end
          end
          if Settings.InstantFinishlineEscape then
            Settings.InstantFinishlineEscape = false
            if _G.VD_SetInstantEscapeToggle then
              _G.VD_SetInstantEscapeToggle(false)
            end
          end
        end
        Settings.AutoFarmSurvivor = val
        if val then
          _G.VD_FarmState.farmTeamStartTime = tick()
          _G.VD_FarmState.farmLastTeamName = ""
          _G.VD_AbortPathfinding = false
          showNotification("Auto Farm Enabled", "Starting automatic generator repairs.", "success")
        else
          _G.VD_AbortPathfinding = true
          pcall(function()
            if not isMobile and VirtualInputManager then
              VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, false, game)
            end
          end)
          local char = localPlayer.Character
          local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
          if hum then
            pcall(function()
              hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
              hum.WalkSpeed = 16
            end)
          end
          if _G.VD_ExitSubSurfacePocket then
            pcall(_G.VD_ExitSubSurfacePocket)
          end
          showNotification("Auto Farm Disabled", "Stopped survivor autofarm immediately.", "info")
        end
        pcall(saveSettings)
      end,
      UI.Accent,
      "AutoFarmSurvivor"
    )
    _G.VD_SetFarmToggle = farmToggleObj.setValue
    _G.VD_SetFarmToggle = _G.VD_SetFarmToggle
    controlRegistry["AutoFarmSurvivor"] = farmToggleObj
    local unhookToggleObj = createToggle(

    triggerInstantEscape = function()
      local character = localPlayer.Character
      local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not rootPart then
        showNotification("Escape Failed", "Character root part not found!", "error")
        return false
      end
      if localHooksTable and type(localHooksTable.InstantEscape) == "function" then
        localHooksTable.InstantEscape(rootPart, showNotification)
        return true
      else
        local bestFinish = nil
        local minDist = math.huge
        for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
          if
            desc:IsA("BasePart")
            and (
              desc.Name == "Fininshline"
              or desc.Name == "Finishline"
              or desc.Name:lower():find("finishline")
              or desc.Name:lower():find("fininshline")
            )
          then
            local d = (desc.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
            if d < minDist then
              minDist = d
              bestFinish = desc
            end
          end
        end
        if bestFinish then
          if _G.VD_StopAllInteractions then
            pcall(_G.VD_StopAllInteractions)
            task.wait(0.15)
          end
          if Settings.AutoFarmPathfinding and _G.VD_SmartWalkTo then
            _G.VD_SmartWalkTo(bestFinish.Position, 3.0)
          else
            safeSegmentedTeleport(rootPart, bestFinish.CFrame)
          end
          showNotification("Instant Escape", "Teleported to escape line!", "success")
          return true
        else
          showNotification("Instant Escape", "Finish Line not found!", "error")
          return false
        end
      end
    end
    local instantEscapeToggleObj = createToggle(
      tabFarm,
      "Instant Finishline Escape",

        if val then

          end
          if _G.VD_CurrentFarmState and tostring(_G.VD_CurrentFarmState):find("PUMPKIN") then
            _G.VD_CurrentFarmState = "IDLE"
          end
          pcall(function()
            if not isMobile and VirtualInputManager then
              VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, false, game)
            end
          end)
          local char = localPlayer.Character
          local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
          if hum then
            pcall(function()
              hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
              hum.WalkSpeed = 16
            end)
          end
          showNotification("Auto Pumpkin Disabled", "Stopped pumpkin crushing automation.", "info")
        end
        pcall(saveSettings)
      end,
      UI.Accent,
      "AutoPumpkin"
    )
    _G.VD_SetAutoPumpkinToggle = autoPumpkinToggleObj.setValue
    controlRegistry["AutoPumpkin"] = autoPumpkinToggleObj
    local fleeToggleObj = createToggle(
      autoPumpkinToggleObj.content,
      "Flee Killer When Close",
      Settings.AutoPumpkinFleeKiller,
      function(val)
        Settings.AutoPumpkinFleeKiller = val

          if _G.VD_ExitSubSurfacePocket then
            pcall(_G.VD_ExitSubSurfacePocket)
          end
        end
        pcall(saveSettings)
      end,
      UI.Accent,
      "AutoPumpkinFleeKiller"
    )
    controlRegistry["AutoPumpkinFleeKiller"] = fleeToggleObj
    createSection(tabFarm, "Generator Automations", UI.Accent)
    local skillCheckGroup = createCollapsibleToggle(
      tabFarm,
      "Auto Skill Check",

      UI.Accent,
      "AutoSkillCheck"
    )
    controlRegistry["AutoSkillCheck"] = { setValue = skillCheckGroup.setValue }
    controlRegistry["InstantSkillCheck"] = createToggle(
      skillCheckGroup.content,
      "Instant Skill Check",
      Settings.InstantSkillCheck,
      function(val)
        Settings.InstantSkillCheck = val
        pcall(saveSettings)
      end,
      UI.Accent,
      "InstantSkillCheck"
    )
    controlRegistry["SkillCheckMode"] = createSelector(
      skillCheckGroup.content,

      { "Perfect", "Normal", "Hybrid" },

initFarmTab()
local function initSelfTab()
  do
    createSection(tabSelf, "Speed Customizations", UI.Accent)
    controlRegistry["ModifierTeamFilter"] = createSelector(
      tabSelf,
      "Modifiers Active For",
      { "Both Teams", "Survivors Only", "Killer Only" },
      { "Both", "Survivors", "Killer" },
      Settings.ModifierTeamFilter or "Both",
      function(val)
        Settings.ModifierTeamFilter = val
        pcall(applyLocalPlayerModifiers)
        pcall(saveSettings)
      end
    )
    controlRegistry["VaultSpeed"] = createSlider(
      tabSelf,
      "Vault Speed Factor",
      1.0,
      2.30,
      math.clamp(Settings.VaultSpeed or 1.0, 1.0, 2.30),
      function(val)
        Settings.VaultSpeed = val
        pcall(applyLocalPlayerModifiers)
        pcall(saveSettings)
      end,
      UI.AccentCyan,
      0.01,
      "x"
    )
    local speedBoostGroup = createCollapsibleToggle(
      tabSelf,
      "Speed Boost Enabled",
      Settings.SpeedBoostEnabled,
      function(val)
        if val then
          local team = localPlayer.Team
          local teamName = team and team.Name
          local filter = Settings.ModifierTeamFilter or "Both"
          local isAllowed = false
          if filter == "Both" then
            isAllowed = teamName == "Survivors" or teamName == "Killer"
          elseif filter == "Survivors" then
            isAllowed = teamName == "Survivors"
          elseif filter == "Killer" then
            isAllowed = teamName == "Killer"
          end
          if not isAllowed then
            Settings.SpeedBoostEnabled = false
            pcall(saveSettings)
            if updateUIFromSettings then
              pcall(updateUIFromSettings)
            end
            showNotification("Speed Boost", "Speed Boost team filter active!", "warning")
            return
          end
        end
        Settings.SpeedBoostEnabled = val
        pcall(applyLocalPlayerModifiers)
        pcall(saveSettings)
      end,
      nil,
      "ToggleSpeedBoost"
    )
    controlRegistry["SpeedBoostEnabled"] = { setValue = speedBoostGroup.setValue }
    controlRegistry["SpeedBoost"] = createSliderFloat(
      speedBoostGroup.content,
      "Speed Boost Multiplier",
      1.0,
      6.0,
      Settings.SpeedBoost,
      function(val)
        Settings.SpeedBoost = val
        pcall(applyLocalPlayerModifiers)
        pcall(saveSettings)
      end
    )
    controlRegistry["CountSpeedPerks"] = createToggle(
      speedBoostGroup.content,
      "Count Speed Perks / Slow Downs",
      Settings.CountSpeedPerks,
      function(val)
        Settings.CountSpeedPerks = val
        pcall(applyLocalPlayerModifiers)
        pcall(saveSettings)
      end,
      nil
    )
    controlRegistry["AntiRubberbandSpeed"] = createToggle(
      speedBoostGroup.content,
      "Anti-Rubberband (Safe Speed)",
      Settings.AntiRubberbandSpeed ~= false,
      function(val)
        Settings.AntiRubberbandSpeed = val
        pcall(applyLocalPlayerModifiers)
        pcall(saveSettings)
      end,
      nil
    )
    local customSpeedGroup = createCollapsibleToggle(
      speedBoostGroup.content,
      "Custom Speed Keybinds",
      Settings.CustomSpeedKeybindsEnabled,
      function(val)
        if val and not isPremiumActive("CustomSpeedKeybinds") then
          showNotification(
            "Premium Feature +",
            "Unlock the Premium version to use Custom Speed Keybinds!",
            "warning"
          )
          return
        end
        Settings.CustomSpeedKeybindsEnabled = val
        pcall(saveSettings)
      end,
      UI.AccentCyan,
      "CustomSpeedKeybinds"
    )
    controlRegistry["CustomSpeedKeybindsEnabled"] = { setValue = customSpeedGroup.setValue }
    local function triggerCustomSpeedSlot(slotIdx)
      if not isPremiumActive("CustomSpeedKeybinds") then
        showNotification(
          "Premium Feature +",
          "Unlock the Premium version to use Custom Speed Keybinds!",
          "warning"
        )
        return
      end
      if not Settings.CustomSpeedKeybindsEnabled then
        showNotification("Custom Speed", "Enable 'Custom Speed Keybinds' toggle first!", "warning")
        return
      end
      if localHooksTable and type(localHooksTable.ApplyCustomSpeedKeybind) == "function" then
        localHooksTable.ApplyCustomSpeedKeybind(
          slotIdx,
          Settings,
          controlRegistry,
          applyLocalPlayerModifiers,
          showNotification
        )
      else
        showNotification(
          "Premium Feature +",
          "Unlock the Premium version to use this feature!",
          "warning"
        )
      end
    end
    local function createCustomSpeedRow(parent, slotIdx, defaultSpeed, keybindName)
      local settingKey = "CustomSpeed" .. tostring(slotIdx)
      local rowContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
      rowContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 56)
      rowContainer.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
      rowContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
      rowContainer.BorderSizePixel = 0
      rowContainer.Parent = parent
      Instance.new("UICorner", rowContainer).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
      local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", rowContainer)
      stroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
      stroke.Thickness = 0.9
      local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
      titleLabel.RichText = true
      titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 18)
      titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 4)
      titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      titleLabel.Text = "Custom Speed Slot " .. tostring(slotIdx) .. " +"
      titleLabel.TextColor3 = UI.Text
      titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
      titleLabel.TextSize = 12
      titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
      titleLabel.Parent = rowContainer
      table.insert(
        registeredPremiumLabels,
        { labelObj = titleLabel, originalText = "Custom Speed Slot " .. tostring(slotIdx), isPrem = true }
      )
      local keybindBtn = createKeybindButton(rowContainer, keybindName, function()
        triggerCustomSpeedSlot(slotIdx)
      end)
      keybindBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 13)
      local currentVal = Settings[settingKey] or defaultSpeed
      local sliderControl = createSliderFloat(
        rowContainer,
        "Multiplier",
        1.0,
        3.0,
        currentVal,
        function(val)
          Settings[settingKey] = val
          pcall(saveSettings)
        end,
        nil,
        0.01
      )
      if sliderControl and sliderControl.container then
        sliderControl.container.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 28)
        sliderControl.container.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 24)
        sliderControl.container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        local cStroke = sliderControl.container:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        if cStroke then
          cStroke.Transparency = 1
        end
      end
      controlRegistry[settingKey] = sliderControl
    end
    createCustomSpeedRow(customSpeedGroup.content, 1, 1.02, "CustomSpeedKey1")
    createCustomSpeedRow(customSpeedGroup.content, 2, 1.15, "CustomSpeedKey2")
    createCustomSpeedRow(customSpeedGroup.content, 3, 1.35, "CustomSpeedKey3")
    createSection(tabSelf, "Character Perks")
    local function createListDropdown(parent, labelText, options, defaultVal, callback)
      local container = Instance.new("Frame")
      container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
      container.BackgroundTransparency = 1

      headerCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
      local headerStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", header)
      headerStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
      headerStroke.Thickness = 0.8
      local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
      label.RichText = true
      label.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
      label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
      label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      label.Text = labelText
      label.TextColor3 = UI.Text
      label.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
      label.TextSize = 13
      label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
      label.Parent = header
      local valLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
      valLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -20, 1, 0)
      valLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
      valLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      valLabel.Text = defaultVal or "None"
      valLabel.TextColor3 = UI.Text
      valLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
      valLabel.TextSize = 12
      valLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
      valLabel.Parent = header
      local arrowLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
      arrowLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
      arrowLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0.5, 0)
      arrowLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
      arrowLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      arrowLabel.Text = "▼"
      arrowLabel.TextColor3 = UI.TextSub
      arrowLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
      arrowLabel.TextSize = 9
      arrowLabel.Parent = header
      local listFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
      listFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
      listFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 34)
      listFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      listFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
      listFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
      listFrame.Parent = container
      local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
      scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 150)
      scroll.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
      scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
      scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
      scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4
      scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = UI.Accent
      scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
      scroll.Parent = listFrame
      local scrollCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", scroll)
      scrollCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
      local scrollStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", scroll)
      scrollStroke.Color = UI.Stroke
      scrollStroke.Thickness = 0.8
      local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
      listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
      listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
      listLayout.Parent = scroll
      local listPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
      listPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6)
      listPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
      listPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6)
      listPadding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6)
      listPadding.Parent = scroll
      local isOpen = false
      local currentValue = defaultVal
      local function toggle(state)
        if state == nil then
          isOpen = not isOpen
        else
          isOpen = state
        end
        arrowLabel.Text = isOpen and "▲" or "▼"
        arrowLabel.TextColor3 = isOpen and UI.Text or UI.TextSub
        headerStroke.Color = isOpen and UI.Stroke or UI.StrokeDim
        listFrame.Size = isOpen and UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 154) or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
        container.Size = isOpen and UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32 + 154 + 4) or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
      end
      header.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        toggle()
      end)
      local buttons = {}
      local function rebuildOptions(newOptions)
        for _, btn in ipairs(buttons) do
          btn:Destroy()
        end
        buttons = {}
        for i, opt in ipairs(newOptions) do
          local optBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
          optBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
          optBtn.BackgroundColor3 = opt == currentValue and UI.Accent or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
          optBtn.BackgroundTransparency = opt == currentValue and 0.5 or 0.95
          optBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
          optBtn.Text = opt
          optBtn.TextColor3 = opt == currentValue and UI.Text or UI.TextSub
          optBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
          optBtn.TextSize = 12
          optBtn.AutoButtonColor = true
          optBtn.LayoutOrder = i
          optBtn.Parent = scroll
          Instance.new("UICorner", optBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
          optBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            currentValue = opt
            valLabel.Text = opt
            toggle(false)
            for _, b in ipairs(buttons) do
              local isSel = (b.Text == currentValue)
              b.BackgroundColor3 = isSel and UI.Accent or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
              b.BackgroundTransparency = isSel and 0.5 or 0.95
              b.TextColor3 = isSel and UI.Text or UI.TextSub
            end
            if callback then
              pcall(callback, opt)
            end
          end)
          table.insert(buttons, optBtn)
        end
        scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, listLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 12)
      end
      rebuildOptions(options)
      listLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
        scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, listLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 12)
      end)
      return {
        setValue = function(val)
          currentValue = val
          valLabel.Text = val
          for _, b in ipairs(buttons) do
            local isSel = (b.Text == currentValue)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = isSel and UI.Accent or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            b.BackgroundTransparency = isSel and 0.5 or 0.95
            b.TextColor3 = isSel and UI.Text or UI.TextSub
          end
        end,
        updateOptions = function(newOpts, _, defaultVal)
          currentValue = defaultVal
          valLabel.Text = defaultVal
          rebuildOptions(newOpts)
        end,
        container = container,
      }
    end
    local function getAvailablePerks()
      local list = {}
      pcall(function()
        local spec = localPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("Spectator")
        local inv = spec and spec:FindFirstChild("Inventory", true)
        local browse = inv and inv:FindFirstChild("Browse_items", true)
        local loadout = browse and browse:FindFirstChild("loadout", true)
        local perksFolder = loadout and loadout:FindFirstChild("Perks", true)
        if perksFolder then
          for _, child in ipairs(perksFolder:GetChildren()) do
            if
              child:IsA("GuiObject")
              and child.Name ~= "UIListLayout"
              and child.Name ~= "UIGridLayout"
            then
              table.insert(list, child.Name)
            end
          end
        end
      end)
      if #list == 0 then
        list = {
          "Group Project",
          "No Pain No Gain",
          "On Screen Fear",
          "Flowstate",
          "Adrenaline",
          "Sprint Burst",
          "Self Care",
          "Decisive Strike",
          "Dead Hard",
          "Iron Will",
          "Resilience",
          "Prove Thyself",
          "Kindred",
          "Spine Chill",
          "Urban Evasion",
          "Borrowed Time",
          "We're Gonna Live Forever",
          "Blast Mine",
          "Flashbang",
        }
      end
      table.sort(list)
      return list
    end
    local function loadPerkLoadout(loadoutData)
      if not loadoutData then
        return
      end
      local unequipEvent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
      unequipEvent = unequipEvent and unequipEvent:FindFirstChild("Shop")
      unequipEvent = unequipEvent and unequipEvent:FindFirstChild("UnequipPerk")
      local equipEvent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
      equipEvent = equipEvent and equipEvent:FindFirstChild("Shop")
      equipEvent = equipEvent and equipEvent:FindFirstChild("EquipPerk")
      if not unequipEvent or not equipEvent then
        showNotification(
          "Perk Loadouts",
          "Shop remotes not found! Make sure you are in game.",
          "error"
        )
        return
      end
      pcall(function()
        unequipEvent:FireServer(3)
        task.wait(0.05)
        unequipEvent:FireServer(2)
        task.wait(0.05)
        unequipEvent:FireServer(1)
        task.wait(0.05)
        if loadoutData.Perk3 and loadoutData.Perk3 ~= "None" and loadoutData.Perk3 ~= "" then
          equipEvent:FireServer(loadoutData.Perk3, 3)
          task.wait(0.05)
        end
        if loadoutData.Perk2 and loadoutData.Perk2 ~= "None" and loadoutData.Perk2 ~= "" then
          equipEvent:FireServer(loadoutData.Perk2, 2)
          task.wait(0.05)
        end
        if loadoutData.Perk1 and loadoutData.Perk1 ~= "None" and loadoutData.Perk1 ~= "" then
          equipEvent:FireServer(loadoutData.Perk1, 1)
          task.wait(0.05)
        end
        showNotification("Perk Loadouts", "Loadout applied successfully!", "success")
      end)
    end

    local function doSelfHeal()

          if showNotification then
            showNotification("Heal", "HumanoidRootPart not found!", "warning")

          return

          showNotification("Heal", "Heal event sent!", "success")

    end

    local isAutoUnhookActive = false
    local originalHookCF = nil
    local function doAutoUnhook()
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      local hrp = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
      local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
        showNotification("Auto Unhook", "Character not found or dead!", "error")
        return
      end
      if isAutoUnhookActive then
        isAutoUnhookActive = false
        if originalHookCF and hrp and hrp.Parent then
          hrp.CFrame = originalHookCF
          hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        end
        showNotification("Auto Unhook", "Auto Unhook cancelled! Returned to hook.", "warning")
        return
      end
      originalHookCF = hrp.CFrame
      isAutoUnhookActive = true
      showNotification("Auto Unhook", "Starting Auto Unhook sequence...", "info")
      task.spawn(function()
        local success, err = pcall(function()
          local chosenGen = nil
          local gens = {}
          for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if desc:IsA("Model") and (desc.Name == "Generator" or desc.Name:find("Generator")) then
              table.insert(gens, desc)
            end
          end
          for _, g in ipairs(gens) do
            local p = g:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
              or g:FindFirstChild("Engine")
              or g:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if p then
              chosenGen = g
              break
            end
          end
          local replicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
          local remotes = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
          local genFolder = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Generator")
          local repairEvent = (genFolder and genFolder:FindFirstChild("RepairEvent"))
            or replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("RepairEvent", true)
          if chosenGen then
            local gPart = chosenGen:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
              or chosenGen:FindFirstChild("Engine")
              or chosenGen:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if gPart then
              hrp.CFrame = gPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
              hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
              task.wait(0.2)
            end
            local repPoint = nil
            for _, child in ipairs(chosenGen:GetChildren()) do
              if child.Name:lower():find("point") then
                repPoint = child
                break
              end
            end
            if repairEvent and repPoint then
              local httpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
              local guid = "FEB67C57-1E59-4609-B765-6304242AC088"
              pcall(function()
                guid = httpService:GenerateGUID(false)
              end)
              local myChar = localPlayer.Character
              pcall(function()
                repairEvent:FireServer(repPoint, true, nil, guid, myChar)
              end)
              task.wait(0.25)
              pcall(function()
                repairEvent:FireServer(repPoint, false, nil, guid, myChar)
              end)
              task.wait(0.2)
            end
          end
          local function getAnticampCharge()
            local c = localPlayer.Character
            local val = nil
            if c then
              val = c:GetAttribute("anticampCharge")
                or c:GetAttribute("AntiCampCharge")
                or c:GetAttribute("AnticampCharge")
                or c:GetAttribute("antiCampCharge")
            end
            if val == nil then
              val = localPlayer:GetAttribute("anticampCharge")
                or localPlayer:GetAttribute("AntiCampCharge")
                or localPlayer:GetAttribute("AnticampCharge")
                or localPlayer:GetAttribute("antiCampCharge")
            end
            if val == nil and c then
              local obj = c:FindFirstChild("anticampCharge", true)
                or c:FindFirstChild("AntiCampCharge", true)
              if obj and obj:IsA("ValueObject") then
                val = obj.Value
              end
            end
            return tonumber(val) or 0
          end
          local startTime = tick()
          local timeout = 60
          local lastNotifyCharge = -1
          while isAutoUnhookActive and (tick() - startTime) < timeout do
            local currentCharge = getAnticampCharge()
            if currentCharge >= 100 then
              break
            end
            local roundedCharge = math.floor(currentCharge)
            if
              roundedCharge % 25 == 0
              and roundedCharge ~= lastNotifyCharge
              and roundedCharge > 0
            then
              lastNotifyCharge = roundedCharge
              showNotification(
                "Auto Unhook",
                string.format("Charging Anti-Camp: %d%%", roundedCharge),
                "info"
              )
            end
            local kRoot = nil
            if getActiveKillerCharacters then
              local killers = getActiveKillerCharacters()
              if killers and #killers > 0 then
                for _, k in ipairs(killers) do
                  local r = k and (
                      k:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or k:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                    )
                  if r then
                    kRoot = r
                    break
                  end
                end
              end
            end
            if not kRoot then
              for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if pl ~= localPlayer and pl.Character then
                  local pChar = pl.Character
                  local isK = pl:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer"
                    or pl:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true
                    or pChar:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer"
                    or pChar:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true
                  if not isK and pl.Team then
                    local tn = pl.Team.Name:lower()
                    if tn:find("killer") or tn:find("slasher") or tn:find("monster") then
                      isK = true
                    end
                  end
                  if isK then
                    kRoot = pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                      or pChar:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                      or pChar:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                    if kRoot then
                      break
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end
            if kRoot and hrp and hrp.Parent then
              hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(kRoot.Position - Vector3.new(0, 16, 0))
              hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            end
            task.wait(0.06)
          end
          if hrp and hrp.Parent and originalHookCF then
            hrp.CFrame = originalHookCF
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            task.wait(0.2)
          end
          local unhookEvent = nil
          pcall(function()
            local carryFolder = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Carry")
            unhookEvent = carryFolder and carryFolder:FindFirstChild("SelfUnHookEvent")
            if not unhookEvent then
              unhookEvent = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("SelfUnHookEvent", true)
            end
          end)
          if unhookEvent then
            unhookEvent:FireServer()
            showNotification("Auto Unhook", "Self-Unhook event executed successfully!", "success")
          else
            showNotification("Auto Unhook", "SelfUnHookEvent not found in Remotes!", "error")
          end
        end)
        isAutoUnhookActive = false
        if not success then
          showNotification("Auto Unhook", "Error: " .. tostring(err), "error")
        end
      end)
    end
    _G.doAutoUnhook = doAutoUnhook

      if doAutoUnhook then
        pcall(doAutoUnhook)
      end
    end, UI.Accent, "AutoSelfUnhook")
