    local function getTargetPallet()
      local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
      if not camera then
        return nil
      end
      local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
      raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
      local validPallets = {}
      for _, p in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
        if p and p.Parent then
          table.insert(validPallets, p)
        end
      end
      raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = validPallets
      local startPos = camera.CFrame.Position
      local direction = camera.CFrame.LookVector * 500
      local result = workspace:Raycast(startPos, direction, raycastParams)
      if result and result.Instance then
        local hitPart = result.Instance
        local current = hitPart
        while current and current ~= workspace do
          if table.find(cachedPallets, current) then
            return current
          end
          current = current.Parent
        end
      end
      return nil
    end
    local function updateTargetPalletHighlight()
      if not Settings.RemoteDropPallet then
        if targetHighlight then
          pcall(function()
            targetHighlight:Destroy()
          end)
          targetHighlight = nil
        end
        return
      end
      local target = getTargetPallet()
      if target then
        local highlightCol = Settings.RemoteDropPalletColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)
        if not targetHighlight or targetHighlight.Parent == nil then
          pcall(function()
            if targetHighlight then
              targetHighlight:Destroy()
            end
          end)
          targetHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
          targetHighlight.Name = "VD_PalletTargetHighlight"
          targetHighlight.FillColor = highlightCol
          targetHighlight.FillTransparency = 0.6
          targetHighlight.OutlineColor = highlightCol
          targetHighlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
        else
          targetHighlight.FillColor = highlightCol
          targetHighlight.OutlineColor = highlightCol
        end
        if targetHighlight.Adornee ~= target then
          targetHighlight.Adornee = target
          targetHighlight.Parent = target
        end
      else
        if targetHighlight then
          targetHighlight.Adornee = nil
          targetHighlight.Parent = nil
        end
      end
    end
    local function doRemoteDropPallet()
      if not Settings.RemoteDropPallet then
        return
      end
      local target = getTargetPallet()
      if not target then
        showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "No pallet targeted!", "warning")
        return
      end
      local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
      local palletFolder = remote and remote:FindFirstChild("Pallet")
      local dropEvent = palletFolder and palletFolder:FindFirstChild("PalletDropEvent")
      if not dropEvent then
        showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "PalletDropEvent remote not found!", "error")
        return
      end
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not root then
        showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "Character root not found!", "error")
        return
      end
      local intact = target:FindFirstChild("Intact")
      if not intact then
        showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "Pallet already dropped or broken!", "warning")
        return
      end
      local intactChildren = intact:GetChildren()
      local targetPart = (
        intactChildren[8]
        and intactChildren[8]:IsA("BasePart")
        and intactChildren[8]
      )
        or intact:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        or (intactChildren[1] and intactChildren[1]:IsA("BasePart") and intactChildren[1])
        or target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        or (target:IsA("Model") and target.PrimaryPart)
      if not targetPart then
        showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "No valid pallet part found!", "error")
        return
      end
      local pos = targetPart.Position
      local dist = (root.Position - pos).Magnitude
      local guid = game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false)
      local droppedThis = false
      if dist <= 14 then
        pcall(function()
          _G.VD_LastRemoteDropTime = tick()
          dropEvent:FireServer(targetPart, pos, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), guid, char)
          droppedThis = true
        end)
      else
        local origCF = root.CFrame
        local approachPos = pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
        safeSegmentedTeleport(root, approachPos)
        task.wait(0.05)
        pcall(function()
          _G.VD_LastRemoteDropTime = tick()
          dropEvent:FireServer(targetPart, pos, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), guid, char)
          droppedThis = true
        end)
        task.wait(0.08)
        safeSegmentedTeleport(root, origCF)
      end
      if droppedThis then
        showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "Pallet dropped remotely!", "success")
      else
        showNotification(
          "Remote Drop Pallet",
          "Failed to drop pallet (already dropped?)",
          "warning"
        )
      end
    end
    task.spawn(function()
      while activeLoop do
        if Settings.RemoteDropPallet then
          pcall(updateTargetPalletHighlight)
          task.wait(0.05)
        else
          if targetHighlight then
            pcall(function()
              targetHighlight:Destroy()
            end)
            targetHighlight = nil
          end
          task.wait(0.5)
        end
      end
    end)
    local function doDropAllPallets()
      local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
      local palletFolder = remote and remote:FindFirstChild("Pallet")
      local dropEvent = palletFolder and palletFolder:FindFirstChild("PalletDropEvent")
      if not dropEvent then
        showNotification("Drop Pallets", "PalletDropEvent remote not found!", "error")
        return
      end
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not root then
        showNotification("Drop Pallets", "Character root not found!", "error")
        return
      end
      local count = 0
      local mapFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
      local res = mapFolder and mapFolder:FindFirstChild("resources")
      local palletsFolder = res and res:FindFirstChild("Pallets")
      local palletList = {}
      if palletsFolder then
        for _, p in ipairs(palletsFolder:GetChildren()) do
          table.insert(palletList, p)
        end
      end
      for _, p in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
        if not table.find(palletList, p) then
          table.insert(palletList, p)
        end
      end
      local http = game:GetService("HttpService")
      local origCF = root.CFrame
      task.spawn(function()
        for _, pallet in ipairs(palletList) do
          if pallet and pallet.Parent then
            local intact = pallet:FindFirstChild("Intact")
            if intact then
              local intactChildren = intact:GetChildren()
              local targetPart = (
                intactChildren[8]
                and intactChildren[8]:IsA("BasePart")
                and intactChildren[8]
              )
                or intact:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                or (intactChildren[1] and intactChildren[1]:IsA("BasePart") and intactChildren[1])
                or pallet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                or (pallet:IsA("Model") and pallet.PrimaryPart)
              if targetPart then
                local pos = targetPart.Position
                local dist = (root.Position - pos).Magnitude
                if dist > 14 then
                  safeSegmentedTeleport(root, pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
                  task.wait(0.04)
                end
                local guid = http:GenerateGUID(false)
                pcall(function()
                  _G.VD_LastRemoteDropTime = tick()
                  dropEvent:FireServer(targetPart, pos, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), guid, char)
                  count = count + 1
                end)
                task.wait(0.06)
              end
            end
          end
        end
        if root and root.Parent then
          safeSegmentedTeleport(root, origCF)
        end
        if count > 0 then
          showNotification(
            "Drop Pallets",
            "Dropped " .. count .. " pallets successfully!",
            "success"
          )
        else
          showNotification("Drop Pallets", "No intact pallets found to drop!", "warning")
        end
      end)
    end
    createButton(
      tabSelf,
      "Drop All Pallets",
      "Drop",
      doDropAllPallets,
      UI.AccentCyan,
      "DropAllPallets"
    )
    local remotePalletGroup = createCollapsibleToggle(

    createButton(

    controlRegistry["RemoteDropPalletColor"] = createCompactColorPicker(

      function(col)
        Settings.RemoteDropPalletColor = col
        if targetHighlight and targetHighlight.Parent then

          targetHighlight.OutlineColor = col

        pcall(saveSettings)
      end
    )
    do
      local isBlockingNearestPallet = false
      local isBlockingNearestVault = false
      local blockSpamLoopRunning = false
      local function getAllVaultTriggers()
        local triggers = {}
        local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") or workspace
        for _, desc in ipairs(map:GetDescendants()) do
          if
            (desc.Name == "VaultTrigger" or desc.Name == "VaultPoint") and desc:IsA("BasePart")
          then
            table.insert(triggers, desc)
          end
        end
        for _, vault in ipairs(cachedVaults) do
          if vault and vault.Parent then
            for _, c in ipairs(vault:GetDescendants()) do
              if
                (c.Name == "VaultTrigger" or c.Name == "VaultPoint")
                and c:IsA("BasePart")
                and not table.find(triggers, c)
              then
                table.insert(triggers, c)
              end
            end
          end
        end
        return triggers
      end
      local function getAllPalletSlidePoints()
        local points = {}
        for _, pallet in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
          if pallet and pallet.Parent then
            for _, child in ipairs(pallet:GetDescendants()) do
              if child.Name == "PalletPointSlide" or child.Name:find("Slide") then
                table.insert(points, child)
              end
            end
          end
        end
        local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") or workspace
        local res = map:FindFirstChild("resources")
        local palletsFolder = res and res:FindFirstChild("Pallets")
        if palletsFolder then
          for _, pallet in ipairs(palletsFolder:GetChildren()) do
            for _, child in ipairs(pallet:GetDescendants()) do
              if
                (child.Name == "PalletPointSlide" or child.Name:find("Slide"))
                and not table.find(points, child)
              then
                table.insert(points, child)
              end
            end
          end
        end
        if getnilinstances then
          pcall(function()
            for _, obj in ipairs(getnilinstances()) do
              if
                obj
                and (obj.Name == "PalletPointSlide" or obj.Name:find("PalletPointSlide"))
                and not table.find(points, obj)
              then
                table.insert(points, obj)
              end
            end
          end)
        end
        return points
      end
      local function getNearestVaultTrigger(pos)
        local triggers = getAllVaultTriggers()
        local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
        for _, vt in ipairs(triggers) do
          if vt and vt.Parent then
            local d = (pos - vt.Position).Magnitude
            if d < bestDist then
              bestDist = d
              best = vt
            end
          end
        end
        return best, bestDist
      end
      local function getNearestPalletSlidePoint(pos)
        local points = getAllPalletSlidePoints()
        local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
        for _, pt in ipairs(points) do
          if pt and pt.Parent then
            local pPos = (pt:IsA("BasePart") and pt.Position)
              or (pt.Parent and pt.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and pt.Parent.Position)
            if pPos then
              local d = (pos - pPos).Magnitude
              if d < bestDist then
                bestDist = d
                best = pt
              end
            end
          end
        end
        if not best then
          for _, pallet in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
            if pallet and pallet.Parent then
              local pp = (pallet:IsA("Model") and pallet.PrimaryPart)
                or pallet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
              if pp then
                local d = (pos - pp.Position).Magnitude
                if d < bestDist then
                  bestDist = d
                  best = pallet:FindFirstChild("PalletPointSlide", true) or pp
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
        return best, bestDist
      end
      local function startBlockSpamLoop()
        if blockSpamLoopRunning then
          return
        end
        blockSpamLoopRunning = true
        task.spawn(function()
          local http = game:GetService("HttpService")
          local rep = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
          local remotes = rep:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
          local palletFolder = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Pallet")
          local windowFolder = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Window")
          local palletSlideEvent = palletFolder and palletFolder:FindFirstChild("PalletSlideEvent")
          local vaultEvent = windowFolder and windowFolder:FindFirstChild("VaultEvent")
          while (isBlockingNearestPallet or isBlockingNearestVault) and activeLoop do
            local char = localPlayer.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
              local myPos = root.Position
              if isBlockingNearestPallet and palletSlideEvent then
                local nearestPt = getNearestPalletSlidePoint(myPos)
                if nearestPt and nearestPt.Parent then
                  pcall(function()
                    palletSlideEvent:FireServer(nearestPt, true, http:GenerateGUID(false), char)
                  end)
                end
              end
              if isBlockingNearestVault and vaultEvent then
                local nearestVt = getNearestVaultTrigger(myPos)
                if nearestVt and nearestVt.Parent then
                  pcall(function()
                    vaultEvent:FireServer(nearestVt, true, http:GenerateGUID(false), char, "fast")
                  end)
                end
              end
            end
            task.wait(0.2)
          end
          blockSpamLoopRunning = false
        end)
      end
      local function blockNearestVault()
        isBlockingNearestVault = true
        Settings.BlockVaults = true
        startBlockSpamLoop()
        showNotification("Block Nearest Vault", "Continuously blocking nearest vault!", "success")
      end

        isBlockingNearestPallet = true

        showNotification("Block Nearest Pallet", "Continuously blocking nearest pallet!", "success")
      end
      local function unlockNearestVault()
        isBlockingNearestVault = false
        Settings.BlockVaults = false
        pcall(function()
          local http = game:GetService("HttpService")
          local rep = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
          local remotes = rep:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
          local windowFolder = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Window")
          local vaultEvent = windowFolder and windowFolder:FindFirstChild("VaultEvent")
          local vaultCompleteEvent = windowFolder
            and windowFolder:FindFirstChild("VaultCompleteEvent")
          local char = localPlayer.Character
          local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if root then
            local nearestVt = getNearestVaultTrigger(root.Position)
            if nearestVt and nearestVt.Parent then
              if vaultEvent then
                pcall(function()
                  vaultEvent:FireServer(nearestVt, false, http:GenerateGUID(false), char, "fast")
                end)
              end
              if vaultCompleteEvent then
                pcall(function()
                  vaultCompleteEvent:FireServer(nearestVt, false)
                end)
              end
            end
          end
        end)
        showNotification("Unlock Nearest Vault", "Nearest vault unblocked and released!", "info")
      end

      eqStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
      eqStroke.Thickness = 0.8
      equipBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        openQuickEquipSlotModal(e.name)
      end)
      local playBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
      playBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 58, 0, 22)
      playBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -64, 0.5, -11)
      playBtn.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
      playBtn.Text = "Play"
      playBtn.TextColor3 = UI.Text
      local plStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", playBtn)
      plStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
      plStroke.Thickness = 0.8
      playBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
      playBtn.TextSize = 10.5
      playBtn.AutoButtonColor = true
      playBtn.Parent = card
      Instance.new("UICorner", playBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
      playBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if playCustomEmote then
          playCustomEmote(e.id, e.name)
        end
      end)
      registerSearchableFeature({
        name = e.name,
        parent = animScrollFrame,
        controlType = "Button",
        container = card,
        keybindName = e.keybind,
        isPremium = false,
        callback = function()
          if playCustomEmote then
            playCustomEmote(e.id, e.name)
          end
        end,
      })
      table.insert(animationFrames, { nameLower = e.name:lower(), container = card })
    end
    for _, e in ipairs(getFullEmoteList()) do
      addAnimationCardToScroll(e)
    end
    animSearchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
      local query = animSearchBox.Text:lower():gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
      for _, item in ipairs(animationFrames) do
        if item.container and item.container.Parent then
          if query == "" or string.find(item.nameLower, query, 1, true) then
            item.container.Visible = true
          else
            item.container.Visible = false
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end
end

          if
            controlRegistry["BypassToFRestrictions"]
            and controlRegistry["BypassToFRestrictions"].setValue
          then
            controlRegistry["BypassToFRestrictions"].setValue(false)
          end
          return
        end
        Settings.BypassToFRestrictions = val
        pcall(saveSettings)
      end,
      nil,
      "BypassToFRestrictions"
    )
    createSection(tabCombat, "Killers", UI.Accent)
    local generalKillerGroup = createCollapsibleGroup(tabCombat, "GENERAL", UI.Accent)
    local activeAttackTable = nil
    local activeAfterAttackTable = nil
    local activeKillerController = nil
    local lastKillerCheckTime = 0
    local cachedIsKiller = false
    local lastKillerChar = nil
    local function isPlayerActiveKiller()
      local char = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
      if
        not char
        or not char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      then
        cachedIsKiller = false
        return false
      end
      if
        activeKillerController
        and activeKillerController.character == char
        and activeKillerController.state
      then
        cachedIsKiller = true
        return true
      end
      local now = tick()
      if char == lastKillerChar and (now - lastKillerCheckTime < 0.5) then
        return cachedIsKiller
      end
      lastKillerCheckTime = now
      lastKillerChar = char
      local team = localPlayer.Team
      if team then
        local tName = team.Name:lower()
        if
          tName == "survivors"
          or tName:find("survivor")
          or tName:find("spectat")
          or tName:find("lobby")
        then
          cachedIsKiller = false
          return false
        end
        if
          tName == "killer"
          or tName == "killers"
          or tName:find("killer")
          or tName:find("slasher")
        then
          cachedIsKiller = true
          return true
        end
      end
      if
        char:GetAttribute("Killer") == true
        or char:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer"
        or localPlayer:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer"
        or char:FindFirstChild("Machete")
        or char:FindFirstChild("Knife")
        or char:FindFirstChild("Weapon")
      then
        cachedIsKiller = true
        return true
      end
      local pg = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
      if pg then
        for _, gui in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
          if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") then
            local gName = gui.Name:lower()
            if
              not gName:find("survivor")
              and (
                string.find(gName, "killer")
                or string.find(gName, "slasher")
                or string.find(gName, "stalker")
                or string.find(gName, "hidden")
                or string.find(gName, "abyss")
                or string.find(gName, "cure")
                or string.find(gName, "veil")
              )
            then
              cachedIsKiller = true
              return true
            end
          end
        end
      end
      cachedIsKiller = false
      return false
    end
    local function findKillerAttackRemote()
      local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
      local remotes = RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
      if not remotes then
        return nil
      end
      local killers = remotes:FindFirstChild("Killers")
      if killers then
        local atk = killers:FindFirstChild("Attack")
          or killers:FindFirstChild("BasicAttack")
          or killers:FindFirstChild("Slash")
        if atk and atk:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
          return atk
        end
      end
      local attacks = remotes:FindFirstChild("Attacks")
      if attacks then
        local atk = attacks:FindFirstChild("BasicAttack") or attacks:FindFirstChild("Attack")
        if atk and atk:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
          return atk
        end
      end
      local direct = remotes:FindFirstChild("BasicAttack") or remotes:FindFirstChild("Attack")
      if direct and direct:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        return direct
      end
      return nil
    end
    local lastDoubleTapTime = 0
    local isDoubleTapping = false
    local function executeDoubleTap()
      if not isPremiumActive() then
        return
      end
      if not (Settings.GeneralKiller and Settings.GeneralKiller.DoubleTap) then
        return
      end
      if isDoubleTapping then
        return
      end
      if not isPlayerActiveKiller() then
        return
      end
      local now = tick()
      if now - lastDoubleTapTime < 0.35 then
        return
      end
      lastDoubleTapTime = now
      isDoubleTapping = true
      task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.05)
        pcall(function()
          if not isPlayerActiveKiller() then
            return
          end
          local targetRemote = findKillerAttackRemote()
          if targetRemote and targetRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            targetRemote:FireServer(false)
          end
        end)
        task.wait(0.25)
        isDoubleTapping = false
      end)
    end
    task.spawn(function()
      pcall(function()
        local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local slowAttack = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes", 5)
          and RS.Remotes:WaitForChild("Killers", 5)
          and RS.Remotes.Killers:WaitForChild("SlowAttack", 5)
        if slowAttack and slowAttack:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
          registerConnection(slowAttack.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
            if Settings.GeneralKiller and Settings.GeneralKiller.DoubleTap then
              executeDoubleTap()
            end
          end))
        end
      end)
    end)
    local lastGcScanTime = 0
    local isScanningGc = false
    local gcScanCountForChar = 0
    local lastGcScanChar = nil
    local function updateAttackTableValues(obj, isInfLunge, lungeMode, lungeDur)
      if not obj or type(obj) ~= "table" then
        return
      end
      if rawget(obj, "_origMaxHold") == nil and obj.maxHold ~= math.huge then
        rawset(obj, "_origMaxHold", obj.maxHold)
      end
      local origHold = rawget(obj, "_origMaxHold") or 0.6
      if isInfLunge then
        if lungeMode == "Custom" or lungeMode == "Custom Duration" then
          obj.maxHold = lungeDur
        else
          obj.maxHold = math.huge
        end
      else
        obj.maxHold = origHold
      end
    end
    local function hookAfterAttackTable(obj)
      if not obj then
        return
      end
      if rawget(obj, "_origCustom") == nil and rawget(obj, "_cdHooked") == nil then
        rawset(obj, "_origCustom", rawget(obj, "custom"))
      end
      local orig = rawget(obj, "_origCustom")
      local cfg = Settings.GeneralKiller or {}
      if isPremiumActive() and cfg.AttackCooldown then
        rawset(obj, "_cdHooked", true)
        obj.custom = function(ctrl, a2, a3, a4)
          if ctrl then
            activeKillerController = ctrl
          end
          local currentCfg = Settings.GeneralKiller or {}
          if
            not isPremiumActive()
            or not currentCfg.AttackCooldown
            or (ctrl and ctrl.state and ctrl.state.isTrueStunned)
          then
            if orig then
              return orig(ctrl, a2, a3, a4)
            end
            return
          end
          local hitType = a2 or "Nothing"
          if hitType == "Parried" then
            if orig then
              return orig(ctrl, a2, a3, a4)
            end
            return
          end
          if not ctrl.afterAttackPlaying then
            ctrl.afterAttackPlaying = true
            ctrl.state.isStunned = true
            ctrl.state.canUpdateSpeed = false
            if ctrl.humanoid then
              ctrl.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
            end
            local baseSpeed = 16
            if ctrl.character then
              baseSpeed = (ctrl.character:GetAttribute("Speed") or 16)
                * (ctrl.character:GetAttribute("speedboost") or 1)
            end
            if ctrl.humanoid then
              ctrl.humanoid.WalkSpeed = baseSpeed * 0.1535
            end
            pcall(function()
              if hitType == "Nothing" then
                if ctrl.stopAllAnimations then
                  ctrl.stopAllAnimations()
                end
                ctrl.state.isAttacking = false
              else
                if ctrl.stopAllAnimations then
                  ctrl.stopAllAnimations()
                end
                ctrl.state.isAttacking = false
                if hitType == "WallHitStun" and ctrl.playAnimation then
                  ctrl.playAnimation("wallhitvm", true)
                elseif hitType == "WipeMachete" and ctrl.playAnimation then
                  ctrl.playAnimation("wipevm", true)
                end
                local animTrack = ctrl.animations and ctrl.animations[hitType]
                if animTrack then
                  animTrack:Play()
                  animTrack:AdjustSpeed(a3 or 1.5)
                end
              end
            end)
            local curCD = tonumber(currentCfg.AttackCooldownTime) or 0.1
            if curCD > 0 then
              task.wait(curCD)
            end
            pcall(function()
              if ctrl.stopAllAnimations then
                ctrl.stopAllAnimations()
              end
              ctrl.state.isStunned = false
              ctrl.state.isAttacking = false
              ctrl.state.attackCount = 0
              if ctrl.motherscript then
                ctrl.motherscript:SetAttribute("action", false)
              end
              if ctrl.setAction then
                ctrl.setAction(false)
              end
              if ctrl.character and not ctrl.state.isTrueStunned and ctrl.humanoid then
                local spd = (ctrl.character:GetAttribute("Speed") or 16)
                  * (ctrl.character:GetAttribute("speedboost") or 1)
                ctrl.humanoid.WalkSpeed = spd
                ctrl.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
              end
              ctrl.state.canUpdateSpeed = true
              ctrl.afterAttackPlaying = false
            end)
          end
        end
      else
        if orig then
          obj.custom = orig
        end
      end
    end
    local function applyGeneralKillerSettings(forceScan)
      local isPrem = isPremiumActive()
      local cfg = Settings.GeneralKiller or {}
      local isInfLunge = isPrem
        and (cfg.InfiniteLunge or (Settings.Hidden and Settings.Hidden.InfiniteLunge))
      local lungeMode = cfg.LungeMode or "Infinite"
      local lungeDur = tonumber(cfg.LungeDuration) or 2.0
      if activeAttackTable then
        updateAttackTableValues(activeAttackTable, isInfLunge, lungeMode, lungeDur)
      end
      if activeAfterAttackTable then
        hookAfterAttackTable(activeAfterAttackTable)
      end
      if activeKillerController and type(activeKillerController.afterAttack) == "table" then
        hookAfterAttackTable(activeKillerController.afterAttack)
      end
      local myChar = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
      if isPlayerActiveKiller() and myChar then
        local pbEnabled = isPrem and (cfg.BreakPalletSpeed == true)
        local pbMult = tonumber(cfg.BreakPalletSpeedMultiplier) or 2.0
        if pbEnabled then
          if myChar:GetAttribute("breakspeed") ~= pbMult then
            pcall(function()
              myChar:SetAttribute("breakspeed", pbMult)
            end)
          end
        else
          if myChar:GetAttribute("breakspeed") and myChar:GetAttribute("breakspeed") > 1 then
            pcall(function()
              myChar:SetAttribute("breakspeed", 1)
            end)
          end
        end
        pcall(function()
          local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
          local kConfig = require(RS.Modules.Killers.KillerConfig)
          if kConfig then
            if rawget(kConfig, "_origPalletBreakDur") == nil then
              rawset(kConfig, "_origPalletBreakDur", kConfig.PALLET_BREAK_DURATION or 2.16)
            end
            local origDur = rawget(kConfig, "_origPalletBreakDur") or 2.16
            if pbEnabled then
              kConfig.PALLET_BREAK_DURATION = math.max(0.1, origDur / pbMult)
            else
              kConfig.PALLET_BREAK_DURATION = origDur
            end
          end
        end)
      end
      if
        not isPrem
        or not (isInfLunge or cfg.AttackCooldown or cfg.BreakPalletSpeed)
        or not isPlayerActiveKiller()
      then
        return
      end
      local now = tick()
      if isScanningGc or (not forceScan and (now - lastGcScanTime < 2.5)) then
        return
      end
      lastGcScanTime = now
      isScanningGc = true
      if getgc and myChar then
        pcall(function()
          local gcList = getgc(true)
          if not gcList then
            return
          end
          for _, obj in ipairs(gcList) do
            if type(obj) == "table" then
              if rawget(obj, "maxHold") ~= nil and rawget(obj, "lungeThreshold") ~= nil then
                activeAttackTable = obj
                updateAttackTableValues(obj, isInfLunge, lungeMode, lungeDur)
              end
              if
                rawget(obj, "character") == myChar
                and rawget(obj, "state") ~= nil
                and rawget(obj, "humanoid") ~= nil
                and (
                  rawget(obj, "playAnimation") ~= nil or rawget(obj, "playAnimationNoStop") ~= nil
                )
              then
                activeKillerController = obj
                if obj.humanoid and obj.humanoid.JumpPower ~= 0 then
                  obj.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
                end
                if type(obj.afterAttack) == "table" then
                  activeAfterAttackTable = obj.afterAttack
                  hookAfterAttackTable(obj.afterAttack)
                end
                if type(obj.palletBreak) == "table" then
                  local pb = obj.palletBreak
                  if rawget(pb, "_origAnimMult") == nil then
                    rawset(pb, "_origAnimMult", pb.animationSpeedMultiplier or 1)
                    rawset(pb, "_origDurMult", pb.durationSpeedMultiplier or 1)
                  end
                  local origAnim = rawget(pb, "_origAnimMult") or 1
                  local origDur = rawget(pb, "_origDurMult") or 1
                  if isPrem and cfg.BreakPalletSpeed then
                    local mult = tonumber(cfg.BreakPalletSpeedMultiplier) or 2.0
                    pb.animationSpeedMultiplier = origAnim * mult
                    pb.durationSpeedMultiplier = origDur * mult
                  else
                    pb.animationSpeedMultiplier = origAnim
                    pb.durationSpeedMultiplier = origDur
                  end
                end
              end
              if
                rawget(obj, "parriedVmTrack") ~= nil
                or (
                  rawget(obj, "onTrackPlay") ~= nil
                  and (rawget(obj, "custom") ~= nil or rawget(obj, "_origCustom") ~= nil)
                )
              then
                activeAfterAttackTable = obj
                hookAfterAttackTable(obj)
              end
            end
          end
          table.clear(gcList)
        end)
      end
      isScanningGc = false
    end
    registerConnection(localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
      activeKillerController = nil
      activeAttackTable = nil
      activeAfterAttackTable = nil
      cachedIsKiller = false
      lastKillerChar = nil
      lastAttackStateTime = 0
      gcScanCountForChar = 0
      lastGcScanChar = newChar
      for _, delayTime in ipairs({ 1.2, 3.0 }) do
        task.delay(delayTime, function()
          if localPlayer and localPlayer.Character == newChar and isPlayerActiveKiller() then
            pcall(applyGeneralKillerSettings, true)
          end
        end)
      end
    end))
    task.spawn(function()
      while activeLoop do
        task.wait(2.5)
        local cfg = Settings.GeneralKiller
        local hasActiveKillerSetting = isPremiumActive()
          and cfg
          and (
            cfg.AttackCooldown
            or cfg.InfiniteLunge
            or cfg.BreakPalletSpeed
            or (Settings.Hidden and Settings.Hidden.InfiniteLunge)
          )
        if hasActiveKillerSetting and localPlayer and localPlayer.Character then
          local char = localPlayer.Character
          if char ~= lastGcScanChar then
            lastGcScanChar = char
            gcScanCountForChar = 0
          end
          local needsScan = false
          if
            not activeKillerController
            or activeKillerController.character ~= char
            or not activeKillerController.state
          then
            needsScan = true
          elseif not activeAttackTable or not activeAfterAttackTable then
            needsScan = true
          end
          if needsScan and gcScanCountForChar < 3 and isPlayerActiveKiller() then
            gcScanCountForChar = gcScanCountForChar + 1
            pcall(applyGeneralKillerSettings, true)
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    local lastAttackStateTime = 0
    registerConnection(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
      local now = tick()
      local isPrem = isPremiumActive()
      local cfg = Settings.GeneralKiller or {}
      local isInfLunge = isPrem
        and (cfg.InfiniteLunge or (Settings.Hidden and Settings.Hidden.InfiniteLunge))
      local lungeMode = cfg.LungeMode or "Infinite"
      if
        isInfLunge
        and (lungeMode == "Infinite" or lungeMode == "infinite")
        and localPlayer
        and localPlayer.Character
      then
        local char = localPlayer.Character
        if char:GetAttribute("lungeboost") ~= 999999 then
          pcall(function()
            char:SetAttribute("lungeboost", 999999)
          end)
        end
      elseif localPlayer and localPlayer.Character then
        local char = localPlayer.Character
        if char:GetAttribute("lungeboost") == 999999 then
          pcall(function()
            char:SetAttribute("lungeboost", 1)
          end)
        end
      end
      local ctrl = activeKillerController
      if ctrl and ctrl.state and isPlayerActiveKiller() then
        if ctrl.humanoid and ctrl.humanoid.JumpPower ~= 0 then
          ctrl.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
        end
        if
          Settings.GeneralKiller
          and Settings.GeneralKiller.AttackCooldown
          and not ctrl.state.isTrueStunned
          and not ctrl.holdingAttack
        then
          local inAttackRecovery = ctrl.afterAttackPlaying
            or (ctrl.state.isAttacking and ctrl.state.isStunned and not ctrl.state.isLunging)
          if inAttackRecovery then
            local cdTime = tonumber(Settings.GeneralKiller.AttackCooldownTime) or 0.1
            local baseSpeed = 16
            if ctrl.character then
              baseSpeed = (ctrl.character:GetAttribute("Speed") or 16)
                * (ctrl.character:GetAttribute("speedboost") or 1)
            end
            if lastAttackStateTime == 0 then
              lastAttackStateTime = now
              if ctrl.humanoid then
                ctrl.humanoid.WalkSpeed = baseSpeed * 0.1535
              end
            elseif now - lastAttackStateTime >= cdTime then
              pcall(function()
                if ctrl.stopAllAnimations then
                  pcall(ctrl.stopAllAnimations)
                end
                ctrl.state.isStunned = false
                ctrl.state.canUpdateSpeed = true
                ctrl.state.isAttacking = false
                ctrl.state.isLunging = false
                ctrl.state.attackCount = 0
                ctrl.afterAttackPlaying = false
                if ctrl.motherscript then
                  pcall(function()
                    ctrl.motherscript:SetAttribute("action", false)
                  end)
                end
                if ctrl.setAction then
                  pcall(ctrl.setAction, false)
                end
                if ctrl.character and not ctrl.state.isTrueStunned and ctrl.humanoid then
                  ctrl.humanoid.WalkSpeed = baseSpeed
                  ctrl.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
                end
              end)
              lastAttackStateTime = 0
            else
              if ctrl.humanoid and ctrl.humanoid.WalkSpeed > baseSpeed * 0.2 then
                ctrl.humanoid.WalkSpeed = baseSpeed * 0.1535
              end
            end
          else
            lastAttackStateTime = 0
          end
        else
          lastAttackStateTime = 0
        end
      else
        lastAttackStateTime = 0
      end
    end))
    local function ensureGeneralKillerCfg()
      if not Settings.GeneralKiller then
        Settings.GeneralKiller = {
          InfiniteLunge = false,
          LungeMode = "Infinite",
          LungeDuration = 2.0,
          DoubleTap = false,
          AttackCooldown = false,
          AttackCooldownTime = 0.1,
          BreakPalletSpeed = false,
          BreakPalletSpeedMultiplier = 2.0,
        }
      end
      if Settings.GeneralKiller.LungeMode == nil then
        Settings.GeneralKiller.LungeMode = "Infinite"
      end
      if Settings.GeneralKiller.LungeDuration == nil then
        Settings.GeneralKiller.LungeDuration = 2.0
      end
      if Settings.GeneralKiller.BreakPalletSpeed == nil then
        Settings.GeneralKiller.BreakPalletSpeed = false
      end
      if Settings.GeneralKiller.BreakPalletSpeedMultiplier == nil then
        Settings.GeneralKiller.BreakPalletSpeedMultiplier = 2.0
      end
    end

      0.1

local function doAimableArchJump()
    Humanoid_upv_1:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
    local LookVector_1 = CurrentCamera_upv_1.CFrame.LookVector
    local v31 = math.asin(LookVector_1.Y)
    local v32 = math.sin(v31)
    local v33 = Vector3.new(LookVector_1.X, 0, LookVector_1.Z)
    if v33.Magnitude <= 0 then
        v33 = Vector3.new(HumanoidRootPart_upv_1.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, HumanoidRootPart_upv_1.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
    end
    HumanoidRootPart_upv_1.Velocity = (v33.Unit * (((math.cos(v31) * 0.3) + 0.7) * 65 * __VD_JUMP_DIST_MULT__)) + Vector3.new(0, ((math.max(0, v32) * 30) + 20) * 1.5 * __VD_JUMP_HEIGHT_MULT__, 0)
    u5 = true
    task.spawn(
        function()
            task.wait(0.15)
            local v34 = RaycastParams.new()
            v34.FilterDescendantsInstances = {u7}
            v34.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            while u5 and (HumanoidRootPart_upv_1) and (HumanoidRootPart_upv_1.Parent) do
                if not (HumanoidRootPart_upv_1.Velocity.Y <= 0) or not (workspace:Raycast(HumanoidRootPart_upv_1.Position, Vector3.new(0, -3, 0), v34)) then
                    task.wait()
                    continue
                end
                Humanoid_upv_1:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
                return
            end
        end
    )
    task.delay(
        3,
        function()
            if not u5 or not Humanoid_upv_1 or not Humanoid_upv_1.Parent then
                return
            end
            Humanoid_upv_1:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
        end
    )
end

      local function findHiddenGui()
        local pg = localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if not pg then
          return nil
        end
        local platform = localPlayer:GetAttribute("platform")
        if platform == "PC" then
          return pg:FindFirstChild("Hidden")
        elseif platform == "Mobile" then
          return pg:FindFirstChild("Hidden-mob")
        elseif platform == "Console" then
          return pg:FindFirstChild("Hidden-con")
        end
        return pg:FindFirstChild("Hidden")
          or pg:FindFirstChild("Hidden-mob")
          or pg:FindFirstChild("Hidden-con")
      end
      local function disableOriginalHiddenScripts()
        local hiddenGui = findHiddenGui()
        if hiddenGui then
          for _, desc in ipairs(hiddenGui:GetDescendants()) do
            if desc:IsA("LocalScript") and not desc:GetAttribute("VD_CustomHidden") then
              if desc.Disabled == false then
                hiddenNCLDisabledOriginal[desc] = true
                pcall(function()
                  desc.Disabled = true
                end)
              end
            end
          end
        end
        if localPlayer and localPlayer.Character then
          for _, desc in ipairs(localPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if
              desc:IsA("LocalScript")
              and (
                desc.Name:lower():find("hidden")
                or desc.Name:lower():find("leap")
                or desc.Name:lower():find("m2")
                or desc.Name:lower():find("killer")
              )
            then
              if desc.Disabled == false then
                hiddenNCLDisabledOriginal[desc] = true
                pcall(function()
                  desc.Disabled = true
                end)
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      local function enableOriginalHiddenScripts()
        for scr, _ in pairs(hiddenNCLDisabledOriginal) do
          pcall(function()
            if scr and scr.Parent then
              scr.Disabled = false
            end
          end)
        end
        table.clear(hiddenNCLDisabledOriginal)
      end
      local function restoreOriginal()
        _G.VD_HiddenActive = false
        hiddenNCLScript = nil
        lastAppliedHiddenChar = nil
        if _G.VD_HiddenConnections then
          for _, conn in ipairs(_G.VD_HiddenConnections) do
            pcall(function()
              conn:Disconnect()
            end)
          end
          table.clear(_G.VD_HiddenConnections)
        end
        enableOriginalHiddenScripts()
        pcall(function()
          if localPlayer and localPlayer.Character then
            localPlayer.Character:SetAttribute("nom1", false)
            local ci = localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("CheckInterractable")
            if ci then
              ci:SetAttribute("action", false)
            end
          end
        end)
      end
      local lastAppliedHiddenChar = nil
      _G.VD_ApplyHiddenNoCooldownLeap = function(forceReapply)
        local isNoCD = Settings.Hidden and Settings.Hidden.NoCooldownLeap
        if not isNoCD then
          restoreOriginal()

        local char = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
        if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then

        end
        if not forceReapply and lastAppliedHiddenChar == char and hiddenNCLScript then
          return
        end
        restoreOriginal()

        if not hiddenGui then
          return
        end
        disableOriginalHiddenScripts()

        local leapLock = tostring(tonumber(hConf.LeapCooldown) or 0)
        local m2CD = tostring(tonumber(hConf.M2Cooldown) or 0)
        local m2Lock = tostring(tonumber(hConf.M2Cooldown) or 0)

          :gsub("__VD_JUMP_DIST_MULT__", jumpDist)
          :gsub("__VD_NO_LANDING_SLOW__", noLandingSlow)
        local loader, loadErr = loadstring(src)

          showNotification("HIDDEN", "loadstring fallito: " .. tostring(loadErr), "error")

        end)

          then
            controlRegistry["Stalker.NoCooldown"].setValue(false)

        if not Settings.Stalker then
          Settings.Stalker = {}

        Settings.Stalker.NoCooldown = val

    )
    controlRegistry["Stalker.KillGrab"] = createToggle(
      stalkerGroup.content,
      "Kill Grab",
      Settings.Stalker and Settings.Stalker.KillGrab or false,
      function(val)
        if val and not isPremiumActive("Stalker") then
          showNotification(

          )
          if
            controlRegistry["Stalker.KillGrab"] and controlRegistry["Stalker.KillGrab"].setValue
          then
            controlRegistry["Stalker.KillGrab"].setValue(false)
          end
          return
        end
        if not Settings.Stalker then
          Settings.Stalker = {}
        end
        Settings.Stalker.KillGrab = val
        pcall(saveSettings)
      end,
      UI.Danger
    )
    controlRegistry["Stalker.StalkWhileMoving"] = createToggle(
      stalkerGroup.content,
      "Stalk While Moving",
      Settings.Stalker and Settings.Stalker.StalkWhileMoving or false,

        end
        Settings.Stalker.StalkWhileMoving = val

    createButton(stalkerGroup.content, "Stalk Everyone (once)", "Run", function()
      task.spawn(function()
        local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local killers = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Killers")
        local stalkerFolder = killers and killers:FindFirstChild("Stalker")
        local startStalking = stalkerFolder and stalkerFolder:FindFirstChild("StartStalking")
        if not startStalking then
          showNotification("Stalker", "StartStalking remote not found!", "error")
          return
        end
        local count = 0
        for _, p in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
          if p ~= localPlayer then
            pcall(function()
              startStalking:FireServer(p)
            end)
            count = count + 1
          end
        end
        showNotification("Stalker", "Stalking " .. count .. " players!", "success")
      end)
    end, UI.AccentCyan, "StalkerStalkEveryone")
    local abysswalkerGroup = createCollapsibleGroup(tabCombat, "ABYSSWALKER", UI.Accent)
    controlRegistry["Stalker.InfiniteCorrupt"] = createToggle(

  registerConnection(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed or isBindingKey then
      return
    end
    local isGamepad = (
      input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad2
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad3
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad4
    )
    local isKey = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or isGamepad
    local isMouse3 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3
    if isKey or isMouse3 then
      local key = isKey and input.KeyCode.Name or input.UserInputType.Name
      if key ~= "Unknown" and key ~= "None" and Settings.Keybinds then
        for bindName, bindKey in pairs(Settings.Keybinds) do
          if bindKey and bindKey ~= "None" then
            local isHoldBind = false
            local rawKey = bindKey
            if type(bindKey) == "string" and bindKey:sub(1, 5):lower() == "hold " then
              isHoldBind = true
              rawKey = bindKey:sub(6)
            end
            local isMatch = false
            if type(rawKey) == "string" and rawKey:find("+") then
              local comboParts = {}
              for part in rawKey:gmatch("[^+]+") do
                table.insert(comboParts, part)
              end
              if #comboParts >= 2 then
                local matchesCurrentKey = false
                for _, p in ipairs(comboParts) do
                  if p == key then
                    matchesCurrentKey = true
                    break
                  end
                end
                if matchesCurrentKey then
                  local allHeld = true
                  for _, p in ipairs(comboParts) do
                    if p ~= key then
                      local isDown = false
                      pcall(function()
                        if p == "MouseButton3" then
                          isDown =
                            UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3)
                        elseif Enum.KeyCode[p] then
                          isDown = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode[p])
                        end
                      end)
                      if not isDown then
                        allHeld = false
                        break
                      end
                    end
                  end
                  if allHeld then
                    isMatch = true
                  end
                end
              end
            else
              if rawKey == key then
                isMatch = true
              end
            end
            if isMatch then
              if isHoldBind and bindName ~= "ToggleUI" then
                activeHoldKeybinds[bindName] = true
                if keybindSetters[bindName] then
                  pcall(keybindSetters[bindName], true)
                elseif keybindActions[bindName] then
                  pcall(keybindActions[bindName])
                end
              else
                local action = keybindActions[bindName]
                if action then
                  pcall(action)
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end))
  registerConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if isBindingKey then
      return
    end
    local isGamepad = (
      input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad2
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad3
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad4
    )
    local isKey = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or isGamepad
    local isMouse3 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3
    if isKey or isMouse3 then
      local key = isKey and input.KeyCode.Name or input.UserInputType.Name
      if key ~= "Unknown" and key ~= "None" and Settings.Keybinds then
        for bindName, bindKey in pairs(Settings.Keybinds) do
          if activeHoldKeybinds[bindName] and bindKey and bindKey ~= "None" then
            local isHoldBind = (type(bindKey) == "string" and bindKey:sub(1, 5):lower() == "hold ")
            local rawKey = isHoldBind and bindKey:sub(6) or bindKey
            local shouldRelease = false
            if type(rawKey) == "string" and rawKey:find("+") then
              for part in rawKey:gmatch("[^+]+") do
                if part == key then
                  shouldRelease = true
                  break
                end
              end
            else
              if rawKey == key then
                shouldRelease = true
              end
            end
            if shouldRelease then
              activeHoldKeybinds[bindName] = nil
              if keybindSetters[bindName] then
                pcall(keybindSetters[bindName], false)
              elseif keybindActions[bindName] then
                pcall(keybindActions[bindName])
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end))
end
initCombatTab()
local function initTeleportTab()
  activeTPFilter = activeTPFilter or "All"
  do
    local function teleportToTarget(category, selectFurthest)
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not root then
        showNotification("Teleport", "Character root not found!", "error")
        return
      end
      local targets = {}
      if category == "Generator" then
        local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
        local gensFolder = map and map:FindFirstChild("Gens")
        if gensFolder then
          for _, child in ipairs(gensFolder:GetChildren()) do
            if child.Name == "Generator" or string.find(child.Name:lower(), "generator") then
              table.insert(targets, child)
            end
          end
        end
        for _, gen in ipairs(cachedGenerators) do
          if gen and gen.Parent and not table.find(targets, gen) then
            table.insert(targets, gen)
          end
        end
        if #targets == 0 then
          for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if desc.Name == "Generator" then
              table.insert(targets, desc)
            end
          end
        end
      elseif category == "Hook" then
        for _, hook in ipairs(cachedHooks) do
          if hook and hook.Parent then
            table.insert(targets, hook)
          end
        end
        if #targets == 0 then
          for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if desc.Name == "Hook" or desc.Name:lower():find("hook") then
              table.insert(targets, desc)
            end
          end
        end
      elseif category == "Gate" then
        for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
          if
            desc.Name == "Gate"
            or desc.Name:lower():find("gate")
            or desc.Name:lower():find("door")
          then
            table.insert(targets, desc)
          end
        end
      elseif category == "Pallet" then
        for _, pallet in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
          if pallet and pallet.Parent then
            table.insert(targets, pallet)
          end
        end
        if #targets == 0 then
          for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if desc.Name == "Pallet" or desc.Name:lower():find("pallet") then
              table.insert(targets, desc)
            end
          end
        end
      elseif category == "Vault" then
        for _, vault in ipairs(cachedVaults) do
          if vault and vault.Parent then
            table.insert(targets, vault)
          end
        end
        if #targets == 0 then
          for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if desc.Name == "Vault" or desc.Name:lower():find("vault") or desc.Name == "Window" then
              table.insert(targets, desc)
            end
          end
        end
      elseif category == "Survivor" then
        for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
          if
            player ~= localPlayer
            and player.Team
            and player.Team.Name == "Survivors"
            and player.Character
            and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          then
            table.insert(targets, player.Character)
          end
        end
      elseif category == "Killer" then
        for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
          local isKiller = false
          if player.Team and player.Team.Name == "Killer" then
            isKiller = true
          elseif player.Name:lower():find("killer") then
            isKiller = true
          end
          if
            isKiller
            and player.Character
            and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          then
            table.insert(targets, player.Character)
          end
        end
      elseif category == "Pumpkin" or category == "Pumpkins" then
        for _, p in ipairs(cachedPumpkins or {}) do
          if p and p.Parent then
            table.insert(targets, p)
          end
        end
        if #targets == 0 then
          local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
          local pFolder = map and map:FindFirstChild("Pumpkins")
          if pFolder then
            for _, child in ipairs(pFolder:GetChildren()) do
              table.insert(targets, child)
            end
          end
        end
      end
      local selectedPart = nil
      local bestDistance = selectFurthest and -1 or math.huge
      for _, t in ipairs(targets) do
        local part = t:IsA("BasePart") and t
          or (t:IsA("Model") and (t.PrimaryPart or t:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")))
          or t:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        if part then
          local dist = (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
          if selectFurthest then
            if dist > bestDistance then
              bestDistance = dist
              selectedPart = part
            end
          else
            if dist < bestDistance then
              bestDistance = dist
              selectedPart = part
            end
          end
        end
      end
      if selectedPart then
        if _G.VD_StopAllInteractions then
          pcall(_G.VD_StopAllInteractions)
          task.wait(0.15)
        end
        local targetPos = selectedPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
        if Settings.PathfindingTP ~= false and _G.VD_SmartWalkTo then
          _G.VD_AbortPathfinding = true
          task.wait(0.03)
          _G.VD_AbortPathfinding = false
          task.spawn(function()
            local reached = _G.VD_SmartWalkTo(targetPos, 3.5)
            if
              not reached
              and (selectedPart.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > 4.0
              and not _G.VD_AbortPathfinding
            then
              safeSegmentedTeleport(root, selectedPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
            end
          end)
          showNotification(
            "Teleport",
            "Pathfinding to "
              .. (selectFurthest and "furthest" or "nearest")
              .. " "
              .. category
              .. "...",
            "info"
          )
        else
          safeSegmentedTeleport(root, selectedPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
          showNotification(
            "Teleport",
            "Teleported to "
              .. (selectFurthest and "furthest" or "nearest")
              .. " "
              .. category
              .. "!",
            "success"
          )
        end
      else
        showNotification(
          "Teleport",
          "No " .. (selectFurthest and "furthest" or "nearest") .. " " .. category .. " found!",
          "error"
        )
      end
    end
    local function teleportToNearest(category)
      teleportToTarget(category, false)
    end
    local function teleportToFurthest(category)
      teleportToTarget(category, true)
    end
    local nearestHeader = createCollapsibleHeader(tabTP, "Nearest Teleports", UI.Accent)
    createButton(nearestHeader.content, "TP To Nearest Generator", "TP", function()
      teleportToNearest("Generator")
    end, UI.Accent, "TpNearestGenerator")
    createButton(nearestHeader.content, "TP To Nearest Hook", "TP", function()
      teleportToNearest("Hook")
    end, UI.Accent, "TpNearestHook")
    createButton(nearestHeader.content, "TP To Nearest Gate", "TP", function()
      teleportToNearest("Gate")
    end, UI.Accent, "TpNearestGate")
    createButton(nearestHeader.content, "TP To Nearest Pallet", "TP", function()
      teleportToNearest("Pallet")
    end, UI.Accent, "TpNearestPallet")
    createButton(nearestHeader.content, "TP To Nearest Vault", "TP", function()
      teleportToNearest("Vault")
    end, UI.Accent, "TpNearestVault")
    createButton(nearestHeader.content, "TP To Nearest Survivor", "TP", function()
      teleportToNearest("Survivor")
    end, UI.Accent, "TpNearestSurvivor")
    createButton(nearestHeader.content, "TP To Killer", "TP", function()
      teleportToNearest("Killer")
    end, UI.Accent, "TpNearestKiller")
    createButton(nearestHeader.content, "TP To Nearest Pumpkin", "TP", function()
      teleportToNearest("Pumpkin")
    end, UI.Accent, "TpNearestPumpkin")
    local furthestHeader = createCollapsibleHeader(tabTP, "Furthest Teleports", UI.Accent)
    createButton(furthestHeader.content, "TP To Furthest Generator", "TP", function()
      teleportToFurthest("Generator")
    end, UI.Accent, "TpFurthestGenerator")
    createButton(furthestHeader.content, "TP To Furthest Hook", "TP", function()
      teleportToFurthest("Hook")
    end, UI.Accent, "TpFurthestHook")
    createButton(furthestHeader.content, "TP To Furthest Gate", "TP", function()
      teleportToFurthest("Gate")
    end, UI.Accent, "TpFurthestGate")
    createButton(furthestHeader.content, "TP To Furthest Pallet", "TP", function()
      teleportToFurthest("Pallet")
    end, UI.Accent, "TpFurthestPallet")
    createButton(furthestHeader.content, "TP To Furthest Vault", "TP", function()
      teleportToFurthest("Vault")
    end, UI.Accent, "TpFurthestVault")
    createButton(furthestHeader.content, "TP To Furthest Survivor", "TP", function()
      teleportToFurthest("Survivor")
    end, UI.Accent, "TpFurthestSurvivor")
    createButton(furthestHeader.content, "TP To Furthest Pumpkin", "TP", function()
      teleportToFurthest("Pumpkin")
    end, UI.Accent, "TpFurthestPumpkin")
    controlRegistry["PathfindingTP"] = createToggle(
      tabTP,
      "Pathfinding Teleport (Smart Walk)",
      Settings.PathfindingTP ~= false,
      function(val)
        Settings.PathfindingTP = val
        pcall(saveSettings)
      end
    )
    controlRegistry["UndergroundTP"] = createToggle(
      tabTP,
      "Underground Teleport (Invisible Transit)",
      Settings.UndergroundTP == true,
      function(val)
        Settings.UndergroundTP = val
        pcall(saveSettings)
      end
    )
    controlRegistry["SafeTpSpeed"] = createSlider(
      tabTP,
      "Tween Teleport Speed (Studs/s)",
      6,
      25,
      Settings.SafeTpSpeed or 14,
      function(val)
        Settings.SafeTpSpeed = val
        pcall(saveSettings)
      end,
      UI.Accent,
      " s/s"
    )
    createSection(tabTP, "Quick Map Teleports")
    local filterButtons = {}
    local filterBar = Instance.new("Frame")
    filterBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
    filterBar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    filterBar.Parent = tabTP
    local filterLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    filterLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    filterLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left
    filterLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
    filterLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
    filterLayout.Parent = filterBar
    local categories = {
      { name = "ALL", value = "All" },
      { name = "GENS", value = "Generator" },
      { name = "PALLETS", value = "Pallet" },
      { name = "VAULTS", value = "Vault" },
      { name = "GATES", value = "Gate" },
      { name = "HOOKS", value = "Hook" },
      { name = "PUMPKINS", value = "Pumpkin" },
    }
    local function updateFilterUI()
      for val, btn in pairs(filterButtons) do
        local isActive = (activeTPFilter == val)
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = isActive and Color3.fromRGB(240, 242, 250) or UI.Card

        local stroke = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        if stroke then
          stroke.Color = isActive and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or UI.StrokeDim
          stroke.Thickness = isActive and 1.2 or 0.8
        end
      end
    end
    for _, cat in ipairs(categories) do
      local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
      btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, isMobile and 60 or 75, 1, 0)

      local btnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
      btnStroke.Color = UI.Stroke
      btnStroke.Thickness = 1
      filterButtons[cat.value] = btn
      btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        activeTPFilter = cat.value

        if refreshTPMenu then
          refreshTPMenu()
        else
        end
      end)
    end

    end)
    tpEmptyLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

      Settings.ShowLiveFPS == true,
      function(val)
        Settings.ShowLiveFPS = val
        pcall(saveSettings)
        if _G.VD_UpdateLiveFPSVisibility then
          pcall(_G.VD_UpdateLiveFPSVisibility, val)
        end

    local function getWorkspaceImageFiles()
      local listFunc = listfiles or syn_io_listfiles or list_files
      local found = {}
      if listFunc then
        local ok, files = pcall(listFunc, "")
        if not ok or not files then
          ok, files = pcall(listFunc)
        end
        if ok and type(files) == "table" then
          for _, filepath in ipairs(files) do
            local fname = tostring(filepath):match("[^/\\]+$") or tostring(filepath)
            local fnameLower = fname:lower()
            if not fnameLower:find("^dbd_hud_") and not fnameLower:find("dbd_hud_") then
              local ext = fname:match("%.([^%.]+)$")
              if ext then
                ext = ext:lower()
                if ext == "png" or ext == "jpg" or ext == "jpeg" or ext == "webp" then
                  table.insert(found, fname)
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      return found
    end
    local function refreshBgControls(enabled)
      local ctrlNames = {
        "CustomBg_AssetId",
        "CustomBg_LocalFile",
        "CustomBg_LocalBrowse",
        "CustomBg_Overlay",
        "CustomBg_ScaleType",
      }
      for _, name in ipairs(ctrlNames) do
        local ctrl = controlRegistry[name]
        local targetContainer = nil
        if typeof(ctrl) == "Instance" and ctrl:IsA("GuiObject") then
          targetContainer = ctrl
        elseif type(ctrl) == "table" then
          if typeof(ctrl.container) == "Instance" then
            targetContainer = ctrl.container
          end
        end
        if targetContainer then
          pcall(function()
            TweenService:Create(
              targetContainer,
              TweenInfo.new(0.2),
              { BackgroundTransparency = enabled and 0.8 or 0.95 }
            ):Play()
            for _, d in ipairs(targetContainer:GetDescendants()) do
              if d:IsA("TextLabel") then
                TweenService
                  :Create(d, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { TextTransparency = enabled and 0 or 0.5 })
                  :Play()
              end
            end
          end)
        end
      end
    end

initTeleportTab()
local function initConfigTab()
  tabConfig = createTab("Config", "rbxassetid://7734058803", "Configs")
  do
    local function refreshTeamConfigSelectors()
      local options = { "None" }
      local values = { "None" }
      local profileNames = {}
      for name, _ in pairs(ConfigSystem.profiles) do
        table.insert(profileNames, name)
      end
      table.sort(profileNames, function(a, b)
        if a == "Default" then
          return true
        end
        if b == "Default" then
          return false
        end
        return a:lower() < b:lower()
      end)
      for _, name in ipairs(profileNames) do
        table.insert(options, name)
        table.insert(values, name)
      end
      if
        controlRegistry["SurvivorConfigProfile"]
        and controlRegistry["SurvivorConfigProfile"].updateOptions
      then
        controlRegistry["SurvivorConfigProfile"].updateOptions(
          options,
          values,
          Settings.SurvivorConfigProfile
        )
      end
      if
        controlRegistry["KillerConfigProfile"]
        and controlRegistry["KillerConfigProfile"].updateOptions
      then
        controlRegistry["KillerConfigProfile"].updateOptions(
          options,
          values,
          Settings.KillerConfigProfile
        )
      end
    end
    createSection(tabConfig, "Premium License +", UI.Accent)
    local premCard = Instance.new("Frame")
    premCard.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 80)
    premCard.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
    premCard.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
    premCard.Parent = tabConfig
    Instance.new("UICorner", premCard).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
    Instance.new("UIStroke", premCard).Color = UI.Stroke
    local statusText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    statusText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 20)
    statusText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 10)
    statusText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    statusText.TextColor3 = UI.Text
    statusText.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    statusText.TextSize = 13
    statusText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    statusText.Parent = premCard
    local function updatePremStatusText()
      if isPremiumActive() then
        statusText.Text = "Status: Premium Active (Key: " .. savedPremiumKey .. ")"
        statusText.TextColor3 = UI.Text
      else
        statusText.Text = "Status: Free Version"
        statusText.TextColor3 = UI.TextSub
      end
    end
    _G.VD_UpdatePremStatusText = updatePremStatusText
    updatePremStatusText()
    local keyInput = Instance.new("TextBox")
    keyInput.Size = UDim2.new(1, -210, 0, 26)
    keyInput.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 40)
    keyInput.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
    keyInput.BorderSizePixel = 0
    keyInput.Text = ""
    keyInput.PlaceholderText = "Enter premium key here..."
    keyInput.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 155, 170)
    keyInput.TextColor3 = UI.Text
    keyInput.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    keyInput.TextSize = 12
    keyInput.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    keyInput.Parent = premCard
    Instance.new("UICorner", keyInput).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    local kiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", keyInput)
    kiStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
    kiStroke.Thickness = 0.8
    local getKeyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    getKeyBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 26)
    getKeyBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -182, 0, 40)
    getKeyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
    getKeyBtn.Text = "GET KEY"
    getKeyBtn.TextColor3 = UI.Accent
    getKeyBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    getKeyBtn.TextSize = 11
    getKeyBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    getKeyBtn.Parent = premCard
    Instance.new("UICorner", getKeyBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    local gkStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", getKeyBtn)
    gkStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
    gkStroke.Thickness = 0.8
    getKeyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
      local discordLink = "https://t.me/gethypnosis"
      local copySuccess = false
      if setclipboard then
        pcall(function()
          setclipboard(discordLink)
          copySuccess = true
        end)
      elseif toclipboard then
        pcall(function()
          toclipboard(discordLink)
          copySuccess = true
        end)
      end
      if copySuccess then
        showNotification(
          "Telegram",
          "Link: t.me/gethypnosis copied to clipboard! Join to get your key.",
          "success"
        )
      else
        showNotification("Telegram", "Link: t.me/gethypnosis (Copied fallback)", "info")
      end
      if openurl then
        pcall(openurl, discordLink)
      end
    end)
    local redeemBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    redeemBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 26)
    redeemBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0, 40)
    redeemBtn.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
    redeemBtn.Text = "REDEEM"

    rdStroke.Thickness = 0.8

    local function refreshProfileList()
      for _, child in ipairs(listContainer:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Frame") then
          child:Destroy()
        end
      end
      local profileNames = {}
      for name, _ in pairs(ConfigSystem.profiles) do
        table.insert(profileNames, name)
      end
      table.sort(profileNames, function(a, b)
        if a == "Default" then
          return true
        end
        if b == "Default" then
          return false
        end
        return a:lower() < b:lower()
      end)
      for i, name in ipairs(profileNames) do
        local isActive = (ConfigSystem.activeProfile == name)
        local card = Instance.new("Frame")
        card.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42)
        card.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
        card.BackgroundTransparency = isActive and 0.3 or 0.6
        card.Parent = listContainer
        Instance.new("UICorner", card).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", card)
        stroke.Color = isActive and Color3.fromRGB(240, 242, 250) or UI.Stroke
        stroke.Thickness = isActive and 1.0 or 0.8
        local nameLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        nameLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, isActive and -150 or -80, 1, 0)
        nameLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
        nameLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        nameLbl.Text = name .. (isActive and "  [ACTIVE]" or "")
        nameLbl.TextColor3 = UI.Text
        nameLbl.Font = isActive and Enum.Font.Ubuntu or Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        nameLbl.TextSize = 13
        nameLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        nameLbl.Parent = card
        local btnsFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
        btnsFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, isActive and 60 or 126, 1, 0)
        btnsFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, isActive and -70 or -136, 0, 0)
        btnsFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        btnsFrame.Parent = card
        local btnLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        btnLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
        btnLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
        btnLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
        btnLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
        btnLayout.Parent = btnsFrame
        if not isActive then
          local loadBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
          loadBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 22)
          loadBtn.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
          loadBtn.Text = "LOAD"
          loadBtn.TextColor3 = UI.Text
          loadBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
          loadBtn.TextSize = 10
          loadBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
          loadBtn.Parent = btnsFrame
          Instance.new("UICorner", loadBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
          local lStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", loadBtn)
          lStroke.Color = UI.Stroke
          lStroke.Thickness = 0.8
          loadBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            TweenService
              :Create(
                loadBtn,
                TweenInfo.new(0.15),
                { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 38, 50) }
              )
              :Play()
          end)
          loadBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(loadBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated })
              :Play()
          end)
          loadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            loadProfile(name)
            refreshProfileList()
            showNotification(
              "Profile Loaded",
              "Configuration '" .. name .. "' successfully loaded!",
              "success"
            )
          end)
        end
        if name ~= "Default" then
          local delBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
          delBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 22)
          delBtn.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
          delBtn.Text = "DELETE"
          delBtn.TextColor3 = UI.Text
          delBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
          delBtn.TextSize = 10
          delBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
          delBtn.Parent = btnsFrame
          Instance.new("UICorner", delBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
          local dStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", delBtn)
          dStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 40, 50)
          dStroke.Thickness = 0.8
          delBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            TweenService
              :Create(
                delBtn,
                TweenInfo.new(0.15),
                { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 25, 32) }
              )
              :Play()
          end)
          delBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(delBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated })
              :Play()
          end)
          delBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            ConfigSystem.profiles[name] = nil
            if ConfigSystem.activeProfile == name then
              loadProfile("Default")
            else
              saveConfigs()
            end
            refreshProfileList()
            showNotification(
              "Profile Deleted",
              "Configuration '" .. name .. "' has been removed.",
              "info"
            )
          end)
        end
      end
      pcall(refreshTeamConfigSelectors)
    end
    saveBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
      local rawText = configNameBox.Text:gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
      local name = rawText
      if name == "" then
        name = ConfigSystem.activeProfile or "Default"
      end
      if name:len() > 20 then
        showNotification("Error", "Configuration name is too long (max 20 chars)", "error")
        return
      end
      task.spawn(function()
        ConfigSystem.profiles[name] = serializeTable(Settings)
        ConfigSystem.activeProfile = name
        saveConfigs()
        configNameBox.Text = ""
        pcall(refreshProfileList)
        showNotification(
          "Profile Saved",
          "Configuration '" .. name .. "' successfully saved!",
          "success"
        )
      end)
    end)
    refreshProfileList()
