    local barColorValues =
      { "auto", "red", "orange", "yellow", "green", "cyan", "blue", "purple", "pink", "white" }
    local barColorMap = {
      auto = nil,
      red = Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38),
      orange = Color3.fromRGB(234, 88, 12),
      yellow = Color3.fromRGB(234, 179, 8),
      green = Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94),
      cyan = Color3.fromRGB(6, 182, 212),
      blue = Color3.fromRGB(59, 130, 246),
      purple = Color3.fromRGB(139, 92, 246),
      pink = Color3.fromRGB(236, 72, 153),
      white = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    }
    local function applyBarColor(colorKey)
      local topBar = mainFrame and mainFrame:FindFirstChild("TopRainbowBar")
      if not topBar then
        return
      end
      local col = barColorMap[colorKey]
      if col then
        topBar.BackgroundColor3 = col
        local c = col
        Settings.TopBarColor = { r = c.R, g = c.G, b = c.B }
      else
        topBar.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Accent
        Settings.TopBarColor = nil
      end
      pcall(saveSettings)
    end
    local initBarVal = "auto"
    if Settings.TopBarColor and type(Settings.TopBarColor) == "table" then
      local sc = Color3.new(Settings.TopBarColor.r, Settings.TopBarColor.g, Settings.TopBarColor.b)
      for k, col in pairs(barColorMap) do
        if
          col
          and math.abs(col.R - sc.R) < 0.01
          and math.abs(col.G - sc.G) < 0.01
          and math.abs(col.B - sc.B) < 0.01
        then
          initBarVal = k
          break
        end
      end
    end
    task.defer(function()
      applyBarColor(initBarVal)
    end)

    importBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
      local raw = importBox.Text
      if raw == "" then
        showNotification("Import Config", "Paste a JSON config string first!", "warning")
        return
      end
      local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
        return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw)
      end)
      if not ok or type(decoded) ~= "table" then
        showNotification("Import Config", "Invalid JSON! Check the format.", "error")
        return
      end
      local count = 0
      local ok2 = pcall(function()
        deserializeTable(Settings, FactorySettings)
        deserializeTable(Settings, decoded)
        if not isPremiumActive() then
          enforceFreeRestrictions()
        end
      end)
      if ok2 then
        for k, _ in pairs(decoded) do
          count = count + 1
        end
      end
      pcall(saveSettings)
      if updateUIFromSettings then
        pcall(updateUIFromSettings)
      end
      showNotification(
        "Import Config",
        "Imported " .. count .. " settings successfully!",
        "success"
      )
      importBox.Text = ""
    end)

        local ok2, json = pcall(function()
          local serialized = serializeTable(Settings)
          return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(serialized)
        end)
        if ok2 and json and #json > 0 then
          local clipOk = false
          pcall(function()
            if setclipboard then
              setclipboard(json)
              clipOk = true
            elseif Clipboard and Clipboard.set then
              Clipboard.set(json)
              clipOk = true
            end
          end)
          if importBox then
            importBox.Text = json
          end
          if clipOk then
            showNotification("Get Config JSON", "Config JSON copied to clipboard!", "success")
          else
            showNotification(
              "Get Config JSON",
              "Config JSON generated! (Copied to text box above)",
              "success"
            )
          end
        else
          showNotification("Get Config JSON", "Failed to encode settings!", "error")
        end
      end)
    end, UI.Accent, "GetConfigJson")

    local function getUnifiedKeybindRows()
      local keybinds = Settings.Keybinds or {}
      local list = {}
      local seenNames = {}
      for k, v in pairs(keybinds) do
        if v and v ~= "None" and v ~= "" then
          local info = technicalBinds[k]
          local dispName = info and info.name or k
          local dispShort = info and info.short or dispName
          local checkFn = info and info.check
            or function()
              if keybindGetters and keybindGetters[k] then
                return keybindGetters[k]() == true
              end
              if Settings[k] ~= nil then
                return Settings[k] == true
              end
              return false
            end
          table.insert(
            list,
            { key = k, val = v, name = dispName, short = dispShort, check = checkFn }
          )
          seenNames[dispName] = true
        end
      end
      for _, feat in ipairs(activeFeaturesListConfig) do
        if feat.check() and not seenNames[feat.name] then
          table.insert(
            list,
            { key = feat.name, val = "", name = feat.name, short = feat.short or feat.name, check = feat.check }
          )
          seenNames[feat.name] = true
        end
      end
      table.sort(list, function(a, b)
        return a.name:lower() < b.name:lower()
      end)
      return list
    end
    local hotkeyRowsMap = {}
    local function buildHotkeyList()
      for _, child in ipairs(hotkeyScroll:GetChildren()) do
        if child.Name == "HotkeyRow" then
          child:Destroy()
        end
      end
      local sorted = getUnifiedKeybindRows()
      for _, item in ipairs(sorted) do
        local isEnabled = item.check()
        local row = Instance.new("Frame")
        row.Name = "HotkeyRow"
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
        row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        row.Parent = hotkeyScroll
        local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 1, 0)
        nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        nameLabel.Text = item.name
        nameLabel.TextColor3 = isEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
          or Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
        nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        nameLabel.TextSize = 11.5
        nameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        nameLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        nameLabel.Parent = row
        local keyLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        keyLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 1, 0)
        keyLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 0, 0)
        keyLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        keyLabel.Text = (item.val and item.val ~= "") and getFriendlyKeyName(item.val):upper()
          or "ACTIVE"
        keyLabel.TextColor3 = isEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
          or Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
        keyLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        keyLabel.TextSize = 11.5
        keyLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
        keyLabel.Parent = row
      end
      if #sorted == 0 then
        local none = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        none.Name = "HotkeyRow"
        none.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
        none.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        none.Text = "No active technical hotkeys assigned"
        none.TextColor3 = UI.Muted
        none.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        none.TextSize = 11.5
        none.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        none.Parent = hotkeyScroll
      end
    end
    buildHotkeyList()
    createButton(tabConfig, "Refresh Hotkey List", "Refresh", function()
      buildHotkeyList()
    end, UI.Accent, "RefreshHotkeys")
    do
      local hotkeyOverlay = nil
      local overlayActive = Settings.ShowHotkeyOverlay or false
      local savedHotkeyPos = UDim2.new(1, -175, 0.5, -60)
      local hotkeyRowRefs = {}
      local noneLabel = nil
      local cooldownOverlay = nil
      local savedCooldownPos = UDim2.new(1, -175, 0.5, 65)
      local cooldownRowRefs = {}
      local function getPerkLiveStatus(perkKey)
        local now = tick()
        local readyColor = UI.Accent or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        if perkKey == "Flowstate" then
          if not Settings.FlowstatePerk then
            return "OFF", Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
          end
          local boostRem = (_G.VD_FlowstateActiveOverrideEnd or 0) - now
          if boostRem > 0 then
            return string.format("BOOST %.1fs", boostRem), Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 255)
          end
          local cdRem = (_G.VD_FlowstateCooldownEnd or 0) - now
          if cdRem > 0 then
            return string.format("%ds", math.ceil(cdRem)), Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 85)
          end
          return "READY", readyColor
        elseif perkKey == "QuickRecovery" then
          if not Settings.SimulateQuickRecovery then
            return "OFF", Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
          end
          local boostRem = (_G.VD_QuickRecoveryBoostEnd or 0) - now
          if boostRem > 0 then
            return string.format("BOOST %.1fs", boostRem), Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 255)
          end
          local cdRem = (_G.VD_QuickRecoveryCooldownEnd or 0) - now
          if cdRem > 0 then
            return string.format("%ds", math.ceil(cdRem)), Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 85)
          end
          return "READY", readyColor
        elseif perkKey == "PerfectLanding" then
          if not Settings.SimulatePerfectLanding then
            return "OFF", Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
          end
          local boostRem = (_G.VD_PerfectLandingBoostEnd or 0) - now
          if boostRem > 0 then
            return string.format("BOOST %.1fs", boostRem), Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 255)
          end
          local cdRem = (_G.VD_PerfectLandingCooldownEnd or 0) - now
          if cdRem > 0 then
            return string.format("%ds", math.ceil(cdRem)), Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 85)
          end
          return "READY", readyColor
        end
        return nil, nil
      end
      local function buildCooldownOverlay()
        if cooldownOverlay then
          pcall(function()
            cooldownOverlay:Destroy()
          end)
          cooldownOverlay = nil
        end
        cooldownRowRefs = {}
        local showFS = Settings.FlowstateCooldownUI == true
          and not (overlayActive and Settings.FlowstatePerk)
        local showQR = Settings.QuickRecoveryCooldownUI == true
          and not (overlayActive and Settings.SimulateQuickRecovery)
        local showPL = Settings.PerfectLandingCooldownUI == true
          and not (overlayActive and Settings.SimulatePerfectLanding)
        if not showFS and not showQR and not showPL then
          return
        end
        local parentGui = screenGui
          or (
            localPlayer
            and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            and localPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("JLXHelperGui")
          )
        if not parentGui or not _G.VD_ExecutionConfirmed then
          return
        end
        cooldownOverlay = Instance.new("Frame")
        cooldownOverlay.Name = "VD_CooldownOverlay"
        cooldownOverlay.Size = UDim2.new(0, 165, 0, 0)
        cooldownOverlay.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        cooldownOverlay.Position = savedCooldownPos
        cooldownOverlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 10, 20)
        cooldownOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
        cooldownOverlay.BorderSizePixel = 0
        cooldownOverlay.ZIndex = 998
        Instance.new("UICorner", cooldownOverlay).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        local os = Instance.new("UIStroke", cooldownOverlay)
        os.Color = UI.Stroke
        os.Thickness = 1
        local op = Instance.new("UIPadding", cooldownOverlay)
        op.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
        op.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)
        op.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6)
        op.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6)
        local ol = Instance.new("UIListLayout", cooldownOverlay)
        ol.Padding = UDim.new(0, 3)
        local itemsToBuild = {}
        if showFS then
          table.insert(itemsToBuild, {
            key = "Flowstate",
            label = "Flowstate",
            check = function()
              return Settings.FlowstatePerk == true
            end,
          })
        end
        if showQR then
          table.insert(itemsToBuild, {
            key = "QuickRecovery",
            label = "Quick Recovery",
            check = function()
              return Settings.SimulateQuickRecovery == true
            end,
          })
        end
        if showPL then
          table.insert(itemsToBuild, {
            key = "PerfectLanding",
            label = "Perfect Landing",
            check = function()
              return Settings.SimulatePerfectLanding == true
            end,
          })
        end
        for _, entry in ipairs(itemsToBuild) do
          local isEnabled = entry.check()
          local statusText, statusColor = getPerkLiveStatus(entry.key)
          local row = Instance.new("Frame")
          row.Name = "CooldownRow_" .. entry.key
          row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
          row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
          row.ZIndex = 999
          row.Parent = cooldownOverlay
          local nl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
          nl.Size = UDim2.new(0.58, 0, 1, 0)
          nl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
          nl.Text = entry.label
          nl.TextColor3 = isEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            or Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
          nl.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
          nl.TextSize = 10
          nl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
          nl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
          nl.ZIndex = 999
          nl.Parent = row
          local kl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
          kl.Size = UDim2.new(0.42, 0, 1, 0)
          kl.Position = UDim2.new(0.58, 0, 0, 0)
          kl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
          kl.Text = statusText or "READY"
          kl.TextColor3 = statusColor or (UI.Accent or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
          kl.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
          kl.TextSize = 10
          kl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
          kl.ZIndex = 999
          kl.Parent = row
          cooldownRowRefs[entry.key] = { entry = entry, row = row, nameLabel = nl, keyLabel = kl }
        end
        local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
        cooldownOverlay.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
          if
            inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
          then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = inp.Position
            startPos = cooldownOverlay.Position
          end
        end)
        cooldownOverlay.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
          if
            dragging
            and (
              inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
              or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            )
          then
            local d = inp.Position - dragStart
            local newPos = UDim2.new(
              startPos.X.Scale,
              startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
              startPos.Y.Scale,
              startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y
            )
            cooldownOverlay.Position = newPos
            savedCooldownPos = newPos
          end
        end)
        cooldownOverlay.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
          if
            inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
          then
            dragging = false
          end
        end)
        cooldownOverlay.Parent = parentGui
      end
      local function buildHotkeyOverlay()
        if hotkeyOverlay then
          pcall(function()
            hotkeyOverlay:Destroy()
          end)
          hotkeyOverlay = nil
        end
        hotkeyRowRefs = {}
        noneLabel = nil
        if not overlayActive or not _G.VD_ExecutionConfirmed then
          return
        end
        local parentGui = screenGui
          or (
            localPlayer
            and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            and localPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("JLXHelperGui")
          )
        if not parentGui then
          return
        end
        hotkeyOverlay = Instance.new("Frame")
        hotkeyOverlay.Name = "VD_HotkeyOverlay"
        hotkeyOverlay.Size = UDim2.new(0, 165, 0, 0)
        hotkeyOverlay.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        hotkeyOverlay.Position = savedHotkeyPos
        hotkeyOverlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 10, 20)
        hotkeyOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
        hotkeyOverlay.BorderSizePixel = 0
        hotkeyOverlay.ZIndex = 998

        os.Thickness = 1

        op.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
        op.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)
        op.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6)
        op.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6)
        local ol = Instance.new("UIListLayout", hotkeyOverlay)
        ol.Padding = UDim.new(0, 3)
        local sorted = getUnifiedKeybindRows()
        for _, item in ipairs(sorted) do
          local isEnabled = item.check()
          local row = Instance.new("Frame")
          row.Name = "OverlayRow_" .. item.name
          row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
          row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
          row.ZIndex = 999
          row.Parent = hotkeyOverlay
          local nl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
          nl.Size = UDim2.new(0.58, 0, 1, 0)
          nl.BackgroundTransparency = 1

          kl.Position = UDim2.new(0.58, 0, 0, 0)
          kl.BackgroundTransparency = 1

          kl.TextColor3 = isEnabled and (UI.Accent or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))

          kl.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
          kl.TextSize = 10
          kl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
          kl.ZIndex = 999

      local function updateOverlayStatesSmoothly()
        if cooldownOverlay and cooldownOverlay.Parent then
          local cStroke = cooldownOverlay:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
          if cStroke and UI.Stroke then
            cStroke.Color = UI.Stroke
          end
          for key, ref in pairs(cooldownRowRefs) do
            local isEnabled = ref.entry.check() == true
            local statusText, statusColor = getPerkLiveStatus(key)
            ref.nameLabel.TextColor3 = isEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
              or Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
            if statusText then
              ref.keyLabel.Text = statusText
              ref.keyLabel.TextColor3 = statusColor
            end
          end
        end
        if not overlayActive or not hotkeyOverlay or not hotkeyOverlay.Parent then
          return
        end
        local hStroke = hotkeyOverlay:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        if hStroke and UI.Stroke then
          hStroke.Color = UI.Stroke
        end
        local activeCount = 0
        for name, ref in pairs(hotkeyRowRefs) do
          local newState = ref.item.check() == true
          if newState then
            activeCount = activeCount + 1
          end
          local isFS = (name == "Flowstate Perk") and Settings.FlowstateCooldownUI
          local isQR = (name == "Simulate Quick Recovery") and Settings.QuickRecoveryCooldownUI
          local isPL = (name == "Simulate Perfect Landing") and Settings.PerfectLandingCooldownUI
          if isFS or isQR or isPL then
            local perkKey = isFS and "Flowstate" or (isQR and "QuickRecovery" or "PerfectLanding")
            local statusText, statusColor = getPerkLiveStatus(perkKey)
            local keyStr = (ref.item.val and ref.item.val ~= "")
                and ("[" .. getFriendlyKeyName(ref.item.val):upper() .. "] ")
              or ""
            ref.nameLabel.TextColor3 = newState and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
              or Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
            ref.keyLabel.Text = keyStr .. (statusText or "READY")
            ref.keyLabel.TextColor3 = statusColor or (UI.Accent or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
            ref.currentState = newState
          else
            local baseKeyText = (ref.item.val and ref.item.val ~= "")
                and getFriendlyKeyName(ref.item.val):upper()
              or ""
            local activeKeyColor = UI.Accent or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            if ref.keyLabel.Text ~= baseKeyText then
              ref.keyLabel.Text = baseKeyText
              ref.keyLabel.TextColor3 = newState and activeKeyColor or Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 120)
            end
            if ref.currentState ~= newState then
              ref.currentState = newState
              local targetColor = newState and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                or Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
              local targetKeyColor = newState and activeKeyColor or Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 120)
              TweenService:Create(
                ref.nameLabel,
                TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                { TextColor3 = targetColor }
              ):Play()
              TweenService:Create(
                ref.keyLabel,
                TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                { TextColor3 = targetKeyColor }
              ):Play()
            elseif newState and ref.keyLabel.TextColor3 ~= activeKeyColor then
              ref.keyLabel.TextColor3 = activeKeyColor
            end
          end
        end
      end
      _G.VD_RefreshHotkeys = function()
        pcall(buildHotkeyList)
        pcall(buildHotkeyOverlay)
        pcall(buildCooldownOverlay)
      end
      _G.VD_RefreshCooldownOverlay = function()

        pcall(updateOverlayStatesSmoothly)
      end

          buildHotkeyOverlay()
          buildCooldownOverlay()
        end,
        UI.Accent,
        "ShowHotkeyOverlay"
      )

        while activeLoop do

            or (cooldownOverlay and cooldownOverlay.Parent)
          if hasActiveOverlay then

          end
          task.wait(0.15)
        end
      end)

    createSection(tabConfig, "Spectator List Overlay", UI.AccentCyan)
    do
      local spectatorListOverlay = nil
      local spectatorListActive = Settings.ShowSpectatorList or false
      local savedSpectatorListPos = UDim2.new(1, -175, 0.5, -130)
      local lastSpectatorSignature = nil
      local function buildSpectatorListOverlay(forceRebuild)
        if not spectatorListActive or not _G.VD_ExecutionConfirmed then
          if spectatorListOverlay then
            pcall(function()
              spectatorListOverlay:Destroy()
            end)
            spectatorListOverlay = nil
          end
          lastSpectatorSignature = nil
          return
        end
        local parentGui = screenGui
          or (
            localPlayer
            and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            and localPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("JLXHelperGui")
          )
        if not parentGui then
          return
        end
        local spectators = {}
        local sigParts = {}
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
          if player ~= localPlayer then
            local team = player.Team
            local teamName = team and team.Name or ""
            local isSpecTeam = teamName == "Spectator"
              or teamName == "Spectators"
              or teamName:lower():find("spec")
              or teamName:lower():find("lobby")
            local char = player.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local isDead = (char and hum and hum.Health <= 0)
              or player:GetAttribute("IsDead") == true
              or (char and char:GetAttribute("Dead") == true)
            local isLobby = not char
              or not char.Parent
              or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
              or (teamName ~= "Killer" and teamName ~= "Survivors")
            if isDead or isSpecTeam or isLobby then
              local statusTag = "[SPEC]"
              local tagColor = UI.AccentCyan
              if isDead then
                statusTag = "[DEAD]"
                tagColor = UI.Danger
              elseif isLobby and not isSpecTeam then
                statusTag = "[LOBBY]"
                tagColor = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190)
              end
              local pName = (
                _G.VD_SpoofedNames
                and (_G.VD_SpoofedNames[player.UserId] or _G.VD_SpoofedNames[player.Name])
              )
                or player.DisplayName
                or player.Name
              if Settings.SurvivorESP and Settings.SurvivorESP.CensorNames then
                pName = "Player " .. string.sub(player.UserId, 1, 3)
              end
              table.insert(spectators, { name = pName, tag = statusTag, color = tagColor })
              table.insert(sigParts, pName .. ":" .. statusTag)
            end
          end
        end
        local currentSig = table.concat(sigParts, "|")
        if
          not forceRebuild
          and spectatorListOverlay
          and spectatorListOverlay.Parent == parentGui
          and currentSig == lastSpectatorSignature
        then
          return
        end
        lastSpectatorSignature = currentSig
        if spectatorListOverlay then
          pcall(function()
            spectatorListOverlay:Destroy()
          end)
          spectatorListOverlay = nil
        end
        spectatorListOverlay = Instance.new("Frame")
        spectatorListOverlay.Name = "VD_SpectatorListOverlay"
        spectatorListOverlay.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 0)
        spectatorListOverlay.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        spectatorListOverlay.Position = savedSpectatorListPos
        spectatorListOverlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 10, 20)
        spectatorListOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
        spectatorListOverlay.BorderSizePixel = 0

        padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6)
        padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6)
        local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", spectatorListOverlay)
        layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 3)
        for _, spec in ipairs(spectators) do
          local row = Instance.new("Frame")
          row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
          row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
          row.ZIndex = 999
          row.Parent = spectatorListOverlay

          nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
          nameLabel.Text = spec.name
          nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220)
          nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
          nameLabel.TextSize = 10
          nameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
          nameLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
          nameLabel.ZIndex = 999
          nameLabel.Parent = row

          tagLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 0, 0)
          tagLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
          tagLabel.Text = spec.tag
          tagLabel.TextColor3 = spec.color
          tagLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
          tagLabel.TextSize = 10
          tagLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
          tagLabel.ZIndex = 999
          tagLabel.Parent = row
        end
        if #spectators == 0 then
          local none = Instance.new("TextLabel")
          none.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)

          none.Text = "No spectators"
          none.TextColor3 = UI.Muted
          none.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
          none.TextSize = 10
          none.ZIndex = 999
          none.Parent = spectatorListOverlay
        end
        local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
        spectatorListOverlay.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
          if
            inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
          then
            dragging = true

            startPos = spectatorListOverlay.Position
          end
        end)

              or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch

          then
            local d = inp.Position - dragStart
            local newPos = UDim2.new(
              startPos.X.Scale,

          then

    local function resetToDefaultSettings(skipNotification)
      activeHoldKeybinds = {}
      local newKeybinds = {}
      if FactorySettings and type(FactorySettings.Keybinds) == "table" then
        for k, _ in pairs(FactorySettings.Keybinds) do
          newKeybinds[k] = (k == "ToggleUI" and "K" or "None")
        end
      end
      if type(Settings.Keybinds) == "table" then
        for k, _ in pairs(Settings.Keybinds) do

        end

      Settings.Keybinds = newKeybinds
      Settings.MobileButtons = {}
      Settings.MobileButtonPositions = {}
      if mobileFloatingButtons then

          end)
        end
        mobileFloatingButtons = {}
      end
      Settings.UserCustomEmotes = {}
      Settings.RemoteDropPalletKey = "None"
      Settings.EmoteWheelKey = "F"
      local function cleanAndDeserialize(target, source)
        if type(target) ~= "table" or type(source) ~= "table" then
          return
        end
        for k in pairs(target) do
          if source[k] == nil then
            target[k] = nil
          end
        end
        for k, v in pairs(source) do
          if type(v) == "table" then
            if isColor3Table(v) then
              target[k] = parseColor3(v)
            else
              if type(target[k]) ~= "table" then
                target[k] = {}
              end
              cleanAndDeserialize(target[k], v)
            end
          else
            target[k] = v
          end
        end
      end
      cleanAndDeserialize(Settings, FactorySettings)
      Settings.Keybinds = newKeybinds
      Settings.MobileButtons = {}
      Settings.MobileButtonPositions = {}
      Settings.UserCustomEmotes = {}

        Settings.DBDSounds.Enabled = false

      if Settings.DBDHud then
        Settings.DBDHud.Enabled = false
      end
      Settings.ShowHotkeyOverlay = false
      Settings.ShowSpectatorList = false
      Settings.ShowInfoBanner = false
      Settings.ShowLiveFPS = false
      pcall(function()
        local parentGui = screenGui
          or (
            localPlayer
            and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            and localPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("JLXHelperGui")
          )
        if parentGui then
          local hotkeyOvl = parentGui:FindFirstChild("VD_HotkeyOverlay")
          if hotkeyOvl then
            hotkeyOvl.Visible = false
          end
          local cdOvl = parentGui:FindFirstChild("VD_CooldownOverlay")
          if cdOvl then
            cdOvl.Visible = false
          end
          local specList = parentGui:FindFirstChild("VD_SpectatorList")
          if specList then
            specList.Visible = false
          end
          local infoBnr = parentGui:FindFirstChild("VD_InfoBanner")
          if infoBnr then
            infoBnr.Visible = false
          end
          local liveFps = parentGui:FindFirstChild("VD_LiveFPSCounter")
          if liveFps then
            liveFps.Visible = false
          end
        end
      end)
      if updateUIFromSettings then
        pcall(updateUIFromSettings)
      end
      if _G.VD_RefreshHotkeys then
        pcall(_G.VD_RefreshHotkeys)
      end
      if _G.VD_RefreshCooldownOverlay then
        pcall(_G.VD_RefreshCooldownOverlay)
      end
      if buildHotkeyList then
        pcall(buildHotkeyList)
      end
      if _G.VD_UpdateSpectatorListOverlay then
        pcall(_G.VD_UpdateSpectatorListOverlay)
      end
      pcall(saveSettings)
      if _G.VD_RefreshProfileList then
        pcall(_G.VD_RefreshProfileList)
      end
      if not skipNotification then
        showNotification(
          "Reset Complete",
          "All settings and keybinds have been reset to factory defaults!",
          "success"
        )
      end
    end
    _G.VD_ResetToDefaultSettings = resetToDefaultSettings
    local function handleReset()
      resetToDefaultSettings(false)
    end
    resetBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(handleReset)
    pcall(function()
      resetBtn.TouchTap:Connect(handleReset)
    end)
    pcall(function()
      resetBtn.Activated:Connect(handleReset)
    end)
    local isUnloading = false
    local isReopeningLauncher = false
    local launcherCard = Instance.new("Frame")
    launcherCard.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)
    launcherCard.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
    launcherCard.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
    launcherCard.Parent = tabConfig
    Instance.new("UICorner", launcherCard).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
    Instance.new("UIStroke", launcherCard).Color = UI.Stroke
    local reopenLauncherBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    reopenLauncherBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 26)
    reopenLauncherBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 11)
    reopenLauncherBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
    reopenLauncherBtn.Text = "REOPEN LAUNCHER (SWITCH VERSION)"
    reopenLauncherBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    reopenLauncherBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    reopenLauncherBtn.TextSize = 11.5
    reopenLauncherBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    reopenLauncherBtn.Parent = launcherCard
    Instance.new("UICorner", reopenLauncherBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    local reopenBtnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", reopenLauncherBtn)
    reopenBtnStroke.Color = UI.Stroke
    reopenBtnStroke.Thickness = 0.5
    reopenLauncherBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
      TweenService:Create(
        reopenLauncherBtn,
        TweenInfo.new(0.15),
        { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60) }
      ):Play()
    end)
    reopenLauncherBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
      TweenService:Create(
        reopenLauncherBtn,
        TweenInfo.new(0.15),
        { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40) }
      ):Play()
    end)
    local function handleReopenLauncher()
      if isUnloading or isReopeningLauncher then
        return
      end
      isReopeningLauncher = true
      reopenLauncherBtn.Text = "OPENING LAUNCHER..."
      task.spawn(function()
        local httpSvc = httpService or game:GetService("HttpService")
        local storageFolder = "gethypnosis.xyz"
        local launcherPath = storageFolder .. "/Launcher.json"
        local isf = isfolder or (syn and syn.isfolder)
        local mkf = makefolder or (syn and syn.makefolder)
        local isfl = isfile or make_isfile or (syn and syn.isfile)
        local rfl = readfile or make_readfile or (syn and syn.readfile)
        local wfl = writefile or make_writefile or (syn and syn.writefile)
        local dfl = delfile or (syn and syn.delfile)
        pcall(function()
          if mkf and (not isf or not isf(storageFolder)) then
            pcall(mkf, storageFolder)
          end
          local savedVersion = nil
          if isfl and rfl then
            local okEx, exists = pcall(isfl, launcherPath)
            if okEx and exists then
              local okRaw, raw = pcall(rfl, launcherPath)
              if okRaw and type(raw) == "string" and #raw > 0 then
                local okDec, dec = pcall(function()
                  return httpSvc:JSONDecode(raw)
                end)
                if okDec and type(dec) == "table" and type(dec.version) == "string" then
                  savedVersion = dec.version
                end
              end
            end
          end
          if wfl then
            local okWrite = pcall(
              wfl,
              launcherPath,
              httpSvc:JSONEncode({
                version = savedVersion,
                remember = false,
                updatedAt = (os.time and os.time()) or 0,
              })
            )
            if not okWrite and dfl and isfl and isfl(launcherPath) then
              pcall(dfl, launcherPath)
            end
          elseif dfl and isfl and isfl(launcherPath) then
            pcall(dfl, launcherPath)
          end
        end)
        local function fetchUrl(url)
          local okGet, body = pcall(function()
            return game:HttpGet(url)
          end)
          if okGet and type(body) == "string" and #body > 0 then
            return body
          end
          local reqFn = (syn and syn.request)
            or (http and http.request)
            or http_request
            or (fluxus and fluxus.request)
            or request
          if type(reqFn) == "function" then
            local okReq, res = pcall(reqFn, { Url = url, Method = "GET" })
            if okReq and type(res) == "table" and type(res.Body) == "string" and #res.Body > 0 then
              local code = res.StatusCode
              if code == nil or (code >= 200 and code < 300) then
                return res.Body
              end
            end
          end
          return nil
        end
        local stamp = tostring(math.floor((os.time and os.time()) or tick()))
        local candidateUrls = {
          "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lixxWW/ViolenceDistrict/refs/heads/main/ViolenceDistrict.lua?t="
            .. stamp,
          "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lixxWW/ViolenceDistrict/main/ViolenceDistrict.lua?t="
            .. stamp,
          "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lixxWW/ViolenceDistrict/refs/heads/main/ViolenceDistrict.lua",
        }
        local launcherSrc = nil
        for i = 1, #candidateUrls do
          launcherSrc = fetchUrl(candidateUrls[i])
          if launcherSrc then
            break
          end
        end
        if isUnloading then
          return
        end
        if not launcherSrc then
          isReopeningLauncher = false
          if reopenLauncherBtn and reopenLauncherBtn.Parent then
            reopenLauncherBtn.Text = "REOPEN LAUNCHER (SWITCH VERSION)"
          end
          pcall(
            showNotification,
            "Launcher Error",
            "Remembered option cleared, but failed to download launcher. Check your connection and try again.",
            "warning"
          )
          return
        end
        local loadFn = loadstring
        if type(loadFn) ~= "function" then
          isReopeningLauncher = false
          if reopenLauncherBtn and reopenLauncherBtn.Parent then
            reopenLauncherBtn.Text = "REOPEN LAUNCHER (SWITCH VERSION)"
          end
          pcall(
            showNotification,
            "Launcher Error",
            "Executor does not support loadstring().",
            "warning"
          )
          return
        end
        local compiledLauncher, compileErr = loadFn(launcherSrc)
        if type(compiledLauncher) ~= "function" then
          isReopeningLauncher = false
          if reopenLauncherBtn and reopenLauncherBtn.Parent then
            reopenLauncherBtn.Text = "REOPEN LAUNCHER (SWITCH VERSION)"
          end
          pcall(
            showNotification,
            "Launcher Error",
            "Failed to compile launcher: " .. tostring(compileErr),
            "warning"
          )
          return
        end
        isUnloading = true
        pcall(doCleanup)
        task.wait(0.25)
        local okRun, runErr = pcall(compiledLauncher)
        if not okRun then
          warn("[VD] Failed to launch version chooser:", runErr)
        end
      end)
    end
    reopenLauncherBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(handleReopenLauncher)
    pcall(function()
      reopenLauncherBtn.TouchTap:Connect(handleReopenLauncher)
    end)
    pcall(function()
      reopenLauncherBtn.Activated:Connect(handleReopenLauncher)
    end)
    local unloadCard = Instance.new("Frame")
    unloadCard.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)
    unloadCard.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
    unloadCard.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
    unloadCard.Parent = tabConfig
    Instance.new("UICorner", unloadCard).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
    Instance.new("UIStroke", unloadCard).Color = UI.Stroke
    local unloadBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    unloadBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 26)
    unloadBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 11)
    unloadBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
    unloadBtn.Text = "UNLOAD SCRIPT & DESTROY UI"
    unloadBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    unloadBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    unloadBtn.TextSize = 11.5
    unloadBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    unloadBtn.Parent = unloadCard
    Instance.new("UICorner", unloadBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    local unloadBtnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", unloadBtn)
    unloadBtnStroke.Color = UI.Stroke
    unloadBtnStroke.Thickness = 0.5
    unloadBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
      TweenService
        :Create(unloadBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60) })
        :Play()
    end)
    unloadBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
      TweenService
        :Create(unloadBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40) })
        :Play()
    end)
    local function handleUnload()
      if isUnloading then
        return
      end
      isUnloading = true
      doCleanup()
    end
    unloadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(handleUnload)
    pcall(function()
      unloadBtn.TouchTap:Connect(handleUnload)
    end)
    pcall(function()
      unloadBtn.Activated:Connect(handleUnload)
    end)
    _G.VD_RefreshProfileList = refreshProfileList
  end
end
initConfigTab()
local function initCommunityTab()
  tabCommunity = createTab("Community", "rbxassetid://7733746980", "Config Hub")
  do
    local defaultCommunityConfigs = {}
    local currentConfigs = defaultCommunityConfigs
    local globalStats = {}
    local userInteractions = { likes = {}, loads = {} }
    local function supabaseRequest(endpoint, method, body)
      local requestFunc = getRequestFunction()
      if not requestFunc then
        return nil
      end
      local headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json", ["x-vd-build"] = OFFICIAL_BUILD_ID }
      if method == "POST" then
        headers["Prefer"] = "return=minimal"
      end
      local url = (SERVER_API_URL or _G.VD_SERVER_URL or "http://78.154.103.2:9156")
        .. "/api/configs"
        .. (endpoint or "")
      local ok, response =
        pcall(requestFunc, { Url = url, Method = method, Headers = headers, Body = body })
      if not ok then
      else
      end
      return ok and response or nil
    end
    local function fetchStats()
      local userResponse = supabaseRequest(
        "/rest/v1/config_interactions?username=eq." .. httpService:UrlEncode(localPlayer.Name),
        "GET"
      )
      if userResponse and (userResponse.StatusCode == 200 or userResponse.status == 200) then
        local success, decoded = pcall(function()
          return httpService:JSONDecode(userResponse.Body)
        end)
        if success and type(decoded) == "table" then
          userInteractions.likes = {}
          userInteractions.loads = {}
          for _, row in ipairs(decoded) do
            if row.interaction_type == "like" then
              userInteractions.likes[row.config_name] = true
            elseif row.interaction_type == "load" then
              userInteractions.loads[row.config_name] = true
            end
          end
        end
      end
      local statsResponse = supabaseRequest("/rest/v1/rpc/get_config_stats", "POST", "{}")
      if statsResponse and (statsResponse.StatusCode == 200 or statsResponse.status == 200) then
        local success, decoded = pcall(function()
          return httpService:JSONDecode(statsResponse.Body)
        end)
        if success and type(decoded) == "table" then
          globalStats = {}
          for _, row in ipairs(decoded) do
            globalStats[row.config_name] =
              { likes = tonumber(row.likes_count) or 0, loads = tonumber(row.loads_count) or 0 }
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local function toggleLike(configName)
      local isLiked = userInteractions.likes[configName]
      if isLiked then
        local endpoint = string.format(
          "/rest/v1/config_interactions?username=eq.%s&config_name=eq.%s&interaction_type=eq.like",
          httpService:UrlEncode(localPlayer.Name),
          httpService:UrlEncode(configName)
        )
        task.spawn(function()
          supabaseRequest(endpoint, "DELETE")
        end)
        userInteractions.likes[configName] = nil
        if globalStats[configName] then
          globalStats[configName].likes = math.max(0, globalStats[configName].likes - 1)
        end
      else
        local body = httpService:JSONEncode({
          username = localPlayer.Name,
          config_name = configName,
          interaction_type = "like",
        })
        task.spawn(function()
          supabaseRequest("/rest/v1/config_interactions", "POST", body)
        end)
        userInteractions.likes[configName] = true
        if not globalStats[configName] then
          globalStats[configName] = { likes = 0, loads = 0 }
        end
        globalStats[configName].likes = globalStats[configName].likes + 1
      end
    end
    local function registerLoad(configName)
      local isLoaded = userInteractions.loads[configName]
      if not isLoaded then
        local body = httpService:JSONEncode({
          username = localPlayer.Name,
          config_name = configName,
          interaction_type = "load",
        })
        task.spawn(function()
          supabaseRequest("/rest/v1/config_interactions", "POST", body)
        end)
        userInteractions.loads[configName] = true
        if not globalStats[configName] then
          globalStats[configName] = { likes = 0, loads = 0 }
        end
        globalStats[configName].loads = globalStats[configName].loads + 1
      end
    end
    createSection(tabCommunity, "Config Hub", UI.Accent)
    local hubHeader = Instance.new("Frame")
    hubHeader.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60)
    hubHeader.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
    hubHeader.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
    hubHeader.Parent = tabCommunity
    Instance.new("UICorner", hubHeader).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
    Instance.new("UIStroke", hubHeader).Color = UI.Stroke
    local hubHeaderLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    hubHeaderLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
    hubHeaderLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
    hubHeaderLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hubHeaderLabel.Text =
      "Browse & share configurations with the community. Submit your own or load one from the feed below."
    hubHeaderLabel.TextColor3 = UI.Text
    hubHeaderLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    hubHeaderLabel.TextSize = 12
    hubHeaderLabel.TextWrapped = true
    hubHeaderLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    hubHeaderLabel.Parent = hubHeader
    createSection(tabCommunity, "Share Your Config", UI.AccentGreen)
    local SHARE_COOLDOWN_FILE = "VD_ShareCooldown_v2.json"
    local lastShareTime = 0
    pcall(function()
      if delfile and isfile and isfile("VD_ShareCooldown_v1.json") then
        delfile("VD_ShareCooldown_v1.json")
      end
      if isfile and isfile(SHARE_COOLDOWN_FILE) then
        local raw = readfile(SHARE_COOLDOWN_FILE)
        local decoded = httpService:JSONDecode(raw)
        if decoded and decoded.t then
          lastShareTime = decoded.t
        end
      end
    end)
    local shareCard = Instance.new("Frame")
    shareCard.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 195)
    shareCard.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
    shareCard.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9
    shareCard.Parent = tabCommunity
    Instance.new("UICorner", shareCard).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
    local shareCardStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", shareCard)
    shareCardStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
    shareCardStroke.Thickness = 0.8
    local nameBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
    nameBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -16, 0, 30)
    nameBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12)
    nameBox.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
    nameBox.BackgroundTransparency = 0.6
    nameBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
    nameBox.Text = ""
    nameBox.PlaceholderText = "Config Title..."
    nameBox.PlaceholderColor3 = UI.Muted
    nameBox.TextColor3 = UI.Text
    nameBox.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    nameBox.TextSize = 11.5
    nameBox.Parent = shareCard
    Instance.new("UICorner", nameBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local nStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", nameBox)
    nStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
    nStroke.Thickness = 0.8
    local authorBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
    authorBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -16, 0, 30)
    authorBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 4, 0, 12)
    authorBox.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
    authorBox.BackgroundTransparency = 0.6
    authorBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
    authorBox.Text = ""
    authorBox.PlaceholderText = "Author Name..."
    authorBox.PlaceholderColor3 = UI.Muted

    local catText = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    local function createCategoryBtn(catName, posX)
      local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
      btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.13, 0, 0, 20)
      btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.26 + posX * 0.14, 0, 0, 100)
      btn.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card

    Instance.new("UICorner", shareBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

    local function updateCooldownLabel()
      local now = tick()
      local elapsed = now - lastShareTime
      local COOLDOWN = 24 * 3600
      if elapsed < COOLDOWN then
        local remaining = COOLDOWN - elapsed
        local h = math.floor(remaining / 3600)
        local m = math.floor((remaining % 3600) / 60)
        cooldownLbl.Text = string.format("Cooldown: %dh %02dm remaining", h, m)
        shareBtn.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
        shareBtn.TextColor3 = UI.Muted
        shareBtnStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
      else
        cooldownLbl.Text = "Ready to publish"
        shareBtn.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
        shareBtn.TextColor3 = UI.Text
        shareBtnStroke.Color = UI.Stroke
      end
    end
    updateCooldownLabel()
    shareBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
      local now = tick()
      local COOLDOWN = 24 * 3600
      if now - lastShareTime < COOLDOWN then
        local remaining = COOLDOWN - (now - lastShareTime)
        local h = math.floor(remaining / 3600)
        local m = math.floor((remaining % 3600) / 60)
        showNotification(
          "Config Hub",
          string.format("Cooldown active! %dh %02dm left.", h, m),
          "warning"
        )
        return
      end
      local title = nameBox.Text:gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
      local author = authorBox.Text:gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
      local desc = descBox.Text:gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
      if title == "" or author == "" then
        showNotification("Config Hub", "Please fill in Config Title and Author Name!", "warning")
        return
      end
      if desc == "" then
        desc = "No description provided."
      end
      local configData = serializeTable(Settings)
      local configId = "cfg_" .. tostring(math.random(1000, 9999))
      local submission = {
        id = configId,
        Name = title,
        Author = author,
        Description = desc,
        Category = selectedCat,
        Config = configData,
      }
      local jsonStr = httpService:JSONEncode(submission)
      local clipOk = pcall(function()
        if setclipboard then
          setclipboard(jsonStr)
        elseif Clipboard and Clipboard.set then
          Clipboard.set(jsonStr)
        end
      end)
      local isPremiumDetected = false
      if
        Settings.AntiWiggle == true
        or Settings.FakeLag == true
        or Settings.Desync == true
        or Settings.RevolverAutofarm == true
        or Settings.AutoFleeKiller == true
        or Settings.SpearTrajectory == true
        or Settings.SpearTrajectoryNoclip == true
        or Settings.BlockVaultPalletInteraction == true
        or Settings.NoclipVaultsPallets == true
        or Settings.FrenzyParry == true
        or Settings.IgnoreAbysswalkerLunge == true
        or (Settings.SpearAimbot and Settings.SpearAimbot.Enabled == true)
        or (Settings.Stalker and (Settings.Stalker.AutoDodge == true or Settings.Stalker.NoCooldown == true or Settings.Stalker.KillGrab == true))
        or (Settings.Theme ~= nil and Settings.Theme ~= "Default" and Settings.Theme ~= "Old")
      then
        isPremiumDetected = true
      end
      local premiumStatusText = isPremiumDetected and " Premium Features Detected!"
        or " Completely Free Config!"
      local embedFields = {
        { name = "Config ID", value = "`" .. configId .. "`", inline = true },
        { name = "Title", value = title, inline = true },
        { name = "Author", value = author, inline = true },
        { name = "Category", value = selectedCat, inline = true },
        { name = "Description", value = desc, inline = false },
        { name = "Premium Status", value = premiumStatusText, inline = false },
      }
      local chunkSize = 950
      if #jsonStr <= chunkSize then
        table.insert(
          embedFields,
          { name = "Config Data", value = "```json\n" .. jsonStr .. "\n```", inline = false }
        )
      else
        local partNum = 1
        for i = 1, #jsonStr, chunkSize do
          local chunk = jsonStr:sub(i, i + chunkSize - 1)
          table.insert(
            embedFields,
            {
              name = "Config Data (Part " .. partNum .. ")",
              value = "```json\n" .. chunk .. "\n```",
              inline = false,
            }
          )
          partNum = partNum + 1
        end
      end
      local totalChars = #title + #author + #selectedCat + #desc + #jsonStr + 300
      task.spawn(function()
        local ok, response
        if totalChars <= 5800 then
          ok, response = pcall(function()
            return makeRequest(
              "/api/log",
              "POST",
              httpService:JSONEncode({
                embeds = { { title = "New Config Submission!", color = 5814783, fields = embedFields } },
              })
            )
          end)
        else
          ok, response = pcall(function()
            return makeRequest(
              "/api/log",
              "POST",
              httpService:JSONEncode({
                embeds = {
                  {
                    title = "New Config Submission! (Split)",
                    color = 5814783,
                    fields = {
                      { name = "Config ID", value = "`" .. configId .. "`", inline = true },
                      { name = "Title", value = title, inline = true },
                      { name = "Author", value = author, inline = true },
                      { name = "Category", value = selectedCat, inline = true },
                      { name = "Description", value = desc, inline = false },
                      { name = "Premium Status", value = premiumStatusText, inline = false },
                    },
                  },
                },
              })
            )
          end)
          if ok and response then
            local status = response.StatusCode or response.status
            if
              tostring(status) == "204"
              or tostring(status) == "200"
              or tostring(status) == "201"
            then
              task.spawn(function()
                local contentChunkSize = 1900
                local partNum = 1
                for i = 1, #jsonStr, contentChunkSize do
                  local chunk = jsonStr:sub(i, i + contentChunkSize - 1)
                  local partPayload = {
                    content = string.format(
                      "Config Data for **%s** (`%s`) Part %d:\n```json\n%s\n```",
                      title,
                      configId,
                      partNum,
                      chunk
                    ),
                  }
                  makeRequest("/api/log", "POST", httpService:JSONEncode(partPayload))
                  partNum = partNum + 1
                  task.wait(0.5)
                end
              end)
            end
          end
        end
        if ok and response then
          local status = response.StatusCode or response.status
          if
            tostring(status) == "204"
            or tostring(status) == "200"
            or tostring(status) == "201"
          then
            lastShareTime = tick()
            pcall(function()
              if writefile then
                writefile(SHARE_COOLDOWN_FILE, httpService:JSONEncode({ t = lastShareTime }))
              end
            end)
            updateCooldownLabel()
            showNotification(
              "Config Shared",
              "Submitted successfully! Copied to clipboard.",
              "success"
            )
          else
            showNotification(
              "Webhook Error",
              "Server returned status: " .. tostring(status),
              "error"
            )
          end
        else
          local errMsg = not ok and tostring(response) or "No response from request function"
          showNotification("Webhook Error", "Failed: " .. errMsg:sub(1, 40), "error")
        end
      end)
      nameBox.Text = ""
      descBox.Text = ""
    end)
    createSection(tabCommunity, "Community Configurations", UI.AccentCyan)
    local selectedSort = "Most Liked"
    local sortContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
    sortContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
    sortContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    sortContainer.Parent = tabCommunity
    local sortLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    sortLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    sortLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
    sortLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    sortLayout.Parent = sortContainer
    local listContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
    listContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
    listContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    listContainer.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    listContainer.Parent = tabCommunity
    local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
    listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    listLayout.Parent = listContainer
    local function getSortedConfigs()
      local sorted = {}
      for _, item in ipairs(currentConfigs) do
        table.insert(sorted, item)
      end
      if selectedSort == "Newest First" then
        local reversed = {}
        for i = #sorted, 1, -1 do
          table.insert(reversed, sorted[i])
        end
        return reversed
      elseif selectedSort == "Oldest First" then
        return sorted
      elseif selectedSort == "Most Liked" then
        table.sort(sorted, function(a, b)
          local aStats = globalStats[a.Name]
          local bStats = globalStats[b.Name]
          local aLikes = (a.Likes or 0) + (aStats and aStats.likes or 0)
          local bLikes = (b.Likes or 0) + (bStats and bStats.likes or 0)
          return aLikes > bLikes
        end)
        return sorted
      elseif selectedSort == "Most Loaded" then
        table.sort(sorted, function(a, b)
          local aStats = globalStats[a.Name]
          local bStats = globalStats[b.Name]
          local aLoads = (a.Loads or 0) + (aStats and aStats.loads or 0)
          local bLoads = (b.Loads or 0) + (bStats and bStats.loads or 0)
          return aLoads > bLoads
        end)
        return sorted
      end
      return sorted
    end
    local function refreshHubList()
      for _, child in ipairs(listContainer:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Frame") or child:IsA("TextLabel") then
          child:Destroy()
        end
      end
      local sortedConfigs = getSortedConfigs()
      if #sortedConfigs == 0 then
        local emptyLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        emptyLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
        emptyLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        emptyLbl.Text = "No community configurations available. Be the first to share one!"
        emptyLbl.TextColor3 = UI.Muted
        emptyLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        emptyLbl.TextSize = 11.5
        emptyLbl.Parent = listContainer

      end
      for idx, item in ipairs(sortedConfigs) do
        local card = Instance.new("Frame")

        card.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
        card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
        card.Parent = listContainer
        Instance.new("UICorner", card).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", card)
        stroke.Color = UI.Stroke
        local titleLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        titleLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -220, 0, 20)
        titleLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)

        titleLbl.Text = item.Name
        titleLbl.TextColor3 = UI.Text
        titleLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        titleLbl.TextSize = 13
        titleLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        titleLbl.Parent = card
        local isPremiumDetected = false

        if configTable then
          if
            configTable.AntiWiggle == true
            or configTable.FakeLag == true
            or configTable.Desync == true
            or configTable.RevolverAutofarm == true
            or configTable.AutoFleeKiller == true
            or configTable.SpearTrajectory == true
            or configTable.SpearTrajectoryNoclip == true
            or configTable.BlockVaultPalletInteraction == true
            or configTable.NoclipVaultsPallets == true
            or configTable.FrenzyParry == true
            or configTable.IgnoreAbysswalkerLunge == true
            or (configTable.SpearAimbot and configTable.SpearAimbot.Enabled == true)
            or (configTable.Stalker and (configTable.Stalker.AutoDodge == true or configTable.Stalker.NoCooldown == true or configTable.Stalker.KillGrab == true))

              configTable.Theme ~= nil

              and configTable.Theme ~= "Old"

        premTag.TextColor3 = isPremiumDetected and Color3.fromRGB(30, 20, 0)
          or Color3.fromRGB(10, 30, 10)

        premTag.TextSize = 9
        premTag.Parent = card
        Instance.new("UICorner", premTag).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
        local tag = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        tag.Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 18)
        tag.Position = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 11)
        local tagColor = UI.Accent
        if item.Category == "LEGIT" then
          tagColor = UI.AccentGreen
        elseif item.Category == "RAGE" then
          tagColor = UI.Danger
        elseif item.Category == "FARM" then
          tagColor = UI.AccentCyan
        elseif item.Category == "SURVIVOR" then
          tagColor = Color3.fromRGB(180, 100, 255)
        elseif item.Category == "KILLER" then
          tagColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 0)
        end
        tag.BackgroundColor3 = tagColor
        tag.Text = item.Category
        tag.TextColor3 = (item.Category == "LEGIT" or item.Category == "FARM")
            and Color3.fromRGB(10, 20, 10)
          or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        tag.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        tag.TextSize = 9
        tag.Parent = card
        Instance.new("UICorner", tag).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

        descLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 32)

        descLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        descLbl.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

        local authLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        authLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 18)
        authLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 68)
        authLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        authLbl.Text = "shared by " .. item.Author
        authLbl.TextColor3 = UI.TextSub
        authLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        authLbl.TextSize = 10.5
        authLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        authLbl.Parent = card
        local loadBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        loadBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 20)
        loadBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -75, 0, 67)
        loadBtn.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
        loadBtn.Text = "LOAD"
        loadBtn.TextColor3 = UI.Text

    local sortOptions = { "Newest First", "Oldest First", "Most Liked", "Most Loaded" }
    local sortButtons = {}
    local function createSortBtn(optionName)
      local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
      btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.235, -4, 1, 0)
      btn.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
      btn.Text = optionName
      btn.TextColor3 = UI.TextSub
      btn.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
      btn.TextSize = 8.5
      btn.Parent = sortContainer
      Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
      local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
      stroke.Color = UI.Stroke
      stroke.Thickness = 0.8
      local function updateBtn()
        if selectedSort == optionName then
          btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 242, 250)
          btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 16, 22)
          stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
          stroke.Thickness = 1.0
        else
          btn.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
          btn.TextColor3 = UI.TextSub
          stroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
          stroke.Thickness = 0.8
        end
      end
      btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        selectedSort = optionName
        for _, ub in ipairs(sortButtons) do
          pcall(ub)
        end
        pcall(refreshHubList)
      end)
      table.insert(sortButtons, updateBtn)
      return btn
    end
    for _, opt in ipairs(sortOptions) do

    end
    local function updateAllSortButtons()
      for _, ub in ipairs(sortButtons) do
        pcall(ub)
      end
    end
    updateAllSortButtons()
    local function loadCommunityConfigsFromRemote()
      task.spawn(function()
        pcall(fetchStats)
        local rawJson = nil
        local serverUrl = _G.VD_SERVER_URL or "http://78.154.103.2:9156"
        local reqFunc = getRequestFunction()
        if reqFunc then
          local ok, apiRes = pcall(
            reqFunc,
            {
              Url = serverUrl .. "/api/community_configs",
              Method = "GET",
              Headers = {
                ["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
                ["x-vd-build"] = OFFICIAL_BUILD_ID,
                ["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate",
              },
            }
          )
          if
            ok
            and apiRes
            and (apiRes.StatusCode == 200 or apiRes.status == 200)
            and apiRes.Body
            and #apiRes.Body > 2
          then
            rawJson = apiRes.Body
          end
        end
        if not rawJson or #rawJson <= 2 then
          local nocacheUrl = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lixxWW/ViolenceDistrict/main/community_configs.json?t="
            .. tostring(math.floor(tick()))
          local success, res = pcall(function()
            return game:HttpGet(nocacheUrl)
          end)
          if success and res and #res > 2 then
            rawJson = res
          elseif reqFunc then
            local ok, reqRes = pcall(
              reqFunc,
              {
                Url = nocacheUrl,
                Method = "GET",
                Headers = { ["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate" },
              }
            )
            if
              ok
              and reqRes
              and (reqRes.StatusCode == 200 or reqRes.status == 200)
              and reqRes.Body
              and #reqRes.Body > 2
            then
              rawJson = reqRes.Body
            end
          end
        end
        if rawJson then
          local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
            return httpService:JSONDecode(rawJson)
          end)
          if ok and type(decoded) == "table" then
            currentConfigs = decoded
            pcall(refreshHubList)
          end
        end
      end)
    end
    _G.VD_RefreshCommunityConfigs = loadCommunityConfigsFromRemote
    loadCommunityConfigsFromRemote()
  end
end
initCommunityTab()
updateUIFromSettings = function()
  if not isPremiumActive() then
    pcall(enforceFreeRestrictions)
  end
  for key, control in pairs(controlRegistry) do
    local path = string.split(key, ".")
    local val = Settings
    for _, step in ipairs(path) do
      if val ~= nil then
        val = val[step]
      end
    end
    if val ~= nil and control.setValue then
      local actualVal = val
      if type(val) == "table" and val.Enabled ~= nil then
        actualVal = val.Enabled
      end
      pcall(function()
        control.setValue(actualVal, false)
      end)
    end
  end
  if keybindButtons then
    for _, updateText in pairs(keybindButtons) do
      pcall(updateText)
    end
  end
  if syncColorUI and activeColorKey then
    pcall(function()
      syncColorUI(Settings.ESPColors[activeColorKey] or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
    end)
  end
  if forceUpdateESPStyle then
    pcall(forceUpdateESPStyle)
  end
  if isMobile and updateMobileHUDButtons then
    pcall(updateMobileHUDButtons)
  end
  if _G.VD_RefreshHotkeys then
    pcall(_G.VD_RefreshHotkeys)
  end
  if _G.VD_RefreshCooldownOverlay then
    pcall(_G.VD_RefreshCooldownOverlay)
  end
  pcall(function()
    local banner = screenGui:FindFirstChild("VD_InfoBanner")
    if banner then
      banner.Position = UDim2.new(
        Settings.InfoBannerPositionScaleX or 0.5,
        Settings.InfoBannerPositionOffsetX or 0,
        Settings.InfoBannerPositionScaleY or 0,
        Settings.InfoBannerPositionOffsetY or (isMobile and 6 or 10)
      )
      banner.Visible = Settings.ShowInfoBanner
        and isPremiumActive()
        and localHooksTable
        and localHooksTable.InfoBanner
    end
    local liveFps = screenGui:FindFirstChild("VD_LiveFPSCounter")
    if liveFps then
      liveFps.Position = UDim2.new(
        Settings.LiveFPSPositionScaleX or 1,
        Settings.LiveFPSPositionOffsetX or (isMobile and -65 or -80),
        Settings.LiveFPSPositionScaleY or 0,
        Settings.LiveFPSPositionOffsetY or (isMobile and 6 or 10)
      )
      liveFps.Visible = Settings.ShowLiveFPS == true
    end
  end)
end
if updateUIFromSettings then
  pcall(updateUIFromSettings)
end
switchTab("Home")
function updateFarmStatus(state)
  local labels = {
    OFF = "OFF",
    IDLE = "Idle...",
    REPAIRING = "Repairing Generator",
    RESCUING = "Saving Comrade",
    OPENINGGATE = "Opening Exit Gate",
    FLEEING = "Fleeing Killer",
    ESCAPING = "Escaping Match",
    ESCAPED = "ESCAPED",
    HUNTING = "Hunting Survivor",
    CARRYING = "Carrying Survivor",
    HANGING = "Hanging Survivor",
    ["PAUSED (Knocked/Hooked)"] = "PAUSED (Knocked/Hooked)",
    ["PAUSED (Spectating/Lobby)"] = "PAUSED (Spectating/Lobby)",
    ["PAUSED (Killer Team)"] = "PAUSED (Killer Team)",
    ["PAUSED (Survivors Team)"] = "PAUSED (Survivors Team)",
  }
  local colors = {
    OFF = UI.Muted,
    IDLE = UI.TextSub,
    REPAIRING = UI.AccentCyan,
    RESCUING = UI.Warning,
    OPENINGGATE = UI.AccentGreen,
    FLEEING = UI.Danger,
    ESCAPING = UI.AccentGreen,
    ESCAPED = UI.AccentGreen,
    HUNTING = UI.Danger,
    CARRYING = UI.Warning,
    HANGING = UI.AccentCyan,
    ["PAUSED (Knocked/Hooked)"] = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 50),
    ["PAUSED (Spectating/Lobby)"] = UI.Muted,
    ["PAUSED (Killer Team)"] = UI.Danger,
    ["PAUSED (Survivors Team)"] = UI.Danger,
  }
  local text = labels[state] or tostring(state)
  local color = colors[state] or UI.Muted
  if tostring(state):find("WAITING") then
    color = UI.AccentCyan
  elseif tostring(state):find("PUMPKIN") then
    color = UI.Accent
  end
  if _G.VD_HomeStatusLabel then
    _G.VD_HomeStatusLabel.Text = text
    _G.VD_HomeStatusLabel.TextColor3 = color
  end
  if _G.VD_HomeStatusDot then
    _G.VD_HomeStatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = color
  end
  if _G.VD_FarmStatusLabel then
    _G.VD_FarmStatusLabel.Text = "Status: " .. text
    _G.VD_FarmStatusLabel.TextColor3 = color
  end
end
_G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus = updateFarmStatus
_G.VD_LastFlashlightEffect = "None"
_G.VD_FlashlightOnState = false
_G.VD_LastHookedLight = nil
_G.VD_LightChangedConn = nil
_G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = false
task.spawn(function()
  local rainbowHue = 0
  local strobeCounter = 0
  local strobeToggle = false
  while activeLoop do
    task.wait(0.05)
    strobeCounter = strobeCounter + 1
    if strobeCounter >= 2 then
      strobeCounter = 0
      strobeToggle = not strobeToggle
    end
    pcall(function()
      if strobeCounter % 4 == 0 then
        local stainColor = Settings.KillerStainColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
        for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
          local char = player.Character
          local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
          local stain = head and head:FindFirstChild("RedSurfaceLight")
          if stain and stain:IsA("Light") then
            if stain.Color ~= stainColor then
              stain.Color = stainColor
            end
          end
        end
      end
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      local fl = char and char:FindFirstChild("Flashlight")
      if fl then
        local lightObj = fl:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpotLight")
          or fl:FindFirstChild("SpotLight", true)
        if lightObj then
          if lightObj ~= _G.VD_LastHookedLight then
            if _G.VD_LightChangedConn then
              pcall(function()
                _G.VD_LightChangedConn:Disconnect()
              end)
            end
            _G.VD_LastHookedLight = lightObj
            _G.VD_FlashlightOnState = lightObj.Enabled
            _G.VD_LightChangedConn = lightObj:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
              if _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled then
                return
              end
              _G.VD_FlashlightOnState = lightObj.Enabled
            end)
            registerConnection(_G.VD_LightChangedConn)
          end
          local currentCol = Settings.FlashlightColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
          if Settings.FlashlightEffect == "Rainbow" then
            rainbowHue = (rainbowHue + 0.008) % 1
            currentCol = Color3.fromHSV(rainbowHue, 1, 1)
          end
          for _, child in ipairs(fl:GetDescendants()) do
            if child:IsA("Light") then
              child.Color = currentCol
              if _G.VD_FlashlightOnState then
                if Settings.FlashlightEffect == "Ultra Bright" then
                  _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = true
                  child.Enabled = true
                  _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = false
                  child.Range = 250
                  child.Brightness = 15
                elseif Settings.FlashlightEffect == "Strobe" then
                  _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = true
                  child.Enabled = strobeToggle
                  _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = false
                else
                  if _G.VD_LastFlashlightEffect == "Ultra Bright" then
                    child.Range = 51
                    child.Brightness = 1.0
                  end
                end
              else
                _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = true
                child.Enabled = false
                _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = false
                if _G.VD_LastFlashlightEffect == "Ultra Bright" then
                  child.Range = 51
                  child.Brightness = 1.0
                end
              end
            elseif child:IsA("Beam") then
              child.Color = ColorSequence.new(currentCol)
              if _G.VD_FlashlightOnState then
                if Settings.FlashlightEffect == "Strobe" then
                  child.Enabled = strobeToggle
                elseif Settings.FlashlightEffect == "Ultra Bright" then
                  child.Enabled = true
                end
              else
                child.Enabled = false
              end
            elseif child:IsA("BasePart") then
              local cName = child.Name:lower()
              if
                cName:find("beam")
                or cName:find("light")
                or cName:find("cone")
                or (child.Transparency > 0 and child.Transparency < 1)
              then
                child.Color = currentCol
                if _G.VD_FlashlightOnState then
                  if Settings.FlashlightEffect == "Strobe" then
                    child.Transparency = strobeToggle and 0.5 or 1
                  elseif Settings.FlashlightEffect == "Ultra Bright" then
                    child.Transparency = 0.4
                  end
                else
                  child.Transparency = 1
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
        _G.VD_LastFlashlightEffect = Settings.FlashlightEffect
      end
    end)
  end
end)

local TP_COLORS = {
  Generator = Color3.fromRGB(0, 210, 255),
  Hook = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 0),
  Pallet = Color3.fromRGB(200, 160, 80),
  Vault = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180),
