local tpRows = {}
function teleportToInstance(instance)
  if
    not localPlayer
    or not localPlayer.Character
    or not localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  then
    return
  end
  local targetPart
  if instance:IsA("Model") then
    targetPart = instance.PrimaryPart or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
  elseif instance:IsA("BasePart") then
    targetPart = instance
  end
  if targetPart then
    if _G.VD_StopAllInteractions then
      pcall(_G.VD_StopAllInteractions)
      task.wait(0.15)
    end
    local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
      and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if myRoot then
      local targetPos = targetPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
      if Settings.PathfindingTP ~= false and _G.VD_SmartWalkTo then
        _G.VD_AbortPathfinding = true
        task.wait(0.03)
        _G.VD_AbortPathfinding = false
        task.spawn(function()
          local reached = _G.VD_SmartWalkTo(targetPos, 3.5)
          if
            not reached
            and (targetPart.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude > 4.0
            and not _G.VD_AbortPathfinding
          then
            safeSegmentedTeleport(myRoot, targetPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
          end
        end)
        showNotification("Teleport", "Pathfinding to map object...", "info")
      else
        safeSegmentedTeleport(myRoot, targetPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
        showNotification("Teleport", "Teleported to object!", "success")
      end
    end
  end
end
function clearTPRows()
  for inst, rowData in pairs(tpRows) do
    if rowData.row then
      rowData.row:Destroy()
    end
    tpRows[inst] = nil
  end
end
function createTPRow(entry)
  if not tpScroll then
    return
  end
  local inst = entry.instance
  local col = TP_COLORS[entry.label] or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
  local row = Instance.new("TextButton")
  row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
  row.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
  row.BorderSizePixel = 0
  row.Text = ""
  row.AutoButtonColor = false
  row.Parent = tpScroll
  local rowCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
  rowCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
  rowCorner.Parent = row
  local tag = Instance.new("Frame")
  tag.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -6)
  tag.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 3)
  tag.BackgroundColor3 = col
  tag.BorderSizePixel = 0
  tag.Parent = row
  Instance.new("UICorner", tag).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 1.5)
  local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
  lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
  lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  lbl.Text = string.format("%s  [%dm]", entry.label, entry.dist)
  lbl.TextColor3 = col
  lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
  lbl.TextSize = 11
  lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
  lbl.Parent = row
  row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
    TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { BackgroundColor3 = UI.HoverCard }):Play()
  end)
  row.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
    TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card }):Play()
  end)
  row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if inst and inst.Parent then
      teleportToInstance(inst)
    end
  end)
  tpRows[inst] = { row = row, label = lbl, typeLabel = entry.label }
end
function collectTPEntries()
  local entries = {}
  local addedMap = {}
  local function addEntry(inst, label)
    if inst and inst.Parent and not addedMap[inst] then
      addedMap[inst] = true
      table.insert(entries, { instance = inst, label = label })
    end
  end
  local filter = activeTPFilter or "All"
  if filter == "All" or filter == "Generator" then
    for _, gen in ipairs(cachedGenerators or {}) do
      if not isGeneratorCompleted(gen) then
        addEntry(gen, "Generator")
      end
    end
    if #entries == 0 and (filter == "Generator" or filter == "All") then
      local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
      local gensFolder = map and map:FindFirstChild("Gens")
      if gensFolder then
        for _, child in ipairs(gensFolder:GetChildren()) do
          if
            (child.Name == "Generator" or string.find(child.Name:lower(), "generator"))
            and not isGeneratorCompleted(child)
          then
            addEntry(child, "Generator")
          end
        end
      end
      for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if
          (desc.Name == "Generator" or desc.Name:lower():find("generator"))
          and desc:IsA("Model")
          and not isGeneratorCompleted(desc)
        then
          addEntry(desc, "Generator")
        end
      end
    end
  end
  if filter == "All" or filter == "Hook" then
    for _, hook in ipairs(cachedHooks or {}) do
      addEntry(hook, "Hook")
    end
    if #entries == 0 and (filter == "Hook" or filter == "All") then
      for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if desc.Name == "Hook" or desc.Name == "HookPoint" or desc.Name:lower():find("hook") then
          local target = desc:IsA("BasePart") and desc
            or desc:FindFirstChild("HookPoint")
            or (desc:IsA("Model") and desc.PrimaryPart)
            or desc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
          if target then
            addEntry(target, "Hook")
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  if filter == "All" or filter == "Pallet" then
    for _, pallet in ipairs(cachedPallets or {}) do
      addEntry(pallet, "Pallet")
    end
    if #entries == 0 and (filter == "Pallet" or filter == "All") then
      for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if desc.Name == "Pallet" or desc.Name:lower():find("pallet") then
          addEntry(desc, "Pallet")
        end
      end
    end
  end
  if filter == "All" or filter == "Vault" then
    for _, vault in ipairs(cachedVaults or {}) do
      addEntry(vault, "Vault")
    end
    if #entries == 0 and (filter == "Vault" or filter == "All") then
      for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if
          desc.Name == "Vault"
          or desc.Name:lower():find("vault")
          or desc.Name == "Window"
          or desc.Name:lower():find("window")
        then
          addEntry(desc, "Vault")
        end
      end
    end
  end
  if filter == "All" or filter == "Gate" then
    for _, gate in ipairs(cachedGates or {}) do
      addEntry(gate, "Gate")
    end
    if #entries == 0 and (filter == "Gate" or filter == "All") then
      for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if
          desc.Name == "Gate"
          or desc.Name:lower():find("gate")
          or desc.Name:lower():find("door")
        then
          addEntry(desc, "Gate")
        end
      end
    end
  end
  if filter == "All" or filter == "Pumpkin" then
    for _, pumpkin in ipairs(cachedPumpkins or {}) do
      addEntry(pumpkin, "Pumpkin")
    end
    if #entries == 0 and (filter == "Pumpkin" or filter == "All") then
      local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
      local pFolder = map and map:FindFirstChild("Pumpkins")
      if pFolder then
        for _, child in ipairs(pFolder:GetChildren()) do
          addEntry(child, "Pumpkin")
        end
      end
    end
  end
  for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
    entry.dist = getDistance(entry.instance)
  end
  table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
    return a.dist < b.dist
  end)
  return entries
end
refreshTPMenu = function()
  if not tpScroll then
    return
  end
  local entries = collectTPEntries()
  clearTPRows()
  if #entries == 0 then
    if tpEmptyLabel then
      tpEmptyLabel.Visible = true
    end
    return
  end
  if tpEmptyLabel then
    tpEmptyLabel.Visible = false
  end
  for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
    createTPRow(entry)
  end
end
function updateTPMenuDistances()
  for inst, rowData in pairs(tpRows) do
    if not inst.Parent then
      if rowData.row then
        rowData.row:Destroy()
      end
      tpRows[inst] = nil
    else
      local dist = getDistance(inst)
      local txt = string.format("%s  [%dm]", rowData.typeLabel, dist)
      if rowData.label.Text ~= txt then
        rowData.label.Text = txt
      end
    end
  end
end
function makeDraggable(gui, dragPart)
  local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPosition
  local function update(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    gui.Position = UDim2.new(
      startPosition.X.Scale,
      startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
      startPosition.Y.Scale,
      startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
    )
  end
  dragPart.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if
      input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    then
      dragging = true
      dragStart = input.Position
      startPosition = gui.Position
      input.Changed:Connect(function()
        if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
          dragging = false
        end
      end)
    end
  end)
  dragPart.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if
      input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    then
      dragInput = input
    end
  end)
  registerConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
      update(input)
    end
  end))
end
makeDraggable(mainFrame, titleBar)
function makeResizable(frame, handle)
  local resizing = false
  local resizeStart = nil
  local startSize = nil
  local dragInput = nil
  handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if
      input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    then
      resizing = true
      resizeStart = input.Position
      startSize = frame.Size
      input.Changed:Connect(function()
        if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
          resizing = false
        end
      end)
    end
  end)
  handle.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if
      input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    then
      dragInput = input
    end
  end)
  registerConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and resizing then
      local delta = input.Position - resizeStart
      local newWidth = math.clamp(startSize.X.Offset + delta.X, 420, 1000)
      local newHeight = math.clamp(startSize.Y.Offset + delta.Y, 260, 800)
      frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, newWidth, 0, newHeight)
      UI.MainW = newWidth
      UI.MainH = newHeight
    end
  end))
end

function doCleanup()
  activeLoop = false
  pcall(function()
    local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if playerGui then
      local frames = {}
      local seen = {}
      for _, desc in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
        if desc:IsA("GuiObject") and desc.Name:find("^Survivor%d+$") then
          local parent = desc.Parent
          if parent and not seen[parent] then
            seen[parent] = true
            table.insert(frames, parent)
          end
        end
      end
      for _, frame in ipairs(frames) do
        if frame:GetAttribute("OrigVisible") ~= nil then
          frame.Visible = frame:GetAttribute("OrigVisible")
          frame:SetAttribute("OrigVisible", nil)
        end
        for _, child in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
          if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Name:find("^Survivor%d+$") then
            if child:GetAttribute("OrigVisible") ~= nil then
              child.Visible = child:GetAttribute("OrigVisible")
              child:SetAttribute("OrigVisible", nil)
            end
          end
        end
        frame:SetAttribute("CachedOverlayPos", nil)
        frame:SetAttribute("CachedOverlaySize", nil)
        local overlay = frame:FindFirstChild("ViolenceDistrictOverlay")
        if overlay then
          overlay:Destroy()
        end
      end
      for _, desc in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
        if desc:IsA("ImageLabel") and desc:GetAttribute("DBDHud_OrigImage") ~= nil then
          desc.Image = desc:GetAttribute("DBDHud_OrigImage")
          desc:SetAttribute("DBDHud_OrigImage", nil)
        end
      end
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _G.VD_DBD and _G.VD_DBD.restoreSounds then
      _G.VD_DBD.restoreSounds()
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if targetHighlight then
      targetHighlight:Destroy()
      targetHighlight = nil
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if currentEmoteTrack then
      currentEmoteTrack:Stop()
      currentEmoteTrack = nil
    end
    if currentEmoteSound then
      currentEmoteSound:Stop()
      currentEmoteSound:Destroy()
      currentEmoteSound = nil
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if restoreMouseState then
      restoreMouseState()
    end
  end)
  cleanupAll()
  pcall(function()
    if cleanupKillerGroundFOV then
      cleanupKillerGroundFOV()
    end
    local fovFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("VD_KillerGroundFOV")
    if fovFolder then
      pcall(function()
        fovFolder:Destroy()
      end)
    end
  end)
  for _, conn in ipairs(scriptConnections) do
    pcall(function()
      conn:Disconnect()
    end)
  end
  scriptConnections = {}
  if localPlayerCharConn then
    pcall(function()
      localPlayerCharConn:Disconnect()
    end)
    localPlayerCharConn = nil
  end
  if localPlayerAttrConn then
    pcall(function()
      localPlayerAttrConn:Disconnect()
    end)
    localPlayerAttrConn = nil
  end
  if localPlayerChildConn then
    pcall(function()
      localPlayerChildConn:Disconnect()
    end)
    localPlayerChildConn = nil
  end
  if _G.HeartbeatConnection then
    pcall(function()
      _G.HeartbeatConnection:Disconnect()
    end)
  end
  pcall(function()
    RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("VD_Aimbot")
  end)
  pcall(function()
    RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("VD_AimAssist")
  end)
  pcall(function()
    RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("VD_CameraStretch")
  end)
  pcall(function()
    RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("VD_SpearAimbot")
  end)
  _G.VD_AimbotTarget = nil
  aimAssistTarget = nil
  aimAssistToggleState = false
  isMobileAimAssistActive = false
  if Settings and Settings.AimAssist then
    Settings.AimAssist.Enabled = false
  end
  pcall(function()
    if gameSpeedBoosts then
      table.clear(gameSpeedBoosts)
    end
    if speedBoostListeners then
      for model, conn in pairs(speedBoostListeners) do
        pcall(function()
          conn:Disconnect()
        end)
      end
      table.clear(speedBoostListeners)
    end
    if ourLastWrittenValue then
      table.clear(ourLastWrittenValue)
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    local playerName = localPlayer.Name
    local targets = {}
    if localPlayer.Character then
      table.insert(targets, localPlayer.Character)
    end
    local direct = workspace:FindFirstChild(playerName)
    if direct and direct:IsA("Model") and not table.find(targets, direct) then
      table.insert(targets, direct)
    end
    local searchRoots =
      { "climb_obsessing", "climb_collisoning", "climb_collisioning", "climb_colliding" }
    for _, rootName in ipairs(searchRoots) do
      local root = workspace:FindFirstChild(rootName)
      if root then
        local model = root:FindFirstChild(playerName)
        if model and model:IsA("Model") and not table.find(targets, model) then
          table.insert(targets, model)
        end
      end
    end
    for _, model in ipairs(targets) do
      pcall(function()
        model:SetAttribute("Flowstate", nil)
      end)
    end
    pcall(function()
      localPlayer:SetAttribute("Flowstate", nil)
    end)
  end)
  pcall(function()
    local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    local hud = playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild("VD_MobileHUD")
    if hud then
      hud:Destroy()
    end
    if originalCameraSettings and originalCameraSettings.CameraMode then
      localPlayer.CameraMode = originalCameraSettings.CameraMode
    end
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
      hum.AutoRotate = true
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
    if defaultLightingSettings then
      Lighting.Brightness = defaultLightingSettings.Brightness
      Lighting.ClockTime = defaultLightingSettings.ClockTime
      Lighting.Ambient = defaultLightingSettings.Ambient
      Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = defaultLightingSettings.OutdoorAmbient

      Lighting.FogStart = defaultLightingSettings.FogStart
      Lighting.FogEnd = defaultLightingSettings.FogEnd
    end
    for obj, props in pairs(cachedAtmospheres) do
      if obj and obj.Parent then
        pcall(function()
          obj.Density = props.Density
          obj.Haze = props.Haze
        end)
      end
    end
    table.clear(cachedAtmospheres)
    for obj, enabled in pairs(cachedDoFs) do
      if obj and obj.Parent then
        pcall(function()
          obj.Enabled = enabled
        end)
      end
    end
    table.clear(cachedDoFs)
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton then
      _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton:Destroy()
      _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton = nil
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if aimAssistMobileButton then
      aimAssistMobileButton:Destroy()
      aimAssistMobileButton = nil
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _G.VD_FovGui then
      _G.VD_FovGui:Destroy()
      _G.VD_FovGui = nil
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if aimAssistFOVScreenGui then
      aimAssistFOVScreenGui:Destroy()
      aimAssistFOVScreenGui = nil
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if aimAssistDrawingCircle then
      aimAssistDrawingCircle.Visible = false
      pcall(function()
        aimAssistDrawingCircle:Remove()
      end)
      aimAssistDrawingCircle = nil
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _G.VD_CrosshairGui then
      _G.VD_CrosshairGui:Destroy()
      _G.VD_CrosshairGui = nil
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    local parents = { guiParent, billboardParent }
    for _, parent in ipairs(parents) do
      if parent then
        local hud = parent:FindFirstChild("VD_MobileHUD")
        if hud then
          pcall(function()
            hud:Destroy()
          end)
        end
        local aimHud = parent:FindFirstChild("VD_MobileAimbotGui")
        if aimHud then
          pcall(function()
            aimHud:Destroy()
          end)
        end
      end
    end
    for k, v in pairs(mobileFloatingButtons) do
      pcall(function()
        v:Destroy()
      end)
    end
    table.clear(mobileFloatingButtons)
    local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if playerGui then
      local flowGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("VD_FlowstateFloatingUI", true)
      if flowGui then
        pcall(function()
          flowGui:Destroy()
        end)
      end
      local perks = nil
      local survivorPerks = playerGui:FindFirstChild("SurvivorPerks")
      if survivorPerks then
        perks = survivorPerks:FindFirstChild("Perks")
        local floatingLabel = survivorPerks:FindFirstChild("FlowstateCustomLabel")
        if floatingLabel then
          pcall(function()
            floatingLabel:Destroy()
          end)
        end
      end
      if not perks then
        local survivor = playerGui:FindFirstChild("Survivor")
        if survivor then
          perks = survivor:FindFirstChild("Perks")
        end
      end
      if not perks then
        local survivorMob = playerGui:FindFirstChild("Survivor-mob")
        if survivorMob then
          perks = survivorMob:FindFirstChild("Perks") or survivorMob:FindFirstChild("Controls")
        end
      end
      if perks then
        local customSlot = perks:FindFirstChild("FlowstateCustomSlot")
        if customSlot then
          pcall(function()
            customSlot:Destroy()
          end)
        end
        for _, slot in ipairs(perks:GetChildren()) do
          if slot:IsA("Frame") or slot:IsA("GuiObject") then
            local flowLabel = slot:FindFirstChild("FlowstateCooldownLabel")
            if flowLabel then
              pcall(function()
                flowLabel:Destroy()
              end)
            end
            if slot:GetAttribute("IsCustom") then
              pcall(function()
                slot:Destroy()
              end)
            end
          end
        end
      end
      local slotScreen = playerGui:FindFirstChild("SlotScreen")
      local itemFrame = slotScreen and slotScreen:FindFirstChild("ItemFrame")
      local parryLabel = itemFrame and itemFrame:FindFirstChild("ParryCooldownLabel")
      if parryLabel then
        pcall(function()
          parryLabel:Destroy()
        end)
      end
      local survivorMob = playerGui:FindFirstChild("Survivor-mob")
      local controls = survivorMob and survivorMob:FindFirstChild("Controls")
      if controls then
        local label = controls:FindFirstChild("ParryCooldownLabel")
        if label then
          pcall(function()
            label:Destroy()
          end)
        end
        local actionButton = controls:FindFirstChild("action")
        local label2 = actionButton and actionButton:FindFirstChild("ParryCooldownLabel")
        if label2 then
          pcall(function()
            label2:Destroy()
          end)
        end
      end
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _G.VD_ApplyHiddenNoCooldownLeap and Settings and Settings.Hidden then
      Settings.Hidden.NoCooldownLeap = false
      _G.VD_ApplyHiddenNoCooldownLeap()
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    TweenService:Create(
      mainFrame,
      TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
      { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }
    ):Play()
  end)
  task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(0.2)
    pcall(function()
      screenGui:Destroy()
    end)
  end)
end

if isMobile or UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
  mobileToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
  mobileToggleBtn.Name = "MobileToggleButton"
  mobileToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 46)
  mobileToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 180)
  mobileToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 19, 26)
  mobileToggleBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
  mobileToggleBtn.Text = ""
  mobileToggleBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
  mobileToggleBtn.ZIndex = 100000
  mobileToggleBtn.Visible = true
  mobileToggleBtn.Parent = screenGui
  _G.VD_MobileToggleBtn = mobileToggleBtn
  Instance.new("UICorner", mobileToggleBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
  local btnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", mobileToggleBtn)
  btnStroke.Color = UI.Accent
  btnStroke.Thickness = 1.4
  btnStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
  local logoImg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
  logoImg.Name = "LogoImage"
  logoImg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -8)
  logoImg.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
  logoImg.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
  logoImg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  logoImg.Image = "rbxassetid://117820993260221"
  task.spawn(function()
    pcall(function()
      local customLogo = getLocalAsset("https://files.catbox.moe/7jhr44.jpg", "VD_Logo1.png", nil)
      if customLogo and logoImg and logoImg.Parent then
        logoImg.Image = customLogo
      end
    end)
  end)
  logoImg.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
  logoImg.ZIndex = 100001
  logoImg.Parent = mobileToggleBtn
  Instance.new("UICorner", logoImg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
  local dragStart = nil
  local startPos = nil
  local isDragging = false
  local dragInput = nil
  local lastDragEndTime = 0
  local function onButtonClicked()
    if isDragging then
      return
    end
    if tick() - lastDragEndTime < 0.25 then
      return
    end
    lastDragEndTime = tick()
    pcall(function()
      TweenService:Create(
        mobileToggleBtn,
        TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        { Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40) }
      ):Play()
      task.delay(0.09, function()
        if mobileToggleBtn and mobileToggleBtn.Parent then
          TweenService:Create(
            mobileToggleBtn,
            TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Size = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 46) }
          ):Play()
        end
      end)
    end)
    pcall(toggleUI)
  end
  mobileToggleBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if
      input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    then
      dragStart = input.Position
      local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
      local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 600)
      local currentAbsX = mobileToggleBtn.Position.X.Scale * vp.X
        + mobileToggleBtn.Position.X.Offset
      local currentAbsY = mobileToggleBtn.Position.Y.Scale * vp.Y
        + mobileToggleBtn.Position.Y.Offset
      startPos = Vector2.new(currentAbsX, currentAbsY)
      isDragging = false
      local connection
      connection = input.Changed:Connect(function()
        if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
          if isDragging then
            lastDragEndTime = tick()
          else
            onButtonClicked()
          end
          dragStart = nil
          dragInput = nil
          isDragging = false
          if connection then
            connection:Disconnect()
          end
        end
      end)
    end
  end)
  mobileToggleBtn.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if
      input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
    then
      dragInput = input
    end
  end)
  registerConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragStart and startPos then
      local delta = input.Position - dragStart
      if delta.Magnitude > 6 then
        isDragging = true
      end
      if isDragging then
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 600)
        local clampedX = math.clamp(startPos.X + delta.X, 4, math.max(4, vp.X - 52))
        local clampedY = math.clamp(startPos.Y + delta.Y, 4, math.max(4, vp.Y - 52))
        mobileToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, clampedX, 0, clampedY)
      end
    end
  end))
end
function patchMobileControls()
  if not isMobile then
    return
  end
  local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
  if not playerGui then
    return
  end
  local controlsFrame = nil
  for _, desc in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
    if desc.Name == "Controls" and desc:IsA("Frame") then
      controlsFrame = desc
      break
    end
  end
  if not controlsFrame then
    return
  end
  local parentGui = controlsFrame:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
  if parentGui then
    pcall(function()
      parentGui.DisplayOrder = 20
      parentGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    end)
    controlsFrame.ZIndex = 1000
    for _, child in ipairs(controlsFrame:GetDescendants()) do
      if child:IsA("GuiButton") then
        child.Active = true
        child.Selectable = true
        child.ZIndex = 1001
      end
      if child:IsA("Frame") and child.BackgroundTransparency == 1 then
        child.Active = false
      end
    end
  end
  if screenGui then
    screenGui.DisplayOrder = 99999
  end
  local aimbotGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("VD_MobileAimbotGui")
  if aimbotGui then
    aimbotGui.DisplayOrder = 99998
  end
  local hudGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("VD_MobileHUD")
  if hudGui then
    hudGui.DisplayOrder = 99997
  end
end
task.spawn(function()
  scanMapObjects()
  refreshTPMenu()
  local lastMapScannedName = getMapName()
  local mapScanTimer, tpDistTimer, modifierTimer, scpScanTimer, staggerIndex = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
  local isCleanedUpSpectator = false
  while activeLoop do
    pcall(function()
      if isSpectating() then
        if not isCleanedUpSpectator then
          cleanupAll()
          isCleanedUpSpectator = true
        end
        task.wait(0.5)
        return
      end
      if isCleanedUpSpectator then
        isCleanedUpSpectator = false
        pcall(function()
          if updateCrosshair then
            updateCrosshair()
          end
        end)
      end
      mapScanTimer = mapScanTimer + 0.1
      if mapScanTimer >= 2.0 then
        local currentMapName = getMapName()
        if currentMapName ~= lastMapScannedName then
          lastMapScannedName = currentMapName
          scanMapObjects()
          refreshTPMenu()
        end
        mapScanTimer = 0
      end
      scpScanTimer = scpScanTimer + 0.1
      if scpScanTimer >= 2.0 then
        pcall(updateSCPCache)
        scpScanTimer = 0
      end
      tpDistTimer = tpDistTimer + 0.1
      if tpDistTimer >= 1.0 then
        updateTPMenuDistances()
        tpDistTimer = 0
      end
      modifierTimer = modifierTimer + 0.1
      if modifierTimer >= 0.35 then
        applyLocalPlayerModifiers()
        modifierTimer = 0
      end
      staggerIndex = (staggerIndex + 1) % #MAP_ESP_STAGGER
      local stagger = MAP_ESP_STAGGER[staggerIndex + 1]
      updateMapESP(stagger.typeKey, stagger.cached())
      pcall(manageHighlights)
      if Settings.Minimap and Settings.Minimap.Enabled and Settings.MasterESP then
        pcall(function()
          _G.VD_MinimapCard.Visible = true
          local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
          local camCFrame = cam.CFrame
          local myPos = localRootPart and localRootPart.Position
            or (
              localPlayer.Character
              and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
              and localPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
            )
          if not myPos then
            return
          end
          local mapRadius = 130
          local dotSize = 5
          local cardSize = 130
          local halfCard = cardSize / 2
          local camForward = Vector3.new(camCFrame.LookVector.X, 0, camCFrame.LookVector.Z).Unit
          local camRight = Vector3.new(camCFrame.RightVector.X, 0, camCFrame.RightVector.Z).Unit
          for _, dot in ipairs(_G.VD_MinimapCard:GetChildren()) do
            if dot.Name == "RadarDot" then
              dot.Visible = false
            end
          end
          local function getOrCreateDot()
            for _, dot in ipairs(_G.VD_MinimapCard:GetChildren()) do
              if dot.Name == "RadarDot" and not dot.Visible then
                return dot
              end
            end
            local d = Instance.new("Frame")
            d.Name = "RadarDot"
            d.Size = UDim2.new(0, dotSize, 0, dotSize)
            d.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            d.BorderSizePixel = 0
            d.ZIndex = 8
            d.Parent = _G.VD_MinimapCard
            Instance.new("UICorner", d).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            return d
          end
          local function placeOnMinimap(worldPos, color)
            local offset = worldPos - myPos
            local relX = offset:Dot(camRight)
            local relZ = offset:Dot(camForward)
            local scale = halfCard / mapRadius
            local pixX = halfCard + relX * scale
            local pixY = halfCard - relZ * scale
            local maxR = halfCard - dotSize
            if (Vector2.new(pixX, pixY) - Vector2.new(halfCard, halfCard)).Magnitude > maxR then
              return
            end
            local dot = getOrCreateDot()
            dot.Position = UDim2.new(0, pixX, 0, pixY)
            dot.BackgroundColor3 = color
            dot.Visible = true
          end
          for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p == localPlayer then
              continue
            end
            local pChar = p.Character
            local pRoot = pChar and pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not pRoot then
              continue
            end
            local team = p.Team
            local isKiller = team and team.Name == "Killer"
            local dotColor = isKiller and Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70) or Color3.fromRGB(
              80,
              255,
              130
            )
            placeOnMinimap(pRoot.Position, dotColor)
          end
          for _, gen in ipairs(cachedGenerators) do
            if not gen or not gen.Parent then
              continue
            end
            if isGeneratorCompleted(gen) then
              continue
            end
            local pp = (gen:IsA("Model") and gen.PrimaryPart)
              or gen:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if pp then
              placeOnMinimap(pp.Position, Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255))
            end
          end
          for _, hook in ipairs(cachedHooks) do
            if not hook or not hook.Parent then
              continue
            end
            local hookPos = hook:IsA("BasePart") and hook.Position or nil
            if hookPos then
              placeOnMinimap(hookPos, Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 0))
            end
          end
          for _, pallet in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
            if not pallet or not pallet.Parent then
              continue
            end
            local pp = (pallet:IsA("Model") and pallet.PrimaryPart)
              or pallet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if pp then
              placeOnMinimap(pp.Position, Color3.fromRGB(180, 130, 70))
            end
          end
        end)
      else
        if _G.VD_MinimapCard.Visible then
          _G.VD_MinimapCard.Visible = false
        end
      end
    end)
    task.wait(0.1)
  end
end)

local _lastKnockedGuardState = false
registerConnection(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
  if not activeLoop then
    return
  end
  local char = localPlayer.Character
  localRootPart = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  pcall(function()
    if char then
      local isKnocked = char:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
        or localPlayer:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
      if not isKnocked and readModelValue then
        isKnocked = readModelValue(char, "Knocked") == true
      end
      if isKnocked and not _lastKnockedGuardState then
        if _G.VD_StopAllInteractions then
          pcall(_G.VD_StopAllInteractions)
        end
      end
      _lastKnockedGuardState = isKnocked
    end
  end)
  pcall(updatePlayersESP)
  if updateESPFadeTransitions then
    pcall(updateESPFadeTransitions, deltaTime or 0.016)
  end
  if updateParryESP then
    pcall(updateParryESP, deltaTime or 0.016)
  end
  if updateKillerGroundFOV then
    pcall(updateKillerGroundFOV)
  end
end))
_G.VD_ResetRainbowCharacter = function(char)
  local targetChar = char or localPlayer.Character
  if targetChar then
    local hl = targetChar:FindFirstChild("RainbowHighlight")
    if hl then
      pcall(function()
        hl:Destroy()
      end)
    end
  end
  for part, state in pairs(_G.VD_OriginalPartStates) do
    pcall(function()
      if part and part.Parent then
        part.Color = state.Color
        part.Material = state.Material
        part.Transparency = state.Transparency
      end
    end)
  end
  _G.VD_OriginalPartStates = {}
  table.clear(_G.VD_RainbowPartsCache)
  _G.VD_LastCacheChar = nil
end

local lastNearVaultCheck = 0
local cachedIsNearVault = false
local lastSwayFlip = 0
local swayDirection = 1
local currentSwayValue = 0
registerConnection(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
  if not activeLoop then
    return
  end
  pcall(function()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam or cam.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
      return
    end
    local rep = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    if
      rep:GetAttribute("RankedState") == "Intro" or rep:GetAttribute("Darkness2Covered") == true
    then
      return
    end
    if Settings.FOV and type(Settings.FOV) == "number" then
      local targetFov = math.min(Settings.FOV, 120)
      if cam.FieldOfView ~= targetFov then
        cam.FieldOfView = targetFov
      end
    end
  end)
  debug.profilebegin("Helper_RenderStepped_Main")
  if Settings.RainbowCharacter then
    pcall(function()
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      if char then
        local hue = (tick() % 4) / 4
        local color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
        if Settings.RainbowCharacterMode == "Highlight" then
          if next(_G.VD_OriginalPartStates) then
            for part, state in pairs(_G.VD_OriginalPartStates) do
              pcall(function()
                if part and part.Parent then
                  part.Color = state.Color
                  part.Material = state.Material
                  part.Transparency = state.Transparency
                end
              end)
            end
            _G.VD_OriginalPartStates = {}
          end
          local hl = char:FindFirstChild("RainbowHighlight")
          if not hl then
            hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
            hl.Name = "RainbowHighlight"
            hl.FillTransparency = 0.4
            hl.OutlineTransparency = 0.0
            hl.Parent = char
          end
          hl.FillColor = color
          hl.OutlineColor = color
          hl.Enabled = true
        else
          local hl = char:FindFirstChild("RainbowHighlight")
          if hl then
            pcall(function()
              hl:Destroy()
            end)
          end
          if _G.VD_LastCacheChar ~= char then
            _G.VD_LastCacheChar = char
            table.clear(_G.VD_RainbowPartsCache)
            for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
              if child:IsA("BasePart") and child.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                table.insert(_G.VD_RainbowPartsCache, child)
              end
            end
          end
          for _, part in ipairs(_G.VD_RainbowPartsCache) do
            if part and part.Parent then
              if not _G.VD_OriginalPartStates[part] then
                _G.VD_OriginalPartStates[part] =
                  { Color = part.Color, Material = part.Material, Transparency = part.Transparency }
              end
              part.Color = color
              if Settings.RainbowCharacterMode == "ForceField" then
                part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
              else
                part.Material = _G.VD_OriginalPartStates[part].Material
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end
  if
    Settings.NoclipVaultsPallets
    and isPremiumActive()
    and localHooksTable
    and localHooksTable.NoclipVaultsPallets
  then
    pcall(function()
      for _, vault in ipairs(cachedVaults) do
        if vault and vault.Parent and not processedNoclip[vault] then
          processedNoclip[vault] = {}
          for _, part in ipairs(vault:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
              local pName = part.Name:lower()
              if
                pName == "inviswall"
                or pName == "bottom"
                or pName:find("vault")
                or pName == "glass"
                or pName == "pane"
              then
                if originalCanCollide[part] == nil then
                  originalCanCollide[part] = part.CanCollide
                end
                part.CanCollide = false
                table.insert(processedNoclip[vault], part)
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      for _, pallet in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
        if pallet and pallet.Parent and not processedNoclip[pallet] then
          processedNoclip[pallet] = {}
          for _, part in ipairs(pallet:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
              if originalCanCollide[part] == nil then
                originalCanCollide[part] = part.CanCollide
              end
              part.CanCollide = false
              table.insert(processedNoclip[pallet], part)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  else
    if next(originalCanCollide) ~= nil then
      pcall(function()
        for part, origState in pairs(originalCanCollide) do
          if part and part.Parent then
            part.CanCollide = origState
          end
        end
      end)
      originalCanCollide = {}
      processedNoclip = {}
    end
  end
  if Settings.AutoMoonwalk then
    pcall(function()
      debug.profilebegin("Helper_AutoMoonwalk")
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
      if root and hum and camera then
        local nowClock = os.clock()
        if
          (nowClock - (_G.VD_LastPumpkinCrush or 0)) < 1.4
          or (nowClock - (_G.VD_LastSlowTime or 0)) < ((_G.VD_SlowDuration or 1.3) + 0.1)
        then
          return
        end
        local isNearVault = cachedIsNearVault
        local now = tick()
        if now - lastNearVaultCheck >= 0.1 then
          lastNearVaultCheck = now
          isNearVault = false
          if Settings.MoonwalkDisableOnVault then
            local controller = getAnimationsController()
            if
              (controller and (controller.isVaulting or controller.isSlideingPallet))
              or char:GetAttribute("isVaulting")
              or char:GetAttribute("isSliding")
            then
              isNearVault = true
            else
              if cachedVaults then
                for _, vault in ipairs(cachedVaults) do
                  if vault and vault.Parent then
                    local pPart = moonwalkPartCache[vault]
                    if pPart == nil then
                      pPart = vault:IsA("BasePart") and vault
                        or (
                          (vault:IsA("Model") and vault.PrimaryPart)
                          or vault:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                          or false
                        )
                      moonwalkPartCache[vault] = pPart
                    end
                    if pPart then
                      local dist = (pPart.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                      if dist <= 10 then
                        isNearVault = true
                        break
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
              if not isNearVault and cachedPallets then
                for _, pallet in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
                  if pallet and pallet.Parent then
                    local isEligible = moonwalkPartCache[pallet]
                    if isEligible == nil then
                      local hrp = pallet:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                      if
                        hrp and (
                          hrp:FindFirstChild("inviswall") or hrp:FindFirstChild("inviswall1")
                        )
                      then
                        isEligible = (pallet:IsA("Model") and pallet.PrimaryPart)
                          or hrp
                          or pallet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                          or false
                      else
                        isEligible = false
                      end
                      moonwalkPartCache[pallet] = isEligible
                    end
                    if isEligible then
                      local dist = (isEligible.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                      if dist <= 8 then
                        isNearVault = true
                        break
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
          cachedIsNearVault = isNearVault
        end
        if not isNearVault then
          hum.AutoRotate = false
          local yaw
          if
            Settings.MoonwalkMovementBased
            and isPremiumActive()
            and localHooksTable
            and localHooksTable.MovementMoonwalk
            and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.01
          then
            local forwardDot = hum.MoveDirection:Dot(camera.CFrame.LookVector)
            local rightDot = hum.MoveDirection:Dot(camera.CFrame.RightVector)
            if math.abs(forwardDot) > math.abs(rightDot) then
              yaw = math.atan2(hum.MoveDirection.X, hum.MoveDirection.Z)
            else
              local camLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
              yaw = math.atan2(camLook.X, camLook.Z)
            end
          else
            local camLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
            yaw = math.atan2(camLook.X, camLook.Z)
          end
          local sway = 0
          if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.01 then
            local speed = Settings.MoonwalkSwaySpeed or 14
            local size = Settings.MoonwalkSwayAmplitude or 0.28
            local jitter = Settings.MoonwalkShaking or 0.05
            local baseSway = math.sin(tick() * speed) * size
            local shake = (math.random() - 0.5) * jitter
            sway = baseSway + shake
          end
          local _, currentYaw, _ = root.CFrame:ToOrientation()
          local targetBaseYaw = yaw
          if Settings.ReverseMoonwalk then
            targetBaseYaw = targetBaseYaw + math.pi
          end
          local diff = (targetBaseYaw - currentYaw + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
          local dt = deltaTime or 0.0166
          local alpha = math.clamp(dt * 5.5, 0, 1)
          local interpolatedBaseYaw = currentYaw + diff * alpha
          local activeSway = 0
          if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.01 then
            local swaySpeed = Settings.MoonwalkSwaySpeed or 14
            local swayInterval = 1.2 / swaySpeed
            local now = tick()
            if now - lastSwayFlip >= swayInterval then
              lastSwayFlip = now
              swayDirection = -swayDirection
            end
            local targetSway = swayDirection * (Settings.MoonwalkSwayAmplitude or 0.65)
            currentSwayValue = currentSwayValue
              + (targetSway - currentSwayValue) * math.clamp(dt * 18, 0, 1)
            local jitter = Settings.MoonwalkShaking or 0.05
            local shake = (math.random() - 0.5) * jitter
            activeSway = currentSwayValue + shake
          else
            currentSwayValue = 0
          end
          local turnDiff = math.abs(diff)
          local swayScale = math.clamp(1 - (turnDiff / (math.pi / 2)), 0, 1)
          activeSway = activeSway * swayScale
          local finalYaw = interpolatedBaseYaw + activeSway
          root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, finalYaw, 0)
        else
          hum.AutoRotate = true
        end
      end
      debug.profileend()
    end)
  end
  debug.profileend()
end))
local function getNoTurnSpeedLossDirection()
  local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
  if not cam then
    return Vector3.zero
  end
  local forward = 0
  local right = 0
  if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Up) then
    forward = forward + 1
  end
  if
    UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Down)
  then
    forward = forward - 1
  end
  if
    UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Right)
  then
    right = right + 1
  end
  if
    UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Left)
  then
    right = right - 1
  end
  if forward == 0 and right == 0 then
    return Vector3.zero
  end
  local camCFrame = cam.CFrame
  local lookFlat = Vector3.new(camCFrame.LookVector.X, 0, camCFrame.LookVector.Z)
  local rightFlat = Vector3.new(camCFrame.RightVector.X, 0, camCFrame.RightVector.Z)
  if lookFlat.Magnitude > 0 then
    lookFlat = lookFlat.Unit
  end
  if rightFlat.Magnitude > 0 then
    rightFlat = rightFlat.Unit
  end
  local rawDir = (lookFlat * forward) + (rightFlat * right)
  return rawDir.Magnitude > 0 and rawDir.Unit or Vector3.zero
end
registerConnection(RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
  if not activeLoop then
    return
  end
  if not Settings.NoTurnSpeedLoss then
    return
  end
  if _G.VD_IsParrying then
    return
  end
  if Settings.AutoMoonwalk then
    return
  end
  local char = localPlayer.Character
  if not char then
    return
  end
  local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or hum.WalkSpeed < 1 then
    return
  end
  local nowTime = os.clock()
  if (nowTime - (_G.VD_LastPumpkinCrush or 0)) < 1.4 then
    return
  end
  if (nowTime - (_G.VD_LastSlowTime or 0)) < ((_G.VD_SlowDuration or 1.3) + 0.1) then
    return
  end
  local intendedDir = getNoTurnSpeedLossDirection()
  local isMoving = intendedDir.Magnitude > 0.05
  if isMoving then
    hum.AutoRotate = false
    hum:Move(intendedDir, false)
    local speedBoostAttr = char:GetAttribute("speedboost") or 1.0
    local baseWalk = char:GetAttribute("Speed") or 16
    local targetSpeed = baseWalk * speedBoostAttr
    if Settings.SpeedBoostEnabled then
      local mult = tonumber(Settings.SpeedBoost) or 1.3
      targetSpeed = baseWalk * mult
    end
    local safePhysics = math.min(targetSpeed, 18.5)
    local currentY = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
      Vector3.new(intendedDir.X * safePhysics, currentY, intendedDir.Z * safePhysics)
    local extraSpeed = targetSpeed - safePhysics
    if extraSpeed > 0 then
      hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + (intendedDir * (extraSpeed * math.clamp(dt or 0.0166, 0.001, 0.05)))
    end
    local currentLook = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
    local flatCurrentLook = Vector3.new(currentLook.X, 0, currentLook.Z).Unit
    local dot = flatCurrentLook:Dot(intendedDir)
    if dot < 0.999 then
      local targetYaw = math.atan2(-intendedDir.X, -intendedDir.Z)
      local currentYaw = math.atan2(-flatCurrentLook.X, -flatCurrentLook.Z)
      local diff = (targetYaw - currentYaw + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
      local lerpFactor = math.clamp(26 * (dt or 0.0166), 0, 1)
      local newYaw = currentYaw + (diff * lerpFactor)
      local currentPos = hrp.Position
      hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentPos) * CFrame.Angles(0, newYaw, 0)
    end
  else
    hum.AutoRotate = true
    hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
  end
end))
_G.VD_FlowstateCooldownEnd = 0
_G.VD_FlowstateActiveOverrideEnd = 0
local function hasFlowstatePerk()
  local team = localPlayer.Team
  if team and team.Name == "Killer" then
    return false
  end
  if Settings.FlowstatePerk then
    return true
  end
  local char = localPlayer.Character
  if char then
    if char:GetAttribute("Flowstate") == true or char:FindFirstChild("Flowstate") ~= nil then
      return true
    end
  end
  local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
  if playerGui then
    local survivorPerks = playerGui:FindFirstChild("SurvivorPerks")
    local perks = survivorPerks and survivorPerks:FindFirstChild("Perks")
    if perks then
      for _, child in ipairs(perks:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Frame") or child:IsA("GuiObject") then
          local icon = child:FindFirstChild("Icon", true)
            or child:FindFirstChildOfClass("ImageLabel")
          if icon and icon:IsA("ImageLabel") then
            if tostring(icon.Image):find("108420950668748") then
              return true
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return false
end
function triggerFastVaultCooldown()
  if not hasFlowstatePerk() then
    return
  end
  if tick() < _G.VD_FlowstateCooldownEnd then
    return
  end
  _G.VD_FlowstateActiveOverrideEnd = tick() + 0.5
  _G.VD_FlowstateCooldownEnd = tick() + (Settings.FlowstateCooldown or 15)
end
_G.VD_QuickRecoveryBoostEnd = 0
_G.VD_QuickRecoveryCooldownEnd = 0
_G.VD_PerfectLandingBoostEnd = 0
_G.VD_PerfectLandingCooldownEnd = 0
local simulatedBoostEnforcerRunning = false
local function startSimulatedBoostEnforcer()
  if simulatedBoostEnforcerRunning then
    return
  end
  simulatedBoostEnforcerRunning = true
  task.spawn(function()
    while activeLoop do
      local now = tick()
      local qrActive = Settings.SimulateQuickRecovery and (now < (_G.VD_QuickRecoveryBoostEnd or 0))
      local plActive = Settings.SimulatePerfectLanding and (
          now < (_G.VD_PerfectLandingBoostEnd or 0)
        )
      if not qrActive and not plActive then
        break
      end
      pcall(applyLocalPlayerModifiers)
      task.wait(0.05)
    end
    simulatedBoostEnforcerRunning = false
    pcall(applyLocalPlayerModifiers)
  end)
end
function triggerQuickRecovery()
  if not Settings.SimulateQuickRecovery then
    return
  end
  local team = localPlayer.Team
  if team and team.Name == "Killer" then
    return
  end
  local now = tick()
  if now < (_G.VD_QuickRecoveryCooldownEnd or 0) then
    return
  end
  local cd = tonumber(Settings.QuickRecoveryCooldown) or 15
  _G.VD_QuickRecoveryBoostEnd = now + 3.0
  _G.VD_QuickRecoveryCooldownEnd = now + math.max(cd, 0.2)
  pcall(applyLocalPlayerModifiers)
  startSimulatedBoostEnforcer()
end
function triggerPerfectLanding()
  if not Settings.SimulatePerfectLanding then
    return
  end
  local team = localPlayer.Team
  if team and team.Name == "Killer" then
    return
  end
  local now = tick()
  if now < (_G.VD_PerfectLandingCooldownEnd or 0) then
    return
  end
  local cd = tonumber(Settings.PerfectLandingCooldown) or 15
  _G.VD_PerfectLandingBoostEnd = now + 3.0
  _G.VD_PerfectLandingCooldownEnd = now + math.max(cd, 0.2)
  if gameSpeedBoosts then
    for m, spd in pairs(gameSpeedBoosts) do
      if type(spd) == "number" and spd < 1.0 then
        gameSpeedBoosts[m] = 1.0
      end
    end
  end
  pcall(applyLocalPlayerModifiers)
  startSimulatedBoostEnforcer()
end
function watchLocalPlayerCharacter(char)
  if not char then
    return
  end
  if localPlayerCharConn then
    pcall(function()
      localPlayerCharConn:Disconnect()
    end)
    localPlayerCharConn = nil
  end
  if localPlayerAnimConn then
    pcall(function()
      localPlayerAnimConn:Disconnect()
    end)
    localPlayerAnimConn = nil
  end
  if localPlayerAttrConn then
    pcall(function()
      localPlayerAttrConn:Disconnect()
    end)
    localPlayerAttrConn = nil
  end
  if localPlayerChildConn then
    pcall(function()
      localPlayerChildConn:Disconnect()
    end)
    localPlayerChildConn = nil
  end
  local stashedSkillcheckObjs = {}
  _G.VD_StashedSkillchecks = stashedSkillcheckObjs
  _G.VD_StashSkillchecks = function()
    if
      not (
        isPremiumActive("NoSkillChecks")
        and localHooksTable
        and type(localHooksTable.NoSkillChecks) == "function"
      )
    then
      return
    end
    local c = localPlayer.Character
    if not c then
      return
    end
    localHooksTable.NoSkillChecks(c, stashedSkillcheckObjs)
  end
  _G.VD_RestoreSkillchecks = function()
    local c = localPlayer.Character
    if not c then
      return
    end
    for i = #stashedSkillcheckObjs, 1, -1 do
      local sc = stashedSkillcheckObjs[i]
      if sc and sc.Parent == nil then
        pcall(function()
          sc.Parent = c
        end)
      end
    end
    table.clear(stashedSkillcheckObjs)
  end
  local function handleSkillcheckChild(child)
    if
      Settings.NoSkillChecks
      and isPremiumActive("NoSkillChecks")
      and localHooksTable
      and type(localHooksTable.NoSkillChecks) == "function"
    then
      local nameLower = child.Name:lower()
      if nameLower:find("skillcheck") then
        if not table.find(stashedSkillcheckObjs, child) then
          table.insert(stashedSkillcheckObjs, child)
        end
        pcall(function()
          child.Parent = nil
        end)
      end
    end
  end
  pcall(function()
    for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
      handleSkillcheckChild(child)
    end
  end)
  localPlayerChildConn = char.ChildAdded:Connect(handleSkillcheckChild)
  task.spawn(function()
    local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
    local animator = hum and hum:WaitForChild("Animator", 10)
    if hum and (isHookIncompatible or not hookmetamethod) then
      localPlayerCharConn = hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(oldState, newState)
        if newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed and Settings.SimulatePerfectLanding then
          pcall(triggerPerfectLanding)
        end
      end)
    end
    if animator then
      localPlayerAnimConn = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
        local trackName = (track.Name or ""):lower()
        local anim = track.Animation
        local animId = anim and anim.AnimationId or ""
        animId = typeof(animId) == "string" and animId:lower() or ""
        if tick() - _G.VD_LastRemoteDropTime < 1.0 then
          local isPalletAnim = trackName:find("pallet")
            or trackName:find("pull")
            or trackName:find("drop")
            or trackName:find("interact")
            or trackName:find("grab")
            or animId:find("pallet")
            or animId:find("pull")
            or animId:find("drop")
            or animId:find("interact")
            or animId:find("grab")
          if isPalletAnim then
            pcall(function()
              track:Stop(0)
            end)
          end
        end
        local isSlowVault = trackName:find("walking") or animId:find("126081405469607")
        local isFastVault = trackName:find("running")
          or trackName:find("finesse")
          or animId:find("83873880822918")
          or animId:find("136962284480779")
          or trackName:find("fast")
        if (isSlowVault or isFastVault) and (isHookIncompatible or not hookmetamethod) then
          pcall(function()
            track.Stopped:Once(function()
              if Settings.SimulateQuickRecovery then
                pcall(triggerQuickRecovery)
              end
            end)
          end)
        end
        if isSlowVault then
          return
        end
        if isFastVault then
          triggerFastVaultCooldown()
        end
      end)
    end
  end)
end
pcall(function()
  watchLocalPlayerCharacter(localPlayer.Character)
end)
registerConnection(localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(watchLocalPlayerCharacter))

_G.VD_TriggerManualFake = nil
pcall(function()

            end
            if SV._origEvaluate then

                or isPremiumActive("FastVault")
                or isPremiumActive()
              )
            then
              return true, "ready", 5
            end
            if SAC._origValidate then
              return SAC._origValidate(self, point, isSprinting)
            end
            return false, "failed", 0
          end
        end

                  rawset(uv, "_validateFastVault", nil)
                  rawset(uv, "_cancelVaultTraversal", nil)
