                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end)
      fastVaultHooked = true
    end
  end
  local alwaysVaultHooked = false
  local function installAlwaysVaultHooks()
    if not Settings.AlwaysVault then
      return
    end
    if not alwaysVaultHooked then
      pcall(function()
        local AL = require(
          ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules")
            :WaitForChild("Survivors")
            :WaitForChild("ActionLocks")
        )
        if AL then
          if not AL._origIsBlocked then
            AL._origIsBlocked = AL.isBlocked
          end
          AL.isBlocked = function(char, actionName)
            if Settings.AlwaysVault and (actionName == "vault" or actionName == "palletslide") then
              return false
            end
            if AL._origIsBlocked then
              return AL._origIsBlocked(char, actionName)
            end
            return false
          end
        end
      end)
      pcall(function()
        local SP = require(
          ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules")
            :WaitForChild("Survivors")
            :WaitForChild("SurvivorProximity")
        )
        if SP then
          if not SP._origFindNearestPoint then
            SP._origFindNearestPoint = SP.findNearestPoint
          end
          local origFind = SP._origFindNearestPoint
          SP.findNearestPoint = function(self, a2, a3)
            if Settings.AlwaysVault then
              local hrp = self.humanoidRootPart
                or (self.character and self.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
              local hrpPos = hrp and hrp.Position
              local maxDist = 7.5
              if hrpPos then
                if a2 == "VaultPoint" then
                  local bestPoint = nil
                  local bestDist = maxDist
                  for _, v in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("VaultPoint")) do
                    if v:IsA("BasePart") and not v:IsDescendantOf(self.character) then
                      local d = (v.Position - hrpPos).Magnitude
                      if d <= bestDist then
                        bestDist = d
                        bestPoint = v
                      end
                    end
                  end
                  if bestPoint then
                    return bestPoint
                  end
                  return nil
                elseif a2 == "PalletPointSlide" then
                  local bestPoint = nil
                  local bestDist = maxDist
                  for _, p in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("pallet")) do
                    local pState = p:GetAttribute("PalletState")
                    local intact = p:FindFirstChild("Intact")
                    local hasSlidePoint = intact and intact:FindFirstChild("PalletPointSlide")
                    local isUpright = (pState == "Upright")
                      or (
                        pState == nil
                        and p:GetAttribute("DroppedAt") == nil
                        and not hasSlidePoint
                      )
                    if not isUpright then
                      if intact then
                        for _, ch in ipairs(intact:GetChildren()) do
                          if
                            ch:IsA("BasePart")
                            and (ch.Name == "PalletPoint" or ch.Name == "PalletPointSlide")
                          then
                            local d = (ch.Position - hrpPos).Magnitude
                            if d <= bestDist then
                              bestDist = d
                              bestPoint = ch
                            end
                          end
                        end
                      else
                        for _, ch in ipairs(p:GetDescendants()) do
                          if
                            ch:IsA("BasePart")
                            and (
                              ch.Name == "PalletPoint"
                              or ch.Name == "PalletPointSlide"
                              or ch.Name == "RootPart"
                            )
                          then
                            local d = (ch.Position - hrpPos).Magnitude
                            if d <= bestDist then
                              bestDist = d
                              bestPoint = ch
                            end
                          end
                        end
                      end
                    end
                  end
                  if bestPoint then
                    return bestPoint
                  end
                  return nil
                end
              end
            end
            return origFind(self, a2, a3)
          end
        end
      end)
      alwaysVaultHooked = true
    end
  end
  local isTraversingNow = false
  local function setOtherPlayersCollision(canCollide)
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if player ~= localPlayer and player.Character then
        for _, part in ipairs(player.Character:GetDescendants()) do
          if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.CanCollide = canCollide
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function isCharacterTraversing()
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    if not char then
      return false
    end
    local ci = char:FindFirstChild("CheckInterractable")
    if ci and (ci:GetAttribute("isVaulting") == true or ci:GetAttribute("isSliding") == true) then
      return true
    end
    if char:GetAttribute("isvaulting") == true or char:GetAttribute("issliding") == true then
      return true
    end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
      for _, track in ipairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
        local name = track.Name:lower()
        if name:find("vault") or name:find("slide") then
          return true
        end
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  registerConnection(RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if not Settings.AlwaysVault then
      if isTraversingNow then
        isTraversingNow = false
        setOtherPlayersCollision(true)
      end
      return
    end
    local active = isCharacterTraversing()
    if active then
      isTraversingNow = true
      setOtherPlayersCollision(false)
    elseif isTraversingNow then
      isTraversingNow = false
      setOtherPlayersCollision(true)
    end
  end))
  local function isKillerRole()
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    if not char then
      return false
    end
    return (
      char:GetAttribute("MorphedKiller") ~= nil
      or char:GetAttribute("Killer") == true
      or char:FindFirstChild("Lookscriptkiller") ~= nil
      or char:FindFirstChild("Powers") ~= nil
      or (isLocalKiller and isLocalKiller())
    )
  end
  _G.VD_IsKillerRole = isKillerRole
  local cachedVaultCommit = nil
  local cachedCameraAction = nil
  local function getCachedVaultCommit()
    if cachedVaultCommit and cachedVaultCommit.Parent then
      return cachedVaultCommit
    end
    pcall(function()
      local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
      local win = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Window")
      cachedVaultCommit = win and win:FindFirstChild("VaultCommit")
    end)
    _G.VD_CachedVaultCommit = cachedVaultCommit
    return cachedVaultCommit
  end
  local function getCachedCameraAction()
    if cachedCameraAction and cachedCameraAction.Parent then
      return cachedCameraAction
    end
    pcall(function()
      local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
      local kil = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Killers")
      cachedCameraAction = kil and kil:FindFirstChild("CameraAction")
    end)
    _G.VD_CachedCameraAction = cachedCameraAction
    return cachedCameraAction
  end
  pcall(getCachedVaultCommit)
  pcall(getCachedCameraAction)
  local cachedKillerContext = nil
  local function getKillerHandler()
    if cachedKillerContext and cachedKillerContext.character and cachedKillerContext.script then
      return cachedKillerContext
    end
    pcall(function()
      local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
      local win = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Window")
      local vr = win and win:FindFirstChild("VaultReject")
      if vr and getconnections then
        for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(vr.OnClientEvent)) do
          if c.Function and getupvalues then
            for _, uv in pairs(getupvalues(c.Function)) do
              if type(uv) == "table" and uv.character == localPlayer.Character then
                cachedKillerContext = uv
                break
              end
            end
          end
          if cachedKillerContext then
            break
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    return cachedKillerContext
  end
  local function performKillerCancel()
    local v6 = getKillerHandler()
    local char = (v6 and v6.character) or localPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if cam then
      cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
      if hum then
        cam.CameraSubject = hum
      end
      local vm = cam:FindFirstChild("VM")
      local vmHum = vm and vm:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local vmAnim = vmHum and vmHum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
      if vmAnim then
        pcall(function()
          for _, track in ipairs(vmAnim:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
            track:Stop(0.05)
          end
        end)
      end
    end
    if v6 and v6.state and v6.state.interactionPrediction then
      if v6.state.interactionPrediction.tween then
        pcall(function()
          v6.state.interactionPrediction.tween:Cancel()
        end)
      end
      v6.state.interactionPrediction = nil
    end
    if v6 and v6.script then
      pcall(function()
        v6.script:SetAttribute("action", false)
        v6.script:SetAttribute("InteractionRequestId", nil)
        v6.script:SetAttribute("InteractionKind", nil)
        v6.script:SetAttribute("isVaulting", false)
      end)
    end
    if v6 and v6.state then
      v6.state.isVaulting = false
    end
    if char then
      pcall(function()
        char:SetAttribute("isVaulting", false)
        char:SetAttribute("Immobile", false)
        char:SetAttribute("overridelookscript", false)
      end)
    end
    if animator then
      for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
        pcall(function()
          track:Stop(0.05)
        end)
      end
    end
    if hum then
      hum.AutoRotate = true
      local baseSpeed = (char and char:GetAttribute("Speed")) or 18.7
      local boost = (char and char:GetAttribute("speedboost")) or 1
      hum.WalkSpeed = baseSpeed * boost
    end
    if hrp then
      hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
      hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end
  end
  _G.VD_PerformKillerCancel = performKillerCancel
  local cachedSurvivorAnimCtrl = nil
  local function getSurvivorAnimController()
    if
      cachedSurvivorAnimCtrl
      and cachedSurvivorAnimCtrl.character
      and cachedSurvivorAnimCtrl.character.Parent
    then
      return cachedSurvivorAnimCtrl
    end
    pcall(function()
      local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
      local sb = remotes
        and remotes:FindFirstChild("Pallet")
        and remotes.Pallet:FindFirstChild("Slidebindable")
      local vb = remotes
        and remotes:FindFirstChild("Window")
        and remotes.Window:FindFirstChild("Vaultbindable")
      local ev = (sb and sb.Event) or (vb and vb.Event)
      if ev and getconnections then
        for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(ev)) do
          if c.Function and getupvalues then
            for _, uv in pairs(getupvalues(c.Function)) do
              if type(uv) == "table" and uv.character == localPlayer.Character then
                cachedSurvivorAnimCtrl = uv
                break
              end
            end
          end
          if cachedSurvivorAnimCtrl then
            break
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    return cachedSurvivorAnimCtrl
  end
  local function performSurvivorCancel(animCtrl, char, currentType, savedEntryCFrame)
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
      return
    end
    local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
    if animCtrl then
      if currentType == "Slide" then
        pcall(function()
          animCtrl:_cancelSlideTraversal()
        end)
      else
        pcall(function()
          animCtrl:_cancelVaultTraversal()
        end)
      end
    end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if animator then
      for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
        local name = track.Animation and track.Animation.Name:lower() or ""
        if name:find("vault") or name:find("slide") or name:find("over") then
          pcall(function()
            track:Stop(0.05)
          end)
        end
      end
    end
    if savedEntryCFrame then
      pcall(function()
        hrp.CFrame = savedEntryCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0.5)
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
      end)
    end
    if hum then
      hum.AutoRotate = true
      hum.JumpPower = 50
    end
    pcall(function()
      char:SetAttribute("overridelookscript", false)
      char:SetAttribute("isvaulting", false)
      char:SetAttribute("issliding", false)
      if animCtrl and animCtrl.motherscript then
        animCtrl.motherscript:SetAttribute("isVaulting", false)
        animCtrl.motherscript:SetAttribute("isSliding", false)
      end
    end)
  end
  local wasActionActive = false
  local actionStartTime = 0
  local actionStartPos = nil
  local savedEntryCFrame = nil
  local activeActionType = "None"
  local fakeExecuted = false
  local obstaclePos = nil
  local traversalDir = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
  local manualFakeArmed = false
  local function triggerManualFake()
    if isKillerRole() then
      performKillerCancel()
    else
      local animCtrl = getSurvivorAnimController()
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      if animCtrl and char then
        local isSliding = (animCtrl.isSlideingPallet == true)
          or (char:GetAttribute("issliding") == true)
        local isVaulting = (animCtrl.isVaulting == true) or (
            char:GetAttribute("isvaulting") == true
          )
        if isSliding or isVaulting then
          performSurvivorCancel(animCtrl, char, isSliding and "Slide" or "Vault", savedEntryCFrame)
        else
          manualFakeArmed = true
        end
      end
    end
  end
  _G.VD_TriggerManualFake = triggerManualFake
  local heartbeatConnection = registerConnection(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if Settings.FastVault or Settings.AlwaysFastVault then
      installFastVaultHooks()
    end
    if Settings.AlwaysVault then
      installAlwaysVaultHooks()
    end
    if not isKillerRole() then
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if hrp then
        local animCtrl = getSurvivorAnimController()
        local isVaultingNow = (animCtrl and animCtrl.isVaulting == true)
          or (char:GetAttribute("isvaulting") == true)
        local isSlidingNow = (animCtrl and animCtrl.isSlideingPallet == true)
          or (char:GetAttribute("issliding") == true)
        local isActionNow = isVaultingNow or isSlidingNow
        local currentActionType = isSlidingNow and "Slide" or (isVaultingNow and "Vault" or "None")
        if isActionNow and not wasActionActive then
          actionStartTime = os.clock()
          actionStartPos = hrp.Position
          activeActionType = currentActionType
          fakeExecuted = false
          local entryCF = hrp.CFrame
          if isSlidingNow and animCtrl and animCtrl.slideEntryCFrame then
            entryCF = animCtrl.slideEntryCFrame
          elseif isVaultingNow and animCtrl and animCtrl.vaultEntryCFrame then
            entryCF = animCtrl.vaultEntryCFrame
          end
          savedEntryCFrame = entryCF
          obstaclePos = nil
          if isSlidingNow then
            local p = animCtrl and (animCtrl.activeSlideWall or animCtrl.activeSlidePoint)
            if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
              obstaclePos = p.Position
            end
          else
            local w = animCtrl
              and (
                animCtrl.activeVaultWall
                or animCtrl.activeVaultPoint
                or animCtrl.activeVaultBottom
              )
            if w and w:IsA("BasePart") then
              obstaclePos = w.Position
            end
          end
          if not obstaclePos then
            obstaclePos = actionStartPos + hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 3.5
          end
          local toObstacle = (obstaclePos - actionStartPos) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
          traversalDir = toObstacle.Magnitude > 0.4 and toObstacle.Unit
            or (hrp.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Unit
        end
        if isActionNow and not fakeExecuted then
          local shouldFake = Settings.FakeVault == true or manualFakeArmed
          if shouldFake then
            local currentPos = hrp.Position
            local forwardFromStart = ((currentPos - actionStartPos) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)):Dot(
              traversalDir
            )
            local signedDistToSill = ((currentPos - obstaclePos) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)):Dot(
              traversalDir
            )
            local elapsed = os.clock() - actionStartTime
            if (forwardFromStart >= 1.6 and signedDistToSill >= 0.35) or (elapsed >= 2.0) then
              performSurvivorCancel(animCtrl, char, activeActionType, savedEntryCFrame)
              fakeExecuted = true
              manualFakeArmed = false
            end
          end
        elseif not isActionNow and wasActionActive then
          fakeExecuted = false
          activeActionType = "None"
          manualFakeArmed = false
        end
        wasActionActive = isActionNow
      end
    end
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    if char and not isKillerRole() then
      local motherscript = char:FindFirstChild("CheckInterractable")
      local isVaultingAttr = char:GetAttribute("isvaulting") == true
        or (motherscript and motherscript:GetAttribute("isVaulting") == true)
      local isSlidingAttr = char:GetAttribute("issliding") == true
        or (motherscript and motherscript:GetAttribute("isSliding") == true)
      if not isVaultingAttr and not isSlidingAttr then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum and hum.Health > 0 and not Settings.AutoMoonwalk and hum.AutoRotate == false then
          local isKnocked = char:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
          local isHooked = char:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
            or char:GetAttribute("Hooked") == true
          local isCarried = char:GetAttribute("IsCarried") == true
          if not isKnocked and not isHooked and not isCarried then
            hum.AutoRotate = true
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end))
  registerConnection(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if gpe then
      return
    end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.X then
      triggerManualFake()
    end
  end))
  if getgenv then
    getgenv()._FastAndFakeVaultConn = heartbeatConnection
  end
end)
task.spawn(function()
  local lastFlowstatePerk = nil
  local initialWriteDone = {}
  while activeLoop do
    pcall(function()
      local playerName = localPlayer.Name
      local targets = {}
      if localPlayer.Character then
        table.insert(targets, localPlayer.Character)
      end
      local direct = workspace:FindFirstChild(playerName)
      if direct and direct:IsA("Model") and not table.find(targets, direct) then
        table.insert(targets, direct)
      end
      local isCurrentlyClimbing = false
      local searchRoots =
        { "climb_obsessing", "climb_collisoning", "climb_collisioning", "climb_colliding" }
      for _, rootName in ipairs(searchRoots) do
        local root = workspace:FindFirstChild(rootName)
        if root then
          local model = root:FindFirstChild(playerName)
          if model and model:IsA("Model") then
            isCurrentlyClimbing = true
            if not table.find(targets, model) then
              table.insert(targets, model)
            end
          end
        end
      end
      if isCurrentlyClimbing then
        triggerFastVaultCooldown()
      end
      local flowstateOnCooldown = tick() < _G.VD_FlowstateCooldownEnd
      local isWithinVaultDuration = tick() < _G.VD_FlowstateActiveOverrideEnd
      local desiredFlowstate = Settings.FlowstatePerk
        and (isWithinVaultDuration or not flowstateOnCooldown)
      if localPlayer:GetAttribute("Flowstate") ~= desiredFlowstate then
        localPlayer:SetAttribute("Flowstate", desiredFlowstate)
      end
      for _, model in ipairs(targets) do
        if model:GetAttribute("Flowstate") ~= desiredFlowstate then
          model:SetAttribute("Flowstate", desiredFlowstate)
        end
      end
    end)
    task.wait(0.1)
  end
end)

task.spawn(function()
  local trackedBlindElements = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
  local function hookBlindElement(desc)
    if desc.Name == "Blind" and desc:IsA("GuiObject") and not trackedBlindElements[desc] then
      trackedBlindElements[desc] = true
      if Settings.NoFlashlightBlind then
        pcall(function()
          desc.Visible = false
          if desc:IsA("Frame") or desc:IsA("ImageLabel") then
            desc.BackgroundTransparency = 1
          end
        end)
      end
      registerConnection(desc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
        if Settings.NoFlashlightBlind then
          pcall(function()
            desc.Visible = false
          end)
        end
      end))
      registerConnection(desc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundTransparency"):Connect(function()
        if Settings.NoFlashlightBlind then
          pcall(function()
            if desc:IsA("Frame") or desc:IsA("ImageLabel") then
              desc.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            end
          end)
        end
      end))
    end
  end
  local playerGui = localPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
  if playerGui then
    for _, desc in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
      hookBlindElement(desc)
    end
    registerConnection(playerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
      hookBlindElement(desc)
    end))
  end
  while activeLoop do
    if Settings.NoFlashlightBlind then
      pcall(function()
        for desc, _ in pairs(trackedBlindElements) do
          if desc and desc.Parent then
            if desc.Visible then
              desc.Visible = false
            end
            if
              (desc:IsA("Frame") or desc:IsA("ImageLabel")) and desc.BackgroundTransparency ~= 1
            then
              desc.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            end
          else
            trackedBlindElements[desc] = nil
          end
        end
      end)
    end
    task.wait(0.5)
  end
end)

(function()
  local currentGoalStart = 104
  local currentGoalEnd = 114
  local lastKingsScourgeCheck = 0
  local cachedHasKingsScourge = false
  local isKingsScourgeRemoteActive = false
  local kingsScourgeStartTime = 0
  local kingsScourgeSeenVisible = false
  local kingsScourgeLastSeen = nil
  _G.VD_IsKingsScourgeActive = false
  pcall(function()
    local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local remotes = rs:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    local kp = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("KillerPerks")
    local ks = kp and kp:FindFirstChild("kingscourge")
    if ks then
      local startEv = ks:FindFirstChild("KingScourgeStart")
      if startEv then
        registerConnection(startEv.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6)
          local char = localPlayer.Character
          local ci = char and char:FindFirstChild("CheckInterractable")
          local reqId = ci and ci:GetAttribute("RepairRequestId")
          if
            a5 == char
            or (a5 and char and a5.Name == char.Name)
            or (not a5 and not a6)
            or (a6 and reqId and a6 == reqId)
          then
            isKingsScourgeRemoteActive = true
            _G.VD_IsKingsScourgeActive = true
            kingsScourgeStartTime = tick()
            kingsScourgeSeenVisible = false
            kingsScourgeLastSeen = tick()
          end
        end))
      end
      local endEv = ks:FindFirstChild("KingScourgeEnd")
      if endEv then
        registerConnection(endEv.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
          isKingsScourgeRemoteActive = false
          _G.VD_IsKingsScourgeActive = false
          kingsScourgeSeenVisible = false
          kingsScourgeLastSeen = nil
        end))
      end
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    local function attachMoveVectorProtection()
      local pScripts = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
      if not pScripts then
        return
      end
      local pMod = pScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
      if not pMod then
        return
      end
      local ok, mod = pcall(require, pMod)
      if not ok or type(mod) ~= "table" or type(mod.GetControls) ~= "function" then
        return
      end
      local ctrl = mod:GetControls()
      if ctrl and type(ctrl.GetMoveVector) == "function" and not ctrl._vd_scourge_shielded then
        local rawGetMoveVector = ctrl.GetMoveVector
        ctrl._vd_scourge_shielded = true
        ctrl.GetMoveVector = function(self, ...)
          if
            _G.VD_IsKingsScourgeActive
            or isKingsScourgeRemoteActive
            or (isKingsScourgeActiveOnCurrentGen and isKingsScourgeActiveOnCurrentGen())
          then
            return Vector3.zero
          end
          return rawGetMoveVector(self, ...)
        end
      end
    end
    attachMoveVectorProtection()
    registerConnection(localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
      task.delay(0.5, attachMoveVectorProtection)
    end))
  end)
  local function hasKillerKingsScourge()
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastKingsScourgeCheck < 2.0 then
      return cachedHasKingsScourge
    end
    lastKingsScourgeCheck = now
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      local team = player.Team
      local isKiller = false
      if team and (team.Name == "Killer" or team.Name:lower():find("killer")) then
        isKiller = true
      elseif player:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or player:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true then
        isKiller = true
      elseif player.Name:lower():find("killer") then
        isKiller = true
      end
      if isKiller and player.Character then
        for _, child in ipairs(player.Character:GetChildren()) do
          if string.find(child.Name, "King's Scourge") then
            cachedHasKingsScourge = true
            return true
          end
        end
        for _, desc in ipairs(player.Character:GetDescendants()) do
          if string.find(desc.Name, "King's Scourge") then
            cachedHasKingsScourge = true
            return true
          end
        end
      end
    end
    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
      if obj:IsA("Model") and obj ~= localPlayer.Character then
        for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
          if string.find(child.Name, "King's Scourge") then
            cachedHasKingsScourge = true
            return true
          end
        end
      end
    end
    cachedHasKingsScourge = false
    return false
  end
  local function getClosestGenerator()
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then
      return nil
    end
    local closestGen = nil
    local minDist = math.huge
    for _, gen in ipairs(cachedGenerators) do
      if gen and gen.Parent and not isGeneratorCompleted(gen) then
        local genRoot = gen:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          or gen:FindFirstChild("Engine")
          or gen:FindFirstChildOfClass("Part")
        if genRoot then
          local dist = (root.Position - genRoot.Position).Magnitude
          if dist < minDist then
            minDist = dist
            closestGen = gen
          end
        end
      end
    end
    for gen, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.Generators) do
      if gen and gen.Parent and not isGeneratorCompleted(gen) then
        local genRoot = gen:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          or gen:FindFirstChild("Engine")
          or gen:FindFirstChildOfClass("Part")
        if genRoot then
          local dist = (root.Position - genRoot.Position).Magnitude
          if dist < minDist then
            minDist = dist
            closestGen = gen
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if minDist < 14 then
      return closestGen
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function isKingsScourgeActiveOnCurrentGen()
    if isKingsScourgeRemoteActive or _G.VD_IsKingsScourgeActive then
      return true
    end
    if _G.VD_KillerHasKingsScourge or hasKillerKingsScourge() then
      local closestGen = getClosestGenerator()
      if closestGen then
        local progress = getGeneratorProgress(closestGen)
        if progress >= 80 then
          return true
        end
      end
    end
    local closestGen = getClosestGenerator()
    if closestGen then
      local progress = getGeneratorProgress(closestGen)
      if progress >= 82 then
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local isTrapCheck = false
  local function selectGoalOffsets()
    if isTrapCheck then
      currentGoalStart = 107
      currentGoalEnd = 111
      return
    end
    if
      isKingsScourgeActiveOnCurrentGen()
      or isKingsScourgeRemoteActive
      or _G.VD_IsKingsScourgeActive
    then
      currentGoalStart = 107
      currentGoalEnd = 111
      return
    end
    local mode = Settings.SkillCheckMode or "Perfect"
    if mode == "Normal" then
      local startOffset = math.random(125, 145)
      currentGoalStart = startOffset
      currentGoalEnd = startOffset + 10
    elseif mode == "Perfect" then
      currentGoalStart = 107
      currentGoalEnd = 111
    elseif mode == "Random" then
      local rate = math.clamp(Settings.PerfectHitRate or 70, 0, 100)
      if math.random(1, 100) <= rate then
        currentGoalStart = 107
        currentGoalEnd = 111
      else
        local startOffset = math.random(125, 145)
        currentGoalStart = startOffset
        currentGoalEnd = startOffset + 10
      end
    end
  end
  local instantSuppressedGen = nil
  local instantSuppressedUntil = 0
  local gen85Triggered = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
  local function isInstantSkillCheckAllowed()
    if not Settings.InstantSkillCheck then
      return false
    end
    if isKingsScourgeActiveOnCurrentGen() or isKingsScourgeRemoteActive then
      return false
    end
    local closestGen = getClosestGenerator()
    if closestGen and closestGen.Parent then
      local isCompleted = isGeneratorCompleted(closestGen)
      local progress = getGeneratorProgress(closestGen)
      if isCompleted or progress >= 100 then
        if instantSuppressedGen == closestGen then
          instantSuppressedGen = nil
          instantSuppressedUntil = 0
        end
        gen85Triggered[closestGen] = nil
      else
        local now = tick()
        if progress >= 85 then
          if not gen85Triggered[closestGen] then
            gen85Triggered[closestGen] = true
            instantSuppressedGen = closestGen
            instantSuppressedUntil = now + 10
          end
        elseif progress < 82 then
          gen85Triggered[closestGen] = false
          if instantSuppressedGen == closestGen then
            instantSuppressedGen = nil
            instantSuppressedUntil = 0
          end
        end
        if instantSuppressedGen == closestGen then
          if now < instantSuppressedUntil then
            return false
          else
            instantSuppressedGen = nil
            instantSuppressedUntil = 0
          end
        end
      end
    else
      if
        instantSuppressedGen
        and (
          not instantSuppressedGen.Parent
          or isGeneratorCompleted(instantSuppressedGen)
          or tick() >= instantSuppressedUntil
        )
      then
        instantSuppressedGen = nil
        instantSuppressedUntil = 0
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  local checkFrame, lineObject, goalObject = nil, nil, nil
  local promptGuiCached = nil
  local lastGoalRotation = nil
  local guiAppearedTime = nil
  local lastHitTime = 0
  local isMoving = false
  local lastRotation = nil
  local hasInstantTriggered = false
  local hasHitCurrent = false
  local currentCheckId = 0
  local isSpaceHeld = false
  local function getSkillCheckPromptGui()
    local pg = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if not pg then
      return nil
    end
    return pg:FindFirstChild("SkillCheckPromptGui") or pg:FindFirstChild("SkillCheckPromptGui-con")
  end
  local vimService = nil
  if not isMobile then
    pcall(function()
      vimService = VirtualInputManager or game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
    end)
  end
  local function releaseSpace()
    pcall(function()
      if not isMobile and vimService then
        pcall(function()
          vimService:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
        end)
      end
      if not isMobile and typeof(keyinput) == "function" then
        pcall(function()
          keyinput(Enum.KeyCode.Space, false)
        end)
      end
      if not isMobile and typeof(keyrelease) == "function" then
        pcall(function()
          keyrelease(0x20)
        end)
      end
      isSpaceHeld = false
    end)
  end
  local function pressSpace()
    pcall(function()
      if isSpaceHeld then
        releaseSpace()
      end
      isSpaceHeld = true
      if not isMobile and vimService then
        pcall(function()
          vimService:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
        end)
      end
      if not isMobile and typeof(keyinput) == "function" then
        pcall(function()
          keyinput(Enum.KeyCode.Space, true)
        end)
      end
      if not isMobile and typeof(keypress) == "function" then
        pcall(function()
          keypress(0x20)
        end)
      end
      if not isMobile and typeof(firesignal) == "function" then
        local fakeInput = {
          KeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.Space,
          UserInputType = Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard,
          UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.Begin,
        }
        pcall(function()
          firesignal(UserInputService.InputBegan, fakeInput, false)
        end)
      end
      local pg = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
      if pg then
        local mobGui = pg:FindFirstChild("Survivor-mob")
        local mobAction = mobGui
          and mobGui:FindFirstChild("Controls")
          and mobGui.Controls:FindFirstChild("action")
        if mobAction then
          local prevGoalRot = goalObject and goalObject.Rotation
          local isScourge = isKingsScourgeActiveOnCurrentGen() or isKingsScourgeRemoteActive
          local fired = false
          if typeof(firesignal) == "function" then
            local ok = pcall(function()
              firesignal(mobAction.MouseButton1Down)
            end)
            if ok then
              fired = true
            end
          end
          local needFallback = not fired
          if
            isScourge
            and fired
            and goalObject
            and prevGoalRot
            and math.abs(goalObject.Rotation - prevGoalRot) <= 0.5
            and checkFrame
            and checkFrame.Visible
          then
            needFallback = true
          end
          if needFallback and typeof(getconnections) == "function" then
            pcall(function()
              local conns = getconnections(mobAction.MouseButton1Down)
              for _, conn in ipairs(conns) do
                if conn and typeof(conn.Fire) == "function" then
                  conn:Fire()
                  if
                    (
                      goalObject
                      and prevGoalRot
                      and math.abs(goalObject.Rotation - prevGoalRot) > 0.5
                    ) or (checkFrame and not checkFrame.Visible)
                  then
                    break
                  end
                end
              end
            end)
          end
        end
        local conGui = pg:FindFirstChild("Survivor-controller")
        local conAction = conGui
          and conGui:FindFirstChild("Controls")
          and conGui.Controls:FindFirstChild("action")
        local conCheck = conAction and conAction:FindFirstChild("check")
        if conCheck then
          local prevGoalRot = goalObject and goalObject.Rotation
          local isScourge = isKingsScourgeActiveOnCurrentGen() or isKingsScourgeRemoteActive
          local conFired = false
          if typeof(firesignal) == "function" then
            local ok = pcall(function()
              firesignal(conCheck.MouseButton1Down)
            end)
            if ok then
              conFired = true
            end
          end
          local needConFallback = not conFired
          if
            isScourge
            and conFired
            and goalObject
            and prevGoalRot
            and math.abs(goalObject.Rotation - prevGoalRot) <= 0.5
            and checkFrame
            and checkFrame.Visible
          then
            needConFallback = true
          end
          if needConFallback and typeof(getconnections) == "function" then
            pcall(function()
              local conns = getconnections(conCheck.MouseButton1Down)
              for _, conn in ipairs(conns) do
                if conn and typeof(conn.Fire) == "function" then
                  conn:Fire()
                  if
                    (
                      goalObject
                      and prevGoalRot
                      and math.abs(goalObject.Rotation - prevGoalRot) > 0.5
                    ) or (checkFrame and not checkFrame.Visible)
                  then
                    break
                  end
                end
              end
            end)
          end
        end
      end
      task.delay(0.015, function()
        releaseSpace()
      end)
    end)
  end
  local function trySetupGUI()
    local activePrompt = getSkillCheckPromptGui()
    if not activePrompt then
      checkFrame, lineObject, goalObject = nil, nil, nil
      isTrapCheck = false
      promptGuiCached = nil
      releaseSpace()
      return false
    end
    promptGuiCached = activePrompt
    checkFrame = activePrompt:FindFirstChild("Check")
    if not checkFrame then
      return false
    end
    lineObject = checkFrame:FindFirstChild("Line")
    local trapPerf = checkFrame:FindFirstChild("TrapPerfect")
    local trapGoal = checkFrame:FindFirstChild("TrapGoal")
    local stdGoal = checkFrame:FindFirstChild("Goal")
    if trapPerf and trapPerf.Visible then
      goalObject = trapPerf
      isTrapCheck = true
    elseif trapGoal and trapGoal.Visible then
      goalObject = trapGoal
      isTrapCheck = true
    elseif trapPerf then
      goalObject = trapPerf
      isTrapCheck = true
    elseif stdGoal then
      goalObject = stdGoal
      isTrapCheck = false
    else
      goalObject = nil
      isTrapCheck = false
    end
    if lineObject and goalObject then
      lastHitTime = 0
      return true
    end
    return false
  end
  local function isSkillCheckActive()
    local activePrompt = getSkillCheckPromptGui()
    if not activePrompt or not activePrompt:IsA("ScreenGui") then
      return false
    end
    local check = activePrompt:FindFirstChild("Check")
    if not check or not check.Visible then
      return false
    end
    if promptGuiCached ~= activePrompt then
      trySetupGUI()
    end
    return true
  end
  local pg = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
  if pg then
    registerConnection(pg.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
      if child.Name == "SkillCheckPromptGui" or child.Name == "SkillCheckPromptGui-con" then
        if _G.VD_DBD and _G.VD_DBD.apply then
          pcall(_G.VD_DBD.apply, child)
        end
        if
          _G.VD_DBD
          and _G.VD_DBD.playEffect
          and Settings.DBDSounds
          and Settings.DBDSounds.Enabled
          and isPremiumActive()
        then
          _G.VD_DBD.playEffect("Warning")
        end
        task.wait(0.05)
        trySetupGUI()
      end
    end))
    registerConnection(pg.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
      if child.Name == "SkillCheckPromptGui" or child.Name == "SkillCheckPromptGui-con" then
        checkFrame, lineObject, goalObject = nil, nil, nil
        promptGuiCached = nil
        releaseSpace()
      end
    end))
  end
  trySetupGUI()
  registerConnection(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not Settings.AutoSkillCheck then
      guiAppearedTime = nil
      lastRotation = nil
      isMoving = false
      hasInstantTriggered = false
      lastGoalRotation = nil
      lastHitTime = 0
      hasHitCurrent = false
      releaseSpace()
      return
    end
    if not isSkillCheckActive() then
      checkFrame, lineObject, goalObject = nil, nil, nil
      guiAppearedTime = nil
      lastRotation = nil
      isMoving = false
      hasInstantTriggered = false
      lastGoalRotation = nil
      lastHitTime = 0
      hasHitCurrent = false
      releaseSpace()
      return
    end
    if isKingsScourgeRemoteActive then
      _G.VD_IsKingsScourgeActive = true
      if isSkillCheckActive() then
        kingsScourgeSeenVisible = true
        kingsScourgeLastSeen = tick()
      end
      local now = tick()
      if
        (kingsScourgeStartTime and (now - kingsScourgeStartTime > 28))
        or (kingsScourgeSeenVisible and kingsScourgeLastSeen and (now - kingsScourgeLastSeen > 4.0))
      then
        isKingsScourgeRemoteActive = false
        _G.VD_IsKingsScourgeActive = false
        kingsScourgeSeenVisible = false
        kingsScourgeLastSeen = nil
      end
    else
      if not isKingsScourgeActiveOnCurrentGen() then
        _G.VD_IsKingsScourgeActive = false
      end
    end
    local resolvedGoal = nil
    local resolvedIsTrap = false
    if checkFrame then
      local trapPerf = checkFrame:FindFirstChild("TrapPerfect")
      local trapGoal = checkFrame:FindFirstChild("TrapGoal")
      if trapPerf and trapPerf.Visible then
        resolvedGoal = trapPerf
        resolvedIsTrap = true
      elseif trapGoal and trapGoal.Visible then
        resolvedGoal = trapGoal
        resolvedIsTrap = true
      else
        local stdGoal = checkFrame:FindFirstChild("Goal")
        if stdGoal and stdGoal.Visible then
          resolvedGoal = stdGoal
          resolvedIsTrap = false
        else
          resolvedGoal = trapPerf or trapGoal or stdGoal
          resolvedIsTrap = (resolvedGoal == trapPerf or resolvedGoal == trapGoal)
        end
      end
    end
    if resolvedGoal and (resolvedGoal ~= goalObject or isTrapCheck ~= resolvedIsTrap) then
      goalObject = resolvedGoal
      isTrapCheck = resolvedIsTrap
      lastGoalRotation = nil
    end
    if not checkFrame or not lineObject or not goalObject then
      trySetupGUI()
      return
    end
    local currentGoalRotation = goalObject.Rotation
    local currentLineRotation = lineObject.Rotation
    local isNewCheck = false
    if lastGoalRotation == nil or math.abs(lastGoalRotation - currentGoalRotation) > 0.5 then
      isNewCheck = true
    end
    if
      lastRotation
      and (
        currentLineRotation < lastRotation - 35 or (lastRotation > 120 and currentLineRotation < 45)
      )
    then
      isNewCheck = true
    end
    if hasHitCurrent and (tick() - lastHitTime > 0.06) then
      local rawDiff = currentLineRotation - currentGoalRotation
      local circDiff = rawDiff % 360
      if circDiff < 0 then
        circDiff = circDiff + 360
      end
      if circDiff < 90 or circDiff > 175 then
        hasHitCurrent = false
        hasInstantTriggered = false
      end
    end
    if isNewCheck then
      lastGoalRotation = currentGoalRotation
      currentCheckId = currentCheckId + 1
      hasInstantTriggered = false
      hasHitCurrent = false
      guiAppearedTime = tick()
      lastRotation = nil
      isMoving = false
      selectGoalOffsets()
    end
    local isSpecialCheck = isTrapCheck or isKingsScourgeActiveOnCurrentGen()
    if isInstantSkillCheckAllowed() then
      if not hasInstantTriggered and not hasHitCurrent then
        hasInstantTriggered = true
        hasHitCurrent = true
        lastHitTime = tick()
        local thisCheckId = currentCheckId
        task.spawn(function()
          if not isSpecialCheck then
            task.wait(0.05)
          else
            task.wait(0.01)
          end
          if
            isSkillCheckActive()
            and checkFrame
            and lineObject
            and goalObject
            and thisCheckId == currentCheckId
          then
            local offset = (currentGoalStart + currentGoalEnd) / 2
            local targetRotation = goalObject.Rotation + offset
            lineObject.Rotation = targetRotation
            pressSpace()
            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
          end
        end)
      end
      return
    end
    if not guiAppearedTime then
      guiAppearedTime = tick()
      hasHitCurrent = false
      selectGoalOffsets()
    end
    if tick() - guiAppearedTime < 0.06 then
      return
    end
    local rawDiff = currentLineRotation - currentGoalRotation
    local diff = rawDiff % 360
    if diff < 0 then
      diff = diff + 360
    end
    local s = currentGoalStart or 104
    local e = currentGoalEnd or 114
    local inZone = (diff >= s and diff <= e)
    local shouldTrigger = inZone
    if lastRotation then
      local prevRawDiff = lastRotation - currentGoalRotation
      local prevDiff = prevRawDiff % 360
      if prevDiff < 0 then
        prevDiff = prevDiff + 360
      end
      local rDiff = currentLineRotation - lastRotation
      if math.abs(rDiff) > 0.05 and math.abs(rDiff) < 100 then
        isMoving = true
        if prevDiff < s and diff >= s and diff <= (s + 20) then
          shouldTrigger = true
        end
      end
    end
    lastRotation = currentLineRotation
    if not isMoving and not isSpecialCheck then
      return
    end
    if shouldTrigger and not hasHitCurrent then
      hasHitCurrent = true
      lastHitTime = tick()
      if
        isSpecialCheck
        or isKingsScourgeActiveOnCurrentGen()
        or isKingsScourgeRemoteActive
        or _G.VD_IsKingsScourgeActive
      then
        if lineObject and goalObject then
          lineObject.Rotation = goalObject.Rotation + 109
        end
      end
      pressSpace()
    end
  end))
  task.spawn(function()
    while activeLoop do
      task.wait(0.25)
      pcall(function()
        local char = localPlayer.Character
        if not char then
          return
        end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local ci = char:FindFirstChild("CheckInterractable")
        if not hrp or not hum then
          return
        end
        local isRepairingAttr = ci and ci:GetAttribute("isRepairing") == true
        local isHealingAttr = ci and ci:GetAttribute("isHealing") == true
        local isExitingAttr = ci and ci:GetAttribute("isExiting") == true
        local isUnhookingAttr = ci and ci:GetAttribute("isUnhooking") == true
        local isTrapped = char:GetAttribute("Trapped") == true
        local isKnocked = char:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
        local isHooked = (char:GetAttribute("HookCount") or 0) >= 3
          or char:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
        local isCarried = char:GetAttribute("IsCarried") == true
        local isDoingLegitAction = isRepairingAttr
          or isHealingAttr
          or isExitingAttr
          or isUnhookingAttr
          or isTrapped
          or isKnocked
          or isHooked
          or isCarried
        if not isDoingLegitAction and (hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05) then
          local wasStuck = false
          if hrp.Anchored then
            hrp.Anchored = false
            wasStuck = true
          end
          if not hum.AutoRotate then
            hum.AutoRotate = true
            wasStuck = true
          end
          local cs = game:GetService("CollectionService")
          if cs:HasTag(hrp, "doing action") then
            pcall(function()
              cs:RemoveTag(hrp, "doing action")
            end)
            wasStuck = true
          end
          if wasStuck or (ci and ci:GetAttribute("RepairRequestId")) then
            local closestGen = getClosestGenerator()
            if closestGen then
              local repPoint = nil
              for _, child in ipairs(closestGen:GetChildren()) do
                if child.Name:lower():find("point") then
                  repPoint = child
                  break
                end
              end
              if repPoint then
                local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
                local remotes = rs:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                local genFolder = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Generator")
                local repEv = (genFolder and genFolder:FindFirstChild("RepairEvent"))
                  or rs:FindFirstChild("RepairEvent", true)
                if repEv then
                  local reqId = (ci and ci:GetAttribute("RepairRequestId")) or "RECOVERY_FIX"
                  pcall(function()
                    repEv:FireServer(repPoint, false, nil, reqId, char)
                  end)
                  if ci then
                    pcall(function()
                      ci:SetAttribute("RepairRequestId", nil)
                    end)
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end)
    end
  end)
end)()
_G.VD_KillerFovFolder = nil
_G.VD_ActiveFovVisuals = {}
cleanupKillerGroundFOV = function()
  if _G.VD_KillerFovFolder then
    pcall(function()
      _G.VD_KillerFovFolder:Destroy()
    end)
    _G.VD_KillerFovFolder = nil
  end
  _G.VD_ActiveFovVisuals = {}
end
_G.VD_FovGroundRayParams = RaycastParams.new()
_G.VD_FovGroundRayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
_G.VD_FovGroundRayParams.IgnoreWater = true
local function getGroundRaycastPoint(groundOrigin, dir, groundY, filterList, throughWalls)
  _G.VD_FovGroundRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterList or {}
  local castOrigin = Vector3.new(groundOrigin.X, groundY + 0.5, groundOrigin.Z)
  local targetPos
  if throughWalls then
    targetPos = castOrigin + dir
  else
    local fwdResult = workspace:Raycast(castOrigin, dir, _G.VD_FovGroundRayParams)
    targetPos = fwdResult and fwdResult.Position or (castOrigin + dir)
  end
  local downRay = workspace:Raycast(
    Vector3.new(targetPos.X, groundY + 3, targetPos.Z),
    Vector3.new(0, -10, 0),
    _G.VD_FovGroundRayParams
  )
  if downRay then
    return Vector3.new(targetPos.X, downRay.Position.Y + 0.08, targetPos.Z)
  end
  return Vector3.new(targetPos.X, groundY + 0.08, targetPos.Z)
end
local function createBeamSegment(parent, color, width, transparency)
  local p0 = Instance.new("Part")
  p0.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
  p0.Transparency = 1
  p0.Anchored = true
  p0.CanCollide = false
  p0.CanQuery = false
  p0.CanTouch = false
  p0.Parent = parent
  local p1 = Instance.new("Part")
  p1.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
  p1.Transparency = 1
  p1.Anchored = true
  p1.CanCollide = false
  p1.CanQuery = false
  p1.CanTouch = false
  p1.Parent = parent
  local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment", p0)
  local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment", p1)
  local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
  beam.Attachment0 = a0
  beam.Attachment1 = a1
  beam.Width0 = width or 0.18
  beam.Width1 = width or 0.18
  beam.FaceCamera = true
  beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60))
  beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(transparency or 0.25)
  beam.Segments = 1
  beam.Parent = p0
  return {
    p0 = p0,
    p1 = p1,
    beam = beam,
    update = function(pos0, pos1, bColor, bWidth, bTransparency)
      p0.Position = pos0
      p1.Position = pos1
      if bColor then
        beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(bColor)
      end
      if bWidth then
        beam.Width0 = bWidth
        beam.Width1 = bWidth
      end
      if bTransparency then
        beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(bTransparency)
      end
    end,
    destroy = function()
      pcall(function()
        p0:Destroy()
      end)
      pcall(function()
        p1:Destroy()
      end)
    end,
  }
end
function updateKillerGroundFOV()
  if isInLobby and isInLobby() then
    if _G.VD_KillerFovFolder then
      cleanupKillerGroundFOV()
    end
    return
  end
  local enabled = Settings.MasterESP
    and Settings.KillerESP
    and Settings.KillerESP.Enabled
    and Settings.KillerESP.GroundFOV
  if not enabled then
    if _G.VD_KillerFovFolder then
      cleanupKillerGroundFOV()
    end
    return
  end
  local killers = {}
  if getActiveKillerCharacters then
    killers = getActiveKillerCharacters()
  end
  if #killers == 0 then
    if _G.VD_KillerFovFolder then
      cleanupKillerGroundFOV()
    end
    return
  end
  if not _G.VD_KillerFovFolder or not _G.VD_KillerFovFolder.Parent then
    _G.VD_KillerFovFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    _G.VD_KillerFovFolder.Name = "VD_KillerGroundFOV"
    _G.VD_KillerFovFolder.Parent = workspace
  end
  local fovColor = Settings.KillerESP.GroundFOVColor
    or (Settings.ESPColors and Settings.ESPColors["Killer"])
    or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
  local fovStyle = Settings.KillerESP.GroundFOVStyle or "Outline Cone"
  local maxDist = Settings.KillerESP.GroundFOVDistance or 12
  local fovTransparency = Settings.KillerESP.GroundFOVTransparency or 0.25
  local fovWidth = Settings.KillerESP.GroundFOVWidth or 0.18
  local halfFovRad = math.rad(35)
  local arcSegmentsCount = 14
  local currentKillersMap = {}
  for _, kChar in ipairs(killers) do
    if not kChar or not kChar.Parent then
      continue
    end
    local kRoot = kChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not kRoot then
      continue
    end
    currentKillersMap[kChar] = true
    local visualData = _G.VD_ActiveFovVisuals[kChar]
    if not visualData or not visualData.beams then
      if visualData and visualData.leftLine then
        pcall(function()
          visualData.leftLine.destroy()
        end)
        pcall(function()
          visualData.rightLine.destroy()
        end)
        if visualData.arcLines then
          for _, b in ipairs(visualData.arcLines) do
            pcall(function()
              b.destroy()
            end)
          end
        end
      end
      visualData = { beams = {} }
      _G.VD_ActiveFovVisuals[kChar] = visualData
    end
    local rootLook = kRoot.CFrame.LookVector
    local horizontalLook = Vector3.new(rootLook.X, 0, rootLook.Z)
    if horizontalLook.Magnitude < 0.001 then
      horizontalLook = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
    else
      horizontalLook = horizontalLook.Unit
    end
    local centerAngle = math.atan2(horizontalLook.Z, horizontalLook.X)
    local filterList = { kChar }
    if localPlayer.Character then
      table.insert(filterList, localPlayer.Character)
    end
    _G.VD_FovGroundRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterList
    local originDownRay =
      workspace:Raycast(kRoot.Position, Vector3.new(0, -15, 0), _G.VD_FovGroundRayParams)
    local groundY = originDownRay and originDownRay.Position.Y or (kRoot.Position.Y - 2.8)
    local groundOrigin = Vector3.new(kRoot.Position.X, groundY + 0.08, kRoot.Position.Z)
    local linePairs = {}
    local function addDashedLine(pA, pB, steps, col, w, tr)
      steps = steps or 6
      for s = 0, steps - 1 do
        if s % 2 == 0 then
          local startPos = pA:Lerp(pB, s / steps)
          local endPos = pA:Lerp(pB, (s + 1) / steps)
          table.insert(linePairs, { startPos, endPos, col, w, tr })
        end
      end
    end
    local throughWalls = Settings.KillerESP and Settings.KillerESP.GroundFOVThroughWalls == true
    local arcPoints = {}
    for i = 0, arcSegmentsCount do
      local t = i / arcSegmentsCount
      local angle = centerAngle - halfFovRad + (t * halfFovRad * 2)
      local dirVector = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * maxDist
      local hitGroundPos =
        getGroundRaycastPoint(groundOrigin, dirVector, groundY, filterList, throughWalls)
      table.insert(arcPoints, hitGroundPos)
    end
    if fovStyle == "Dotted Arc" or fovStyle == "Dotted Cone" then
      addDashedLine(groundOrigin, arcPoints[1], 8, fovColor, fovWidth, fovTransparency)
      addDashedLine(groundOrigin, arcPoints[#arcPoints], 8, fovColor, fovWidth, fovTransparency)
      for i = 1, arcSegmentsCount do
        if i % 2 == 1 then
          table.insert(
            linePairs,
            { arcPoints[i], arcPoints[i + 1], fovColor, fovWidth, fovTransparency }
          )
        end
      end
    else
      table.insert(linePairs, { groundOrigin, arcPoints[1], fovColor, fovWidth, fovTransparency })
      table.insert(
        linePairs,
        { groundOrigin, arcPoints[#arcPoints], fovColor, fovWidth, fovTransparency }
      )
      for i = 1, arcSegmentsCount do
        table.insert(
          linePairs,
          { arcPoints[i], arcPoints[i + 1], fovColor, fovWidth, fovTransparency }
        )
      end
    end
    for i, pair in ipairs(linePairs) do
      local beamData = visualData.beams[i]
      if not beamData then
        beamData = createBeamSegment(_G.VD_KillerFovFolder, pair[3], pair[4], pair[5])
        visualData.beams[i] = beamData
      end
      beamData.update(pair[1], pair[2], pair[3], pair[4], pair[5])
    end
    while #visualData.beams > #linePairs do
      local lastBeam = table.remove(visualData.beams)
      if lastBeam then
        lastBeam.destroy()
      end
    end
  end
  for kChar, visualData in pairs(_G.VD_ActiveFovVisuals) do
    if not currentKillersMap[kChar] then
      if visualData.beams then
        for _, b in ipairs(visualData.beams) do
          b.destroy()
        end
      end
      if visualData.leftLine then
        visualData.leftLine.destroy()
      end
      if visualData.rightLine then
        visualData.rightLine.destroy()
      end
      if visualData.arcLines then
        for _, b in ipairs(visualData.arcLines) do
          b.destroy()
        end
      end
      _G.VD_ActiveFovVisuals[kChar] = nil
    end
  end
end
function updateParryESP()
  if isInLobby and isInLobby() then
    if _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment then
      pcall(function()
        _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment:Destroy()
      end)
      _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment = nil
    end
    return
  end
  local enabled = Settings.AutoParry and Settings.ParryRangeESP and Settings.MasterESP
  local char = localPlayer.Character
  local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not enabled or not root then
    if _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment then
      pcall(function()
        _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment:Destroy()
      end)
      _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment = nil
    end
    return
  end
  if not _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment or _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Parent == nil then
    _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
    _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Name = "VD_ParryRangeESP"
    _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Height = 0.05
    _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Transparency = 0.6
    _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.AlwaysOnTop = true
    _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.ZIndex = 10
    _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -3.1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
  end
  if _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Adornee ~= root then
    _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Adornee = root
  end
  if _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Parent ~= root then
    _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Parent = root
  end
  local targetRadius = Settings.ParryRange or 12
  if _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Radius ~= targetRadius then
    _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Radius = targetRadius
    _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.InnerRadius = targetRadius - 0.2
  end
  local killerInRange = false
  if getActiveKillerCharacters then
    local rangeLimit = Settings.ParryRange or 16
    local killers = getActiveKillerCharacters()
    for _, killerChar in ipairs(killers) do
      if killerChar and killerChar.Parent then
        local killerRoot = killerChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if killerRoot then
          local dist = (killerRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
          if dist <= rangeLimit then
            killerInRange = true
            break
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  if Settings.ParryRangeViewInRange and not killerInRange then
    _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Visible = false
  else
    _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Visible = true
    _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Transparency = 0.6
    _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
  end
end
task.spawn(function()
  local parryRemote = nil
  local lastParryTime = 0
  local cachedKillerCharacters = {}
  local lastKillerCharactersUpdate = 0
  local hasShownConnectedNotif = false
  local currentCooldownEnd = 0
  local StrictCooldown = true
  local RateLimit = 0.05
  local AutoEquip = true
  local Notify = false
  local SmartMeleeFilter = true
  local Method_Hitbox = true
  local Method_Animation = true
  local Method_Remote = false
  local Method_Predictive = false
  registerConnection(localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    currentCooldownEnd = 0
    _G.VD_IsParrying = false
    isPermanentCooldown = false
    _activeParryClient = nil
    _G.VD_ActiveParryClient = nil
  end))
  local function setupCooldownListeners()
    local function processAttributeChange(attr, val)
      if attr == "ParryCooldown" or attr == "ParryCD" or attr == "ParryMissed" then
        if type(val) == "number" then
          currentCooldownEnd = tick() + val
        elseif attr:lower():find("miss") and (val == true or val == 60) then
          currentCooldownEnd = lastParryTime + 60
        end
      end
    end
    local playerConn = localPlayer.AttributeChanged:Connect(processAttributeChange)
    registerConnection(playerConn)
    local lastCharAttrConn = nil
    local lastCharChildConn = nil
    local function monitorCharacter(char)
      if not char then
        return
      end
      if lastCharAttrConn then
        pcall(function()
          lastCharAttrConn:Disconnect()
        end)
        lastCharAttrConn = nil
      end
      if lastCharChildConn then
        pcall(function()
          lastCharChildConn:Disconnect()
        end)
        lastCharChildConn = nil
      end
      local charConn = char.AttributeChanged:Connect(processAttributeChange)
      lastCharAttrConn = charConn
      registerConnection(charConn)
      local childConn = char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if
          (child.Name:lower():find("cooldown") or child.Name:lower():find("parry"))
          and not child:IsA("Tool")
          and not child:IsA("Model")
          and not child.Name:lower():find("dagger")
        then
          task.wait(0.01)
          local duration = nil
          if child:IsA("ValueBase") and type(child.Value) == "number" then
            duration = child.Value
          else
            local valAttr = child:GetAttribute("Value")
              or child:GetAttribute("Duration")
              or child:GetAttribute("Cooldown")
            if type(valAttr) == "number" then
              duration = valAttr
            end
          end
          if duration then
            currentCooldownEnd = lastParryTime + duration
          elseif child.Name:lower():find("miss") then
            currentCooldownEnd = lastParryTime + 60
          end
        end
      end)
      lastCharChildConn = childConn
      registerConnection(childConn)
    end
    if localPlayer.Character then
      task.spawn(monitorCharacter, localPlayer.Character)
    end
    local charAdded = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(monitorCharacter)
    registerConnection(charAdded)
  end
  local function cleanAnimId(id)
    return string.match(tostring(id), "%d+") or ""
  end
  local getParryTool, hasDagger, equipDagger, isDaggerEquipped, isObstructed, isFacingTarget, executeParry
  function getParryTool()
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    local searchContainers = {}
    if char then
      table.insert(searchContainers, char)
    end
    if backpack then
      table.insert(searchContainers, backpack)
    end
    for _, container in ipairs(searchContainers) do
      local exact = container:FindFirstChild("Parrying Dagger")
        or container:FindFirstChild("Parry Dagger")
      if exact then
        return exact
      end
      for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
        local nameLower = child.Name:lower()
        if string.find(nameLower, "parry") or string.find(nameLower, "dagger") then
          return child
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  function hasDagger()
    local equipped = localPlayer:GetAttribute("EquippedItem")
    if tostring(equipped) == "Parrying Dagger" or tostring(equipped) == "Parry Dagger" then
      return true
    end
    if getParryTool() ~= nil then
      return true
    end
    return false
  end
  function isDaggerEquipped()
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    if char then
      local exact = char:FindFirstChild("Parrying Dagger") or char:FindFirstChild("Parry Dagger")
      if exact then
        return true
      end
      for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        local nameLower = child.Name:lower()
        if string.find(nameLower, "parry") or string.find(nameLower, "dagger") then
          return true
        end
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  function equipDagger()
    local tool = getParryTool()
    if tool and tool.Parent ~= localPlayer.Character then
      local hum = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      pcall(function()
        tool.Parent = localPlayer.Character
        if hum then
          task.spawn(function()
            hum:EquipTool(tool)
          end)
        end
      end)
      task.wait(0.01)
    end
  end
  local function scanForParryRemote()
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
      local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
      local remotes = rs:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
      local items = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Items")
      local dagger = items
        and (items:FindFirstChild("Parrying Dagger") or items:FindFirstChild("Parry Dagger"))
      if dagger then
        return dagger:FindFirstChild("parry") or dagger:FindFirstChild("Parry")
      end
    end)
    if ok and result then
      return result
    end
    local tool = getParryTool()
    if tool then
      for _, desc in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
        if desc.Name == "parry" or desc.Name == "Parry" then
          return desc
        end
      end
      for _, desc in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
        if desc:IsA("RemoteEvent") or desc:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
          return desc
        end
      end
    end
    local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    for _, desc in ipairs(rs:GetDescendants()) do
      if desc.Name == "parry" and (desc:IsA("RemoteEvent") or desc:IsA("RemoteFunction")) then
        return desc
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local parryResultConnection = nil
  local isPermanentCooldown = false
  local _activeParryClient = nil
  local lastParryClientSearch = 0
  local function getActiveParryClient()
    if _activeParryClient and _activeParryClient.tool and _activeParryClient.tool.Parent then
      return _activeParryClient
    end
    if
      _G.VD_ActiveParryClient
      and _G.VD_ActiveParryClient.tool
      and _G.VD_ActiveParryClient.tool.Parent
    then
      _activeParryClient = _G.VD_ActiveParryClient
      return _activeParryClient
    end
    if not hasDagger() then
      return nil
    end
    local now = os.clock()
    if (now - lastParryClientSearch) < 3.0 then
      return nil
    end
    lastParryClientSearch = now
    local ok, pcModule = pcall(function()
      local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
      local mod = rs:FindFirstChild("Modules")
      local itm = mod and mod:FindFirstChild("Items")
      local pd = itm and itm:FindFirstChild("ParryingDagger")
      return pd and pd:FindFirstChild("ParryClient") and require(pd.ParryClient)
    end)
    if ok and type(pcModule) == "table" then
      if not pcModule._VD_Hooked then
        pcModule._VD_Hooked = true
        local origNew = pcModule.new
        if type(origNew) == "function" then
          pcModule.new = function(...)
            local inst = origNew(...)
            _G.VD_ActiveParryClient = inst
            _activeParryClient = inst
            return inst
          end
        end
      end
      if typeof(getgc) == "function" then
        local gcList = getgc(true)
        if gcList then
          for _, obj in ipairs(gcList) do
            if type(obj) == "table" then
              local mt = getmetatable(obj)
              if
                mt == pcModule
                or (
                  type(obj.Parry) == "function"
                  and (
                    rawget(obj, "parryEvent")
                    or rawget(obj, "daggerFolder")
                    or rawget(obj, "tool")
                  )
                )
              then
                _G.VD_ActiveParryClient = obj
                _activeParryClient = obj
                table.clear(gcList)
                return obj
              end
            end
          end
          table.clear(gcList)
        end
      end
    end
    return _G.VD_ActiveParryClient
  end
  local function connectParryResult()
    if parryResultConnection then
      return
    end
    local tool = getParryTool()
    local parryResultEvent = nil
    if tool then
      parryResultEvent = tool:FindFirstChild("parryResult") or tool:FindFirstChild("ParryResult")
    end
    if not parryResultEvent then
      local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
      local remotes = rs:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
      if remotes then
        local items = remotes:FindFirstChild("Items")
        if items then
          local dagger = items:FindFirstChild("Parrying Dagger")
            or items:FindFirstChild("Parry Dagger")
          if dagger then
            parryResultEvent = dagger:FindFirstChild("parryResult")
              or dagger:FindFirstChild("ParryResult")
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if not parryResultEvent then
      local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
      parryResultEvent = rs:FindFirstChild("parryResult", true)
        or rs:FindFirstChild("ParryResult", true)
    end
    if parryResultEvent and parryResultEvent:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
      parryResultConnection = parryResultEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(
        function(success, cooldown, permanent, reset, char)
          if char and localPlayer.Character and char ~= localPlayer.Character then
            return
          end
          if reset == true then
            isPermanentCooldown = false
            currentCooldownEnd = 0
            return
          end
          if permanent == true then
            isPermanentCooldown = true
            currentCooldownEnd = math.huge
            return
          end
          isPermanentCooldown = false
          local cdVal = tonumber(cooldown)
          if cdVal and cdVal > 0 then
            currentCooldownEnd = tick() + cdVal
          else
            currentCooldownEnd = 0
          end
        end
      )
      registerConnection(parryResultConnection)
    end
  end
  local function getParryRemote()
    if parryRemote and parryRemote.Parent and parryRemote:IsDescendantOf(game) then
      return parryRemote
    end
    local found = scanForParryRemote()
    if found then
      parryRemote = found
      pcall(connectParryResult)
      if not hasShownConnectedNotif then
        hasShownConnectedNotif = true
      end
      return parryRemote
    end
    return nil
  end
  task.defer(getParryRemote)
  getActiveKillers = function()
    local killers = {}
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if player == localPlayer then
        continue
      end
      local isKiller = false
      if player:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or player:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true then
        isKiller = true
      elseif
        player.Character
        and (
          player.Character:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer"
          or player.Character:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true
        )
      then
        isKiller = true
      end
      if not isKiller then
        local team = player.Team
        if team then
          local tName = team.Name:lower()
          if
            tName:find("killer")
            or tName:find("slasher")
            or tName:find("hunter")
            or tName:find("monster")
          then
            isKiller = true
          elseif
            not tName:find("survivor")
            and not tName:find("lobby")
            and not tName:find("spectat")
          then
            isKiller = true
          end
        else
          local plName = player.Name:lower()
          if plName:find("killer") or plName:find("slasher") or plName:find("hunter") then
            isKiller = true
          end
        end
      end
      if isKiller and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        table.insert(killers, player)
      end
    end
    return killers
  end
  getActiveKillerCharacters = function()
    local chars = {}
    local humanKillers = getActiveKillers()
    for _, player in ipairs(humanKillers) do
      if player.Character then
        table.insert(chars, player.Character)
      end
    end
    local killersFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Killers")
    if killersFolder then
      for _, child in ipairs(killersFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if
          child:IsA("Model")
          and child:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
          and child:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        then
          if not table.find(chars, child) then
            table.insert(chars, child)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if cachedSCPs then
      for _, scpModel in ipairs(cachedSCPs) do
        if scpModel and scpModel.Parent then
          if not table.find(chars, scpModel) then
            table.insert(chars, scpModel)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
      if descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant ~= localPlayer.Character then
        local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby") or workspace:FindFirstChild("lobby")
        if lobby and descendant:IsDescendantOf(lobby) then
          continue
        end
        local nameLower = descendant.Name:lower()
        if
          nameLower:find("display")
          or nameLower:find("statue")
          or nameLower:find("showcase")
          or nameLower:find("dummy")
          or nameLower:find("shop")
          or nameLower:find("pedestal")
        then
          continue
        end
        if
          string.find(nameLower, "zombie")
          or string.find(nameLower, "slasher")
          or string.find(nameLower, "monster")
          or string.find(nameLower, "killer")
          or string.find(nameLower, "veil")
          or string.find(nameLower, "stalker")
          or string.find(nameLower, "masked")
          or string.find(nameLower, "abysswalker")
        then
          local hum = descendant:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
          local hrp = descendant:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if hum and hum.Health > 0 and hrp and not hrp.Anchored then
            if not table.find(chars, descendant) then
              table.insert(chars, descendant)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return chars
  end
  local function isCharacterKiller(char)
    if not char then
      return false
    end
    local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
    if player then
      if player == localPlayer then
        return false
      end
      if player:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or player:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true then
        return true
      end
      if char:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or char:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true then
        return true
      end
      local team = player.Team
      if team then
        local tName = team.Name:lower()
        if
          tName:find("killer")
          or tName:find("slasher")
          or tName:find("hunter")
          or tName:find("monster")
        then
          return true
        elseif
          not tName:find("survivor")
          and not tName:find("lobby")
          and not tName:find("spectat")
        then
          return true
        end
      else
        local plName = player.Name:lower()
        if plName:find("killer") or plName:find("slasher") or plName:find("hunter") then
          return true
        end
      end
    else
      if cachedSCPs and table.find(cachedSCPs, char) then
        return true
      end
      if char:IsA("Model") and char ~= localPlayer.Character then
        local nameLower = char.Name:lower()
        if
          string.find(nameLower, "zombie")
          or string.find(nameLower, "slasher")
          or string.find(nameLower, "monster")
          or string.find(nameLower, "killer")
          or string.find(nameLower, "veil")
          or string.find(nameLower, "stalker")
          or string.find(nameLower, "masked")
          or string.find(nameLower, "abysswalker")
        then
          if char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            return true
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  isObstructed = function()
    return false
  end
  local function getVelocity(part)
    if not part then
      return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    end
    local success, vel = pcall(function()
      return part.AssemblyLinearVelocity or part.Velocity or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    end)
    return success and vel or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
  end
  isFacingTarget = function(killerRoot, targetRoot)
    local direction = (targetRoot.Position - killerRoot.Position).Unit
    local lookVector = killerRoot.CFrame.LookVector
    local dot = lookVector:Dot(direction)
    if dot > -0.1 then
      return true
    end
    local velocity = getVelocity(killerRoot)
    if velocity.Magnitude > 3 then
      local velocityDir = velocity.Unit
      local isMovingTowards = velocityDir:Dot(direction) > 0.3
      if isMovingTowards then
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local function isKillerBusyOrNonAttacking(kChar)
    if not kChar or not kChar.Parent then
      return false
    end
    if kChar:GetAttribute("Immobile") == true then
      return true
    end
    if kChar:GetAttribute("IsCarrying") == true then
      return true
    end
    if kChar:GetAttribute("IsStunned") == true then
      return true
    end
    if kChar:GetAttribute("isVaulting") == true then
      return true
    end
    if
      kChar:GetAttribute("isBreakingPallet") == true
      or kChar:GetAttribute("isBreakingGen") == true
    then
      return true
    end
    local kPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(kChar)
    if kPlayer then
