      if kPlayer:GetAttribute("IsCarrying") == true then
        return true
      end
      if kPlayer:GetAttribute("isVaulting") == true then
        return true
      end
      if
        kPlayer:GetAttribute("isBreakingPallet") == true
        or kPlayer:GetAttribute("isBreakingGen") == true
      then
        return true
      end
      if kPlayer:GetAttribute("IsStunned") == true or kPlayer:GetAttribute("Immobile") == true then
        return true
      end
    end
    for _, child in ipairs(kChar:GetChildren()) do
      if
        child:IsA("Model")
        and (child:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") or child:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
      then
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local function isNonAttackAnimation(animName, trackName, animId)
    if animId ~= "" and BLACKLISTED_ANIMATION_IDS[animId] then
      return true
    end
    local fullName = (animName .. " " .. trackName):lower()
    if fullName:find("vault") or fullName:find("window") then
      return true
    end
    if
      fullName:find("break")
      or fullName:find("pallet")
      or fullName:find("destroy")
      or fullName:find("kick")
    then
      return true
    end
    if
      fullName:find("gen")
      or fullName:find("generator")
      or fullName:find("repair")
      or fullName:find("lever")
    then
      return true
    end
    if
      fullName:find("carry")
      or fullName:find("pickup")
      or fullName:find("drop")
      or fullName:find("hook")
      or fullName:find("unhook")
    then
      return true
    end
    if
      fullName:find("stun")
      or fullName:find("wallhit")
      or fullName:find("parried")
      or fullName:find("wipe")
    then
      return true
    end
    if
      fullName:find("trap")
      or fullName:find("flask")
      or fullName:find("spear")
      or fullName:find("pull")
      or fullName:find("chain")
    then
      return true
    end
    if
      fullName:find("idle")
      or fullName:find("walk")
      or fullName:find("run")
      or fullName:find("locomotion")
      or fullName:find("crouch")
      or fullName:find("crawl")
    then
      return true
    end
    if
      fullName:find("taunt")
      or fullName:find("emote")
      or fullName:find("inspect")
      or fullName:find("dance")
    then
      return true
    end
    if fullName:find("slowdown") or fullName:find("heal") then
      return true
    end
    return false
  end
  local function isExplicitAttackAnimation(animName, trackName, animId)
    if animId ~= "" and ATTACK_ANIMATION_IDS[animId] and not BLACKLISTED_ANIMATION_IDS[animId] then
      return true
    end
    local fullName = (animName .. " " .. trackName):lower()
    if
      fullName:find("attack")
      or fullName:find("swing")
      or fullName:find("slash")
      or fullName:find("lunge")
      or fullName:find("m1")
    then
      return true
    end
    return false
  end
  local function isTrackBlacklistedByKillerAnims(track, killerChar)
    local animObj = track and track.Animation
    if not animObj then
      return false
    end
    local animId = cleanAnimId(animObj.AnimationId)
    if animId ~= "" and BLACKLISTED_ANIMATION_IDS[animId] then
      return true
    end
    local aName = (animObj.Name or ""):lower()
    local tName = (track.Name or ""):lower()
    if isNonAttackAnimation(aName, tName, animId) then
      return true
    end
    if killerChar and killerChar.Parent then
      local animsFolder = killerChar:FindFirstChild("Animations")
      if animsFolder and animsFolder:IsA("Folder") then
        if animObj:IsDescendantOf(animsFolder) then
          if
            isNonAttackAnimation(aName, tName, animId)
            or aName:find("idle")
            or aName:find("walk")
            or aName:find("run")
            or aName:find("locomotion")
          then
            return true
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local function findAnimationInExplorer(animId)
    return nil
  end
  local function getPing()
    local ping = 80
    pcall(function()
      local p = cachedOneWayPing and (cachedOneWayPing * 2) or 0.08
      if type(p) == "number" and p > 0 then
        ping = p * 1000
      end
    end)
    return ping
  end
  executeParry = function(reason, dist, killerChar)
    if not Settings.AutoParry then
      return
    end
    if _G.VD_IsDodgingStalker == true or (tick() - (_G.VD_LastDodgeTime or 0) < 1.5) then
      return
    end
    if not hasDagger() then
      return
    end
    if killerChar and isKillerBusyOrNonAttacking(killerChar) then
      return
    end
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    if not char then
      return
    end
    local isKnocked = char:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
      or localPlayer:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
      or (readModelValue and readModelValue(char, "Knocked") == true)
    local isHooked = char:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
      or localPlayer:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
      or (readModelValue and readModelValue(char, "IsHooked") == true)
    local isCarried = char:GetAttribute("IsCarried") == true
      or localPlayer:GetAttribute("IsCarried") == true
    local isDead = localPlayer:GetAttribute("IsDead") == true or char:GetAttribute("IsDead") == true
    if isKnocked or isHooked or isCarried or isDead then
      return
    end
    local cs = game:GetService("CollectionService")
    if cs and cs:HasTag(char, "Silenced") then
      return
    end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if false and hum and hum.Health < 0 then
      return
    end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if false and root and cs and cs:HasTag(root, "doing action") then
      return
    end
    local checkInter = char:FindFirstChild("CheckInterractable")
    if checkInter then
      for _, attr in ipairs({
        "isVaulting",
        "isSliding",
        "isDroppingPallet",
        "isRepairing",
        "isHealing",
        "isUnhooking",
        "isExiting",
      }) do
        if checkInter:GetAttribute(attr) then
          return
        end
      end
    end
    local ignoreFrenzy = false
    if Settings.FrenzyParry and isPremiumActive() then
      ignoreFrenzy = true
    end
    if ignoreFrenzy and killerChar then
      local isFrenzy = killerChar:GetAttribute("Frenzy") == true
      if not isFrenzy then
        local killerPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(killerChar)
        if killerPlayer and killerPlayer:GetAttribute("Frenzy") == true then
          isFrenzy = true
        end
      end
      if isFrenzy then
        return
      end
    end
    local now = tick()
    if isPermanentCooldown then
      return
    end
    if StrictCooldown and now < currentCooldownEnd then
      return
    end
    local pClient = getActiveParryClient()
    if pClient and (pClient.isParryOnCooldown or pClient.isParryResolving) then
      return
    end
    if now - lastParryTime <= RateLimit then
      return
    end
    lastParryTime = now
    if Notify then
      showNotification("Parry Detected", reason, "info")
    end
    task.spawn(function()
      if Settings.ParryDelay and Settings.ParryDelay > 0 then
        task.wait(Settings.ParryDelay)
      end
      local c = localPlayer.Character
      if not c then
        return
      end
      local h = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local r = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local tool = getParryTool()
      if tool and tool.Parent ~= c then
        equipDagger()
      end
      local client = getActiveParryClient()
      local parried = false
      if client then
        if client.character ~= c then
          pcall(function()
            client:_bindCharacter(c)
          end)
        end
        pcall(function()
          client.isParryResolving = false
          client.isParryOnCooldown = false
          client:Parry()
          parried = true
        end)
      end
      pcall(function()
        local parryEv = scanForParryRemote()
          or (
            game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            and game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes:FindFirstChild("Items")
            and game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Items:FindFirstChild("Parrying Dagger")
            and game
              :GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Items["Parrying Dagger"]
              :FindFirstChild("parry")
          )
        if parryEv then
          if parryEv:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            parryEv:FireServer(c)
          elseif parryEv:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
            parryEv:InvokeServer(c)
          end
        end
      end)
      pcall(function()
        local animator = h and (h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or h)
        if animator then
          local animId = (tool and tool:GetAttribute("useanim")) or "109133187196613"
          local cleanId = string.match(tostring(animId), "%d+") or "109133187196613"
          local animObj = Instance.new("Animation")
          animObj.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. cleanId
          local track = animator:LoadAnimation(animObj)
          track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
          track:Play(0.05, 1, 1)
        end
      end)
      pcall(function()
        if tool and tool:IsA("Tool") then
          tool:Activate()
        end
      end)
      if VirtualInputManager then
        pcall(function()
          VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL2, false, game)
          task.delay(0.04, function()
            pcall(function()
              VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL2, false, game)
            end)
          end)
        end)
      end
      if true then
        pcall(function()
          local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
          local survMob = playerGui
            and (playerGui:FindFirstChild("Survivor-mob") or playerGui:FindFirstChild("Survivor"))
          local controls = survMob and survMob:FindFirstChild("Controls")
          local guiMob = controls
            and (controls:FindFirstChild("Gui-mob") or controls:FindFirstChild("action"))
          if guiMob then
            if typeof(firesignal) == "function" then
              pcall(function()
                firesignal(guiMob.MouseButton1Down)
              end)
            end
            if typeof(getconnections) == "function" then
              for _, conn in ipairs(getconnections(guiMob.MouseButton1Down)) do
                pcall(function()
                  conn:Fire()
                end)
              end
            end
          end
        end)
        pcall(function()
          if tool and tool:IsA("Tool") then
            tool:Activate()
          end
        end)
        pcall(function()
          local animator = h and (h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or h)
          if false and animator then
            local animId = (tool and tool:GetAttribute("useanim")) or "109133187196613"
            local animObj = Instance.new("Animation")
            animObj.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. string.match(tostring(animId), "%d+")
            local track = animator:LoadAnimation(animObj)
            track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
            track:Play()
          end
        end)
      end
    end)
  end
  local function trackKillerAttack(killerChar, reason, animIdOrName, trackRef)
    if not Settings.AutoParry then
      return
    end
    if not hasDagger() then
      return
    end
    if killerChar and isKillerBusyOrNonAttacking(killerChar) then
      return
    end
    local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
      and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local killerRoot = killerChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot or not killerRoot then
      return
    end
    local baseRange = Settings.ParryRange or 8.5
    local targetRange = baseRange
    if Settings.ParryPingCompensation then
      local currentPing = getPing()
      targetRange = baseRange + (currentPing * 0.015)
    end
    local triggerRange = math.max(targetRange, 13)
    local initialDist = (killerRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
    if initialDist <= triggerRange then
      local passFacing = true
      if Settings.ParryFacingCheck then
        passFacing = isFacingTarget(killerRoot, myRoot)
      end
      if passFacing then
        executeParry(reason, initialDist, killerChar)
        return
      end
    end
    task.spawn(function()
      local startTime = tick()
      while activeLoop and (tick() - startTime < 0.25) do
        if isKillerBusyOrNonAttacking(killerChar) then
          break
        end
        local isTrackActive = true
        pcall(function()
          if trackRef and trackRef.Parent then
            if not trackRef.IsPlaying or (trackRef.TimePosition or 0) > 0.45 then
              isTrackActive = false
            end
          else
            isTrackActive = false
          end
        end)
        if not isTrackActive then
          break
        end
        local char = localPlayer.Character
        local mRoot = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local kRoot = killerChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not mRoot or not kRoot then
          break
        end
        local dist = (kRoot.Position - mRoot.Position).Magnitude
        if dist > 30 then
          break
        end
        local bRange = Settings.ParryRange or 8.5
        local tRange = bRange
        if Settings.ParryPingCompensation then
          local currentPing = getPing()
          tRange = bRange + (currentPing * 0.015)
        end
        local trigRange = math.max(tRange, 13)
        if dist <= trigRange then
          local passFacing = true
          if Settings.ParryFacingCheck then
            passFacing = isFacingTarget(kRoot, mRoot)
          end
          if passFacing then
            executeParry(reason, dist, killerChar)
            break
          end
        end
        task.wait(0.01)
      end
    end)
  end
  local watchedColliders = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
  local function watchCollider(collider)
    if watchedColliders[collider] then
      return
    end
    watchedColliders[collider] = true
    if not collider:IsA("BasePart") then
      watchedColliders[collider] = nil
      return
    end
    local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
      and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then
      watchedColliders[collider] = nil
      return
    end
    if not Settings.AutoParry or not Method_Hitbox or not hasDagger() then
      watchedColliders[collider] = nil
      return
    end
    if collider:IsDescendantOf(localPlayer.Character) then
      watchedColliders[collider] = nil
      return
    end
    if
      Settings.IgnoreAbysswalkerLunge
      and (
        collider.Name:sub(1, 17) == "SlashHitboxDebug"
        or collider.Name:lower():find("slashhitboxdebug")
      )
    then
      watchedColliders[collider] = nil
      return
    end
    local baseRange = Settings.ParryRange or 8.5
    local targetRange = baseRange
    if Settings.ParryPingCompensation then
      local currentPing = getPing()
      targetRange = baseRange + (currentPing * 0.015)
    end
    local triggerRange = math.max(targetRange, 13)
    local initialDist = (collider.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
    if initialDist <= triggerRange then
      local now = tick()
      if now - lastKillerCharactersUpdate >= 1.0 or #cachedKillerCharacters == 0 then
        lastKillerCharactersUpdate = now
        cachedKillerCharacters = getActiveKillerCharacters()
      end
      local killers = cachedKillerCharacters
      local killerChar = nil
      for _, kChar in ipairs(killers) do
        local kRoot = kChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if kRoot then
          local kDist = (collider.Position - kRoot.Position).Magnitude
          if kDist < 15 then
            killerChar = kChar
            break
          end
        end
      end
      if killerChar and not isKillerBusyOrNonAttacking(killerChar) then
        local passFacing = true
        if Settings.ParryFacingCheck then
          local killerRoot = killerChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if killerRoot then
            passFacing = isFacingTarget(killerRoot, myRoot)
          end
        end
        if passFacing then
          executeParry(
            "Rilevata Hitbox di Attacco (" .. collider.Name .. ")",
            initialDist,
            killerChar
          )
          watchedColliders[collider] = nil
          return
        end
      end
    end
    task.spawn(function()
      local startTime = tick()
      local now = tick()
      if now - lastKillerCharactersUpdate >= 1.0 or #cachedKillerCharacters == 0 then
        lastKillerCharactersUpdate = now
        cachedKillerCharacters = getActiveKillerCharacters()
      end
      local killers = cachedKillerCharacters
      while activeLoop and (tick() - startTime < 0.3) and collider and collider.Parent do
        local char = localPlayer.Character
        local mRoot = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not mRoot then
          break
        end
        local hitboxDist = (collider.Position - mRoot.Position).Magnitude
        if hitboxDist > 30 then
          break
        end
        local bRange = Settings.ParryRange or 8.5
        local tRange = bRange
        if Settings.ParryPingCompensation then
          local currentPing = getPing()
          tRange = bRange + (currentPing * 0.015)
        end
        local trigRange = math.max(tRange, 13)
        if hitboxDist <= trigRange then
          local killerChar = nil
          for _, kChar in ipairs(killers) do
            local kRoot = kChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if kRoot then
              local kDist = (collider.Position - kRoot.Position).Magnitude
              if kDist < 15 then
                killerChar = kChar
                break
              end
            end
          end
          if killerChar and not isKillerBusyOrNonAttacking(killerChar) then
            local passFacing = true
            if Settings.ParryFacingCheck then
              local killerRoot = killerChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
              if killerRoot then
                passFacing = isFacingTarget(killerRoot, mRoot)
              end
            end
            if passFacing then
              executeParry(
                "Rilevata Hitbox di Attacco (" .. collider.Name .. ")",
                hitboxDist,
                killerChar
              )
              break
            end
          end
        end
        task.wait(0.01)
      end
      watchedColliders[collider] = nil
    end)
  end
  local function isToolDescendant(inst)
    local current = inst.Parent
    while current and current ~= workspace do
      if current:IsA("Tool") then
        return true
      end
      current = current.Parent
    end
    return false
  end
  registerConnection(workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
    if not Settings.AutoParry or not Method_Hitbox then
      return
    end
    if not descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
      return
    end
    if
      Settings.IgnoreAbysswalkerLunge
      and (
        descendant.Name:sub(1, 17) == "SlashHitboxDebug"
        or descendant.Name:lower():find("slashhitboxdebug")
      )
    then
      return
    end
    local nameLower = descendant.Name:lower()
    local isHitbox = false
    if string.match(descendant.Name, "^WallHitboxCollider_%d+$") then
      isHitbox = true
    elseif
      string.find(nameLower, "slashhitbox")
      or string.find(nameLower, "attackhitbox")
      or string.find(nameLower, "swinghitbox")
      or string.find(nameLower, "m1hitbox")
    then
      if not isToolDescendant(descendant) then
        isHitbox = true
      end
    end
    if isHitbox then
      watchCollider(descendant)
    end
  end))
  local watchedAnimators = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
  local function watchAnimator(animator, killerChar)
    if watchedAnimators[animator] then
      return
    end
    watchedAnimators[animator] = true
    local function checkTrack(track)
      if not track then
        return
      end
      local animObj = track.Animation
      local animId = ""
      local animName = ""
      local trackName = ""
      pcall(function()
        if animObj then
          animId = cleanAnimId(animObj.AnimationId)
          animName = (animObj.Name or ""):lower()
        end
        trackName = (track.Name or ""):lower()
      end)
      local kName = killerChar and killerChar.Name or "Killer"
      local prio = track.Priority
      local prioName = prio and (prio.Name or tostring(prio)) or "Unknown"
      local isLooped = track.Looped or false
      local myChar = localPlayer.Character
      local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local kRoot = killerChar and killerChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local dist = (myRoot and kRoot) and (kRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude or 999
      pcall(function()
        if
          Settings.AutoDodgeVeilSpear and (Settings.AutoFarmSurvivor or Settings.AutoFarmAFKTotal)
        then
          if myRoot and kRoot then
            if dist <= 150 then
              local isThrowAnim = animName:find("throw")
                or animName:find("spear")
                or animName:find("launch")
                or animName:find("cast")
              if
                not isThrowAnim
                and (prio == Enum.AnimationPriority.Action or prio == Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2)
                and not isLooped
              then
                if dist > 18 then
                  local dir = (myRoot.Position - kRoot.Position).Unit
                  local dot = kRoot.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(dir)
                  if dot > 0.3 then
                    isThrowAnim = true
                  end
                end
              end
              if isThrowAnim then
                local isKnocked = myChar
                  and (
                    myChar:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
                    or localPlayer:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
                  )
                local isHooked = myChar
                  and (
                    myChar:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
                    or localPlayer:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
                  )
                if not isKnocked and not isHooked then
                  if _G.VD_PreemptiveDodge then
                    pcall(_G.VD_PreemptiveDodge)
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end)
      if not Settings.AutoParry or not Method_Animation or not hasDagger() then
        return
      end
      if animId == "" or BLACKLISTED_ANIMATION_IDS[animId] == true then
        return
      end
      if
        animId == "102746205979822"
        or animId == "84093948968516"
        or animId == "86266790353635"
      then
        return
      end
      if isKillerBusyOrNonAttacking(killerChar) then
        return
      end
      if isNonAttackAnimation(animName, trackName, animId) then
        return
      end
      if
        (animId == "80411309607666" or animId == "100014992013740")
        and Settings.IgnoreAbysswalkerLunge
        and isPremiumActive()
      then
        return
      end
      if
        isLooped
        and (
          prio == Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
          or prio == Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
          or prio == Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
        )
      then
        return
      end
      local timePos = 0
      pcall(function()
        timePos = track.TimePosition or 0
      end)
      if timePos > 0.35 then
        return
      end
      if isTrackBlacklistedByKillerAnims(track, killerChar) then
        return
      end
      local reason = "Killer Animation: "
        .. (
          animId ~= "" and animId
          or (animName ~= "" and animName or (trackName ~= "" and trackName or "Attack"))
        )
      trackKillerAttack(killerChar, reason, animId, track)
    end
    local playConn = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(checkTrack)
    registerConnection(playConn)
    pcall(function()
      for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
        task.spawn(checkTrack, track)
      end
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
      while animator and animator.Parent and animator:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and activeLoop do
        task.wait(1)
      end
      if playConn then
        playConn:Disconnect()
      end
      watchedAnimators[animator] = nil
    end)
  end
  local function hookKillerWeapon(tool, killerChar)
    if not tool:IsA("Tool") then
      return
    end
    if tool:GetAttribute("VD_Hooked") then
      return
    end
    tool:SetAttribute("VD_Hooked", true)
    local toolConns = {}
    local lastWeaponParry = 0
    local function processDescendant(desc)
      if desc:IsA("Trail") or desc:IsA("Beam") then
        local conn = desc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
          if desc.Enabled and Settings.AutoParry then
            local now = tick()
            if now - lastWeaponParry < 0.25 then
              return
            end
            if isKillerBusyOrNonAttacking(killerChar) then
              return
            end
            local myChar = localPlayer.Character
            local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local kRoot = killerChar and killerChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if myRoot and kRoot then
              local dist = (kRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
              if dist <= 14 then
                local passFacing = true
                if Settings.ParryFacingCheck then
                  passFacing = isFacingTarget(kRoot, myRoot)
                end
                if passFacing then
                  lastWeaponParry = now
                  executeParry("Attivazione Trail Arma (" .. tool.Name .. ")", dist, killerChar)
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end)
        table.insert(toolConns, conn)
        registerConnection(conn)
      elseif desc:IsA("BasePart") then
        local conn = desc.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
          if Settings.AutoParry then
            local now = tick()
            if now - lastWeaponParry < 0.25 then
              return
            end
            if isKillerBusyOrNonAttacking(killerChar) then
              return
            end
            local kHum = killerChar and killerChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local kAnim = kHum and kHum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
            local isAttackingNow = false
            if kAnim then
              for _, trk in ipairs(kAnim:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                local aObj = trk.Animation
                local aId = aObj and cleanAnimId(aObj.AnimationId) or ""
                local aNm = aObj and (aObj.Name or ""):lower() or ""
                local tNm = (trk.Name or ""):lower()
                if
                  (not isNonAttackAnimation(aNm, tNm, aId))
                  and not BLACKLISTED_ANIMATION_IDS[aId]
                  and not trk.Looped
                  and (
                    trk.Priority ~= Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
                    and trk.Priority ~= Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
                  )
                then
                  isAttackingNow = true
                  break
                end
              end
            end
            if not isAttackingNow then
              return
            end
            local myChar = localPlayer.Character
            if myChar and hit:IsDescendantOf(myChar) then
              local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
              local kRoot = killerChar and killerChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
              if myRoot and kRoot then
                local dist = (kRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                if dist <= 14 then
                  local passFacing = true
                  if Settings.ParryFacingCheck then
                    passFacing = isFacingTarget(kRoot, myRoot)
                  end
                  if passFacing then
                    lastWeaponParry = now
                    executeParry("Contatto Fisico Arma (" .. tool.Name .. ")", dist, killerChar)
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end)
        table.insert(toolConns, conn)
        registerConnection(conn)
      end
    end
    for _, desc in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
      task.spawn(processDescendant, desc)
    end
    local descConn = tool.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
      pcall(processDescendant, desc)
    end)
    table.insert(toolConns, descConn)
    registerConnection(descConn)
    task.spawn(function()
      while tool and tool.Parent and killerChar and killerChar.Parent and activeLoop do
        task.wait(2)
      end
      for _, c in ipairs(toolConns) do
        pcall(function()
          c:Disconnect()
        end)
      end
      table.clear(toolConns)
    end)
  end
  local function setupAnimatorListener(char)
    if not char then
      return
    end
    if not isCharacterKiller(char) then
      return
    end
    local function checkChild(child)
      if child:IsA("Humanoid") then
        local function checkAnimator(animChild)
          if animChild:IsA("Animator") then
            pcall(watchAnimator, animChild, char)
          end
        end
        child.ChildAdded:Connect(checkAnimator)
        local animator = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if animator then
          pcall(watchAnimator, animator, char)
        end
      elseif child:IsA("Tool") then
        pcall(hookKillerWeapon, child, char)
      end
    end
    char.ChildAdded:Connect(checkChild)
    for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
      pcall(checkChild, child)
    end
  end
  for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if player ~= localPlayer then
      if player.Character then
        task.spawn(setupAnimatorListener, player.Character)
      end
      registerConnection(player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        setupAnimatorListener(char)
      end))
    end
  end
  registerConnection(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    registerConnection(player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
      setupAnimatorListener(char)
    end))
  end))
  task.spawn(function()
    while activeLoop do
      if Settings.AutoParry and hasDagger() then
        pcall(function()
          local myChar = localPlayer.Character
          local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          local now = tick()
          if now - lastKillerCharactersUpdate >= 1.0 or #cachedKillerCharacters == 0 then
            lastKillerCharactersUpdate = now
            cachedKillerCharacters = getActiveKillerCharacters()
          end
          local targets = cachedKillerCharacters
          local closestDist = 9999
          for _, targetChar in ipairs(targets) do
            local targetRoot = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if targetRoot then
              if myRoot then
                local dist = (targetRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < closestDist then
                  closestDist = dist
                end
              end
            end
            local humanoid = targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
            if animator and isCharacterKiller(targetChar) then
              watchAnimator(animator, targetChar)
            end
          end
          if closestDist <= 45 and AutoEquip and not isDaggerEquipped() then
            equipDagger()
          end
        end)
        task.wait(0.05)
      else
        task.wait(0.5)
      end
    end
  end)
  task.spawn(function()
    local attacksFolder = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes", 5)
    attacksFolder = attacksFolder and attacksFolder:WaitForChild("Attacks", 5)
    if not attacksFolder then
      return
    end
    local function getKillerFromArgs(...)
      for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
        local val = select(i, ...)
        if typeof(val) == "Instance" then
          if val:IsA("Model") and val:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            return val
          elseif val:IsA("Player") and val.Character then
            return val.Character
          end
        end
      end
      local myChar = localPlayer.Character
      local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if myRoot then
        local closest = nil
        local minDist = 30
        local now = tick()
        if now - lastKillerCharactersUpdate >= 1.0 or #cachedKillerCharacters == 0 then
          lastKillerCharactersUpdate = now
          cachedKillerCharacters = getActiveKillerCharacters()
        end
        for _, killer in ipairs(cachedKillerCharacters) do
          local kRoot = killer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if kRoot then
            local dist = (kRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
            if dist < minDist then
              minDist = dist
              closest = killer
            end
          end
        end
        return closest
      end
      return nil
    end
    local function onRemoteAttackFired(remoteName, ...)
      if not Settings.AutoParry or not Method_Remote or not hasDagger() then
        return
      end
      local killerChar = getKillerFromArgs(...)
      if not killerChar then
        return
      end
      if isKillerBusyOrNonAttacking(killerChar) then
        return
      end
      trackKillerAttack(killerChar, "Remoto di Attacco (" .. remoteName .. ")", remoteName)
    end
    for _, remote in ipairs(attacksFolder:GetChildren()) do
      if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        registerConnection(remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
          pcall(onRemoteAttackFired, remote.Name, ...)
        end))
      end
    end
  end)
  task.spawn(function()
    while activeLoop do
      if Settings.AutoParry and Method_Predictive and hasDagger() then
        pcall(function()
          local myChar = localPlayer.Character
          local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if myRoot then
            local now = tick()
            if now - lastKillerCharactersUpdate >= 1.0 or #cachedKillerCharacters == 0 then
              lastKillerCharactersUpdate = now
              cachedKillerCharacters = getActiveKillerCharacters()
            end
            local killers = cachedKillerCharacters
            for _, killerChar in ipairs(killers) do
              local killerRoot = killerChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
              if killerRoot then
                local dist = (killerRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                if dist <= 45 and AutoEquip and not isDaggerEquipped() then
                  equipDagger()
                end
                if dist <= 9 and not isKillerBusyOrNonAttacking(killerChar) then
                  local velocity = getVelocity(killerRoot)
                  if velocity.Magnitude >= 12 then
                    local dirToMe = (myRoot.Position - killerRoot.Position).Unit
                    local dot = velocity.Unit:Dot(dirToMe)
                    if dot > 0.75 then
                      local passFacing = true
                      if Settings.ParryFacingCheck then
                        passFacing = isFacingTarget(killerRoot, myRoot)
                      end
                      if passFacing then
                        executeParry(
                          "Rincorsa Veloce Killer (Distanza: " .. string.format("%.1f", dist) .. ")",
                          dist,
                          killerChar
                        )
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end)
        task.wait(0.01)
      else
        task.wait(0.5)
      end
    end
  end)
  local function getCooldownUI()
    local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if not playerGui then
      return nil
    end
    for _, guiName in ipairs({ "Survivor", "Survivor-con", "Survivor-mob", "Survivor-gamepad" }) do
      local survivor = playerGui:FindFirstChild(guiName)
      if survivor then
        local bLeft = survivor:FindFirstChild("bottom left")
          or survivor:FindFirstChild("BottomLeft")
          or survivor
        local gen = bLeft:FindFirstChild("Gen") or survivor:FindFirstChild("Gen", true)
        if gen then
          local itemFrame = gen:FindFirstChild("ItemFrame")
          if itemFrame then
            local gui = itemFrame:FindFirstChild("Gui")
            if gui then
              return gui
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function updateCooldownUI()
    if Settings.HideParryUI then
      cleanupParryUI()
      return
    end
    local now = tick()
    local isEquipped = hasDagger()
    local client = getActiveParryClient()
    local clientOnCooldown = false
    if client and (client.isParryOnCooldown or client.isParryResolving) then
      clientOnCooldown = true
    end
    pcall(function()
      local gui = getCooldownUI()
      if gui then
        local barGradOnCooldown = false
        local bar = gui:FindFirstChild("Bar")
        local grad = bar
          and (bar:FindFirstChild("UIGradient") or bar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient"))
        if grad and grad.Offset and grad.Offset.Y > 0.3 then
          barGradOnCooldown = true
        end
        local label = gui:FindFirstChild("ParryCooldownLabel")
        if not label then
          label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
          label.Name = "ParryCooldownLabel"
          label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
          label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
          label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
          label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
          label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
          label.TextScaled = true
          label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
          label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
          label.ZIndex = 25
          label.Parent = gui
          local sizeConstraint = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint", label)
          sizeConstraint.MaxTextSize = 13
          sizeConstraint.MinTextSize = 8
        end
        if not isEquipped then
          label.Visible = false
        else
          if isPermanentCooldown then
            label.Text = "COOLDOWN\nLOCKED"
            label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
            label.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
            label.Visible = true
          elseif now < currentCooldownEnd then

            label.Text = "COOLDOWN\n" .. tostring(remaining) .. "s"
            label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
            label.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
            label.Visible = true
          elseif clientOnCooldown or barGradOnCooldown then
            label.Text = "COOLDOWN"
            label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 60)
            label.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
            label.Visible = true
          else
            label.Text = "READY!"
            label.TextColor3 = UI.Accent or Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 120)
            label.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
            label.Visible = true
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    pcall(function()
      local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
      local survMob = playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild("Survivor-mob")
      local controls = survMob and survMob:FindFirstChild("Controls")

          label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
          label.Name = "ParryCooldownLabel"
          label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
          label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
          label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
          label.TextScaled = true
          label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
          label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
          label.Active = false
          label.Selectable = false
          label.ZIndex = 25
          label.Size = UDim2.new(1.2, 0, 0.4, 0)
          label.Position = UDim2.new(-0.1, 0, -0.45, 0)
          label.Parent = parryBtn
          local sizeConstraint = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint", label)
          sizeConstraint.MaxTextSize = 14
          sizeConstraint.MinTextSize = 8

            label.Text = "COOLDOWN: LOCKED"
            label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
            label.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
            label.Visible = true
          elseif now < currentCooldownEnd then
            local remaining = math.ceil(currentCooldownEnd - now)
            label.Text = "COOLDOWN: " .. tostring(remaining) .. "s"
            label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
            label.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
            label.Visible = true
          elseif clientOnCooldown or barGradOnCooldown then
            label.Text = "COOLDOWN"
            label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 60)
            label.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
            label.Visible = true
          else
            label.Text = "READY!"
            label.TextColor3 = UI.Accent or Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 120)
            label.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
            label.Visible = true
          end
        end

    end)
  end
  pcall(function()
    local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")

        or playerGui:FindFirstChild("VD_FlowstateFloatingUI", true)

        _G.VD_FlowstateFloatingUIRef = nil

      local floatingLabel = survivorPerks and survivorPerks:FindFirstChild("FlowstateCustomLabel")
      if floatingLabel then
        pcall(function()
          floatingLabel:Destroy()
        end)
      end
      local perks = (survivorPerks and survivorPerks:FindFirstChild("Perks"))
        or (playerGui:FindFirstChild("Survivor") and playerGui.Survivor:FindFirstChild("Perks"))
      if perks then
        for _, slot in ipairs(perks:GetChildren()) do

task.spawn(function()
  local localNoclipConn = nil
  local function setNoclip(enabled)
    if enabled then
      if not localNoclipConn then
        localNoclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
          local char = localPlayer.Character
          if char then
            for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
              if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.CanCollide = false
              end
            end
          end
        end)
      end
    else
      if localNoclipConn then
        localNoclipConn:Disconnect()
        localNoclipConn = nil
      end
    end
  end
  local function hasTwistOfFate()
    local equippedAttr = tostring(localPlayer:GetAttribute("EquippedItem") or ""):lower()
    if equippedAttr:find("twist") or equippedAttr:find("fate") or equippedAttr:find("revolver") then
      return true
    end
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    if char then
      for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Tool") or child:IsA("Model") then
          local n = child.Name:lower()
          if
            n:find("twist")
            or n:find("fate")
            or n:find("revolver")
            or n:find("gun")
            or child:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
            or child:FindFirstChild("gun", true)
          then
            return true
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local bp = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    if bp then
      for _, child in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Tool") or child:IsA("Model") then
          local n = child.Name:lower()
          if
            n:find("twist")
            or n:find("fate")
            or n:find("revolver")
            or n:find("gun")
            or child:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
            or child:FindFirstChild("gun", true)
          then
            return true
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  while activeLoop do
    if
      Settings.RevolverAutofarm
      and isPremiumActive()
      and localHooksTable
      and localHooksTable.RevolverAutofarm
    then
      pcall(function()
        local teamName = localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name or ""
        if teamName == "Survivors" then
          local spawnTime = _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime or 0
          if spawnTime > 0 and (tick() - spawnTime) >= 15 then
            if hasTwistOfFate() then
              local char = localPlayer.Character
              local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
              local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
              if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                local twistOfFate = nil
                for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                  if child:IsA("Tool") then
                    local n = child.Name:lower()
                    if
                      n:find("twist")
                      or n:find("fate")
                      or n:find("revolver")
                      or n:find("gun")
                      or child:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
                      or child:FindFirstChild("gun", true)
                    then
                      twistOfFate = child
                      break
                    end
                  end
                end
                if not twistOfFate then
                  local bp = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
                  if bp then
                    for _, child in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
                      if child:IsA("Tool") then
                        local n = child.Name:lower()
                        if
                          n:find("twist")
                          or n:find("fate")
                          or n:find("revolver")
                          or n:find("gun")
                          or child:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
                          or child:FindFirstChild("gun", true)
                        then
                          hum:EquipTool(child)
                          task.wait(0.1)
                          twistOfFate = child
                          break
                        end
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
                if twistOfFate then
                  local gun = nil
                  for _, desc in ipairs(twistOfFate:GetDescendants()) do
                    if
                      desc:IsA("LuaSourceContainer")
                      and (desc.Name:lower() == "gun" or desc.Name:lower():find("twist"))
                    then
                      if
                        desc.Parent
                        and desc.Parent ~= twistOfFate
                        and desc.Parent.Name ~= "Right Arm"
                      then
                        gun = desc.Parent
                        break
                      end
                    end
                  end
                  if not gun then
                    local rightArm = twistOfFate:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
                    if rightArm then
                      for _, child in ipairs(rightArm:GetChildren()) do
                        if child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("BasePart") or child:IsA("Folder") then
                          gun = child
                          break
                        end
                      end
                    end
                  end
                  if not gun then
                    local anyGun = twistOfFate:FindFirstChild("gun", true)
                    if anyGun and not anyGun:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
                      gun = anyGun
                    elseif anyGun and anyGun:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") and anyGun.Parent then
                      gun = anyGun.Parent
                    else
                      gun = twistOfFate:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart") or twistOfFate
                    end
                  end
                  if gun then
                    local targetKiller = nil
                    local killers = {}
                    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                      if p ~= localPlayer then
                        local isK = false
                        if
                          p:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or p:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true
                        then
                          isK = true
                        elseif
                          p.Character
                          and (
                            p.Character:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer"
                            or p.Character:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true
                          )
                        then
                          isK = true
                        else
                          local t = p.Team
                          if t then
                            local tn = t.Name:lower()
                            if tn:find("killer") or tn:find("slasher") then
                              isK = true
                            end
                          end
                        end
                        if
                          isK
                          and p.Character
                          and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        then
                          local kHum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                          if kHum and kHum.Health > 0 then
                            table.insert(killers, p.Character)
                          end
                        end
                      end
                    end
                    if #killers == 0 then
                      for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                        if desc:IsA("Model") and desc ~= char then
                          local nameLower = desc.Name:lower()
                          if
                            string.find(nameLower, "zombie")
                            or string.find(nameLower, "slasher")
                            or string.find(nameLower, "monster")
                            or string.find(nameLower, "killer")
                          then
                            local kh = desc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                            if kh and kh.Health > 0 and desc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                              table.insert(killers, desc)
                            end
                          end
                        end
                      end
                    end
                    if #killers > 0 then
                      local killerChar = killers[1]
                      local killerRoot = killerChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                      if killerRoot then
                        setNoclip(true)
                        local behindPos = killerRoot.Position - (killerRoot.CFrame.LookVector * 8)
                        local targetPos = killerRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, -1.0, 0)
                        root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(behindPos, targetPos)
                        local direction = (targetPos - root.Position).Unit
                        if direction.Magnitude == 0 or direction.X ~= direction.X then
                          direction = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
                        end
                        local replicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
                        local remotes = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                        local items = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Items")
                        local twistOfFateRemote = items and items:FindFirstChild("Twist of Fate")
                        local fireRemote = twistOfFateRemote
                          and twistOfFateRemote:FindFirstChild("Fire")
                        if not fireRemote then
                          for _, desc in ipairs(replicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
                            if
                              desc.Name == "Fire"
                              and desc.Parent
                              and desc.Parent.Name == "Twist of Fate"
                            then
                              fireRemote = desc
                              break
                            end
                          end
                        end
                        if fireRemote then
                          local directionArg = (vector and vector.create or Vector3.new)(
                            direction.X,
                            direction.Y,
                            direction.Z
                          )
                          fireRemote:FireServer(gun, directionArg)
                        end
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          else
            setNoclip(false)
          end
        else
          setNoclip(false)
        end
      end)
    else
      setNoclip(false)
    end
    task.wait(0.1)
  end
  setNoclip(false)
end)
task.spawn(function()
  local lastTriggerTime = 0
  while activeLoop do
    task.wait(0.1)
    pcall(function()
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      if char then
        local progressVal = readModelValue(char, "HookedProgress")
        if progressVal and tonumber(progressVal) then
          local progNum = tonumber(progressVal)
          if progNum <= 3.0 and progNum > 0 then
            if
              Settings.RevolverAutofarm
              and isPremiumActive()
              and localHooksTable
              and localHooksTable.RevolverAutofarm
            then
              setRevolverAutofarm(false)
              showNotification(
                "Revolver Autofarm",
                "Disabled revolver autofarm: HookedProgress reached <= 3.0",
                "info"
              )
              if tick() - lastTriggerTime > 3.0 then
                lastTriggerTime = tick()
                if triggerInstantEscape then
                  pcall(triggerInstantEscape)
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end
end)
task.spawn(function()
  local currentState = "Idle"
  local currentTarget = nil
  local currentPoint = nil
  local reservedGen = nil
  local lastEscapeTime = 0
  local ignoredSurvivors = {}
  local hookedTracker = {}
  local blacklistedGenerators = {}
  local lastTrackedHealth = nil
  local hasTakenHitAfterTwist = false
  local lastHitTimestamp = 0
  local function isPlayerWithTwistOfFate(player)
    if not player or player == localPlayer then
      return false
    end
    local equippedAttr = tostring(player:GetAttribute("EquippedItem") or ""):lower()
    if equippedAttr:find("twist") or equippedAttr:find("fate") or equippedAttr:find("revolver") then
      return true
    end
    local char = player.Character
    if char then
      for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Tool") or child:IsA("Model") then
          local n = child.Name:lower()
          if
            n:find("twist")
            or n:find("fate")
            or n:find("revolver")
            or n:find("gun")
            or child:FindFirstChild("gun", true)
          then
            return true
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local bp = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    if bp then
      for _, child in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Tool") or child:IsA("Model") then
          local n = child.Name:lower()
          if n:find("twist") or n:find("fate") or n:find("revolver") or n:find("gun") then
            return true
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local function isPlayerLookingDirectlyAtMe(player, maxDist)
    maxDist = maxDist or 80
    local myChar = localPlayer.Character
    local theirChar = player and player.Character
    if not myChar or not theirChar then
      return false
    end
    local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local myHead = myChar:FindFirstChild("Head") or myRoot
    local theirHead = theirChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
      or theirChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local theirRoot = theirChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot or not theirHead or not theirRoot then
      return false
    end
    local toMe = (myHead.Position - theirHead.Position)
    local dist = toMe.Magnitude
    if dist > maxDist or dist < 0.1 then
      return false
    end
    local dirToMe = toMe / dist
    local headLook = theirHead.CFrame.LookVector
    local rootLook = theirRoot.CFrame.LookVector
    local dot = math.max(headLook:Dot(dirToMe), rootLook:Dot(dirToMe))
    if dot < 0.65 then
      return false
    end
    local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
    rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { theirChar, myChar }
    rayParams.IgnoreWater = true
    local rayResult = workspace:Raycast(theirHead.Position, toMe, rayParams)
    if rayResult and rayResult.Instance and rayResult.Instance.CanCollide then
      return false
    end
    return true
  end
  local function getNearbyTwistOfFatePlayer(maxDist)
    maxDist = maxDist or 80
    local myChar = localPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then
      return nil, math.huge
    end
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if player ~= localPlayer and isPlayerWithTwistOfFate(player) then
        local char = player.Character
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root then
          local d = (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
          if d <= maxDist then
            return player, d
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return nil, math.huge
  end
  local function getAnyTwistPlayerLookingAtMe(maxDist)
    maxDist = maxDist or 80
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if player ~= localPlayer and isPlayerWithTwistOfFate(player) then
        if isPlayerLookingDirectlyAtMe(player, maxDist) then
          return player
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local blacklistedGates = {}
  local function blacklistGate(gate, duration)
    blacklistedGates[gate] = tick() + (duration or 25)
  end
  local function isGateBlacklisted(gate)
    return blacklistedGates[gate] and tick() < blacklistedGates[gate]
  end
  local lastTelemetryCheck = 0
  local lastRepairCheckTime = 0
  local lastRepairingValue = nil
  local function getGateLever(gate)
    if not gate then
      return nil
    end
    if gate.Name == "ExitLever" then
      return gate:FindFirstChild("Main")
        or (gate:IsA("BasePart") and gate)
        or (gate:IsA("Model") and gate.PrimaryPart)
        or gate:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    end
    local exitLever = gate:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true) or gate:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")
    if exitLever then
      local main = exitLever:FindFirstChild("Main")
        or (exitLever:IsA("BasePart") and exitLever)
        or (exitLever:IsA("Model") and exitLever.PrimaryPart)
        or exitLever:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
      if main then
        return main
      end
    end
    for _, desc in ipairs(gate:GetDescendants()) do
      if desc.Name == "Main" and desc.Parent.Name:find("Lever") then
        return desc
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local openedGatesMemory = {}
  _G.VD_OpenedGatesMemory = openedGatesMemory
  local function isGateOpen(gate)
    if not gate then
      return false
    end
    if openedGatesMemory[gate] == true then
      return true
    end
    local container = (gate.Name == "ExitLever" and gate.Parent) or gate
    if container and openedGatesMemory[container] == true then
      return true
    end
    local p1 = getGateProgress(gate)
    if p1 >= 100 then
      openedGatesMemory[gate] = true
      if container then
        openedGatesMemory[container] = true
      end
      return true
    end
    if container and container ~= gate then
      local p2 = getGateProgress(container)
      if p2 >= 100 then
        openedGatesMemory[gate] = true
        openedGatesMemory[container] = true
        return true
      end
    end
    if container and container.Parent and container.Parent ~= workspace then
      local p3 = getGateProgress(container.Parent)
      if p3 >= 100 then
        openedGatesMemory[gate] = true
        openedGatesMemory[container] = true
        return true
      end
    end
    local relatedObjects = { gate, container }
    if container and container.Parent and container.Parent ~= workspace then
      table.insert(relatedObjects, container.Parent)
    end
    local lever = (gate.Name == "ExitLever" and gate)
      or (
        container
        and (container:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true) or container:FindFirstChild("ExitLever"))
      )
    if lever then
      table.insert(relatedObjects, lever)
    end
    local leverMain = lever
      and (lever:FindFirstChild("Main") or lever:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))
    if leverMain then
      table.insert(relatedObjects, leverMain)
    end
    for _, obj in ipairs(relatedObjects) do
      if obj then
        for _, attrName in ipairs({ "Opened", "Open", "IsOpen", "IsOpened", "GateOpen", "ExitOpen" }) do
          local av = obj:GetAttribute(attrName)
          if av == true or av == "true" or av == 1 then
            openedGatesMemory[gate] = true
            if container then
              openedGatesMemory[container] = true
            end
            return true
          end
        end
        for _, valName in ipairs({ "Opened", "Open", "IsOpen", "IsOpened", "GateOpen" }) do
          local vo = obj:FindFirstChild(valName)
          if
            vo
            and vo:IsA("ValueObject")
            and (vo.Value == true or vo.Value == "true" or tonumber(vo.Value) == 1)
          then
            openedGatesMemory[gate] = true
            if container then
              openedGatesMemory[container] = true
            end
            return true
          end
        end
        for _, progAttr in ipairs({ "ActivationProgress", "Progress", "RepairProgress" }) do
          local pv = obj:GetAttribute(progAttr)
          if pv ~= nil then
            local num = tonumber(pv)
            if num and ((num <= 1.01 and num >= 1.0) or num >= 100) then
              openedGatesMemory[gate] = true
              if container then
                openedGatesMemory[container] = true
              end
              return true
            end
          end
          local pChild = obj:FindFirstChild(progAttr)
          if pChild and pChild:IsA("ValueObject") then
            local num = tonumber(pChild.Value)
            if num and ((num <= 1.01 and num >= 1.0) or num >= 100) then
              openedGatesMemory[gate] = true
              if container then
                openedGatesMemory[container] = true
              end
              return true
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local box = (container and container:FindFirstChild("Box", true))
      or (container and container.Parent and container.Parent:FindFirstChild("Box", true))
    if box and box:IsA("BasePart") and not box.CanCollide then
      openedGatesMemory[gate] = true
      if container then
        openedGatesMemory[container] = true
      end
      return true
    end
    local lg = (container and container:FindFirstChild("LeftGate", true))
      or (container and container.Parent and container.Parent:FindFirstChild("LeftGate", true))
    local lge = (container and container:FindFirstChild("LeftGate-end", true))
      or (container and container.Parent and container.Parent:FindFirstChild("LeftGate-end", true))
    if lg and lge and lg:IsA("BasePart") and lge:IsA("BasePart") then
      local posDist = (lg.Position - lge.Position).Magnitude
      local orientDiff = lg.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(lge.CFrame.LookVector)
      if posDist < 2.5 and orientDiff > 0.95 then
        openedGatesMemory[gate] = true
        if container then
          openedGatesMemory[container] = true
        end
        return true
      end
    end
    local rg = (container and container:FindFirstChild("RightGate", true))
      or (container and container.Parent and container.Parent:FindFirstChild("RightGate", true))
    local rge = (container and container:FindFirstChild("RightGate-end", true))
      or (container and container.Parent and container.Parent:FindFirstChild("RightGate-end", true))
    if rg and rge and rg:IsA("BasePart") and rge:IsA("BasePart") then
      local posDist = (rg.Position - rge.Position).Magnitude
      local orientDiff = rg.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(rge.CFrame.LookVector)
      if posDist < 2.5 and orientDiff > 0.95 then
        openedGatesMemory[gate] = true
        if container then
          openedGatesMemory[container] = true
        end
        return true
      end
    end
    if container then
      for _, part in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
        if
          part:IsA("BasePart")
          and (
            part.Name == "Box"
            or part.Name == "Door"
            or part.Name == "Gate"
            or part.Name == "Bar"
            or part.Name == "ExitDoor"
          )
        then
          if not part.CanCollide then
            openedGatesMemory[gate] = true
            openedGatesMemory[container] = true
            return true
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local lastTeamName = ""
  local survivorsTeamStartTime = 0
  local function getNearestFinishLine()
    local bestFinish = nil
    local minDist = math.huge
    local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
      and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then
      return nil
    end
    local searchRoots = { workspace }
    local mapFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
    if mapFolder then
      searchRoots = { mapFolder }
    end
    for _, root in ipairs(searchRoots) do
      for _, desc in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if
          desc:IsA("BasePart")
          and (
            desc.Name == "Fininshline"
            or desc.Name == "Finishline"
            or string.find(desc.Name:lower(), "finishline")
            or string.find(desc.Name:lower(), "fininshline")
          )
        then
          local d = (desc.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
          if d < minDist then
            minDist = d
            bestFinish = desc
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return bestFinish
  end
  local function getBestEscapeFinishLine(killerPos)
    local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
      and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then
      return nil
    end
    if #cachedGates == 0 then
      return getNearestFinishLine()
    end
    local openGates = {}
    for _, gate in ipairs(cachedGates) do
      if gate and gate.Parent and isGateOpen(gate) then
        table.insert(openGates, gate)
      end
    end
    if #openGates == 0 then
      return nil
    end
    local candidates = {}
    local allFinishLines = {}
    local searchRoots = { workspace }
    local mapFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
    if mapFolder then
      searchRoots = { mapFolder }
    end
    for _, root in ipairs(searchRoots) do
      for _, desc in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if
          desc:IsA("BasePart")
          and (
            desc.Name == "Fininshline"
            or desc.Name == "Finishline"
            or string.find(desc.Name:lower(), "finishline")
            or string.find(desc.Name:lower(), "fininshline")
          )
        then
          table.insert(allFinishLines, desc)
        end
      end
    end
    for _, finishLine in ipairs(allFinishLines) do
      for _, gate in ipairs(openGates) do
        local gatePart = getGatePartSafe(gate)
        if
          finishLine:IsDescendantOf(gate)
          or finishLine:IsDescendantOf(gate.Parent)
          or (gatePart and (finishLine.Position - gatePart.Position).Magnitude < 150)
        then
          table.insert(candidates, { finishLine = finishLine, gate = gate })
          break
        end
      end
    end
    if #candidates == 0 then
      return getNearestFinishLine()
    end
    local bestFinish = nil
    local bestScore = -math.huge
    for _, cand in ipairs(candidates) do
      local finishLine = cand.finishLine
      local gate = cand.gate
      local gatePart = getGatePartSafe(gate) or finishLine
      local score = 0
      if killerPos and gatePart then
        local distToKiller = (gatePart.Position - killerPos).Magnitude
        if distToKiller < 60 then
          score = score - 10000
        else
          score = score + distToKiller
        end
      end
      local distToMe = (finishLine.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
      score = score - (distToMe * 0.1)
      if score > bestScore then
        bestScore = score
        bestFinish = finishLine
      end
    end
    return bestFinish
  end
  local function canPathToFinishLine(finishLine)
    if not finishLine then
      return false
    end
    local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
      and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then
      return false
    end
    local path =
      PathfindingService:CreatePath({ AgentRadius = 2.0, AgentHeight = 5.0, AgentCanJump = true })
    local success, _ = pcall(function()
      path:ComputeAsync(myRoot.Position, finishLine.Position)
    end)
    return success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success
  end
  local function getNearestReachableFinishLine()
    local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
      and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then
      return nil
    end
    local finishLines = {}
    local mapFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
    if mapFolder then
      for _, desc in ipairs(mapFolder:GetDescendants()) do
        if
          desc:IsA("BasePart")
          and (
            desc.Name == "Fininshline"
            or desc.Name == "Finishline"
            or desc.Name:lower():find("finishline")
            or desc.Name:lower():find("fininshline")
          )
        then
          table.insert(finishLines, desc)
        end
      end
    end
    local bestFinish = nil
    local minDist = math.huge
    for _, finishLine in ipairs(finishLines) do
      local path =
        PathfindingService:CreatePath({ AgentRadius = 2.0, AgentHeight = 5.0, AgentCanJump = true })
      local success, _ = pcall(function()
        path:ComputeAsync(myRoot.Position, finishLine.Position)
      end)
      if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        local d = (finishLine.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
        if d < minDist then
          minDist = d
          bestFinish = finishLine
        end
      end
    end
    return bestFinish
  end
  local function walkTo(targetPosition)
    local character = localPlayer.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
      return
    end
    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
      AgentRadius = 2.0,
      AgentHeight = 5.0,
      AgentCanJump = true,
      AgentJumpHeight = 10.0,
      AgentMaxSlope = 45,
    })
    local success, errorMessage = pcall(function()
      path:ComputeAsync(rootPart.Position, targetPosition)
    end)
    if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
      local waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
      for _, waypoint in ipairs(waypoints) do
        if not Settings.AutoFarmSurvivor or currentState ~= "Escaping" then
          break
        end
        humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
        if waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
          humanoid.Jump = true
        end
        local reached = false
        local checkTime = tick()
        local connection
        connection = humanoid.MoveToFinished:Connect(function(status)
          reached = true
          if connection then
            connection:Disconnect()
          end
        end)
        while not reached and tick() - checkTime < 1.2 do
          task.wait(0.05)
        end
        if connection then
          connection:Disconnect()
        end
      end
    else
      humanoid:MoveTo(targetPosition)
    end
  end
  local function canOpenAnyGate()
    for _, gate in ipairs(cachedGates) do
      if gate and gate.Parent and getGateLever(gate) and not isGateOpen(gate) then
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local function isLeverInteractable(leverMain)
    if not leverMain then
      return false
    end
    local prompt = leverMain:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
      or leverMain.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
    if not prompt then
      pcall(function()
        for _, desc in ipairs(leverMain.Parent:GetDescendants()) do
          if desc:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
            prompt = desc
            break
          end
        end
      end)
    end
    if prompt then
      return prompt.Enabled
    end
    local cd = leverMain:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
      or leverMain.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
    if cd then
      return true
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function isGatePowered(gate)
    if not gate then
      return false
    end
    local leverMain = getGateLever(gate)
    if leverMain then
      local interactable = isLeverInteractable(leverMain)
      if interactable ~= nil then
        return interactable
      end
    end
    if gate:GetAttribute("Powered") == true or gate:GetAttribute("Powered") == "true" then
      return true
    end
    if
      leverMain
      and (leverMain:GetAttribute("Powered") == true or leverMain:GetAttribute("Powered") == "true")
    then
      return true
    end
    local totalGens = #cachedGenerators
    local completedGens = 0
    for _, gen in ipairs(cachedGenerators) do
      if gen and gen.Parent and isGeneratorCompleted(gen) then
        completedGens = completedGens + 1
      end
    end
    local uncompletedCount = totalGens - completedGens
    if totalGens == 0 then
      return false
    end
    local requiredUncompleted = (totalGens >= 7) and 2 or 1
    return (uncompletedCount <= requiredUncompleted)
  end
  local function areGatesPowered()
    local activeSurvivors = 0
    local potentialSurvivors = 0
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      local team = player.Team
      local isSurvivor = false
      if team then
        if
          team.Name == "Survivors"
          or team.Name ~= "Killer" and team.Name ~= "Spectators" and team.Name ~= "Spectator"
        then
          isSurvivor = true
        end
      else
        local plName = player.Name:lower()
        if not plName:find("killer") and not plName:find("spectator") then
          isSurvivor = true
        end
      end
      if isSurvivor then
        potentialSurvivors = potentialSurvivors + 1
        local char = player.Character
        if char then
          if char:GetAttribute("vaultspeed") ~= nil or char:FindFirstChild("vaultspeed") ~= nil then
            activeSurvivors = activeSurvivors + 1
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local spawnElapsed = tick() - (_G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime or 0)
    local isLastSurvivor = false
    if spawnElapsed > 25.0 then
      isLastSurvivor = (activeSurvivors <= 1)
    else
      isLastSurvivor = (potentialSurvivors <= 1)
    end
    if isLastSurvivor then
      return true
    end
    for _, gate in ipairs(cachedGates) do
      if gate and gate.Parent and isGatePowered(gate) then
        return true
      end
    end
    if #cachedGates == 0 then
      local totalGens = #cachedGenerators
      if totalGens == 0 then
        return false
      end
      local completedGens = 0
      for _, gen in ipairs(cachedGenerators) do
        if gen and gen.Parent and isGeneratorCompleted(gen) then
          completedGens = completedGens + 1
        end
      end
      local uncompletedCount = totalGens - completedGens
      local requiredUncompleted = (totalGens >= 7) and 2 or 1
      return (uncompletedCount <= requiredUncompleted)
    end
    return false
  end
  local function canEscapeNow(killerDist)
    local kDist, kPos = getNearestKillerInfo()
    local finishLine = getBestEscapeFinishLine(kPos)
    if not finishLine then
      return false
    end
    local openCount = 0
    local totalGates = 0
    local anyGateOpen = false
    for _, gate in ipairs(cachedGates) do
      if gate and gate.Parent and getGateLever(gate) then
        totalGates = totalGates + 1
        if isGateOpen(gate) then
          openCount = openCount + 1
          anyGateOpen = true
        end
      end
    end
    local bothGatesOpen = (totalGates > 0 and openCount >= totalGates)
    local activeSurvivors = 0
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      local char = player.Character
      if char then
        if char:GetAttribute("vaultspeed") ~= nil or char:FindFirstChild("vaultspeed") ~= nil then
          activeSurvivors = activeSurvivors + 1
        end
      end
    end
    local isLastSurvivor = (activeSurvivors <= 1)
    local gatesAreOpen = anyGateOpen or bothGatesOpen or (totalGates == 0)
    return gatesAreOpen
  end
  local repairRemote = nil
  local unhookRemote = nil
  local leverRemote = nil
  local lastRepairPoint = nil
  local lastGatePoint = nil
  local previousGateDuringOpen = nil
  local function scanRemotes()
    local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    pcall(function()
      local remotes = rs:WaitForChild("Remotes", 2)
      if remotes then
        local gen = remotes:WaitForChild("Generator", 2)
        if gen then
          local rep = gen:WaitForChild("RepairEvent", 2)
          if rep then
            repairRemote = rep
          end
        end
        local carry = remotes:WaitForChild("Carry", 2)
        if carry then
          local unh = carry:WaitForChild("UnHookEvent", 2)
          if unh then
            unhookRemote = unh
          end
          if not unhookRemote then
            for _, desc in ipairs(carry:GetDescendants()) do
              if
                string.find(desc.Name:lower(), "unhook") or string.find(desc.Name:lower(), "rescue")
              then
                unhookRemote = desc
                break
              end
            end
          end
        end
        if not unhookRemote then
          for _, desc in ipairs(remotes:GetDescendants()) do
            if desc:IsA("RemoteEvent") or desc:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
              local n = desc.Name:lower()
              if string.find(n, "unhook") or string.find(n, "rescue") then
                unhookRemote = desc
                break
              end
            end
          end
        end
        local exit = remotes:WaitForChild("Exit", 2)
        if exit then
          local lev = exit:WaitForChild("LeverEvent", 2)
          if lev then
            leverRemote = lev
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end
  local function isIgnored(player)
    return ignoredSurvivors[player] and tick() < ignoredSurvivors[player]
  end
  local function isGenBlacklisted(gen)
    return blacklistedGenerators[gen] and tick() < blacklistedGenerators[gen]
  end
  local function blacklistGenerator(gen, duration)
    blacklistedGenerators[gen] = tick() + (duration or 25)
  end
