  local function isInLobby()
    local team = localPlayer.Team
    local teamName = team and team.Name or ""
    if teamName ~= "Survivors" and teamName ~= "Killer" then
      return true
    end
    local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
    if not map then
      return true
    end
    local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby") or workspace:FindFirstChild("lobby")
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    if lobby and char and char:IsDescendantOf(lobby) then
      return true
    end
    return false
  end
  _G.VD_IsInLobby = isInLobby
  local function getKillers()
    if isInLobby() then
      return {}
    end
    local killers = {}
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if player ~= localPlayer then
        local team = player.Team
        local isKiller = team and team.Name == "Killer"
        local isSurvivor = team and team.Name == "Survivors"
        if not team then
          local plName = player.Name:lower()
          if plName:find("killer") then
            isKiller = true
          elseif plName:find("survivor") then
            isSurvivor = true
          end
        end
        if
          isKiller
          and not isSurvivor
          and player.Character
          and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        then
          table.insert(killers, player)
        end
      end
    end
    return killers
  end
  _G.VD_GetKillers = getKillers
  local function getNearestKillerInfo()
    if isInLobby() then
      return math.huge, nil
    end
    local nearestDist = math.huge
    local nearestPosition = nil
    local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
      and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then
      return nearestDist, nil
    end
    local killerChars = {}
    if getActiveKillerCharacters then
      pcall(function()
        killerChars = getActiveKillerCharacters()
      end)
    end
    if not killerChars or #killerChars == 0 then
      killerChars = {}
      for _, k in ipairs(getKillers()) do
        if k.Character then
          table.insert(killerChars, k.Character)
        end
      end
    end
    for _, kChar in ipairs(killerChars) do
      if kChar and kChar.Parent then
        local kRoot = kChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if kRoot then
          local dist = (kRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
          if dist < nearestDist then
            nearestDist = dist
            nearestPosition = kRoot.Position
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return nearestDist, nearestPosition
  end
  local function isPointOccupied(point)
    if not point then
      return false
    end
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if
        player ~= localPlayer
        and player.Character
        and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      then
        local dist = (player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - point.Position).Magnitude
        if dist < 4.0 then
          return true
        end
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local function isGeneratorPoint(part)
    return part and part:IsA("BasePart") and string.find(part.Name:lower(), "generatorpoint") ~= nil
  end
  local function getGeneratorPoint(gen)
    local fallbackPoint = nil
    for _, child in ipairs(gen:GetChildren()) do
      if string.find(child.Name:lower(), "generatorpoint") then
        if not isPointOccupied(child) then
          return child
        else
          fallbackPoint = child
        end
      end
    end
    if fallbackPoint then
      return nil
    end
    local basePart = gen:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    if basePart then
      if not isPointOccupied(basePart) then
        return basePart
      end
    end
    if gen:IsA("Model") and gen.PrimaryPart then
      if not isPointOccupied(gen.PrimaryPart) then
        return gen.PrimaryPart
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function getGenPartSafe(gen)
    if gen:IsA("Model") then
      return gen.PrimaryPart or gen:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    end
    return gen:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
  end
  local function getGenDistFromPos(gen, pos)
    local genPart = getGenPartSafe(gen)
    if genPart then
      return (genPart.Position - pos).Magnitude
    end
    return math.huge
  end
  local function isSCPNear(position, maxDistance)
    local mapFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
    if not mapFolder then
      return false
    end
    for _, child in ipairs(mapFolder:GetChildren()) do
      if child:IsA("Folder") or child:IsA("Model") then
        for _, obj in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
          if
            obj:IsA("Model") and (
              obj.Name:lower():find("^scp") or obj.Name:lower():match("^scp%d+$")
            )
          then
            local primary = obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if primary then
              local dist = (primary.Position - position).Magnitude
              if dist <= maxDistance then
                return true, obj
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      if
        child:IsA("Model")
        and (child.Name:lower():find("^scp") or child.Name:lower():match("^scp%d+$"))
      then
        local primary = child.PrimaryPart or child:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        if primary then
          local dist = (primary.Position - position).Magnitude
          if dist <= maxDistance then
            return true, child
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return false, nil
  end
  local function getGeneratorScore(gen, killerPos, myPos)
    local genPart = getGenPartSafe(gen)
    if not genPart then
      return -999999
    end
    local distToKiller = 9999
    if killerPos then
      distToKiller = (genPart.Position - killerPos).Magnitude
      if distToKiller < 45 then
        return -999999
      end
    end
    local isNearSCP, scpObj = isSCPNear(genPart.Position, 15)
    if isNearSCP then
      return -999999
    end
    local progress = getGeneratorProgress(gen)
    local score = (progress * 15) + (distToKiller * 2)
    if isPremiumActive() and Settings.AutoFarmTwistOfFate then
      for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= localPlayer and isPlayerWithTwistOfFate(player) then
          local pChar = player.Character
          local pRoot = pChar and pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if pRoot and (pRoot.Position - genPart.Position).Magnitude < 30 then
            score = score - 50000
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if currentTarget == gen then
      score = score + 1000
    end
    if reservedGen == gen then
      score = score + 500
    end
    return score
  end
  local function getSafeGenerator(killerPos)
    local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
      and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local myPos = myRoot and myRoot.Position
    local bestGen = nil
    local bestScore = -math.huge
    for _, gen in ipairs(cachedGenerators) do
      if not gen or not gen.Parent then
        continue
      end
      if isGeneratorCompleted(gen) then
        continue
      end
      if isGeneratorPaused(gen) then
        continue
      end
      if isGenBlacklisted(gen) then
        continue
      end
      local pt = getGeneratorPoint(gen)
      if not pt then
        continue
      end
      local ok, score = pcall(getGeneratorScore, gen, killerPos, myPos)
      if ok and score and score > bestScore then
        bestScore = score
        bestGen = gen
      end
    end
    return bestGen
  end
  local function getHookedSurvivors()
    local hooked = {}
    local now = os.clock()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if player == localPlayer then
        continue
      end
      local char = player.Character
      if char then
        local progressVal = readModelValue(char, "HookedProgress")
        local isHooked = false
        if progressVal and tonumber(progressVal) then
          local progNum = tonumber(progressVal)
          local track = hookedTracker[player]
          if not track then
            hookedTracker[player] = { lastVal = progNum, lastChangeTime = 0 }
          else
            if track.lastVal ~= progNum then
              track.lastVal = progNum
              track.lastChangeTime = now
            end
            if now - track.lastChangeTime < 3.0 then
              isHooked = true
            end
          end
        else
          hookedTracker[player] = nil
        end
        if isHooked then
          table.insert(hooked, player)
        end
      end
    end
    return hooked
  end
  local function findHookForSurvivor(player)
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then
      return nil
    end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then
      return nil
    end
    local bestHookPoint = nil
    local minDist = math.huge
    for _, hook in ipairs(cachedHooks or {}) do
      if hook and hook.Parent then
        local dist = (hook.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
        if dist < minDist then
          minDist = dist
          bestHookPoint = hook
        end
      end
    end
    return minDist < 12 and bestHookPoint or nil
  end
  local function getHookedSurvivorSafe(killerPos)
    if not (isPremiumActive() and Settings.AutoFarmUnhookSurvivors) then
      return nil, nil, nil
    end
    local now = os.clock()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if player == localPlayer then
        continue
      end
      if isIgnored(player) then
        continue
      end
      local char = player.Character
      if char then
        local isHooked = false
        local hookPoint = nil
        local isHookedVal = readModelValue(char, "IsHooked")
        if isHookedVal ~= nil then
          if isHookedVal == true then
            isHooked = true
            hookPoint = findHookForSurvivor(player)
          end
        else
          local progressVal = readModelValue(char, "HookedProgress")
          if progressVal and tonumber(progressVal) then
            local progNum = tonumber(progressVal)
            local track = hookedTracker[player]
            if not track then
              hookedTracker[player] = {
                initialVal = progNum,
                lastVal = progNum,
                lastChangeTime = now,
                firstSeenTime = now,
                decreaseCount = 0,
              }
            else
              if track.lastVal ~= progNum then
                if progNum < track.lastVal then
                  track.decreaseCount = track.decreaseCount + 1
                else
                  track.decreaseCount = 0
                  track.initialVal = progNum
                  track.firstSeenTime = now
                end
                track.lastVal = progNum
                track.lastChangeTime = now
              end
              if
                now - track.firstSeenTime >= 1.0
                and track.decreaseCount >= 2
                and progNum < track.initialVal
              then
                if now - track.lastChangeTime < 3.0 and progNum > 0 and progNum < 100 then
                  hookPoint = findHookForSurvivor(player)
                  if hookPoint then
                    isHooked = true
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          else
            hookedTracker[player] = nil
          end
        end
        if isHooked and hookPoint then
          local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if hrp and (not killerPos or (hrp.Position - killerPos).Magnitude > 75) then
            return hookPoint, hookPoint, player
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return nil, nil, nil
  end
  local currentRepairGuid = nil
  local function getRepairGuid()
    if not currentRepairGuid then
      pcall(function()
        currentRepairGuid = game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false)
      end)
      if not currentRepairGuid then
        currentRepairGuid = "FEB67C57-1E59-4609-B765-6304242AC088"
      end
    end
    return currentRepairGuid
  end
  local function stopRepairRemote()
    if repairRemote then
      local guid = currentRepairGuid or "FEB67C57-1E59-4609-B765-6304242AC088"
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      if currentPoint then
        pcall(function()
          repairRemote:FireServer(currentPoint, false, nil, guid, char)
        end)
      end
      if lastRepairPoint and lastRepairPoint ~= currentPoint then
        pcall(function()
          repairRemote:FireServer(lastRepairPoint, false, nil, guid, char)
        end)
      end
    end
    currentRepairGuid = nil
    isRepairingRemoteActive = false
    lastRepairPoint = nil
  end
  local function stopLeverRemote()
    if leverRemote then
      if currentPoint then
        pcall(function()
          leverRemote:FireServer(currentPoint, false)
        end)
      end
      if lastGatePoint and lastGatePoint ~= currentPoint then
        pcall(function()
          leverRemote:FireServer(lastGatePoint, false)
        end)
      end
    end
    isGateRemoteActive = false
    lastGatePoint = nil
  end
  local function stopAllInteractions()
    stopRepairRemote()
    stopLeverRemote()
    currentPoint = nil
    currentTarget = nil
  end
  _G.VD_StopAllInteractions = stopAllInteractions
  local function updateStatus(state)
    _G.VD_CurrentFarmState = state
    if _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus then
      pcall(function()
        _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus(state)
      end)
    end
  end
  local isSubSurfaceActive = false
  local subSurfaceOriginalCFrame = nil
  local subSurfaceLockConn = nil
  local function enterSubSurfacePocket(depth)
    if isSubSurfaceActive then
      return
    end
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
      return
    end
    local d = depth or Settings.SubSurfaceDepth or 8.5
    subSurfaceOriginalCFrame = root.CFrame
    isSubSurfaceActive = true
    pcall(function()
      for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
          p.CanCollide = false
        end
      end
    end)
    local undergroundCF = root.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, d, 0)
    root.CFrame = undergroundCF
    pcall(function()
      root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
      root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end)
    local expectedY = subSurfaceOriginalCFrame.Position.Y - d
    subSurfaceLockConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
      if not isSubSurfaceActive or not root or not root.Parent then
        return
      end
      pcall(function()
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
          root.Position.X,
          expectedY,
          root.Position.Z,
          select(4, subSurfaceOriginalCFrame:GetComponents())
        )
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
          hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
        end
      end)
    end)
  end
  local function exitSubSurfacePocket()
    if not isSubSurfaceActive then
      return
    end
    if subSurfaceLockConn then
      pcall(function()
        subSurfaceLockConn:Disconnect()
      end)
      subSurfaceLockConn = nil
    end
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if root and subSurfaceOriginalCFrame then
      root.CFrame = subSurfaceOriginalCFrame
      pcall(function()
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
      end)
    end
    pcall(function()
      for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
          p.CanCollide = true
        end
      end
    end)
    isSubSurfaceActive = false
    subSurfaceOriginalCFrame = nil
  end
  _G.VD_EnterSubSurfacePocket = enterSubSurfacePocket
  _G.VD_ExitSubSurfacePocket = exitSubSurfacePocket
  local function smartWalkTo(targetPosition, maxDist, abortCondition)
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not root or hum.Health <= 0 then
      return false
    end
    if isSubSurfaceActive then
      exitSubSurfacePocket()
      task.wait(0.05)
    end
    local destPos = (typeof(targetPosition) == "CFrame" and targetPosition.Position)
      or (typeof(targetPosition) == "Vector3" and targetPosition)
      or (targetPosition and targetPosition:IsA("BasePart") and targetPosition.Position)
    if not destPos then
      return false
    end
    local initialDist = (destPos - root.Position).Magnitude
    if initialDist <= (maxDist or 3.2) then
      return true
    end
    local originalWalkSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed
    local safeSpeed = 21.0
    if not isMobile and VirtualInputManager then
      pcall(function()
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, false, game)
      end)
    end
    local sprintKeeper = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
      if not root or not root.Parent or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
        return
      end
      pcall(function()
        if hum.WalkSpeed < safeSpeed then
          hum.WalkSpeed = safeSpeed
        end
        hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
      end)
    end)
    local maxRepathAttempts = 5
    local repathAttempt = 0
    local completed = false
    while repathAttempt < maxRepathAttempts and not completed do
      repathAttempt = repathAttempt + 1
      if _G.VD_AbortPathfinding or (abortCondition and abortCondition()) then
        completed = false
        break
      end
      if not root or not root.Parent or hum.Health <= 0 then
        break
      end
      local curDist = (destPos - root.Position).Magnitude
      if curDist <= (maxDist or 3.2) then
        completed = true
        break
      end
      local agentRadius = (repathAttempt == 1 and 2.0)
        or (repathAttempt == 2 and 2.5)
        or (repathAttempt == 3 and 3.0)
        or 3.5
      local agentJumpHeight = (repathAttempt == 1 and 10.0) or (repathAttempt == 2 and 14.0) or 18.0
      local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
        AgentRadius = agentRadius,
        AgentHeight = 5.0,
        AgentCanJump = true,
        AgentJumpHeight = agentJumpHeight,
        AgentMaxSlope = 45,
        WaypointSpacing = 3.5,
      })
      local pathSuccess = pcall(function()
        path:ComputeAsync(root.Position, destPos)
      end)
      local waypoints = {}
      if pathSuccess and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
      else
        if repathAttempt >= 3 and safeSegmentedTeleport then
          safeSegmentedTeleport(root, destPos)
          completed = ((destPos - root.Position).Magnitude <= (maxDist or 3.5))
          break
        end
        table.insert(waypoints, { Position = destPos, Action = Enum.PathWaypointAction.Walk })
      end
      local needRepath = false
      local lastCheckPos = root.Position
      local lastCheckTime = tick()
      local stuckTicks = 0
      local lastJumpTime = 0
      local currentWpIndex = 1
      local blockedConn = nil
      if pathSuccess and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        blockedConn = path.Blocked:Connect(function(blockedIdx)
          if blockedIdx >= currentWpIndex then
            needRepath = true
          end
        end)
      end
      for wpIndex, wp in ipairs(waypoints) do
        currentWpIndex = wpIndex
        if _G.VD_AbortPathfinding or (abortCondition and abortCondition()) then
          completed = false
          break
        end
        if needRepath then
          break
        end
        local function shouldBunkerKiller()
          if isInLobby and isInLobby() then
            return false
          end
          if Settings.AutoPumpkin then
            return Settings.AutoPumpkinFleeKiller == true
          elseif Settings.AutoFarmSurvivor then
            return Settings.AutoFarmSubSurface == true
          else
            return (Settings.AutoFleeKiller == true and Settings.AutoFarmSubSurface == true)
          end
        end
        local kDist, kPos = getNearestKillerInfo()
        if kDist and kDist < 28 and shouldBunkerKiller() then
          enterSubSurfacePocket()
          local bunkerStart = tick()
          while isSubSurfaceActive and (tick() - bunkerStart < 15) do
            task.wait(0.15)
            if
              _G.VD_AbortPathfinding
              or (abortCondition and abortCondition())
              or not shouldBunkerKiller()
            then
              break
            end
            local elapsedBunker = tick() - bunkerStart
            if elapsedBunker >= 2.0 then
              local curKDist = getNearestKillerInfo()
              if not curKDist or curKDist > 40 then
                break
              end
            end
          end
          exitSubSurfacePocket()
          task.wait(0.05)
          if
            _G.VD_AbortPathfinding
            or (abortCondition and abortCondition())
            or not shouldBunkerKiller()
          then
            break
          end
          needRepath = true
          break
        end
        hum:MoveTo(wp.Position)
        if wp.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
          hum.Jump = true
          pcall(function()
            hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
          end)
        end
        local stepReached = false
        local stepStart = tick()
        local moveConn
        moveConn = hum.MoveToFinished:Connect(function(status)
          stepReached = true
          if moveConn then
            moveConn:Disconnect()
          end
        end)
        local wpDist = (wp.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
        local stepTimeout = math.max(0.4, (wpDist / math.max(safeSpeed, 1.0)) + 0.35)
        while not stepReached and not needRepath and (tick() - stepStart < stepTimeout) do
          task.wait(0.04)
          if _G.VD_AbortPathfinding or (abortCondition and abortCondition()) then
            completed = false
            break
          end
          if not root or not root.Parent or hum.Health <= 0 then
            break
          end
          local kDistNow, _ = getNearestKillerInfo()
          if kDistNow and kDistNow < 28 and shouldBunkerKiller() then
            enterSubSurfacePocket()
            local bunkerStart = tick()
            while isSubSurfaceActive and (tick() - bunkerStart < 15) do
              task.wait(0.15)
              if
                _G.VD_AbortPathfinding
                or (abortCondition and abortCondition())
                or not shouldBunkerKiller()
              then
                break
              end
              local elapsedBunker = tick() - bunkerStart
              if elapsedBunker >= 2.0 then
                local curKDist = getNearestKillerInfo()
                if not curKDist or curKDist > 40 then
                  break
                end
              end
            end
            exitSubSurfacePocket()
            task.wait(0.05)
            if
              _G.VD_AbortPathfinding
              or (abortCondition and abortCondition())
              or not shouldBunkerKiller()
            then
              break
            end
            needRepath = true
            break
          end
          if (wp.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= 2.8 then
            stepReached = true
            break
          end
          local now = tick()
          if now - lastCheckTime >= 0.35 then
            local distMoved = (root.Position - lastCheckPos).Magnitude
            lastCheckPos = root.Position
            lastCheckTime = now
            if distMoved < 0.6 and (destPos - root.Position).Magnitude > (maxDist or 3.2) then
              stuckTicks = stuckTicks + 1
              if stuckTicks == 1 then
                if now - lastJumpTime > 0.4 then
                  lastJumpTime = now
                  hum.Jump = true
                  pcall(function()
                    hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
                  end)
                end
                local toWp = (wp.Position - root.Position)
                local flatDir = Vector3.new(toWp.X, 0, toWp.Z)
                if flatDir.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                  flatDir = flatDir.Unit
                  local perp = Vector3.new(-flatDir.Z, 0, flatDir.X)
                  local nudgePos = root.Position + (perp * 2.5) + (flatDir * 0.5)
                  hum:MoveTo(nudgePos)
                end
              elseif stuckTicks >= 2 then
                needRepath = true
                stepReached = true
                break
              end
            else
              stuckTicks = 0
            end
          end
        end
        if moveConn then
          pcall(function()
            moveConn:Disconnect()
          end)
        end
        if (destPos - root.Position).Magnitude <= (maxDist or 3.2) then
          completed = true
          break
        end
        if needRepath then
          break
        end
      end
      if blockedConn then
        pcall(function()
          blockedConn:Disconnect()
        end)
        blockedConn = nil
      end
      if (destPos - root.Position).Magnitude <= (maxDist or 3.2) then
        completed = true
        break
      end
    end
    if
      not completed
      and not _G.VD_AbortPathfinding
      and not (abortCondition and abortCondition())
    then
      if (destPos - root.Position).Magnitude > (maxDist or 3.2) and safeSegmentedTeleport then
        safeSegmentedTeleport(root, destPos)
        completed = ((destPos - root.Position).Magnitude <= (maxDist or 3.5))
      end
    end
    if sprintKeeper then
      pcall(function()
        sprintKeeper:Disconnect()
      end)
    end
    pcall(function()
      if not isMobile and VirtualInputManager then
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, false, game)
      end
      hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
      if originalWalkSpeed and originalWalkSpeed > 0 then
        hum.WalkSpeed = originalWalkSpeed
      end
    end)
    return completed
  end
  _G.VD_SmartWalkTo = smartWalkTo
  local function safeTeleport(targetCFrame)
    local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
      and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then
      return
    end
    local wasActive = isRepairingRemoteActive or isGateRemoteActive
    if wasActive then
      stopRepairRemote()
      stopLeverRemote()
      task.wait(0.15)
    end
    lastPreTeleportCFrame = myRoot.CFrame
    local targetPos = (typeof(targetCFrame) == "CFrame" and targetCFrame.Position)
      or (typeof(targetCFrame) == "Vector3" and targetCFrame)
      or targetCFrame
    if Settings.AutoFarmPathfinding then
      local reached = smartWalkTo(targetPos, 3.5, function()
        return not Settings.AutoFarmSurvivor
      end)
      if reached then
        return
      end
    end
    safeSegmentedTeleport(myRoot, targetCFrame)
  end
  _G.VD_TriggerDodgeChangeGen = function()
    if currentState == "Repairing" and currentTarget then
      blacklistGenerator(currentTarget, 45)
      stopRepairRemote()
      local _, killerPos = getNearestKillerInfo()
      local nextGen = getSafeGenerator(killerPos)
      if nextGen then
        local pt = getGeneratorPoint(nextGen)
        if pt then
          local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
            and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if myRoot then
            safeTeleport(pt.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
            currentTarget = nextGen
            currentPoint = pt
            currentState = "Repairing"
            updateStatus("REPAIRING")
            if repairRemote then
              local guid = getRepairGuid()
              local char = localPlayer.Character
              pcall(function()
                repairRemote:FireServer(pt, true, nil, guid, char)
              end)
              isRepairingRemoteActive = true
              lastRepairPoint = pt
            end
            return true
          end
        end
      end
      local fallbackPos = nil
      pcall(function()
        if cachedGates and #cachedGates > 0 then
          local gate = cachedGates[1]
          local lever = getGateLever(gate)
          if lever then
            fallbackPos = lever.CFrame
          end
        end
        if not fallbackPos and getBestEscapeFinishLine then
          fallbackPos = getBestEscapeFinishLine()
        end
      end)
      local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
        and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if myRoot and fallbackPos then
        safeTeleport(fallbackPos + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
      end
      currentTarget = nil
      currentPoint = nil
      currentState = "Idle"
      updateStatus("IDLE")
      return false
    end
    return false
  end
  local function switchGeneratorFromTwistOfFate(tofPlayer)
    if currentTarget then
      blacklistGenerator(currentTarget, 45)
    end
    stopRepairRemote()
    task.wait(0.1)
    local _, killerPos = getNearestKillerInfo()
    local nextGen = getSafeGenerator(killerPos)
    if nextGen then
      local pt = getGeneratorPoint(nextGen)
      if pt then
        local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
          and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if myRoot then
          safeTeleport(pt.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
          currentTarget = nextGen
          currentPoint = pt
          currentState = "Repairing"
          updateStatus("REPAIRING")
          if isGeneratorPoint(pt) and repairRemote then
            local guid = getRepairGuid()
            local char = localPlayer.Character
            pcall(function()
              repairRemote:FireServer(pt, true, nil, guid, char)
            end)
            isRepairingRemoteActive = true
            lastRepairPoint = pt
          end
          showNotification(
            "Twist Of Fate",
            "Evaded Twist Of Fate user. Switched generator!",
            "info"
          )
          return true
        end
      end
    end
    currentTarget = nil
    currentPoint = nil
    currentState = "Idle"
    updateStatus("IDLE")
    showNotification("Twist Of Fate", "Evaded Twist Of Fate user!", "info")
    return false
  end
  while activeLoop do
    task.wait(0.2)
    if _G.VD_DodgeActive then
      continue
    end
    if currentState ~= "Repairing" then
      lastRepairCheckTime = 0
      lastRepairingValue = nil
    end
    if not isSurvivorFarmAllowed() or Settings.AutoPumpkin then
      hasTakenHitAfterTwist = false
      lastTrackedHealth = nil
      if currentState ~= "Idle" or isRepairingRemoteActive or isGateRemoteActive then
        stopAllInteractions()
        currentState = "Idle"
      end
      continue
    end
    if not repairRemote or not unhookRemote or not leverRemote then
      scanRemotes()
    end
    local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
      and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then
      stopAllInteractions()
      currentState = "Idle"
      updateStatus("IDLE")
      continue
    end
    local killerDist, killerPos = getNearestKillerInfo()
    if
      killerDist
      and killerDist < 25
      and Settings.AutoFarmSubSurface
      and not isSubSurfaceActive
    then
      stopRepairRemote()
      stopLeverRemote()
      enterSubSurfacePocket()
      local bunkerStart = tick()
      while isSubSurfaceActive and (tick() - bunkerStart < 15) do
        task.wait(0.2)
        local elapsedBunker = tick() - bunkerStart
        if elapsedBunker >= 3.5 then
          local curDist = getNearestKillerInfo()
          if curDist and curDist > 50 then
            break
          end
        end
      end
      exitSubSurfacePocket()
      task.wait(0.1)
      continue
    end
    local myChar = localPlayer.Character
    local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local currentHealth = myHum and myHum.Health or 100
    local maxHealth = myHum and myHum.MaxHealth or 100
    if lastTrackedHealth == nil then
      lastTrackedHealth = currentHealth
    else
      if currentHealth < (lastTrackedHealth - 0.5) and currentHealth > 0 then
        hasTakenHitAfterTwist = true
        lastHitTimestamp = tick()
      end
      lastTrackedHealth = currentHealth
    end
    if
      isPremiumActive()
      and Settings.AutoFarmTwistOfFate
      and (currentState == "Repairing" or currentState == "Idle")
    then
      if hasTakenHitAfterTwist or (currentHealth < maxHealth - 2) then
        local lookingPlayer = getAnyTwistPlayerLookingAtMe(80)
        if lookingPlayer then
          pcall(switchGeneratorFromTwistOfFate, lookingPlayer)
          continue
        end
      end
    end
    if
      Settings.AutoFleeKiller
      and isPremiumActive("AutoFleeKiller")
      and killerDist < 35
      and killerPos
    then
      if localHooksTable and type(localHooksTable.AutoFleeKiller) == "function" then
        local fled = localHooksTable.AutoFleeKiller(
          localPlayer.Character,
          myRoot,
          killerPos,
          cachedGenerators,
          getGenPartSafe,
          isGeneratorCompleted,
          isGeneratorPaused,
          getGeneratorPoint,
          showNotification
        )
        if fled then
          stopAllInteractions()
          currentState = "Repairing"
          updateStatus("REPAIRING")
          continue
        end
      end
    end
    if currentState == "Repairing" and currentTarget then
      local fled = false
      if killerPos then
        local genKillerDist = getGenDistFromPos(currentTarget, killerPos)
        if genKillerDist < 60 then
          fled = true
        end
      end
      if not fled then
        local genPart = getGenPartSafe(currentTarget)
        if genPart then
          local isNear, scpObj = isSCPNear(genPart.Position, 15)
          if isNear then
            fled = true
          end
        end
      end
      if fled then
        stopRepairRemote()
        if Settings.AutoFarmSubSurface then
          enterSubSurfacePocket()
          local waitStart = tick()
          while isSubSurfaceActive and (tick() - waitStart < 20) do
            task.wait(0.2)
            local elapsedBunker = tick() - waitStart
            if elapsedBunker >= 3.5 then
              local curKDist = getNearestKillerInfo()
              if curKDist and curKDist > 50 then
                break
              end
            end
          end
          exitSubSurfacePocket()
          task.wait(0.1)
        end
        local curKDistAfter = getNearestKillerInfo()
        if (not curKDistAfter or curKDistAfter > 42) and currentTarget and currentPoint then
          if not isGeneratorCompleted(currentTarget) then
            if not repairRemote then
              scanRemotes()
            end
            if repairRemote then
              local guid = getRepairGuid()
              local char = localPlayer.Character
              pcall(function()
                repairRemote:FireServer(currentPoint, true, nil, guid, char)
              end)
              isRepairingRemoteActive = true
              lastRepairPoint = currentPoint
              updateStatus("REPAIRING")
              continue
            end
          end
        end
        blacklistGenerator(currentTarget, 35)
        reservedGen = currentTarget
        stopRepairRemote()
        task.wait(0.1)
        currentTarget = nil
        currentPoint = nil
        currentState = "Idle"
        updateStatus("IDLE")
        continue
      end
    end
    if currentState == "OpeningGate" and killerDist < 40 then
      stopLeverRemote()
      if Settings.AutoFarmSubSurface then
        enterSubSurfacePocket()
        local waitStart = tick()
        while isSubSurfaceActive and (tick() - waitStart < 25) do
          task.wait(0.2)
          local elapsedBunker = tick() - waitStart
          if elapsedBunker >= 3.5 then
            local curKDist = getNearestKillerInfo()
            if curKDist and curKDist > 50 then
              break
            end
          end
        end
        exitSubSurfacePocket()
        task.wait(0.1)
      end
      stopLeverRemote()
      task.wait(0.1)
      local curKDistAfter = getNearestKillerInfo()
      local gateAlreadyOpen = (currentTarget and isGateOpen(currentTarget))
      if not gateAlreadyOpen then
        for _, g in ipairs(cachedGates) do
          if g and g.Parent and isGateOpen(g) then
            gateAlreadyOpen = true
            break
          end
        end
      end
      if gateAlreadyOpen then
        updateStatus("GATE 100% - WAITING (1s)")
        task.wait(1.0)
        local finishLine = getBestEscapeFinishLine(killerPos) or getNearestFinishLine()
        if finishLine then
          stopAllInteractions()
          currentState = "Escaping"
          currentTarget = finishLine
          currentPoint = finishLine
          updateStatus("ESCAPING")
          continue
        end
      end
      if (not curKDistAfter or curKDistAfter > 40) and currentTarget and currentPoint then
        if not isGateOpen(currentTarget) then
          if not leverRemote then
            scanRemotes()
          end
          if leverRemote then
            pcall(function()
              leverRemote:FireServer(currentPoint, true)
            end)
            isGateRemoteActive = true
            lastGatePoint = currentPoint
            updateStatus("OPENINGGATE")
            continue
          end
        end
      end
      local bestGate = nil
      local bestDist = -1
      if killerPos then
        for _, gate in ipairs(cachedGates) do
          if
            gate
            and gate.Parent
            and getGateLever(gate)
            and not isGateOpen(gate)
            and gate ~= currentTarget
          then
            local gp = getGatePartSafe(gate)
            if gp and killerPos then
              local d = (gp.Position - killerPos).Magnitude
              if d > bestDist then
                bestDist = d
                bestGate = gate
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      if bestGate and bestGate ~= currentTarget then
        local leverMain = getGateLever(bestGate)
        if leverMain then
          if not leverRemote then
            scanRemotes()
          end
          if leverRemote then
            previousGateDuringOpen = currentTarget
            currentState = "OpeningGate"
            currentTarget = bestGate
            currentPoint = leverMain
            safeTeleport(leverMain.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
            task.wait(0.2)
            pcall(function()
              leverRemote:FireServer(leverMain, true)
            end)
            isGateRemoteActive = true
            lastGatePoint = leverMain
            updateStatus("OPENINGGATE")
            continue
          end
        end
      end
      if currentTarget and currentPoint and not isGateOpen(currentTarget) then
        if not leverRemote then
          scanRemotes()
        end
        if leverRemote then
          pcall(function()
            leverRemote:FireServer(currentPoint, true)
          end)
          isGateRemoteActive = true
          lastGatePoint = currentPoint
          updateStatus("OPENINGGATE")
          continue
        end
      end
      currentTarget = nil
      currentPoint = nil
      currentState = "Idle"
      updateStatus("IDLE")
      continue
    end
    if currentState == "Idle" then
      local finishLine = getBestEscapeFinishLine(killerPos)
      if finishLine then
        local openCount = 0
        local totalGates = 0
        local anyGateOpen = false
        for _, gate in ipairs(cachedGates) do
          if gate and gate.Parent and getGateLever(gate) then
            totalGates = totalGates + 1
            if isGateOpen(gate) then
              openCount = openCount + 1
              anyGateOpen = true
            end
          end
        end
        local bothGatesOpen = (totalGates > 0 and openCount >= totalGates)
        local activeSurvivors = 0
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
          local char = player.Character
          if char then
            if
              char:GetAttribute("vaultspeed") ~= nil or char:FindFirstChild("vaultspeed") ~= nil
            then
              activeSurvivors = activeSurvivors + 1
            end
          end
        end
        local isLastSurvivor = (activeSurvivors <= 1)
        local gatesAreOpen = anyGateOpen or bothGatesOpen or (totalGates == 0)
        if gatesAreOpen then
          local hookObj, hookPoint, surv = getHookedSurvivorSafe(killerPos)
          if hookObj and hookPoint then
          else
            stopAllInteractions()
            updateStatus("GATE 100% - WAITING (1s)")
            task.wait(1.0)
            currentState = "Escaping"
            currentTarget = finishLine
            currentPoint = finishLine
            updateStatus("ESCAPING")
            continue
          end
        end
      end
      local hookObj, hookPoint, surv = getHookedSurvivorSafe(killerPos)
      if hookObj and hookPoint then
        if not unhookRemote then
          scanRemotes()
        end
        stopAllInteractions()
        currentState = "Rescuing"
        currentTarget = surv
        currentPoint = hookPoint
        updateStatus("RESCUING")
        local rescueStart = tick()
        local success = false
        while tick() - rescueStart < 2.5 and activeLoop do
          safeTeleport(hookPoint.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
          if unhookRemote then
            local targetHookPoint = hookPoint
            if targetHookPoint.Name ~= "HookPoint" then
              local hp = targetHookPoint.Parent
                and targetHookPoint.Parent:FindFirstChild("HookPoint")
              if hp then
                targetHookPoint = hp
              else
                pcall(function()
                  for _, d in ipairs(targetHookPoint.Parent:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d.Name == "HookPoint" then
                      targetHookPoint = d
                      break
                    end
                  end
                end)
              end
            end
            pcall(function()
              unhookRemote:FireServer(targetHookPoint)
            end)
          end
          pcall(function()
            local hookModel = hookPoint.Parent
            local prompt = hookPoint:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
            if not prompt and hookModel then
              for _, desc in ipairs(hookModel:GetDescendants()) do
                if desc:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
                  prompt = desc
                  break
                end
              end
            end
            if prompt then
              if fireproximityprompt then
                fireproximityprompt(prompt)
              end
            end
          end)
          task.wait(0.25)
          local isHookedNow = surv.Character
            and (
              readModelValue(surv.Character, "IsHooked") == true
              or surv.Character:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
            )
          if not isHookedNow then
            local progressVal = readModelValue(surv.Character, "HookedProgress")
            if not progressVal or tonumber(progressVal) == 0 then
              success = true
              break
            end
          end
          local kDist, _ = getNearestKillerInfo()
          if kDist < 50 then
            break
          end
        end
        if success then
        else
          ignoredSurvivors[surv] = tick() + 15.0
        end
        stopAllInteractions()
        currentState = "Idle"
        updateStatus("IDLE")
        continue
      end
      local gatesPowered = areGatesPowered()
      if gatesPowered then
        local bestGate, bestDist = nil, math.huge
        for _, gate in ipairs(cachedGates) do
          if
            gate
            and gate.Parent
            and getGateLever(gate)
            and not isGateOpen(gate)
            and not isGateBlacklisted(gate)
          then
            local gp = getGatePartSafe(gate)
            if gp then
              local d = (gp.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
              if d < bestDist then
                bestDist = d
                bestGate = gate
              end
            end
          end
        end
        if not bestGate then
          bestDist = math.huge
          for _, gate in ipairs(cachedGates) do
            if gate and gate.Parent and getGateLever(gate) and not isGateOpen(gate) then
              local gp = getGatePartSafe(gate)
              if gp then
                local d = (gp.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                if d < bestDist then
                  bestDist = d
                  bestGate = gate
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
        if bestGate then
          local leverMain = getGateLever(bestGate)
          if leverMain then
            if not leverRemote then
              scanRemotes()
            end
            if leverRemote then
              stopAllInteractions()
              currentState = "OpeningGate"
              currentTarget = bestGate
              currentPoint = leverMain
              safeTeleport(leverMain.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
              task.wait(0.2)
              pcall(function()
                leverRemote:FireServer(leverMain, true)
              end)
              isGateRemoteActive = true
              lastGatePoint = leverMain
              updateStatus("OPENINGGATE")
              continue
            end
          end
        end
      end
      if not gatesPowered then
        local bestGen = getSafeGenerator(killerPos)
        if bestGen then
          if not repairRemote then
            scanRemotes()
          end
          if repairRemote then
            local pt = getGeneratorPoint(bestGen)
            if pt then
              safeTeleport(pt.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
              currentState = "Repairing"
              currentTarget = bestGen
              currentPoint = pt
              if reservedGen == bestGen then
                reservedGen = nil
              end
              Settings.AutoSkillCheck = true
              if isGeneratorPoint(pt) then
                local guid = getRepairGuid()
                local char = localPlayer.Character
                pcall(function()
                  repairRemote:FireServer(pt, true, nil, guid, char)
                end)
                isRepairingRemoteActive = true
                lastRepairPoint = pt
              else
                isRepairingRemoteActive = false
              end
              updateStatus("REPAIRING")
            else
              updateStatus("IDLE")
              task.wait(0.5)
            end
          end
        else
          updateStatus("IDLE")
          task.wait(1.0)
        end
      else
        updateStatus("IDLE")
        task.wait(0.5)
      end
      continue
    end
    if currentState == "Repairing" then
      if
        not currentTarget
        or not currentTarget.Parent
        or isGeneratorCompleted(currentTarget)
        or isGeneratorPaused(currentTarget)
      then
        stopRepairRemote()
        task.wait(0.1)
        currentTarget = nil
        currentPoint = nil
        currentState = "Idle"
        updateStatus("IDLE")
        continue
      end
      if lastRepairCheckTime == 0 then
        lastRepairCheckTime = tick()
        local char = localPlayer.Character
        lastRepairingValue = char and char:GetAttribute("repairing") or nil
      elseif tick() - lastRepairCheckTime >= 5.0 then
        local char = localPlayer.Character
        local currentRepairingVal = char and char:GetAttribute("repairing")
        local isRepairingValid = false
        if currentRepairingVal and currentRepairingVal ~= 0 then
          if not lastRepairingValue or currentRepairingVal ~= lastRepairingValue then
            isRepairingValid = true
          end
        end
        if not isRepairingValid then
          stopRepairRemote()
          task.wait(0.1)
          currentTarget = nil
          currentPoint = nil
          currentState = "Idle"
          updateStatus("IDLE")
          lastRepairCheckTime = 0
          lastRepairingValue = nil
          continue
        else
          lastRepairCheckTime = tick()
          lastRepairingValue = currentRepairingVal
        end
      end
      local hookObj, hookPoint, surv = getHookedSurvivorSafe(killerPos)
      if hookObj and hookPoint then
        stopRepairRemote()
        task.wait(0.1)
        currentTarget = nil
        currentPoint = nil
        currentState = "Idle"
        updateStatus("IDLE")
        continue
      end
      local gatesPowered = areGatesPowered()
      if gatesPowered and (canOpenAnyGate() or canEscapeNow(killerDist)) then
        stopRepairRemote()
        task.wait(0.1)
        currentTarget = nil
        currentPoint = nil
        currentState = "Idle"
        updateStatus("IDLE")
        continue
      end
      if not isGeneratorPoint(currentPoint) then
        local newPt = getGeneratorPoint(currentTarget)
        if isGeneratorPoint(newPt) then
          currentPoint = newPt
          isRepairingRemoteActive = false
        end
      end
      local myDist = (myRoot.Position - currentPoint.Position).Magnitude
      if myDist > 10 then
        safeTeleport(currentPoint.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
        task.wait(0.2)
        myDist = (myRoot.Position - currentPoint.Position).Magnitude
      end
      if not repairRemote then
        scanRemotes()
      end
      if repairRemote then
        if myDist <= 10 then
          local guid = getRepairGuid()
          local char = localPlayer.Character
          pcall(function()
            repairRemote:FireServer(currentPoint, true, nil, guid, char)
          end)
          isRepairingRemoteActive = true
          lastRepairPoint = currentPoint
        else
          if isRepairingRemoteActive then
            stopRepairRemote()
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if currentState == "Escaping" then
      local finishLine = getBestEscapeFinishLine(killerPos) or getNearestFinishLine()
      if finishLine then
        currentTarget = finishLine
        currentPoint = finishLine
        updateStatus("ESCAPING")
        local noclipActive = true
        local noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
          if not noclipActive then
            return
          end
          local c = localPlayer.Character
          if c then
            for _, p in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
              if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
                p.CanCollide = false
              end
            end
          end
        end)
        safeTeleport(finishLine.CFrame)
        for attempt = 1, 10 do
          local c = localPlayer.Character
          if
            not c
            or not c.Parent
            or c:GetAttribute("HasEscaped") == true
            or localPlayer:GetAttribute("HasEscaped") == true
          then
            break
          end
          local r = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if r then
            local strideZ = ((attempt % 3) - 1) * 3.5
            r.CFrame = finishLine.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, strideZ)
            r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = finishLine.CFrame.LookVector * 22
            pcall(function()
              if typeof(firetouchinterest) == "function" and finishLine:IsA("BasePart") then
                firetouchinterest(r, finishLine, 0)
                task.wait(0.05)
                firetouchinterest(r, finishLine, 1)
              end
            end)
          end
          task.wait(0.3)
        end
        noclipActive = false
        if noclipConn then
          pcall(function()
            noclipConn:Disconnect()
          end)
        end
        if not Settings.AutoFarmAFK then
          Settings.AutoFarmSurvivor = false
          if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
            pcall(function()
              _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(false)
            end)
          end
          stopAllInteractions()
          currentState = "Idle"
          updateStatus("OFF")
        else
          stopAllInteractions()
          currentState = "Idle"
          updateStatus("ESCAPED")
          while activeLoop and localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name == "Survivors" do
            updateStatus("ESCAPED")
            task.wait(0.5)
          end
        end
        showNotification("Escape Triggered", "Escaped through finish line successfully!", "success")
      else
        local fallbackGatePart = nil
        for _, gate in ipairs(cachedGates) do
          if gate and gate.Parent and isGateOpen(gate) then
            fallbackGatePart = getGatePartSafe(gate)
            if fallbackGatePart then
              break
            end
          end
        end
        if fallbackGatePart then
          safeTeleport(fallbackGatePart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))
          task.wait(1.0)
          if not Settings.AutoFarmAFK then
            Settings.AutoFarmSurvivor = false
            if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
              pcall(function()
                _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(false)
              end)
            end
            stopAllInteractions()
            currentState = "Idle"
            updateStatus("OFF")
          else
            stopAllInteractions()
            currentState = "Idle"
            updateStatus("ESCAPED")
            while activeLoop and localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name == "Survivors" do
              updateStatus("ESCAPED")
              task.wait(0.5)
            end
          end
          showNotification(
            "Escape Triggered",
            "Teleported to gate fallback successfully!",
            "success"
          )
        else
          currentState = "Idle"
          updateStatus("IDLE")
        end
      end
      continue
    end
    if currentState == "OpeningGate" then
      local curProg = (currentTarget and getGateProgress(currentTarget)) or 0
      if curProg == 0 and currentTarget and currentTarget.Parent then
        curProg = getGateProgress(currentTarget.Parent)
      end
      if
        not currentTarget
        or not currentTarget.Parent
        or isGateOpen(currentTarget)
        or curProg >= 100
      then
        stopLeverRemote()
        if currentTarget then
          openedGatesMemory[currentTarget] = true
          if currentTarget.Parent then
            openedGatesMemory[currentTarget.Parent] = true
          end
          blacklistedGates[currentTarget] = nil
        end
        updateStatus("GATE 100% - WAITING (1s)")
        task.wait(1.0)
        local finishLine = getBestEscapeFinishLine(killerPos) or getNearestFinishLine()
        if finishLine then
          currentState = "Escaping"
          currentTarget = finishLine
          currentPoint = finishLine
          updateStatus("ESCAPING")
        else
          currentTarget = nil
          currentPoint = nil
          currentState = "Idle"
          updateStatus("IDLE")
        end
        continue
      end
      local myDist = (myRoot.Position - currentPoint.Position).Magnitude
      if myDist > 10 then
        safeTeleport(currentPoint.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
        task.wait(0.2)
        myDist = (myRoot.Position - currentPoint.Position).Magnitude
      end
      if not leverRemote then
        scanRemotes()
      end
      if leverRemote then
        if myDist <= 10 then
          pcall(function()
            leverRemote:FireServer(currentPoint, true)
          end)
          isGateRemoteActive = true
          lastGatePoint = currentPoint
        else
          if isGateRemoteActive then
            stopLeverRemote()
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end)
task.spawn(function()
  local lastGlobalFleeTime = 0
  local lastDebugPrint = 0
  while activeLoop do
    task.wait(0.25)
    if
      Settings.AutoFleeKiller
      and isPremiumActive("AutoFleeKiller")
      and not Settings.AutoFarmSurvivor
    then
      local success, err = pcall(function()
        local char = localPlayer.Character
        local myRoot = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myRoot then
          return
        end
        local isKnocked = char:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
          or localPlayer:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
        if not isKnocked and readModelValue then
          isKnocked = readModelValue(char, "Knocked") == true
        end
        local isHooked = char:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
          or localPlayer:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
        if not isHooked and readModelValue then
          isHooked = readModelValue(char, "IsHooked") == true
        end
        if isKnocked or isHooked then
          return
        end
        local myPos = myRoot.Position
        local nearestDist = math.huge
        local nearestPos = nil
        for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
          if player == localPlayer then
            continue
          end
          local team = player.Team
          if team and team.Name == "Killer" and player.Character then
            local kRoot = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if kRoot then
              local d = (kRoot.Position - myPos).Magnitude
              if d < nearestDist then
                nearestDist = d
                nearestPos = kRoot.Position
              end
            end
          end
        end
        if tick() - lastDebugPrint > 1.5 then
          lastDebugPrint = tick()
          local genCount = cachedGenerators and #cachedGenerators or 0
        end
        if tick() - lastGlobalFleeTime < 3.0 then
          return
        end
        if nearestDist < 35 and nearestPos then
          if localHooksTable and type(localHooksTable.AutoFleeKiller) == "function" then
            local fled = localHooksTable.AutoFleeKiller(
              char,
              myRoot,
              nearestPos,
              cachedGenerators,
              getGenPartSafe,
              isGeneratorCompleted,
              isGeneratorPaused,
              getGeneratorPoint,
              showNotification
            )
            if fled then
              lastGlobalFleeTime = tick()
            end
          end
        end
      end)
      if not success then
        warn("[Auto Flee Killer Loop Error] " .. tostring(err))
      end
    end
  end
end)
task.spawn(function()
  local hasEscapedThisRound = false
  local lastEscapedSpawnTime = 0
  local function updateStatus(state)
    _G.VD_CurrentFarmState = state
    if _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus then
      pcall(function()
        _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus(state)
      end)
    end
  end
  while activeLoop do
    task.wait(0.5)
    if not Settings.InstantFinishlineEscape then
      hasEscapedThisRound = false
      continue
    end
    local team = localPlayer.Team
    local isSurvivor = team
      and (
        team.Name == "Survivors"
        or (team.Name ~= "Killer" and team.Name ~= "Spectators" and team.Name ~= "Spectator")
      )
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    local rootPart = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not (isSurvivor and rootPart) then
      hasEscapedThisRound = false
      updateStatus("WAITING FOR MATCH (Survivor)")
      continue
    end
    local currentSpawnTime = _G.VD_FarmState and _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime or 0
    if currentSpawnTime > 0 and currentSpawnTime ~= lastEscapedSpawnTime then
      hasEscapedThisRound = false
    end
    if hasEscapedThisRound then
      updateStatus("ESCAPED")
      continue
    end
    local spawnTime = currentSpawnTime > 0 and currentSpawnTime or tick()
    local totalWait = 13.0
    while activeLoop and Settings.InstantFinishlineEscape and not hasEscapedThisRound do
      local currentTeam = localPlayer.Team
      local isStillSurv = currentTeam
        and (
          currentTeam.Name == "Survivors"
          or (
            currentTeam.Name ~= "Killer"
            and currentTeam.Name ~= "Spectators"
            and currentTeam.Name ~= "Spectator"
          )
        )
      local currentRoot = localPlayer.Character
        and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not (isStillSurv and currentRoot) then
        break
      end
      local elapsed = tick() - spawnTime
      if elapsed >= totalWait then
        break
      end
      local remaining = math.ceil(totalWait - elapsed)
      updateStatus("PREPARING ESCAPE (" .. remaining .. "s)")
      task.wait(0.5)
    end
    if activeLoop and Settings.InstantFinishlineEscape and not hasEscapedThisRound then
      local currentTeam = localPlayer.Team
      local isStillSurv = currentTeam
        and (
          currentTeam.Name == "Survivors"
          or (
            currentTeam.Name ~= "Killer"
            and currentTeam.Name ~= "Spectators"
            and currentTeam.Name ~= "Spectator"
          )
        )
      local character = localPlayer.Character
      local myRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if isStillSurv and myRoot then
        updateStatus("ESCAPING")
        local executed = false
        if localHooksTable and type(localHooksTable.InstantEscape) == "function" then
          local ok = pcall(function()
            localHooksTable.InstantEscape(myRoot, showNotification)
          end)
          if ok then
            executed = true
          end
        end
        if not executed then
          local bestFinish = nil
          local minDist = math.huge
          for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if
              desc:IsA("BasePart")
              and (
                desc.Name == "Fininshline"
                or desc.Name == "Finishline"
                or desc.Name:lower():find("finishline")
                or desc.Name:lower():find("fininshline")
              )
            then
              local d = (desc.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
              if d < minDist then
                minDist = d
                bestFinish = desc
              end
            end
          end
          if bestFinish then
            if _G.VD_StopAllInteractions then
              pcall(_G.VD_StopAllInteractions)
              task.wait(0.15)
            end
            local nearestGate = nil
            local minGateDist = math.huge
            for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
              if obj:IsA("BasePart") or obj:IsA("Model") then
                local lName = obj.Name:lower()
                if lName:find("gate") or lName:find("exitlever") or lName == "escapegate" then
                  local pos = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Position
                    or (obj.PrimaryPart and obj.PrimaryPart.Position)
                  if pos then
                    local d = (pos - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < minGateDist then
                      minGateDist = d
                      nearestGate = obj
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end
            local noclipActive = true
            local noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
              if not noclipActive then
                return
              end
              local c = localPlayer.Character
              if c then
                for _, p in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
                  if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
                    p.CanCollide = false
                  end
                end
              end
            end)
            if nearestGate then
              local gatePos = nearestGate:IsA("BasePart") and nearestGate.Position
                or (nearestGate.PrimaryPart and nearestGate.PrimaryPart.Position)
              if gatePos then
                local toFinish = (bestFinish.Position - gatePos) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                local forward = toFinish.Magnitude > 0.5 and toFinish.Unit
                  or myRoot.CFrame.LookVector
                myRoot.CFrame =
                  CFrame.new(gatePos + forward * 8 + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), gatePos + forward * 16)
                task.wait(0.2)
              end
            end
            for attempt = 1, 15 do
              local c = localPlayer.Character
              if
                not c
                or not c.Parent
                or c:GetAttribute("HasEscaped") == true
                or localPlayer:GetAttribute("HasEscaped") == true
              then
                break
              end
              local strideZ = ((attempt % 3) - 1) * 3.5
              myRoot.CFrame = bestFinish.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, strideZ)
              myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = bestFinish.CFrame.LookVector * 22
              pcall(function()
                if typeof(firetouchinterest) == "function" and bestFinish:IsA("BasePart") then
                  firetouchinterest(myRoot, bestFinish, 0)
                  task.wait(0.05)
                  firetouchinterest(myRoot, bestFinish, 1)
                end
              end)
              task.wait(0.35)
            end
            noclipActive = false
            if noclipConn then
              pcall(function()
                noclipConn:Disconnect()
              end)
            end
            showNotification("Instant Escape", "Escaped through finish line!", "success")
            executed = true
          else
            showNotification("Instant Escape", "Finish Line not found!", "error")
            updateStatus("ESCAPE FAILED")
          end
        end
        if executed then
          hasEscapedThisRound = true
          lastEscapedSpawnTime = currentSpawnTime > 0 and currentSpawnTime or tick()
          updateStatus("ESCAPED")
        end
      end
    end
  end
end)
task.spawn(function()
  while activeLoop do
    if
      Settings.AntiWiggle
      and isPremiumActive("AntiWiggle")
      and localHooksTable
      and type(localHooksTable.AntiWiggle) == "function"
    then
      pcall(localHooksTable.AntiWiggle)
    end
    task.wait(0.05)
  end
end)
task.spawn(function()
  local blacklistedPumpkins = {}
  local function getCrushRemote()
    local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local remotes = rs:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    if remotes then
      local events = remotes:FindFirstChild("Events")
      if events then
        local hw = events:FindFirstChild("Halloween")
        if hw then
          local crush = hw:FindFirstChild("Crush")
          if crush then
            return crush
          end
        end
      end
      for _, desc in ipairs(remotes:GetDescendants()) do
        if (desc:IsA("RemoteEvent") or desc:IsA("RemoteFunction")) and desc.Name == "Crush" then
          return desc
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function getTargetPumpkinPart(pumpkin)
    if not pumpkin then
      return nil
    end
    if pumpkin:IsA("BasePart") then
      return pumpkin
    end
    if pumpkin:IsA("Model") then
      local hb = pumpkin:FindFirstChild("HB")
        or pumpkin:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
        or pumpkin:FindFirstChild("HitBox")
      if hb and hb:IsA("BasePart") then
        return hb
      end
      return pumpkin.PrimaryPart or pumpkin:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function getPumpkinCrushTarget(pumpkin)
    if not pumpkin then
      return nil
    end
    local hb = pumpkin:FindFirstChild("HB")
      or (pumpkin.Parent and pumpkin.Parent:FindFirstChild("HB"))
    if hb then
      return hb
    end
    return getTargetPumpkinPart(pumpkin) or pumpkin
  end
  while activeLoop do
    task.wait(0.2)
    if Settings.AutoPumpkin then
      if isInLobby and isInLobby() then
        _G.VD_CurrentFarmState = "WAITING FOR MATCH (Lobby)"
        if _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus then
          pcall(function()
            _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus("WAITING FOR MATCH (Lobby)")
          end)
        end
        task.wait(1.0)
        continue
      end
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      local myRoot = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local isSurvivor = false
      local team = localPlayer.Team
      if team then
        local tName = team.Name:lower()
        if tName:find("survivor") then
          isSurvivor = true
        end
      end
      if char and myRoot and hum and hum.Health > 0 and isSurvivor and not isSpectating() then
        local killerNear = false
        if
          Settings.AutoPumpkinFleeKiller
          and not (isInLobby and isInLobby())
          and getNearestKillerInfo
        then
          local kDist, _ = getNearestKillerInfo()
          if kDist and kDist < 25 then
            killerNear = true
          end
        end
        if not killerNear then
          local now = tick()
          local alivePumpkins = {}
          local seen = {}
          local function addPumpkin(p)
            if p and p.Parent and p:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and not seen[p] then
              if not (blacklistedPumpkins[p] and now < blacklistedPumpkins[p]) then
                local pt = getTargetPumpkinPart(p)
                if pt then
                  seen[p] = true
                  table.insert(alivePumpkins, p)
                end
              end
            end
          end
          for _, p in ipairs(cachedPumpkins or {}) do
            addPumpkin(p)
          end
          local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
          local pFolder = map and map:FindFirstChild("Pumpkins")
          if pFolder then
            for _, child in ipairs(pFolder:GetChildren()) do
              addPumpkin(child)
            end
          end
          if #alivePumpkins > 0 then
            local bestPumpkin = nil
            local bestDist = math.huge
            local bestPart = nil
            for _, p in ipairs(alivePumpkins) do
              local pt = getTargetPumpkinPart(p)
              if pt then
                local d = (pt.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                if d < bestDist then
                  bestDist = d
                  bestPumpkin = p
                  bestPart = pt
                end
              end
            end
            if bestPumpkin and bestPart then
              local pState = "PUMPKIN (" .. #alivePumpkins .. " LEFT)"
              _G.VD_CurrentFarmState = pState
              if _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus then
                pcall(function()
                  _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus(pState)
                end)
              end
              local targetCF = CFrame.new(bestPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
              local dist = (bestPart.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
              if dist > 4.5 then
                local reached = false
                if Settings.AutoFarmPathfinding and _G.VD_SmartWalkTo then
                  reached = _G.VD_SmartWalkTo(targetCF, 4.0, function()
                    return not Settings.AutoPumpkin
                  end)
                end
                if
                  not reached
                  and (bestPart.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude > 6.0
                  and Settings.AutoPumpkin
                then
                  safeSegmentedTeleport(myRoot, targetCF)
                end
              end
              if
                myRoot
                and bestPumpkin.Parent
                and (bestPart.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude <= 7.0
              then
                local crushRemote = getCrushRemote()
                local crushTarget = getPumpkinCrushTarget(bestPumpkin)
                local attempts = 0
                local crushed = false
                while
                  attempts < 3
                  and bestPumpkin.Parent
                  and bestPumpkin:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
                  and Settings.AutoPumpkin
                do
                  attempts = attempts + 1
                  if crushRemote then
                    pcall(function()
                      crushRemote:FireServer(crushTarget)
                    end)
                  end
                  pcall(function()
                    local pg = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
                    local pc = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("pcprompts")
                    local fr = pc and pc:FindFirstChild("Frame")
                    local ps = fr and fr:FindFirstChild("pumpkinstomp")
                    if ps and ps.Visible then
                      if not isMobile then
                        local vim = VirtualInputManager
                        if not vim then
                          pcall(function()
                            vim = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
                          end)
                        end
                        if vim then
                          vim:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
                          task.wait(0.05)
                          vim:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
                        end
                      end
                    end
                  end)
                  pcall(function()
                    local c = localPlayer.Character
                    local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if h then
                      h:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
                    end
                  end)
                  task.wait(1.3)
                  if not bestPumpkin.Parent or not bestPumpkin:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
                    crushed = true
                    break
                  end
                end
                if not crushed and bestPumpkin.Parent then
                  blacklistedPumpkins[bestPumpkin] = tick() + 15.0
                else
                  local idx = table.find(cachedPumpkins, bestPumpkin)
                  if idx then
                    table.remove(cachedPumpkins, idx)
                  end
                  pcall(function()
                    removeModelESP(bestPumpkin, "Pumpkins")
                  end)
                end
              end
            end
          else
            _G.VD_CurrentFarmState = "ALL PUMPKINS CRUSHED"
            if _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus then
              pcall(function()
                _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus("ALL PUMPKINS CRUSHED")
              end)
            end
          end
        else
          _G.VD_CurrentFarmState = "PUMPKIN (KILLER NEAR)"
          if _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus then
            pcall(function()
              _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus("PUMPKIN (KILLER NEAR)")
            end)
          end
          task.wait(0.5)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end)
_G.VD_KillerFarmState = _G.VD_KillerFarmState or {}
_G.VD_KillerFarmState.grabRetries = _G.VD_KillerFarmState.grabRetries or 0
_G.VD_KillerFarmState.isHooking = _G.VD_KillerFarmState.isHooking or false
_G.VD_KillerFarmState.lastHookRemoteTime = _G.VD_KillerFarmState.lastHookRemoteTime or 0
_G.VD_KillerFarmState.hookedBlacklist = _G.VD_KillerFarmState.hookedBlacklist or {}
_G.VD_KillerFarmState.lastGrabTime = _G.VD_KillerFarmState.lastGrabTime or 0
task.spawn(function()
  local lastTarget = nil
  local function checkIsCarrying()
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    local isCarrying = localPlayer:GetAttribute("IsCarrying") == true
      or (char and char:GetAttribute("IsCarrying") == true)
    if isCarrying then
      local anyoneCarried = false
      for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= localPlayer then
          local pChar = player.Character
          if
            player:GetAttribute("IsCarried") == true
            or (pChar and pChar:GetAttribute("IsCarried") == true)
            or (readModelValue and pChar and readModelValue(pChar, "IsCarried") == true)
          then
            anyoneCarried = true
            break
          end
        end
      end
      if not anyoneCarried then
        local lastGrab = _G.VD_KillerFarmState.lastGrabTime or 0
        if tick() - lastGrab > 4.0 then
          isCarrying = false
        end
      end
    end
    return isCarrying
  end
  local function isHookOccupied(hookPart, carriedTarget)
    local now = tick()
    local bl = _G.VD_KillerFarmState.hookedBlacklist
    if bl[hookPart] and now < bl[hookPart] then
      return true
    elseif bl[hookPart] then
      bl[hookPart] = nil
    end
    if hookPart:GetAttribute("IsOccupied") == true or hookPart:GetAttribute("Occupied") == true then
      return true
    end
    local hookModel = hookPart.Parent
    if hookModel then
      if
        hookModel:GetAttribute("IsOccupied") == true or hookModel:GetAttribute("Occupied") == true
      then
        return true
      end
    end
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if player == localPlayer or player == carriedTarget then
        continue
      end
      local char = player.Character
      if not char then
        continue
      end
      local charRoot = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not charRoot then
        continue
      end
      local distToMe = (
        charRoot.Position
        - (
          localPlayer.Character
            and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            and localPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
          or charRoot.Position
        )
      ).Magnitude
      local isCarried = player:GetAttribute("IsCarried") == true
        or char:GetAttribute("IsCarried") == true
        or (readModelValue and readModelValue(char, "IsCarried") == true)
        or distToMe < 4
      if isCarried then
        continue
      end
      local isHooked = char:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
        or player:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
        or (readModelValue and readModelValue(char, "IsHooked") == true)
      local distToHook = (charRoot.Position - hookPart.Position).Magnitude
      if isHooked and distToHook < 15 then
        return true
      end
      if not isHooked and distToHook < 8 then
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local function getNearestFreeHook(myPos, carriedTarget)
    local bestHook = nil
    local minDist = math.huge
    for _, hook in ipairs(cachedHooks) do
      local hookPart = hook:IsA("BasePart") and hook
        or (hook:IsA("Model") and hook.PrimaryPart)
        or hook:FindFirstChild("HookPoint", true)
        or hook:FindFirstChild("Handle", true)
        or hook:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
      if hookPart and not isHookOccupied(hookPart, carriedTarget) then
        local d = (hookPart.Position - myPos).Magnitude
        if d < minDist then
          minDist = d
          bestHook = hookPart
        end
      end
    end
    return bestHook
  end
  local function getKillerFarmSurvivorStatus()
    local unhookedSurvivors = {}
    local hookedPositions = {}
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if player == localPlayer then
        continue
      end
      local team = player.Team
      local isSurvivor = false
      if team then
        if
          team.Name == "Survivors"
          or (team.Name ~= "Killer" and team.Name ~= "Spectators" and team.Name ~= "Spectator")
        then
          isSurvivor = true
        end
      else
        isSurvivor = true
      end
      if isSurvivor then
        local char = player.Character
