        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if char and root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
          local isHooked = char:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
            or player:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
            or (readModelValue and readModelValue(char, "IsHooked") == true)
          if isHooked then
            table.insert(hookedPositions, root.Position)
          else
            table.insert(unhookedSurvivors, player)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return unhookedSurvivors, hookedPositions
  end
  local function getFurthestAntiCampSpot(hookedPositions)
    if not hookedPositions or #hookedPositions == 0 then
      return nil
    end
    local candidatePositions = {}
    for _, gate in ipairs(cachedGates or {}) do
      if gate and gate.Parent then
        local part = getGatePartSafe(gate)
        if part then
          table.insert(candidatePositions, part.Position)
        end
      end
    end
    for _, gen in ipairs(cachedGenerators or {}) do
      if gen and gen.Parent then
        local part = (gen:IsA("BasePart") and gen)
          or (gen:IsA("Model") and gen.PrimaryPart)
          or gen:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        if part then
          table.insert(candidatePositions, part.Position)
        end
      end
    end
    for _, hook in ipairs(cachedHooks or {}) do
      if hook and hook.Parent then
        local part = (hook:IsA("BasePart") and hook)
          or (hook:IsA("Model") and hook.PrimaryPart)
          or hook:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        if part then
          table.insert(candidatePositions, part.Position)
        end
      end
    end
    local bestPos = nil
    local maxMinDist = -1
    for _, cPos in ipairs(candidatePositions) do
      local minDist = math.huge
      for _, hPos in ipairs(hookedPositions) do
        local d = (cPos - hPos).Magnitude
        if d < minDist then
          minDist = d
        end
      end
      if minDist > maxMinDist then
        maxMinDist = minDist
        bestPos = cPos
      end
    end
    if not bestPos or maxMinDist < 45 then
      local avgPos = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
      for _, hPos in ipairs(hookedPositions) do
        avgPos = avgPos + hPos
      end
      avgPos = avgPos / #hookedPositions
      local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
        and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local curPos = myRoot and myRoot.Position or avgPos
      local awayDir = curPos - avgPos
      local flatDir = Vector3.new(awayDir.X, 0, awayDir.Z)
      if flatDir.Magnitude < 0.1 then
        flatDir = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
      else
        flatDir = flatDir.Unit
      end
      bestPos = avgPos + flatDir * 180 + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    else
      bestPos = bestPos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    end
    return bestPos
  end
  local function getAutoFarmTarget()
    local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
      and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then
      return nil
    end
    local bestSurvivor = nil
    local minDist = math.huge
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if player == localPlayer then
        continue
      end
      local team = player.Team
      local isSurvivor = false
      if team then
        if
          team.Name == "Survivors"
          or team.Name ~= "Killer" and team.Name ~= "Spectators" and team.Name ~= "Spectator"
        then
          isSurvivor = true
        end
      else
        isSurvivor = true
      end
      if isSurvivor then
        local char = player.Character
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
          local isHooked = char:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
            or player:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
            or (readModelValue and readModelValue(char, "IsHooked") == true)
          if not isHooked then
            local d = (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
            if d < minDist then
              minDist = d
              bestSurvivor = player
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return bestSurvivor
  end
  local function updateKillerStatus(state)
    _G.VD_CurrentFarmState = state
    if _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus then
      pcall(function()
        _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus(state)
      end)
    end
  end
  while activeLoop do
    local delayTime = 0.15
    if not isKillerFarmAllowed() then
      task.wait(delayTime)
      continue
    end
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    local isCarrying = checkIsCarrying()
    if not isCarrying then
      delayTime = 0.08
    else
      delayTime = 0.15
    end
    local farmOk, farmErr = pcall(function()
      local myRoot = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not myRoot then
        return
      end
      if isCarrying then
        if not _G.VD_KillerFarmState.wasCarrying then
          _G.VD_KillerFarmState.wasCarrying = true
          task.wait(2.0)
          char = localPlayer.Character
          myRoot = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          isCarrying = checkIsCarrying()
          if not isCarrying or not myRoot then
            return
          end
        end
        updateKillerStatus("CARRYING")
        if not _G.VD_KillerFarmState.isHooking then
          local freeHook = getNearestFreeHook(myRoot.Position, lastTarget)
          if freeHook then
            _G.VD_KillerFarmState.isHooking = true
            local hookPos = freeHook.Position
            local distToHook = (myRoot.Position - hookPos).Magnitude
            if distToHook > 4 then
              if Settings.AutoFarmPathfinding and _G.VD_SmartWalkTo then
                _G.VD_SmartWalkTo(hookPos + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 1.8), 3.0)
              else
                safeSegmentedTeleport(
                  myRoot,
                  CFrame.new(hookPos + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 1.8), hookPos)
                )
              end
              pcall(function()
                workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame =
                  CFrame.new(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, hookPos)
              end)
              task.wait(0.2)
            end
            local carryRemotes =
              game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Carry")
            local hookEvent = carryRemotes:WaitForChild("HookEvent", 2)
            local hookCommit = carryRemotes:WaitForChild("HookCommit", 2)
            updateKillerStatus("HANGING")
            local now = tick()
            local timeSinceLast = now - (_G.VD_KillerFarmState.lastHookRemoteTime or 0)
            if timeSinceLast >= 2.0 then
              _G.VD_KillerFarmState.lastHookRemoteTime = now
              if hookEvent then
                pcall(function()
                  hookEvent:FireServer(freeHook)
                end)
              end
              task.wait(0.15)
              if hookCommit then
                pcall(function()
                  hookCommit:FireServer(freeHook)
                end)
              end
              task.wait(0.15)
            end
            local hookModel = freeHook.Parent
            local prompt = freeHook:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
            if not prompt and hookModel then
              prompt = hookModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
              if not prompt then
                for _, desc in ipairs(hookModel:GetDescendants()) do
                  if desc:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
                    prompt = desc
                    break
                  end
                end
              end
            end
            if prompt then
              pcall(function()
                fireproximityprompt(prompt)
              end)
              task.wait(0.15)
            end
            local hookStart = tick()
            local hookSuccess = false
            while tick() - hookStart < 2.0 do
              local charCheck = localPlayer.Character
              local stillCarrying = localPlayer:GetAttribute("IsCarrying") == true
                or (charCheck and charCheck:GetAttribute("IsCarrying") == true)
              if not stillCarrying then
                hookSuccess = true
                break
              end
              task.wait(0.1)
            end
            if not hookSuccess then
              _G.VD_KillerFarmState.hookedBlacklist[freeHook] = tick() + 8.0
            end
            _G.VD_KillerFarmState.isHooking = false
            _G.VD_KillerFarmState.lastHookRemoteTime = 0
            _G.VD_KillerFarmState.grabRetries = 0
          else
            updateKillerStatus("IDLE")
            task.wait(0.5)
          end
        end
      else
        _G.VD_KillerFarmState.wasCarrying = false
        _G.VD_KillerFarmState.isHooking = false
        local target = getAutoFarmTarget()
        if target then
          lastTarget = target
          local targetChar = target.Character
          local targetRoot = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          local targetHum = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
          if targetRoot and targetHum and targetHum.Health > 0 then
            local isKnocked = targetChar:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
              or target:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
            if not isKnocked then
              updateKillerStatus("HUNTING")
              local targetPos = targetRoot.Position
              local targetLook = targetRoot.CFrame.LookVector
              local flatLook = Vector3.new(targetLook.X, 0, targetLook.Z).Unit
              local killerPos = targetPos - flatLook * 1.2
              if Settings.AutoFarmPathfinding and _G.VD_SmartWalkTo then
                _G.VD_SmartWalkTo(killerPos, 2.5)
              else
                safeSegmentedTeleport(myRoot, CFrame.new(killerPos, targetPos))
              end
              pcall(function()
                workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame =
                  CFrame.new(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, targetPos)
              end)
              local attacksRemotes =
                game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Attacks")
              local lunge = attacksRemotes:WaitForChild("Lunge", 2)
              local basic = attacksRemotes:WaitForChild("BasicAttack", 2)
              if lunge then
                pcall(function()
                  lunge:FireServer()
                end)
              end
              if basic then
                pcall(function()
                  basic:FireServer()
                end)
              end
              _G.VD_KillerFarmState.grabRetries = 0
            else
              updateKillerStatus("CARRYING")
              safeSegmentedTeleport(myRoot, targetRoot.CFrame)
              task.wait(0.15)
              local carryRemote = game
                :GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
                :WaitForChild("Remotes")
                :WaitForChild("Carry")
                :WaitForChild("CarrySurvivorEvent", 2)
              if carryRemote then
                pcall(function()
                  carryRemote:FireServer(targetChar)
                end)
              end
              task.wait(0.2)
              local success = localPlayer:GetAttribute("IsCarrying") == true
                or (char and char:GetAttribute("IsCarrying") == true)
              if success then
                _G.VD_KillerFarmState.lastGrabTime = tick()
              else
                _G.VD_KillerFarmState.grabRetries = (_G.VD_KillerFarmState.grabRetries or 0) + 1
                if (_G.VD_KillerFarmState.grabRetries or 0) >= 3 then
                  _G.VD_KillerFarmState.grabRetries = 0
                  task.wait(0.5)
                end
              end
            end
          else
            updateKillerStatus("IDLE")
          end
        else
          local unhookedSurvivors, hookedPositions = getKillerFarmSurvivorStatus()
          if #hookedPositions > 0 and #unhookedSurvivors == 0 then
            local safeAntiCampPos = getFurthestAntiCampSpot(hookedPositions)
            if safeAntiCampPos and myRoot then
              local distToSafe = (myRoot.Position - safeAntiCampPos).Magnitude
              if distToSafe > 6 then
                safeSegmentedTeleport(myRoot, CFrame.new(safeAntiCampPos))
              end
              updateKillerStatus("AWAY (ANTI-CAMP)")
            else
              updateKillerStatus("IDLE")
            end
          else
            updateKillerStatus("IDLE")
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    if not farmOk and farmErr then
      warn("[Killer Farm Error]: " .. tostring(farmErr))
    end
    task.wait(delayTime)
  end
end);
(function()
  local moonwalkMobileButton = nil
  local cancelGenMobileButton = nil
  local mobileHUD = nil
  updateMobileHUDButtons = function()
    if not isMobile then
      return
    end
    if mobileFloatingButtons then
      for bindName, btn in pairs(mobileFloatingButtons) do
        pcall(function()
          btn:Destroy()
        end)
      end
      table.clear(mobileFloatingButtons)
    end
    if Settings.MobileButtons then
      for bindName, btnText in pairs(Settings.MobileButtons) do
        if btnText and btnText ~= "" and btnText ~= "None" then

        end
      end
    end
  end

function updateMobileAimbotButton()
  local enabled = Settings.RevolverAimbot.Enabled
  if enabled and isMobile then
    if not _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton or not _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton.Parent then
      if _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton then
        pcall(function()
          _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton:Destroy()
        end)
      end
      local mobileGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
      mobileGui.Name = "VD_MobileAimbotGui"
      mobileGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
      mobileGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
      pcall(function()
        mobileGui.Parent = guiParent
      end)
      if not mobileGui.Parent then
        mobileGui.Parent = billboardParent
      end
      local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
      button.Name = "AimbotButton"
      button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 75)
      button.Position = UDim2.new(0.8, -37, 0.55, -37)
      button.BackgroundColor3 = _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive and Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 255)
        or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
      button.BackgroundTransparency = _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive and 0.3 or 0.5
      button.Text = "AIM"
      button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
      button.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
      button.TextSize = 16
      button.Parent = mobileGui
      local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
      corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
      corner.Parent = button
      local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
      stroke.Thickness = 2
      stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
      stroke.Transparency = 0.3
      stroke.Parent = button
      local dragStart = nil
      local startPos = nil
      local dragging = false
      local dragInput = nil
      button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if
          input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
          or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        then
          dragStart = input.Position
          startPos = button.Position
          dragging = false
          local connection
          connection = input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
              dragStart = nil
              dragInput = nil
              if connection then
                connection:Disconnect()
              end
              if not dragging then
                _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive = not _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive
                if _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive then
                  button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 255)
                  button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
                else
                  button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                  button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
                end
              end
            end
          end)
        end
      end)
      button.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if
          input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
          or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        then
          dragInput = input
        end
      end)
      registerConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragStart then
          local delta = input.Position - dragStart
          if delta.Magnitude > 5 then
            dragging = true
          end
          button.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale,
            startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale,
            startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
          )
        end
      end))
      _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton = mobileGui
    else
      _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton.Enabled = true
      local button = _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton:FindFirstChild("AimbotButton")
      if button then
        button.BackgroundColor3 = _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive and Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 255)
          or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        button.BackgroundTransparency = _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive and 0.3 or 0.5
      end
    end
  else
    if _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton then
      _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton.Enabled = false
      _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive = false
    end
  end
end
local function sortCandidatesByPriority(candidates, priority, maxRadius)
  if not candidates or #candidates == 0 then
    return nil
  end
  maxRadius = math.max(maxRadius or 150, 1)
  if priority == "Furthest" then
    table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
      if math.abs(a.dist - b.dist) > 0.01 then
        return a.dist > b.dist
      end
      return a.health < b.health
    end)
  elseif priority == "Injured" then
    table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
      if math.abs(a.health - b.health) > 0.01 then
        return a.health < b.health
      end
      return a.dist < b.dist
    end)
  elseif priority == "Healed" then
    table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
      if math.abs(a.health - b.health) > 0.01 then
        return a.health > b.health
      end
      return a.dist < b.dist
    end)
  elseif priority == "NearestInjured" then
    table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
      local normDistA = a.dist / maxRadius
      local normDistB = b.dist / maxRadius
      local maxHpA = math.max(a.maxHealth or 100, 1)
      local maxHpB = math.max(b.maxHealth or 100, 1)
      local normHpA = math.clamp(a.health / maxHpA, 0, 1)
      local normHpB = math.clamp(b.health / maxHpB, 0, 1)
      local scoreA = 0.5 * normDistA + 0.5 * normHpA
      local scoreB = 0.5 * normDistB + 0.5 * normHpB
      if math.abs(scoreA - scoreB) > 0.001 then
        return scoreA < scoreB
      end
      return a.dist < b.dist
    end)
  elseif priority == "NearestHealed" then
    table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
      local normDistA = a.dist / maxRadius
      local normDistB = b.dist / maxRadius
      local maxHpA = math.max(a.maxHealth or 100, 1)
      local maxHpB = math.max(b.maxHealth or 100, 1)
      local normHpA = math.clamp(a.health / maxHpA, 0, 1)
      local normHpB = math.clamp(b.health / maxHpB, 0, 1)
      local scoreA = 0.5 * normDistA + 0.5 * (1 - normHpA)
      local scoreB = 0.5 * normDistB + 0.5 * (1 - normHpB)
      if math.abs(scoreA - scoreB) > 0.001 then
        return scoreA < scoreB
      end
      return a.dist < b.dist
    end)
  elseif priority == "FurthestInjured" then
    table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
      local normDistA = a.dist / maxRadius
      local normDistB = b.dist / maxRadius
      local maxHpA = math.max(a.maxHealth or 100, 1)
      local maxHpB = math.max(b.maxHealth or 100, 1)
      local normHpA = math.clamp(a.health / maxHpA, 0, 1)
      local normHpB = math.clamp(b.health / maxHpB, 0, 1)
      local scoreA = 0.5 * (1 - normDistA) + 0.5 * normHpA
      local scoreB = 0.5 * (1 - normDistB) + 0.5 * normHpB
      if math.abs(scoreA - scoreB) > 0.001 then
        return scoreA < scoreB
      end
      return a.dist > b.dist
    end)
  elseif priority == "FurthestHealed" then
    table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
      local normDistA = a.dist / maxRadius
      local normDistB = b.dist / maxRadius
      local maxHpA = math.max(a.maxHealth or 100, 1)
      local maxHpB = math.max(b.maxHealth or 100, 1)
      local normHpA = math.clamp(a.health / maxHpA, 0, 1)
      local normHpB = math.clamp(b.health / maxHpB, 0, 1)
      local scoreA = 0.5 * (1 - normDistA) + 0.5 * (1 - normHpA)
      local scoreB = 0.5 * (1 - normDistB) + 0.5 * (1 - normHpB)
      if math.abs(scoreA - scoreB) > 0.001 then
        return scoreA < scoreB
      end
      return a.dist > b.dist
    end)
  else
    table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
      if math.abs(a.dist - b.dist) > 0.01 then
        return a.dist < b.dist
      end
      return a.health < b.health
    end)
  end
  return candidates[1]
end
function getClosestPlayerToMouse()
  local cfg = Settings.RevolverAimbot or {}
  local maxDist = cfg.Radius or 150
  local priority = cfg.Priority or "Nearest"
  local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
  if not camera then
    return nil
  end
  local mousePos = (
    isMobile
    and camera
    and Vector2.new(camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
  ) or UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
  local myTeam = localPlayer.Team
  local candidates = {}
  for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if player == localPlayer then
      continue
    end
    if myTeam and player.Team == myTeam then
      continue
    end
    local char = player.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char
      and (
        char:FindFirstChild(cfg.TargetPart or "UpperTorso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      )
    if char and hum and hum.Health > 0 and root then
      local screenPos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
      if onScreen then
        local dist = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - mousePos).Magnitude
        if dist <= maxDist then
          table.insert(
            candidates,
            { root = root, dist = dist, health = hum.Health, maxHealth = math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1) }
          )
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local best = sortCandidatesByPriority(candidates, priority, maxDist)
  return best and best.root or nil
end
function updateFOVCircle()
  local enabled = Settings.RevolverAimbot
    and Settings.RevolverAimbot.Enabled
    and Settings.RevolverAimbot.ShowFOV
  local radius = Settings.RevolverAimbot and Settings.RevolverAimbot.Radius or 150
  local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
  if not camera then
    return
  end
  local center = (
    isMobile
    and camera
    and Vector2.new(camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
  ) or UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
  pcall(function()
    if not _G.VD_FovGui or not _G.VD_FovGui.Parent then
      if _G.VD_FovGui then
        pcall(function()
          _G.VD_FovGui:Destroy()
        end)
      end
      _G.VD_FovGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
      _G.VD_FovGui.Name = "VD_AimbotFOVScreenGui"
      _G.VD_FovGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
      _G.VD_FovGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
      if isMobile then
        _G.VD_FovGui.Parent = billboardParent
      else
        pcall(function()
          _G.VD_FovGui.Parent = guiParent
        end)
        if not _G.VD_FovGui.Parent then
          _G.VD_FovGui.Parent = billboardParent
        end
      end
      _G.VD_FovFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
      _G.VD_FovFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
      _G.VD_FovFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      _G.VD_FovFrame.Active = false
      _G.VD_FovFrame.Selectable = false
      _G.VD_FovFrame.Parent = _G.VD_FovGui
      local fovCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", _G.VD_FovFrame)
      fovCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
      local fovStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", _G.VD_FovFrame)
      fovStroke.Thickness = 1.5
      fovStroke.Color = UI.Accent
      fovStroke.Transparency = 0.4
    end
    if enabled then
      _G.VD_FovFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, center.X, 0, center.Y)
      _G.VD_FovFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, radius * 2, 0, radius * 2)
      _G.VD_FovGui.Enabled = true
    else
      _G.VD_FovGui.Enabled = false
    end
  end)
end
local currentCrosshairKey = ""
function updateCrosshair()
  local enabled = Settings.ShowCrosshair
    or (
      Settings.RevolverAimbot
      and Settings.RevolverAimbot.Enabled
      and Settings.RevolverAimbot.ShowCrosshair
    )
  local style = Settings.CrosshairStyle
    or (Settings.RevolverAimbot and Settings.RevolverAimbot.CrosshairStyle)
    or "Classic"
  local color = Settings.CrosshairColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)
  local baseSize = Settings.CrosshairSize or 10
  local scale = baseSize / 10
  local configKey = tostring(enabled)
    .. "_"
    .. tostring(style)
    .. "_"
    .. tostring(color:ToHex())
    .. "_"
    .. tostring(baseSize)
  if configKey == currentCrosshairKey and _G.VD_CrosshairGui and _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Parent then
    return
  end
  currentCrosshairKey = configKey
  pcall(function()
    if _G.VD_CrosshairGui then
      pcall(function()
        _G.VD_CrosshairGui:Destroy()
      end)
      _G.VD_CrosshairGui = nil
    end
    if not enabled then
      return
    end
    _G.VD_CrosshairGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Name = "VD_CrosshairScreenGui"
    _G.VD_CrosshairGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    _G.VD_CrosshairGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    if isMobile then
      _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Parent = billboardParent
    else
      pcall(function()
        _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Parent = guiParent
      end)
      if not _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Parent then
        _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Parent = billboardParent
      end
    end
    local centerContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
    centerContainer.Name = "CenterContainer"
    centerContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    centerContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    centerContainer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    centerContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    centerContainer.Parent = _G.VD_CrosshairGui
    local showDot = (style == "Tactical" or style == "Dot" or style == "Dot & Circle")
    local showCircle = (style == "Tactical" or style == "Circle" or style == "Dot & Circle")
    local showTicks = (style == "Tactical" or style == "Classic")
    if showDot then
      local dotRadius = math.max(2, math.round(3 * scale))
      _G.VD_CenterDot = Instance.new("Frame")
      _G.VD_CenterDot.Name = "CenterDot"
      _G.VD_CenterDot.Size = UDim2.new(0, dotRadius, 0, dotRadius)
      _G.VD_CenterDot.Position = UDim2.new(0, -dotRadius / 2, 0, -dotRadius / 2)
      _G.VD_CenterDot.BackgroundColor3 = color
      _G.VD_CenterDot.BorderSizePixel = 0
      _G.VD_CenterDot.Parent = centerContainer
      local dotCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", _G.VD_CenterDot)
      dotCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
      local dotStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", _G.VD_CenterDot)
      dotStroke.Thickness = 1
      dotStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    end
    if showCircle then
      local rawCircleSize = (style == "Circle") and 12 or 14
      local circleSize = math.max(6, math.round(rawCircleSize * scale))
      local shadowSize = circleSize + 2
      local gapCircle = Instance.new("Frame")
      gapCircle.Name = "GapCircle"
      gapCircle.Size = UDim2.new(0, circleSize, 0, circleSize)
      gapCircle.Position = UDim2.new(0, -circleSize / 2, 0, -circleSize / 2)
      gapCircle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      gapCircle.Parent = centerContainer
      local circleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", gapCircle)
      circleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
      local circleStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", gapCircle)
      circleStroke.Thickness = math.max(1, 1.2 * scale)
      circleStroke.Color = color
      local shadowCircle = Instance.new("Frame")
      shadowCircle.Name = "ShadowCircle"
      shadowCircle.Size = UDim2.new(0, shadowSize, 0, shadowSize)
      shadowCircle.Position = UDim2.new(0, -shadowSize / 2, 0, -shadowSize / 2)
      shadowCircle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      shadowCircle.Parent = centerContainer
      local shadowCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", shadowCircle)
      shadowCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
      local shadowStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", shadowCircle)
      shadowStroke.Thickness = 1
      shadowStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
      shadowStroke.Transparency = 0.5
    end
    if showTicks then
      local thickness = math.max(1, math.round(1.5 * scale))
      local halfThick = thickness / 2
      local linesData = {}
      if style == "Tactical" then
        local length = math.max(2, math.round(4 * scale))
        local gap = math.max(4, math.round(9 * scale))
        linesData = {
          { Size = UDim2.new(0, thickness, 0, length), Position = UDim2.new(
            0,
            -halfThick,
            0,
            -(gap + length)
          ) },
          { Size = UDim2.new(0, thickness, 0, length), Position = UDim2.new(0, -halfThick, 0, gap) },
          { Size = UDim2.new(0, length, 0, thickness), Position = UDim2.new(
            0,
            -(gap + length),
            0,
            -halfThick
          ) },
          { Size = UDim2.new(0, length, 0, thickness), Position = UDim2.new(0, gap, 0, -halfThick) },
        }
      else
        local length = math.max(3, math.round(8 * scale))
        local gap = math.max(1, math.round(2 * scale))
        linesData = {
          { Size = UDim2.new(0, thickness, 0, length), Position = UDim2.new(
            0,
            -halfThick,
            0,
            -(gap + length)
          ) },
          { Size = UDim2.new(0, thickness, 0, length), Position = UDim2.new(0, -halfThick, 0, gap) },
          { Size = UDim2.new(0, length, 0, thickness), Position = UDim2.new(
            0,
            -(gap + length),
            0,
            -halfThick
          ) },
          { Size = UDim2.new(0, length, 0, thickness), Position = UDim2.new(0, gap, 0, -halfThick) },
        }
      end
      for _, data in ipairs(linesData) do
        local line = Instance.new("Frame")
        line.Size = data.Size
        line.Position = data.Position
        line.BackgroundColor3 = color
        line.BorderSizePixel = 0
        line.Parent = centerContainer
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", line)
        stroke.Thickness = 1
        stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
      end
    end
    _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Enabled = true
  end)
end
task.spawn(function()
  task.wait(0.1)
  pcall(updateCrosshair)
end)
function runAimbot()
  local aimbotEnabled = Settings.RevolverAimbot.Enabled
  if not aimbotEnabled then
    updateFOVCircle()
    if isMobile then
      updateMobileAimbotButton()
    end
    _G.VD_AimbotTarget = nil
    return
  end
  updateFOVCircle()
  if isMobile then
    updateMobileAimbotButton()
  end
  local isPressed = false
  if isMobile then
    isPressed = _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive
  else
    local keyName = Settings.RevolverAimbot.Key or "MouseButton2"
    if keyName == "MouseButton2" then
      isPressed = UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2)
    elseif keyName == "MouseButton1" then
      isPressed = UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
    else
      pcall(function()
        isPressed = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode[keyName])
      end)
    end
  end
  if isPressed then
    if
      not _G.VD_AimbotTarget
      or not _G.VD_AimbotTarget.Parent
      or not _G.VD_AimbotTarget.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      or _G.VD_AimbotTarget.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health <= 0
    then
      _G.VD_AimbotTarget = getClosestPlayerToMouse()
    end
    if _G.VD_AimbotTarget then
      local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
      if camera then
        local targetPos = _G.VD_AimbotTarget.Position
        if Settings.RevolverAimbot.PredictionEnabled then
          local targetChar = _G.VD_AimbotTarget.Parent
          local targetRoot = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if targetRoot then
            local distance = (camera.CFrame.Position - targetPos).Magnitude
            local velocity = Settings.RevolverAimbot.BulletVelocity or 800
            local travelTime = distance / velocity
            local targetVelocity = targetRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            targetPos = targetPos + (targetVelocity * travelTime)
          end
        end
        targetPos = targetPos
          + camera.CFrame.RightVector * ((Settings.RevolverAimbot.OffsetX or 0) / 10)
          + camera.CFrame.UpVector * ((Settings.RevolverAimbot.OffsetY or 0) / 10)
        pcall(function()
          local character = localPlayer.Character
          local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if rootPart then
            local targetPos2D = Vector3.new(targetPos.X, rootPart.Position.Y, targetPos.Z)
            rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(rootPart.Position, targetPos2D)
          end
        end)
        local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(camera.CFrame.Position, targetPos)
        local smoothness = Settings.RevolverAimbot.Smoothness or 0.15
        if smoothness <= 0 then
          camera.CFrame = targetCFrame
        else
          camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame:Lerp(targetCFrame, smoothness)
        end
      end
    end
  else
    _G.VD_AimbotTarget = nil
  end
end
RunService:BindToRenderStep("VD_Aimbot", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, runAimbot)
do
  local lastCustomFireTime = 0
  local isCustomAimActive = false
  local activeAimAnimTrack = nil
  local function isLocalPlayerSurvivor()
    if localPlayer.Team then
      local tName = localPlayer.Team.Name:lower()
      if tName:find("killer") or tName:find("slasher") or tName:find("monster") then
        return false
      end
      if tName:find("surv") then
        return true
      end
    end
    local role = localPlayer:GetAttribute("Role")
      or (localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:GetAttribute("Role"))
    if
      role == "Killer"
      or localPlayer:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true
      or (localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true)
    then
      return false
    end
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    if char and char.Parent then
      local pName = char.Parent.Name:lower()
      if pName:find("killer") then
        return false
      end
      if pName:find("surv") then
        return true
      end
    end
    if role == "Survivor" then
      return true
    end
    if char then
      local cName = char.Name:lower()
      if
        cName:find("veil")
        or cName:find("myers")
        or cName:find("stalker")
        or cName:find("killer")
        or cName:find("abyss")
      then
        return false
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  local function getEquippedToFGun()
    if not isLocalPlayerSurvivor() then
      return nil
    end
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    if char then
      for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Tool") or child:IsA("Model") then
          local n = child.Name:lower()
          if
            n:find("twist")
            or n:find("fate")
            or n:find("revolver")
            or n:find("gun")
            or child:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
            or child:FindFirstChild("gun", true)
          then
            return child
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local bp = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    if bp then
      for _, child in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Tool") or child:IsA("Model") then
          local n = child.Name:lower()
          if
            n:find("twist")
            or n:find("fate")
            or n:find("revolver")
            or n:find("gun")
            or child:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
            or child:FindFirstChild("gun", true)
          then
            return child
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function getToFWeaponItem(tool)
    if not tool then
      return nil
    end
    for _, desc in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
      if
        desc:IsA("LuaSourceContainer")
        and (desc.Name:lower() == "gun" or desc.Name:lower():find("twist"))
      then
        if desc.Parent and desc.Parent ~= tool and desc.Parent.Name ~= "Right Arm" then
          return desc.Parent
        end
      end
    end
    local rightArm = tool:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
    if rightArm then
      for _, child in ipairs(rightArm:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Model") then
          return child
        end
      end
      for _, child in ipairs(rightArm:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("BasePart") and child.Name ~= "Right Arm" then
          return child
        end
      end
    end
    for _, child in ipairs(tool:GetChildren()) do
      if child:IsA("Model") and child.Name ~= "Right Arm" then
        return child
      end
    end
    local anyGun = tool:FindFirstChild("gun", true)
    if anyGun and not anyGun:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
      return anyGun
    elseif anyGun and anyGun:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") and anyGun.Parent then
      return anyGun.Parent
    end
    return tool:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart") or tool
  end
  local function getToFFireRemote()
    local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    local items = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Items")
    if items then
      local tof = items:FindFirstChild("Twist of Fate") or items:FindFirstChild("Revolver")
      local fire = tof and tof:FindFirstChild("Fire")
      if fire then
        return fire
      end
      for _, item in ipairs(items:GetChildren()) do
        local iname = item.Name:lower()
        if iname:find("twist") or iname:find("fate") or iname:find("revolver") then
          local f = item:FindFirstChild("Fire")
          if f then
            return f
          end
        end
      end
    end
    for _, desc in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
      if desc.Name == "Fire" and desc.Parent then
        local pName = desc.Parent.Name:lower()
        if pName:find("twist") or pName:find("fate") or pName:find("revolver") then
          return desc
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function playShootFeedback(item)
    pcall(function()
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if hum then
        local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
        anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://124735239320776"
        local track = hum:LoadAnimation(anim)
        track:Play()
      end
      if item then
        local shootSound = item:FindFirstChild("shoot", true)
        if shootSound and shootSound:IsA("Sound") then
          shootSound:Play()
        end
      end
    end)
  end
  local function startAimingVisuals()
    pcall(function()
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if hum and not activeAimAnimTrack then
        local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
        anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://75029269564639"
        activeAimAnimTrack = hum:LoadAnimation(anim)
        activeAimAnimTrack:Play()
      end
      if char then
        char:SetAttribute("Aiming", true)
      end
      local tool = getEquippedToFGun()
      local item = getToFWeaponItem(tool)
      local equipSound = item and item:FindFirstChild("equip", true)
      if equipSound and equipSound:IsA("Sound") then
        equipSound:Play()
      end
    end)
  end
  local function stopAimingVisuals()
    pcall(function()
      if activeAimAnimTrack then
        activeAimAnimTrack:Stop()
        activeAimAnimTrack = nil
      end
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      if char then
        char:SetAttribute("Aiming", false)
      end
    end)
  end
  local function forceFireToFWeapon()
    if
      not (
        Settings.BypassToFRestrictions
        and isPremiumActive("BypassToFRestrictions")
        and localHooksTable
        and localHooksTable.BypassToFRestrictions
      )
    then
      return
    end
    if not isLocalPlayerSurvivor() then
      return
    end
    if not isCustomAimActive then
      return
    end
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
      return
    end
    local tool = getEquippedToFGun()
    if not tool then
      return
    end
    local itemInstance = getToFWeaponItem(tool)
    if not itemInstance then
      return
    end
    local now = tick()
    if (now - lastCustomFireTime) < 0.35 then
      return
    end
    lastCustomFireTime = now
    local fireRemote = getToFFireRemote()
    if not fireRemote then
      return
    end
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local dir = cam and cam.CFrame.LookVector or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
    if Settings.RevolverSilentAim and Settings.RevolverSilentAim.Enabled and isPremiumActive() then
      pcall(function()
        local targetChar = nil
        local bestDist = math.huge
        local fovRad = Settings.RevolverSilentAim.FOVRadius or 200
        local vpCenter = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
        for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
          if pl ~= localPlayer and pl.Character then
            local pChar = pl.Character
            local pHum = pChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local pRoot = pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
              or pChar:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
              or pChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if pHum and pHum.Health > 0 and pRoot then
              local isK = (
                pl:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer"
                or pl:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true
                or pChar:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer"
                or pChar:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true
              )
              local targetMode = Settings.RevolverSilentAim.Target or "Both Teams"
              local valid = false
              if targetMode == "Both Teams" then
                valid = true
              elseif targetMode == "Killer" and isK then
                valid = true
              elseif targetMode == "Survivors" and not isK then
                valid = true
              end
              if valid then
                local sPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(pRoot.Position)
                if onScreen or sPos.Z > 0 then
                  local dist = (Vector2.new(sPos.X, sPos.Y) - vpCenter).Magnitude
                  if dist <= fovRad and dist < bestDist then
                    bestDist = dist
                    targetChar = pChar
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
        if targetChar then
          local hitPart = targetChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
            or targetChar:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
            or targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if hitPart then
            local startPos = cam.CFrame.Position
            dir = (hitPart.Position - startPos).Unit
          end
        end
      end)
    end
    pcall(function()
      local directionArg = (vector and vector.create or Vector3.new)(dir.X, dir.Y, dir.Z)
      fireRemote:FireServer(itemInstance, directionArg)
      playShootFeedback(itemInstance)
    end)
  end
  local mobileWeaponGui = nil
  local mobileAimBtn = nil
  local mobileFireBtn = nil
  local lastNativeAimInstance = nil
  local wasAimCancelled = false
  local function hookNativeMobileAimControls()
    if not isMobile then
      return false
    end
    local playerGui = localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if not playerGui then
      return false
    end
    local survivorMob = playerGui:FindFirstChild("Survivor-mob")
      or playerGui:FindFirstChild("SurvivorMob")
    if not survivorMob then
      for _, child in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
        if
          child:IsA("ScreenGui")
          and (child.Name:lower():find("survivor") or child.Name:lower():find("mob"))
        then
          survivorMob = child
          break
        end
      end
    end
    if not survivorMob then
      return false
    end
    local controls = survivorMob:FindFirstChild("Controls", true)
    local guiMob = controls and controls:FindFirstChild("Gui-mob", true)
    if not guiMob then
      guiMob = survivorMob:FindFirstChild("Gui-mob", true)
    end
    local icon = guiMob and guiMob:FindFirstChild("icon", true)
    local cancelaim = (guiMob and guiMob:FindFirstChild("cancelaim", true))
      or survivorMob:FindFirstChild("cancelaim", true)
    local targetAim = icon or guiMob
    if not targetAim then
      return false
    end
    if lastNativeAimInstance == targetAim then
      return true
    end
    lastNativeAimInstance = targetAim
    pcall(function()
      if targetAim:IsA("GuiObject") then
        targetAim.Active = true
      end
      if targetAim.Parent and targetAim.Parent:IsA("GuiObject") then
        targetAim.Parent.Active = true
      end
    end)
    local function bindAimTouch(obj)
      if not obj or not obj:IsA("GuiObject") then
        return
      end
      obj.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if
          input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
          or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        then
          if not isLocalPlayerSurvivor() then
            return
          end
          if
            not (
              Settings.BypassToFRestrictions
              and isPremiumActive("BypassToFRestrictions")
              and localHooksTable
              and localHooksTable.BypassToFRestrictions
            )
          then
            return
          end
          local tool = getEquippedToFGun()
          if not tool then
            return
          end
          wasAimCancelled = false
          isCustomAimActive = true
          startAimingVisuals()
          if cancelaim then
            pcall(function()
              cancelaim.Visible = true
            end)
          end
          local moveConn
          moveConn = input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Change then
              if cancelaim and cancelaim.Visible then
                local cPos = cancelaim.AbsolutePosition
                local cSize = cancelaim.AbsoluteSize
                local pX, pY = input.Position.X, input.Position.Y
                if
                  pX >= cPos.X
                  and pX <= (cPos.X + cSize.X)
                  and pY >= cPos.Y
                  and pY <= (cPos.Y + cSize.Y)
                then
                  if not wasAimCancelled then
                    wasAimCancelled = true
                    isCustomAimActive = false
                    stopAimingVisuals()
                  end
                end
              end
            elseif input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
              if moveConn then
                moveConn:Disconnect()
              end
              if wasAimCancelled then
                wasAimCancelled = false
                isCustomAimActive = false
                stopAimingVisuals()
              else
                if isCustomAimActive then
                  forceFireToFWeapon()
                end
                isCustomAimActive = false
                stopAimingVisuals()
              end
            end
          end)
        end
      end)
    end
    bindAimTouch(targetAim)
    if
      targetAim.Parent
      and targetAim.Parent:IsA("GuiObject")
      and targetAim.Parent ~= controls
      and targetAim.Parent ~= survivorMob
    then
      bindAimTouch(targetAim.Parent)
    end
    if cancelaim and cancelaim:IsA("GuiObject") then
      pcall(function()
        cancelaim.Active = true
      end)
      cancelaim.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if
          input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
          or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        then
          wasAimCancelled = true
          isCustomAimActive = false
          stopAimingVisuals()
        end
      end)
      if cancelaim:IsA("GuiButton") then
        cancelaim.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
          wasAimCancelled = true
          isCustomAimActive = false
          stopAimingVisuals()
        end)
        cancelaim.Activated:Connect(function()
          wasAimCancelled = true
          isCustomAimActive = false
          stopAimingVisuals()
        end)
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  local function updateMobileWeaponControls()
    if not isMobile then
      return
    end
    local tool = getEquippedToFGun()
    local shouldShow = tool
      and Settings.BypassToFRestrictions
      and isPremiumActive("BypassToFRestrictions")
      and localHooksTable
      and localHooksTable.BypassToFRestrictions
      and isLocalPlayerSurvivor()
    if not shouldShow then
      if mobileWeaponGui and mobileWeaponGui.Parent then
        mobileWeaponGui.Enabled = false
      end
      if isCustomAimActive then
        isCustomAimActive = false
        stopAimingVisuals()
      end
      return
    end
    local nativeHooked = false
    pcall(function()
      nativeHooked = hookNativeMobileAimControls()
    end)
    if nativeHooked or (lastNativeAimInstance and lastNativeAimInstance.Parent) then
      if mobileWeaponGui and mobileWeaponGui.Parent then
        mobileWeaponGui.Enabled = false
      end
      return
    end
    local parentContainer = guiParent
      or (localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui"))
    if not parentContainer then
      return
    end
    if not mobileWeaponGui or not mobileWeaponGui.Parent then
      mobileWeaponGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
      mobileWeaponGui.Name = "VD_MobileWeaponHUD"
      mobileWeaponGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
      mobileWeaponGui.DisplayOrder = 99996
      pcall(function()
        mobileWeaponGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
      end)
      mobileWeaponGui.Parent = parentContainer
      mobileAimBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
      mobileAimBtn.Name = "MobileAimButton"
      mobileAimBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 56, 0, 56)
      mobileAimBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -145, 1, -190)
      mobileAimBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 22, 30)
      mobileAimBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
      mobileAimBtn.Text = "AIM"
      mobileAimBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 220)
      mobileAimBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
      mobileAimBtn.TextSize = 13
      mobileAimBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
      mobileAimBtn.Parent = mobileWeaponGui
      Instance.new("UICorner", mobileAimBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
      local aimStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", mobileAimBtn)
      aimStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
      aimStroke.Thickness = 1.2
      mobileFireBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
      mobileFireBtn.Name = "MobileFireButton"
      mobileFireBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 64, 0, 64)
      mobileFireBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -80, 1, -195)
      mobileFireBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 18, 20)
      mobileFireBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
      mobileFireBtn.Text = "FIRE"
      mobileFireBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
      mobileFireBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
      mobileFireBtn.TextSize = 14
      mobileFireBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
      mobileFireBtn.Parent = mobileWeaponGui
      Instance.new("UICorner", mobileFireBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
      local fireStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", mobileFireBtn)
      fireStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
      fireStroke.Thickness = 1.2
      local function makeDraggable(btn)
        local isDragging = false
        local dragStart, startPos = nil, nil
        btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
          if
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
          then
            isDragging = false
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = btn.Position
            local conn
            conn = input.Changed:Connect(function()
              if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                if conn then
                  conn:Disconnect()
                end
              end
            end)
          end
        end)
        btn.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
          if
            (
              input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
              or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            ) and dragStart
          then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            if delta.Magnitude > 8 then
              isDragging = true
              btn.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale,
                startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale,
                startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
              )
            end
          end
        end)
        return function()
          return isDragging
        end
      end
      local isAimDragging = makeDraggable(mobileAimBtn)
      local isFireDragging = makeDraggable(mobileFireBtn)
      mobileAimBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if isAimDragging() then
          return
        end
        isCustomAimActive = not isCustomAimActive
        if isCustomAimActive then
          startAimingVisuals()

          fireStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
        end
      end)

            :Create(mobileFireBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.08), { Size = UDim2.new(0, 58, 0, 58) })

              TweenService
                :Create(mobileFireBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.08), { Size = UDim2.new(0, 64, 0, 64) })
                :Play()

          end)
        else

        end
      end)
    end
    mobileWeaponGui.Enabled = true
  end

    if not isLocalPlayerSurvivor() then
      return
    end
    if
      not (
        Settings.BypassToFRestrictions
        and isPremiumActive("BypassToFRestrictions")
        and localHooksTable
        and localHooksTable.BypassToFRestrictions
      )
    then
      return
    end

    if not tool then

    end

      input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
      or (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1
        and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2
      )
    then
      if isCustomAimActive then
        forceFireToFWeapon()
      end

      input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
      or (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1
        and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL2
      )
    then
      isCustomAimActive = true
      startAimingVisuals()
    end
  end))
  registerConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if not isLocalPlayerSurvivor() then
      if isCustomAimActive then
        isCustomAimActive = false
        stopAimingVisuals()
      end
      return
    end
    if
      input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
      or (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1
        and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL2
      )
    then
      isCustomAimActive = false
      stopAimingVisuals()
    end
  end))

    if isMobile then
      pcall(updateMobileWeaponControls)
    end

      if isCustomAimActive then
        isCustomAimActive = false
        stopAimingVisuals()

      return

      if isCustomAimActive then
        isCustomAimActive = false
        stopAimingVisuals()
      end
      return
    end

    local char = localPlayer.Character
    if not cam or not char then
      return
    end

      local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        local pos = hrp.Position
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos, pos + (Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z).Unit * 900))
      end
    end
  end))

(function()
  local aimAssistTarget = nil

  local function isAimAssistTargetKiller(p)
    if not p then
      return false
    end
    if p:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or p:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true then
      return true
    end
    local char = p.Character
    if char then
      if
        char:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer"
        or char:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true
        or char:GetAttribute("Killer") == true
      then
        return true
      end
      if
        char.Name == "Veil"
        or char:FindFirstChild("StunEvent")
        or char:FindFirstChild("Machete")
        or char:FindFirstChild("Knife")
        or char:FindFirstChild("Weapon")
      then
        return true
      end
      local pParent = char.Parent
      if pParent and (pParent.Name == "Killers" or pParent.Name:lower():find("killer")) then
        return true
      end
    end
    local t = p.Team
    if t then
      local tn = t.Name:lower()
      if tn:find("killer") or tn:find("slasher") or tn:find("monster") then
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local function isAimAssistTargetValid(target)
    if not target or not target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
      return false
    end
    local char = target.Parent
    if not char or not char:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
      return false
    end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
      return false
    end
    return true
  end
  function getAimAssistClosestTarget()
    local cfg = Settings.AimAssist or {}
    local maxRadius = cfg.FOV or 150
    local targetPartName = cfg.TargetPart or "UpperTorso"
    local filter = cfg.TargetTeam or "Both"
    local priority = cfg.Priority or "Nearest"
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then
      return nil
    end
    local mousePos = (
      isMobile
      and camera
      and Vector2.new(camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    ) or UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local candidates = {}
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if player == localPlayer then
        continue
      end
      local isK = isAimAssistTargetKiller(player)
      if filter == "Survivors" and isK then
        continue
      end
      if filter == "Killer" and not isK then
        continue
      end
      local char = player.Character
      if not char or not char:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
        continue
      end
      local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local part = char:FindFirstChild(targetPartName)
        or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or char:FindFirstChild("Head")
      if hum and hum.Health > 0 and part and part:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
        local screenPos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        if onScreen and screenPos.Z > 0 then
          local dist = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - mousePos).Magnitude
          if dist <= maxRadius then
            table.insert(
              candidates,
              { part = part, dist = dist, health = hum.Health, maxHealth = math.max(
                hum.MaxHealth,
                1
              ) }
            )
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local best = sortCandidatesByPriority(candidates, priority, maxRadius)
    return best and best.part or nil
  end

        isPressed = isMobileAimAssistActive
      elseif cfg.Mode == "Toggle" then
        isPressed = aimAssistToggleState
      else
        local keyName = cfg.Key or "MouseButton2"
        if keyName == "MouseButton2" then
          isPressed = UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2)
        elseif keyName == "MouseButton1" then
          isPressed = UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
        else
          pcall(function()
            if keyName:find("Button") or keyName:find("DPad") then
              isPressed = UserInputService:IsGamepadButtonDown(
                Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1,
                Enum.KeyCode[keyName]
              )
            else
              isPressed = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode[keyName])
            end
          end)
        end
      end
      if isPressed then
        if not isAimAssistTargetValid(aimAssistTarget) then
          aimAssistTarget = getAimAssistClosestTarget()
        end
        if isAimAssistTargetValid(aimAssistTarget) then
          local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
          if camera then
            local targetPos = aimAssistTarget.Position
            if cfg.Prediction then
              local targetChar = aimAssistTarget.Parent
              local targetRoot = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
              if targetRoot then
                local dist = (camera.CFrame.Position - targetPos).Magnitude
                local travelTime = dist / 1000
                targetPos = targetPos + (targetRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity * travelTime)
              end
            end
            local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(camera.CFrame.Position, targetPos)
            local smoothness = cfg.Smoothness or 0.2
            if smoothness >= 0.95 then
              camera.CFrame = targetCFrame
            else
              camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame:Lerp(targetCFrame, smoothness)
            end
          end
        else
          aimAssistTarget = nil
        end
      else
        aimAssistTarget = nil
      end
    end)
  end
  local function ensureAimAssistBound()

      RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("VD_AimAssist")
    end)
    pcall(function()
      RunService:BindToRenderStep(
        "VD_AimAssist",
        Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2,
        runAimAssist
      )
    end)
  end
  _G.VD_EnsureAimAssistBound = ensureAimAssistBound
  ensureAimAssistBound()

local spearAimbotTarget = nil
local targetVelocityTracker = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
function getSmoothedVelocity(player, rawVelocity, rootPart)
  local lastData = targetVelocityTracker[player]
  local now = tick()
  local posVel = rawVelocity
  if rootPart and typeof(rootPart) == "Instance" and rootPart:IsA("BasePart") then
    if
      lastData
      and lastData.lastPos
      and (now - lastData.time) > 0.001
      and (now - lastData.time) < 0.5
    then
      local dt = now - lastData.time
      posVel = (rootPart.Position - lastData.lastPos) / dt
    end
  end
  if rawVelocity.Magnitude < 0.5 and posVel.Magnitude < 0.5 then
    if not lastData then
      lastData = {}
      targetVelocityTracker[player] = lastData
    end
    lastData.velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    lastData.time = now
    lastData.lastPos = (rootPart and typeof(rootPart) == "Instance" and rootPart:IsA("BasePart"))
        and rootPart.Position
      or nil
    return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
  end
  if posVel.Magnitude > 60 then
    posVel = rawVelocity
  end
  if rawVelocity.Magnitude > 60 then
    rawVelocity = posVel.Magnitude <= 60 and posVel or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
  end
  local blendedVel = rawVelocity:Lerp(posVel, 0.5)
  if blendedVel.Magnitude > 40 then
    blendedVel = blendedVel.Unit * 40
  end
  if not lastData or (now - lastData.time > 0.5) then
    if not lastData then
      lastData = {}
      targetVelocityTracker[player] = lastData
    end
    lastData.velocity = blendedVel
    lastData.time = now
    lastData.lastPos = (rootPart and typeof(rootPart) == "Instance" and rootPart:IsA("BasePart"))
        and rootPart.Position
      or nil
    return blendedVel
  end
  if lastData.velocity and lastData.velocity.Magnitude > 1.5 and blendedVel.Magnitude > 1.5 then
    local dot = lastData.velocity.Unit:Dot(blendedVel.Unit)
    if dot < 0.25 then
      lastData.velocity = blendedVel
      lastData.time = now
      lastData.lastPos = (rootPart and typeof(rootPart) == "Instance" and rootPart:IsA("BasePart"))
          and rootPart.Position
        or nil
      return blendedVel
    end
  end
  local alpha = 0.45
  local smoothed = lastData.velocity:Lerp(blendedVel, alpha)
  if smoothed.Magnitude < 0.2 then
    smoothed = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
  elseif smoothed.Magnitude > 32 then
    smoothed = smoothed.Unit * 32
  end
  lastData.velocity = smoothed
  lastData.time = now
  lastData.lastPos = (rootPart and typeof(rootPart) == "Instance" and rootPart:IsA("BasePart"))
      and rootPart.Position
    or nil
  return smoothed
end
local function getOneWayPing()
  local ok, ping = pcall(function()
    return cachedOneWayPing and (cachedOneWayPing * 2) or 0.07
  end)
  if ok and type(ping) == "number" and ping > 0 then
    return math.clamp(ping * 0.5, 0, 0.25)
  end
  return 0.035
end
function solveProjectileAim(startPos, targetPos, targetVelocity, targetAcceleration, speed, gravity)
  local projSpeed = (speed and speed > 50) and speed or 150
  local grav = (gravity and gravity > 0) and gravity or 98
  local leadVel = targetVelocity or Vector3.zero
  local flatVel = Vector3.new(leadVel.X, 0, leadVel.Z)
  local vertVel = math.clamp(leadVel.Y, -4.0, 1.5)
  local effectiveVel = Vector3.new(flatVel.X, vertVel, flatVel.Z)
  local ping = getOneWayPing()
  local distInitial = (targetPos - startPos).Magnitude
  local t = distInitial / projSpeed
  local predictedPos = targetPos
  for i = 1, 4 do
    local totalTime = t + ping
    local curLead = effectiveVel * totalTime
    local maxLead = 32 * totalTime
    if curLead.Magnitude > maxLead then
      curLead = curLead.Unit * maxLead
    end
    predictedPos = targetPos
      + curLead
      + 0.5 * (targetAcceleration or Vector3.zero) * (totalTime ^ 2)
    local D = predictedPos - startPos
    local x = Vector3.new(D.X, 0, D.Z).Magnitude
    local y = D.Y
    if grav == 0 then
      t = D.Magnitude / projSpeed
    else
      local a = 0.25 * (grav ^ 2)
      local b = y * grav - (projSpeed ^ 2)
      local c = x ^ 2 + y ^ 2
      local delta = b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c
      if delta >= 0 then
        local u1 = (-b - math.sqrt(delta)) / (2 * a)
        local u2 = (-b + math.sqrt(delta)) / (2 * a)
        local u = -1
        if u1 > 0 and u2 > 0 then
          u = math.min(u1, u2)
        elseif u1 > 0 then
          u = u1
        elseif u2 > 0 then
          u = u2
        end
        if u > 0 then
          t = math.sqrt(u)
        else
          t = D.Magnitude / projSpeed
        end
      else
        t = D.Magnitude / projSpeed
        break
      end
    end
  end
  local D = predictedPos - startPos
  local G = Vector3.new(0, -grav, 0)
  local throwVelocity = (D - 0.5 * G * (t ^ 2)) / t
  return throwVelocity.Unit, predictedPos
end
_G.VD_SolveProjectileAim = solveProjectileAim
_G.VD_GetSmoothedVelocity = getSmoothedVelocity
task.spawn(function()
  registerConnection(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if
      not (Settings.SpearAimbot and Settings.SpearAimbot.Enabled)
      and not (Settings.RevolverSilentAim and Settings.RevolverSilentAim.Enabled)
      and not (Settings.SpearSilentAim and Settings.SpearSilentAim.Enabled)
    then
      return
    end
    pcall(function()
      for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= localPlayer and p.Character then
          local root = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if root then
            local rawVel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity or root.Velocity or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            getSmoothedVelocity(p, rawVel, root)
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end))
end)
local function runSpearAimbot()
  if
    not (Settings.SpearAimbot and Settings.SpearAimbot.Enabled and isPremiumActive("SpearAimbot"))
  then
    spearAimbotTarget = nil
    return
  end
  if localHooksTable and type(localHooksTable.RunSpearAimbot) == "function" then
    localHooksTable.RunSpearAimbot({
      char = localPlayer.Character,
      localPlayer = localPlayer,
      camera = workspace.CurrentCamera,
      isMobile = isMobile,
      UserInputService = UserInputService,
      Players = Players,
      Settings = Settings,
      spearChargeStart = _G.VD_SpearChargeStart,
      specialSpearSpeed = _G.VD_SpecialSpearSpeed,
      normalSpearSpeed = _G.VD_NormalSpearSpeed,
      specialSpearGravity = _G.VD_SpecialSpearGravity,
      normalSpearGravity = _G.VD_NormalSpearGravity,
      sortCandidatesByPriority = sortCandidatesByPriority,
      getSmoothedVelocity = getSmoothedVelocity,
      solveProjectileAim = solveProjectileAim,
      getTarget = function()
        return spearAimbotTarget
      end,
      setTarget = function(t)
        spearAimbotTarget = t
      end,
    })
  else
    spearAimbotTarget = nil
  end
end
RunService:BindToRenderStep("VD_SpearAimbot", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, runSpearAimbot);
(function()
  local scriptStartTime = os.clock()
  local executionURL = "/api/log"
  local function sendExecutionMessage()
    local embed = {
      title = "🚀 Violence District Script Executed!",
      color = 32767,
      fields = {
        {
          name = "Username",
          value = string.format("%s (@%s)", localPlayer.DisplayName, localPlayer.Name),
          inline = true,
        },
        { name = "User ID", value = tostring(localPlayer.UserId), inline = true },
        { name = "Executor", value = detectExecutor(), inline = true },
        { name = "Execution Time", value = os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), inline = false },
      },
      footer = { text = "6locc Scripts • Violence District v1.7.1" },
      timestamp = os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
    }
    local payload = httpService:JSONEncode({ embeds = { embed } })
    makeRequest(executionURL, "POST", payload)
  end
  local playtimeURL = "/api/log"
  local function sendPlaytimeMessage(minutes)
    local playtimeText = minutes .. " minute" .. (minutes == 1 and "" or "s")
    local embed = {
      title = "⏱️ Violence District Playtime Tracker",
      color = 65280,
      fields = {
        {
          name = "Username",
          value = string.format("%s (@%s)", localPlayer.DisplayName, localPlayer.Name),
          inline = true,
        },
        { name = "User ID", value = tostring(localPlayer.UserId), inline = true },
        { name = "Executor", value = detectExecutor(), inline = true },
        { name = "Execution Time", value = os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), inline = false },
        { name = "Playtime", value = playtimeText, inline = false },
      },
      footer = { text = "6locc Scripts • Violence District v1.7.1" },
      timestamp = os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
    }
    local payload = httpService:JSONEncode({ embeds = { embed } })
    makeRequest(playtimeURL, "POST", payload)
  end
  task.spawn(function()
    sendExecutionMessage()
    sendPlaytimeMessage(0)
    while activeLoop do
      task.wait(300)
      local minutes = math.floor((os.clock() - scriptStartTime) / 60)
      sendPlaytimeMessage(minutes)
    end
  end)
  local suggestionURL = "/api/log"
  local suggestionNonsenseCount = {}
  local suggestionBanned = {}
  local function containsLink(text)
    local lower = text:lower()
    return lower:find("https?://") ~= nil
      or lower:find("www%.") ~= nil
      or lower:find(".com") ~= nil
      or lower:find(".net") ~= nil
      or lower:find(".gg") ~= nil
      or lower:find(".io") ~= nil
      or lower:find(".xyz") ~= nil
      or lower:find("discord") ~= nil
  end
  local function isNonsense(text)
    local trimmed = text:gsub("%s+", "")
    if trimmed:match("^%d+$") then
      return true
    end
    if not text:find("%s") and trimmed:match("^[a-z0-9]+$") and #trimmed <= 20 then
      return true
    end
    if not text:find("%s") and #trimmed <= 15 then
      return true
    end
    return false
  end
  function sendSuggestionMessage(suggestion)
    local uid = tostring(localPlayer.UserId)
    if suggestionBanned[uid] then
      showNotification(
        "Suggestion Blocked",
        "You have been blocked from sending suggestions.",
        "error"
      )
      return
    end
    if containsLink(suggestion) then
      showNotification("Suggestion Blocked", "Links are not allowed in suggestions.", "error")
      return
    end
    if isNonsense(suggestion) then
      suggestionNonsenseCount[uid] = (suggestionNonsenseCount[uid] or 0) + 1
      if suggestionNonsenseCount[uid] >= 3 then
        suggestionBanned[uid] = true
        showNotification(
          "Suggestion Blocked",
          "You have been blocked from sending suggestions.",
          "error"
        )
      else
        showNotification("Suggestion", "Please write a meaningful suggestion.", "warning")
      end
      return
    end
    local avatarUrl = "https://www.roblox.com/headshot-thumbnail/image?userId="
      .. uid
      .. "&width=150&height=150&format=png"
    pcall(function()
      local rf = getRequestFunction()
      if rf then
        local res = rf({
          Url = "https://thumbnails.roproxy.com/v1/users/avatar-headshot?userIds="
            .. uid
            .. "&size=150x150&format=Png&isCircular=false",
          Method = "GET",
        })
        if res and res.Body then
          local data = httpService:JSONDecode(res.Body)
          if data and data.data and data.data[1] then
            avatarUrl = data.data[1].imageUrl
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    local embed = {
      author = {
        name = string.format("%s (@%s)", localPlayer.DisplayName, localPlayer.Name),
        icon_url = avatarUrl,
        url = "https://www.roblox.com/users/" .. uid .. "/profile",
      },
      title = "New Suggestion",
      description = suggestion,
      color = 0x8A57FF,
      thumbnail = { url = avatarUrl },
      fields = { { name = "Executor", value = "`" .. detectExecutor() .. "`", inline = false } },
      footer = { text = "6locc Scripts • Violence District" },
      timestamp = os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
    }
    makeRequest(suggestionURL, "POST", httpService:JSONEncode({ embeds = { embed } }))
  end
end)();
(function()
  local PREFERENCES_FILE = "VD_Popup_Preferences.json"
  local popupPreferences = {
    HideChangelog = false,
    HideConfigsInfo = false,
    HideSuggestion = false,
    HideChaosLordNotice = false,
    HideMiguelNotice = false,
    HideDofhNotice = false,
  }
  local function loadPopupPreferences()
    local rf = readfile or make_readfile or (syn and syn.readfile)
    local isf = isfile or (syn and syn.isfile)
    if rf and isf and isf(PREFERENCES_FILE) then
      pcall(function()
        local content = rf(PREFERENCES_FILE)
        if content and content ~= "" then
          local decoded = httpService:JSONDecode(content)
          if decoded then
            if decoded.HideChangelog ~= nil then
              popupPreferences.HideChangelog = decoded.HideChangelog
            end
            if decoded.HideConfigsInfo ~= nil then
              popupPreferences.HideConfigsInfo = decoded.HideConfigsInfo
            end
            if decoded.HideSuggestion ~= nil then
              popupPreferences.HideSuggestion = decoded.HideSuggestion
            end
            if decoded.HideChaosLordNotice ~= nil then
              popupPreferences.HideChaosLordNotice = decoded.HideChaosLordNotice
            end
            if decoded.HideMiguelNotice ~= nil then
              popupPreferences.HideMiguelNotice = decoded.HideMiguelNotice
            end
            if decoded.HideDofhNotice ~= nil then
              popupPreferences.HideDofhNotice = decoded.HideDofhNotice
            end
          end
        end
      end)
    end
  end
  function savePopupPreferences()
    local wf = writefile or make_writefile or (syn and syn.writefile)
    if wf then
      pcall(function()
        wf(PREFERENCES_FILE, httpService:JSONEncode(popupPreferences))
      end)
    end
  end

      elseif prefix == "[/]" then
        return '<font color="#FFDC00">[/]</font>' .. changeText:sub(4)
