                fallback = "rbxassetid://107835950539866",
              },
            }
            local selectedSong = loadingSongs[math.random(1, #loadingSongs)]
            local soundId =
              getLocalAsset(selectedSong.url, selectedSong.file, selectedSong.fallback)
            if soundId then
              sound.SoundId = soundId
              sound:Play()
              TweenService:Create(sound, TweenInfo.new(0.8), { Volume = 0.4 }):Play()
            end
          end)
          local steps = 100
          local taskIdx = 1
          for i = 1, steps do
            local pctVal = i / steps
            TweenService:Create(
              barFill,
              TweenInfo.new(0.03, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad),
              { Size = UDim2.new(pctVal, 0, 1, 0) }
            ):Play()
            pctLabel.Text = tostring(i) .. "%"
            if taskIdx <= #tasks and i >= tasks[taskIdx].pct then
              statusLabel.Text = tasks[taskIdx].text
              taskIdx = taskIdx + 1
            end
            task.wait(0.025)
          end
          task.wait(0.3)
          fadeLoader(1, 0.4)
          TweenService:Create(
            sound,
            TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
            { Volume = 0 }
          ):Play()
          task.wait(0.6)
          loadCG:Destroy()
          sound:Stop()
          sound:Destroy()
          isLoadingScreenActive = false
          toggleUI(true)
          if mobileToggleBtn then
            mobileToggleBtn.Visible = (isMobile or UserInputService.TouchEnabled)
          end
          if _G.VD_RefreshHotkeys then
            pcall(_G.VD_RefreshHotkeys)
          end
          if _G.VD_RefreshCooldownOverlay then
            pcall(_G.VD_RefreshCooldownOverlay)
          end
          if _G.VD_RefreshSpectatorList then
            pcall(_G.VD_RefreshSpectatorList)
          end
          if _G.VD_InfoBannerRef and Settings.ShowInfoBanner then
            _G.VD_InfoBannerRef.Visible = true
          end
          if _G.VD_LiveFPSRef and Settings.ShowLiveFPS then
            _G.VD_LiveFPSRef.Visible = true
          end
        end)
      end
      local function stepSuggestion()
        if showSuggestion then
          pcall(function()
            createSuggestionPopup(true, finishChain)
          end)
        else
          finishChain()
        end
      end
      local function stepConfigs()
        if showConfigs then
          pcall(function()
            createConfigsInfoPopup(stepSuggestion)
          end)
        else
          stepSuggestion()
        end
      end
      local function stepChangelog()
        if showChangelog then
          pcall(function()
            createChangelogPopup(stepConfigs)
          end)
        else
          stepConfigs()
        end
      end
      local function stepChaosLord()
        if showChaosLordNotice then
          pcall(function()
            createChaosLordNoticePopup(stepChangelog)
          end)
        else
          stepChangelog()
        end
      end
      if showMiguelNotice then
        pcall(function()
          createMiguelNoticePopup(stepChaosLord)
        end)
      else
        stepChaosLord()
      end
    end
    local function stepPremiumCheck()
      task.spawn(function()
        loadSavedPremiumKey(function(successVal, message)
          initialPremiumCheckCompleted = true
          if successVal then
            if _G.VD_UpdatePremiumUIState then
              pcall(_G.VD_UpdatePremiumUIState)
            end
            showNotification("Premium Version +", "Premium key automatically validated!", "success")
          else
            savedPremiumKey = "None"
            pcall(enforceFreeRestrictions)
            if updateUIFromSettings then
              pcall(updateUIFromSettings)
            end
            if _G.VD_UpdatePremiumUIState then
              pcall(_G.VD_UpdatePremiumUIState)
            end
            local isExplicitInvalid = message
              and (
                message:find("Invalid")
                or message:find("revoked")
                or message:find("disabled")
                or message:find("expired")
                or message:find("HWID lock")
                or message:find("bound")
              )
            if isExplicitInvalid then
              pcall(function()
                local delfile = delfile or (syn and syn.delfile)
                if delfile and isfile and isfile(PREMIUM_KEY_FILE) then
                  delfile(PREMIUM_KEY_FILE)
                elseif writefile then
                  writefile(PREMIUM_KEY_FILE, "{}")
                end
              end)
            end
          end
        end)
      end)
      continueChain()
    end
    local function onStartupGatePassed()
      stepPremiumCheck()
    end
    if _G.VD_ExecutionDone then
      if _G.VD_ExecutionConfirmed then
        onStartupGatePassed()
      end
    else
      startupChainCallback = onStartupGatePassed
    end
  end
  (function()
    local abysswalkerCircleAdornment = nil
    local abysswalkerCircleLastTime = 0
    local abysswalkerCircleTween = nil
    function updateAbysswalkerCircle(radius)
      abysswalkerCircleLastTime = tick()
      local char = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
      local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not root then
        return
      end
      if not abysswalkerCircleAdornment or abysswalkerCircleAdornment.Parent == nil then
        abysswalkerCircleAdornment = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
        abysswalkerCircleAdornment.Name = "VD_AbyssAutoCrouchCircle"
        abysswalkerCircleAdornment.Height = 0.06
        abysswalkerCircleAdornment.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        abysswalkerCircleAdornment.Transparency = 1.0
        abysswalkerCircleAdornment.AlwaysOnTop = true
        abysswalkerCircleAdornment.ZIndex = 10
        abysswalkerCircleAdornment.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -3.1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(
          math.rad(90),
          0,
          0
        )
      end
      if abysswalkerCircleAdornment.Adornee ~= root then
        abysswalkerCircleAdornment.Adornee = root
      end
      if abysswalkerCircleAdornment.Parent ~= root then
        abysswalkerCircleAdornment.Parent = root
      end
      abysswalkerCircleAdornment.Radius = radius
      abysswalkerCircleAdornment.InnerRadius = math.max(0.1, radius - 0.25)
      abysswalkerCircleAdornment.Visible = true
      if abysswalkerCircleAdornment.Transparency > 0.45 then
        if abysswalkerCircleTween then
          pcall(function()
            abysswalkerCircleTween:Cancel()
          end)
        end
        abysswalkerCircleTween = TweenService:Create(
          abysswalkerCircleAdornment,
          TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
          { Transparency = 0.45 }
        )
        abysswalkerCircleTween:Play()
      end
    end
    registerConnection(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
      if
        abysswalkerCircleAdornment
        and abysswalkerCircleAdornment.Visible
        and abysswalkerCircleLastTime > 0
      then
        if (tick() - abysswalkerCircleLastTime) >= 3.0 then
          abysswalkerCircleLastTime = 0
          if abysswalkerCircleTween then
            pcall(function()
              abysswalkerCircleTween:Cancel()
            end)
          end
          abysswalkerCircleTween = TweenService:Create(
            abysswalkerCircleAdornment,
            TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
            { Transparency = 1.0 }
          )
          abysswalkerCircleTween:Play()
          task.delay(0.42, function()
            if abysswalkerCircleAdornment and abysswalkerCircleLastTime == 0 then
              abysswalkerCircleAdornment.Visible = false
            end
          end)
        end
      end
    end))
  end)()
  local function setupAbysswalkerAutoDodge()
    local TARGET_ANIM_IDS = { ["100014992013740"] = true, ["80411309607666"] = true }
    local DODGE_WINDOW = 1.5
    local CROUCH_DURATION = 1.0
    local lastHookedChar = nil
    local animHookConn = nil
    local scanThrottle = 0
    local function doCrouch()
      if isMobile then
        pcall(function()
          local btn = localPlayer.PlayerGui["Survivor-mob"].Controls.crouch
          btn.MouseButton1Down:Fire()
          task.delay(CROUCH_DURATION, function()
            pcall(function()
              btn.MouseButton1Up:Fire()
            end)
          end)
        end)
      else
        pcall(function()
          local vim = VirtualInputManager
          if not vim then
            pcall(function()
              vim = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
            end)
          end
          if vim then
            vim:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl, false, game)
            vim:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.C, false, game)
            task.delay(CROUCH_DURATION, function()
              pcall(function()
                vim:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl, false, game)
                vim:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.C, false, game)
              end)
            end)
          end
        end)
      end
    end
    local function findAbyssPlayer()
      for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= localPlayer then
          local ok, k = pcall(getSelectedKiller, p)
          if ok and tostring(k):lower():find("abysswalker") then
            return p
          end
          local char = p.Character
          if char then
            local cName = char.Name:lower()
            if cName:find("abysswalker") or cName:find("stalker") then
              return p
            end
            local team = p.Team
            if team and (team.Name == "Killer" or team.Name:lower():find("killer")) then
              return p
            end
          end
        end
      end
      return nil
    end
    local function onAnimPlayed(track)
      if not (Settings.Stalker and Settings.Stalker.AutoDodge and isPremiumActive()) then
        return
      end
      local id = (track.Animation and tostring(track.Animation.AnimationId):match("%d+"))
        or (track.AnimationId and tostring(track.AnimationId):match("%d+"))
        or ""
      if not TARGET_ANIM_IDS[id] then
        return
      end
      _G.VD_IsDodgingStalker = true
      local ap = findAbyssPlayer()
      local kChar = (ap and ap.Character) or lastHookedChar
      if not kChar or not kChar.Parent then
        _G.VD_IsDodgingStalker = false
        return
      end
      local myChar = localPlayer.Character
      local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local kRoot = kChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not myRoot or not kRoot then
        _G.VD_IsDodgingStalker = false
        return
      end
      task.spawn(function()
        local t0 = tick()
        local dodged = false
        _G.VD_IsDodgingStalker = true
        local dodgeDistThreshold = (Settings.Stalker and Settings.Stalker.AutoDodgeDistance) or 15
        while (tick() - t0) < DODGE_WINDOW and not dodged do
          if localHooksTable and type(localHooksTable.StalkerDodge) == "function" then
            dodged = localHooksTable.StalkerDodge(myRoot, kRoot, dodgeDistThreshold, doCrouch)
          else
            local dist = (myRoot.Position - kRoot.Position).Magnitude
            if dist <= dodgeDistThreshold then
              doCrouch()
              dodged = true
            end
          end
          RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        _G.VD_IsDodgingStalker = false
      end)
    end
    local function hookChar(char)
      if animHookConn then
        pcall(function()
          animHookConn:Disconnect()
        end)
      end
      animHookConn = nil
      local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local anim = hum and (hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or hum)
      if not anim then
        local c
        c = char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
          if d:IsA("Animator") then
            c:Disconnect()
            animHookConn = d.AnimationPlayed:Connect(onAnimPlayed)
            registerConnection(animHookConn)
          end
        end)
        registerConnection(c)
        return
      end
      animHookConn = anim.AnimationPlayed:Connect(onAnimPlayed)
      registerConnection(animHookConn)
      lastHookedChar = char
    end
    registerConnection(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
      if not (Settings.Stalker and Settings.Stalker.AutoDodge and isPremiumActive()) then
        return
      end
      scanThrottle = scanThrottle + 1
      if scanThrottle < 30 then
        return
      end
      scanThrottle = 0
      local ap = findAbyssPlayer()
      if not ap then
        return
      end
      local char = ap.Character
      if char and char ~= lastHookedChar then
        hookChar(char)
      end
    end))
  end
  setupAbysswalkerAutoDodge()
  startStartupChain()
end)();
(function()
  local Players = game:GetService("Players")
  local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
  local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
  local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
  local activeLoop = true
  local isStalkingActive = false
  registerConnection(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then
      return
    end
    if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Q then
      return
    end
    local selectedKiller = ""
    pcall(function()
      selectedKiller = tostring(getSelectedKiller(localPlayer))
    end)
    local selKLow = selectedKiller:lower()
    if selKLow:find("abysswalker") then
      if not (Settings.Stalker and Settings.Stalker.InfiniteCorrupt) then
        return
      end
      pcall(function()
        local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

        local hrp = localPlayer.Character
          and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if sp and hrp then
          sp:FireServer("70398808450410", hrp, 0.4, 60)
        end
        local killers = remotes:FindFirstChild("Killers")
        local abyssF = killers and killers:FindFirstChild("Abysswalker")
        local corrupt = abyssF and abyssF:FindFirstChild("corrupt")
        if corrupt then
          corrupt:FireServer()
        end
      end)
      return
    end
    if not (selKLow:find("stalker") or selKLow:find("veil") or selKLow:find("masked")) then
      return
    end
    if not isPremiumActive() then
      return
    end
    local noCooldown = Settings.Stalker
      and Settings.Stalker.NoCooldown
      and isPremiumActive()
      and localHooksTable
      and localHooksTable.Stalker
    local killGrab = Settings.Stalker
      and Settings.Stalker.KillGrab
      and isPremiumActive()
      and localHooksTable
      and localHooksTable.Stalker
    if not noCooldown then
      return
    end
    if isStalkingActive then
      return
    end
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local animator = humanoid and (humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or humanoid)
    if not root or not animator then
      return
    end
    local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    if not remotes then
      return
    end
    isStalkingActive = true
    local activeTrack = nil
    pcall(function()
      local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
      animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://77477445889320"
      activeTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
      activeTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
      activeTrack:Play()
    end)
    local attacks = remotes:FindFirstChild("Attacks")
    local basicAttack = attacks and attacks:FindFirstChild("BasicAttack")
    local killers = remotes:FindFirstChild("Killers")
    local stalkerFolder = killers and killers:FindFirstChild("Stalker")
    local consumeReady = stalkerFolder and stalkerFolder:FindFirstChild("ConsumeReady")
    local grabEvent = stalkerFolder and stalkerFolder:FindFirstChild("grab")
    local soundPlayer = remotes:FindFirstChild("SoundPlayer")
    if soundPlayer then
      pcall(function()
        soundPlayer:FireServer("132736711620405", localPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart, 0.3, 70)
      end)
    end
    if basicAttack then
      pcall(function()
        basicAttack:FireServer(true)
      end)
    end
    if consumeReady then
      pcall(function()
        consumeReady:FireServer()
      end)
    end
    if grabEvent then
      task.spawn(function()
        local grabWindowActive = true
        local endTime = tick() + 2.0
        while grabWindowActive and tick() < endTime do
          RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
          local myChar = localPlayer.Character
          local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if not myRoot then
            break
          end
          local nearestChar = nil
          local nearestDist = math.huge
          for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= localPlayer and p.Character then
              local sRoot = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
              local sHum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
              if sRoot and sHum and sHum.Health > 0 then
                local d = (sRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                if d < nearestDist then
                  nearestDist = d
                  nearestChar = p.Character
                end
              end
            end
          end
          if nearestChar and nearestDist <= 5.0 then
            local iterations = killGrab and 2 or 1
            for _ = 1, iterations do
              pcall(function()
                grabEvent:FireServer(nearestChar)
              end)
              if iterations > 1 then
                task.wait(0.05)
              end
            end
            if activeTrack then
              pcall(function()
                activeTrack:Stop()
              end)
            end
            grabWindowActive = false
            break
          end
        end
        if activeTrack then
          pcall(function()
            activeTrack:Stop()
          end)
        end
        isStalkingActive = false
      end)
    else
      task.delay(0.5, function()
        if activeTrack then
          pcall(function()
            activeTrack:Stop()
          end)
        end
        isStalkingActive = false
      end)
    end
  end))
  task.spawn(function()

            end
          end)

        end
        if not (selKLow:find("stalker") or selKLow:find("veil") or selKLow:find("masked")) then

        local activeTrack2 = nil

    while activeLoop do
      task.wait(0.2)
      if Settings.Stalker and Settings.Stalker.StalkWhileMoving then
        pcall(function()
          local remotes2 = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
          local killers2 = remotes2 and remotes2:FindFirstChild("Killers")
          local stalkerFolder2 = killers2 and killers2:FindFirstChild("Stalker")
          local startStalking = stalkerFolder2 and stalkerFolder2:FindFirstChild("StartStalking")
          if startStalking then
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
              if p ~= localPlayer and p.Character then
                local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                  pcall(function()
                    startStalking:FireServer(p)
                  end)
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end)
      end
    end
  end)
end)();
(function()
  local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
  local function getExecutorName()
    if identifyexecutor then
      local success, name = pcall(identifyexecutor)
      if success and name then
        return tostring(name)
      end
    end
    if getexecutorname then
      local success, name = pcall(getexecutorname)
      if success and name then
        return tostring(name)
      end
    end
    return "Unknown"
  end
  local function sendTelemetry(amount)
    local data = { username = localPlayer.Name, executor = getExecutorName(), playtime = amount }
    local requestFunc = (syn and syn.request)
      or (http and http.request)
      or http_request
      or (fluxus and fluxus.request)
      or request
    if requestFunc then
      pcall(function()
        requestFunc({
          Url = (SERVER_API_URL or _G.VD_SERVER_URL or "http://78.154.103.2:9156") .. "/api/log",
          Method = "POST",
          Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" },
          Body = HttpService:JSONEncode(data),
        })
      end)
    end
  end
  task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(60)
    sendTelemetry(60)
    while activeLoop do
      task.wait(300)
      sendTelemetry(300)
    end
  end)
end)()
task.spawn(function()
  local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
  if not defaultLightingSettings then
    defaultLightingSettings = {
      FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
      FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
      Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
      ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
      Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
      OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
      GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
    }
  end
  local allFogObjects = {}
  local function registerFogObject(obj)
    if not obj:IsA("Atmosphere") and not obj:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") then
      return
    end
    if table.find(allFogObjects, obj) then
      return
    end
    table.insert(allFogObjects, obj)
  end
  registerConnection(Lighting.DescendantAdded:Connect(registerFogObject))
  for _, obj in ipairs(Lighting:GetDescendants()) do
    registerFogObject(obj)
  end
  updateVisuals = function()
    pcall(function()
      local function getOrCreateEffect(className, name)
        local effect = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
        if not effect then
          effect = Instance.new(className)
          effect.Name = name
          effect.Parent = Lighting
        end
        return effect
      end
      local isRtxOn = Settings.RTXGraphics
        and isPremiumActive()
        and localHooksTable
        and localHooksTable.RTXGraphics
      local hasVisualHooks = isPremiumActive()
        and localHooksTable
        and localHooksTable.VisualCustomization
      local hasFogHooks = isPremiumActive() and localHooksTable and localHooksTable.CustomFog
      local hasLightingHooks = isPremiumActive()
        and localHooksTable
        and localHooksTable.CustomLighting
      local hasBloomHooks = isPremiumActive() and localHooksTable and localHooksTable.CustomBloom
      local hasSunRaysHooks = isPremiumActive() and localHooksTable and localHooksTable.SunRays
      local preset = (hasVisualHooks and Settings.VisualPreset) or "Default"
      local sat = 0
      local con = 0
      local tint = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
      if preset == "Custom" then
        sat = Settings.VisualSaturation or 0.25
        con = Settings.VisualContrast or 0.12
      elseif preset == "Vibrant & Alive" then
        sat = 0.35
        con = 0.15
      elseif preset == "Clean Daylight" then
        sat = 0.20
        con = 0.10
        tint = Color3.fromRGB(255, 252, 245)
      elseif preset == "Cyberpunk Neon" then
        sat = 0.55
        con = 0.25
        tint = Color3.fromRGB(230, 200, 255)
      elseif preset == "Warm Sunset" then
        sat = 0.30
        con = 0.14
        tint = Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 210)
      elseif preset == "Moonlight" then
        sat = 0.15
        con = 0.20
        tint = Color3.fromRGB(210, 230, 255)
      elseif preset == "Default" then
        sat = 0.0
        con = 0.0
      end
      if Settings.GraphicsTint == "Warm" then
        tint = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 220)
      elseif Settings.GraphicsTint == "Cold" then
        tint = Color3.fromRGB(220, 240, 255)
      end
      local ccNeeded = isRtxOn
        or preset ~= "Default"
        or sat ~= 0
        or con ~= 0
        or Settings.GraphicsTint ~= "Default"
      if ccNeeded then
        local cc = getOrCreateEffect("ColorCorrectionEffect", "Helper_ColorCorrection")
        cc.Enabled = true
        cc.Contrast = isRtxOn and (con + 0.10) or con
        cc.Saturation = isRtxOn and (sat + 0.15) or sat
        cc.TintColor = tint
      else
        local cc = Lighting:FindFirstChild("Helper_ColorCorrection")
        if cc then
          cc:Destroy()
        end
      end
      if isRtxOn then
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(35, 30, 45)
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(45, 40, 55)
        Lighting.Brightness = 2.5
        Lighting.ExposureCompensation = 0.4
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
        Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 1
        Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 1
      elseif Settings.CustomLightingEnabled and hasLightingHooks and not Settings.FullBright then
        local customCol = Settings.CustomLightingColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        Lighting.Ambient = customCol
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = customCol
        if defaultLightingSettings then
          Lighting.Brightness = defaultLightingSettings.Brightness
          Lighting.GlobalShadows = defaultLightingSettings.GlobalShadows
        end
      else
        if not Settings.FullBright and defaultLightingSettings then
          Lighting.Ambient = defaultLightingSettings.Ambient
          Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = defaultLightingSettings.OutdoorAmbient
          Lighting.Brightness = defaultLightingSettings.Brightness
          Lighting.GlobalShadows = defaultLightingSettings.GlobalShadows
        end
      end
      local tod = (hasLightingHooks and Settings.TimeOfDayPreset) or "Default"
      if not Settings.FullBright then
        if tod == "Day" then
          Lighting.ClockTime = 14.0
        elseif tod == "Sunset" then
          Lighting.ClockTime = 18.0
        elseif tod == "Sunrise" then
          Lighting.ClockTime = 6.5
        elseif tod == "Night" then
          Lighting.ClockTime = 0.0
        elseif tod == "Midnight" then
          Lighting.ClockTime = 24.0
        elseif tod == "Default" and defaultLightingSettings then
          Lighting.ClockTime = defaultLightingSettings.ClockTime
        end
      end
      local bloomNeeded = isRtxOn or (Settings.CustomBloomEnabled and hasBloomHooks)
      if bloomNeeded then
        local bloom = getOrCreateEffect("BloomEffect", "Helper_Bloom")
        bloom.Enabled = true
        bloom.Intensity = (Settings.CustomBloomEnabled and hasBloomHooks)
            and (Settings.BloomIntensity or 0.8)
          or (isRtxOn and 0.8 or 0.5)
        bloom.Size = (Settings.CustomBloomEnabled and hasBloomHooks) and (Settings.BloomSize or 24)
          or (isRtxOn and 24 or 24)
        bloom.Threshold = (Settings.CustomBloomEnabled and hasBloomHooks)
            and (Settings.BloomThreshold or 0.85)
          or (isRtxOn and 0.85 or 0.8)
      else
        local bloom = Lighting:FindFirstChild("Helper_Bloom")
        if bloom then
          bloom:Destroy()
        end
      end
      local sunRaysNeeded = isRtxOn or (Settings.SunRaysEnabled and hasSunRaysHooks)
      if sunRaysNeeded then
        local sunRays = getOrCreateEffect("SunRaysEffect", "Helper_SunRays")
        sunRays.Enabled = true
        sunRays.Intensity = (Settings.SunRaysEnabled and hasSunRaysHooks)
            and (Settings.SunRaysIntensity or 0.10)
          or (isRtxOn and 0.08 or 0.05)
        sunRays.Spread = 0.7
      else
        local sunRays = Lighting:FindFirstChild("Helper_SunRays")
        if sunRays then
          sunRays:Destroy()
        end
      end
      if not Settings.NoFog then
        if Settings.CustomFogEnabled and hasFogHooks then
          Lighting.FogColor = Settings.CustomFogColor or Color3.fromRGB(120, 160, 200)
          Lighting.FogStart = Settings.CustomFogStart or 0
          Lighting.FogEnd = Settings.CustomFogEnd or 800
          local atm = getOrCreateEffect("Atmosphere", "Helper_Atmosphere")
          atm.Density = Settings.AtmosphereDensity or 0.2
          atm.Offset = 0.25
          atm.Color = Settings.CustomFogColor or Color3.fromRGB(120, 160, 200)
          atm.Decay = Settings.CustomFogColor or Color3.fromRGB(120, 160, 200)
          atm.Glare = 0.4
          atm.Haze = 0.1
        elseif isRtxOn then
          local atm = getOrCreateEffect("Atmosphere", "Helper_Atmosphere")
          atm.Density = Settings.AtmosphereDensity or 0.2
          atm.Offset = 0.25
          atm.Color = Color3.fromRGB(160, 180, 200)
          atm.Glare = 0.4
          atm.Haze = 0.1
        else
          local atm = Lighting:FindFirstChild("Helper_Atmosphere")
          if atm then
            atm:Destroy()
          end
          if defaultLightingSettings then
            Lighting.FogStart = defaultLightingSettings.FogStart
            Lighting.FogEnd = defaultLightingSettings.FogEnd
          end
        end
      end
      if
        Settings.CinematicDOF
        and isPremiumActive()
        and localHooksTable
        and localHooksTable.CinematicDOF
      then
        local dof = getOrCreateEffect("DepthOfFieldEffect", "Helper_DOF")
        dof.Enabled = true
        dof.FocusDistance = 25
        dof.InFocusRadius = 15
        dof.NearIntensity = 0.1
        dof.FarIntensity = 0.65
      else
        local dof = Lighting:FindFirstChild("Helper_DOF")
        if dof then
          dof:Destroy()
        end
      end
      if _G.VD_UpdateCustomSkybox then
        pcall(_G.VD_UpdateCustomSkybox)
      end
      if _G.VD_UpdateCustomParticles then
        pcall(_G.VD_UpdateCustomParticles)
      end
    end)
  end
  local wasFullBright = false
  local wasNoFog = false
  local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
  local rtxAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(35, 30, 45)
  local rtxOutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(45, 40, 55)
  registerConnection(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if
      Settings.RTXGraphics
      and isPremiumActive()
      and localHooksTable
      and localHooksTable.RTXGraphics
    then
      if Lighting.Ambient ~= rtxAmbient then
        Lighting.Ambient = rtxAmbient
      end
      if Lighting.OutdoorAmbient ~= rtxOutdoorAmbient then
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = rtxOutdoorAmbient
      end
      if Lighting.Brightness ~= 2.5 then
        Lighting.Brightness = 2.5
      end
      if Lighting.ExposureCompensation ~= 0.4 then
        Lighting.ExposureCompensation = 0.4
      end
      if Lighting.GlobalShadows ~= true then
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
      end
      if Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale ~= 1 then
        Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 1
      end
      if Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale ~= 1 then
        Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 1
      end
    end
  end))
  task.defer(function()
    if updateVisuals then
      pcall(updateVisuals)
    end
  end)
  while activeLoop do
    task.wait(0.2)
    pcall(function()
      if Settings.FullBright then
        if Lighting.Brightness ~= 2 then
          Lighting.Brightness = 2
        end
        if Lighting.ClockTime ~= 14 then
          Lighting.ClockTime = 14
        end
        local white = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        if Lighting.Ambient ~= white then
          Lighting.Ambient = white
        end
        if Lighting.OutdoorAmbient ~= white then
          Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = white
        end
        if Lighting.GlobalShadows ~= false then
          Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
        end
        wasFullBright = true
      elseif wasFullBright then
        wasFullBright = false
        if updateVisuals then
          pcall(updateVisuals)
        end
      end
      if Settings.NoFog then
        if Lighting.FogStart ~= 999999 then
          Lighting.FogStart = 999999
        end
        if Lighting.FogEnd ~= 999999 then
          Lighting.FogEnd = 999999
        end
        for i = #allFogObjects, 1, -1 do
          local obj = allFogObjects[i]
          if not obj or not obj.Parent then
            table.remove(allFogObjects, i)
          else
            if obj:IsA("Atmosphere") then
              if not cachedAtmospheres[obj] then
                cachedAtmospheres[obj] = { Density = obj.Density, Haze = obj.Haze }
              end
              if obj.Density ~= 0 then
                obj.Density = 0
              end
              if obj.Haze ~= 0 then
                obj.Haze = 0
              end
            elseif obj:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") then
              if cachedDoFs[obj] == nil then
                cachedDoFs[obj] = obj.Enabled
              end
              if obj.Enabled ~= false then
                obj.Enabled = false
              end
            end
          end
        end
        wasNoFog = true
      elseif wasNoFog then
        if defaultLightingSettings then
          Lighting.FogStart = defaultLightingSettings.FogStart
          Lighting.FogEnd = defaultLightingSettings.FogEnd
        end
        for obj, props in pairs(cachedAtmospheres) do
          if obj and obj.Parent then
            pcall(function()
              obj.Density = props.Density
              obj.Haze = props.Haze
            end)
          end
        end
        table.clear(cachedAtmospheres)
        if not Settings.RemoveDOF then
          for obj, enabled in pairs(cachedDoFs) do
            if obj and obj.Parent then
              pcall(function()
                obj.Enabled = enabled
              end)
            end
          end
          table.clear(cachedDoFs)
        end
        wasNoFog = false
        if updateVisuals then
          pcall(updateVisuals)
        end
      end
      if Settings.RemoveDOF and not Settings.NoFog then
        for i = #allFogObjects, 1, -1 do
          local obj = allFogObjects[i]
          if obj and obj.Parent and obj:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") then
            if cachedDoFs[obj] == nil then
              cachedDoFs[obj] = obj.Enabled
            end
            if obj.Enabled ~= false then
              obj.Enabled = false
            end
          end
        end
      elseif not Settings.RemoveDOF and not Settings.NoFog and next(cachedDoFs) ~= nil then
        for obj, enabled in pairs(cachedDoFs) do
          if obj and obj.Parent then
            pcall(function()
              obj.Enabled = enabled
            end)
          end
        end
        table.clear(cachedDoFs)
      end
    end)
  end
end)
task.spawn(function()
  while activeLoop do
    task.wait(1)
    pcall(function()
      if Settings.AutoSkillCheck and Settings.SkillCheckSpeedVal then
        local char = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
        if char then
          local speedVal = Settings.SkillCheckSpeedVal or 1.0
          char:SetAttribute("skillcheckspeed", speedVal)
          char:SetAttribute("SkillCheckSpeed", speedVal)
        end
      end
    end)
  end
end)
destroyDesyncGhost = nil
updateDesyncGhostAppearance = nil;
(function()
  local packetQueue = {}
  local isDispatchingQueue = false
  local fakeLagActive = false
  local lastFakeLagTick = tick()
  local desyncGhost = nil
  destroyDesyncGhost = function()
    if desyncGhost then
      pcall(function()
        desyncGhost:Destroy()
      end)
      desyncGhost = nil
    end
  end
  updateDesyncGhostAppearance = function()
    if not desyncGhost then
      return
    end
    if not Settings.EnableDesyncGhost then
      destroyDesyncGhost()
      return
    end
    pcall(function()
      local colorMap = {
        Accent = UI.Accent,
        Cyan = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255),
        Purple = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 255),
        Green = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120),
        Red = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60),
        Yellow = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 0),
        White = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
      }
      local selectedColor = colorMap[Settings.DesyncGhostColor or "Accent"] or UI.Accent
      local trans = Settings.DesyncGhostTransparency or 0.5
      local alwaysOnTop = Settings.DesyncGhostAlwaysOnTop
      if alwaysOnTop == nil then
        alwaysOnTop = true
      end
      local hl = desyncGhost:FindFirstChild("GhostHighlight")
      if hl then
        hl.FillColor = selectedColor
        hl.FillTransparency = trans
        hl.DepthMode = alwaysOnTop and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
          or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
      end
    end)
  end
  local function createDesyncGhost(char, anchorCFrame)
    if not Settings.EnableDesyncGhost then
      destroyDesyncGhost()
      return
    end
    pcall(function()
      local rootPart = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not rootPart then
        return
      end
      local colorMap = {
        Accent = UI.Accent,
        Cyan = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255),
        Purple = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 255),
        Green = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120),
        Red = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60),
        Yellow = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 0),
        White = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
      }
      local selectedColor = colorMap[Settings.DesyncGhostColor or "Accent"] or UI.Accent
      local trans = Settings.DesyncGhostTransparency or 0.5
      local alwaysOnTop = Settings.DesyncGhostAlwaysOnTop
      if alwaysOnTop == nil then
        alwaysOnTop = true
      end
      if desyncGhost and desyncGhost.Parent then
        local currentRootCFrame = rootPart.CFrame
        for _, child in ipairs(desyncGhost:GetChildren()) do
          if child:IsA("BasePart") then
            local origName = child:GetAttribute("OriginalPartName")
            local originalPart = origName and char:FindFirstChild(origName, true)
            if originalPart then
              local offset = currentRootCFrame:ToObjectSpace(originalPart.CFrame)
              child.CFrame = anchorCFrame * offset
              child.Color = selectedColor
            end
          elseif child:IsA("Highlight") then
            child.FillColor = selectedColor
            child.FillTransparency = trans
            child.DepthMode = alwaysOnTop and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
              or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
          end
        end
        return
      end
      destroyDesyncGhost()
      local ghost = Instance.new("Model")
      ghost.Name = "DesyncGhost"
      local hum = Instance.new("Humanoid")
      hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
      hum.Parent = ghost
      local currentRootCFrame = rootPart.CFrame
      for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("BasePart") and child.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
          local clone = child:Clone()
          clone.Anchored = true
          clone.CanCollide = false
          clone.CastShadow = false
          clone.Transparency = 0.99
          clone.Color = selectedColor
          clone.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
          clone:SetAttribute("OriginalPartName", child.Name)
          for _, sub in ipairs(clone:GetChildren()) do
            if sub:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
              sub.TextureId = ""
            else
              sub:Destroy()
            end
          end
          local offset = currentRootCFrame:ToObjectSpace(child.CFrame)
          clone.CFrame = anchorCFrame * offset
          clone.Parent = ghost
        elseif child:IsA("Accessory") then
          local handle = child:FindFirstChild("Handle")
          if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
            local clone = handle:Clone()
            clone.Anchored = true
            clone.CanCollide = false
            clone.CastShadow = false
            clone.Transparency = 0.99
            clone.Color = selectedColor
            clone.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            clone:SetAttribute("OriginalPartName", handle.Name)
            for _, sub in ipairs(clone:GetChildren()) do
              if sub:IsA("SpecialMesh") or sub:IsA("Mesh") then
                pcall(function()
                  sub.TextureId = ""
                end)
              else
                sub:Destroy()
              end
            end
            local offset = currentRootCFrame:ToObjectSpace(handle.CFrame)
            clone.CFrame = anchorCFrame * offset
            clone.Parent = ghost
          end
        end
      end
      local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
      hl.Name = "GhostHighlight"
      hl.FillColor = selectedColor
      hl.FillTransparency = trans
      hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
      hl.OutlineTransparency = 0.1
      hl.DepthMode = alwaysOnTop and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
      hl.Adornee = ghost
      hl.Enabled = true
      hl.Parent = ghost
      ghost.Parent = workspace
      desyncGhost = ghost
    end)
  end
  task.spawn(function()
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local desyncActive = false
    while activeLoop do
      local deltaTime = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
      if #packetQueue > 0 then
        isDispatchingQueue = true
        local now = tick()
        local i = 1
        while i <= #packetQueue do
          local pkt = packetQueue[i]
          if not Settings.FakeLag or now >= pkt.sendTime then
            table.remove(packetQueue, i)
            pcall(pkt.func, pkt.self, (table.unpack or unpack)(pkt.args))
          else
            i = i + 1
          end
        end
        while #packetQueue > 30 do
          local dropped = table.remove(packetQueue, 1)
          if dropped and dropped.func then
            pcall(dropped.func, dropped.self, (table.unpack or unpack)(dropped.args))
          end
        end
        isDispatchingQueue = false
      end
      if
        (Settings.FakeLag or Settings.Desync)
        and isPremiumActive()
        and localHooksTable
        and (localHooksTable.FakeLag or localHooksTable.Desync)
      then
        pcall(function()
          local char = localPlayer.Character
          local rootPart = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
          if not rootPart or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            if fakeLagActive or desyncActive then
              rootPart.Anchored = false
              fakeLagActive = false
              desyncActive = false
            end
            return
          end
          if Settings.Desync then
            if fakeLagActive then
              fakeLagActive = false
              destroyDesyncGhost()
            end
            if not desyncActive then
              desyncActive = true
              rootPart.Anchored = true
              createDesyncGhost(char, rootPart.CFrame)
            end
            if rootPart.Anchored then
              local moveDir = humanoid.MoveDirection
              if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
                local speed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
                rootPart.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame + (moveDir * (speed * deltaTime))
              end
            end
          elseif Settings.FakeLag then
            if desyncActive then
              desyncActive = false
              destroyDesyncGhost()
            end
            local ms = math.clamp(Settings.FakeLagMs or 200, 50, 1000)
            local delaySec = ms / 1000
            if not fakeLagActive then
              fakeLagActive = true
              lastFakeLagTick = tick()
              rootPart.Anchored = true
              createDesyncGhost(char, rootPart.CFrame)
            end
            if rootPart.Anchored then
              local moveDir = humanoid.MoveDirection
              if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
                local speed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
                rootPart.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame + (moveDir * (speed * deltaTime))
              end
            end
            if tick() - lastFakeLagTick >= delaySec then
              rootPart.Anchored = false
              destroyDesyncGhost()
              task.wait(0.08)
              rootPart.Anchored = true
              createDesyncGhost(char, rootPart.CFrame)
              lastFakeLagTick = tick()
            end
          end
        end)
      else
        if fakeLagActive or desyncActive then
          pcall(function()
            local char = localPlayer.Character
            local rootPart = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if rootPart then
              rootPart.Anchored = false
            end
          end)
          destroyDesyncGhost()
          fakeLagActive = false
          desyncActive = false
        end
        task.wait(0.2)
      end
    end
    pcall(function()
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      local rootPart = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if rootPart then
        rootPart.Anchored = false
      end
    end)
    destroyDesyncGhost()
    if #packetQueue > 0 then
      for _, pkt in ipairs(packetQueue) do
        pcall(pkt.func, pkt.self, (table.unpack or unpack)(pkt.args))
      end
      table.clear(packetQueue)
    end
  end)
  task.spawn(function()
    while activeLoop do
      task.wait(15)
      pcall(function()
        if pruneDeadConnections then
          pcall(pruneDeadConnections)
        end
        if collectgarbage then
          collectgarbage("collect")
        end
      end)
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    local SpearMathModule = nil
    local function getSpearMathModule()
      if SpearMathModule then
        return SpearMathModule
      end
      pcall(function()
        local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local mod = rs:FindFirstChild("Modules")
        local kil = mod and mod:FindFirstChild("Killers")
        local veil = kil and kil:FindFirstChild("Veil")
        if veil and veil:FindFirstChild("SpearMath") then
          SpearMathModule = require(veil:FindFirstChild("SpearMath"))
        end
      end)
      return SpearMathModule
    end
    getSpearMathModule()
    local SpearConfig = {
      MaxSpeed = 180.0,
      Gravity = Vector3.new(0, -98.0999984741211, 0),
      SpawnOffset = 3.0,
      MinChargeTime = 0.3,
      FullChargeTime = 1.0,
      PiercingChargeTime = 2.0,
      SegmentsCount = 16,
      StepDt = 0.065,
    }
    local cachedEndAttack = nil
    local lastChargeDataSearch1 = 0
    local function getChargeData()
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      if not char then
        return false, 0
      end
      local isVeil = (
        char:GetAttribute("MorphedKiller") == "Veil"
        or char:GetAttribute("Veil") == true
        or char:FindFirstChild("Spear") ~= nil
      )
      if not isVeil then
        return false, 0
      end
      local animScript = char:FindFirstChild("Animations")
      if not animScript then
        return false, 0
      end
      local isScriptValid = false
      if cachedEndAttack and getfenv then
        local ok, env = pcall(getfenv, cachedEndAttack)
        if ok and env and env.script == animScript then
          isScriptValid = true
        end
      end
      if not cachedEndAttack or not isScriptValid then
        cachedEndAttack = nil
        local now = os.clock()
        if (now - lastChargeDataSearch1) < 2.0 then
          return false, 0
        end
        lastChargeDataSearch1 = now
        if typeof(getgc) == "function" then
          pcall(function()
            local funcs = getgc()
            if funcs then
              for _, f in ipairs(funcs) do
                if type(f) == "function" and (not islclosure or islclosure(f)) then
                  local okName, name = pcall(debug.info, f, "n")
                  if okName and name == "endAttack" then
                    local okEnv, env = pcall(getfenv, f)
                    if okEnv and env and env.script == animScript then
                      cachedEndAttack = f
                      break
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
              table.clear(funcs)
            end
          end)
        end
      end
      if cachedEndAttack and typeof(getupvalues) == "function" then
        local ok, uvs = pcall(getupvalues, cachedEndAttack)
        if ok and type(uvs) == "table" then
          local isCharging = uvs[2] == true
          local chargeStart = tonumber(uvs[9]) or 0
          return isCharging, chargeStart
        end
      end
      return false, 0
    end
    local function calculateVeilSpearAim(targetChar, customOrigin)
      local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
      if not Camera or not targetChar then
        return nil, nil, nil
      end
      local root = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or (targetChar:IsA("Model") and targetChar.PrimaryPart)
        or targetChar:FindFirstChild("Torso")
      if not root then
        return nil, nil, nil
      end
      local aimPart = targetChar:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or root
      local vertOffset = (Settings.SpearSilentAim and Settings.SpearSilentAim.VerticalOffset) or 0
      local targetPos = aimPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.2 + vertOffset, 0)
      local isCharging, chargeStart = getChargeData()
      local now = (
        typeof(workspace.GetServerTimeNow) == "function" and workspace.GetServerTimeNow(workspace)
      ) or os.clock()
      local chargeTime = SpearConfig.FullChargeTime
      if isCharging and chargeStart > 0 then
        chargeTime = math.max(SpearConfig.MinChargeTime, now - chargeStart)
      end
      local launchSpeed = math.clamp(chargeTime * SpearConfig.MaxSpeed, 1, SpearConfig.MaxSpeed)
      local launchOrigin = customOrigin
        or (Camera.CFrame.Position + Camera.CFrame.LookVector * SpearConfig.SpawnOffset)
      local G = SpearConfig.Gravity
      local g = math.abs(G.Y)
      local targetVel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity or root.Velocity or Vector3.zero
      local ping = (typeof(getOneWayPing) == "function" and getOneWayPing())
        or (typeof(getPing) == "function" and (getPing() / 2))
        or 0.045
      ping = math.clamp(ping, 0.015, 0.25)
      local flatVel = Vector3.new(targetVel.X, 0, targetVel.Z)
      local vertVel = math.clamp(targetVel.Y, -14, 14)
      local effectiveVel = Vector3.new(flatVel.X, vertVel, flatVel.Z)
      local initialTarget = targetPos + effectiveVel * ping
      local D = initialTarget - launchOrigin
      local t = math.max(0.04, D.Magnitude / launchSpeed)
      local predPos = initialTarget
      for iter = 1, 5 do
        local totalT = t + ping
        predPos = targetPos + effectiveVel * totalT
        local disp = predPos - launchOrigin
        local horizDist = Vector3.new(disp.X, 0, disp.Z).Magnitude
        local y = disp.Y
        local a = 0.25 * (g ^ 2)
        local b = y * g - (launchSpeed ^ 2)
        local c = horizDist ^ 2 + y ^ 2
        local delta = b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c
        if delta >= 0 then
          local u1 = (-b - math.sqrt(delta)) / (2 * a)
          if u1 > 0 then
            t = math.sqrt(u1)
          else
            t = math.max(0.04, disp.Magnitude / launchSpeed)
          end
        else
          t = math.max(0.04, disp.Magnitude / launchSpeed)
          break
        end
      end
      local launchVel = (predPos - launchOrigin - 0.5 * G * (t ^ 2)) / t
      local aimDir = (launchVel.Magnitude > 0.001) and launchVel.Unit or nil
      if not aimDir or aimDir.X ~= aimDir.X then
        local toPred = predPos - launchOrigin
        aimDir = (toPred.Magnitude > 0.001) and toPred.Unit or Camera.CFrame.LookVector
      end
      return aimDir, launchOrigin, launchSpeed, predPos
    end
    local oldNamecall
    local safeCheckcaller = checkcaller or function()
      return false
    end
    local safeNewcclosure = newcclosure or function(f)
      return f
    end
    local safeSetnamecallmethod = setnamecallmethod or (set_namecall_method or nil)
    if isHookIncompatible or not hookmetamethod or not getnamecallmethod then
      task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(1)
        showNotification(
          "Compatibility Mode",
          "Network hooks disabled for " .. detectExecutor() .. " compatibility.",
          "warning"
        )
      end)
      return
    end
    oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(
      game,
      "__namecall",
      safeNewcclosure(function(self, ...)
        local method = getnamecallmethod()
        if (method == "FireServer" or method == "fireServer") and self and self.Name == "Crush" then
          _G.VD_LastPumpkinCrush = os.clock()
        end
        if method == "Fire" or method == "fire" then
          local camAction = _G.VD_CachedCameraAction
          if camAction and self == camAction then
            local args = { ... }
            if
              args[1] == "vault"
              and Settings.FakeVault
              and _G.VD_IsKillerRole
              and _G.VD_IsKillerRole()
            then
              return
            end
          end
        end
        if method ~= "FireServer" and method ~= "fireServer" then
          return oldNamecall(self, ...)
        end
        if self and self.Name == "FlingReport" then
          return
        end
        local vCommit = _G.VD_CachedVaultCommit
        if vCommit and self == vCommit then
          if Settings.FakeVault and _G.VD_IsKillerRole and _G.VD_IsKillerRole() then
            if _G.VD_PerformKillerCancel then
              task.spawn(_G.VD_PerformKillerCancel)
            end
            return
          end
        end
        if typeof(self) == "Instance" then
          local rName = self.Name
          if rName == "KingScourgeHit" then
            local args = { ... }
            if args[2] == "fail" then
              args[2] = "success"
            end
            if safeSetnamecallmethod then
              safeSetnamecallmethod(method)
            end
            return oldNamecall(self, (table.unpack or unpack)(args))
          end
        end
        if not Settings.FakeLag then
          if typeof(self) ~= "Instance" then
            return oldNamecall(self, ...)
          end
          local rName = self.Name
          local rLower = rName:lower()
          if
            rLower ~= "vaultcompleteevent"
            and rLower ~= "vaultevent"
            and rLower ~= "fall"
            and rLower ~= "spearthrow"
            and rLower ~= "fire"
          then
            return oldNamecall(self, ...)
          end
        end
        local args = { ... }
        local shouldBypass = false
        local customReturn = nil
        local success, err = pcall(function()
          if
            self.Name == "VaultEvent"
            and (Settings.FastVault or Settings.AlwaysFastVault)
            and (
              isPremiumActive("AlwaysFastVault")
              or isPremiumActive("FastVault")
              or isPremiumActive()
            )
          then
            if args[2] == false then
              args[2] = true
            end
            local char = localPlayer.Character
            if char then
              pcall(function()
                char:SetAttribute("Sprinting", true)
                char:SetAttribute("IsRunning", true)
              end)
            end
          end
          if typeof(self) == "Instance" then
            if self.Name == "VaultCompleteEvent" and not _G.VD_ReleasingBlockInteractions then
              if Settings.SimulateQuickRecovery and type(triggerQuickRecovery) == "function" then
                task.spawn(triggerQuickRecovery)
              end
            elseif self.Name == "Fall" then
              local p = self.Parent
              if not p or p.Name == "Mechanics" or p.Name == "Remotes" then
                if
                  Settings.SimulatePerfectLanding and type(triggerPerfectLanding) == "function"
                then
                  task.spawn(triggerPerfectLanding)
                end
              end
            end
            local rNameLower = self.Name:lower()
            if rNameLower == "spearthrow" then
              local isSilentActive = Settings.SpearSilentAim
                and Settings.SpearSilentAim.Enabled
                and isPremiumActive()
              local isAimbotActive = Settings.SpearAimbot
                and Settings.SpearAimbot.Enabled
                and isPremiumActive()
              if isSilentActive or isAimbotActive then
                local throwData = (type(args[1]) == "table" and args[1]) or nil
                local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                local origin = (
                  throwData
                  and typeof(throwData.Origin) == "Vector3"
                  and throwData.Origin
                )
                  or (camera and (camera.CFrame.Position + camera.CFrame.LookVector * 3.0))
                local targetChar = (type(getSilentAimTarget) == "function" and getSilentAimTarget())
                if not targetChar then
                  local fovRadius = (Settings.SpearSilentAim and Settings.SpearSilentAim.FOVRadius)
                    or 240
                  local bestDist = fovRadius
                  local screenCenter = camera and (camera.ViewportSize / 2)
                  for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if p ~= localPlayer and p.Character then
                      local c = p.Character
                      local hum = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                      local root = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        or (c:IsA("Model") and c.PrimaryPart)
                      if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 and not c:GetAttribute("Immobile") then
                        if camera and screenCenter then
                          local sPos, onScreen = (
                            typeof(camera.WorldToViewportPoint) == "function"
                            and camera.WorldToViewportPoint(camera, root.Position)
                          ) or camera:WorldToViewportPoint(
                              root.Position
                            )
                          if onScreen and sPos.Z > 0 then
                            local dist = (Vector2.new(sPos.X, sPos.Y) - screenCenter).Magnitude
                            if dist <= bestDist then
                              bestDist = dist
                              targetChar = c
                            end
                          end
                        end
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
                if targetChar then
                  local finalAimDir, launchOrigin, launchSpeed =
                    calculateVeilSpearAim(targetChar, origin)
                  if
                    finalAimDir
                    and finalAimDir.X == finalAimDir.X
                    and finalAimDir.Magnitude > 0.001
                  then
                    if throwData then
                      throwData.Direction = finalAimDir
                      if not throwData.Origin or typeof(throwData.Origin) ~= "Vector3" then
                        throwData.Origin = launchOrigin
                      end
                      if throwData.Velocity then
                        local spd = (
                          typeof(throwData.Velocity) == "Vector3"
                          and throwData.Velocity.Magnitude > 1
                          and throwData.Velocity.Magnitude
                        ) or launchSpeed
                        throwData.Velocity = finalAimDir * spd
                      end
                    elseif typeof(args[1]) == "Vector3" and typeof(args[2]) == "Vector3" then
                      args[2] = finalAimDir
                    elseif typeof(args[1]) == "Vector3" then
                      args[1] = finalAimDir
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end
            if self.Name == "Fire" then
              local p1 = self.Parent
              local p1Name = p1 and p1.Name:lower() or ""
              if p1Name == "twist of fate" or p1Name:find("twist") or p1Name:find("revolver") then
                if
                  Settings.RevolverSilentAim
                  and Settings.RevolverSilentAim.Enabled
                  and isPremiumActive()
                then
                  if localHooksTable and localHooksTable.RevolverSilentAim then
                    pcall(localHooksTable.RevolverSilentAim, args)
                  end
                end
              end
            end
            if Settings.FakeLag and not isDispatchingQueue and not safeCheckcaller() then
              local ms = math.clamp(Settings.FakeLagMs or 200, 50, 1000)
              table.insert(packetQueue, {
                self = self,
                func = function(re, ...)
                  if re and typeof(re) == "Instance" then
                    re:FireServer(...)
                  end
                end,
                args = args,
                sendTime = tick() + (ms / 1000),
              })
              shouldBypass = true
              customReturn = nil
              return
            end
          end
        end)
        if safeSetnamecallmethod then
          safeSetnamecallmethod(method)
        end
        if not success then
          return oldNamecall(self, ...)
        end
        if shouldBypass then
          return customReturn
        end
        local okCall, callRes = pcall(oldNamecall, self, (table.unpack or unpack)(args))
        if okCall then
          return callRes
        end
        if
          typeof(self) == "Instance"
          and (method == "FireServer" or method == "fireServer")
          and typeof(self.FireServer) == "function"
        then
          return self.FireServer(self, (table.unpack or unpack)(args))
        end
        return callRes
      end)
    )
  end)
end)();
(function()
  local lastTeamForConfigSwitch = nil
  local isSwitchingConfig = false
  local function checkTeamAndSwitchConfig()
    if isSwitchingConfig then
      return
    end
    if not localPlayer then
      return
    end
    local team = localPlayer.Team
    local teamName = team and team.Name or ""
    if teamName == lastTeamForConfigSwitch then
      return
    end
    lastTeamForConfigSwitch = teamName
    if teamName == "Survivors" then
      local targetProf = Settings.SurvivorConfigProfile
      if targetProf and targetProf ~= "None" and ConfigSystem.profiles[targetProf] then
        isSwitchingConfig = true
        task.spawn(function()
          showNotification(
            "Team Switcher",
            "Survivor detected, loading Config: " .. targetProf,
            "success"
          )
          loadProfile(targetProf)
          if _G.VD_RefreshProfileList then
            pcall(_G.VD_RefreshProfileList)
          end
          isSwitchingConfig = false
        end)
      end
    elseif teamName == "Killer" then
      local targetProf = Settings.KillerConfigProfile
      if targetProf and targetProf ~= "None" and ConfigSystem.profiles[targetProf] then
        isSwitchingConfig = true
        task.spawn(function()
          showNotification(
            "Team Switcher",
            "Killer detected, loading Config: " .. targetProf,
            "success"
          )
          loadProfile(targetProf)
          if _G.VD_RefreshProfileList then
            pcall(_G.VD_RefreshProfileList)
          end
          isSwitchingConfig = false
        end)
      end
    end
  end
  function connectTeamSwitcher()
    if not localPlayer then
      return
    end
    registerConnection(localPlayer:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(function()
      checkTeamAndSwitchConfig()
    end))
    checkTeamAndSwitchConfig()
  end
  task.spawn(connectTeamSwitcher)
end)()

task.spawn(function()
  local lastDodgeTime = 0
  local lastPreemptiveDodgeTime = 0
  _G.VD_NormalSpearSpeed = 150
  _G.VD_NormalSpearGravity = 98
  _G.VD_SpecialSpearSpeed = 170
  _G.VD_SpecialSpearGravity = 98
  local function fastDodge(reason)
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastDodgeTime < 1.0 then
      return
    end
    lastDodgeTime = now
    _G.VD_LastDodgeTime = now
    if _G.VD_TriggerDodgeChangeGen then
      local ok, result = pcall(_G.VD_TriggerDodgeChangeGen)
      if ok and result then
        showNotification(
          "Spear Dodge",
          "Veil threw a spear! Switched to another generator.",
          "warning"
        )
      else
        showNotification("Spear Dodge", "Veil threw a spear! Fleeing to safe location.", "warning")
      end
    end
  end
  _G.VD_PreemptiveDodge = function()
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastPreemptiveDodgeTime < 1.0 then
      return
    end
    lastPreemptiveDodgeTime = now
    lastDodgeTime = now
    fastDodge("Preemptive throw animation detected")
  end
  local function triggerVeilSpearDodge()
    fastDodge("Spear projectile detected")
  end
  local function isDodgeAllowed()
    if not Settings.AutoDodgeVeilSpear then
      return false
    end
    if not Settings.AutoFarmSurvivor then
      return false
    end
    local team = localPlayer.Team
    if not team or team.Name ~= "Survivors" then
      return false
    end
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    if not char then
      return false
    end
    local isKnocked = readModelValue(char, "Knocked") == true
      or char:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
    local isHooked = readModelValue(char, "IsHooked") == true
      or char:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
    if isKnocked or isHooked then
      return false
    end
    return true
  end
  local function isPlayerWeapon(inst)
    local current = inst
    while current and current ~= workspace do
      if current:IsA("Model") and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(current) then
        return true
      end
      current = current.Parent
    end
    return false
  end
  local activeSpears = {}
  local function handleNewInstance(descendant)
    if not descendant then
      return
    end
    local isPartOrModel = descendant:IsA("BasePart") or descendant:IsA("Model")
    if not isPartOrModel then
      return
    end
    if Settings.DodgeDebugMode then
      local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
        and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local distanceStr = "Unknown"
      if myRoot then
        local pcallSuccess, dist = pcall(function()
          local pos = descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant:GetPivot().Position
            or descendant.Position
          return (pos - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
        end)
        if pcallSuccess and dist then
          distanceStr = string.format("%.1f studs", dist)
        end
      end
    end
    local nameLower = descendant.Name:lower()
    if
      (nameLower:find("spear") or nameLower:find("projectile")) and not isPlayerWeapon(descendant)
    then
      table.insert(activeSpears, descendant)
      pcall(function()
        local char = localPlayer.Character
        local head = char
          and (char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
        local initialPos = descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant:GetPivot().Position
          or descendant.Position
        if head and (initialPos - head.Position).Magnitude < 10 then
          local localOffset = head.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(initialPos)
          task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(0.015)
            if not descendant or not descendant.Parent then
              return
            end
            local p1 = descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant:GetPivot().Position
              or descendant.Position
            local velocity = (p1 - initialPos) / 0.015
            local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if camera then
              local angle = math.acos(
                math.clamp(velocity.Unit:Dot(camera.CFrame.LookVector), -1, 1)
              ) * (180 / math.pi)
            end
          end)
        end
      end)
      local isSpecial = false
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      if char and char:GetAttribute("special") == true then
        isSpecial = true
      end
      task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.02)
        if not descendant or not descendant.Parent then
          return
        end
        local p0 = descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant:GetPivot().Position or descendant.Position
        local t0 = tick()
        task.wait(0.04)
        if not descendant or not descendant.Parent then
          return
        end
        local p1 = descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant:GetPivot().Position or descendant.Position
        local t1 = tick()
        task.wait(0.04)
        if not descendant or not descendant.Parent then
          return
        end
        local p2 = descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant:GetPivot().Position or descendant.Position
        local t2 = tick()
        local dt1 = t1 - t0
        local dt2 = t2 - t1
        if dt1 > 0.001 and dt2 > 0.001 then
          local v0 = (p1 - p0) / dt1
          local v1 = (p2 - p1) / dt2
          local acc = (v1 - v0) / dt1
          local speed = v0.Magnitude
          local ema = 0.25
          if speed > 40 and speed < 300 then
            if isSpecial then
              if speed > 155 then
                _G.VD_SpecialSpearSpeed = _G.VD_SpecialSpearSpeed * (1 - ema) + speed * ema
              end
            else
              if speed > 100 then
                _G.VD_NormalSpearSpeed = _G.VD_NormalSpearSpeed * (1 - ema) + speed * ema
              end
            end
          end
          local wGrav = workspace.Gravity / 2
          _G.VD_NormalSpearGravity = wGrav
          _G.VD_SpecialSpearGravity = wGrav
        end
      end)
      if isDodgeAllowed() then
        local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
          and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if myRoot then
          local pcallSuccess, dist = pcall(function()
            local pos = descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant:GetPivot().Position
              or descendant.Position
            return (pos - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
          end)
          if pcallSuccess and dist and dist < 120 then
            triggerVeilSpearDodge()
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if Settings.NoStun then
      local team = localPlayer.Team
      local isKiller = team and team.Name == "Killer"
      if not team then
        isKiller = localPlayer.Name:lower():find("killer") ~= nil
      end
      if isKiller and nameLower:find("stun") then
        local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
          and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if myRoot then
          local pcallSuccess, dist = pcall(function()
            local pos = descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant:GetPivot().Position
              or descendant.Position
            return (pos - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
          end)
          if pcallSuccess and dist and dist < 12 then
            pcall(function()
              descendant:Destroy()
            end)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  registerConnection(workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
    if not activeLoop or not isDodgeAllowed() then
      return
    end
    if
      (descendant:IsA("BasePart") or descendant:IsA("Model")) and not isPlayerWeapon(descendant)
    then
      local n = descendant.Name:lower()
      if n:find("spear") or n:find("projectile") then
        table.insert(activeSpears, descendant)
        local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
          and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if myRoot then
          local ok, dist = pcall(function()
            local p = descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant:GetPivot().Position
              or descendant.Position
            return (p - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
          end)
          if ok and dist and dist < 150 then
            fastDodge("DescendantAdded spear within " .. tostring(math.floor(dist)) .. " studs")
          end
        end
      end
    end
    pcall(handleNewInstance, descendant)
  end))
  registerConnection(workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(descendant)
    if not activeLoop or not isDodgeAllowed() then
      return
    end
    local idx = table.find(activeSpears, descendant)
    if idx then
      table.remove(activeSpears, idx)
    end
  end))
  local heartbeatConn
  heartbeatConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not activeLoop then
      if heartbeatConn then
        heartbeatConn:Disconnect()
      end
      return
    end
    if not isDodgeAllowed() or #activeSpears == 0 then
      return
    end
    local myRoot = localPlayer.Character
      and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then
      return
    end
    for _, spear in ipairs(activeSpears) do
      if spear and spear.Parent then
        local ok, dist = pcall(function()
          local p = spear:IsA("Model") and spear:GetPivot().Position or spear.Position
          return (p - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
        end)
        if ok and dist and dist < 60 then
          fastDodge("Heartbeat spear within " .. tostring(math.floor(dist)) .. " studs")
          break
        end
      end
    end
  end)

      end
    end)

  local cachedEndAttack = nil
  local lastChargeDataSearch2 = 0
  local function getChargeData()
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    if not char then
      return false, 0
    end
    local isVeil = (
      char:GetAttribute("MorphedKiller") == "Veil"
      or char:GetAttribute("Veil") == true
      or char:FindFirstChild("Spear") ~= nil
    )
    if not isVeil then
      return false, 0
    end
    local animScript = char:FindFirstChild("Animations")
    if not animScript then
      return false, 0
    end
    if not cachedEndAttack or (getfenv and getfenv(cachedEndAttack).script ~= animScript) then
      cachedEndAttack = nil
      local now = os.clock()
      if (now - lastChargeDataSearch2) < 3.0 then
        return false, 0
      end
      lastChargeDataSearch2 = now
      if typeof(getgc) == "function" then
        local funcs = getgc()
        if funcs then
          for _, f in ipairs(funcs) do
            if type(f) == "function" and (not islclosure or islclosure(f)) then
              if debug.info(f, "n") == "endAttack" and getfenv(f).script == animScript then
                cachedEndAttack = f
                break
              end
            end
          end
          table.clear(funcs)
        end
      end
    end
    if cachedEndAttack and typeof(getupvalues) == "function" then
      local ok, uvs = pcall(getupvalues, cachedEndAttack)
      if ok and uvs then
        local isCharging = uvs[2] == true
        local chargeStart = tonumber(uvs[9]) or 0
        return isCharging, chargeStart
      end
    end
    return false, 0
  end
  local function isSolidWorld(instance)
    if not instance or not instance:IsA("BasePart") then
      return false
    end
    if instance == workspace.Terrain then
      return true
    end
    if instance.Transparency >= 0.05 and not instance:HasTag("TrueInvis") then
      return false
    end
    return instance.CanCollide == true
  end
  local function isSpearInHand(character)
    if not character then
      return false
    end
    local spearModel = character:FindFirstChild("Spear")
    if spearModel then
      local spearPart = spearModel:FindFirstChild("Spear")
      if spearPart and spearPart:IsA("BasePart") then
        return spearPart.Transparency < 0.5
      end
    end
    if character:GetAttribute("VeilSpearEquipped") == true then
      return true
    end
    if character:GetAttribute("spearmode") == true then
      return true
    end
    return false
  end
  local function isOtherVeilHoldingSpear(character)
    if not character then
      return false
    end
    local isVeil = (
      character:GetAttribute("MorphedKiller") == "Veil"
      or character:GetAttribute("Veil") == true
      or character:FindFirstChild("spearmanager") ~= nil
      or character:FindFirstChild("Spear") ~= nil
    )
    if not isVeil then
      return false
    end
    return isSpearInHand(character)
  end

  local function createUniversalFOVCircle(name, defaultVisible, defaultRadius, defaultColor)
    local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    sg.Name = name .. "_Gui"
    sg.DisplayOrder = 99999
    sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
    sg.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    local parentFolder = (type(gethui) == "function" and gethui()) or guiParent or billboardParent
    sg.Parent = parentFolder
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Name = "FOVCircle"
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, defaultRadius * 2, 0, defaultRadius * 2)
    frame.Visible = defaultVisible
    frame.Parent = sg
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Thickness = 1.5
    stroke.Color = defaultColor
    stroke.Transparency = 0.15
    stroke.Parent = frame
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    corner.Parent = frame
    local wrapper = {}
    local visible = defaultVisible
    local radius = defaultRadius
    local color = defaultColor
    local transparency = 0.85
    local thickness = 1.5
    setmetatable(wrapper, {
      __index = function(t, key)
        if key == "Visible" then
          return visible
        elseif key == "Radius" then
          return radius
        elseif key == "Color" then
          return color
        elseif key == "Transparency" then
          return transparency
        elseif key == "Thickness" then
          return thickness
        end
      end,
      __newindex = function(t, key, val)
        if key == "Visible" then
          visible = val
          frame.Visible = val
        elseif key == "Radius" then
          radius = val
          frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, val * 2, 0, val * 2)
        elseif key == "Color" then
          color = val
          stroke.Color = val
        elseif key == "Transparency" then
          transparency = val
          stroke.Transparency = 1 - val
        elseif key == "Thickness" then
          thickness = val
          stroke.Thickness = val
        elseif key == "Position" then
          frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, val.X, 0, val.Y)
        end
      end,
    })
    function wrapper:Remove()
      pcall(function()
        sg:Destroy()
      end)
    end
    function wrapper:destroy()
      pcall(function()
        sg:Destroy()
      end)
    end
    return wrapper
  end
