  local localRayParams = RaycastParams.new()
  localRayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  localRayParams.IgnoreWater = true
  local otherRayParams = RaycastParams.new()
  otherRayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  otherRayParams.IgnoreWater = true
  local lastOtherVeilCheckTime = 0
  local cachedOtherVeilChar = nil
  local trajectoryConn
  trajectoryConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local isTrajEnabled = Settings.SpearTrajectory and isPremiumActive("SpearTrajectory")
    local isSilentAimOn = Settings.SpearSilentAim
      and Settings.SpearSilentAim.Enabled
      and isPremiumActive()
    if not activeLoop or (not isTrajEnabled and not isSilentAimOn) then
      HideLocalVisuals()
      HideOtherVisuals()
      return
    end
    local char = localPlayer.Character
    local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not char or not Camera then
      HideLocalVisuals()
      HideOtherVisuals()
      return
    end
    if not Holder or not Holder.Parent then
      pcall(setupVeilVisuals)
    end
    local isLocalVeil = (
      char:GetAttribute("MorphedKiller") == "Veil"
      or char:GetAttribute("Veil") == true
      or char:FindFirstChild("Spear") ~= nil
    )
    local isSpearMode = isLocalVeil and isSpearInHand(char)
    if not isSpearMode then
      HideLocalVisuals()
    else
      local isCharging, chargeStart = getChargeData()
      local now = (
        typeof(workspace.GetServerTimeNow) == "function" and workspace.GetServerTimeNow(workspace)
      ) or os.clock()
      local chargeTime = 1.0
      if isCharging and chargeStart > 0 then
        chargeTime = math.max(SpearConfig.MinChargeTime, now - chargeStart)
      else
        chargeTime = SpearConfig.FullChargeTime
      end
      local currentSpeed = math.clamp(chargeTime * SpearConfig.MaxSpeed, 1, SpearConfig.MaxSpeed)
      local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position + Camera.CFrame.LookVector * SpearConfig.SpawnOffset
      local lookVector = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
      local targetPart = nil
      if
        Settings.SpearAimbot
        and Settings.SpearAimbot.Enabled
        and spearAimbotTarget
        and spearAimbotTarget.Parent
        and isPremiumActive()
      then
        targetPart = spearAimbotTarget
      end
      local velocity = lookVector * currentSpeed
      local gravity = SpearConfig.Gravity
      localRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, Camera, Holder }
      local pathPoints = { origin }
      local dt = SpearConfig.StepDt
      for i = 1, SpearConfig.SegmentsCount do
        local t = i * dt
        local pt = origin + velocity * t + 0.5 * gravity * (t * t)
        table.insert(pathPoints, pt)
      end
      local targetLocked = false
      local hitPosition = nil
      local hitStepIndex = SpearConfig.SegmentsCount
      if SpearWorld and type(SpearWorld.characterHit) == "function" then
        for i = 1, #pathPoints - 1 do
          local p1 = pathPoints[i]
          local p2 = pathPoints[i + 1]
          local charHit = SpearWorld.characterHit(p1, p2, char)
          if charHit then
            targetLocked = true
            hitPosition = charHit.Position
            hitStepIndex = i
            break
          end
        end
      end
      if not targetLocked then
        for i = 1, #pathPoints - 1 do
          local p1 = pathPoints[i]
          local p2 = pathPoints[i + 1]
          for _, plyr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plyr ~= localPlayer and plyr.Character then
              local root = plyr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                or plyr.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
              if root then
                local seg = p2 - p1
                local segLen = seg.Magnitude
                if segLen > 0 then
                  local dir = seg / segLen
                  local toRoot = root.Position - p1
                  local proj = math.clamp(toRoot:Dot(dir), 0, segLen)
                  local closest = p1 + dir * proj
                  if (closest - root.Position).Magnitude <= 3.2 then
                    targetLocked = true
                    hitPosition = closest
                    hitStepIndex = i
                    break
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
          if targetLocked then
            break
          end
        end
      end
      local isNoclip = (Settings.SpearTrajectoryNoclip == true)
      if not targetLocked then
        for i = 1, #pathPoints - 1 do
          local p1 = pathPoints[i]
          local p2 = pathPoints[i + 1]
          local displacement = p2 - p1
          local ray = workspace:Raycast(p1, displacement, localRayParams)
          if ray then
            local okInst, hitInst = pcall(function()
              return ray.Instance
            end)
            if okInst and hitInst then
              if isNoclip then
                if hitInst == workspace.Terrain or ray.Normal.Y > 0.65 then
                  if isSolidWorld(hitInst) then
                    hitPosition = ray.Position
                    hitStepIndex = i
                    break
                  end
                end
              else
                if isSolidWorld(hitInst) then
                  hitPosition = ray.Position
                  hitStepIndex = i
                  break
                end
              end
            elseif ray.Normal.Y > 0.65 then
              hitPosition = ray.Position
              hitStepIndex = i
              break
            end
          end
        end
      end
      local defaultCol = TrajectoryColors[Settings.SpearTrajectoryColor]
        or Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255)
      local finalColor = targetLocked and TargetLockedColor or defaultCol
      for i = 1, SpearConfig.SegmentsCount do
        local p = LocalSquareSegments[i]
        if p then
          if i <= hitStepIndex then
            local p1 = pathPoints[i]
            local p2 = (i == hitStepIndex and hitPosition) or pathPoints[i + 1]
            if p2 then
              local segLen = (p2 - p1).Magnitude
              if segLen > 0.001 then
                local curThick = targetLocked and (StripThickness * 1.3) or StripThickness
                p.Size = Vector3.new(curThick, curThick, segLen)
                p.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((p1 + p2) * 0.5, p2)
                p.Color = finalColor
                local tRatio = i / SpearConfig.SegmentsCount
                p.Transparency = targetLocked and (0.04 + 0.18 * tRatio) or (0.08 + 0.24 * tRatio)
              else
                p.Transparency = 1
              end
            else
              p.Transparency = 1
            end
          else
            p.Transparency = 1
          end
        end
      end
      if hitPosition and LocalHitMarkerBall then
        LocalHitMarkerBall.Position = hitPosition
        LocalHitMarkerBall.Color = finalColor
        LocalHitMarkerBall.Size = targetLocked and Vector3.new(0.38, 0.38, 0.38)
          or Vector3.new(0.24, 0.24, 0.24)
        LocalHitMarkerBall.Transparency = targetLocked and 0.02 or 0.1
        if LocalHitMarkerRing then
          LocalHitMarkerRing.Position = hitPosition
          LocalHitMarkerRing.Color = finalColor
          local pPrev = pathPoints[math.max(1, hitStepIndex)]
          local hitDir = (hitPosition - pPrev).Unit
          if hitDir.Magnitude > 0.01 then
            LocalHitMarkerRing.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hitPosition, hitPosition + hitDir)
              * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
          end
          local ringDiameter = targetLocked and 0.75 or 0.55
          LocalHitMarkerRing.Size = Vector3.new(0.04, ringDiameter, ringDiameter)
          LocalHitMarkerRing.Transparency = targetLocked and 0.15 or 0.35
        end
      else
        if LocalHitMarkerBall then
          LocalHitMarkerBall.Transparency = 1
        end
        if LocalHitMarkerRing then
          LocalHitMarkerRing.Transparency = 1
        end
      end
      if aimbotLockAdorn then
        if targetPart and targetPart.Parent then
          aimbotLockAdorn.Adornee = targetPart
          aimbotLockAdorn.Transparency = 0.45
        else
          aimbotLockAdorn.Adornee = nil
          aimbotLockAdorn.Transparency = 1
        end
      end
    end
    local nowOtherCheck = os.clock()
    if (nowOtherCheck - lastOtherVeilCheckTime) >= 1.2 then
      lastOtherVeilCheckTime = nowOtherCheck
      cachedOtherVeilChar = nil
      for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= localPlayer and p.Character then
          if isOtherVeilHoldingSpear(p.Character) then
            cachedOtherVeilChar = p.Character
            break
          end
        end
      end
    elseif
      cachedOtherVeilChar
      and (not cachedOtherVeilChar.Parent or not isOtherVeilHoldingSpear(cachedOtherVeilChar))
    then
      cachedOtherVeilChar = nil
    end
    local otherVeilChar = cachedOtherVeilChar
    if not otherVeilChar or not otherVeilChar:FindFirstChild("Head") then
      HideOtherVisuals()
      return
    end
    local otherLook = otherVeilChar:GetAttribute("CamLook")
    if not otherLook or typeof(otherLook) ~= "Vector3" or otherLook.Magnitude < 0.1 then
      otherLook = otherVeilChar.Head.CFrame.LookVector
    end
    local otherOrigin = otherVeilChar.Head.Position + otherLook * SpearConfig.SpawnOffset
    local otherVelocity = otherLook * SpearConfig.MaxSpeed
    local otherGravity = SpearConfig.Gravity
    local otherPoints = { otherOrigin }
    local dt = SpearConfig.StepDt
    for i = 1, SpearConfig.SegmentsCount do
      local t = i * dt
      local pt = otherOrigin + otherVelocity * t + 0.5 * otherGravity * (t * t)
      table.insert(otherPoints, pt)
    end
    otherRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { otherVeilChar, char, Camera, Holder }
    local aimingAtLocalPlayer = false
    local otherTargetLocked = false
    local otherHitStep = SpearConfig.SegmentsCount
    local otherHitPos = nil
    if SpearWorld and type(SpearWorld.characterHit) == "function" then
      for i = 1, #otherPoints - 1 do
        local p1 = otherPoints[i]
        local p2 = otherPoints[i + 1]
        local charHit = SpearWorld.characterHit(p1, p2, otherVeilChar)
        if charHit then
          otherTargetLocked = true
          otherHitPos = charHit.Position
          otherHitStep = i
          local hitChar = nil
          pcall(function()
            hitChar = charHit.Character
          end)
          if hitChar and (hitChar == char or (char and hitChar.Name == char.Name)) then
            aimingAtLocalPlayer = true
          end
          break
        end
      end
    end
    if not otherTargetLocked then
      local isNoclip = (Settings.SpearTrajectoryNoclip == true)
      for i = 1, #otherPoints - 1 do
        local p1 = otherPoints[i]
        local p2 = otherPoints[i + 1]
        local disp = p2 - p1
        local r = workspace:Raycast(p1, disp, otherRayParams)
        if r then
          local okInst, hitInst = pcall(function()
            return r.Instance
          end)
          if okInst and hitInst then
            if isNoclip then
              if hitInst == workspace.Terrain or r.Normal.Y > 0.65 then
                if isSolidWorld(hitInst) then
                  otherHitPos = r.Position
                  otherHitStep = i
                  break
                end
              end
            else
              if isSolidWorld(hitInst) then
                otherHitPos = r.Position
                otherHitStep = i
                break
              end
            end
          elseif r.Normal.Y > 0.65 then
            otherHitPos = r.Position
            otherHitStep = i
            break
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local otherColor = aimingAtLocalPlayer and OtherVeilAimingAtMeColor or OtherVeilColor
    for i = 1, SpearConfig.SegmentsCount do
      local p = OtherSquareSegments[i]
      if p then
        if i <= otherHitStep then
          local p1 = otherPoints[i]
          local p2 = (i == otherHitStep and otherHitPos) or otherPoints[i + 1]
          if p2 then
            local segLen = (p2 - p1).Magnitude
            if segLen > 0.001 then
              p.Size = Vector3.new(StripThickness, StripThickness, segLen)
              p.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((p1 + p2) * 0.5, p2)
              p.Color = otherColor
              local tRatio = i / SpearConfig.SegmentsCount
              p.Transparency = 0.08 + 0.24 * tRatio
            else
              p.Transparency = 1
            end
          else
            p.Transparency = 1
          end
        else
          p.Transparency = 1
        end
      end
    end
    if otherHitPos and OtherHitMarkerBall then
      OtherHitMarkerBall.Position = otherHitPos
      OtherHitMarkerBall.Color = otherColor
      OtherHitMarkerBall.Size = (aimingAtLocalPlayer or otherTargetLocked)
          and Vector3.new(0.38, 0.38, 0.38)
        or Vector3.new(0.24, 0.24, 0.24)
      OtherHitMarkerBall.Transparency = 0.1
      if OtherHitMarkerRing then
        OtherHitMarkerRing.Position = otherHitPos
        OtherHitMarkerRing.Color = otherColor
        local pPrev = otherPoints[math.max(1, otherHitStep)]
        local hitDir = (otherHitPos - pPrev).Unit
        if hitDir.Magnitude > 0.01 then
          OtherHitMarkerRing.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(otherHitPos, otherHitPos + hitDir)
            * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
        end
        OtherHitMarkerRing.Size = Vector3.new(0.04, 0.6, 0.6)
        OtherHitMarkerRing.Transparency = 0.35
      end
    else
      if OtherHitMarkerBall then
        OtherHitMarkerBall.Transparency = 1
      end
      if OtherHitMarkerRing then
        OtherHitMarkerRing.Transparency = 1
      end
    end
  end)
  registerConnection(trajectoryConn)
end)

(function()
  local lastFixTimers = {}
  local function cancelTimers()
    for _, t in ipairs(lastFixTimers) do
      pcall(task.cancel, t)
    end
    table.clear(lastFixTimers)
  end
  local function runSpawnFix()
    pcall(function()
      local char = localPlayer.Character
      if not char then
        return
      end
      local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not root or not hum then
        return
      end
      local rep = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
      local rankedState = rep:GetAttribute("RankedState")
      if rankedState == "Intro" or rep:GetAttribute("Darkness2Covered") == true then
        return
      end
      if localPlayer:GetAttribute("isspectating") then
        pcall(function()
          localPlayer:SetAttribute("isspectating", false)
        end)
      end
      if char:GetAttribute("overridelookscript") then
        pcall(function()
          char:SetAttribute("overridelookscript", false)
        end)
      end
      local roundActive = char:GetAttribute("RoundScriptsActive")
      local needScriptRecovery = (roundActive ~= true)
      if needScriptRecovery then
        pcall(function()
          char:SetAttribute("RoundScriptsActive", true)
        end)
        pcall(function()
          char:SetAttribute("RankedIntroComplete", true)
        end)
        pcall(function()
          local remotes = rep:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
          local gameRemotes = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Game")
          local startEvent = gameRemotes and gameRemotes:FindFirstChild("Start")
          if startEvent and startEvent:IsA("BindableEvent") then
            startEvent:Fire()
          end
        end)
        local enableRemote = nil
        pcall(function()
          enableRemote = rep.Remotes.Game:FindFirstChild("EnableScript")
        end)
        for _, desc in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
          pcall(function()
            if desc:IsA("LocalScript") then
              if not desc.Enabled then
                desc.Enabled = true
              end
            elseif desc:IsA("Script") and desc.Parent == char and enableRemote then
              enableRemote:FireServer(desc)
            end
          end)
        end
      end
      pcall(function()
        local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if not playerGui then
          return
        end
        local darkness = playerGui:FindFirstChild("Darkness")
        if darkness then
          local f1 = darkness:FindFirstChild("Frame")
          if f1 then
            pcall(function()
              f1.Visible = false
            end)
          end
          local f2 = darkness:FindFirstChild("Frame2")
          if f2 then
            pcall(function()
              f2.Visible = false
            end)
          end
        end
        local isMob = isMobile or (localPlayer:GetAttribute("platform") == "Mobile")
        for _, gui in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
          if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") and gui.Name ~= "VD_GuiParentProbe" then
            local n = gui.Name
            local isMobGui = (n:sub(-4) == "-mob")
            local isConGui = (n:sub(-4) == "-con")
            if isMob then
              if isMobGui and not gui.Enabled then
                gui.Enabled = true
              end
            else
              if not isMobGui and not isConGui and not gui.Enabled then
                gui.Enabled = true
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end)
      pcall(function()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam and cam.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable and rankedState ~= "Intro" then
          cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
          cam.CameraSubject = hum

          if head then

          end

            if acc:IsA("Accessory") then
              local handle = acc:FindFirstChild("Handle")
              if handle then
                handle.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
              end
            end
          end
          if hum and hum.CameraOffset == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) then
            hum.CameraOffset = Vector3.new(0, 0.20000000298023224, -1.5)
          end
        end
      end)
      local isAnchored = false
      for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do

      if hum then

        end
        if hum.WalkSpeed < 1 then

      end
    end)

  local function scheduleFixSequence()
    cancelTimers()
    local team = localPlayer.Team
    local isAllowedTeam = team
      and (
        team.Name == "Survivors"
        or team.Name == "Killer"
        or team.Name:lower():find("killer")
        or team.Name:lower():find("survivor")
      )
    if not isAllowedTeam then
      return
    end
    local delays = { 1.5, 4.0, 7.5, 11.0, 16.0 }
    for _, sec in ipairs(delays) do
      local t = task.delay(sec, function()
        runSpawnFix()
      end)
      table.insert(lastFixTimers, t)
    end
  end
  registerConnection(localPlayer:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(function()
    pcall(scheduleFixSequence)

        end
      end))
    end
  end)
  task.defer(function()
    pcall(scheduleFixSequence)
  end)

      pcall(checkAndPatch, desc)

  local detectMap = getMapName
  local function findDetectedKiller()
    for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
      local isK = false
      local team = player.Team
      if team and (team.Name == "Killer" or team.Name:lower():find("killer")) then
        isK = true
      elseif player:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or player:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true then
        isK = true
      elseif
        player.Character
        and (
          player.Character:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer"
          or player.Character:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true
        )
      then
        isK = true
      end
      if isK then
        return player
      end
    end
    local highestChance = -1
    local killerPlayer = nil
    for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
      local allow = player:GetAttribute("AllowKiller")
      if allow == true then
        local chance = player:GetAttribute("KillerChance") or 0
        if chance > highestChance then
          highestChance = chance
          killerPlayer = player
        end
      end
    end
    return killerPlayer
  end
  local lastScannedKillerChar = nil
  local lastScannedKillerPlayer = nil
  local cachedKillerPerks = {}
  local lastScanTime = 0
  local function getKillerPerks(killerPlayer, killerChar)
    local now = tick()
    if
      (killerChar and killerChar == lastScannedKillerChar)
      or (not killerChar and killerPlayer and killerPlayer == lastScannedKillerPlayer)
    then
      if now - lastScanTime < 6.0 then
        return cachedKillerPerks
      end
    end
    lastScannedKillerChar = killerChar
    lastScannedKillerPlayer = killerPlayer
    lastScanTime = now
    local detectedPerks = {}
    local function checkName(name)
      if not name or name == "" then
        return
      end
      local cleanN = cleanString(name)
      for _, perk in ipairs(cleanedPerks) do
        if cleanN == perk.clean or cleanN:find(perk.clean, 1, true) then
          if not table.find(detectedPerks, perk.name) then
            table.insert(detectedPerks, perk.name)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if killerChar then
      pcall(function()
        for _, desc in ipairs(killerChar:GetDescendants()) do
          if
            not (
              desc:IsA("BasePart")
              or desc:IsA("JointInstance")
              or desc:IsA("Attachment")
              or desc:IsA("Constraint")
              or desc:IsA("SpecialMesh")
              or desc:IsA("WrapTarget")
              or desc:IsA("WrapLayer")
            )
          then
            checkName(desc.Name)
            if desc:IsA("ValueObject") and type(desc.Value) == "string" then
              checkName(desc.Value)
            end
          end
        end
        for attrName, _ in pairs(killerChar:GetAttributes()) do
          checkName(attrName)
        end
      end)
    end
    if killerPlayer then
      pcall(function()
        for attrName, _ in pairs(killerPlayer:GetAttributes()) do
          checkName(attrName)
        end
        local activePerks = killerPlayer:FindFirstChild("EquippedPerks")
          or killerPlayer:FindFirstChild("Perks")
        if activePerks then
          for _, child in ipairs(activePerks:GetChildren()) do
            checkName(child.Name)
            if child:IsA("ValueObject") and type(child.Value) == "string" then
              checkName(child.Value)
            end
          end
        end
      end)
    end
    cachedKillerPerks = detectedPerks
    for _, pk in ipairs(detectedPerks) do
      local pkLower = pk:lower()
      if pkLower:find("scourge") or pkLower:find("king") then
        _G.VD_KillerHasKingsScourge = true
        break
      end
    end
    return detectedPerks
  end

        Settings.InfoBannerPositionOffsetX = banner.Position.X.Offset
        Settings.InfoBannerPositionScaleY = banner.Position.Y.Scale
        Settings.InfoBannerPositionOffsetY = banner.Position.Y.Offset

      end)

  end)
  while activeLoop do
    pcall(function()
      local show = Settings.ShowInfoBanner

      if not show then

      end
      local accentHex = string.format(
        "#%02X%02X%02X",
        math.floor(UI.Accent.R * 255),
        math.floor(UI.Accent.G * 255),
        math.floor(UI.Accent.B * 255)
      )
      brandLbl.Text = string.format('<font color="%s"><b>HYPNOSIS</b></font>', accentHex)

          '<font color="%s"><b>MAP</b></font>  <font color="#FFFFFF">%s</font>',
          accentHex,
          mapName
        )
        mapChip.Visible = true
      else
        mapChip.Visible = false
      end
      local killerPlayer = findDetectedKiller()
      local selectedKiller = "None"
      if killerPlayer then
        selectedKiller = killerPlayer:GetAttribute("SelectedKiller") or killerPlayer.Name
      end
      local killerChar = killerPlayer and killerPlayer.Character
      if killerPlayer and not killerChar then
        killerChar = workspace:FindFirstChild(killerPlayer.Name)
        if not killerChar then
          for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if
              child:IsA("Model")
              and (child:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or child:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true)
            then
              killerChar = child
              break
            end
          end
        end
      end
      if killerChar and (selectedKiller == "None" or selectedKiller == killerPlayer.Name) then
        local charName = killerChar.Name
        if charName ~= killerPlayer.Name and charName ~= "Character" then
          selectedKiller = charName
        end
      end
      if Settings.InfoBannerShowKiller then
        killerLbl.Text = string.format(
          '<font color="%s"><b>KILLER</b></font>  <font color="#FFFFFF">%s</font>',
          accentHex,
          tostring(selectedKiller)
        )
        killerChip.Visible = true
      else
        killerChip.Visible = false

      if Settings.InfoBannerShowPerks then

      else

      end
      if Settings.InfoBannerShowPing then

          if type(p) == "number" and p > 0 then
            ping = p * 1000
          end
        end)
        pingLbl.Text = string.format(

          math.floor(ping)
        )
        pingChip.Visible = true
      else
        pingChip.Visible = false
      end
      if not banner.Visible then
        banner.Visible = true
      end
    end)
    task.wait(1.5)
  end
end)

  local fpsAccumTime = 0

  registerConnection(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if not Settings.ShowLiveFPS or not fpsGui or not fpsGui.Parent or not fpsGui.Visible then
      return
    end
    frameCount = frameCount + 1
    fpsAccumTime = fpsAccumTime + dt
    if fpsAccumTime >= 0.15 then
      currentLiveFPS = math.round(frameCount / fpsAccumTime)
      frameCount = 0
      fpsAccumTime = 0

        or (currentLiveFPS >= 30 and "#FFD3B6" or "#FF8B8B")
      fpsLbl.Text = string.format(

        fpsColor,
        currentLiveFPS
      )
    end
  end))
end
local function getSurvivorsBoundingBox(frame)
  local minX, minY = math.huge, math.huge
  local maxX, maxY = -math.huge, -math.huge
  local found = false
  for _, child in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
    if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Name:find("^Survivor%d+$") and child.Visible then
      found = true
      local absPos = child.AbsolutePosition - frame.AbsolutePosition
      local absSize = child.AbsoluteSize
      local x = absPos.X
      local y = absPos.Y
      local w = absSize.X
      local h = absSize.Y
      if x < minX then
        minX = x
      end
      if y < minY then
        minY = y
      end
      if x + w > maxX then
        maxX = x + w
      end
      if y + h > maxY then
        maxY = y + h
      end
    end
  end
  if found and maxX > minX and maxY > minY then
    return UDim2.new(0, minX, 0, minY), UDim2.new(0, maxX - minX, 0, maxY - minY)
  end
  return nil, nil
end

                  end
                end
              end
            end
          else
            local realDisplay = localPlayer and localPlayer.DisplayName or "User"
            local realUser = localPlayer and localPlayer.Name or "User"
            if sideDisplay and sideDisplay.Text ~= realDisplay then
              sideDisplay.Text = realDisplay
            end
            if sideUser and sideUser.Text ~= ("@" .. realUser) then
              sideUser.Text = "@" .. realUser
            end
            if welcomeLbl and welcomeLbl.Text ~= ("Welcome back, " .. realDisplay .. "!") then
              welcomeLbl.Text = "Welcome back, " .. realDisplay .. "!"
            end
            local curPlayer = _G.VD_CurrentSelectedPlayer or localPlayer
            if
              curPlayer == localPlayer or (curPlayer and curPlayer.UserId == localPlayer.UserId)
            then
              local realHeader = realDisplay .. " (@" .. realUser .. ")"
              if homeHeader and homeHeader.Text ~= realHeader then
                homeHeader.Text = realHeader
              end
              if homeAvatar then
                local realThumb = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id="
                  .. tostring(localPlayer.UserId)
                  .. "&w=150&h=150"
                if homeAvatar.Image ~= realThumb then
                  homeAvatar.Image = realThumb
                end
              end
            end
            if homePlayerScroll then
              for _, btn in ipairs(homePlayerScroll:GetChildren()) do
                if btn:IsA("TextButton") and btn:GetAttribute("PlayerName") == localPlayer.Name then
                  local nameLbl = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
                  local img = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("ImageLabel")
                  if nameLbl and nameLbl.Text ~= realDisplay then
                    nameLbl.Text = realDisplay
                  end
                  if img and img.Image == "rbxassetid://0" then
                    img.Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id="
                      .. tostring(localPlayer.UserId)
                      .. "&w=150&h=150"
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end)
    end)
  end
end)
local lastCameraPos = nil
local bindCameraStretch = nil
local function updateCameraStretch(dt)
  if not activeLoop then
    return
  end
  pcall(function()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera or camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
      return
    end
    local rep = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    if
      rep:GetAttribute("RankedState") == "Intro" or rep:GetAttribute("Darkness2Covered") == true
    then
      return
    end
    local isStiffnessActive = Settings.CameraStiffnessEnabled
    local stiffness = isStiffnessActive and Settings.CameraStiffness or 1.0
    if
      isStiffnessActive
      and stiffness
      and type(stiffness) == "number"
      and stiffness < 0.999
      and stiffness > 0
    then
      local currentPos = camera.CFrame.Position
      local currentRot = camera.CFrame - currentPos
      if lastCameraPos then
        if (currentPos - lastCameraPos).Magnitude > 20 then
          lastCameraPos = currentPos
        end
        local delta = math.clamp(dt or (1 / 60), 0.001, 0.1)
        local speed = math.clamp(stiffness, 0.005, 1.0) * 45
        local alpha = math.clamp(1 - math.exp(-speed * delta), 0.001, 1.0)
        local smoothedPos = lastCameraPos:Lerp(currentPos, alpha)
        camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(smoothedPos) * currentRot
        lastCameraPos = smoothedPos
      else
        lastCameraPos = currentPos
      end
    else
      lastCameraPos = camera.CFrame.Position
    end
    local isAspectEnabled = Settings.AspectRatioEnabled
    local rawAspect = isAspectEnabled and (Settings.AspectRatio or 0.65) or 1.0
    local aspectVal = rawAspect
    if isAspectEnabled and aspectVal > 1.05 and aspectVal <= 2.5 then
      aspectVal = aspectVal / (16 / 9)
    end
    local isAspectCustom = isAspectEnabled and (math.abs(aspectVal - 1.0) > 0.005)
    local isFovCustom = (Settings.FOV and Settings.FOV > 120)
    if not isAspectCustom and not isFovCustom then
      if camera.FieldOfView ~= Settings.FOV then
        camera.FieldOfView = Settings.FOV
      end
      local cf = camera.CFrame
      if cf.X ~= cf.X or cf.Y ~= cf.Y or cf.Z ~= cf.Z then
        return
      end
      local r = cf.RightVector
      local u = cf.UpVector
      if r.Magnitude < 0.01 or u.Magnitude < 0.01 then
        return
      end
      if math.abs(r.Magnitude - 1) > 0.001 or math.abs(u.Magnitude - 1) > 0.001 then
        camera.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(cf.Position, r.Unit, u.Unit)
      end
      return
    end
    local scaleX = 1.0
    local scaleY = isAspectCustom and math.clamp(aspectVal, 0.05, 3.0) or 1.0
    local effectiveFov = math.min(Settings.FOV, 120)
    if camera.FieldOfView ~= effectiveFov then
      camera.FieldOfView = effectiveFov
    end
    if isFovCustom then
      local targetFovRad = math.rad(Settings.FOV / 2)
      local baseFovRad = math.rad(effectiveFov / 2)
      local fovScale = math.tan(baseFovRad) / math.tan(targetFovRad)
      scaleX = scaleX * fovScale
      scaleY = scaleY * fovScale
    end
    local cf = camera.CFrame
    if cf.X ~= cf.X or cf.Y ~= cf.Y or cf.Z ~= cf.Z then
      return
    end
    local r = cf.RightVector
    local u = cf.UpVector
    if r.Magnitude < 0.01 or u.Magnitude < 0.01 then
      return
    end
    local cleanCF = CFrame.fromMatrix(cf.Position, r.Unit, u.Unit)
    if scaleX ~= scaleX or scaleY ~= scaleY or scaleX <= 0 or scaleY <= 0 then
      return
    end
    camera.CFrame = cleanCF * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0, scaleX, 0, 0, 0, scaleY, 0, 0, 0, 1)
  end)
end
bindCameraStretch = function()
  pcall(function()
    RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("VD_CameraStretch")
  end)
  pcall(function()
    RunService:BindToRenderStep(
      "VD_CameraStretch",
      Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1,
      updateCameraStretch
    )
  end)
end
bindCameraStretch()
registerConnection(workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
  bindCameraStretch()
  pcall(function()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam or cam.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
      return
    end
    local rep = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    if
      rep:GetAttribute("RankedState") == "Intro" or rep:GetAttribute("Darkness2Covered") == true
    then
      return
    end
    if Settings.FOV and type(Settings.FOV) == "number" then
      cam.FieldOfView = math.min(Settings.FOV, 120)
    end
  end)
end));
(function()
  local highlightColors = {
    Cyan = Color3.fromRGB(0, 240, 255),
    Red = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50),
    Green = Color3.fromRGB(50, 255, 50),
    Yellow = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 50),
    Purple = Color3.fromRGB(170, 80, 255),
    Orange = Color3.fromRGB(255, 125, 0),
    Pink = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 200),
    White = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    Blue = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 255),
  }
  local targetBoxState = { gui = nil, frame = nil, corners = {} }
  setupTargetBoxGui = function()
    if targetBoxState.gui and targetBoxState.gui.Parent then
      return
    end
    local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    g.Name = "VD_SilentAimTargetGui"
    g.ResetOnSpawn = false
    g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    g.DisplayOrder = 999
    g.Parent = guiParent
    targetBoxState.gui = g
    local f = Instance.new("Frame")
    f.Name = "TargetBox"
    f.BackgroundTransparency = 1.0
    f.BorderSizePixel = 0
    f.Visible = false
    f.Parent = g
    targetBoxState.frame = f
    local cornerLen = 14
    local cornerThick = 2.5
    local function createCornerLine(name, anchor, pos, size)
      local line = Instance.new("Frame")
      line.Name = name
      line.AnchorPoint = anchor
      line.Position = pos
      line.Size = size
      line.BorderSizePixel = 0
      line.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
      line.Parent = f
      return line
    end
    targetBoxState.corners = {
      TL_H = createCornerLine(
        "TL_H",
        Vector2.new(0, 0),
        UDim2.new(0, -1, 0, -1),
        UDim2.new(0, cornerLen, 0, cornerThick)
      ),
      TL_V = createCornerLine(
        "TL_V",
        Vector2.new(0, 0),
        UDim2.new(0, -1, 0, -1),
        UDim2.new(0, cornerThick, 0, cornerLen)
      ),
      TR_H = createCornerLine(
        "TR_H",
        Vector2.new(1, 0),
        UDim2.new(1, 1, 0, -1),
        UDim2.new(0, cornerLen, 0, cornerThick)
      ),
      TR_V = createCornerLine(
        "TR_V",
        Vector2.new(1, 0),
        UDim2.new(1, 1, 0, -1),
        UDim2.new(0, cornerThick, 0, cornerLen)
      ),
      BL_H = createCornerLine(
        "BL_H",
        Vector2.new(0, 1),
        UDim2.new(0, -1, 1, 1),
        UDim2.new(0, cornerLen, 0, cornerThick)
      ),
      BL_V = createCornerLine(
        "BL_V",
        Vector2.new(0, 1),
        UDim2.new(0, -1, 1, 1),
        UDim2.new(0, cornerThick, 0, cornerLen)
      ),
      BR_H = createCornerLine(
        "BR_H",
        Vector2.new(1, 1),
        UDim2.new(1, 1, 1, 1),
        UDim2.new(0, cornerLen, 0, cornerThick)
      ),
      BR_V = createCornerLine(
        "BR_V",
        Vector2.new(1, 1),
        UDim2.new(1, 1, 1, 1),
        UDim2.new(0, cornerThick, 0, cornerLen)
      ),
    }
  end
  getSilentAimTarget = function()
    if not isPremiumActive() then
      return nil, nil
    end
    local localChar = localPlayer.Character
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam or not localChar then
      return nil, nil
    end
    local screenCenter = cam.ViewportSize / 2
    local bestTargetChar = nil
    local bestDist = math.huge
    local bestType = nil
    local isSpearActive = Settings.SpearSilentAim
      and Settings.SpearSilentAim.Enabled
      and Settings.SpearSilentAim.TargetHighlightEnabled
    local isRevolverActive = Settings.RevolverSilentAim
      and Settings.RevolverSilentAim.Enabled
      and Settings.RevolverSilentAim.TargetHighlightEnabled
    if not isSpearActive and not isRevolverActive then
      return nil, nil
    end
    local equippedWeapon = nil
    pcall(function()
      for _, child in ipairs(localChar:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Tool") or child:IsA("Model") then
          local n = child.Name:lower()
          if
            n:find("twist")
            or n:find("fate")
            or n:find("revolver")
            or child:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
            or child:FindFirstChild("gun", true)
          then
            equippedWeapon = "Twist of Fate"
            break
          elseif n:find("spear") or n:find("veil") then
            equippedWeapon = "Veil Spear"
            break
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    local activeMode = nil
    if (equippedWeapon == "Twist of Fate" or isRevolverActive) and not isSpearActive then
      activeMode = "Revolver"
    elseif equippedWeapon == "Twist of Fate" and isRevolverActive then
      activeMode = "Revolver"
    elseif (equippedWeapon == "Veil Spear" or isSpearActive) and not isRevolverActive then
      activeMode = "Spear"
    else
      if isSpearActive then
        activeMode = "Spear"
      elseif isRevolverActive then
        activeMode = "Revolver"
      end
    end
    if not activeMode then
      return nil, nil
    end
    local fovRadius = (activeMode == "Spear") and (Settings.SpearSilentAim.FOVRadius or 240)
      or (Settings.RevolverSilentAim.FOVRadius or 200)
    local targetFilter = (activeMode == "Spear") and "Both Teams"
      or (Settings.RevolverSilentAim.Target or "Both Teams")
    local candidates = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if p ~= localPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:IsA("Model") then
        local pTeam = p.Team and p.Team.Name or ""
        local isAllowed = (activeMode == "Spear")
          or (targetFilter == "Both Teams")
          or (targetFilter == "Survivors" and pTeam == "Survivors")
          or (targetFilter == "Killer" and pTeam == "Killer")
        if isAllowed then
          local pChar = p.Character
          local pRoot = pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or pChar:FindFirstChild(targetPartName)
            or (pChar:IsA("Model") and pChar.PrimaryPart)
          local pHum = pChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
          if pRoot and pHum and pHum.Health > 0 then
            local screenPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(pRoot.Position)
            if onScreen and screenPos.Z > 0 then
              local d = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - screenCenter).Magnitude
              if d <= fovRadius then
                table.insert(
                  candidates,
                  {
                    player = p,
                    character = pChar,
                    part = pRoot,
                    dist = d,
                    health = pHum.Health,
                    maxHealth = pHum.MaxHealth or 100,
                  }
                )
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local priority = (activeMode == "Spear") and (Settings.SpearSilentAim.Priority or "Nearest")
      or (Settings.RevolverSilentAim.Priority or "Nearest")
    local best = sortCandidatesByPriority(candidates, priority, fovRadius)
    if best then
      bestTargetChar = best.character
      bestType = activeMode
    end
    return bestTargetChar, bestType
  end
  get2DBoundingBox = function(targetChar)
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam or not targetChar then
      return nil
    end
    local head = targetChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local root = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      or (targetChar:IsA("Model") and targetChar.PrimaryPart)
    if not root then
      return nil
    end
    local headPos = head and (head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.7, 0))
      or (root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0))
    local feetPos = root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
    local topPoint, topOnScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(headPos)
    local bottomPoint, bottomOnScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(feetPos)
    local rootPoint, rootOnScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
    if not rootOnScreen or rootPoint.Z <= 0 then
      return nil
    end
    local height = math.abs(bottomPoint.Y - topPoint.Y)
    local width = math.clamp(height * 0.6, 12, 350)
    if height < 6 then
      return nil
    end
    return rootPoint.X - (width / 2), topPoint.Y, width, height
  end
  updateSilentAimTargetHighlight = function()
    local spearAimOn = Settings.SpearSilentAim
      and Settings.SpearSilentAim.Enabled
      and isPremiumActive()
    local revAimOn = Settings.RevolverSilentAim
      and Settings.RevolverSilentAim.Enabled
      and isPremiumActive()
    if not spearAimOn and not revAimOn then
      if targetBoxState.frame and targetBoxState.frame.Visible then
        targetBoxState.frame.Visible = false
      end
      return
    end
    setupTargetBoxGui()
    local targetChar, activeType = nil, nil
    pcall(function()
      targetChar, activeType = getSilentAimTarget()
    end)
    if targetChar and activeType and targetBoxState.frame then
      local posX, posY, width, height = get2DBoundingBox(targetChar)
      if posX and posY and width and height then
        local cfg = (activeType == "Spear") and Settings.SpearSilentAim
          or Settings.RevolverSilentAim
        local colName = cfg.TargetHighlightColor or (activeType == "Spear" and "Red" or "Cyan")
        local col = highlightColors[colName]
          or (activeType == "Spear" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(0, 240, 255))
        targetBoxState.frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, posX, 0, posY)
        targetBoxState.frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, height)
        targetBoxState.frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1.0
        local cornerLen = math.clamp(math.floor(width * 0.25), 6, 16)
        local corners = targetBoxState.corners
        if corners.TL_H then
          corners.TL_H.Size = UDim2.new(0, cornerLen, 0, 2.5)
        end
        if corners.TR_H then
          corners.TR_H.Size = UDim2.new(0, cornerLen, 0, 2.5)
        end
        if corners.BL_H then
          corners.BL_H.Size = UDim2.new(0, cornerLen, 0, 2.5)
        end
        if corners.BR_H then
          corners.BR_H.Size = UDim2.new(0, cornerLen, 0, 2.5)
        end
        if corners.TL_V then
          corners.TL_V.Size = UDim2.new(0, 2.5, 0, cornerLen)
        end
        if corners.TR_V then
          corners.TR_V.Size = UDim2.new(0, 2.5, 0, cornerLen)
        end
        if corners.BL_V then
          corners.BL_V.Size = UDim2.new(0, 2.5, 0, cornerLen)
        end
        if corners.BR_V then
          corners.BR_V.Size = UDim2.new(0, 2.5, 0, cornerLen)
        end
        for _, cornerLine in pairs(corners) do
          if cornerLine then
            cornerLine.BackgroundColor3 = col
            cornerLine.BackgroundTransparency = 0
          end
        end
        targetBoxState.frame.Visible = true
        return
      end
    end
    if targetBoxState.frame and targetBoxState.frame.Visible then
      targetBoxState.frame.Visible = false
    end
  end
  registerConnection(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if updateSilentAimTargetHighlight then
      updateSilentAimTargetHighlight()
    end
  end))
end)()
